titles.summary: Forty year-old Oscar-winning screenwriter George (Dudley Moore) attempts to combat a bout of mid-life crisis by pursuing the woman of his dreams (Bo Derek), even though he first sees her as she is making the way to her own wedding. Tracking the object of his affections to her honeymoon destination in Mexico, George makes several bumbling attempts at seduction, much to the chagrin of his long-suffering girlfriend (Julie Andrews). Blake Edwards' adult comedy was the surprise hit of 1979 and made a Hollywood star of 'Cuddly Dudley'.

titles.title: 101 dalmatians
titles.summary: Classic children's animated adventure based on Dodie Smith's novel. When Roger (voice of Ben Wright) and Anita (Lisa Davis) marry and their dogs Pongo (Rod Taylor) and Perdita (Cate Bauer) produce a litter of 15 Dalmatian puppies, they find themselves receiving unwelcome advances from the evil Cruella de Vil (Betty Lou Gerson). She has plans to turn the pups into a fur coat and when Roger and Anita refuse, she hires two crooks to steal them for her. However, once the theft is revealed, Pongo rallies together a gang of canine friends and sets out on a mission to retrieve his young, discovering them in a lonely mansion, imprisoned along with a further 84 Dalmatian puppies.

titles.title: 101 dalmatians
titles.summary: Roger (Jeff Daniels) and Anita (Joely Richardson) meet and fall in love whilst out walking their dogs, Pongo and Perdy. They are married, and their hounds also prove compatible, producing a litter of fifteen black and white puppies. However, Anita's boss, fashion designer Cruella DeVil (Glenn Close), wants to skin the pups and turn them into a coat. To this end she sends her henchmen Jasper (Hugh Laurie) and Horace (Mark Williams) to kidnap the tiny canines.

titles.title: 102 dalmatians
titles.summary: Freshly-released from prison, the infamous dog-botherer Cruella DeVil (Glenn Close) is apparently a reformed woman. So much so in fact, that she now owns her own dog shelter. But of course, it's not long before she's up to her old tricks, enlisting the help of Parisian designer Le Pelt (Gerard Depardieu), as she again attempts to realise her dream of owning a coat made from the fur of dalmation puppies. Never mind though, probation officer Chloe (Alice Evans) is keeping a watchful eye on Cruella, and with a little canine help she's going to do her best to foil the fur-lover's evil antics.

titles.title: 120 beats per minute
titles.summary: Robin Campillo co-writes and directs this French drama centred on the AIDS epidemic in the 1990s. The film follows a group of activists as they try to effect change as part of the ACT UP movement in Paris. Frustrated by the government and the pharmaceutical industry's lack of action, the guerrilla group stages a number of public protests as they try to agree on a strategy and its passionate members struggle with their own experiences with the deadly virus.

Asif Kapadia directs this blend of documentary and sci-fi dystopian drama set in the year 2073. Ghost (Samantha Morton) is a solitary scavenger trying to survive in a world ravaged by climate change and the breakdown of democracy. As she remembers stories she heard about what the world was like before, she contemplates her harsh existence and reflects on how this nightmarish world came to be.

titles.title: 23 walks
titles.summary: British drama starring Dave Johns and Alison Steadman. Strangers Fern (Steadman) and Dave (Johns) meet in a park in London and over the course of a number of walks with their dogs an unlikely romance blossoms between the elderly pair.

titles.title: 28 years later
titles.summary: Ralph Fiennes, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Jodie Comer star in this third instalment of the post-apocalyptic horror franchise directed by Danny Boyle. Decades after the Rage Virus devastated the country, a group of survivors live on a small island connected to the mainland by a single barricaded causeway. Jamie (Taylor-Johnson) takes his 12-year-old son Spike (Alfie Williams) with him to the mainland to teach him how to kill the infected but when Spike hears rumours of a doctor living on the mainland, he breaks all the rules of his community to find him in the hope that he can help Isla (Comer), his sick mother, to recover. The cast also includes Jack O'Connell, Erin Kellyman and Edvin Ryding.

titles.title: 28 years later: The bone temple
titles.summary: Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams return to star in this fourth instalment of the post-apocalyptic horror franchise directed by Nia DaCosta. As depraved cult leader Sir Lord Jimmy Crystal (O'Connell) inducts Spike (Williams) into his group, Dr. Ian Kelson (Fiennes) continues to bond with the infected Alpha he named Samson (Chi Lewis-Parry). While Kelson learns more about the Rage Virus and the possibility of a cure, Jimmy searches for new offerings and Spike's life descends into a nightmare. The cast also includes Emma Laird, Erin Kellyman and Cillian Murphy.

titles.title: 3 faces
titles.summary: Jafar Panahi co-writes, directs and stars in this Iranian drama. While shooting her latest film, actress Behnaz Jafari receives a video of a young girl in distress, pleading for help and claiming her conservative family is preventing her from realising her dream of studying at a prestigious drama school in Tehran. Joined by Panahi, Jafari sets out to find the girl and travels to her remote mountain village but struggles to track her down and instead finds unhelpful locals unwilling to help her cause.

titles.title: The 400 blows
titles.summary: Francois Truffaut's semi-autobiographical first feature stars Jean-Pierre Léaud as Antoine Doinel, an unruly young Parisian whose unhappiness leads him into trouble. Frequently running away from school and home, Antoine spends much of his time playing with his friends on the steets of the city; but events take a more serious turn when an accusation of plagiarism leads him to quit school and the theft of a typewriter lands him in trouble with the police. Léaud was to reprise his role as Doinel in four further Truffaut-directed adventures: 'Antoine et Colette' (1962), 'Baiser volés' (1968), 'Domicile conjugal' (1970), and 'Love on the Run' (1979).

titles.title: 45 years
titles.summary: Charlotte Rampling and Tom Courtenay star as an aged couple in this British drama written and directed by Andrew Haigh. In the run-up to their 45th wedding anniversary, Kate (Rampling) and Geoff Mercer (Courtenay) are rocked by the news that the body of Geoff's former fiancée has been discovered in the Swiss Alps, 50 years after she disappeared on a walking holiday with Geoff. Although Kate knew of Geoff's first love he kept their engagement a secret. As Geoff reminisces about his past and debates whether to fly to Switzerland to formally identify the body, his wife is left to re-evaluate their long relationship. As Kate finalises preparations for their anniversary party, she begins to delve deeper into her husband's past and makes new discoveries that threaten to spell the end for their 45-years of marriage. Rampling was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actress.

titles.title: The 5th wave
titles.summary: Chloë Grace Moretz stars in this sci-fi thriller based on the novel by Rick Yancey. When an aeroplane falls from the sky, high school student Cassie (Moretz) starts to notice strange things happening around her. Learning that a mysterious wave has hit the Earth wiping out the world's electronic signals, word starts to spread of possible extraterrestrial activity. When a second wave hits, bringing with it an earthquake that shakes the entire planet, terrifying tsunamis follow wiping out towns and cities. A third wave brings devastating diseases that destroy entire populations. As a fourth wave hits, allowing 'the others' to gain access to Earth, fewer and fewer humans are left to fight off the evil that is taking over the planet, but Cassie, along with fellow survivor Evan Walker (Alex Roe), take it upon themselves to do all they can to save the world before the fifth wave hits...

titles.title: 8 days
titles.summary: All eight episodes of the German apocalyptic thriller series. An asteroid is set to hit Europe in eight days putting the entire western side of the continent in immediate danger. With time running out, most people attempt to flee for safety, but for those that cannot make it out, chaos rapidly descends as hedonism, repentance and crime take hold before the inevitable cataclysm unfolds.

titles.title: Across the waters
titles.summary: Nicolo Donato co-writes and directs this Danish wartime drama starring David Dencik and Danica Curcic. With Danish Jews living in fear of deportation to the concentration camps by occupying Nazi forces, Jewish jazz musician Arne Itkin (Dencik) decides the only safe option for his wife Miriam (Curcic) and young son is to flee across the Oresund Strait to Sweden. However, with Gestapo patrols looking to stop any potential escape attempts, Arne and his family are forced to go to extreme lengths in order to achieve their goal. The cast also includes Jakob Cedergren, Nicolas Bro and Morten Holst.

titles.title: Ad astra
titles.summary: Brad Pitt stars in this sci-fi thriller from film-maker James Gray. Two decades after his father left for Neptune on an exploratory space mission never to return, Roy McBride (Pitt) sets out to follow in his footsteps and investigate how his mission might have failed. The cast also includes Tommy Lee Jones, Donald Sutherland and Ruth Negga.

titles.title: The Addams family 2
titles.summary: Greg Tiernan and Conrad Vernon co-direct this computer-animated comedy sequel based on the cartoon strip by Charles Addams. Hoping to spend some quality time with their children, Gomez (voice of Oscar Isaac) and Morticia (Charlize Theron) take Wednesday (Chloë Grace Moretz) and Pugsley (Javon Walton), along with Uncle Fester (Nick Kroll), Thing and Lurch (Vernon), on a road trip across the United States. However, along the way they encounter mad scientist Cyrus Strange (Bill Hader), who claims that Wednesday is his biological daughter.

titles.title: Adult life skills
titles.summary: Rachel Tunnard writes and directs this British comedy starring Jodie Whittaker as a 29-year-old hermit who refuses to move out of her mum's garden shed. Living at the bottom of her mum (Lorraine Ashbourne)'s garden, Anna (Whittaker) spends her days working in a local youth club and her nights making videos with her thumbs as the stars of the show. When her best friend Fiona (Rachael Deering) comes to visit, Anna finds herself looking after her eight-year-old, cowboy-obsessed neighbour Clint (Ozzy Myers), fending off the awkward advances of estate agent Brendan (Brett Goldstein) and forced to confront the tragedy that led her to retreat from society.

titles.title: The adventures of Huck Finn
titles.summary: Disneyfied adaptation of Twain's masterpiece about a friendship between a runaway young ruffian and an escaped slave who, together, take to the Mississippi on a raft and embark on various adventures with crooks, widows, bullies, sheriffs and sailors.

titles.title: The adventures of jurassic pet - Chapter 1
titles.summary: Low budget family drama directed by Ryan Bellgardt. When school boy Chris (Kyler Beck) visits an antique store he comes away with a mysterious object which he later discovers is an unhatched dinosaur egg. Once the dinosaur is born Chris names him Albert and promises to look after him. However, Albert is highly sought after by evil scientist Dr Yost (David Fletcher-Hall) who wishes to use his DNA to create a new species of dinosaur. Can Chris and his friends protect Albert from the clutches of those who wish to do him harm?

titles.title: The adventures of Priscilla, queen of the desert
titles.sortTitle: adventures of priscilla, queen of the desert
titles.summary: Australian comedy starring Hugo Weaving, Guy Pearce and Terence Stamp. When Tick (Weaving) accepts a job offer to perform his drag act in Alice Springs, his friends Bernadette (Stamp) and Adam (Pearce) join him on the journey, which they undertake in a gaudy bus christened Priscilla. During the trip, their friendships are tested and they are subjected to homophobic abuse and violence but they also meet Bob (Bill Hunter), a kindly mechanic who joins them on their journey. As Bernadette and Bob grow closer, Tick has the chance to reconnect with his estranged family.

titles.title: Aferim!
titles.summary: Radu Jude directs and co-writes this drama set in 19th-century Wallachia, Romania. The story follows police officer Costandin (Teodor Corban), who, at the request of nobleman Iordache (Alexandru Dabija), goes in search of his Gypsy slave Carfin (Toma Cuzin), now on the run after getting romantically involved with his boss's wife.

titles.title: The aftermath
titles.summary: James Kent directs this drama adaptation of the book by Rhidian Brook. In the wake of WWII, Rachael Morgan (Keira Knightley) arrives in Hamburg to be with her husband, Lewis (Jason Clarke), a colonel still carrying out work on behalf of the British war effort. Rachael is stunned to learn that the requisitioned home they are moving into still has the owner living there with his daughter, under Lewis's instruction. Before long, Lewis and Rachael begin to feud over his position in Germany and the work he is tasked with carrying out, leading Rachael's attention to be diverted towards Stefan Lubert (Alexander Skarsgård), the owner of the mansion they have took over. The two soon enter a passionate affair, which leaves Rachael questioning her future with Lewis and her own morals.

titles.title: Aftersun
titles.summary: Paul Mescal and Francesca Corio star in this drama from debut filmmaker Charlotte Wells. Gazing at home video footage, Sophie (Celia Rowlson-Hall) recalls a holiday in Turkey with her father (Mescal) 20 years earlier, but the tenuous link between memory and truth is called into question. As Sophie struggles to reconcile her memories with the reality of her father's existence, aspects of her father that were known and unknown, she also must come to terms with her own identity and the desire to better understand herself.

titles.title: Agatha and the truth of murder
titles.sortTitle: agatha and the truth of murder
titles.summary: Terry Loane directs this made-for-TV drama based on true events in 1926 in which well-known crime writer Agatha Christie (Ruth Bradley) must solve a real life murder when a woman is bludgeoned to death on a train. The cast also includes Stacha Hicks, Blake Harrison and Dean Andrews.

titles.title: Agatha Christie: The ABC murders
titles.summary: All three episodes from the British television drama based on the novel by Agatha Christie. When detective Hercule Poirot (John Malkovich) receives letters signed 'A.B.C.' from an unknown sender, he learns there will soon be a spate of murders. When the first victim, Alice Asher (Tamzin Griffin), is found lying next to a travel book known as 'The A.B.C. Railway Guide' with the pages open at the letter A, Poirot must work fast if he is to identify the killer and their intentions before they claim more lives in quick succession.

titles.title: Agatha Christie's crooked house
titles.summary: Glenn Close stars in this crime drama adapted from Agatha Christie's novel. When a wealthy businessman is poisoned in his own home, private detective Charles Hayward (Max Irons) is called in to work the case. As the investigation continues, Charles soon realises the main suspect is the victim's granddaughter Sophia (Stefanie Martini), but he quickly faces difficulties as the rest of the family close ranks around her, leaving Charles unsure of who to trust. The cast also includes Gillian Anderson, Christina Hendricks and Terence Stamp.

titles.title: Aladdin
titles.summary: Disney adaptation of the traditional tale, featuring an Oscar-winning score by Tim Rice and the voice of Robin Williams as the Genie in the lamp. Aladdin (Scott Weinger), a street urchin with a pet monkey called Abu (Frank Welker), one day meets the beautiful Princess Jasmine (Linda Larkin) by chance in the marketplace after she has sneaked out of the royal palace looking for some fun. The sultan's advisor, the evil Jafar (Jonathan Freeman), who is hatching a plot to marry Jasmine and become sultan himself, senses her attraction to the youth and immediately gives orders to throw Aladdin in jail. But when Aladdin discovers a magic lamp in a cave, his quest to defeat Jafar and win the hand of the princess begins.

titles.title: Alexander and the terrible, horrible, no good, very bad day
titles.sortTitle: alexander and the terrible, horrible, no good, very bad day
titles.summary: Steve Carell and Jennifer Garner star in this family comedy based on the children's book by Judith Viorst. Eleven-year-old Alexander Cooper (Ed Oxenbould) has the worst day ever, experiencing one mishap after the other. His dad Ben (Carell), mum Kelly (Garner) and older siblings Anthony (Dylan Minnette) and Emily (Kerris Dorsey) always seem to have sunny dispositions and fail to empathise with his misery. However, when his family find themselves in terrible situations of their own, Alexander begins to understand that to have good days you must also have bad ones. The film co-stars Bella Thorne, Jennifer Coolidge, Megan Mullally and Donald Glover.

titles.title: Alfie
titles.summary: Michael Caine stars in this classic British comedy drama directed by Lewis Gilbert. Based on the play by Bill Naughton, the film follows Alfie Pennyworth (Caine), a streetwise womaniser in 1960s London. His conquests are numerous, from young girlfriend Gilda (Julia Foster) to frustrated housewife Lily (Vivien Merchant), but the chirpy cockney never seems to get any fulfilment from his antics. When Gilda then becomes pregnant and Alfie suffers a health scare, he begins to question his choice of lifestyle. The cast also includes Jane Asher, Shelley Winters and Alfie Bass.

titles.title: Ali
titles.summary: Will Smith stars as legendary boxer Muhammad Ali in this biopic directed by Michael Mann which chronicles a significant decade in Ali's life. In 1964, Cassius Clay defeats Sonny Liston (Michael Bentt) to become the World Heavyweight Champion. Soon afterwards he becomes close to Malcolm X (Mario Van Peebles) and Elijah Muhammad (Albert Hall), the leader of the Nation of Islam, and changes his name to Muhammad Ali. When he refuses to be drafted during the Vietnam War, he is banned from boxing and undertakes a legal battle to appeal his conviction, which entails a five year prison sentence. After he succeeds, he returns to the ring and fights to regain his title, culminating in the 1974 Rumble in the Jungle against George Foreman (Charles Shufford). The cast also includes Jamie Foxx, Jon Voight and Ron Silver.

titles.title: Alice in Wonderland
titles.summary: Tim Burton and Disney join forces for this 3D fantasy adventure based on the characters from the Lewis Carroll classics 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland' and 'Through the Looking Glass'. Mia Wasikowska stars as the nineteen-year-old Alice, who returns to the magical world of her childhood adventure to reunite with her friends the Mad Hatter (Johnny Depp), the White Rabbit (Michael Sheen), Tweedledum and Tweedledee (both played by Matt Lucas), the Dormouse (Barbara Windsor), the Caterpillar (Alan Rickman) and the Cheshire Cat (Stephen Fry). Alice discovers her true destiny as she joins forces with the colourful denizens of Wonderland to overthrow the wicked Red Queen (Helena Bonham Carter).

titles.title: Alice through the looking glass
titles.summary: Mia Wasikowska, Johnny Depp and Helena Bonham Carter reprise their roles in this fantasy adventure sequel based on Lewis Carroll's novel, directed by James Bobin and produced by Tim Burton. Alice (Wasikowska) finds herself in a mysterious, alternate world after going through a mirror and emerging on the other side of the glass. While there she discovers that the Mad Hatter (Depp) is in danger and that Wonderland could be turned into a wasteland by the evil Time (Sacha Baron Cohen). As Alice tries to turn back time in order to save her friend she once again comes face-to-face with the Red Queen (Bonham Carter)... The film also stars Anne Hathaway as the White Queen and Matt Lucas as Tweedledee and Tweedledum while the voice cast includes Alan Rickman as the Caterpillar, Stephen Fry as the Cheshire Cat and Michael Sheen as the White Rabbit.

titles.title: Alita - Battle angel
titles.summary: Robert Rodriguez directs this action adventure co-written and produced by James Cameron. Set hundreds of years in the future following a worldwide disaster, the core of the unconscious cyborg Alita (Rosa Salazar) is discovered lying in a scrapyard within Iron City by a cyborg doctor named Dyson Ido (Christoph Waltz). Once Alita is repaired and rebooted, she is unable to recall her past life and the events of what led to her being destroyed. As Alita begins to explore Iron City, she utilises her astonishing fighting skills to help hunt down criminals and competes in deadly games. However, soon Alita begins to remember her previous life and when challenged by adversaries starts to realise her true purpose.

titles.title: All about my mother
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Pedro Almodóvar. Single mother Manuela (Cecilia Roth) takes her seventeen-year-old son Esteban (Eloy Azorín) to the theatre for his birthday but he is tragically killed when he chases after a taxi carrying his favourite actress, Huma Rojo (Marisa Paredes). Consumed with guilt, Manuela decides to go in search of Esteban's father, who she discovers is now called Lola (Toni Cantó). Together with Lola and a group of new friends including Huma and Rosa (Penélope Cruz), a pregnant and HIV-positive nun, Manuela embarks on a painful journey of self-discovery.

titles.title: All about them
titles.summary: Jérôme Bonnell co-writes and directs this French drama. The film follows twenty-somethings Micha, Mélodie and Charlotte (Félix Moati, Anaïs Demoustier and Sophie Verbeeck). Micha and Charlotte have been in a relationship for four years but difficulty ensues when they both find themselves falling for Mélodie. However, Mélodie is the only one who is aware of the three-pointed affair...

titles.title: All is true
titles.summary: Kenneth Branagh directs and stars in this biographical drama based around the final days in the life of William Shakespeare. Having worked his way up to become a renowned playwright, tragedy strikes when William's theatre, The Globe, burns to the ground. After being on the road with his plays for nearly 20 years, William returns home to his wife Anne (Judi Dench) who now sees him as a stranger. Having never properly dealt with the death of his son 17 years ago, William must now face up to the broken family that he left behind.

titles.title: All of us strangers
titles.summary: Andrew Scott, Paul Mescal, Jamie Bell and Claire Foy star in this drama written and directed by Andrew Haigh. Screenwriter Adam (Scott) is struggling to work on a script drawn from memories of his painful past. Afraid of intimacy, he rejects the advances of his flirtatious neighbour Harry (Mescal), until he encounters his dead parents in his childhood home, looking and living as they did just before they died 30 years ago in an accident when Adam was a boy. As he gets to know his parents and shares his sexuality and other parts of his life now with them, he cautiously begins a relationship with Harry and begins to consider a future with him. However, Adam's ghosts cannot stay with him forever and he must contend with the difficult truths of his new reality.

titles.title: All quiet on the Western Front
titles.sortTitle: all quiet on the western front
titles.summary: Edward Berger directs this adaptation of Erich Maria Remarque's novel about a group of idealistic young Germans recruited to fight on the Western Front in 1917. Amongst their number is the patriotic 17-year-old Paul Baumer (Felix Kammerer), whose preconceptions are rapidly shattered upon witnessing the horror of life in the trenches.

titles.title: Alone in Berlin
titles.summary: Vincent Perez directs this historical drama adapted from Hans Fallada's novel. The film follows the story of working-class couple Otto (Brendan Gleeson) and Anna (Emma Thompson) as they wage an anonymous propaganda war against the Nazis in 1940s Berlin. After receiving news that their only son has been killed in battle the parents are left devastated and angry, blaming the Nazi regime for his untimely death. Looking to get some form of revenge, Otto begins inscribing blank postcards with anti-Nazi rhetoric and leaving them in public places across the city. It's not long before word spreads of the secret resistance movement and police inspector Escherich (Daniel Brühl) is appointed to lead a city-wide manhunt for the mysterious scribe.

titles.title: The Alto Knights
titles.summary: Biographical crime drama from director Barry Levinson. Mob bosses Vito Genovese and Frank Costello (both played by Robert De Niro) both yearn for control over the streets of New York. When one takes out a hit on the other however, the course of organised crime is changed forever. The cast also includes Debra Messing, Kathrine Narducci and Cosmo Jarvis.

titles.title: Amadeus
titles.summary: Milos Forman directs this biopic based on the play by Peter Shaffer which tells the story of the composer Antonio Salieri (F. Murray Abraham) and his relationship to the man he later claims to have murdered, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (Tom Hulce). Having already gained the confidence of the Emperor (Jeffrey Jones), Salieri is frustrated by the arrival of the genius Mozart, a man who quickly usurps his position in the court. His frustration is magnified by both his disapproval of Mozart's vulgar behaviour and by the fact that it is he, more so than anyone else, who can appreciate the true beauty of the young composer's work. When Mozart dies under mysterious circumstances, can it really be Salieri who is to blame?

titles.title: The amateur
titles.summary: Rami Malek and Laurence Fishburne star in this action thriller directed by James Hawes. When his wife Sarah (Rachel Brosnahan) is killed during a terrorist attack in London, CIA analyst Charlie Heller (Malek) is determined to avenge her. When his superiors do not act, he blackmails them into training him to become a killer. As he utilises all of his skills and intelligence to hunt down the people responsible for Sarah's death, he prepares to exact his revenge. The cast also includes Caitríona Balfe, Jon Bernthal and Michael Stuhlbarg.

titles.title: The amazing burping pig
titles.summary: Family feature about a young girl and her friendship with her pet pig. When Talia Rose (Lindsey Blanchard) and her family move to a new city she finds it hard to get used to her new surroundings both at school and at home. Her mum (Jennifer Taylor) and dad (Joey Lawrence) try their best to help Talia and her two sisters get used to their new home but Talia remains down about her lack of friends and the mean bullies at school. That all changes, however, when she finds a miniature pig (voice of Drake Bell) wandering around in her back garden and takes it in as her new pet. After naming it Arlo, Talia and her new pet become best friends and he helps her stand up to her school bullies but how will her family react when they find out they're sharing their new home with a pig?

titles.title: The Amazing Maurice
titles.summary: Animated family adventure based on the novel by Terry Pratchett. Ginger cat Maurice (voice of Hugh Laurie), young human Keith (Himesh Patel) and a gang of rats travel from place to place running successful scams together. When they reach the town of Bad Blintz, they must team up with bookworm Malicia (Emilia Clarke) to take down the villainous Boss Man (David Thewlis). The voice cast also includes Gemma Arterton, Ariyon Bakare, Rob Brydon, Hugh Bonneville and David Tennant.

titles.title: American animals
titles.summary: Bart Layton writes and directs this British-American crime drama starring Evan Peters, Barry Keoghan, Blake Jenner and Jared Abrahamson as four young men who attempt a daring heist. The film follows the four bright students - Warren Lipka (Peters), Spencer Reinhard (Keoghan), Chas Allen (Jenner) and Eric Borsuk (Abrahamson) - at Kentucky's Transylvania University as they hatch a plan to steal a rare multimillion-dollar edition of 'The Birds of America' collection by John James Audebon from their own college library. The boys concoct an elaborate plan to steal the books, which are only guarded by an elderly librarian, however, their knowledge of classic Hollywood crime films might not be enough to ensure they succeed...

titles.title: American pastoral
titles.summary: Ewan McGregor directs and stars in this drama based on the novel by Philip Roth. The film charts the life of Jewish American businessman, and former standout athlete, Seymour 'Swede' Levov (McGregor) whose life begins to unravel during the social and political upheaval of the 1960s. Born and raised in Weequahic, the Jewish neighbourhood of Newark, New Jersey, Swede achieved celebrity status in his local community due to his sports star status, his marriage to former Miss New Jersey, Dawn (Jennifer Connelly), and his place in charge of his father's glove factory. But his perfect upper-class American life comes crashing down when the tensions of the decade tear his country and community apart and his daughter Merry (Dakota Fanning) becomes a radical political activist, with devastating consequences.

titles.title: An American pickle
titles.summary: US comedy drama starring Seth Rogen. In 1920, Eastern Europeans Herschel and Sarah Greenbaum (Rogen and Sarah Snook) immigrate to America in search of a better life and a more prosperous future. Herschel finds a job in a pickle factory, where an accident causes him to fall into a vat of brine only to emerge 100 years later, perfectly preserved. Although he becomes a media sensation, Herschel struggles to adjust to a modern world he does not recognise. However, he is soon introduced to his only living descendant, computer programmer Ben (Rogen), and the two distant relatives attempt to teach each other about life.

titles.title: The American society of magical negroes
titles.summary: Justice Smith and David Alan Grier star in this comedy from film-maker Kobi Libii. Struggling African-American artist Aren (Smith) has been experiencing setbacks, with many being attributed to his race. When he has a chance encounter with bartender Roger (Grier), he is introduced to the American Society of Magical Negroes, an organisation set up to safeguard the world for African Americans by making the lives of white people easier. As he embarks on his new position within the Society, he puts everything and everyone in danger when he develops feelings for a client. The cast also includes An-Li Bogan, Drew Tarver and Rupert Friend.

titles.title: Ammonite
titles.summary: Kate Winslet and Saoirse Ronan star in this romantic drama written and directed by Francis Lee. In Victorian England, renowned palaeontologist Mary Anning (Winslet) scours the southern coast of Lyme Regis collecting fossils and shells to sell to tourists. When Roderick Murchison (James McArdle), a wealthy visitor from London, offers to pay her to look after his ailing wife, Charlotte (Ronan), Mary is unable to turn him down. She reluctantly allows Charlotte to observe her at work, and despite their differences a passionate romance develops between the two women.

holdings.status: In-transit from Jubilee Library to Patcham Library (Set: 06 Jan 2022)

titles.title: Amour
titles.summary: Michael Haneke directs this Academy Award-winning drama exploring death, ageing and the fear of loss. Anne and George (Emmanuelle Riva and Jean-Louis Trintignant) are a couple in their 80s who are enjoying their retirement, but that changes when, after an operation following a stroke, Anne is left wheelchair-bound and paralysed. Although she expresses her wish to die, even going so far as to make an attempt at taking her own life, George tries to remind her of the beauty and worth of life itself and the love that they share for each other. The feature won the Academy Award, a Golden Globe and a BAFTA for Best Foreign Language Film, and received a BAFTA for Best Leading Actress (Riva).

titles.title: Amsterdam
titles.summary: David O. Russell writes and directs this period drama set in the 1930s. Friends since the war, when they served together, lawyer Harold Woodman (John David Washington) and plastic surgeon Burt Berendsen (Christian Bale) are drawn into a mystery, suspected of murder. As they fight to clear their names and identify the real killers, they realise they are caught up in a wider conspiracy. The ensemble cast also includes Margot Robbie, Anya Taylor-Joy, Rami Malek, Mike Myers, Robert De Niro, Chris Rock, Zoe Saldana and Taylor Swift.

titles.title: Anaconda (2025)
titles.summary: Paul Rudd and Jack Black star in this comedy adventure directed by Tom Gormican. Childhood friends Doug (Black), Griff (Rudd), Kenny (Steve Zahn) and Claire (Thandiwe Newton) have always wanted to travel to the Amazon and film an amateur remake of 'Anaconda' (1997). When they finally get the opportunity to realise their dream, the line between fiction and reality blurs as they are terrorised by a real giant anaconda and must fight for their lives. The cast also includes Ice Cube, Daniela Melchior and Selton Mello.

titles.title: Anaïs in love
titles.summary: French comedy drama written and directed by Charline Bourgeois-Tacquet. Anaïs (Anaïs Demoustier) has got problems. Her boyfriend has moved out and she's worried she isn't capable of love. Her mother has cancer, she's behind on the rent and her dissertation isn't going well. She meets Daniel (Denis Podalydès), a man twice her age, and they begin a passionless affair before she becomes obsessed with Daniel's partner Emilie (Valeria Bruni Tedeschi) and pursues her as well.

titles.title: Anatomy of a fall
titles.summary: Justine Triet writes and directs this thriller starring Sandra Hüller, Samuel Theis and Milo Machado Graner. A murder investigation places the victim's wife as the main suspect when a man is mysteriously found lying dead in the snow outside of their isolated chalet. As Sandra (Hüller) works to prove her innocence, she must depend on her blind son, Daniel (Graner), to convey the truth when he is the only witness to his father, Samuel (Theis)'s death. When the police begin to question whether Samuel fell from a height or was pushed, will Daniel's testimony be the key to her freedom or assure her guilt?

titles.title: Anemone
titles.summary: Daniel Day-Lewis co-writes and stars in this drama directed by Ronan Day-Lewis. Jem Stoker (Sean Bean) travels into the woods in northern England to find his estranged brother Ray (Day-Lewis), who withdrew from the world two decades ago. As the two men reconnect, they are forced to reckon with the ghosts of their past and must confront dark truths that have long remained unspoken. Meanwhile, Ray's son Brian (Samuel Bottomley) - raised by Jem all these years - fears that he is doomed to follow in his father's footsteps. Can this fractured family find a way to heal? The cast also includes Samantha Morton and Safia Oakley-Green.

titles.title: The angry birds movie 2
titles.summary: Thurop Van Orman directs this animated sequel based on the mobile app game. Angry birds Red (voice of Jason Sudeikis), Chuck (Josh Gad) and Bomb (Danny McBride) once again team up to protect Bird Island from outsiders. Making unlikely allies in the inhabitants of Piggy Island, with King Pig Leonard (Bill Hader) leading the way, the birds and pigs band together to try to fend off the residents of the new Eagle Island.

titles.title: Annette
titles.summary: Adam Driver and Marion Cotillard star in this musical drama directed by Leos Carax. In Los Angeles, stand-up comedian Henry McHenry (Driver) meets and falls in love with renowned operatic soprano Ann Defrasnoux (Cotillard). As Henry grows increasingly resentful of his wife's success, the couple welcomes an extraordinarily gifted daughter, Annette (Devyn McDowell), into the world.

titles.title: Annihilation
titles.summary: Natalie Portman stars in this US action drama written and directed by Alex Garland. Based on Jeff VanderMeer's novel of the same name, the film follows Lena (Portman), a biologist, as she sets out on a dangerous expedition to the mysterious uninhabited region known as Area X. Accompanied by a psychologist, an anthropologist and a surveyor, Lena desperately searches for clues about her husband Kane (Oscar Isaac) who disappeared while on a similar expedition to Area X some time before. The cast also includes Jennifer Jason Leigh, Gina Rodriguez and Tessa Thompson.

titles.title: Another end
titles.summary: Gael García Bernal, Renate Reinsve and Bérénice Bejo star in this drama directed by Piero Messina. After Sal (Bernal) loses Zoe (Reinsve), the woman he loves, in a car accident, he struggles to move on. His sister Ebe (Bejo) works at Aeternum, a company that pioneered a new technology which allows the memories and personalities of deceased individuals to be placed in a host body so that the bereaved can interact with their loved ones again for a short time. However, when Sal agrees to do this with Zoe, he finds himself falling in love with her all over again and refuses to let her go...

titles.title: Another round
titles.summary: Mads Mikkelsen and Thomas Bo Larsen star in this Danish drama co-written and directed by Thomas Vinterberg. The film follows four friends, who are all teachers, as they decide to test the theory of a Norwegian philosopher who claimed that humans are born with a blood alcohol level that is fractionally too low. By maintaining a constantly elevated blood alcohol level they hope to improve their personal and professional lives, but the experiment's initial success soon sends the men spiralling towards disaster.

titles.title: Ant-Man
titles.summary: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly and Michael Douglas star in this sci-fi action movie following the Marvel Comics superhero. Decades earlier scientist Hank Pym (Douglas) invented a special suit that would allow him to transform to the size of an ant and give him super-strength. The ageing hero approaches petty thief Scott Lang (Rudd) and, with the help of his daughter Hope van Dyne (Lilly), Hank trains him to become the new Ant-Man. After Darren Cross (Corey Stoll) takes over his former mentor Pym's business he produces a similar suit to be worn by the military as well as a more powerful suit for himself, transforming him into Yellowjacket. This results in chaos and it's up to Ant-Man to use both his thieving skills and his new-found abilities to save the day.

titles.title: Ant-Man and the wasp: Quantumania
titles.summary: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly, Michelle Pfeiffer and Michael Douglas reprise their roles in this action adventure sequel directed by Peyton Reed. Scott Lang (Rudd) and his daughter Cassie (Kathryn Newton) find themselves transported to the Quantum Realm along with Hope Van Dyne (Lilly), Hank Pym (Douglas) and Janet Van Dyne (Pfeiffer), where they come up against Kang the Conqueror (Jonathan Majors). As Scott mourns the time he lost with Cassie and Janet is forced to confront her trauma from decades spent trapped in the Quantum Realm, can they thwart Kang's plans? William Jackson Harper and Katy M. O'Brian also star.

titles.title: Anyone but you
titles.summary: Sydney Sweeney and Glen Powell star in this romantic comedy directed by Will Gluck. Bea (Sweeney) and Ben (Powell) enjoy an amazing first date together, until a disastrous misunderstanding ends any hope of a relationship developing between them. When their sisters Claudia (Alexandra Shipp) and Halle (Hadley Robinson) begin dating, Bea and Ben can't avoid each other any longer, but Claudia and Halle's destination wedding in Australia brings the two foes closer than either of them would like. With Ben's ex-girlfriend and Bea's ex-fiancé both also in attendence, and Claudia and Halle desperate for their wedding to proceed without any drama, Bea and Ben decide to pretend to be together, but will their ruse end in love or disaster?

titles.title: Apostasy
titles.summary: Debut film-maker Dan Kokotajlo writes and directs this British drama focusing on a community of Jehovah's Witnesses in north-west England. In Oldham, middle-aged single mother Ivanna (Siobhan Finneran)'s worst fears are realised when her eldest teenage daughter Luisa (Sacha Parkinson) begins to question her faith and then gets pregnant after starting college. If her mother and sister cannot convince her to return to The Truth, they face the difficult obligation to disown Luisa completely. Meanwhile, her younger sister, Alex (Molly Wright), also attracts a male suitor in fellow Jehovah's Witness Steven (Robert Emms). However, despite her devotion to her religion, Alex also struggles to reconcile her beliefs with her personal life and encounters a dilemma that threatens to tear the family apart.

titles.title: The apprentice
titles.summary: Ali Abbassi directs this biographical drama about Donald Trump, specifically his relationship with lawyer Roy Cohn. When Donald Trump (Sebastian Stan) meets Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong) in 1973, they are both equally aware of each other's infamy. With Trump living in the shadow of his property tycoon father, he yearns to make a name for himself and so employs Cohn to help him build his own empire. As the two work together, using unethical, and sometimes illegal, tactics to get what they want, they develop a partnership and make plans for their world domination. The cast also includes Maria Bakalova, Martin Donovan and Catherine McNally.

titles.title: The Apu trilogy: Pather panchali/Aparajito/The world of Apu
titles.sortTitle: apu trilogy: pather panchali/aparajito/the world of apu
titles.summary: Box set featuring all three films in Satyajit Ray's celebrated 'Apu Trilogy'. 'Pather Panchali' (1955) tells the story of a family living in the grip of poverty in a small Bengali village, focusing on the experiences of a young boy, Apu, and paying careful attention to a series of ordinary events: Apu's father sets off to the city in search of work, leaving his wife to take care of the children and an elderly aunt; a frugal meal is prepared; rains flatten the landscape; a train passes by; someone dies. 'Aparajito' (1956) sees Apu move with his family to the busy city of Benares, where they hope to build a new life after suffering a devastating family tragedy. But when Apu's father then dies, the young man decides to head out on his own and attend college in Calcutta, leading to a growing estrangement between himself and his widowed mother. Finally, in 'The World of Apu' (1959), the adult Apu hopes to become a writer, but his lack of finances force him to abandon his university studies. He meets an old friend Pulu and together they travel to the wedding of Pulu's cousin, Aparna. When the bridegroom turns out to be insane and the wedding is cancelled, Apu agrees to marry Aparna to save her from ridicule. They return to his Calcutta apartment to start a new life and Apu comes to love his wife, but his happiness is soon shattered by a tragic turn of events.

titles.title: Aquaman
titles.summary: Jason Momoa stars as the DC Comics superhero in this action adventure directed by James Wan. Heir to the throne of the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, Arthur Curry (Momoa) is raised on the surface world by his human father and trained by Nuidis Vulko (Willem Dafoe) after his mother, Queen Atlanna (Nicole Kidman), is forced to return to her kingdom. When his half-brother Orm (Patrick Wilson) declares war on the surface, Arthur reluctantly embraces his destiny and embarks on a quest with fellow Atlantean Mera (Amber Heard) to find the Trident of Atlan and reclaim his rightful place as King of Atlantis.

titles.title: The Ardennes
titles.summary: Robin Pront directs and co-writes this Belgian crime drama starring Kevin Janssens, Jeroen Perceval and Veerle Baetens. After a robbery gone wrong, Kenneth (Janssens) is imprisoned for four years while his brother Dave (Jeroen Perceval) escapes and takes off with Kenneth's girlfriend Sylvie (Baetens). When Kenneth is released from prison, after failing to cooperate with the police, he's eager to return to his old ways but discovers Dave is a reformed man keen to stay clean. Unsure how his brother will react, Dave can't bring himself to tell Kenny that he and Sylvie are now a couple and expecting a child together. Aware that Kenny's volatility could sink their relationship, Dave dubiously agrees to help his brother cover up his latest crime in the Ardennes forests where they spent their childhood together.

titles.title: Are you there God? It's me, Margaret
titles.sortTitle: are you there god? it's me, margaret
titles.summary: Abby Ryder Fortson and Rachel McAdams star in this US drama based on Judy Blume's novel. 11-year-old Margaret (Fortson) has her life turned upside down when she must move with her parents from New York City to New Jersey, join a new school and make new friends. Despite having no affiliation to any religious model, Margaret begins to talk to God, confiding her hopes and fears and finding out about different forms of worship as she begins a year-long school project. Meanwhile, as Margaret and her new friends learn about puberty and become more aware of boys, they are soon competing with each other to develop quickly. Can God provide Margaret with all the answers to her troubles?

titles.title: The Aristocats
titles.summary: Disney classic that took four years to make. When an eccentric millionairess decides to leaves her money to her cat, Duchess (voiced by Eva Gabor), sneaky butler Edgar decides to dispose of the furry obstacle and claim the loot for himself. The embattled Duchess is helped out by streetwise alley cat Thomas O'Malley (Phil Harris) and his scat cat friends - a group of feline jazz muscians.

titles.title: Armageddon time
titles.summary: A multi-generational examination of 1980s America by writer and director James Gray starring Anne Hathaway, Anthony Hopkins, and Banks Repeta. Paul Graff (Repeta), the younger son of a Ukrainian-Jewish immigrant family, has a passion for art and likes to goof around with his African-American friend Johnny (Jaylin Webb), who comes from a poorer family with restricted social mobility. When Paul and Johnny's antics finally get them into trouble, Paul's parents see it as a sign to send him to an elite private institution wholly disconnected from Paul's own interests.

titles.title: Arrival
titles.summary: Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner and Forest Whitaker star in this sci-fi drama directed by Denis Villeneuve. After mysterious alien spacecraft land on Earth, American linguistics professor Dr Louise Banks (Adams) finds herself working with the army to decode the aliens' communications. Under the command of Colonel Weber (Whitaker), Louise and military scientist Ian Donnelly (Renner) try to learn more about the aliens' language so they can communicate with them and discover why they have come to Earth, before someone else across the globe decides to attack first. But with the CIA and global leaders monitoring their interactions, will they be able to make their breakthrough without any unwanted interference? The film was nominated for nine BAFTAs, including Best Film, Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Leading Actress (Adams), two Golden Globe Awards for Best Performance By an Actress in a Motion Picture - Drama (Adams) and Best Original Score - Motion Picture (Jóhann Jóhannsson), and eight Academy Awards including Best Picture, Best Director (Villeneuve) and Best Adapted Screenplay.

titles.title: Ash is purest white
titles.summary: Zhangke Jia writes and directs this Chinese drama starring Tao Zhao and Fan Liao. Beginning in 2001, the film follows the relationship of gangster Bin (Liao) and his girlfriend Qiao (Zhao). When Bin's life is threatened by members of a rival young gang, Qiao intervenes and is sentenced to five years in jail for her part in the confrontation. When she is released, she goes looking for Bin and eventually finds him in the city of Fengjie, where he lives a peaceful life having turned his back on his criminal past, but will Qiao choose to join him?

titles.title: Ashes in the snow
titles.summary: WWII drama set in Lithuania and Siberia about a young artist named Lina (Bel Powley) who is sent to a remote labour camp along with her family during Stalin's reign of terror. Through her drawings and notes Lina tries to depict the harrowing conditions that her people are made to suffer. The cast also features James Cosmo, Jonah Hauer-King and Lisa Loven Kongsli.

titles.title: The assistant
titles.summary: Julia Garner stars as the titular assistant in this US drama written and directed by Kitty Green. The film follows a day in the life of Jane (Garner), who has been working as an entry-level assistant to an executive at a film production company in New York for two months. As she goes about her day, Jane begins to uncover instances of sexual harassment carried out by her boss.

titles.title: Asterix: The mansions of the gods
titles.sortTitle: asterix: the mansions of the gods
titles.summary: Louis Clichy and Alexandre Astier direct this children's animation based on the comic book series by René Goscinny. Jack Whitehall and Nick Frost voice Asterix and Obelix, the two feisty Gauls in rural Brittany, the last vestige of autonomy from the Romans. Caesar (Jim Broadbent), dissatisfied, sets out a plan to construct a luxurious estate called 'The Mansions of the Gods' to win round the Gauls in the village. Asterix and Obelix, determined to foil Caesar's plot, mobilise the villagers against the Roman encroachment.

titles.title: Asterix: The secret of the magic potion
titles.sortTitle: asterix: the secret of the magic potion
titles.summary: Louis Clichy and Alexandre Astier direct this children's animation based on the comic book series by René Goscinny. Christian Clavier and Guillaume Briat voice Asterix and Obelix, the two feisty Gauls living in rural Brittany free from Roman rule. When the elderly Panoramix (Bernard Alane) breaks his leg Asterix and Obelix seek a young druid capable and worthy of learning the secret magic potion that enables the villagers to live without interference from the Roman army. However, as they set off Asterix and Obelix are met by the invading Romans and they must do all they can to find a young druid before it is too late.

titles.title: Asteroid city
titles.summary: American comedy drama directed and co-written by Wes Anderson. A small desert town in 1950s America, Asteroid City is famous for its observatory and its meteor crater. While the military test atomic weapons nearby, stargazers enjoy views of the night sky and a group of high-school students attend a convention showcasing their inventions. As Augie Steenbeck (Jason Schwartzman) struggles with how to tell his four children that their mother has passed away and that he has brought her ashes along with them, an alien arrives. As Asteroid City is locked down by the military, its inhabitants are left to try and process the otherworldly event they have witnessed. Meanwhile, a television host invites his audience behind the scenes of a new play entitled 'Asteroid City'... The ensemble cast also includes Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hanks, Tilda Swinton, Bryan Cranston and Jeffrey Wright.

titles.title: The astronaut
titles.summary: Kate Mara and Laurence Fishburne star in this sci-fi horror thriller written and directed by Jess Varley. After an incident in space, astronaut Sam Walker (Mara) crashes back to Earth and is found floating in a damaged capsule in the Atlantic Ocean. Placed in a safe house to quarantine while the circumstances of her return are investigated, she begins experiencing strange phenomena. Unsure of who she can trust, she fears that something terrifying has followed her back to Earth. The cast also includes Gabriel Luna and Ivana Milicevic.

titles.title: The astronaut lovers
titles.summary: Lautaro Bettoni and Javier Orán star in this Spanish-language romantic comedy drama written and directed by Marco Berger. When Pedro (Orán) returns to his home in Argentina to spend time with his friends and family, he reunites with his childhood friend Maxi (Bettoni). Pedro is a proud gay man while Maxi has always dated women but when Maxi learns that his ex-girlfriend is also in town, he asks Pedro to pretend to be his boyfriend to make her jealous. However, as the banter and tension between them escalates, Maxi is forced to question what he truly wants.

titles.title: At eternity's gate
titles.summary: Willem Dafoe stars as Vincent van Gogh in this biographical drama. Set in the painter's final years, the film follows van Gogh as he leaves Paris and settles in the town of Arles in the south of France. There, he enjoys an extraordinarily creative period and ponders the philosophical nature of his work. After once again succumbing to his mental demons, van Gogh is hospitalised in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence but continues to paint in his recent rich creative vein before being discharged to live out his final days.

titles.title: Atomic blonde
titles.summary: Charlize Theron and James McAvoy star in this thriller directed by David Leitch. Based on Antony Johnston's graphic novel of the same name, the story follows Lorraine Broughton (Theron), an elite MI6 spy tasked with taking down a secretive organisation responsible for the murder of an undercover agent in Berlin. With the Cold War coming to an end and allegiances shifting in the city, Broughton reluctantly joins up with local station chief David Percival (McAvoy) to conduct the investigation. However, with a missing list of double agents putting the West's entire intelligence network in serious danger, the pair must put their differences aside and work together in order to achieve their objectives. The cast also includes John Goodman, James Faulkner and Sofia Boutella.

titles.title: Avatar: Fire and ash
titles.summary: Third instalment of the sci-fi action adventure franchise co-written and directed by James Cameron. Jake (Sam Worthington), Neytiri (Zoe Saldana) and their children have settled into life with the Metkayina clan but are struggling to cope with their grief following the death of Neteyam. When Miles Quaritch (Stephen Lang) allies himself with Varang (Oona Chaplin), the leader of the aggressive, volcano-dwelling Mangkwan clan, the battle for the future of Pandora intensifies with devastating consequences. The cast also includes Kate Winslet, Sigourney Weaver and Britain Dalton.

titles.title: Avatar: The way of water
titles.summary: Sci-fi action adventure sequel co-written and directed by James Cameron. 12 years after the Na'vi defeated the humans invading Pandora, Jake Sully (Sam Worthington) and Neytiri (Zoe Saldana) are living happily with their family. When the humans return, determined to make Pandora their new home, Jake leads the fight against them but the family is soon forced to leave their tribe and seek sanctuary with the oceanic Metkayina clan. The cast also includes Stephen Lang, Sigourney Weaver, Cliff Curtis and Kate Winslet.

titles.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
titles.summary: Robert Downey Jr, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Evans and Scarlett Johansson reprise their roles as the Marvel superheroes in this action sequel written and directed by Joss Whedon. In an attempt to bring peace to the world Tony Stark aka Iron Man (Downey Jr) creates Ultron (voice of James Spader), a robot with artificial intelligence. However, instead of protecting humans, Ultron believes the only way to restore peace to Earth is to eliminate its citizens. The Avengers - Iron Man, Thor (Hemsworth), the Hulk (Ruffalo), Captain America (Evans), Black Widow (Johansson) and Hawkeye (Jeremy Renner) - team up once again to save the day, but can they defeat Ultron before he obliterates the human race? The cast also includes Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Elizabeth Olsen, Paul Bettany, Cobie Smulders and Samuel L. Jackson.

titles.title: Avengers: Endgame
titles.summary: Robert Downey Jr, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Evans and Brie Larson reprise their roles as the Marvel superheroes in this action sequel directed by Anthony and Joe Russo. Following on from 'Avengers: Infinity War' (2018), the surviving Avengers attempt to undo the destruction caused by Thanos (Josh Brolin) and the Infinity Stones.

holdings.status: In-transit from Portslade Library to Hove Library (Set: 22 Nov 2024)

titles.title: Avengers: Infinity war
titles.summary: Robert Downey Jr, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Evans and Chris Pratt reprise their roles as the Marvel superheroes in this action sequel directed by Anthony and Joe Russo. With the future of the universe coming under threat from the powerful Thanos (Josh Brolin), the Avengers and their allies must join together and put their lives on the line as they bid to put a stop to Thanos's evil schemes. The cast also includes Benedict Cumberbatch, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hiddleston and Chadwick Boseman.

titles.title: Awesome adventures: Races, chases and rescues
titles.sortTitle: awesome adventures: races, chases and rescues
titles.summary: Seven adventures from a selection of children's favourite animated shows. The episodes are: 'Play Time' and 'Hiro Helps Out' from 'Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends'; 'Roley's Rovers' and 'Lofty and the Monster' from 'Bob the Builder'; 'Floating Cart' and 'When Fools Rush In' from 'Fireman Sam'; and 'Trollee in Trouble' from 'Mike the Knight'.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 31 May 2013); In-transit from Saltdean Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 09 Oct 2021)

titles.title: Azor
titles.summary: Fabrizio Rongione and Stéphanie Cléau star in this drama directed by Andreas Fontana. In 1980, Swiss banker Yvan De Wiel (Rongione) travels to Argentina with his wife Inés (Cléau) to reassure his wealthy clients following the disappearance of his colleague in Buenos Aires.

titles.title: Babette's feast
titles.summary: Writer/director Gabriel Axel's Oscar-winning film is set in 19th-century Denmark. Babette (Stéphane Audran), a chef and refugee from France's civil war, finds herself in a remote Danish hamlet working for two sisters who preside over its inhabitants. The sisters were brought up under the strict regime of their devout father who preached salvation through self-denial and have kept his teachings going even after his death. But Babette's arrival is set to change the status quo when she cooks a sumptuous meal for the sisters and their friends.

titles.title: Baby done
titles.summary: New Zealand comedy starring Rose Matafeo and Matthew Lewis. Carefree adventurer Zoe (Matafeo) has her life upended when she discovers she is pregnant. While her boyfriend Tim (Lewis) relishes the prospect of becoming a father, Zoe remains reluctant to give up her current lifestyle and embrace motherhood.

titles.title: Babygirl
titles.summary: Nicole Kidman and Harris Dickinson star in this erotic thriller from director and writer Halina Reijn. CEO Romy Mathis (Kidman) is dissatisfied with her marital sex life and so when a young and handsome intern shows an interest in her, the two embark on a torrid affair, putting her career and marriage in jeopardy. The cast also includes Antonio Banderas, Sophie Wilde and Leslie Silva.

titles.title: Babylon
titles.summary: Period drama written and directed by Damien Chazelle set in Hollywood in the late 1920s. Stars rise and fall as the industry transitions from silent films to sound during an era of unchecked ambition, chaos and excess. Jack Conrad (Brad Pitt)'s star is waning while Nellie LaRoy (Margot Robbie) is about to make it big. Manny Torres (Diego Calva) is working his way from elephant-wrangling onto film sets and can't help but fall in love with Nellie, but Hollywood can crush dreams as easily as grant them. Jean Smart, Li Jun Li and Jovan Adepo also star.

titles.title: Babyteeth
titles.summary: Shannon Murphy directs this Australian comedy starring Ben Mendelsohn, Essie Davis and Eliza Scanlen. Teenager Milla (Scanlen) is suffering from cancer when she falls in love for the first time, though her choice of partner, the enigmatic and apparently homeless Moses (Toby Wallace), is not met with approval from her parents, Henry (Mendelsohn) and Anna (Davis). Not wishing to impose themselves too strongly on their daughter's choice Henry and Anna allow him to stay in the house, but his residency in their home is not without problems.

titles.title: Back to black
titles.summary: Marisa Abela stars as the late British musician Amy Winehouse in this biopic directed by Sam Taylor-Johnson. The film follows the star's rise to success from an aspiring singer as an adolescent through to her troubled final years in her mid-twenties as she struggles with drug and alcohol addiction and a volatile relationship with her husband, Blake Fielder-Civil (Jack O'Connell). Despite battling her demons, Amy's albums 'Back to Black' and 'Rehab' earn her numerous awards and catapult her into music stardom. The cast also includes Eddie Marsan, Lesley Manville and Juliet Cowan.

titles.title: The bad guys
titles.summary: Pierre Perifel directs this animated comedy adventure featuring the voice talents of Sam Rockwell, Awkwafina and Richard Ayoade. Mr. Wolf (voice of Rockwell) leads a group of criminals called the Bad Guys but when they are finally caught, he makes a deal to keep them out of prison. While they pretend to be reformed, they are framed for a crime they did not commit and their bonds of friendship are tested. Now they must decide once and for all if they are going to continue being the Bad Guys or if they will choose to be truly good. The voice cast also includes Zazie Beetz, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson.

titles.title: The bad guys 2
titles.summary: Pierre Perifel directs this animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Sam Rockwell, Awkwafina and Danielle Brooks. Led by Mr. Wolf (voice of Rockwell), the Bad Guys are doing their best to live as Good Guys now but they are struggling to find work because people don't trust them. When Kitty Kat (Brooks), the leader of the Bad Girls, forces the Bad Guys to attempt a daring heist, will they succeed in sabotaging her evil scheme and finally proving to the world that they are truly good? The voice cast also includes Marc Maron, Craig Robinson and Anthony Ramos.

titles.title: Bad times at the El Royale
titles.sortTitle: bad times at the el royale
titles.summary: Jeff Bridges, Jon Hamm and Cynthia Erivo star in this thriller written and directed by Drew Goddard. In the late 1960s, seven strangers cross paths at the El Royale, a neglected hotel on the border between California and Nevada. They all have something to hide and over the course of one shocking night, their long-held secrets will be revealed. In the ensuing chaos and violence, not everyone will survive... The cast also includes Chris Hemsworth, Dakota Johnson, Cailee Spaeny and Lewis Pullman.

titles.title: Bait
titles.summary: Edward Rowe stars in this drama written and directed by Mark Jenkin. Despite having sold his parents' cottage to a wealthy couple from London, Cornish fisherman Martin (Rowe) is still struggling to save enough money to buy himself a boat. As the tourist season begins and visitors start flocking to the coast, Martin can't hide his anger and growing resentment at the changes being made in the name of tourism. The cast also includes Simon Shepherd, Mary Woodvine and Georgia Ellery.

titles.title: The ballad of Lefty Brown
titles.summary: American Western in which ageing cowboy Lefty Brown (Bill Pullman) sees his friend murdered before his very eyes. Following his death he sets out to avenge him and bring the killers to justice, despite having previously resigned himself to slowing down in life and allowing younger men to fill his shoes. While Lefty scours the plains of Montana for the ruthless murderers, unbeknown to him he is being accused of the crime himself. Will Lefty prove his innocence and finally be able to produce the true ones to blame at the mercy of the law?

titles.title: The ballad of Wallis Island
titles.summary: British comedy drama written by and starring Tom Basden and Tim Key. Charles (Key) won the lottery and, with his winnings, bought the remote Wallis Island off the coast of Wales where he now lives alone following the death of his wife. His dream is to reunite his favourite band, McGwyer Mortimer, and so he invites both former members to the island to perform a one-off show. Although both Herb McGwyer (Basden) and Nell Mortimer (Carey Mulligan), who broke up both personally and professionally, accept his invitation, old tensions soon flare between them and things don't go exactly as Charles had planned. The cast also includes Sian Clifford, Akemnji Ndifornyen and Kerrie Thomason.

titles.title: Ballerina: From the world of John Wick
titles.sortTitle: ballerina: from the world of john wick
titles.summary: Ana de Armas stars in this fifth instalment of the action thriller franchise which serves as a spin-off set between the events of 'John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum' (2019) and 'John Wick: Chapter 4' (2023). After her father is murdered, Eve Macarro (de Armas) is schooled in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma. Alongside ballet, she trains in weaponry and martial arts but she remains haunted by the loss of her father. When she has proven herself capable, she embarks on a quest to take down the people responsible for his murder. The cast also includes Anjelica Huston, Gabriel Byrne and Keanu Reeves.

titles.title: Balloon
titles.summary: German thriller set in 1979 following two families as they attempt to flee East Germany in a hot air balloon. At the height of the Cold War, two families living in Thüringen decide to join forces to build a hot air balloon and fly over the border into West Germany in search of a better life. When their first attempt to flee the authoritarian GDR falters, the families are forced back to the drawing board to take to the skies in a new balloon before the Stasi closes in on their plan.

titles.title: Bambi
titles.summary: Classic Disney animated feature. The film follows young male deer Bambi (voices of Bobby Stewart/Donnie Dunagan/Hardie Albright/John Sutherland) from his birth and woodland childhood with friends Thumper (Peter Behn/Tim Davis/Sam Edwards) and Flower (Stan Alexander/Davis/Sterling Holloway), through to his ascendancy into the tall, antlered Prince of the Forest who finds love with the beautiful Faline (Cammie King/Ann Gillis). However, when he tragically loses his mother to hunters, Bambi must summon enough bravery to lead the rest of the animals to safety.

titles.title: Bambi 2 - The great prince of the forest
titles.sortTitle: bambi 2 - the great prince of the forest
titles.summary: Eagerly-awaited sequel to the classic 40s animated feature. Join Bambi (voice of Alexander Gould) as he reunites with his father, The Great Prince (Patrick Stewart), who must now raise the young fawn and teach him the way of the forest. But, in the adventure of a lifetime, the proud parent discovers that there is much more he can learn from his spirited young son.

titles.title: Bambi: A tale of life in the woods
titles.sortTitle: bambi: a tale of life in the woods
titles.summary: Mylène Farmer narrates this live-action adaptation of the novel by Felix Salten. As young fawn Bambi grows older, he must navigate many challenges including the loss of his mother and finding a mate. Meanwhile, although his forest home is beautiful and he has found many friends there, he must also face the dangers it holds including human hunters.

titles.title: Bambi/Bambi 2 - The great prince of the forest
titles.sortTitle: bambi/bambi 2 - the great prince of the forest
titles.summary: Double bill of two popular animated adventures. 'Bambi' (1942) follows young male deer Bambi from his birth and woodland childhood with friends Thumper the rabbit and Flower the skunk, through to his ascendancy into tall, antlered adulthood. Along the way he tragically loses his mother to hunters and finds love with the beautiful Faline. In 'Bambi 2 - The Great Prince of the Forest' (2005) Bambi (voice of Alexander Gould) reunites with his father, The Great Prince (Patrick Stewart), who must now raise the young fawn and teach him the way of the forest. But, in the adventure of a lifetime, the proud parent discovers that there is much more he can learn from his spirited young son.

titles.title: Bananas
titles.summary: Woody Allen co-writes, directs and stars in this comedy. Puny New Yorker and gadget tester Fielding Mellish (Allen) is in love with Nancy (Louise Lasser), a beautiful political activist who is obsessed by the battles being waged in San Marcos between the dictator General Vargas (Carlos Montalban) and his revolutionary opponents. In an audacious attempt to impress his beloved, Fielding makes for San Marcos and in a bizarre and bewildering series of events, ends up becoming the president of the country.

titles.title: The banshees of Inisherin
titles.summary: Martin McDonagh writes and directs this black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell and Brendan Gleeson. Neighbours Pádraic (Farrell) and Colm (Gleeson) have always been friends, until one day Colm abruptly declares that their friendship is over and he wants nothing more to do with Pádraic. Confused and upset, Pádraic tries to repair their relationship, but Colm threatens violence unless Pádraic leaves him alone. Kerry Condon and Barry Keoghan also star.

titles.title: Barb & Star go to Vista Del Mar
titles.sortTitle: barb & star go to vista del mar
titles.summary: Annie Mumolo and Kristen Wiig co-write and star in this US comedy. When they both lose their jobs, lifelong friends Barb and Star (Mumolo and Wiig) leave their hometown of Soft Rock, Nebraska for the first time and head to Vista Del Mar, Florida for a week-long holiday. When they arrive at the Palm Vista Hotel, the Midwestern duo find themselves in the middle of Sharon Gordon Fisherman (Wiig)'s vengeful plot to destroy Vista Del Mar while they vie for the attention of her attractive partner in crime, Edgar Paget (Jamie Dornan).

titles.title: Barbie
titles.summary: Margot Robbie stars as the eponymous fashion doll in this live-action adventure directed by Greta Gerwig. Barbie and her friends (also all called Barbie) live in Barbie Land, a world made perfect for Barbies, where Ken (Ryan Gosling) and all the other Kens live in adoration of their female counterparts. Though Barbie is thriving in the brightly-coloured utopia of Barbie Land where Barbies can be anything they want to be, she begins to be troubled by dark and deep thoughts that make her question what lies beyond her world. Determined to answer life's biggest questions, she sets off on a journey which takes her into the human world, where she soon learns that life as a woman isn't quite built for Barbies... The all-star cast also includes Will Ferrell, America Ferrera, Issa Rae and Dua Lipa.

titles.title: Basil the Great Mouse Detective
titles.summary: Sherlock Holmes' mouse counterpart Basil lives in the basement of 221B Baker Street, just below the great man himself. Hired to locate a kidnapped toymaker, Basil and his trusty sidekick Dawson soon find themselves up against their arch-enemy Professor Ratigan. It seems Ratigan wants to use the toymaker to make a mechanical replica of the Queen who will then bestow the villain with the right to rule over rodent London - but not if Basil can find a way to stop him.

titles.title: The Batman
titles.summary: Matt Reeves directs this action adventure starring Robert Pattinson as the DC Comics superhero. In his second year of fighting crime in Gotham City, masked vigilante Batman hunts down a sadistic serial killer known as the Riddler (Paul Dano), who is on a mission to expose the widespread corruption within the city's elite. Working with GCPD lieutenant James Gordon (Jeffrey Wright) and cat burglar Selina Kyle (Zoë Kravitz), the dark knight's search for the Riddler leads him to uncover a conspiracy connected to his own family. The cast also includes Andy Serkis, Colin Farrell and John Turturro.

titles.title: Batman ninja
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure featuring the caped crusader in Japan. When Gorilla Grodd (voice of Fred Tatasciore)'s time displacement machine malfunctions, Batman (Roger Craig Smith) is sent back in time to feudal Japan along with a number of his most fearsome enemies. Each of the villains seeks to rule a piece of the divided land, led by Batman's arch nemesis the Joker (Tony Hale), who wants to take all of the land for himself. However, Catwoman (Grey Griffin), Nightwing (Adam Croasdell), Robin (Yuri Lowenthal), Red Hood (Will Friedle) and Red Robin (also Friedle) all join the dark knight to defeat his greatest adversaries and help him find a way back home.

titles.title: Batman: Assault on Arkham
titles.summary: Animated feature from Jay Olivia and Ethan Spaulding. When Amanda Waller (voiced by CCH Pounder) and Harley Quinn (Hynden Walch) get together to form the Suicide Squad, whose number one ambition is to break in to the Arkham Asylum to retrieve information from the Riddler (Matthew Gray Gubler), the accidental freeing of the Joker (Troy Baker) results in Batman (Kevin Conroy) being alerted to their premeditated crime. Can the caped superhero stop them before serious damage is done?

titles.title: Battleship Potemkin
titles.summary: Sergei M. Eisenstein directs this silent drama centred on the naval mutiny and street riots at the seaport of Odessa that sparked the 1905 Russian Revolution. When the crew of the Battleship Potemkin protest after being given rotten meat as rations, the captain responds by ordering the execution of the dissidents. Outrage at this injustice quickly ignites and the townspeople surround the harbour in a mass demonstration. However, when the authorities move to quell the uprising, brutality and tragedy ensue.

titles.title: Be cool Scooby-Doo!: Season 1 - volume 1
titles.summary: Seven episodes from the children's animated series following the gang of mystery solvers. After completing their last year of high school Shaggy (voice of Matthew Lillard), Fred (Frank Welker), Daphne (Grey Griffin) and Velma (Kate Micucci), along with Scooby-Doo (also Welker), spend their final summer as a group on an adventure aboard the Mystery Machine, coming face-to-face with a number of monsters and ghouls on the way.

titles.title: Beast
titles.summary: Jessie Buckley and Johnny Flynn star in this British drama written and directed by Michael Pearce. Set in Jersey, the film follows Moll (Buckley), a young girl haunted by events from her past who strikes up a relationship with mysterious poacher Pascal (Flynn). However, when a number of young girls are murdered, the police soon turn their attention to Pascal, leaving Moll facing some big decisions as she goes against the wishes of her family to stand by her man. The cast also includes Geraldine James and Charley Palmer Rothwell.

titles.title: Beast of war
titles.summary: Mark Coles Smith stars in this Australian action horror written and directed by Kiah Roache-Turner. In 1942, a ship carrying troops across the Timor Sea to the frontlines is sunk by the Japanese. A handful of survivors including Leo (Coles Smith) and his friend Will (Joel Nankervis) float on a raft made from the wreckage but their nightmare is far from over. When a great white shark begins hunting them, they are caught in a desperate battle for survival. The cast also includes Steve Le Marquand, Lee Tiger Halley and Sam Delich.

titles.title: Beats
titles.summary: Scottish coming-of-age drama set in West Lothian in the 1990s and directed by Brian Welsh. Best friends Johnno (Cristian Ortega) and Spanner (Lorn Macdonald) promise to make the most of what may be their final summer together as Johnno is set to move to a newly built suburb with his mother Alison (Laura Fraser) and stepfather Robert (Brian Ferguson). When the teenagers find out about an illegal rave happening they see it as a fitting way to culminate their friendship as they revel in the dance and techno music that they both love. The cast also features Ryan Fletcher, Martin Donaghy and Amy Manson.

titles.title: Beautiful boy
titles.summary: Steve Carell and Timothée Chalamet star in this American biographical drama based on the memoirs of David and Nic Sheff (Carell and Chalamet/Jack Dylan Grazer/Zachary Rifkin/Kue Lawrence). The film follows David as he tries to save his son Nic from a crippling drug addiction that threatens to destroy his life. When he first realises Nic has been using drugs David sends him to a rehab facility for immediate treatment, beginning a long cycle of relapse and rehabilitation, while David relentlessly searches for solutions to save his son and realises his attempts are ultimately doomed to fail.

titles.title: A beautiful day in the neighbourhood
titles.summary: Tom Hanks and Matthew Rhys star in this biographical drama about children's television presenter Fred Rogers (Hanks). Assigned to write an article about heroes, journalist Lloyd Vogel (Rhys) interviews much-loved broadcaster Fred Rogers, star of 'Mister Rogers' Neighborhood'. Struggling with problems in his personal life, Lloyd doubts the authenticity of the kindly presenter, but when he seizes the opportunity to get Fred's opinion on his family issues, he begins to see what everyone else sees in Mister Rogers.

titles.title: Beauty and the beast
titles.summary: Bill Condon directs this fantasy adaptation of Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont's fairy tale which stars Emma Watson and Dan Stevens in the title roles. When a prince is turned into a hideous beast by a magical spell, he finds that the only way out of his predicament is to win the love of the beautiful Belle (Watson). Belle agrees to stay at his castle in exchange for the freedom of her father, whom the Beast (Stevens) had previously captured after finding him in the castle grounds. At first she is repulsed by his hideous features, but as time passes she learns to recognise his true inner beauty, much to the disgust of local hunter Gaston (Luke Evans), who wants to take Belle for himself. In a fit of jealous rage, Gaston rallies the local villagers into a mob by convincing them that the Beast is an evil monster, and attempts to storm the castle in a bid to get rid of him once and for all. The cast also includes the voice talents of Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen.

titles.title: Beauty and the Beast (Disney)
titles.summary: Disney animated adaptation of Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont's classic fairy tale. When a prince is turned into a hideous beast by a magical spell, he finds that the only way out of his predicament is to win the love of the beautiful Belle (voice of Paige O'Hara). Belle agrees to stay at his castle in exchange for the freedom of her father, whom the Beast (Robby Benson) had previously held captive. At first she is repulsed by his hideous features, but as time passes she learns to recognise his true inner beauty, much to the disgust of local hunter Gaston (Richard White) who wants to take Belle for himself.

titles.title: Beauty and the Beast: The enchanted Christmas
