titles.sortTitle: beauty and the beast: the enchanted christmas
titles.summary: A straight-to-video parallel storyline to the Disney smash hit 'Beauty and the Beast'. Returning to the time when Belle was imprisoned in the Beast's castle, the film tells of the young woman's attempts to bring some Christmas cheer to her surroundings, even though the Beast doesn't like the festive season. To this end, Belle invites all the enchanted objects from the castle to help, encouraging them to sing and dance so that the spirit of Yuletide might thaw the Beast's heart.

titles.title: The bed sitting room
titles.summary: Richard Lester's late 1960s cult comedy, set during the aftermath of a nuclear explosion which ended WWIII, follows those who have survived in what is left of England enduring spontaneous mutations into various creatures and objects. The film is based on the play written by Spike Milligan and John Antrobus and stars some of Britain's best known comedians, including Peter Cook, Dudley Moore and the aforementioned Milligan.

titles.title: Bedknobs and broomsticks
titles.summary: In 1940 three English children are evacuated from London, only to discover the lady they're staying with (Angela Lansbury) is a witch - but a good one. With the aid of her spells and a magic bed, the children visit an undersea kingdom, witness a football match played by teams of wild cartoon animals, and successfully thwart a Nazi invasion of Britain. Live action and animation are combined in this Oscar-winning Disney film, which also features the songs 'Portobello Road' (as performed by the spiv Bruce Forsyth) and 'The Beautiful Briny Sea'.

titles.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
titles.summary: Michael Keaton reprises his eponymous role in this sequel to the 1988 dark comedy. Following the death of her father, Lydia Deetz (Winona Ryder) returns to Winter River with her mother Delia (Catherine O'Hara) and estranged daughter Astrid (Jenna Ortega). Although she feels like she doesn't fit in with her family, Astrid discovers that she has inherited her mother's powers of being able to see and speak to the dead. She soon finds herself summoning Beetlejuice after she is lured to the afterlife by Jeremy (Arthur Conti), to whom she has taken a shine. When Lydia learns that Jeremy died following a police chase after he killed his parents, she reluctantly seeks Beetlejuice's help in saving her daughter. The cast also includes Justin Theroux, Willem Dafoe and Monica Bellucci.

titles.title: Bel ami
titles.summary: Robert Pattinson and Uma Thurman star in this sumptuous Paris-set period drama based on the novella by Guy de Maupassant. Georges Duroy (Pattinson) is a suave and handsome young journalist using his wits and powers of manipulation to make his way in 1890s Paris. In order to ascend the social ladder, Duroy seduces a string of influential society beauties including Madeleine Forestier (Thurman), Virginie Walters (Kristen Scott Thomas) and Clotilde de Marelle (Christina Ricci). His peasant background has soon become a distant memory as he achieves dizzying success both in his career and in fashionable society.

titles.title: Belfast
titles.summary: Kenneth Branagh writes and directs this coming-of-age comedy drama centred on a working-class family in 1960s Belfast. Nine-year-old Buddy (Jude Hill) grows up in a crowded council house which he shares with his loving family: Ma (Caitriona Balfe), Pa (Jamie Dornan), who frequently travels to England for work, Granny (Judi Dench) and Pop (Ciarán Hinds). As violence engulfs the city, the Protestant family considers leaving their home in Belfast for the safety of England. Meanwhile, Buddy seeks the advice of his Pop to win the affections of a Catholic classmate before finding trouble with local girl Moira (Lara McDonnell).

titles.title: Belle epoque
titles.summary: A nostalgic Spanish comedy set in 1931. Fernando (Jorge Sanz), a deserter from the Spanish Army hides in a country house with an elderly man and his four beautiful daughters. During his sojourn at the house he becomes romantically entangled with all of the various daughters, but must eventually decide which of the daughters he intends to marry...Winner of the Best Foreign Film Oscar.

titles.title: Benediction
titles.summary: Jack Lowden and Peter Capaldi star as English war poet Siegfried Sassoon in this biographical drama directed by Terence Davies. The film follows Sassoon as he returns home after fighting in the First World War, decorated for his bravery while serving on the Western Front but declining to return to battle. While interned in a military psychiatric hospital, Sassoon struggles to come to terms with his homosexuality and meets fellow writer Wilfred Owen (Matthew Tennyson) before marrying Hester Gatty (Kate Phillips/Gemma Jones) and experiencing a crisis of faith later in his life.

titles.title: Benjamin
titles.summary: British comedy drama written and directed by Simon Amstell. Benjamin (Colin Morgan) is a promising film-maker who is filled with angst about the upcoming premiere of his second feature and how it will be received. At the premiere he is introduced to charismatic French singer Noah (Phénix Brossard) and a flourishing romance develops between the pair.

titles.title: Bergman island
titles.summary: Vicky Krieps, Tim Roth and Mia Wasikowska star in this drama written and directed by Mia Hansen-Love. The film follows film-making couple Chris and Tony Sanders (Krieps and Roth) as they travel to the Swedish island of Fårö, the former home of Ingmar Bergman, to take part in a residency programme. As they share their respective screenplays with one another, the line between fiction and reality begins to blur.

titles.title: Best friends
titles.summary: Animal adventure feature. This is the tale of a group of best friends as they each embark on their own unique journey and adventure on their way to a weekend camping trip. Once they arrive at their favourite spot in the wild, the gang get up to all kinds of different adventures including swimming, hunting and telling stories round the campfire.

titles.title: Better man
titles.summary: Michael Gracey directs this fantastical biographical drama following the life and career of Robbie Williams. Portrayed by a CGI-animated chimpanzee, Robbie (voice of Williams)'s story is told from the beginning as a child intent on being famous and his achievement of a place in the five-piece boyband Take That. The cast also features Raechelle Banno as Nicole Appleton, Jake Simmance as Gary Barlow and Steve Pemberton as Robbie's father Peter.

titles.title: Beyond suspicion
titles.summary: Thriller in which an ex-police detective sets out to seek vengeance on those who wronged him and killed his partner. When his path of retribution directs him to a murder plot involving a car bomb, Danny Gallagher (Karl Urban) uncovers that the victim was involved in an affair with federal agent Rebecca (Sofía Vergara). Can Danny trust her to guide him in the right direction or will he end up going against his mentor Jimmy (Andy Garcia)'s advice and turn rogue?

titles.title: The BFG
titles.summary: Steven Spielberg directs this adaptation of Roald Dahl's novel starring Mark Rylance as the Big Friendly Giant. The film follows Sophie (Ruby Barnhill) as she is whisked away from her orphanage by the BFG and taken to Giant Country where she is immediately at risk of being eaten by the other, larger giants, including Fleshlumpeater (Jemaine Clement) and Bloodbottler (Bill Hader). Together, Sophie and the BFG go on an adventure to Dream Country where they capture dreams for the BFG to give to all of the human world's sleeping children. After coming up with a cunning plan, the pair head back to London to see if the Queen (Penelope Wilton) can help them tackle the problem of the bullying, child-eating giants.

titles.title: A big bold beautiful journey
titles.summary: Margot Robbie and Colin Farrell star in this fantasy drama directed by Kogonada. When Sarah (Robbie) and David (Farrell) meet at a wedding there is an immediate spark between them but although they are both single, they each find committed and meaningful relationships difficult. They cross paths again soon afterwards and undertake a road trip together which leads them to revisit significant moments from their pasts. Will the wisdom they gain from the experience give them a chance at finding happiness together? The cast also includes Phoebe Waller-Bridge, Kevin Kline and Hamish Linklater.

titles.title: Big boys
titles.summary: Isaac Krasner stars in this coming-of-age comedy written and directed by Corey Sherman. 14-year-old Jamie (Krasner) goes on a weekend camping trip with his older brother Will (Taj Cross) and their cousin Allie (Dora Madison Burge). He is not pleased to learn that Allie has brought her new boyfriend Dan (David Johnson III) along but soon discovers that Dan is kind and supportive, unlike Will, who frequently teases his brother. As the trip progresses, Jamie's feelings for Dan lead him to come to a deeper understanding of himself.

titles.title: Big little lies
titles.summary: Reese Witherspoon, Nicole Kidman and Shailene Woodley star in this seven-part HBO miniseries based on the novel by Liane Moriarty. On the first day of school in Monterey, Madeline Martha Mackenzie (Witherspoon), her friend Celeste Wright (Kidman) and newly-arrived single mother Jane Chapman (Woodley) are enrolling their kids in the first grade. When a murder takes place at a school fundraiser, their seemingly perfect lives are called into question as Madeline struggles to come to terms with her recent divorce, Celeste's husband Perry (Alexander Skarsgård) becomes increasingly violent towards her and Jane finally opens up about the trauma of her past. The episodes are: 'Somebody's Dead', 'Serious Mothering', 'Living the Dream', 'Push Comes to Shove', 'Once Bitten', 'Burning Love' and 'You Get What You Need'.

titles.title: Big little lies: The complete second season
titles.sortTitle: big little lies: the complete second season
titles.summary: All seven episodes from the second season of the HBO drama starring Reese Witherspoon, Nicole Kidman and Shailene Woodley. In Monterey, California, Madeline (Witherspoon), Celeste (Kidman), Jane (Woodley), Renata (Laura Dern) and Bonnie (Zoë Kravitz) are struggling to move on with their lives and remain haunted by the night of Perry (Alexander Skarsgård)'s death. To make matters worse, Perry's grieving mother, Mary Louise (Meryl Streep), arrives to support her family and begins asking questions about the circumstances of her son's death. The episodes are: 'What Have They Done?', 'Tell-Tale Hearts', 'The End of the World', 'She Knows', 'Kill Me', 'The Bad Mother' and 'I Want to Know'.

titles.title: Big mommas - like father, like son
titles.sortTitle: big mommas - like father, like son
titles.summary: Third film in the 'Big Momma's House' comedy franchise. In this instalment, FBI agent Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) - aka Big Momma - enlists the help of his stepson Trent (Brandon T. Jackson) to dress up in drag and go undercover to track down a murderer at a girls' performing arts school.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 13 Mar 2014); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 05 Jun 2020)

titles.title: The big short
titles.summary: Adam McKay co-writes and directs this financial drama starring Brad Pitt, Steve Carell, Christian Bale and Ryan Gosling. The film follows eccentric financial analyst Michael Burry (Bale) as he uncovers an impending crash in the housing market and puts together a plan to profit from it. As Burry's predictions are spread by those who believe he is mad, a small number of people, including Jared Vennett (Gosling), Ben Rickert (Pitt) and Mark Baum (Carell), get on board with his idea in the hope of saving their assets. The supporting cast includes Selena Gomez, Rafe Spall and Karen Gillan. The film was nominated for six Academy Awards including Best Picture, Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Supporting Actor (Bale), winning for Best Adapted Screenplay. The film also won the BAFTA Award for Best Adapted Screenplay.

titles.title: The big sleep
titles.summary: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall star in this classic film noir directed by Howard Hawks. Los Angeles-based private detective Philip Marlowe (Bogart) is hired by General Sternwood (Charles Waldron) to help his daughter Carmen (Martha Vickers) with a gambling issue, but Carmen's sister Vivian (Bacall) believes that the situation is more complex than it appears. As his investigation progresses, Marlowe uncovers much darker secrets involving the Sternwood family and their associates. The cast also includes John Ridgely, Peggy Knudsen and Regis Toomey.

titles.title: Biggles: Adventures in time
titles.summary: Time travelling adventure adaptation starring Neil Dickson in the title role. New Yorker Jim Ferguson (Alex Hyde-White) is spontaneously transported back in time to the skies of 1917 and finds himself in the middle of an aerial battle during the First World War. It transpires that he is the time twin of Royal Flying Corps pilot James 'Biggles' Bigglesworth, meaning that whenever one of them is in trouble, the other is transported through time to come to their aid. As Biggles embarks on his latest dangerous mission against the Germans, Jim struggles to maintain his normal life back in the '80s and explain his unusual disappearances to fiancée Debbie (Fiona Hutchison), while his services are repeatedly called upon by his assigned twin.

titles.title: The bikeriders
titles.summary: Austin Butler, Jodie Comer and Tom Hardy star in this action drama written and directed by Jeff Nichols. When Kathy (Comer) meets biker Benny (Butler) in a bar, she quickly becomes aquainted with his life as part of the Chicago-based Vandals Motorcycle Club. What started as a group of bike enthusiasts soon turned into a gang where violence, drugs and prostitution are a daily occurrence. With Kathy keen to change Benny's ways, he will have to choose between his love and his passion. The cast also includes Michael Shannon, Mike Faist and Norman Reedus.

titles.title: The bikeriders
titles.summary: Austin Butler, Jodie Comer and Tom Hardy star in this action drama written and directed by Jeff Nichols. When Kathy (Comer) meets biker Benny (Butler) in a bar, she quickly becomes aquainted with his life as part of the Chicago-based Vandals Motorcycle Club. What started as a group of bike enthusiasts soon turned into a gang where violence, drugs and prostitution are a daily occurrence. With Kathy keen to change Benny's ways, he will have to choose between his love and his passion. The cast also includes Michael Shannon, Mike Faist and Norman Reedus.

titles.title: Bill
titles.summary: Mathew Baynton stars as William 'Bill' Shakespeare in this drama written by Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond. Set during the early years of Shakespeare's life, the story follows his journey from being an unknown lute player from Stratford-upon-Avon to becoming a renowned playwright in London. As the struggling musician leaves his family and friends behind to travel to the big city, he hopes that his dreams of finding his true calling will finally become a reality. The cast also includes Martha Howe-Douglas as Anne Hathaway, Helen McCrory as Queen Elizabeth I and Damian Lewis as Sir Richard Hawkins.

titles.title: Bill & Ted face the music
titles.summary: Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter return to star as Theodore 'Ted' Logan and William 'Bill' S. Preston, Esq. in this sci-fi comedy sequel. 25 years after rocking the world with their Wyld Stallyns concert, Bill and Ted are again called upon to save the universe after a visitor from the future warns them that they need to write a new song to unite the world. With no fresh ideas, the middle-aged pair get back in the time-travelling phone booth and venture into the future to obtain the song they need from their future selves. Meanwhile, their daughters Billie (Brigette Lundy-Paine) and Thea (Samara Weaving) travel back in time to recruit a group of musical legends from throughout history.

titles.title: Bird
titles.summary: Nykiya Adams and Barry Keoghan star in this British drama written and directed by Andrea Arnold. 12-year-old Bailey (Adams) lives in a squat in Kent with her father Bug (Keoghan) and half-brother Hunter (Jason Buda) and is no stranger to violence in her young life. When Bug tells her that he is getting married the following week to a woman he has known for only three months, Bailey is far from happy. However, after meeting a mysterious man called Bird (Franz Rogowski) who is searching for answers about his past, her life is transformed. The cast also includes Jasmine Jobson and Frankie Box.

titles.title: The bird with the crystal plumage
titles.summary: Italian thriller and debut feature from writer and director Dario Argento. American writer Sam Dalmas (Tony Musante) is out walking in Rome when he passes an art gallery and witnesses a mysterious man in a black leather raincoat attempt to murder the gallery owner's wife. The police question Sam, but he finds their methods too slow and soon decides to investigate the attack himself. Believing the assailant to be a serial killer responsible for the murder of a number of women across the city, Sam starts his search in the hope of catching the culprit before they can strike again, but when the killer begins threatening him and his girlfriend Julia (Suzy Kendall) over the phone, Sam soon realises he could be the murderer's next target.

titles.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
titles.summary: Burt Lancaster stars in this American biopic based on the true story of Robert Stroud, as told by Tom Gaddis in his renowned biography. Hardened murderer Stroud (Lancaster) is a withdrawn prison inmate who discovers a way of dealing with his isolation by caring for a sick bird. As he nurses the bird back to health Stroud develops an interest in ornithology and becomes a world authority on the subject, and following his transfer to the notorious 'Rock' in San Francisco Bay Stroud's interest does not abate.

titles.title: The birds
titles.summary: Classic horror directed by Alfred Hitchcock. Spoiled socialite Melanie Daniels (Tippi Hedren) pursues lawyer Mitch Brenner (Rod Taylor) to his Bodega Bay home after they meet in a bird shop. Melanie sails across the bay to deliver the gift of a lovebird to Mitch's young sister, only to be attacked by a gull on her way back. Soon random attacks on humans are taking place all over Bodega, as birds of all varieties mass in their thousands overhead.

titles.title: Birds of prey - and the fantabulous emancipation of one Harley -
titles.sortTitle: birds of prey - and the fantabulous emancipation of one harley -
titles.summary: Margot Robbie reprises her role as Harley Quinn in this action adventure spin-off of 'Suicide Squad' (2016). After breaking up with the Joker, Harley is enjoying her new-found independence in Gotham when she runs into trouble in the form of crime lord Roman Sionis aka Black Mask (Ewan McGregor) and his right-hand man Victor Zsasz (Chris Messina). When orphan Cassandra Cain (Ella Jay Basco) steals one of Roman's diamonds, he tasks Harley with finding the young thief. However, it's not long before she teams up with Dinah aka Black Canary (Jurnee Smollett), vigilante Huntress (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) and GCPD officer Renee Montoya (Rosie Perez) to turn the tables on Roman.

titles.title: The birth of a nation - The Masters of Cinema Series
titles.sortTitle: birth of a nation - the masters of cinema series
titles.summary: D.W. Griffith co-writes and directs this epic and controversial account of the American Civil War and its aftermath. It tells the story of two families, the pro-Union Stonemans from the North and the pro-Confederacy Camerons from the South, and the way in which they are both caught up in the turmoil which befalls a sleepy Deep South town when Northern Abolitionists threaten to outlaw the slave trade which has existed there for years. Things go from bad to worse when Ben Cameron (Henry B. Walthall)'s little sister dies at the hands of Gus (Walter Long), a black farmhand, and Ben dons a Ku Klux Klan mask both to avenge her death and to come to the rescue of his beloved girlfriend Elsie (Lillian Gish), who has been kidnapped by a corrupt mixed-race governor.

titles.title: The bitter tears of Petra Von Kant
titles.sortTitle: bitter tears of petra von kant
titles.summary: Rainer Werner Fassbinder writes and directs this German drama based on his own play. Fading fashion designer Petra von Kant (Margit Carstensen) celebrates her birthday by receiving a succession of female acquantainces to her apartment, all of whom have contributed to her teetering on the edge of a nervous breakdown.

titles.title: Black 47
titles.summary: Hugo Weaving and James Frecheville star in this historical drama co-written and directed by Lance Daly. Set during the Great Famine in 1840s Ireland, the film follows Feeney (Frecheville), a deserter from the British army, who returns to his homeland to find his mother starved to death, his brother hanged by the British and his country in total disarray. After witnessing women and children evicted from their homes and many of his poor countrymen starving to death, Feeney sets out on a one-man revenge mission against the corrupt officials and ruthless British officers enforcing their brutal rule over his suffering people. The cast also includes Jim Broadbent and Stephen Rea.

titles.title: Black bag
titles.summary: Michael Fassbender and Cate Blanchett star in this spy thriller from director Steven Soderbergh. When intelligence agent George Woodhouse (Fassbender) learns that his wife and colleague Kathryn (Blanchett) has been accused of being a traitor, he must decide what is more important to him: his marriage or his country. The ensemble cast also includes Regé-Jean Page, Pierce Brosnan and Naomie Harris.

titles.title: Black beauty
titles.summary: Daniel Zirilli directs this modern adaptation of the classic story about friendship, loyalty and kindness. When 15-year-old Audry (Jennifer McKenzie) volunteers to work at the local shelter, she is surprised to see that they have a resident horse. After finding out that the horse has been abused and neglected all her life, she convinces her grandfather (Bruce Davison) to adopt her in the hope of giving her a second chance at happiness.

titles.title: The black cat
titles.summary: Classic horror starring Bela Lugosi. While honeymooning in Budapest, young couple Peter (David Manners) and Joan Allison (Julie Bishop) meet Doctor Vitus Verdegast (Lugosi), who is en route to the mansion of his old 'friend', Hjalmar Poelzig (Boris Karloff). Forced to enjoy Poelzig's hospitality themselves following a bus crash, the Allisons discover that he is in fact a devil worshipper who betrayed Verdegast and thousands of their countrymen during WWI. Verdegast now wants revenge - but Poelzig pre-empts him by taking his guests prisoner, announcing his intention to turn Joan into the bride of Satan..

titles.title: Black cat white cat
titles.summary: In Yugoslavia, Matko Destanov (Bajram Severdzan) ends up in debt to gangster Dadan Karambolo (Srdan Todorovic) after a failed heist. Dadan will agree to cancel the debt if Matko arranges for his son, Zare (Florijan Ajdini) to marry Dadan's daughter, who is so tiny that she has been nicknamed 'Ladybird'. However, Zare is in love with local waitress Ida (Branka Katic), and romantic complications soon ensue.

titles.title: Black Panther: Wakanda forever
titles.summary: Ryan Coogler returns to direct and co-write this action adventure sequel based on the Marvel Comics characters. Following the death of King T'Challa, Queen Ramonda (Angela Bassett), Princess Shuri (Letitia Wright) and their allies must fight to protect Wakanda from those who seek its resources as well as a new threat emerging from the sea. Lupita Nyong'o, Danai Gurira, Dominique Thorne, Winston Duke, Martin Freeman and Tenoch Huerta also star.

titles.title: The Black Panthers - Vanguard of the revolution
titles.sortTitle: black panthers - vanguard of the revolution
titles.summary: Stanley Nelson directs this documentary that chronicles the history of the Black Panther Party. From their formation in 1966 in Oakland, California, the film follows the revolutionary African-American group's rise throughout the '60s and '70s and features interviews with former members, FBI members and street police officers that clashed with the party, in addition to archive footage. Although they gained the backing of Hollywood icons Marlon Brando and Jane Fonda, the radical Nationalist group struggled with inner conflict and exterior pressure during the height of their relevance, struggles that would eventually contribute to their demise.

titles.title: Black phone 2
titles.summary: Mason Thames, Madeleine McGraw and Ethan Hawke return to star in this horror sequel directed by Scott Derrickson. In 1982, Finney Blake (Thames) is struggling to recover from the experience of being kidnapped by the brutal serial killer known as the Grabber (Hawke) four years earlier. When his sister Gwen (McGraw) begins experiencing terrifying visions and nightmares, they come to fear the Grabber has returned. They travel to Alpine Lake, the camp Gwen has been seeing in her visions, to uncover the truth about what is happening and are soon caught in a battle for survival against a vengeful enemy who has transcended death. The cast also includes Miguel Mora, Demián Bichir and Arianna Rivas.

titles.title: Black Widow
titles.summary: Scarlett Johansson reprises her role as the Marvel Comics superhero in this action adventure directed by Cate Shortland. When Natasha Romanoff (Johansson) reunites with her sister, Yelena Belova (Florence Pugh), she discovers certain truths about their upbringing. Together the pair take on Dreykov (Ray Winstone), the evil mastermind responsible for shaping their upbringing. In order to take on Dreykov, Romanoff and Belova must reunite with their parents, Melina (Rachel Weisz) and Alexei (David Harbour).

titles.title: The blackening
titles.summary: Grace Byers, Jermaine Fowler, Dewayne Perkins and Melvin Gregg star in this slasher horror comedy directed by Tim Story. A group of friends gather at a cabin in the woods to celebrate Juneteenth together but instead they are targeted by a masked killer who forces them to play a racist game called 'The Blackening'. If they cannot answer the questions correctly, the consequences could prove to be fatal and soon, they are all forced to fight for their lives. The cast also includes Antoinette Robertson, X Mayo and Sinqua Walls.

titles.title: BlackkKlansman
titles.summary: John David Washington and Adam Driver star in this US comedy drama co-written and directed by Spike Lee. Set in the 1970s, the film follows Ron Stallworth (Washington), the first African American police officer in Colorado Springs, as he attempts to go undercover and infiltrate the local chapter of the Ku Klux Klan. Joining forces with his white partner Flip Zimmerman (Driver), who agrees to play the role of Ron at Klan events, Ron makes contact with Klan leader David Duke (Topher Grace) and quickly becomes integrated into the organisation. However, as Ron and Flip delve deeper into the Klan's workings, they soon make some shocking discoveries which could lead to deadly consequences.

titles.title: Blancanieves
titles.summary: Pablo Berger writes and directs this Spanish black and white silent fantasy drama based on the 'Snow White' fairy tale by the Brothers Grimm. Famous matador Antonio Villalta (Daniel Giménez Cacho) finds his life changed forever when, after being paralysed in the bull ring, his young wife dies in childbirth. Raised by her grandmother until she too dies, Antonio's young daughter Carmen (Sofía Oria) is then permitted to stay at her father's new home, dominated by her heartlessly cruel new stepmother, her father's former nurse, Encarna (Maribel Verdú). Secretly schooled by Antonio in the bullfighting arts, the now teenage Carmen (Macarena García)'s destiny suddenly changes when, after falling victim to Encarna's evil plotting, she finds herself rescued by a troupe of travelling dwarf bullfighters.

titles.title: Blindspotting
titles.summary: Daveed Diggs and Rafael Casal co-write, produce and star in this US comedy drama. The film follows Collin (Diggs), a convicted criminal attempting to get through the last week of his probation despite the presence of his childhood friend Miles (Casal), a troublemaker who embraces the street life. Things become complicated when Collin witnesses a police officer shooting a civilian and Miles buys a gun before getting into a confrontation at a party. Realising Miles' recklessness could land him back in jail, Collin soon finds himself on a collision course with his oldest friend.

titles.title: Blink twice
titles.summary: Zoë Kravitz writes and directs this psychological thriller starring Channing Tatum. When cocktail waitresses Frida (Naomi Ackie) and Jess (Alia Shawkat) get invited to tech billionaire Slater King (Tatum)'s private island retreat, they jump at the chance to spend a few days relaxing in the sun with the rich and famous. Once there however, their phones are confiscated and strange things start to happen. The cast also includes Christian Slater, Geena Davis and Haley Joel Osment.

titles.title: Blue moon
titles.summary: Ethan Hawke, Margaret Qualley and Andrew Scott star in this comedy drama directed by Richard Linklater. On 31st March 1943, 'Oklahoma!' opens on Broadway but lyricist Lorenz Hart (Hawke) leaves the performance early to begin drinking. As he converses with bartender Eddie (Bobby Cannavale), he bitterly mourns the end of his creative partnership with Richard Rodgers (Scott) who has moved on due to Lorenz's drinking and unreliability and wrote 'Oklahoma!' with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney) instead of Lorenz. Meanwhile, Lorenz hopes to at least succeed in finally winning the love of the much younger Elizabeth Weiland (Qualley) but soon begins to realise that his night is destined to end in complete and utter failure. The cast also includes Patrick Kennedy and Jonah Lees.

titles.title: The Blues Brothers/Blues Brothers 2000
titles.summary: Blues Brothers double bill. In 'The Blues Brothers', brothers Jake and Elwood (John Belushi and Dan Ackroyd) have sold their souls to rhythm'n'blues, but still lend a hand when the church orphanage in which they were raised is threatened with closure. Resolving to stage a fund-raising gig with their old band, they have God on their side but everyone else against them. Packed with car chases, music and cameo appearances (including Ray Charles, James Brown, Aretha Franklin and John Lee Hooker). In 'Blues Brothers 2000', Elwood emerges from a long stretch in prison to find the world has changed: his partner Jake has gone, the band have broken up and the orphanage where he was raised has been demolished. However, meaning is brought back to his life when he embarks upon a mission to save the soul of a wayward youngster. The band must be reconvened, with the help of a new recruit (John Goodman), in order to compete at Queen Moussette's Battle of the Bands whilst avoiding the attentions of the police. As in the first film there are cameos from a host of blues and soul musicians.

titles.title: Bluey: Cricket & other stories
titles.summary: Collection of ten animated adventures following Blue Heeler puppy Bluey as she gets up to mischief with her sister Bingo and her friends. The episodes are: 'Cubby', 'Exercise', 'Relax', 'Stickbird', 'Show and Tell', 'Dragon', 'Wild Girls', 'TV Shop', 'Slide' and 'Cricket'.

titles.title: Blur: To the end/Live at Wembley Stadium
titles.sortTitle: blur: to the end/live at wembley stadium
titles.summary: Documentary and concert film duology which follow British indie rock band Blur as they reunite after a second hiatus. In 'Blur: To the End' (2024), in advance of the release of their ninth studio album 'The Ballad of Darren', Blur perform their first concert in eight years and embark on a series of small warm-up shows before headlining Wembley Stadium for two nights in July 2023. Footage of the band in the studio, on the road and on stage features alongside archival footage. The concert film 'Blur: Live at Wembley Stadium' (2023) captures the band's performances at Wembley. The career-spanning setlist includes 'There's No Other Way', 'Popscene', 'Song 2', 'To the End', 'Parklife', 'Tender' and 'The Narcissist'.

titles.title: Bob Dylan: 30th anniversary concert
titles.summary: Live concert from the American folk blues singer celebrating three decades in the music business. Recorded in New York's Madison Square Garden, Dylan was joined on stage by a plethora of musical icons from Johnny Cash to Stevie Wonder and Eric Clapton to Neil Young. The songs performed include 'Like a Rolling Stone', 'It Ain't Me Babe' and 'I'll Be Your Baby Tonight'.

titles.title: Bob Marley: One love
titles.summary: Kingsley Ben-Adir stars as the eponymous reggae legend in this biographical drama directed by Reinaldo Marcus Green. In 1976, after an attempt is made on his life due to his political activism, Marley is forced to leave Jamaica. While his wife Rita (Lashana Lynch) and their family go to America, Marley and his band travel to London where they record the seminal album 'Exodus'. However, Marley's desire for peace between Jamaica's warring political parties leads him to return home in 1978 so that he can perform at the One Love Peace Concert in Kingston where he strives to bring an end to the violence afflicting the country. The cast also includes James Norton, Aston Barrett Jr. and Anthony Welsh.

titles.title: Bob the Builder: Lofty lets loose
titles.sortTitle: bob the builder: lofty lets loose
titles.summary: Six more episodes from the children's animated series following builder Bob (voice of Lee Ingleby) and his gang of talking vehicles. In this instalment, Lofty (Steven Kynman) gets a bit overexcited about meeting a giraffe at the zoo, Bob and his team help open a new alien-themed revolving restaurant and build a new track for the Spring City fun run before the 'Ballroom Blitz' dance show comes to Spring City. The episodes are: 'Kitchen Whizz', 'Lofty Lets Loose', 'Cats and Dogs', 'Fitness Frenzy', 'Ballroom Blitz' and 'Pick Up a Penguin'.

titles.title: Bodyguard
titles.summary: All six episodes from the British television drama in which war veteran-turned Police Sergeant David Budd (Richard Madden) must grapple with the conflict of his duties and his own core beliefs. Working for the Metropolitan Police's Royalty and Specialist Protection Branch, Budd is drafted in to be the chief protection officer of Home Secretary Julia Montague (Keeley Hawes). Having served in Helmand and experienced first-hand trauma, David's mental stability is shattered underneath the surface, and his memories of the atrocities he encountered leaves him questioning his loyalty to Montague and her means of power.

titles.title: Book club
titles.summary: Diane Keaton and Jane Fonda star in this US comedy co-written and directed by Bill Holderman. The film follows friends Diane (Keaton), Vivian (Fonda), Sharon (Candice Bergen) and Carol (Mary Steenburgen) who begin reading the novel 'Fifty Shades of Grey' as part of their book club. Finding themselves intrigued by the book's racy content, the group begin looking to find excitement in their own lives. The cast also includes Andy Garcia, Don Johnson and Richard Dreyfuss.

titles.title: Book club: The next chapter
titles.summary: Diane Keaton, Jane Fonda, Candice Bergen and Mary Steenburgen return to star in this US comedy sequel directed by Bill Holderman. With Vivian (Fonda) newly engaged, the four friends take a trip to Italy for a bachelorette holiday before Vivian's wedding in Tuscany. Starting off in Rome, it isn't long before the women get up to all manner of mischief while celebrating love, friendship and life in their 70s.

titles.title: The bookshop
titles.summary: Emily Mortimer and Bill Nighy star in Isabel Coixet's big screen adaptation of the novel by Penelope Fitzgerald. In 1959, widow Florence Green (Mortimer) uproots her simple life in favour of a new challenge in the English seaside town of Hardborough. Buying an old house in the middle of the town, she converts the ground floor into a bookshop in the hope of bringing people together through the joy of literature. Her good intentions and ambition come under fire however, when she stocks the scandalous novel 'Lolita' by Vladimir Nabokov and the influencial Violet Gamart (Patricia Clarkson) vows to do all in her power to get the bookshop closed down.

titles.title: Booksmart
titles.summary: Olivia Wilde directs this comedy drama in which two academically-gifted high school students make a pact to become more rebellious before their impending graduation. After years of intense studying and perfecting their grades in preparation for college, Amy (Kaitlyn Dever) and Molly (Beanie Feldstein) realise towards the end of their high school career that they have missed out on numerous parties and acts of typical teen rebellion. With graduation around the corner, the girls set out to have as much fun as possible before entering the adult world. The cast also includes Lisa Kudrow, Jason Sudeikis and Billie Lourd.

titles.title: Border
titles.summary: Swedish fantasy drama based on the short story by John Ajvide Lindqvist. Tina (Eva Melander) works for the Swedish Customs Services, where she uses her unique ability to smell guilt and shame to apprehend criminals crossing the border. After she is recruited to use her special talent on a police investigation, Tina meets Vore (Eero Milonoff) a mysterious, similarly disfigured man who illuminates her life and forces her to question her past.

titles.title: Borderlands
titles.summary: Eli Roth directs this action adventure based on the video game series. The story follows outlaw Lilith (Cate Blanchett) as she returns to her home planet of Pandora in search of Atlas (Edgar Ramirez)'s missing daughter. As she teams up with Roland (Kevin Hart), Tiny Tina (Ariana Greenblatt), Tannis (Jamie Lee Curtis), Krieg (Florian Munteanu) and robot Claptrap (voice of Jack Black), the group of misfits set about saving the young girl who may be the secret to the universe's survival.

titles.title: The boss baby 2 - Family business
titles.summary: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Alec Baldwin, James Marsden and Amy Sedaris. Now all grown up, the Templeton brothers have drifted apart. Tim (Marsden) is happily married with two daughters while his little brother Ted (Baldwin) is a work-obsessed, successful CEO. However, when the brothers learn that Tim's infant daughter Tina (Sedaris) is an undercover executive of BabyCorp, they must turn back into children and work together to stop Dr Erwin Armstrong (Jeff Goldblum) from carrying out his evil plan to rid the world of bossy parents.

titles.title: The Boxtrolls
titles.summary: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Isaac Hempstead Wright, Elle Fanning and Ben Kingsley. Below the streets of Cheesebridge live the Boxtrolls, a community of cave-dwelling and cardboard box-wearing creatures, who are believed to pose a threat to the citizens of the town and their children. However, in truth they pose no such threat and have even raised an orphaned boy, Eggs (voice of Hempstead Wright), as one of their own. Archibald Snatcher (Kingsley), a local pest exterminator, hatches a plan to get rid of the Boxtrolls for good as a means of securing his place within the town's cheese-loving elite. When the Boxtrolls hear of Archibald's plan it then falls to Eggs to save the day, since he is the only member of the group who can remain undetected on the city streets. He ventures above ground and soon befriends local rich girl Winnie (Fanning), who agrees to help Eggs save his adopted family from extinction. The voice cast also includes Simon Pegg, Toni Collette and Richard Ayoade.

titles.title: The Boxtrolls
titles.summary: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Isaac Hempstead Wright, Elle Fanning and Ben Kingsley. Below the streets of Cheesebridge live the Boxtrolls, a community of cave-dwelling and cardboard box-wearing creatures, who are believed to pose a threat to the citizens of the town and their children. However, in truth they pose no such threat and have even raised an orphaned boy, Eggs (voice of Hempstead Wright), as one of their own. Archibald Snatcher (Kingsley), a local pest exterminator, hatches a plan to get rid of the Boxtrolls for good as a means of securing his place within the town's cheese-loving elite. When the Boxtrolls hear of Archibald's plan it then falls to Eggs to save the day, since he is the only member of the group who can remain undetected on the city streets. He ventures above ground and soon befriends local rich girl Winnie (Fanning), who agrees to help Eggs save his adopted family from extinction. The voice cast also includes Simon Pegg, Toni Collette and Richard Ayoade.

titles.title: The boy and the heron
titles.summary: Hayao Miyazaki writes and directs this Japanese anime featuring the voice talents of Luca Padovan, Robert Pattinson and Florence Pugh. Mahito Maki (voice of Padovan) lives with his father Shoichi (Christian Bale) and his pregnant wife Natsuko (Gemma Chan), the sister of Mahito's late mother Hisako (also Chan) who perished in a hospital fire. Feeling lost after the death of his mother, Mahito struggles to fit in at school and resents his family, but when he encounters a mischievous heron (Pattinson) who lures Mahito into believing he can be reunited with his mother, he follows the heron into an ethereal world where the dead live amongst magical creatures and humans with incredible powers.

titles.title: A boy called Christmas
titles.summary: Maggie Smith, Toby Jones and Sally Hawkins star in this festive drama. Based on the novel by Matt Haig, the film tells the story of 13-year-old Nikolas (Henry Lawfull) as he sets off on a dangerous quest to bring hope to the world. Accompanied by his pet mouse Miika (voice of Stephen Merchant) and a reindeer named Blitzen, Nikolas searches for the legendary kingdom of Elfhelm, home of the elves, where he hopes to find his missing father. The cast also includes Kristen Wiig, Jim Broadbent and Michiel Huisman.

titles.title: Boy erased
titles.summary: Joel Edgerton directs, writes and stars in this biographical drama based on the memoir of Garrard Conley, who was made to attend gay conversion therapy by his strictly religious family. When Jared (Lucas Hedges) is outed to his own parents by a vicious college student, he reluctantly admits that he is attracted to men after breaking up with his girlfriend. Horrified by the prospect of having a gay son, Baptist preacher Marshall (Russell Crowe) forces Jared to attend a gay conversion programme or else face being ostracised by his family. Enduring the torment of gruelling psychological treatment and witnessing the abuse of his peers, Jared stands up to the bullying behaviour of programme leader Victor (Edgerton) with the support of his mother, Nancy (Nicole Kidman), who becomes horrified at the treatment of her son. Marshall, however, continues to struggle with his son's identity which begins to tear the family apart.

titles.title: Boyhood
titles.summary: Patricia Arquette and Ethan Hawke star in this groundbreaking drama written and directed by Richard Linklater. Filmed over a period of 12 years with the same cast members, the film begins as Olivia (Arquette) moves to Houston, Texas with her son Mason (Ellar Coltrane) and daughter Samantha (Lorelei Linklater) after the disintegration of her marriage to the children's father Mason Sr. (Hawke). As Mason progresses from a child to a young man, he must deal with the aftermath of his parents' divorce and the numerous other difficulties that come with growing up.

titles.title: Boys
titles.summary: French gay-themed drama. After being arrested for his part in a nightclub altercation, 33-year-old Jonas (Félix Maritaud/Nicolas Bauwens) begins to be haunted by events from his formative years, when he first began to discover his sexuality, with the help of classmate Nathan (Tommy-Lee Baïk).

titles.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
titles.summary: Francis Ford Coppola directs this adaptation of Bram Stoker's classic vampire novel. Believing Mina Murray (Winona Ryder) to be the reincarnation of his lost love, Count Dracula (Gary Oldman) leaves her fiancé Jonathan Harker (Keanu Reeves) for dead and travels to London to pursue her. After Dracula bites Mina's best friend Lucy Westenra (Sadie Frost), Doctor Abraham Van Helsing (Anthony Hopkins) is summoned to help them to deal with the monster... The cast also includes Richard E. Grant, Cary Elwes and Tom Waits.

titles.title: Breathless
titles.summary: Jean-Luc Godard directs this classic French crime drama which recounts the brief love affair between petty criminal Michel (Jean-Paul Belmondo) and young American student Patricia (Jean Seberg). Michel has killed a police officer after stealing a car and is now hiding out in Patricia's Paris apartment. But the police are getting closer, and Michel falls deeper in love with Patricia just as it seems his time is running out.

titles.title: Breathless
titles.summary: Jean-Luc Godard directs this classic French crime drama which recounts the brief love affair between petty criminal Michel (Jean-Paul Belmondo) and young American student Patricia (Jean Seberg). Michel has killed a police officer after stealing a car and is now hiding out in Patricia's Paris apartment. But the police are getting closer, and Michel falls deeper in love with Patricia just as it seems his time is running out.

titles.title: The bride!
titles.summary: Jessie Buckley and Christian Bale star in this gothic horror written and directed by Maggie Gyllenhaal. In Chicago in 1936, Frankenstein's monster (Bale) asks scientist Dr. Cornelia Euphronious (Annette Bening) to create an eternal companion for him to ease his loneliness. Taking pity on him, she helps him to reanimate a murdered woman who becomes his Bride (Buckley). As the two of them begin their new life together, it soon becomes apparent that as the Bride discovers herself, she cannot be controlled or contained. The cast also includes Jake Gyllenhaal, Penélope Cruz and Peter Sarsgaard.

titles.title: Bridge of spies
titles.summary: Tom Hanks stars in this historical drama set during the Cold War directed by Steven Spielberg. When Rudolf Abel (Mark Rylance) sits down on a park bench in Brooklyn, New York, a secret message left for him causes the FBI to arrest him under suspicion of being a Soviet spy. When insurance lawyer James B. Donovan (Hanks) is assigned to Abel's defence, he finds his new challenge increasingly difficult as the defendent refuses to co-operate. The cast also includes Amy Ryan, Alan Alda and Domenick Lombardozzi.

titles.title: Bridget Jones: Mad about the boy
titles.sortTitle: bridget jones: mad about the boy
titles.summary: Renée Zellweger reprises her eponymous role in this fourth instalment in the Bridget Jones franchise, based on the novel by Helen Fielding. As Bridget navigates the latest chapter in her life as a widow and mother to two young children, she finds herself with a new love interest some 20 years her junior. The cast also includes Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson and Chiwetel Ejiofor.

titles.title: Brighton
titles.summary: British comedy directed by Stephen Cookson. Two elderly couples return to Brighton where they first met. Despite being much older the men in particular appear stuck in their old ways but the world around them is very different to the one they remember. The cast features Larry Lamb, Philip Davis, Marion Bailey and Lesley Sharp.

titles.title: Brimstone
titles.summary: Guy Pearce and Dakota Fanning star in this Western thriller written and directed by Martin Koolhoven. Midwife Liz Bundy (Fanning)'s life is changed forever when a charismatic new preacher (Pearce) arrives in her quiet frontier town in the Old West. Blaming Liz for the death of a baby she delivered, the preacher begins making her life a misery as he subjects her to a torrent of physical and emotional abuse. Desperate and alone, Liz is forced to put her life on the line as she bravely attempts to fight back against her evil tormentor. The cast also includes Kit Harington, Carice van Houten and Emilia Jones.

titles.title: Bring her back
titles.summary: Australian supernatural horror directed by Danny and Michael Philippou. After the death of their father, 17-year-old Andy (Billy Barratt) and his stepsister Piper (Sora Wong) are sent to live with foster parent Laura (Sally Hawkins). She also cares for Oliver (Jonah Wren Phillips), a mute boy with behavioural problems, and is struggling to recover from the tragic loss of her daughter. Andy soon becomes unsettled by Laura's actions and she in turn begins to undermine him and interfere with his relationship with Piper. When he realises how dangerous she truly is, will he be able to save Piper before it's too late?

titles.title: Bring them down
titles.summary: Christopher Andrews directs this Irish thriller starring Barry Keoghan and Christopher Abbott. Sheep farmer Michael (Abbott) is forced to take on the responsibility of the family farm after his father's health declines. As he takes over his father's role in the feud he had with the neighbours, Michael also begins to understand that he must go to great lengths to protect his land and livestock. The cast also includes Colm Meaney, Nora-Jane Noone and Paul Ready.

titles.title: Brooklyn
titles.summary: Saoirse Ronan and Domhnall Gleeson star in this romantic drama adapted from the novel by Colm Tóibín. Set in the 1950s, the story follows young Irish woman Ellis Lacey (Ronan) as she travels to New York City in search of a better life. Initially homesick, she begins to adjust to her new surroundings with the help of Italian-American Tony Fiorello (Emory Cohen) with whom she becomes romantically involved. After news of a family crisis, Ellis returns to Ireland where she enjoys spending time back in her hometown and becomes acquainted with a young man, Jim Farrell (Gleeson), finding herself torn between two very different paths. The cast also includes Jim Broadbent and Julie Walters. The film was nominated for three Academy Awards including Best Picture and won the BAFTA Award for Best British Film.

titles.title: Brother
titles.summary: Clement Virgo directs this Canadian drama based on the novel by David Chariandy, starring Lamar Johnson and Aaron Pierre. Brothers Michael and Francis (Johnson and Pierre) are bonded by their shared love of the hip-hop scene of 1990s Toronto, and while their single mother is out working long shifts Francis takes care of his younger sibling, teaching him about the complexities of life. One day, however, a tragic event tears the family apart, and Michael is left with only the lessons of his adolescence to help him navigate his adult life in the absence of his elder brother.

titles.title: The brutalist
titles.summary: Adrien Brody stars in this post-war drama from director Brady Corbet. After being separated from his wife Erzsébet (Felicity Jones), Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth (Brody) seeks a new life in America. Getting a job with his cousin at his furniture company, they receive a renovation commission from the son of wealthy industrialist Harrison Lee Van Buren (Guy Pearce). Although enraged at the work being done without his consent, Harrison employs László to design a monument in memory of his late mother, offering to help him repatriate his wife in return. After he is subjected to horrific abuse at the hands of Harrison, László spirals into addiction and is in danger of losing himself in the turmoil.

titles.title: Bugonia
titles.summary: Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons star in this black comedy directed by Yorgos Lanthimos. With the help of his impressionable cousin Don (Aidan Delbis), beekeeper and conspiracy theorist Teddy Gatz (Plemons) kidnaps Michelle Fuller (Stone), the CEO of a high-profile pharmaceutical company. He believes that she is an alien who has disguised herself as a human in order to bring about the destruction of the planet. While she is confined in their basement, Michelle attempts to threaten, appease and bargain with Teddy, but he does not believe anything she says. As the days pass and Teddy becomes increasingly volatile, will he get the answers he seeks? The cast also includes Alicia Silverstone and Stavros Halkias.

titles.title: Burning
titles.summary: Korean drama co-written and directed by Chang-dong Lee. While out on a delivery, courier and aspiring writer Lee Jong-su (Ah-In Yoo) meets Shin Hae-mi (Jong-seon Jeon), who claims they were childhood friends. Despite not recognising her, Jong-su joins Hae-mi for dinner and agrees to watch her cat while she's away on an upcoming trip to Africa. However, he is shocked when she returns with rich Korean Ben (Steven Yeun). As Jong-su gets to know him, Ben reveals an unusual clandestine compulsion, a revelation that leads Jong-su to develop a consuming obsession with Hae-mi's enigmatic new boyfriend.

titles.title: C'mon c'mon
titles.summary: Joaquin Phoenix stars in this indie drama written and directed by Mike Mills. The film follows radio journalist Johnny (Phoenix) as he travels cross-country to New York City with his nine-year-old nephew Jesse (Woody Norman). Along the way they interview young people about their lives and their hopes for the future.

titles.title: Call me by your name
titles.summary: Coming-of-age romantic drama based on the novel by André Aciman. Elio Perlman (Timothée Chalamet) is a young man who lives with his parents in their villa in Italy. When Oliver (Armie Hammer), a graduate student comes to stay with Elio's father (Michael Stuhlbarg), a professor, he captivates the attention of Elio, and soon the two attract each other. They spend a summer together cycling in the sunshine, playing music and attending to their sophisticated mutual interests, and Elio considers his sexuality while devoting himself to winning Oliver's affections.

titles.title: The call of the wild
titles.summary: Harrison Ford stars in this American adventure based on Jack London's classic novel. Set in the 1890s, the film follows St. Bernard/Scotch Collie Buck as he begins an epic adventure after he is stolen from his home in Santa Clara, California and taken to Yukon where he is sold into service as a sled dog. Delivering mail for his new masters Perrault (Omar Sy) and Françoise (Cara Gee), Buck learns to work as part of a pack before crossing paths with Jack Thornton (Ford) and discovering the call of the wild. The cast also includes Dan Stevens, Karen Gillan and Bradley Whitford.

titles.title: The calling
titles.summary: Susan Sarandon and Donald Sutherland star in this thriller directed by Jason Stone. Detective Hazel Micallef (Sarandon) is part of a small police unit in the sleepy town of Fort Dundas where crimes committed are few and far between. When a string of brutal murders awaken the curiosity of the police department Hazel and young cop Ben Wingate (Topher Grace) go out in search of the sadistic killer. After a pattern begins to emerge between the murders Hazel consults Father Price (Sutherland), who informs her that the killer is spelling out an ancient prayer of resurrection...

titles.title: Camille Claudel 1915
titles.summary: Bruno Dumont directs this biographical drama about the French sculptor Camille Claudel, who is here portrayed by Juliette Binoche. The film focuses on Camille's time spent in an asylum after she is sent there by her brother, the poet Paul Claudel (Jean-Luc Vincent), who questions his sister's sanity when she destroys some of her own works. She lives a reclusive life trying to prove to her doctor that she is mentally stable while waiting in hope that her brother will visit and consent to her discharge from the institution.

titles.title: Can you ever forgive me?
titles.summary: American drama based on the memoirs of author Lee Israel chronicling her criminal career in the forging of works purported to be written by celebrities. Now a disgraced writer and facing rejection from publishers after a failed biography on Estée Lauder, Lee (Melissa McCarthy) becomes desperate to find a way to make ends meet. When an opportunity arises in the form of a typed letter she stumbles across in a library, Lee takes the letter to an expert for evaluation only to discover a way of forging more papers under numerous famous literary names. However, Lee's luck soon runs out when the FBI get wind of her fraudulence and set out to put a stop to her enterprise.

titles.title: Canary
titles.summary: Christiaan Olwagen directs this drama centred on a young man as he is conscripted into the South African army in 1985. Having always considered himself an outsider due to his deemed unconventional interests, Johan (Schalk Bezuidenhout) has anxieties about his duty to the army but is provided with a degree of solace in the Canaries, the army's choir. He does not find escape from the harsh reality of war for long, however, as soon the assignments given to him begin to weigh heavily on his conscience just as he begins to question his identity and sexuality.

titles.title: Candyman
titles.summary: Nia DaCosta writes and directs this sequel which follows on from events in the 1992 horror of the same name. Anthony McCoy (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), a visual artist, moves into the newly upgraded neighbourhood of Cabrini Green in Chicago with his girlfriend, Brianna (Teyonah Parris). When Anthony ventures out to learn more about the former housing projects of Cabrini Green, he has a chance encounter with a long-time resident who educates him on the true story behind the legend of the killer known as the Candyman (Tony Todd), who apparently could be summoned into corporeal existence if anyone speaks his name five times in a row. As Anthony delves into the history of the Candyman and allows it to influence his work, his sanity slowly begins to unravel as obsession takes hold of him and the lines between imagination and reality become dangerously blurred.

titles.title: Capone
titles.summary: Tom Hardy stars as notorious gangster Al Capone in this biographical crime drama. Once one of the most feared bootleggers of the Prohibition era, in 1939 Chicago mobster Al Capone is released from prison with a deteriorating mental state caused by untreated neurosyphilis and dementia. Despite his ailing health, Capone remains under constant surveillance by the FBI, who remain convinced that his decline is an elaborate act staged to retrieve his hidden fortune. However, as his mental state continues to deteriorate, Capone reckons with his past misdeeds as he becomes unable to distinguish reality from fantasy.

titles.title: Captain America: Brave new world
titles.summary: Anthony Mackie reprises his role as Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, in this superhero action adventure directed by Julius Onah. When an attempt is made to assassinate President Thaddeus Ross (Harrison Ford), Wilson uncovers evidence of a conspiracy to sow discord and division between America and Japan. As he attempts to identify who is pulling the strings and works to prevent a war, a dangerous secret involving Ross is exposed. The cast also includes Danny Ramirez, Carl Lumbly, Tim Blake Nelson and Giancarlo Esposito.

titles.title: Captain America: Civil war
titles.summary: Chris Evans and Robert Downey Jr. reprise their roles as Steve Rogers and Tony Stark in this superhero action adventure sequel directed by Anthony and Joe Russo. Following the events of 'Avengers: Age of Ultron' (2015), the United Nations seek to oversee and control the activity of the Avengers, which causes a deep divide within the team of superheroes. The Avengers are split into two opposing factions headed by Captain America (Evans) and Iron Man (Downey Jr.), when a new threat to the safety of the world emerges. Will the Avengers be able to defeat their common enemy and repair the schism between them? The cast also includes Scarlett Johansson, Sebastian Stan and Anthony Mackie.

titles.title: Captain America: The winter soldier
titles.summary: Chris Evans reprises his role as Steve Rogers in this superhero action adventure sequel directed by Anthony and Joe Russo. Two years after the events of 'The Avengers' (2012) Rogers is working for S.H.I.E.L.D. and continues to try to adjust to modern society. When he discovers that S.H.I.E.L.D. has been infiltrated by Hydra, he joins forces with Natasha Romanoff (Scarlett Johansson) and former soldier Sam Wilson (Anthony Mackie) to uncover the extent of the corruption and defeat a powerful Hydra assassin called the Winter Soldier (Sebastian Stan). The cast also includes Samuel L. Jackson, Robert Redford and Cobie Smulders.

titles.title: Captain Hook: The cursed tides
titles.summary: Richard Rowden stars as the eponymous pirate in this low-budget action adventure written and directed by Lars Janssen. James Hook is determined to exact vengeance upon his sworn enemy Admiral Smee (Sean Cronin) after suffering a catastrophic defeat at Smee's hands. Unable to fight Smee and his forces alone, he enlists the help of blacksmith Silas Blackweather (Munraj Bhachu) who has a score of his own to settle after the murder of his sister. The cast also includes Destiny Viva and Ewen Weatherburn.

titles.title: Captain Underpants: The first epic movie
titles.sortTitle: captain underpants: the first epic movie
titles.summary: Animated comedy featuring the voice talents of Ed Helms, Kevin Hart and Thomas Middleditch. Best friends George and Harold (Hart and Middleditch) have created their own comic book about a superhero they call Captain Underpants. One day, while being told off by their school principal Mr Krupp (Helms), they accidentally hypnotise him into believing he is Captain Underpants. While they try to control Mr Krupp as his delusions of heroism begin to get out of hand, they learn that new teacher, Professor Poopypants (Nick Kroll), is actually an evil scientist planning an attack on the school. As the boys persuade Mr Krupp to stop trying to perfect the art of flying and help them stop Professor Poopypants, what they thought would be a normal day at school turns out to be a day they'll never forget.

titles.title: The card counter
titles.summary: Oscar Isaac stars in this crime drama written and directed by Paul Schrader. While serving a lengthy prison sentence former military interrogator William Tell (Isaac) learned to count cards. Despite his talents Tell lives a lonely existence on the road as he drifts from one casino to the next, winning modest amounts and declining the financial support of wealthy investors. When Tell meets Cirk (Tye Sheridan), the son of a fellow interrogator, he decides to help the young man on his quest for vengeance against retired Major John Gordo (Willem Dafoe).

titles.title: The Care Bears movie
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. Mr Cherrywood (voice of Mickey Rooney) runs an orphanage and one night, he tells the children a story about the Care Bears who live in Care-a-Lot and travel to Earth looking for people to cheer up. When Nicholas (Hadley Kay), a magician's apprentice, accidentally unleashes an evil spirit from inside an old book, he is brainwashed into helping the spirit in its quest to remove all traces of caring from the world. Can the Care Bears and their new friends Jason (Sunny Besen Thrasher) and Kim (Cree Summer Francks) work together with the Care Bear Cousins to save Nicholas and defeat the evil spirit?

titles.title: Care bears: Cheer, there & everywhere
titles.summary: Eight episodes of the children's animated series following the adventures of the Care Bears. In the fantastical town of Care-a-lot, Cheer Bear (voice of Tabitha St. Germain) and the other Care Bears spread goodwill and empathy wherever they go. But with Grizzle (Mark Oliver) up to his dirty tricks, it'll take a collective effort to change his outlook and protect Care-a-lot for good. The episodes are: 'Growing Pains', 'King Grumpy', 'Cheer, There and Everywhere', 'Case of the Grumpies', 'Gobblebugs', 'Grizzle-ized', 'Two of a Kind' and 'Stand Up & Cheer'.

titles.title: A Caribbean dream
titles.summary: Adaptation of William Shakespeare's play 'A Midsummer Night's Dream' set on the Caribbean island of Barbados. As guests gather for the wedding of Theseus (Aden Gillett) and Hippolyta (Sonia Williams) in the 18th-century Fustic House, butler Puck (Patrick Michael Foster) proceeds to cause chaos for everyone in attendance, amongst them Titania (Susannah Harker) and Oberon (Adrian Green).

titles.title: Carmen
titles.summary: Melissa Barrera stars as the eponymous character in this reimagining of Bizet's opera of the same name. After her mother is killed, Carmen flees north, hoping to cross the border from Mexico into Texas and make her way to Los Angeles to find her mother's friend, Masilda (Rossy de Palma). When she runs into Aidan (Paul Mescal), and his border patrol, another act of violence forces the two of them to go on the run together.

titles.title: Carol
titles.summary: Cate Blanchett and Rooney Mara star in this romantic drama adapted from the novel by Patricia Highsmith. In the 1950s a New York department store employee and amateur photographer Therese Belivet (Mara) meets Carol Aird (Blanchett), a lady who has come to buy a Christmas present for her young daughter Rindy (Kk Heim). The two women soon strike up a friendship and, with Carol going through a divorce from husband Harge (Kyle Chandler), they decide to go away on a trip to Chicago where their relationship develops into a romance. But with Rindy's custody in question, Carol, worrying that she will be cut off from her daughter because of the nature of her relationship with Therese, has no choice but to leave. Despite their love for each other is their romance doomed to fail? The film was nominated for six Academy Awards including Best Actress (Blanchett), Best Supporting Actress (Mara) and Best Original Score (Carter Burwell).

titles.title: Carrie's War
titles.summary: TV adaptation of the bestselling children's novel by Nina Bawden. When 14-year-old Carrie Willow (Keeley Fawcett) and her younger brother Nick (Jack Stanley) are evacuated from London to the small Welsh town of Druids Bottom during World War II, they are taken in by the strict Mr Evans (Alun Armstrong) and his sister Auntie Lou (Lesley Sharp). As the children gradually realise they have entered a mysterious world of curses, witchcraft and druids, their lives are altered forever.

titles.title: Cars 2
titles.summary: John Lasseter directs this Pixar animated comedy adventure sequel. When slow-witted tow truck Mater (voiced by Larry the Cable Guy) travels to Tokyo with his superstar friend Lightning McQueen (Owen Wilson) for the international Grand Prix, sleek Aston Martin Finn McMissile (Michael Caine) and his sidekick Holley Shiftwell (Emily Mortimer) become convinced that Mater is, despite his unassuming appearance, nothing less than a brilliant international spy.

titles.title: Cars 3
titles.summary: Brian Fee directs this Pixar animated comedy adventure sequel featuring the voice talents of Armie Hammer, Owen Wilson and Bonnie Hunt. With a new generation of highly-tuned, ultra-fast racers led by seemingly unbeatable rookie Jackson Storm (Hammer) dominating races, legendary speedster Lightning McQueen (Wilson) suddenly finds himself being muscled out of the sport he loves. After then pushing himself to the limit and crashing out of a meet at the Los Angeles International Speedway, Lightning is forced to step away from competing in order to recover from his injuries. However, determined not to give up on his dreams Lightning seeks help from enthusiastic race technician Cruz Ramirez (Cristela Alonzo) in a bid to make it back to the top and defeat his flash new rivals on Piston Cup Racing's biggest stage.

titles.title: Casablanca
titles.summary: Classic war-time romantic drama starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman. During World War II former lovers Rick Blaine (Bogart) and Ilsa Lund (Bergman) are reunited by chance in Casablanca, where he runs a nightclub and she, with her husband, Victor Laszlo (Paul Henreid), is working for the Czech Resistance. Recriminations, rekindled desires and patriotic duty battle for primacy as Ilsa's husband tries to outwit the local Nazis and escape from Morocco, whilst Rick and Ilsa rekindle their love for one another.

titles.title: Catherine the Great
titles.summary: All four parts of the British miniseries starring Helen Mirren in the title role which follows the Empress of Russia as she defies all expectations as a female ruler and sheds light on her relationship with military commander Grigory Potemkin (Jason Clarke).

titles.title: Caught stealing
titles.summary: Austin Butler stars in this crime thriller directed by Darren Aronofsky. In New York in 1998, bartender Hank Thompson (Butler)'s life is turned upside down when his quirky neighbour Russ (Matt Smith) asks Hank to look after his cat while he is out of town. Soon Hank is being threatened by multiple gangsters and as he fights to stay alive and uncover the truth about why this is happening to him, he faces further violence and betrayal. The cast also includes Zoë Kravitz, Liev Schreiber and Vincent D'Onofrio.

titles.title: CBeebies: Party collection
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from Cbeebies favourites including 'Something Special', 'Go Jetters', 'Hey Duggee' and 'Sarah & Duck'.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 26 Feb 2018); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 04 Oct 2022)

titles.title: CBeebies: The snow queen
titles.summary: Stage musical adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's classic fairy tale featuring the CBeebies gang performing live at the Curve Theatre in Leicester. The story follows Gerda (Cat Sandion) as she tries to save her best friend Kai (Dr Ranj) from the evil Snow Queen (Rebecca Keatley), who plans to freeze him forever.

titles.title: Cemetery of splendour
titles.summary: Thai drama written and directed by Apichatpong Weerasethakul. The film follows a group of soldiers as they are stricken by a seemingly incurable and mysterious sleeping sickness that causes them to suffer spiritual hallucinations. Volunteers Jen and Keng (Jenjira Pongpas and Jarinpattra Rueangram) tend to the patients in a temporary clinic housed in a remote, former school in the Thai town of Khon Kaen. While Jen keeps a close eye on Itt (Banlop Lomnoi), a soldier who has few visitors, Jen uses her psychic abilities to bridge the gap between the unconscious men and their families. Meanwhile, doctors at the facility try a variety of different techniques to treat the unusual condition.

titles.title: CFF collection: Volume 6 - outer space
titles.summary: Triple bill of British movies produced by the Children's Film Foundation. In 'Supersonic Saucer' (1956) an alien from Venus befriends a group of children and helps them to fend off a band of thieves. In 'Kadoyng' (1972) three youngsters team up with an extra-terrestrial being in an attempt to stop their village being demolished. In 'The Glitterball' (1977) two boys help a young alien get back to its mothership with the Air Force and a petty criminal hot on their heels.

titles.title: Challengers
titles.summary: Luca Guadagnino directs this American drama starring Zendaya, Mike Faist and Josh O'Connor. Forced to abandon her dreams of becoming a professional tennis player, Tashi Duncan (Zendaya) is now a successful coach to her husband, Art (Faist), who is about to face the biggest challenge of his career. Meanwhile, Art's former best friend and competitor for Tashi's affections, Patrick (O'Connor), is rising through the ranks of the lower tournaments and looks to play against Art in one final face-off. When Tashi reunites with Patrick once again, however, who will she choose to stand by?

titles.title: Chaos walking
titles.summary: Tom Holland and Daisy Ridley star in this sci-fi adventure based on the trilogy of novels by Patrick Ness. In the distant future, Viola Eade (Ridley) crash-lands on New World, a planet recently colonised by humans where everyone can hear each other's thoughts. She meets Todd (Holland), who has been raised to believe that every woman on the planet was killed by a deadly virus which also caused 'The Noise'. When war breaks out and Viola's life is threatened, Todd vows to protect her as he attempts to solve the mysteries of his home planet. The cast also includes Mads Mikkelsen, Demián Bichir and Cynthia Erivo.

titles.title: Charlie and Lola: The absolutely complete series 3
titles.sortTitle: charlie and lola: the absolutely complete series 3
titles.summary: The entire third season of the animated series based on the bestselling books by Lauren Child. Episodes are: 'I Really Really Need Actual Ice Skates', 'I Wish I Could Do That and Also That Too', 'What Can I Wear for Halloween?', 'But Marv Is Absolutely Charlie's Best Friend', 'But We Always Do It Like This', 'I Can't Stop Hiccuping', 'I Am Going to Save a Panda', 'I've Got Nobody to Play With', 'I Am Making a Craze', 'But Where Completely Are We?', 'I Slightly Want to Go Home', 'I Am Extremely, Absolutely Boiling', 'I Am Goody the Good', 'It Is Very Special and Extremely Ancient', 'I Would Like to Actually Keep It', 'It's Raining It's Boring', 'I Can Dance Like a Dancer', 'Help I Really Mean It', 'Our Shop Sells Everything', 'I Am Inventing a Usefullish Invention', 'I Can Train Your Dog', 'Do Not Ever Never Let Go', 'I Am Completely Hearing and Also Listening', 'But I Don't Really Like This Present', 'I Really Absolutely Must Have Glasses', 'Thunder Completely Does Not Scare Me' and 'Everything Is Different and not the Same'.

titles.title: Charlie Chaplin: Limelight
titles.summary: Charlie Chaplin writes, directs and stars in this comedy drama. Set in London, just before the start of the First World War, a former stage clown (Chaplin) rescues a young dancer (Claire Bloom) from suicide, helps her career and watches her rise to stardom, just as he is being forgotten. Buster Keaton co-stars as Chaplin's stage partner.

titles.title: Charlie Chaplin: The great dictator
titles.summary: The rise of Nazism is spoofed in this 1940 film, in which an amnesiac Jewish barber is mistaken for the dictator of Tomania, Adenoid Hynkel (both played by Chaplin). Paulette Goddard, Jack Oakie and Reginald Gardiner co-star.

titles.title: Chernobyl
titles.summary: All five parts of the historical drama miniseries depicting events from the Chernobyl nuclear disaster of April 1986 and the aftermath that followed. The show follows the stories of those who fought to attempt to contain the disaster as well as the coverups surrounding the true magnitude of the unfolding catastrophic situation. The episodes are: '1:23:45', 'Please Remain Calm', 'Open Wide, O Earth', 'The Happiness of All Mankind' and 'Vichnaya Pamyat'.

titles.title: Chicken run
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure co-directed by Nick Park and Peter Lord. Life on Tweedy's Chicken Farm is far from pleasant for the inmates. They are badly treated by Mr Tweedy (voice of Tony Haygarth) and his domineering wife, and are kept alive only as long as they keep producing eggs. Ginger (Julia Sawalha)'s various attempts at escape have failed due to the lethargy of her fellow chickens but when Rocky (Mel Gibson) crash lands on the farm, she sees the chance she has been waiting for. If Rocky can teach everyone how to fly, they can stage a mass break-out. Can he help Ginger and her friends find freedom before Mrs Tweedy (Miranda Richardson) executes her terrible plan to turn them all into chicken pies?

titles.title: The children act
titles.summary: British drama in which a high court judge must make a life-or-death decision on behalf of a child while struggling with her own problems in her personal life. Putting her marriage and own self-interests on the back burner, Fiona Maye (Emma Thompson) puts her time and energy into a high-profile case which sees a 17-year-old Jehovah's Witness refuse a life-saving blood transfusion due to his religious principles. With the boy's condition worsening by the day, it is up to Fiona to ultimately decide whether to overrule the parents' and child's decision and enforce the blood transfusion or to grant the family their wish and dismiss it. When Fiona liaises with the boy herself to gain a greater understanding of his needs feelings of regret rise to the surface as she reflects on her failing marriage and her husband, Jack (Stanley Tucci), begs her to fight for their relationship. When the time comes for Fiona to lay down the law, which path will she choose and can she mend her broken bond with her husband?

titles.title: Chinatown
titles.summary: Jack Nicholson stars in this crime drama directed by Roman Polanski. Private eye Jake Gittes (Nicholson) is hired to follow water commissioner Hollis Mulwray (Darrell Zwerling), only to see him turn up dead at the bottom of a reservoir. Realising he has been used, Gittes confronts Mulwray's widow, Evelyn (Faye Dunaway), a woman who seems to have plenty of secrets of her own, not least her ambiguous relationship with her father, Noah Cross (John Huston).

titles.title: The choral
titles.summary: Ralph Fiennes stars in this comedy drama directed by Nicholas Hytner. In 1916, the Ramsden Choral Society in Yorkshire has seen most of its members and its choir master depart for the Western Front. Dr. Henry Guthrie (Fiennes), recently returned from working in Germany, is reluctantly hired to lead the choir and he begins recruiting new members before attempting to stage a performance of Edward Elgar's 'The Dream of Gerontius'. Despite the committee's reservations, Guthrie's talent is undeniable and as he showcases new voices, those awaiting news from the Front find some measure of hope to cling to during the dark days of war. The cast also includes Robert Emms, Alun Armstrong and Mark Addy.

titles.title: Christmas story
titles.summary: Finnish Christmas drama imagining Santa Claus's childhood. When young Nikolas (Otto Gustavsson) becomes orphaned after an accident, the residents of his village decide to care for him collectively, the arrangement being that every Christmas Nikolas will move on to a new home in the village. Nikolas starts making toys as gifts for the children of the families who extended their generosity towards him. Over the years, Nikolas's former adoptive families become many, and almost every household finds presents on its doorstep on Christmas morning. But things look set to change when Nikolas goes to work for grumpy carpenter Iisakki (Kari Vaananen). Can he find a way to continue bringing joy to children at Christmas time?

titles.title: Christopher Robin
titles.summary: Ewan McGregor stars in this fantasy adventure based on the characters created by A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard. Now grown up and living in the city, Christopher Robin (McGregor) finds it difficult to find time for his family while working as a businessman. Just as things are starting to get on top of him, his childhood friend Pooh (voice of Jim Cummings) appears looking for his help having lost all of his friends.
