The pair head back to the Hundred Acre Wood where Christopher helps Pooh locate his missing buddies and is reunited with Tigger (Cummings), Eeyore (Brad Garrett), Rabbit (Peter Capaldi) and Piglet (Nick Mohammed) once more. However, the animals soon see Christopher has lost his sense of imagination, and, when he heads back to the real world, Pooh and the rest of the gang decide to repay Christopher by helping him rediscover his love for life.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 24 Aug 2022); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 19 Jul 2024)

titles.title: The chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
titles.summary: The story continues as exiled heir to the throne, Prince Caspian (Ben Barnes), tries to defeat evil King Miraz (Sergio Castellitto) and regain his rightful place on the throne. Thinking it has only been one year since they last visited the magical kingdom of Narnia, the four child heroes return to discover that 1300 years have actually passed in the kingdom. With Narnia's golden age over, the usurpers, King Miraz and Queen Punaprisma (Alicia Borrachero), have taken the throne. Eager to keep his bloodline on the throne, the evil king plans to kill the rightful heir, Prince Caspian, in order that his son will inherit the kingdom. Now it's up to Peter (William Moseley), Susan (Anna Popplewell), Edmund (Skandar Keynes) and Lucy (Georgie Henley) to find Prince Caspian and, with the aid of those loyal to Narnia, restore the rightful king to the throne.

titles.title: Chuggington: Chuggineers ready to build
titles.summary: Special episode of the CBeebies animated series following the adventures of three apprentice engines - Wilson (voice of Morgan Overton), Brewster (Toby Davies) and Koko (Imogen Bailey) - in the fun-packed land of Chuggington. The episodes are: 'Chuggineers Ready to Build', 'Brewster Makes Tracks', 'Back Up Brewster', 'The Old Silver Mine Line' and 'On Track Brewster'.

titles.title: Cinderella
titles.summary: Musical adaptation of the classic fairy tale. Cinderella (Camila Cabello) has big dreams of becoming a successful fashion designer and with the help of her Fabulous Godmother (Billy Porter), she's determined to make them come true. Nicholas Galitzine, Idina Menzel, Pierce Brosnan and Minnie Driver also star.

titles.title: Cinderella
titles.summary: Kenneth Branagh directs this live-action fairy tale adaptation starring Lily James, Richard Madden, Cate Blanchett and Helena Bonham Carter. When her widowed father remarries to Lady Tremaine (Blanchett), Ella (James) does her best to be welcoming to her stepmother and her new stepsisters Anastasia (Holliday Grainger) and Drizella (Sophie McShera). However, after the unexpected death of her father, Ella finds herself being mistreated by Lady Tremaine and her daughters, forced to be a servant and nicknamed 'Cinderella'. One day in the woods she encounters a handsome stranger and believes him to work in the Palace, not realising he is in fact Prince Charming (Madden). Ella's household receives an invitation to a royal ball and Ella hopes she will get the chance to see the young man again. When Lady Tremaine refuses to let her attend the ball, a friendly fairy (Bonham Carter) steps in to lend a helping hand. The film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Costume Design.

titles.title: Cinderella
titles.summary: Children's animation which offers an unorthodox take on the classic fairy tale. Set amidst the tumult and adventure of the Wild West, a land populated by anthropomorphic animals, the tale follows cowgirl Cinderella as she prepares for a night at the royal ball. However, with her love Prince Vladimir and his mother, the Duchess, having been kidnapped by a band of gorilla pirates, Cinderella will have to display her toughness if she wants to rescue them from their plight. She duly sets off in pursuit, spurred on by the aid of a spiritualist with special powers. How will she fare?

titles.title: Cinderella (Disney)
titles.summary: Disney's animated version of the classic fairy tale. When her widowed father marries the wicked Lady Tremaine (voice of Eleanor Audley), Cinderella (Ilene Woods) does her best to be welcoming to her new stepmother and stepsisters Anastasia (Lucille Bliss) and Drizella (Rhoda Williams). However, she soon finds herself being mistreated by Lady Tremaine and her daughters and forced to work as a servant. One day in the woods she encounters a handsome stranger and believes him to work in the Palace, not realising that he is in fact Prince Charming (William Phipps). Cinderella's household then receives an invitation to a royal ball and she hopes she will get the chance to see the young man again, but when Lady Tremaine refuses to let her attend, a friendly fairy (Verna Felton) steps in to lend a helping hand.

titles.title: Cinema Paradiso
titles.summary: Director Guiseppe Tornatore's award-winning film focuses on the effect that cinema had on the inhabitants of a small Sicilian village during World War Two. After receiving news of the death of an old friend, director Salvatore Di Vita (Jacques Perrin) returns to his home village after spending 30 years away. In flashback, Salvatore (Salvatore Cascio/Marco Leonardi) recalls his fatherless childhood, his fascination with the films he saw at the local cinema and his adventures with Alfredo (Philippe Noiret), the cinema's projectionist.

titles.title: Civil war
titles.summary: Alex Garland writes and directs this dystopian war drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Nick Offerman. The United States is giving way to a disastrous civil war between the armed forces of the President (Offerman)'s dictatorship and the rebel resistance fighters, with many civillians being killed in the ensuing battles. Photojournalists Lee and Joel (Dunst and Moura) are travelling to Washington D.C. to meet with the President when they are caught in the crossfire of the fighting, saving young photographer Jessie (Caelie Spaeny) from an airstrike. With Jessie now in tow, Lee and Joel attempt to capture the devastation as they precariously make their way across the war-torn and increasingly dangerous United States.

titles.title: The clan
titles.summary: Argentinian crime drama directed by Pablo Trapero based on real events from the 1980s. The clan Puccio is a middle-class family presided over by iron-fisted Arquimedes (Guillermo Francella). Recently unemployed, he conspires with his eldest son Alejandro (Peter Lanzani) to kidnap members of local wealthy families and hold them to ransom, unbeknownst to his wife Epifanía (Lili Popovich) and the rest of his family. With the local police force agreeing to turn a blind eye, Arquimedes can get away with anything. Cracks begin to appear in the family stronghold, however, as Alejandro envisages a different life for himself and other family members begin to suspect.

titles.title: The clean up crew
titles.summary: Jonathan Rhys Meyers and Antonio Banderas star in this action comedy directed by Jon Keeyes. When Siobhan (Melissa Leo) and her team of crime scene cleaners - Alex (Rhys Meyers), Megan (Ekaterina Baker) and Chuck (Swen Temmel) - find a large amount of money hidden in the chimney of the house they are cleaning up, they decide to take it. However, the money belongs to Gabriel (Banderas) and was intended to pay off some corrupt police officers until an attempt to steal it resulted in the mess that the cleaners are currently removing. With both Gabriel and the police coming after the money and willing to kill to retrieve it, is there any way out for the clean up crew?

titles.title: Clifford the big red dog
titles.summary: Fantasy adventure based on the series of children's books by Norman Bridwell. When 12-year-old Emily Elizabeth Howard (Darby Camp) is gifted a little red puppy, which she names Clifford, her love for her new pet causes Clifford to grow to an enormous size. As he proceeds to cause havoc across Manhattan and in Emily's uncle (Jack Whitehall)'s apartment, Clifford's antics attract the attention of biotech company owner Zac Tiernan (Tony Hale), who wants to capture the giant hound for his own evil experiments. Can Emily and her new friend Owen (Izaac Wang) find a way to save Clifford before it's too late?

titles.title: Climax
titles.summary: Sofia Boutella stars in this French musical horror written and directed by Gaspar Noé. When a group of urban dancers meet at an abandoned boarding school for a three-day rehearsal, they decide to dedicate an evening to a party where they share a bowl of sangria. When they start to hallucinate, they realise that someone has spiked the drink with LSD. As a few of the dancers begin to reveal their darkest secrets while under the influence of the drug, some will end up experiencing heaven while others descend into hell...

titles.title: Close
titles.summary: Belgian coming-of-age drama directed by Lukas Dhont. The close relationship of 13-year-old best friends Léo (Eden Dambrine) and Rémi (Gustav De Waele) is abruptly shattered when they return to school after the summer. Accused of being a couple and bullied by their peers, Léo begins to withdraw from Rémi, with tragic consequences.

titles.title: Cloud babies: Wide awake sun
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the animated children's series. Baba Pink, Baba Blue, Baba Yellow and Baba Green live with little Sky Imp Bobo White in a house high up in the clouds and it is their job to look after the sky.

titles.title: Clouds of Sils Maria
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Oliver Assayas starring Juliette Binoche. In the middle of a divorce, veteran actress Maria Enders (Binoche) is asked to star in a new adaptation of 'Maloja Snake' by Wilhelm Melchior, the play that launched her career two decades earlier. This time, however, Maria is not asked to reprise the role that she portrayed when she was 16, and instead is required to play middle-aged businesswoman Helena who is manipulated and eventually driven to suicide by her young assistant. To prepare for the role, Maria departs for Sils Maria, a remote region of the Alps, with her devoted assistant Valentine (Kristen Stewart). Aided by Valentine, Maria investigates the young and reckless American actress (Chloë Grace Moretz) who has been chosen to interpret the role of her character's assistant. As Maria then begins to notice more of herself in the youthful actress, she finds herself confronting some of the demons that come with her profession...

titles.title: Coco
titles.summary: Animated adventure directed by Lee Unkrich and Adrian Molina. The film follows Miguel Rivera (voice of Anthony Gonzalez), a 12-year-old aspiring musician desperate to become a star like his idol Ernesto de la Cruz (Benjamin Bratt), Mexico's most famous music and film star. Despite being banned from playing music by his family, Miguel sets off on an epic adventure to the Land of the Dead with his dog Dante and trickster Hector (Gael García Bernal) in a bid to find Ernesto and unlock the secrets behind his mysterious family history.

titles.title: Cocoon
titles.summary: German coming-of-age drama written and directed by Leonie Krippendorff. Awkward 14-year-old Nora (Lena Urzendowsky) spends the summer hanging out with her older sister Jule (Lena Klenke) and trying to gain acceptance from her peers as their mother neglects them due to her alcohol addiction. When a new girl, Romy (Jella Haase), arrives Nora finds herself drawn to her vitality and a new found confidence grows within her as she begins to note the subtle changes into adulthood.

titles.title: Code unknown
titles.summary: Walking along a Paris street, following a meeting with his brother's girlfriend Anne (Juliette Binoche), Jean (Alexandre Hamidi) contemptuously throws an empty paper bag into the open hands of Romanian beggar Maria (Luminita Gheorghiu). Music teacher Amadou (Ona Lu Yenke) witnesses this, and when he demands that Jean apologise to Maria, the two get caught in a scuffle which results in both Amadou's arrest and Maria's deportation. Michael Haneke's film takes this brief moment and follows the paths of all its main characters over the subsequent weeks, tracing the subtle ways in which different lives intertwine in modern-day Europe.

titles.title: Cold call
titles.summary: All four parts of the British drama miniseries starring Sally Lindsay as single mother June, who loses a large sum of money to a cold call scam. After selling a house and having the entire sum of money stolen, June sets out to discover who is responsible, forcing her to make difficult decisions that put her in danger.

titles.title: Cold storage
titles.summary: Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell and Liam Neeson star in this horror comedy directed by Jonny Campbell. When an extremely contagious and mutative parasitic fungus breaches containment, its destructive capabilities threaten the future of humanity. Free to spread after spending years lying dormant in a cold storage vault, the fungus begins infecting and destroying every living thing in its path. As security guards Travis and Naomi (Keery and Campbell) fight to keep it contained, bioterror operative Robert Quinn (Neeson) races to the site of the outbreak to aid their fight. The cast also includes Lesley Manville, Vanessa Redgrave and Sosie Bacon.

titles.title: Cold War
titles.summary: Pawel Pawlikowski co-writes and directs this romantic drama set during the Cold War. In Poland in 1949, musical director Wiktor Warski (Tomasz Kot) finds a star in young student Zula Lichon (Joanna Kulig), while scouting local talent for his folk group. After enjoying success and beginning an affair, the couple are split apart when their show is forced to become a Soviet propaganda act and Wiktor heads for the freedom of Western Europe while Zula hesitates and opts to stay, a decision that will shape their tragic romance for decades to come.

titles.title: Collateral
titles.summary: All four episodes from the British television drama miniseries in which a young man in South London is shot dead as he delivers a pizza. The detective overseeing the chase, DI Kip Glaspie (Carey Mulligan) uncovers that the victim was a Syrian refugee named Abdullah Asif (Sam Otto) who should not have been on shift that night. DI Glaspie must get to the bottom of the case by figuring out the motive for the murder and find the perpetrator among a few unlikely suspects.

titles.title: Collective
titles.summary: Exposé documentary from film-maker Alexander Nanau which examines the aftermath of a devastating fire that took hold of the Colectiv nightclub in Bucharest, Romania, when sparks from a band's pyrotechnics set the venue ablaze and killed 64 people. In its wake, a team of investigative journalists are tipped off about the unfolding of a national scandal and they set out to dig deeper.

titles.title: The color purple
titles.summary: Blitz Bazawule directs this musical adaptation of Alice Walker's Pulitzer prize-winning novel starring Fantasia Barrino and Colman Domingo. Over the course of 40 years, the film follows the life of Celie (Barrino), a poor black woman who endures years of abuse from her father and her husband Mister (Domingo). When her husband embarks on an affair with the beautiful Shug (Taraji P. Henson), an attraction is also formed between the two women, and lonely Celie finally begins to blossom. The cast also includes Danielle Brooks, Halle Bailey and Jon Batiste.

titles.title: The colors within
titles.summary: Feature-length Japanese anime directed by Naoko Yamada. High school student Totsuko Higurashi (voice of Sayu Suzukawa) sees colours in people and is drawn to her classmate Kimi Sakunaga (Akari Takaishi) because of the colour she perceives in her. Together with Rui Kagehira (Taisei Kido), they form a band and their friendship blossoms as they create music together.

titles.title: Compartment no.6
titles.summary: Offbeat drama co-written and directed by Juho Kuosmanen. Finnish archaeology student Laura (Seidi Haarla) forms an unlikely bond with Russian miner Vadim (Yuriy Borisov) while travelling aboard a sleeper train from Moscow to Murmansk.

titles.title: A complete unknown
titles.summary: Timothée Chalamet stars in this biographical musical drama co-written and directed by James Mangold. Bob Dylan (Chalamet) arrives in New York and soon becomes part of its vibrant folk music scene but as he rises to stardom, he finds himself desperate for artistic freedom. He wants to record his original music but is forced by his label to release mainly covers. When he begins experimenting with electric instruments, the Newport Folk Festival fear that he may debut his controversial new sound while headlining their 1965 event. When he does just that, many in the crowd are outraged, but he is finally free to be himself. The cast also includes Elle Fanning, Monica Barbaro and Edward Norton.

titles.title: Conclave
titles.summary: Ralph Fiennes and Stanley Tucci star in this thriller from director Edward Berger. Following the death of the Pope, Cardinal Lawrence (Fiennes) is given the task of leading the search for his successor. As he and his friend Cardinal Bellini (Tucci) try to navigate the strange world of the Conclave, he begins to realise that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy which could have devastating consequences for the Catholic Church. The cast also includes John Lithgow, Isabella Rossellini and Jacek Koman.

titles.title: The convert
titles.summary: Lee Tamahori directs this historical drama starring Guy Pearce. Set in 1930s New Zealand, lay preacher Thomas Munro (Pearce) travels to a British settlement to continue his teachings, however he finds himself stuck in the middle of a war between two Maori tribes. The cast also includes Tioreore Ngatai-Melbourne, Antonio Te Maioho and Lawrence Makoare.

titles.title: Coraline
titles.summary: Stop-motion animation based on the novella by Neil Gaiman which follows the trials of a young girl who finds herself in an unsettling parallel reality. After moving into her new home with her busy parents, eleven-year-old Coraline Jones (voice of Dakota Fanning) begins exploring. When she discovers a hidden door, she crawls through the tunnel beyond into an eerie Other World. Initially bewitched by her strange new surroundings where everything seems to revolve around her and the button-eyed doppelgangers of her parents lavish her with attention, Coraline soon has to fight to return home when her Other Mother (Teri Hatcher) tries to force her to stay.

titles.title: Corsage
titles.summary: Marie Kreutzer writes and directs this historical drama starring Vicky Krieps as Empress Elisabeth of Austria. In 1877, the year of her 40th birthday, Elisabeth is struggling. Striving to conform to the required standards of beauty and behaviour, she is becoming increasingly aware of her unhappiness and, worse, her inability to do anything about it. Defiant, she searches for ways to regain control of her life. Florian Teichtmeister, Aaron Friesz and Colin Morgan also star.

titles.title: The county
titles.summary: Icelandic comedy drama directed by Grímur Hákonarson. After her husband, dairy farmer Reynir (Hinrik Olafsson), dies in a road accident, Inga (Arndís Hrönn Egilsdóttir) finds herself drowning in debt and decides to speak out against the rampant corruption in her co-operative farming community.

titles.title: The courier
titles.summary: Benedict Cumberbatch stars in this Cold War thriller directed by Dominic Cooke. In 1960, unsuspecting British businessman Greville Wynne (Cumberbatch) is drawn into the dangerous world of espionage when he is recruited by MI6 and tasked with travelling to Russia to meet with high-ranking Soviet military intelligence officer Oleg Penkovsky (Merab Ninidze) before transporting top-secret information on the Soviet nuclear programme back to London. The cast also includes Rachel Brosnahan, Jessie Buckley and Angus Wright.

titles.title: The courier
titles.summary: Action thriller starring Gary Oldman and Olga Kurylenko. When crime lord Ezekiel Mannings (Oldman) is arrested Special Agent Roberts (Dermot Mulroney) relies on a witness testimonial from Nick Murch (Amit Shah) in order to prosecute him. However, Nick's safety ends up in the hands of a mysterious courier (Kurylenko) delivering a suspect package.

titles.title: Crash: Director's cut
titles.summary: Director's Cut of the oscar-winning urban drama which tracks the volatile intersections of a multi-ethnic cast of characters' struggles to overcome their fears as they careen in and out of one another's lives. A Brentwood housewife and her DA husband; a Persian store owner; two police detectives who are also lovers; an African-American television director and his wife; a Mexican locksmith; two car-jackers; a rookie cop; and a middle-aged Korean couple - they all live in Los Angeles, and during the next 36 hours, they will all collide. Matt Dillon, Sandra Bullock, Don Cheadle and Karina Arroyave star.

titles.title: Crawl
titles.summary: Kaya Scodelario and Barry Pepper star in this American horror directed by Alexandre Aja. When aspiring swimmer Haley (Scodelario) is informed about an impending hurricane due to hit Florida she defies state orders by refusing to evacuate until she has checked on the safety of her father Dave (Pepper). When she discovers him in the basement of the house he is already badly wounded. However, as she attempts to help him to safety Haley realises that the exit is blocked by ravenous alligators. As the storm intensifies and flood water breaches the basement Haley does all she can to protect her father and free them both from the clutches of the alligators.

titles.title: The creation: an oratorio for soprano, tenor and bass soli, SATB and orchestra
titles.sortTitle: creation : an oratorio for soprano, tenor and bass soli, satb and orchestra
subjects: Choruses, Sacred (Mixed voices) with orchestra -- Vocal scores with piano

titles.title: Crime 101
titles.summary: Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo and Halle Berry star in this crime thriller written and directed by Bart Layton. As jewel thief Mike Davis (Hemsworth) considers his future, he seeks help from disgruntled insurance broker Sharon Colvin (Berry) to pull off one last heist. However, Detective Lou Lubesnick (Ruffalo) is hunting Mike and thinks he has uncovered a pattern to his crimes, while Ormon (Barry Keoghan), a violent and unpredictable young criminal, is moving in on Mike's territory and causing havoc. As Lou closes in, can Mike succeed in securing his future and his freedom? The cast also includes Nick Nolte, Monica Barbaro and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

titles.title: The critic
titles.summary: Ian McKellen leads an all-star cast in this British thriller following the plight of a London film critic. In 1930s London, Daily Chronicle film critic Jimmy Erskine (McKellen) is arrested, along with his lover Tom Turner (Alfred Enoch), for homosexuality. Because of his crimes, he is dismissed from his position by his boss Viscount David Brooke (Mark Strong). Eager for revenge, Erskine recruits actress Nina Land (Gemma Arterton) to seduce Brooke with a view to blackmailing him to get his job back. The cast also also includes Lesley Manville, Ben Barnes and Nikesh Patel.

holdings.status: Reservation Allocation Expired (BHCC) (Set: 18 Mar 2025); In-transit from Hove Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 25 Jan 2025)

titles.title: Crock of gold - A few rounds with Shane MacGowan
titles.sortTitle: crock of gold - a few rounds with shane macgowan
titles.summary: Julien Temple directs this documentary charting the life and career of Shane MacGowan, Irish punk musician and lead singer of The Pogues, featuring contributions from those who have been influenced by his music such as Johnny Depp, Nick Cave and Bono.

titles.title: The Croods
titles.summary: A prehistoric family embark on a journey of discovery in this Academy Award-nominated, animated comedy featuring the vocal talents of Nicolas Cage and Ryan Reynolds. Content to stay within the confines of their stone-age cave, Grug (Cage), his wife Ugga (Catherine Keener), daughter Eep (Emma Stone), son Thunk (Clark Duke), and mother-in-law Gran (Cloris Leachman) soon find themselves homeless when a seismic upheaval literally brings the roof down. As they venture out into a wondrous, unknown world in search of a new home, the family soon team up with a nomadic caveboy called Guy (Ryan Reynolds), who offers his own unique take on the challenges ahead. The film received an Oscar nomination for Best Animated Feature.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 25 Apr 2014); On loan - Due: 31 Oct 2026

titles.title: The Croods: A new age
titles.summary: Animated adventure sequel that follows prehistoric patriarch Grug (voice of Nicolas Cage) as he attempts to lead his family to safety. On their travels they discover a secluded land where they think they can be happy, but the problem is it is already occupied. The Betterman family have been living comfortably in this new land so when Grug and his clan threaten to ruin their idyll, tensions form. Can the two families put aside their differences when an even bigger threat occurs?

titles.title: Crossing
titles.summary: Levan Akin writes and directs this Turkish drama starring Mzia Arabuli, Lucas Kankava and Deniz Dumanli. Retired history teacher Lia (Arabuli) embarks on a journey to find her estranged transgender niece Tekla (Tako Kurdovanidze), a journey which leads her to Istanbul. Lia promised Tekla's dying mother that she would find her and return her home and she vows to keep that promise no matter how long it takes. The cast also includes Nino Karchava and Levan Bochorishvili.

titles.title: The crown: Season four
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the fourth season of the biographical drama based on the life of Queen Elizabeth II. The story picks up in 1979 as Margaret Thatcher (Gillian Anderson) is elected Britain's first female Prime Minister. Under pressure from his family to find a suitable wife, Prince Charles (Josh O'Connor) begins dating Lady Diana Spencer (Emma Corrin). The episodes are: 'Gold Stick', 'The Balmoral Test', 'Fairytale', 'Favourites', 'Fagan', 'Terra Nullius', 'The Hereditary Principle', '48:1', 'Avalanche' and 'War'.

titles.title: The crown: Season two
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the second season of the biographical drama based on the life of Queen Elizabeth II. The story picks up in 1957 as Queen Elizabeth (Claire Foy) and Prince Philip (Matt Smith) debate the state of their marriage after Elizabeth suspects Philip of having an affair. Meanwhile, Foreign Secretary Anthony Eden (Jeremy Northam) faces challenges to pass his solution to the Egyptian takeover of the Suez Canal and a secret agreement is uncovered between the British, French and Israeli governments. The episodes are: 'Misadventure', 'A Company of Men', 'Lisbon', 'Beryl', 'Marionettes', 'Vergangenheit', 'Matrimonium', 'Dear Mrs. Kennedy', 'Paterfamilias' and 'Mystery Man'.

titles.title: The crown: The complete fifth season
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the fifth season of the drama based on the life of Queen Elizabeth II (Imelda Staunton). The story picks up in 1991 as the marriage between Prince Charles (Dominic West) and Princess Diana (Elizabeth Debicki) is falling apart and a series of scandals engulf the royal family. The episodes are: 'Queen Victoria Syndrome', 'The System', 'Mou Mou', 'Annus Horribilis', 'The Way Ahead', 'Ipatiev House', 'No Woman's Land', 'Gunpowder', 'Couple 31' and 'Decommissioned'.

titles.title: Cruella
titles.summary: Emma Stone stars as Cruella de Vil in this prequel to '101 Dalmatians' (1961). Aspiring fashion designer Estella (Stone) makes a living as a pickpocket in 1970s London, alongside fellow thieves Jasper (Joel Fry) and Horace (Paul Walter Hauser). As a gift for her birthday Jasper and Horace create a fake CV and gain Estella an entry-level position with the most influential designer in London, the Baroness (Emma Thompson). Estella quickly makes an impact but she has ulterior motives for wanting to get close to the Baroness, and sets out a cunning plan to steal her wealth. In order to do so she must reinvent herself as Cruella, and also find a way of getting round the Baroness' three Dalmatian dogs.

titles.title: Crypto
titles.summary: John Stalberg Jr. directs this American thriller. Wall Street banker Martin Duran (Beau Knapp) returns to his hometown after being demoted from his position in New York. Having been estranged from his family for a number of years Martin struggles to reconnect with his father (Kurt Russell) and older brother Caleb (Luke Hemsworth). However, when Martin investigates money laundering and finds that the Russian mob are involved Martin and his family find that their lives are in danger.

titles.title: Cuckoo
titles.summary: Hunter Schafer and Dan Stevens star in this horror from writer/director Tilman Singer. After the death of her mother, teenager Gretchen (Schafer) is forced to relocate with her father (Marton Csokas), step-mother (Jessica Henwick) and half-sister (Mila Lieu) to a remote community in the Bavarian Alps. The family quickly get involved in the community project to build a hotel, with Gretchen being offered a job by boss Herr König (Stevens). When Gretchen witnesses strange occurances including female hotel guests vomiting and having seizures, she becomes convinced that there is more to the community than meets the eye.

titles.title: Custody
titles.summary: French drama directed by Xavier Legrand. Desperate to rekindle his relationship with ex-partner Miriam Besson (Léa Drucker), Antoine (Denis Ménochet) goes to the courts to apply for joint custody of their 12-year-old son Julien (Thomas Gioria). However, with Antoine manipulating Julien in order to get what he wants, the whole situation soon becomes too much for him and begins to affect his mental state. The cast also includes Mathilde Auneveux, Mathieu Saikaly and Florence Janas.

titles.title: The cut
titles.summary: Orlando Bloom stars in this psychological thriller directed by Sean Ellis. An unnamed boxer (Bloom) comes out of retirement to compete in a high-stakes fight in the hope of making a comeback. With only one week to lose a significant amount of weight, he undertakes a gruelling training regimen. However, as his obsessive quest spirals into self-destruction, he begins to lose his grip on reality. The cast also includes Caitríona Balfe and John Turturro.

titles.title: The cynic, the rat and the fist
titles.sortTitle: cynic, the rat and the fist
titles.summary: Umberto Lenzi directs this action-packed Italian crime thriller. After escaping from prison, rising criminal Luigi 'Chinaman' Maietto (Tomas Milian) orders a hit on Inspector Tanzi (Maurizio Merli) who put him behind bars. Unfortunately for him, Tanzi survives and vows to do all he can to return Maietto to the prison where he belongs. But if he is to catch him, Tanzi must work outside the law when he denies his superior's request to go into hiding, instead preferring to catch Maietto himself.

titles.title: Cyrano
titles.summary: Peter Dinklage stars in the title role of this adaptation of Edmond Rostand's 19th century comedic play. Accomplished soldier Cyrano de Bergerac is convinced that his appearance makes him unworthy of love. When the object of his affection, Roxanne (Haley Bennett), falls madly in love with Christian de Neuvillette (Kelvin Harrison Jr.), a new recruit to his regiment, Cyrano offers his skills as a wordsmith to help the young man win Roxanne's heart with a series of romantic letters, while continuing to love her from afar.

titles.title: Dahomey
titles.summary: Documentary from director Mati Diop following the journey to return stolen treasures to the Kingdom of Dahomey. Part fact and part fiction, the documentary follows the artefacts that were purloined and shipped to France during the Colonial period and put on display at the Musée du Quai Branly. After a lengthy campaign, the items were repatriated and returned to their rightful home.

titles.title: Damaged
titles.summary: Samuel L. Jackson, Gianni Capaldi and Vincent Cassel star in this thriller from director Terry McDonough. Detective Dan Lawson (Jackson) is called in after a spate of serial killings occur in Scotland. Working alongside Detective Inspector Glen Boyd (Capaldi), Lawson connects the new killings with a case he worked on five years previously in Chicago and attempts to figure out whether it is a copycat killer or if the murderer has crossed oceans to find new targets. The cast also include Kate Dickie, John Hannah and Laura Haddock.

titles.title: Dancer in the dark
titles.summary: Björk stars in this musical drama written and directed by Lars von Trier. Selma (Björk) is a Czech immigrant who works as a machine operator in an American tool factory. Almost blind herself, she struggles to make enough money to pay for the operation which will save her son's eyesight, and has nearly collected the complete sum when the money is stolen from her by the cop (David Morse) who lives next door. Discovering this, Selma goes to appeal to the cop's mercy, but he refuses to listen and pulls a gun on her, an act which will have fatal consequences for the both of them.

titles.title: Danger Mouse: Mission improbable
titles.summary: All-new animated series following the adventures of the world's greatest secret agent Danger Mouse (voice of Alexander Armstrong) and his best friend and sidekick, Penfold (Kevin Eldon), as they pit themselves against all manner of threats with the help of their boss Colonel K (Stephen Fry).

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 04 Nov 2015); Being repaired (Set: 11 Dec 2023)

titles.title: Dangerous animals
titles.summary: Jai Courtney and Hassie Harrison star in this Australian horror thriller directed by Sean Byrne. After surviving a shark attack as a boy, Tucker (Courtney) became obsessed with the creatures and is now a serial killer who feeds his live victims to sharks. When he abducts nomadic surfer Zephyr (Harrison), will she be able to escape this brutal fate? The cast also includes Josh Heuston, Rob Carlton and Ella Newton.

titles.title: The dark and the wicked
titles.summary: American horror written and directed by Bryan Bertino. When they learn that their father (Michael Zagst) is terminally ill, siblings Louise (Marin Ireland) and Michael (Michael Abbot Jr) return to be with him in his final days at the remote farmhouse where they grew up. However, upon their return the pair find that their mother (Julie Oliver-Touchstone) has drastically changed, and they grow increasingly concerned by the presence of strange voices...

titles.title: Dark habits
titles.summary: Spanish comedy drama written and directed by Pedro Almodóvar. Cristina S. Pascual stars as Yolanda, a nightclub singer who witnesses her boyfriend die from an overdose. With the police out to question her, she decides to take refuge with a strange band of nuns in a convent in Madrid. With the convent, which was set up to offer shelter to troubled women, in serious danger of closure due to the withdrawal of funding from their main benefactor, the nuns welcome Yolanda and plan to get her to sing at a party for their wealthy patron in the hope that it will convince her not to abandon them. The cast also includes Julieta Serrano, Carmen Maura and Cecilia Roth.

titles.title: Dark horse
titles.summary: Todd Solonz writes and directs this bittersweet dark comedy drama charting the dysfunctional romance that unfolds between two 30-something misfits. Abe (Jordan Gelber) is a balding, chronically dissatisfied 'kidult' who works for his father (Christopher Walken), is spoiled rotten by his doting mother (Mia Farrow), and spends his free time indulging his passion for collecting toys. When he meets Miranda (Selma Blair), a failed writer going through post break-up depression, the two gradually enter into an unstable relationship with a habit of going off at some unexpected and bizarre tangents.

titles.title: Dark river
titles.summary: Ruth Wilson and Mark Stanley star in this British drama written and directed by Clio Barnard. The film follows Alice (Wilson), a young woman who returns home to the family farm in North Yorkshire following the death of her father. With her brother Joe (Stanley) angry that he was left to look after their ill father and run the farm on his own, the pair's relationship soon hits breaking point when Alice reveals she intends to apply to become the farm's sole tenant, a move which brings a number of dark memories back to the surface. The cast also includes Sean Bean and Shane Attwooll.

titles.title: Dark waters
titles.summary: Mark Ruffalo stars in this legal thriller directed by Todd Haynes. Robert Bilott (Ruffalo) is a corporate lawyer making his name and money by defending large chemical corporations. When he is visited by a farmer who tells Robert that his cows are being poisoned by chemical company DuPont, he at first does not take the farmer seriously. However, when he starts to investigate, Robert soon begins to realise that DuPont have knowingly poisoned the water supply for the last 40 years and have no plans to stop. Can a corporate lawyer turn the tables on the companies he has dedicated his career to defending?

titles.title: Darkest hour
titles.summary: Gary Oldman stars in this British war drama directed by Joe Wright. During World War II, with the threat of a German invasion looming, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill (Oldman) faces some huge decisions as he plots to stop the Nazi advance. With time running out, Churchill must decide whether to negotiate with the Germans in a bid to save British lives or rally his troops and fight back against all the odds. The cast also includes Ben Mendelsohn, Kristin Scott Thomas and Lily James.

titles.title: David Attenborough's Natural History Museum alive
titles.sortTitle: david attenborough's natural history museum alive
titles.summary: David Attenborough presents this documentary that makes use of cutting-edge CGI to bring to life the residents of London's Natural History Museum. From famously extinct creatures such as the dodo and dinosaurs to some lesser known animals from Earth's prehistoric past, Attenborough highlights the distinctive features of the residents he meets and discusses how they may have lived and died.

titles.title: David Bowie: Sound and vision
titles.summary: Documentary about the late rock icon David Bowie. The programme features interviews with friends, family and music contemporaries, as well as footage of his live performances, to chronicle his impactful and diverse career from the '60s through to the new millennium.

titles.title: Day of the fight
titles.summary: Jack Huston directs this sporting drama starring Michael Pitt, Steve Buscemi and Joe Pesci. Once renowned boxer Mike Flannigan (Pitt) has been serving time in prison. On the day of his release, he vows to fight again and sets in motion preparations for his redemption. The cast also includes Ron Perlman, John Magaro and Nicolette Robinson.

titles.title: The day the earth blew up: Looney Tunes
titles.sortTitle: day the earth blew up: looney tunes
titles.summary: Animated sci-fi comedy directed by Peter Browngardt. When a meteor crashes to Earth and damages the roof of the farmhouse where Porky Pig and Daffy Duck (voices of Eric Bauza) live, they both get jobs at a nearby bubble-gum factory so that they can afford the repairs. However, when they discover that an alien has contaminated the gum and intends to use it to bring everyone on Earth under his control, Daffy and Porky join forces with Petunia Pig (Candi Milo) and attempt to save the world.

titles.title: DC league of super-pets
titles.summary: Animated action adventure featuring the DC Comics superhero pets. When his beloved owner and best friend Superman (voice of John Krasinski) is captured by Lex Luthor (Marc Maron), Krypto the Superdog (Dwayne Johnson) unites a team of super-pets, including Ace the Bat-Hound (Kevin Hart), pig PB (Vanessa Bayer), turtle Merton (Natasha Lyonne) and squirrel Chip (Diego Luna), to save the captive superheroes of the Justice League. The voice cast also includes Kate McKinnon, Keanu Reeves, Jameela Jamil and Olivia Wilde.

titles.title: The dead don't die
titles.summary: Jim Jarmusch writes and directs this zombie comedy starring Bill Murray, Adam Driver and Chloë Sevigny. When the sleepy town of Centerville is suddenly struck by an influx of flesh-eating zombies, it is up to local police officers Cliff Robertson (Murray), Ronnie Peterson (Driver) and Mindy Morrison (Sevigny) to put their learned experience to use by slaying any walking dead that get in their way. The cast also includes Danny Glover, Selena Gomez, Steve Buscemi, Tom Waits and Iggy Pop.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 22 Nov 2019); On reserve shelf at Hove Library

titles.title: Dead in a week or your money back
titles.sortTitle: dead in a week or your money back
titles.summary: British action comedy starring Aneurin Barnard, Tom Wilkinson and Christopher Eccleston. After several failed suicide attempts, despairing writer William (Barnard) hires professional hitman Leslie O'Neil (Wilkinson) to kill him. Despite signing his own death warrant, William begins having second thoughts when a publisher shows interest in his new book. However, Leslie is reluctant to rescind their agreement and eager to prove to his boss that he still has what it takes to be an effective assassin.

titles.title: Dead man's wire
titles.summary: Bill Skarsgård stars in this crime thriller directed by Gus Van Sant. After falling behind on his mortgage payments, Indianapolis businessman Tony Kiritsis (Skarsgård) takes his mortgage broker Richard Hall (Dacre Montgomery) hostage using a shotgun connected to a dead man's wire. He feels he has been cheated by Hall's company and is desperate for justice. As the police and journalists circle, Tony shares his story with radio DJ Fred Temple (Colman Domingo) and fights to be heard. The cast also includes Al Pacino, Cary Elwes and Myha'la.

titles.title: Dead of winter
titles.summary: Brian Kirk directs this thriller starring Emma Thompson. Following her husband's death, Barb (Thompson) travels to Minnesota to fulfil his wishes of having his ashes spread at Lake Hilda, the location of their first date. After a snowstorm causes her to divert from her route, she encounters a cabin where she notices blood in the snow. Asking the cabin's owner for directions in order to investigate the blood, Barb discovers a kidnapped girl in the basement, but can she distract him long enough to let her escape?

titles.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
titles.summary: Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman reprise their roles as Deadpool and Wolverine in this superhero action adventure sequel directed by Shawn Levy. When Deadpool learns that Mr Paradox (Matthew Macfadyen) from the Time Variance Authority is planning to destroy his universe, he embarks on a mission to find a Wolverine variant who can help him to save his world from annihilation. However, when Mr Paradox sends the two of them into the Void, they meet another even more powerful threat in the form of Cassandra Nova (Emma Corrin) and soon, Deadpool's world is not the only one at risk of destruction. The cast also includes Dafne Keen, Chris Evans and Wesley Snipes.

titles.title: Dear Evan Hansen
titles.summary: Ben Platt stars in the title role of this adaptation of the coming-of-age Broadway musical. 17-year-old high school student Evan Hansen suffers from crippling social anxiety. To help him overcome his fears and boost his confidence, his therapist advises Evan to write a series of letters to himself. After one of his classmates commits suicide, a misunderstanding places Evan and his letters in the spotlight. However, as he uses his new-found popularity to help others tackle their mental health issues, Evan's false claims start to come under scrutiny. The cast also includes Kaitlyn Dever, Amy Adams, Julianne Moore and Amandla Stenberg.

titles.title: Death on the Nile
titles.summary: Kenneth Branagh directs and stars as Belgian detective Hercule Poirot in this US crime drama based on the novel by Agatha Christie. While on holiday in 1930s Egypt, Poirot finds himself on the hunt for a killer after rich heiress Linnet Ridgeway-Doyle (Gal Gadot) is tragically murdered aboard a cruise ship travelling down the Nile. After discovering that a number of the passengers had a reason to kill her, Poirot faces a race against time to solve the case before the ship reaches port. The cast also includes Armie Hammer, Tom Bateman and Emma Mackey.

titles.title: Death squad
titles.summary: Futuristic sci-fi thriller. In 2047 Earth has been taken over and is now ruled by the Confederate Central Government who repress all its occupants. In a rising rebel movement Ryan Willburn (Stephen Baldwin), a Green War agent, is given the task of investigating the CCG for its acts of crime against Earth's inhabitants. His mission pits him against the fearsome Colonel Asimov (Rutger Hauer) and his loyal group of mercenaries but Willburn will not give up and is aided in his fight by Tuage (Neva Leoni), a mutant survivor of the CCG rebellion who vows to offer her assistance.

titles.title: Decision to leave
titles.summary: South Korean psychological thriller directed by Park Chan-Wook. What begins as a standard suicide case soon turns into something far more beguiling for insomniac detective Hae-jun (Park Hae-il) when he meets the elusive Chinese immigrant Seo-rae (Tang Wei). As the truth becomes harder to define, and more bodies turn up, Hae-jun is forced to question not only his own tenacity as a police officer, but also the essential values of his personal life.

titles.title: Deep water
titles.summary: All six episodes from the British television drama following three separate women as they attempt to overcome the overwhelming obstacles in their lives and keep their families and relationships intact. The cast includes Anna Friel, Rosalind Eleazar and Sinead Keenan.

titles.title: Deerskin
titles.summary: Absurd French drama directed by Quentin Dupieux and starring Jean Dujardin. Georges (Dujardin) has recently purchased a deerskin jacket to which he grows increasingly attached. When he moves to a remote mountainous town he befriends local waitress Denise (Adèle Haenel) and together the pair work on a film which revolves around Georges taking jackets from complete strangers.

titles.title: Denial
titles.summary: Rachel Weisz, Tom Wilkinson and Timothy Spall star in this historical drama. Based on her own book, the film follows American historian Deborah Lipstadt (Weisz)'s legal battle with British scholar David Irving (Spall) after he sued her and her publisher for accusing him of being a Holocaust denier in 1996. In the courtroom, Lipstadt and her British lawyers Anthony Julius (Andrew Scott) and Richard Rampton (Wilkinson) are made to prove that Irving was lying by denying the Holocaust and must therefore prove its occurrence in their defence. Desperate to take to the stand herself, Lipstadt is approached by numerous Holocaust survivors eager to testify but her legal team remain steadfast in their intention to keep the trial focused on Irving and on the validity of Lipstadt's claims.

titles.title: Der pass
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the German-Austrian drama which follows a police investigation into the discovery of a body lying on the German-Austrian border. German commissioner Ellie Stocker (Julia Jentsch) and Austrian inspector Gedeon Winter (Nicholas Ofczarek) are sent to carry out their investigation, but soon discover that the brutal murder appears to have been ritualistic in nature and may lead to findings of more bizarre and ruthless killings. Will they uncover the meaning of all this and track down the killer before it's too late?

titles.title: The Derby stallion
titles.summary: Coming-of-age drama starring Zac Efron as Patrick McCardle, a 15-year-old unsure of what he wants to do with his life. Although under pressure from his father to focus on baseball, Patrick meets Houston Jones (Bill Cobbs), a mysterious horse trainer who gives him a shot at riding in the famous Derby Cup. But along with the challenges of training, Patrick must also overcome the malicious intentions of Randy Adams (Michael Nardelli) - local bully, rich kid and five-time Derby Cup Champion.

titles.title: Descendants 2
titles.summary: Kenny Ortega directs this fantasy adventure sequel following the children of some of Disney's most notorious villains. When the celebrity lifestyle becomes too much for Mal (Dove Cameron), she reverts back to her old ways and returns to the Isle of the Lost. However, her sudden return doesn't go down well with her old enemy Uma (China Anne McClain), who is still bitter that Mal was chosen to become a citizen of Auradon over her. Meanwhile, realising that Mal's disappearance could be his fault, Ben (Mitchell Hope) ventures to the Isle with Evie (Sofia Carson) in the hope he can find her and bring her back to Auradon.

titles.title: Descendants 3
titles.summary: Kenny Ortega directs this fantasy adventure sequel following the teenage children of some of Disney's most notorious villains. In this instalment, Mal (Dove Cameron), Evie (Sofia Carson), Carlos (Cameron Boyce) and Jay (Booboo Stewart) return to the Isle of the Lost to select four new recruits to join them at Auradon Prep. Hades (Cheyenne Jackson), ruler of the underworld, uses the opportunity to escape, leading Mal to consider closing the barrier forever. Meanwhile, Audrey (Sarah Jeffery), jealous of Ben (Mitchell Hope) and Mal's recent engagement, casts a sleeping curse on Auradon. With the help of her friends, can Mal reverse the spell and restore order to the kingdom?

titles.title: Despicable me 2
titles.summary: Supervillain Gru and his Minions return in this animated comedy sequel. Now living a life of domestic bliss in suburbia with his adopted daughters Margo (voice of Miranda Cosgrove), Agnes (Elsie Fisher) and Edith (Dana Gaier), Gru (Steve Carell)'s world is turned upside down when he is abducted by agent Lucy Wilde (Kristen Wiig) of the Anti-Villain League on the orders of her boss Silas Ramsbottom (Steve Coogan). All is not as it seems, however, for with the world threatened by a new and dastardly supervillain known as Eduardo (Benjamin Bratt), it falls to Gru and his Minions to save the day.

titles.title: Despicable me 3
titles.summary: Kyle Balda and Pierre Coffin direct this animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Steve Carell, Trey Parker and Kristen Wiig. Now working with his secret agent wife Lucy Wilde (Wiig) at the Anti-Villain League, former supervillain Gru (Carell) is tasked with taking down a new enemy in former child star Balthazar Bratt (Parker). Having grown up to become obsessed with the eccentric character he played in the 1980s, Bratt has hatched a scheme for world domination and will do whatever it takes to achieve his goal. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, it once again falls to Gru and his Minions to save the day.

titles.title: Despicable me 4
titles.summary: Chris Renaud directs this animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Will Ferrell. After welcoming a new addition to their family, Gru and Lucy (Carrell and Wiig) find themselves in danger when a new enemy, the evil Maxime Le Mal (Ferrell), shows up and threatens to destroy their happiness. The voice cast also includes Pierre Coffin, Miranda Cosgrove and Steve Coogan.

titles.title: Destroyer
titles.summary: Karyn Kusama directs this American crime thriller starring Nicole Kidman. 17 years after going undercover with a Californian gang for a lengthy operation, LAPD detective Erin Bell (Kidman) remains haunted by the botched heist that cost her partner Chris (Sebastian Stan) his life. When the gang's dangerous leader Silas (Toby Kebbell) re-emerges, Bell sets about finally bringing him to justice by whatever means necessary.

titles.title: Devil in the dust
titles.summary: Guy Pearce and DeWanda Wise star in this Western thriller directed by Ned Crowley. In Arizona in 1859, former slave Sarah (Wise) and her daughter are shunned by their neighbours, who fear the little girl who seemingly brings death to anyone she touches. Sarah seeks help from Bender (Pearce), a doctor and a broken man, who agrees to escort her and her daughter through the lawless wilderness to Ross (Bill Pullman), a faith healer Sarah hopes can help. However, soon after they begin their journey, they discover that others are seeking the girl and will go to great lengths to take her... The cast also includes Raoul Max Trujillo, Jack Alcott and Joanna Cassidy.

titles.title: The devil wears Prada 2
titles.summary: Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway and Emily Blunt reprise their roles in this comedy drama sequel directed by David Frankel. In the two decades since she left 'Runway' magazine, Andrea Sachs (Hathaway) has become a successful reporter but when she is unexpectedly made redundant, she accepts an offer to return to 'Runway' as the features editor. Meanwhile, Miranda Priestly (Streep), the magazine's formidable editor-in-chief, is struggling to navigate a recent scandal and the rapidly changing world of print media while her former assistant Emily Charlton (Blunt) is now thriving at Dior. As Andy attempts to find her place at 'Runway' once again, she discovers that not only is Miranda's position in jeopardy, but so is the future of 'Runway' itself. The cast also includes Stanley Tucci, Kenneth Branagh and Lucy Liu.

titles.title: Devil's Dyke: a Victorian pastime
titles.summary: The Devil's Dyke, a deep gorge in the South Downs five and a half miles north west of Brighton, began life as a tourist attraction as early as 1818 when a small wooden hut was erected on the adjacent Dyke Hill. In the 1830s a Mr. William Thacker built a hotel on the site, and in later years an adventurous proprietor named James Hubbard took over and increased the facilities to include a bicycle railway, roundabouts, swings, a brass band and all the fun of the fair. He also opened two unusual enterprises; an Aerial Cableway and a Funicular Railway. An essential part of a day out at the Devil's Dyke was the ride on the Brighton and Dyke Railway. The standard gauge line enabled visitors easy access to the Dyke, and during the 1890s James Hubbard's amusement park was one of the most important tourist attractions of South East England.

titles.title: Dial M for murder
titles.summary: Grace Kelly and Ray Milland star in Alfred Hitchcock's classic thriller adapted from the play by Frederick Knott. Former tennis pro Tony Wendice (Milland) hatches a cunning plot to get rid of his socialite wife, Margot (Kelly), when he discovers that she has been having an affair with author Mark Halliday (Robert Cummings). Wendice blackmails a corrupt former schoolmate into murdering her, but the man bungles the job, and Margot, having killed her would-be assailant in self-defence, then finds herself under suspicion of premeditated murder...

titles.title: Diary of a wimpy kid 3 - dog days
titles.sortTitle: diary of a wimpy kid 3 - dog days
titles.summary: Family comedy based on the fourth book in the 'Wimpy Kid' series by author and cartoonist Jeff Kinney. Greg (Zachary Gordon) is having his worst summer ever. A self-confessed 'indoor person', all he wants to do is spend his holidays playing computer games in his room with the curtains drawn. But his mother has other ideas, and packs him off with his best friend, Rowley (Robert Capron), to stay at a country club, where - to Greg's horror - outdoor activites and family bonding are the order of the day.

titles.title: Diary of a wimpy kid 4 - The long haul
titles.sortTitle: diary of a wimpy kid 4 - the long haul
titles.summary: Family comedy sequel based on the ninth book in the 'Diary of a Wimpy Kid' series by author and cartoonist Jeff Kinney. Set one year after the events of 'Diary of a Wimpy Kid - Dog Days' (2012), the Heffley family are preparing to spend four days in the car together as they go on a road trip to see grandma for her 90th birthday. When Greg (Jason Drucker) learns that there is a gaming convention being held on the same weekend just a short distance away, he and Rodrick (Charlie Wright) hatch a plan to ditch their parents and go to the convention. The film also stars Tom Everett Scott, Alicia Silverstone and Joshua Hoover.

titles.title: Didi
titles.summary: Sean Wang directs this coming-of-age comedy drama. Due to start high school soon, 13-year-old Chris Wang (Izaac Wang) has led a sheltered life with his strict Taiwanese-American family. Eager to not get left behind, he spends his summer learning how to flirt, skate and how to truly be himself. The cast also includes Joan Chen, Shirley Chen and Raul Dial.

titles.title: Die my love
titles.summary: Jennifer Lawrence and Robert Pattinson star in this black comedy drama directed by Lynne Ramsay. Grace and Jackson (Lawrence and Pattinson) leave New York City behind to make a fresh start in Montana. Jackson travels a lot for work and as Grace, now lonely and isolated, struggles with a new baby, her mental health rapidly deteriorates. As their once passionate relationship declines, her suspicions about his fidelity intensify and she finds the line between the real and the imagined blurring dangerously. The cast also includes LaKeith Stanfield, Sissy Spacek and Nick Nolte.

titles.title: Diego Maradona
titles.summary: Sporting documentary charting the highs and lows of iconic footballer Diego Maradona. The documentary focuses on Maradona's time with Napoli as he helped them to secure their first ever Serie A title in the 1986-87 season. However, despite his success on the field Maradona was also struggling with the pressures of fame as he battled a cocaine addiction, had links with the local mafia, and fathered an illegitimate son.

titles.title: Dirty God
titles.summary: Sacha Polak co-writes and directs this drama starring Vicky Knight. The film follows single mother Jade (Knight) in the aftermath of an acid attack as she tries to come to terms with her disfigurement and readjust to normal life. After being attacked by her ex-boyfriend, Jade undergoes numerous surgeries and rehabilitation sessions before the perpetrator is put on trial. But as she tries to quell her rage and find love and happiness again, will she ever find a way to feel comfortable in her own skin?

titles.title: The disaster artist
titles.summary: James Franco directs and stars in this drama based on the book by Greg Sestero and Tom Bissell, which chronicles the making of 'The Room' (2003). After meeting in an acting class Sestero (Dave Franco) befriends wannabe actor Tommy Wiseau (James Franco) and the pair move to Los Angeles in the hope of getting their big break. But when Hollywood refuses to grant them work, Wiseau decides to make his own movie. The film follows the troubled making of Wiseau's debut feature and its unexpected success which garnered it cult status as an accidental comedy and made a star of its creator.

titles.title: Disclosure day
titles.summary: Emily Blunt and Josh O'Connor star in this sci-fi thriller directed by Steven Spielberg. Cybersecurity analyst Dr. Daniel Kellner (O'Connor) works for Wardex, an organisation that has kept the existence of extraterrestrial life a secret from humankind for decades. When he decides to reveal the truth to the world, his fate becomes entwined with that of Margaret Fairchild (Blunt), a television meteorologist who has suddenly gained powerful psychic abilities. However, there are those who are determined to do whatever it takes to prevent the truth from coming to light and both Daniel and Margaret are soon in danger. The cast also includes Colin Firth, Colman Domingo and Eve Hewson.

titles.title: A discovery of witches: Season 2
titles.summary: All the episodes from the second season of the fantasy drama starring Matthew Goode and Teresa Palmer and based on the novel by Deborah Harkness which follows a vampire and a witch as they navigate the modern world. With populations of witches, vampires and demons having greatly diminished in the 21st century, vampire Matthew Clairmont (Goode) must blend in to his surroundings while witch Diana Bishop (Palmer) tries to leave her secret world behind as she carries out her life as a historian. When she stumbles across a bewitched book in an Oxford library, however, Diana is dragged back into witchcraft and must uncover the origins of the book. As Matthew encounters Diana and informs her that he has been searching for this very book for over a century, the pair must work as a team to protect it from evil forces while crossing the boundaries of forbidden relationships amongst their kind. In this season the pair travel back in time where they hope an encounter with the all-powerful Goody Alsop (Sheila Hancock) can enlighten Diana on how to harness her magic abilities.

titles.title: Disney zombies
titles.summary: US musical drama directed by Paul Hoen. 50 years after a terrible accident turned half the population of Seabrook into zombies, zombie students start going to the human high school and mixing with the general population. Despite a difficult first meeting, zombie Zed (Milo Manheim) gets to know human cheerleader Addison (Meg Donnelly) and the pair soon fall in love. With the rest of the students unhappy with their relationship, Zed and Addison do their best to prove zombies and humans can get along.

titles.title: Disney's Snow White
titles.summary: Rachel Zegler and Gal Gadot star in this live-action reimagining of 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs' (1937). When the Evil Queen (Gadot) grows jealous of her stepdaughter Snow White (Zegler)'s beauty, she commands that she be killed. Instead, Snow White escapes into the forest and vows to free her kingdom from the Evil Queen's tyranny. Aided by her seven new friends and a rebellious citizen called Jonathan (Andrew Burnap), will Snow White succeed in her quest to save her people?

titles.title: Disobedience
titles.summary: Rachel Weisz and Rachel McAdams star in this romantic drama directed by Sebastián Lelio and based on the novel by Naomi Alderman. Following the death of her estranged father, Ronit Krushka (Weisz) returns from New York to the Orthodox Jewish community in London in which she was raised but chose to abandon. Staying with her childhood friend Dovid (Alessandro Nivola), Ronit rekindles an illicit passionate love affair with his wife, Esti (McAdams), which threatens to spark outrage in their community and causes both women to question their faith and their future.

titles.title: Disorder
titles.summary: Paranoid thriller directed by Alice Winocour. Vincent (Matthias Schoenaerts) is suffering with post-traumatic stress disorder after serving in Afghanistan as a French Special Forces soldier. When he returns home and takes on the role of bodyguard for Jessie (Diane Kruger), the wife of a wealthy but shady businessman living in France, he becomes enchanted by her. Suffering from hallucinations and unable to cast off the role of alert on-duty soldier, he becomes convinced that the woman he is protecting is in danger from a strange outside threat. This paranoia blurs the distinction between reality and illusion and for Victor becomes all-consuming.

titles.title: Disturbing the peace
titles.summary: Guy Pearce stars as a small-town marshal in this American action drama. When a gang of outlaw bikers arrive in the town of Horse Cave and lay siege to the bank it is up to Marshall Dillon to defend the town. However, he hasn't carried a gun since a fatal accident many years previously and if he is going to protect the citizens he will have to overcome his personal trauma.

titles.title: Do the right thing
titles.summary: American comedy drama directed by Spike Lee. On the hottest day of the year in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, pizzeria owner Sal Fragione (Danny Aiello) opens his establishment as he has done for the last 25 years. When one of his customers, Buggin Out (Giancarlo Esposito), makes a complaint that the gallery of photos on the restaurant's wall shows only white Italian-Americans, chaos ensues as the rest of the predominantly African-American neighbourhood band together to incite change.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 15 Mar 2019); Being repaired (Set: 14 Aug 2024)

titles.title: Doctor Strange in the multiverse of madness
titles.sortTitle: doctor strange in the multiverse of madness
titles.summary: Benedict Cumberbatch reprises his role as Doctor Stephen Strange in this action adventure sequel, directed by Sam Raimi. While the Scarlet Witch (Elizabeth Olsen) is searching for a way to be with her children, Doctor Strange and Wong (Benedict Wong) must move between worlds to protect America Chavez (Xochitl Gomez) who possesses the power to travel the multiverse. Rachel McAdams and Chiwetel Ejiofor also star.

titles.title: Doctor Who: Resolution
titles.summary: New Year's special of the relaunched sci-fi adventure drama starring Jodie Whittaker as the legendary Time Lord. When an ancient enemy, scattered across the planet, is inadvertently revived by two archaeologists in Sheffield, the Doctor and her companions, Graham (Bradley Walsh), Ryan (Tosin Cole) and Yasmin (Mandip Gill), abandon their New Year's celebrations and set out to defeat it before it tries to take over the world.

titles.title: Dog man
titles.summary: Animated adventure featuring the voice talents of Peter Hastings and Pete Davidson. Police officer Knight (Hastings) and his trusty dog Greg both get injured while working a case. As they both undergo surgery, their lives are saved by joining them as one, half man and half dog. As Dog Man continues his efforts to serve and protect, he finds himself chasing after Petey (Pete Davidson), Dog Man's feline archenemy. The voice cast also includes Isla Fisher, Ricky Gervais and Billy Boyd.

titles.title: A doggone adventure
titles.summary: Family adventure drama directed by Tony Randel. Professor Masters (John Henry Richardson) tries to protect his talking dog Murphy (voice of Steve Altman) from capture by an evil corporation. However, in order to evade capture the Professor relies on the help of a group of curious and adventurous children.

titles.title: Dogs at the opera
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. Whilst on the run from a group of animal catchers, stray dog Samson (voice of Andrew Winn) meets Margo (Maria Smakhtina) at the theatre. She belongs to Anastasia (Liza Klimova), a renowed ballerina who owns a tiara rumoured to have once belonged to Queen Elizabeth I. When the tiara is stolen, Samson and Margot must join forces to recover it before the fourth act when Anastasia needs it for her performance.

titles.title: Dogtanian and the three muskehounds
titles.summary: Animated adventure based on the classic stories by Alexandre Dumas that follows cartoon hound Dogtanian as he grows up in Paris and aspires to become a Muskehound, loyal to the King of France and fighting for justice.

titles.title: Dolphin boy
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. After Snowball the dolphin (voice of Kay Rommel) saves a young boy (Polina Workman) who falls into the ocean as a baby, they are raised together as brothers. Together they attempt to thwart the schemes of the evil octopus (Stephen Peter Krisel) seeking to take over their underwater home while the boy also searches for his human mother after learning the truth about his origins.

titles.title: Dolphin tale 2
titles.summary: Harry Connick Jr, Morgan Freeman and Ashley Judd star in this family drama sequel based on real events. The film continues the true story of Winter, a dolphin who was rescued by the Clearwater Marine Aquarium and given a prosthetic tale, having lost her own following a crab trap accident. When her elderly dolphin friend Panama dies, Winter becomes depressed and her health rapidly declines. Dr. Clay (Connick Jr) is given one month by a USDA inspector to pair Winter with another female dolphin, to ensure her return to full health. With time running out, the CMA staff save a young female they name Hope. She may just be the perfect new companion for Winter but will the two animals bond?

titles.title: Domino
titles.summary: Brian De Palma directs this thriller set across Europe, starring Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Carice van Houten and Guy Pearce. Danish police officers Christian (Coster-Waldau) and Lars (Soren Malling) are caught off-guard when they are called to what they believe is only a domestic disturbance. Once they arrive they discover a more serious situation unfolding and attempt to arrest Imran (Eriq Ebouaney), who they believe has committed a murder. However, as Christian stakes out the rest of the apartment Lars is killed by Imran, who then manages to escape the scene. As Christian seeks revenge he encounters corrupt CIA agent Joe Martin (Guy Pearce) who may be employing Imran as a double agent thus compromising Christian's desire for vengeance.

titles.title: Don't worry darling
titles.summary: Olivia Wilde directs and stars in this psychological thriller alongside Florence Pugh, Harry Styles and Chris Pine. In 1950s California, Jack and Alice Chambers (Styles and Pugh) share a seemingly idyllic life in the utopian suburban desert town of Victory. However, when devoted housewife Alice grows suspicious of her husband's top-secret work for the Victory Project, founded by community leader Frank (Pine), she uncovers the sinister truth behind her utopian existence. The cast also includes Gemma Chan, KiKi Layne and Nick Kroll.

titles.title: Dope
titles.summary: Coming-of-age comedy drama written and directed by Rick Famuyiwa. Malcolm (Shameik Moore) is a big fish in a small pond; he dreams of going to Harvard and becoming a lawyer but the stunted ideals of his family and school prevent most from going after their dreams. As Malcolm perseveres regardless, he and his friends are invited to an underground party which leads to an adventure of epic proportions involving drugs, gangs and half-naked women.

titles.title: Downton Abbey: A new era
titles.summary: Hugh Bonneville, Maggie Smith and Michelle Dockery reprise their roles in this second feature-length sequel to the period drama series. As they prepare to welcome the 1930s, the Crawley family embark on a new adventure. When she receives a visit from an old friend, the Dowager Countess (Smith) learns that she has inherited a villa in the South of France. Intrigued by her mysterious past, the family set off on a sun-filled holiday to explore the newly acquired grand establishment. The cast also includes Jim Carter, Elizabeth McGovern and Laura Carmichael.

titles.title: Downton Abbey: The grand finale
titles.summary: Simon Curtis directs this British period drama sequel starring Michelle Dockery, Hugh Bonneville and Elizabeth McGovern. In 1930, a now-divorced Lady Mary (Dockery) finds herself facing social disgrace. Meanwhile, her father Robert Crawley (Bonneville) attempts to resolve the family's financial problems. With the challenges they face only increasing, the family must come together and embrace the changing times if they are to safeguard their future. The cast also includes Laura Carmichael, Dominic West and Paul Giamatti.

titles.title: Downton Abbey: The movie
titles.summary: Hugh Bonneville, Maggie Smith and Michelle Dockery reprise their roles in this feature-length sequel to the drama series. As news arrives of an impending visit from King George V and Queen Mary (Simon Jones and Geraldine James), the Crawley family and the staff of Downton Abbey must ensure that everyone is on their best behaviour. Can they keep up appearances long enough to provide the King and Queen with a pleasant stay? The cast also includes Elizabeth McGovern, Joanne Froggatt and Tuppence Middleton.

titles.title: Dracula
titles.summary: Caleb Landry Jones stars as the eponymous vampire in this gothic horror written and directed by Luc Besson. After losing his beloved wife during a fierce battle, Prince Vladimir rejects God and is forced to live forever as Dracula. As the centuries pass, he never gives up hope that his wife will one day be reincarnated. When he meets Mina Murray (Zoë Bleu), he knows that she is the one and he is overjoyed to finally be reunited with her. However, her fiancé Jonathan Harker (Ewens Abid) will not let her go without a fight and he enlists the help of a determined priest (Christoph Waltz) to save Mina. The cast also includes Matilda De Angelis, David Shields and Guillaume de Tonquédec.

titles.title: Dragged across concrete
titles.summary: Mel Gibson and Vince Vaughn star in this crime drama written and directed by S. Craig Zahler. After being suspended for using excessive force on a suspect, an act that is caught on camera and becomes a media sensation, old-school veteran cop Brett Ridgeman (Gibson) and his younger partner Anthony Lurasetti (Vaughn) decide to use their criminal connections to get compensation for their lost earnings. Following a tip from a former associate, the disgraced cops plot to intercept a score being carried out by Lorentz Vogelman (Thomas Kretschmann) and his hired crew, with deadly consequences.

titles.title: Dragon rider
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure based on the bestselling book by Cornelia Funke. Fearing his fellow dragons' home is about to be destroyed by humans, young silver dragon Firedrake (voice of Thomas Brodie-Sangster) sets out on a quest to prove his worth by searching for a fabled haven known as the Rim of Heaven. Joined by best friend Sorrel (Felicity Jones), Firedrake adopts orphan Ben (Freddie Highmore) as his dragon rider. Hunting the trio down is monster Nettlebrand (Patrick Stewart), who has been created with the sole purpose of wiping out the dragons.

titles.title: Dragonheart - Battle for the heartfire
titles.summary: Fantasy adventure sequel directed by Patrik Syversen. Following the death of the king, two of his grandsons use the power of the legendary dragon Drago (voice of Patrick Stewart) against each other as they each try to prove they are the rightful heir to the throne. However, when the Heartfire - the source of Drago's power - is stolen, the young hopefuls must put their differences aside and join forces in an attempt to retrieve the Heartfire before it's too late. The cast also includes Tom Rhys Harries, Jessamine-Bliss Bell and Tamzin Merchant.

titles.title: The drama
titles.summary: Robert Pattinson and Zendaya star in this dark comedy from director Kristoffer Borgli. A week away from getting married, young couple Charlie and Emma (Pattinson and Zendaya) appear to have everything in order. When they meet up with friends Rachel and Mike (Alana Haim and Mamoudou Athie), Rachel suggests that they share the worst thing they have ever done before they get married. With the others revealing fairly trivial things, the group is shocked to learn Emma's confession and it leaves Charlie wondering whether she is the right person for him.

titles.title: Dream scenario
titles.summary: Nicolas Cage stars in this comedy horror which follows the life of an ordinary man whose world is turned upside down when he begins to appear in the dreams of strangers. Unassuming college professor Paul Matthews (Cage) becomes the centre of public attention when millions of people meet him in their dreams. The public attention turns to scrutiny, however, when some people begin to experience frighteningly violent dreams with Paul at the centre of their nightmares. Can Paul find out what caused this strange phenomenon and find a way to return to his former life?

titles.title: The dressmaker
titles.summary: Jocelyn Moorhouse directs this Australian revenge comedy starring Kate Winslet as Myrtle Dunnage, a woman who returns to her hometown to take care of her ailing mother Molly (Judy Davis). Myrtle's return sparks much debate between the residents of the town as she was accused of murdering someone many years ago. Now an expert dressmaker, Myrtle goes about transforming the local fashion while exacting her revenge upon those who have wronged her in the past... The supporting cast includes Liam Hemsworth and Hugo Weaving.

titles.title: Drive my car
titles.summary: Ryûsuke Hamaguchi directs this Japanese drama based on the short story by Haruki Murakami. Following the untimely death of his wife, Tokyo theatre actor and Yûsuke Kafuku (Hidetoshi Nishijima) employs chauffeur Misaki Watari (Tôko Miura) to drive him to a festival in Hiroshima where he is scheduled to helm a new production of Chekhov's 'Uncle Vanya'. On their journey Yûsuke shares tales of his personal suffering and the pair form an unlikely bond.

titles.title: Drop
titles.summary: Christopher Landon directs this thriller starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar. Widowed mother of two Violet (Fahy) finds herself having to start over after the death of her husband. Going on her first date in years, her company for the evening is the charming and polite Henry (Sklenar). Her evening is going well until she begins receiving threatening messages dropped to her phone. With her children's lives in danger, Violet must meet the demands of her mysterious contact or face the consequences.

titles.title: The drummer & the keeper
titles.summary: Irish drama written and directed by Nick Kelly. The film follows the unlikely friendship between Gabriel (Dermot Murphy), the bipolar drummer of a rock band, and Christopher (Jacob McCarthy), an institutionalised 17-year-old with Asperger's syndrome. After his bandmates become tired of his behaviour, Gabriel decides to seek treatment and, after it is suggested he takes up some exercise and play football, he meets Christopher, the team's goalkeeper. As the pair bond over their shared experiences of mental illness, Gabriel realises his new medication is curbing his musical talent but will he stay the course and beat his illness?

titles.title: Dublin murders
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the crime drama based on the novels by Tana French. When a young girl is found murdered in a forest in Ireland, detectives Rob Reilly (Killian Scott) and Cassie Maddox (Sarah Greene) are sent to investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the crime. However, the murder location is the same place where years before, two children also died and one survived, never able to retell the events of what took place. Could the two cases be linked and might it be too close to home for the detectives?

titles.title: Due date
titles.summary: Todd Phillips directs this road trip comedy starring Robert Downey Jr. and Zach Galifianakis. Businessman Peter Highman (Downey Jr.) is an anxiously expectant first-time father whose wife's due date is only five days away. As Peter rushes to catch a flight home to Los Angeles from Atlanta to be present at the birth, complications arise and he is forced to hitch a ride home with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay (Galifianakis). The two unlikely companions embark on a frenzied cross-country road trip that will change both of their lives forever. Jamie Foxx and Michelle Monaghan co-star.

titles.title: The duke
titles.summary: Jim Broadbent and Helen Mirren star in this British drama based on the theft of Goya's portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in 1961. 60-year-old working-class Geordie Kempton Bunton (Broadbent) pulls off the audacious heist and demands £140,000 be paid to a charity supporting the elderly.
