When his attempt to hide the painting from his unsuspecting wife Dorothy (Mirren) fails, Kempton decides to return the painting and finds himself forced to protest his innocence in court. The cast also includes Fionn Whitehead, Matthew Goode and Anna Maxwell Martin.

titles.title: Dumbo
titles.summary: Tim Burton directs this Disney fantasy adventure starring Colin Farrell, Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Eva Green. In 1919, the struggling Medici Bros. Circus, run by ringmaster Max Medici (DeVito), is taken over by V.A. Vandevere (Keaton), an entrepreneur who seeks to exploit the show's star attraction, Dumbo the flying elephant. In his new entertainment venture, Dreamland, Vandevere pairs Dumbo with trapeze artist Colette Marchant (Green), with spectacular success. However, war veteran Holt Farrier (Farrell), who cares for Dumbo with the help of his two children, uncovers dark secrets behind Vandevere's new amusement park, which threaten to bring down the show.

titles.title: Dune
titles.summary: Denis Villeneuve co-writes and directs this adaptation of Frank Herbert's epic sci-fi novel. Set in the distant future on the barren desert planet Arrakis, aka Dune, where a precious life-enhancing spice is guarded by monster sandworms, young nobleman Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) leads his family and the native Fremen people against the territorial designs of his family's arch-enemies, the Harkonnens. However, once on Dune, Paul discovers he is earmarked for an even greater destiny. The all-star cast also includes Rebecca Ferguson, Oscar Isaac, Josh Brolin and Zendaya.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 05 Feb 2025); On loan - Due: 04 Nov 2026

titles.title: Dune: Part two
titles.summary: Denis Villeneuve returns to direct this second instalment of the adaptation of Frank Herbert's epic sci-fi novel. Following on from the events of 'Dune' (2020), Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) swears vengeance on those who betrayed his family and caused the downfall of the House of Atreides. Meanwhile, Paul must prove himself to gain the allegiance of the Fremen but his relationship with Chani (Zendaya) causes unrest and he is forced to confront the prophecies which, if they come to fruition, spell doom for Arrakis. As news travels of Paul's upsurgence, his enemies both old and new prepare for the ultimate battle. The cast also includes Christopher Walken, Florence Pugh and Austin Butler.

titles.title: Dungeons & dragons: Honour among thieves
titles.summary: Chris Pine, Michelle Rodriguez and Regé-Jean Page star in this fantasy action adventure based on the classic role-playing game. Following the death of his wife, thief and former member of the Harpers Edgin Davis (Pine) raises his daughter Kira (Chloe Coleman) with the help of his barbarian friend Holga (Rodriguez). When Kira is kidnapped by rogue Lord of Neverwinter Forge Fitzwilliam (Hugh Grant), Edgin and Holga join forces with paladin Xenk (Page), sorcerer Simon (Justice Smith) and druid Doric (Sophia Lillis) as they set off on a dangerous quest to retrieve the Tablet of Reawakening and defeat the evil forces of Forge and Red Wizard of Thay Sofina (Daisy Head).

titles.title: Dunkirk
titles.summary: Christopher Nolan writes and directs this war drama which tells the story of the Dunkirk evacuation during WWII. In May 1940, hundreds of thousands of Allied soldiers are trapped on the beaches of Dunkirk after being pushed back by the German army during the Battle of France, prompting a massive rescue operation to evacuate them. As the evacuation, code-named Operation Dynamo, gets underway, the soldiers of the British Expeditionary Force hold a shrinking position as the Nazis advance upon them. Meanwhile, civilian sailors are called upon to use whatever vessels they have to aid the rescue effort across the Channel as the Royal Air Force tries to defend the vulnerable troops on the ground from the skies. The ensemble cast includes Fionn Whitehead, Tom Hardy, Cillian Murphy, Mark Rylance, Kenneth Branagh and Aneurin Barnard.

titles.title: East of Eden
titles.summary: Elia Kazan's classic adaptation of Steinbeck's novel, set in a small farming valley in California in 1917. Two brothers rival for the love of their stern, overbearing, widowed father (Raymond Massey). However, when Cal (James Dean), the rejected rebel son, discovers that his mother (Jo Van Fleet) is not dead but running a nearby brothel, he decides to tell his brother (Richard Davalos). This spiteful decision soon leads to the destruction of his relationship with his brother, who in a drunken frenzy runs off to enlist in an army unit being shipped overseas to the battlefields of France. Unable to bear the loss of his favourite son, Cal's pacifist father breaks down completely. The film was nominated for four Oscars with Van Fleet winning for Best Actress in a Supporting Role. Kazan also won a Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture - Drama and Dean was posthumously given a Golden Globe Special Achievement Award for Best Dramatic Actor.

titles.title: Eastern boys
titles.summary: Robin Campillo writes and directs this gay-themed drama starring Olivier Rabourdin. Having caught the eye of a male prostitute at the Gare du Nord train station in Paris, Muller (Rabourdin) approaches the young man to organise an illicit rendezvous. The youngster introduces himself as Marek (Kirill Emelyanov) and agrees to visit Muller at his home the next day. However, when Marek arrives, accompanied by a gang of other men, and proceeds to empty Muller's house of his possessions, he soon realises that he's been tricked...

titles.title: Eddington
titles.summary: Pedro Pascal and Joaquin Phoenix star in this contemporary Western written and directed by Ari Aster. In May 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic, the town of Eddington, New Mexico is struggling. When Mayor Ted Garcia (Pascal) enforces a lockdown and the wearing of masks, Sheriff Joe Cross (Phoenix) fights back against the restrictions. Cross then decides to run against Garcia, who is campaigning for re-election, and as their conflict escalates the town descends into chaos. The cast also includes Austin Butler, Emma Stone and Luke Grimes.

titles.title: The edge of seventeen
titles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld and Haley Lu Richardson star as high school best friends in this teenage American drama. Nadine Byrd (Steinfeld) is struggling through her teenage years and, though intelligent, finds it hard to fit in with her peers. Her junior year at high school gets off to a bad start after catching her best friend, Krista (Richardson) in bed with her older brother Darian (Blake Jenner). After forcing Krista to choose between her friendship and her brother, Nadine finds herself more alone than ever and turns to lunchtime visits with her teacher Mr. Bruner (Woody Harrelson) for comfort and guidance. With her mum (Kyra Sedgwick) perennially absent and her crush seemingly unaware she exists, Nadine begins to wonder if there's any way she can make it through her teenage years when she finds herself opening up to her equally awkward classmate Erwin (Hayden Szeto). The film was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Performance By an Actress in a Motion Picture - Comedy Or Musical (Steinfeld).

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 13 Apr 2017); In-transit from Hangleton Library to Hove Library (Set: 10 May 2021)

titles.title: Eileen
titles.summary: William Oldroyd directs this mystery thriller starring Anne Hathaway and Thomasin McKenzie. Set in a juvenile detention centre for boys in 1960s Boston, every day in secretary Eileen Dunlop (McKenzie)'s life is exactly the same. Until, that is, the facility employs new psychologist Rebecca (Hathaway) whose methods are somewhat unconventional. As Eileen and Rebecca form an unlikely bond, their attempts to treat a troubled boy have disastrous consequences. The cast also includes Shea Whigham, Sam Nivola and Owen Teague.

titles.title: The electrical life of Louis Wain
titles.summary: Benedict Cumberbatch stars as the eponymous artist in this biographical drama. In Victorian London, eccentric artist Louis Wain works as an illustrator to provide for his five sisters and gains a modest amount of notoriety for his portraits of animals. He eventually leaves his family home and discovers the subject that would define his career after he marries his sisters' governess, Emily Richardson (Claire Foy). However, following the tragic and untimely death of his wife after a battle with illness Louis' mental health begins to rapidly deteriorate.

titles.title: Elemental
titles.summary: Animated comedy drama from Disney/Pixar featuring the voice talents of Mamoudou Athie and Leah Lewis. After moving to Element City, fire elements Bernie and Cinder Lumen (voices of Ronnie del Carmen and Shila Ommi) have a daughter, Ember (Lewis) and run a shop called the Fireplace, which Bernie hopes to pass to Ember when he retires. She struggles to control her temper and, one day, accidentally breaks a water pipe and floods the Fireplace's basement, which brings Wade Ripple (Athie), a water element and city inspector, into her life. As Wade falls in love with Ember, can he prove to her that fire and water can mix after all and, in so doing, win her heart?

titles.title: Elena
titles.summary: Andrei Zvyagintsev directs and co-writes this Russian suspense drama. Elena (Nadezhda Markina) is a former nurse now married to a rich husband, Vladimir (Andrey Smirnov). The middle-aged couple's marriage comes under strain when Elena asks her husband to give financial support to Sergey (Aleksey Rozin), her unemployed son from a previous marriage, and his family. Vladimir refuses to help Sergey and goes further, changing his will to make his long-estranged daughter, Katya (Elena Lyadova), his sole heiress. Furious with her husband and with nowhere to turn, Elena decides to take matters into her own hands.

titles.title: Elena and the secret of Avalor
titles.sortTitle: elena and the secret of avalor
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the animated series which follows young Princess Elena (voice of Aimee Carrero) as she attempts to reclaim her throne from the evil Queen Shuriki (Jane Fonda). With the help of Princess Sofia (Ariel Winter), spirit animal Zuzo (Keith Ferguson) and trainee wizard Mateo (Joseph Haro), Elena is freed from the Amulet of Avalor and soon sets her sights on taking her rightful place as ruler of the kingdom. The episodes are: 'Elena and the Secret of Avalor', 'Spellbound', 'Finders Leapers', 'Prince Too Charming' and 'Royal Retreat'.

titles.title: Elena of Avalor: Ready to rule
titles.sortTitle: elena of avalor: ready to rule
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the animated series which follows young Princess Elena (voice of Aimee Carrero) as she rules over the enchanted kingdom of Avalor. After saving her land from an evil sorceress, Elena enlists the help of her sister Isabel (Jenna Ortega), friend Naomi (Jillian Rose Reed), wizard Mateo (Joseph Haro) and royal guard Gabe (Jorge Diaz) as she attempts to keep her people safe and prove she is ready to be queen. The episodes are: 'First Day of Rule', 'Model Sister', 'All Heated Up' and 'Island of Youth'.

titles.title: Elevation
titles.summary: Anthony Mackie and Morena Baccarin star in this sci-fi action thriller directed by George Nolfi. Three years ago, Reapers destroyed almost all of humanity and now the few remaining survivors live at least 8,000 feet above sea level where the Reapers do not go. When Will (Mackie) is forced to venture below the safety line in search of the medical equipment he needs to save his son's life, he is joined by Nina (Baccarin), a scientist hoping to find a way to kill the Reapers. Can they survive the perilous journey and give humanity a chance of salvation?

titles.title: Elio
titles.summary: Animated sci-fi adventure from Disney/Pixar featuring the voice talents of Yonas Kibreab and Zoe Saldana. After the death of his parents, Elio Solís (voice of Kibreab) went to live with his aunt Olga (Saldana). Now eleven years old, he is obsessed with space and wishes aliens would abduct him and take him away from his lonely life. When his wish suddenly comes true, he finds himself in the Communiverse and begins making new friends whilst attempting to resolve an intergalactic crisis. Will his unexpected adventure help him to discover where he truly belongs? The voice cast also includes Jameela Jamil, Remy Edgerly and Brad Garrett.

titles.title: Elvis
titles.summary: Austin Butler stars as Elvis Presley in this biographical musical drama directed by Baz Luhrmann. The film follows Elvis (Chaydon Jay/Butler) from childhood, where he encountered gospel and blues music for the first time, on his journey to becoming a rock and roll superstar. In 1955, Elvis is signed by RCA Records and hires Colonel Tom Parker (Tom Hanks) as his manager before achieving unprecedented success following the release of his debut album. Following a stint in the military to improve his controversial image, Elvis stars in a string of Hollywood movies before making a triumphant return to live performing. The cast also includes Olivia DeJonge, Helen Thomson and Luke Bracey.

titles.title: Ema
titles.summary: Chilean drama directed by Pablo Larraín. Unable to conceive a child of their own, dancer Ema (Mariana Di Girolamo) and her choreographer husband Gastón (Gael García Bernal) adopt a young Colombian boy but become troubled by his propensity for arson, and decide to give him up after he sets fire to their home, resulting in Ema's sister being hospitalised and permanently disfigured. Despite the couple's disastrous experience of adoption, Ema struggles to overcome the loss and her failure as a mother.

titles.title: Emil and the detectives
titles.summary: Classic German adventure drama adapted from the novel by Erich Kästner, who co-wrote the script with Billy Wilder. The film follows young Emil (Rolf Wenkhaus) as he travels to Berlin by train to visit his grandmother. When his money is stolen by a fellow passenger, who turns out to be a member of a gang of criminals, he asks a group of youthful detectives for help.

titles.title: Emily
titles.summary: Emma Mackey stars as English writer Emily Brontë in this biographical drama written and directed by Frances O'Connor. The film tells the story of how the shy and reclusive Emily came to write her classic novel 'Wuthering Heights', from her first attempts at writing with her sisters Charlotte (Alexandra Dowling) and Anne (Amelia Gething) during their childhood in the Yorkshire Moors, to her passionate affair with her father's curate, William Weightman (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). The cast also includes Fionn Whitehead, Gemma Jones and Adrian Dunbar.

titles.title: Emily the criminal
titles.summary: Aubrey Plaza stars as the titular character in this crime thriller written and directed by John Patton Ford. Due to her criminal record, Emily struggles to find a decent job and is heavily in debt. She becomes involved in a credit card fraud ring where she meets Youcef (Theo Rossi) but as they become closer and dream of the future, the danger they're in now only increases. Megalyn Echikunwoke also stars.

titles.title: Emma
titles.summary: Anya Taylor-Joy stars as the eponymous matchmaker in this adaptation of the Jane Austen novel directed by Autumn de Wilde. Emma Woodhouse has a tendency to meddle in the lives of those closest to her but when she involves herself in her friend Harriet Smith (Mia Goth)'s love life, she risks costing her a chance at true happiness. Meanwhile, she finds herself growing closer to George Knightly (Johnny Flynn), who frequently disapproves of her actions. The cast also includes Bill Nighy, Miranda Hart and Josh O'Connor.

titles.title: The emperor's new groove
titles.summary: Animated comedy featuring the voice of David Spade as Inca Emperor Kuzco, a rich, vain man who takes delight in other people's misfortunes. His former-advisor Yzma (Eartha Kitt) would like to get rid of him and hatches a plan to poison him. But when this is botched by Yzma's assistant and instead the potion turns Kuczo into a lowly (but talking) llama, Kuzco finds that he has to learn what life is like for the people at the bottom. Kuzco enlists the help of a poor farmer (voiced by John Goodman) to get him back to the palace and find a sorcerer that can reverse the spell whilst dodging Yzma and her assistant who are still trying to finish off their evil plan. The film features songs by Sting, one of which was nominated for an Oscar.

titles.title: Empire of light
titles.summary: Olivia Colman and Micheal Ward star in this romantic drama written and directed by Sam Mendes. In the early 1980s, Hilary (Colman), a duty manager at the Empire Cinema on the south coast of England, is struggling with her mental health and is having an affair with her married boss Donald (Colin Firth). When Stephen (Ward) starts working at the cinema, he and Hilary fall for each other, but as Hilary's mental health fluctuates, the constant racism Stephen suffers culminates in a violent assault. Toby Jones also stars.

titles.title: Encanto
titles.summary: Animated adventure starring the voice talents of Stephanie Beatriz, John Leguizamo and Diane Guerrero. The film follows young teenager Mirabel Madrigal (Beatriz) and the Madrigal family who each possess magical abilities with the exception of Mirabel. As she is constantly reminded of her lack of special talent Mirabel goes in search of what her own gift may be. However, when she notices cracks appearing on the family home she warns the others and they must band together to figure out what is going wrong.

titles.title: Enchantimals: Finding home
titles.summary: Feature-length children's animated adventure based on the Mattel toys. In the magical land of Everwilde, a group of half-girl half-animals live with their animal best friends. When Enchantimal Patter Peacock (voice of Sabrina Pitre) becomes lost, Felicity Fox (Kazumi Evans) and the gang offer her a place to stay. But when her animal best friend goes missing, the friends set off on a mission to find him.

titles.title: The end
titles.summary: Post-apocalyptic musical drama from director Joshua Oppenheimer. A wealthy family, headed by Mother and Father (Tilda Swinton and Michael Shannon), have lived for two decades in a salt mine following an environmental disaster which left the lands above uninhabitable. Along with their Son (George MacKay), they live with Mother's Friend (Bronagh Gallagher), their Butler (Tim McInnerny) and Doctor (Lennie James), all believing that life above no longer exists. When a Girl (Moses Ingram) finds her way into the mine, with the story that her family were all killed trying to cross a river, the family reluctantly allow her to stay, remaining dubious of her motives. When the Son begins to develop feelings for the Girl however, Mother and Father face big decisions.

titles.title: The end we start from
titles.summary: Mahalia Belo directs this British survival drama based on the novel by Megan Hunter. Jodie Comer plays the role of a young woman who is pregnant with her first child. Along with her husband (Joel Fry) she travels to hospital after her waters break, but a torrential storm looms over their journey into parenthood. As the world prepares for impending disaster from catastrophic floods, the new parents must navigate their new lives while saying goodbye to their home. The cast also includes Benedict Cumberbatch, Mark Strong and Gina McKee.

titles.title: Entebbe
titles.summary: Thriller based on true events starring Rosamund Pike and Daniel Brühl as Brigitte Kuhlmann and Wilfried Böse, two terrorists who helped to hijack a flight from Tel Aviv to Paris with the passengers being held hostage. On the 27th of June 1976, Kuhlmann and Böse, members of German Revolutionary Cells, alongside two others are under instruction to hijack a plane to force the government to release militants being held in prison in Israel. With the objective of trading the 248 hostage passengers for these prisoners as well as Palestinians and prisoners held in other countries, a 7-day stand-off ensues as they attempt to bargain with the Israeli government and threaten that if their demands are not met, their hostages will be killed. With time running out and innocent lives at risk, an operation must get underway to free the hostages and capture the hijackers.

titles.title: EPiC: Elvis Presley in concert
titles.summary: Baz Luhrmann directs this documentary celebrating Elvis Presley in which previously unseen rehearsal and performance footage from his Las Vegas residency has been restored and combined with interview footage of Presley discussing his life and career.

titles.title: Episodes: Series 4
titles.summary: All nine episodes from the fourth series of the BBC comedy starring Matt LeBlanc, Stephen Mangan and Tamsin Greig. Sean and Beverly Lincoln (Mangan and Greig) are co-writers of American sitcom 'Pucks!' with the lead role played by Matt LeBlanc (as himself). In this series, Sean and Beverly are summoned back to LA to film six more episodes of 'Pucks!' as they also try to launch new show 'The Opposite of Us'. Meanwhile, Matt experiences financial troubles after being conned by his accountant and, as a result, considers remarrying his ex-wife.

titles.title: Equals
titles.summary: Nicholas Hoult and Kristen Stewart star in this romantic drama from co-writer and director Drake Doremus. In a futuristic dystopian society where all human emotion has been eradicated by drugs, co-workers Silas (Hoult) and Nia (Stewart) begin a secret relationship after picking up a mysterious virus which causes their feelings to return. However, when a cure for the disease is found, Silas and Nia must find a way to escape the totalitarian state in order to preserve their relationship. The cast also includes Guy Pearce and Jacki Weaver.

titles.title: Eternal beauty
titles.summary: Craig Roberts writes and directs this comedy drama starring Sally Hawkins as Jane, a woman with schizophrenia as she attempts to forge her own path away from the over-protectiveness of her family and doctor. When Jane meets Mike (David Thewlis), her life is turned upside down when she begins to explore her feelings of love and affection. The cast also includes Morfydd Clark, Billie Piper and Alice Lowe.

titles.title: Everybody knows
titles.summary: Asghar Farhadi directs this Spanish drama starring Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem, which follows the story of a mother's worst fears coming to life when she discovers her daughter has been abducted. Desperate to find her, Laura (Cruz) recruits the help of her family and the small community of her home town, but soon dark truths and hidden secrets begin to unravel forcing her to question her trust in those she holds dearest.

titles.title: The exception
titles.summary: Romance drama directed by David Leveaux and starring Jai Courtney, Christopher Plummer and Lily James. Following his abdication after Germany's defeat in the First World War, former German emperor Wilhelm II (Plummer) lives in exile at a remote estate in the Netherlands. In 1940, as Nazi Germany goes on the offensive in the Second World War, Captain Brandt (Courtney) is assigned to assess the security situation at Wilhelm's residence. There he meets and is immediately drawn into a relationship with Mieke (James) while suspicions grow that there is a spy in their midst.

titles.title: Exhibition
titles.summary: British drama directed by Joanna Hogg. D and H (Viv Albertine and Liam Gillick) are two wealthy artists living in their well-maintained modernist house in London. Willingly isolated from their friends and without a family of their own, the pair keep mainly to themselves even at home. As they seek to sell the house which has been their home for the past 18 years, the thought of moving elsewhere produces great resentment and tension between them which in turn causes the intimacy and communication in their relationship to become almost non-existent.

titles.title: Exodus - Gods and kings
titles.summary: Biblical drama directed by Ridley Scott starring Christian Bale and Joel Edgerton. Moses and Rhamses (Bale and Edgerton) have lived their lives as close as brothers until a revelation from their protector Nun (Ben Kingsley) sees a rivalry emerge like nothing before. When Moses learns of a prophecy that names him as the liberating leader of Egypt, the only thing that stands in the way of his destiny is his ambitious adopted sibling Rhamses who is prepared to go to any lengths to secure his own future. The cast also includes Sigourney Weaver, Indira Varma and Aaron Paul.

titles.title: The exorcism
titles.summary: Joshua John Miller co-writes and directs this American thriller starring Russell Crowe. Struggling, alcoholic actor Anthony Miller (Crowe) is set to play a priest in a film named The Georgetown Project, which portrays the demonic possession of a young girl. As Anthony takes on the role, however, he becomes tormented by the horrors of his past and begins to display increasingly dangerous behaviour which can only be stopped with the help of a real-life exorcism... The cast also includes Ryan Simpkins, David Hyde Pierce and Sam Worthington.

titles.title: Eye for an eye
titles.summary: John Travolta, Morgan Freeman, Brendan Fraser and Famke Janssen star in this crime thriller based on the novel by Richard Salvatore. Private investigator Carson Phillips (Travolta) is employed on a missing persons case. As he digs deeper however, he discovers that his estranged daughter Rebecca (Ella Bleu Travolta) is the main suspect in what is now a murder enquiry and he must do all he can to clear her name and solve the case.

titles.title: Eyewitness
titles.summary: All six episodes of the Norwegian drama series directed and co-written by Jarl Emsell Larsen. When two 15-year-old boys, Philip and Henning (Axel Bøyum and Odin Waage), who are experimenting with their sexuality meet discreetly in a cabin in the woods, they did not envisage becoming witnesses to multiple brutal murders. As the boys agree to stay quiet about what they saw for fear of having to explain their presence in the woods, the local sheriff, and Philip's foster mother, begins to investigate the mysterious murders.

titles.title: F1 the movie
titles.summary: Brad Pitt stars in this action drama directed by Joseph Kosinski. After Sonny Hayes (Pitt) was forced to retire from Formula One in the 1990s following a serious crash, he began racing in other disciplines while also gambling and working as a taxi driver. His friend and former teammate Ruben Cervantes (Javier Bardem) now owns and runs the struggling Apex Grand Prix team and recruits Sonny to race for him and to mentor his other driver, young prodigy Joshua Pearce (Damson Idris). The two drivers soon clash but they both have something to prove and as Sonny fights for redemption, can he reward Ruben for his faith in him? The cast also includes Kerry Condon, Tobias Menzies and Kim Bodnia.

titles.title: The Fabelmans
titles.summary: Michelle Williams and Paul Dano star in this coming-of-age drama directed by Steven Spielberg. In 1950s Arizona, young Sammy Fabelman (Mateo Zoryan/Gabriel LaBelle) dreams of becoming a film-maker. While his father Burt (Dano) sees his passion for film-making as merely a hobby, Sammy's mother Mitzi (Williams) encourages him to pursue his dream. While Sammy embarks on his first film-making projects, a surprising discovery threatens to tear his family apart and destroy his fledgling passion for cinema. The cast also includes Seth Rogen, Julia Butters and Judd Hirsch.

titles.title: Fackham Hall
titles.summary: Thomasin McKenzie, Ben Radcliffe and Damian Lewis star in this historical parody directed by Jim O'Hanlan. Fackham Hall has been in the Davenport family for generations but Lord Davenport (Lewis) has no male heir. To keep the estate in the family, his daughter Poppy (Emma Laird) is due to marry her cousin Archibald (Tom Felton). When she flees the church during the wedding, Lady Davenport (Katherine Waterston) hopes that their daughter Rose (McKenzie) will marry Archibald instead but she has fallen for Eric (Radcliffe), the new hall boy. When Lord Davenport is killed in the aftermath of the failed wedding, Inspector Watt (Tom Goodman-Hill) arrives to investigate and long-held family secrets are revealed which will determine the future of Fackham Hall. The cast also includes Anna Maxwell Martin, Jimmy Carr and Sue Johnston.

titles.title: Fall
titles.summary: Action thriller co-written and directed by Scott Mann. Becky (Grace Fulton) hasn't climbed since her last trip ended in tragedy but her best friend Hunter (Virginia Gardner) urges her to try again. They climb 2000 feet to the top of an abandoned radio tower but an accident leaves them stranded precariously. Together they must battle the elements and their lack of supplies as they attempt to find a way back down. The cast also includes Jeffrey Dean Morgan and Mason Gooding.

titles.title: The fall guy
titles.summary: Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt star in this action comedy from director David Leitch. When former choreographer-turned-stuntman Colt Seavers (Gosling) gets a job on his ex-girlfriend Jody Moreno (Blunt)'s directorial debut, he must exceed the expectations of his job description when the lead actor goes missing. Volunteering to find the star of the film, Colt does his best to impress Jody to save her film and ultimately get her to fall in love with him again. The cast also includes Hannah Waddingham, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Stephanie Hsu.

titles.title: The fall guy
titles.summary: Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt star in this action comedy from director David Leitch. When former choreographer-turned-stuntman Colt Seavers (Gosling) gets a job on his ex-girlfriend Jody Moreno (Blunt)'s directorial debut, he must exceed the expectations of his job description when the lead actor goes missing. Volunteering to find the star of the film, Colt does his best to impress Jody to save her film and ultimately get her to fall in love with him again. The cast also includes Hannah Waddingham, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Stephanie Hsu.

titles.title: Fallen leaves
titles.summary: Aki Kaurismäki writes and directs this Finnish drama starring Alma Pöysti and Jussi Vatanen. After meeting the quiet and unassuming Ansa (Pöysti) in a karaoke bar, Holappa (Vatanen) falls for her and wants to find her again, but has lost her phone number. When the two eventually reconnect they slowly pursue a romance with each other, but will Holappa's alcoholism get in the way?

titles.title: Falling
titles.summary: Viggo Mortensen writes, directs and stars in this drama. As dementia causes his health to rapidly decline, Willis Peterson (Lance Henriksen/Sverrir Gudnason) leaves his rural Midwestern farm to move in with his son John (Mortensen/William Healy/Etienne Kellici/Grady McKenzie) and his partner Eric (Terry Chen) in California. Their reunion causes old tensions to resurface between John and his racist and homophobic father who is reluctant to accept his family's help.

titles.title: The family Fang
titles.summary: Nicole Kidman and Jason Bateman star in this dark comedy drama based on the novel by Kevin Wilson. Annie and Baxter Fang (Kidman and Bateman) had an extremely unusual childhood, with their parents using them as props in their performance art pieces. As Annie grows up to be a successful actress and Baxter an acclaimed author, they return to their family home after Baxter is shot and in need of recuperation. When they receive a call from the police saying that their parents are missing and believed dead, the siblings disagree over whether the news is real or simply their most elaborate performance. The cast also includes Christopher Walken, Maryann Plunkett and Kathryn Hahn.

titles.title: Family plot
titles.summary: Alfred Hitchcock's 54th and final film. Fake medium Blanche (Barbara Harris) and her boyfriend Lumley (Bruce Dern) are attempting to scam the elderly Miss Rainbird (Cathleen Nesbitt) by discovering the long-lost heir to her family fortune. Meanwhile, sinister jeweller Arthur Adamson (William Devane) plots a kidnapping scheme with his girlfriend, Fran (Karen Black). Although no link is immediately discernible between the activities of the two couples, their paths eventually cross in the most unexpected of ways.

titles.title: Fantasia
titles.summary: Ambitious animated epic from Disney studios, which includes sequences set to music by - amongst others - Bach, Tchaikovsky, Stravinsky, Mussorgsky, Schubert and Beethoven. Also featured is the famous 'Sorcerer's Apprentice' routine, in which Mickey Mouse (voiced by Walt himself for the last time) creates magical mayhem when he tries to get his chores done with the aid of a spell or two.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 13 Apr 2017); Reservation Allocation Expired (BHCC) (Set: 27 Aug 2026)

titles.title: Fantastic beasts and where to find them
titles.sortTitle: fantastic beasts and where to find them
titles.summary: David Yates directs this fantasy adventure adapted by J.K. Rowling from her own novel. Set in New York in 1926, the film stars Eddie Redmayne as eccentric wizard Newt Scamander, author and Ministry of Magic employee, who is headed to the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a special briefcase that is home to a variety of dangerous beasts. After the creatures escape Newt finds himself wanted by the US authorities. Meanwhile, the incident has a negative impact on relations between magical and non-magical people in New York. Is there any way to repair the damage caused? The cast also includes Katherine Waterston, Colin Farrell, Jon Voight and Ron Perlman.

titles.title: Fantastic beasts: The crimes of Grindelwald
titles.sortTitle: fantastic beasts: the crimes of grindelwald
titles.summary: Eddie Redmayne reprises his role as magizoologist Newt Scamander in this fantasy adventure sequel to 'Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them' (2016), directed by David Yates. When dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald (Johnny Depp) evades capture from MACUSA, Newt is called upon by his former teacher Albus Dumbledore (Jude Law) to bring Grindelwald to justice once again. Their quest takes the pair to 1920s Paris, where Grindelwald is searching for Obscurial Credence Barebone (Ezra Miller) to help him accomplish his mission of subjugating the entire No-Maj population and leading a new wizarding order. The cast also includes Katherine Waterston, Dan Fogler, Alison Sudol, Zoë Kravitz and Callum Turner.

titles.title: Fantastic beasts: The secrets of Dumbledore
titles.sortTitle: fantastic beasts: the secrets of dumbledore
titles.summary: Eddie Redmayne reprises his role as magizoologist Newt Scamander in this fantasy adventure sequel. As dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald (Mads Mikkelsen) plots to take over the wizarding world and lead his followers in a war against the Muggles, Albus Dumbledore (Jude Law) enlists the help of Newt, his brother Theseus (Callum Turner), American No-Maj Jacob Kowalski (Dan Fogler) and Charms teacher Lally Hicks (Jessica Williams) to stop him. The cast also includes Ezra Miller, Alison Sudol and Katherine Waterston.

holdings.status: In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hangleton Library (Set: 19 Jul 2024)

titles.title: The fantastic four: First steps
titles.summary: Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach star in this superhero action adventure directed by Matt Shakman. Four years ago, Reed Richards (Pascal), Sue Storm (Kirby), Johnny Storm (Quinn) and Ben Grimm (Moss-Bachrach) gained incredible powers after being exposed to cosmic rays. They became the Fantastic Four and now use their gifts to protect the people of Earth. When the Silver Surfer (Julia Garner) appears and announces that the world is going to be destroyed by Galactus (Ralph Ineson), a cosmic being who consumes planets to sustain himself, the team attempt to stop him but soon begin to fear this may be a fight they cannot win. The cast also includes Mark Gatiss, Natasha Lyonne and Sarah Niles.

holdings.status: On reserve shelf at Hove Library

titles.title: A fantastic woman
titles.summary: Chilean drama co-written and directed by Sebastián Lelio. The film follows transgender waitress Marina Vidal (Daniela Vega) in the devastating aftermath of her 57-year-old husband Orlando (Francisco Reyes)'s sudden death. Moonlighting as a nightclub singer, Marina soon finds herself having to process her grief whilst becoming the focus of everyone's suspicions surrounding her husband's untimely death. Looked upon as a murderer by the investigating authorities and Orlando's family, Marina is banned from her husband's funeral and questioned and harassed relentlessly before she can fully come to terms with her grief as she tries to make everyone around her see the truth.

titles.title: Far from the madding crowd
titles.summary: Carey Mulligan and Matthias Schoenaerts star in this adaptation of Thomas Hardy's classic 19th century novel. Gabriel Oak (Schoenaerts) is a humble shepherd who, with his life's savings and a hefty loan, has managed to purchase his very own sheep farm. Gabriel is working hard, perfectly content with his life, when his eyes meet those of Bathsheba Everdene (Mulligan), his new young neighbour who has come to live with her aunt. Although many worlds and classes apart the two have an instant connection and Gabriel quickly proposes marriage. Valuing her independence greatly, Bathsheba refuses Gabriel's proposal and moves away to start anew. However, as they both begin new chapters of their lives, fate endeavours to bring them back together.

titles.title: Farming
titles.summary: Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje writes, directs and stars in this British drama. While his parents complete their studies, young Nigerian Enitan (Zephan Hanson Amissah/Damson Idris) is farmed out to a white working-class family in Tilbury, Essex. Displaced from his cultural heritage and subjected to constant racist abuse, violence and degradation, Eni learns to hate his own skin and struggles with his identity until, as a teenager, he becomes part of the feared skinhead gang the Tilbury Skins.

titles.title: Fast X
titles.summary: Vin Diesel, Jason Statham, Michelle Rodriguez and John Cena return to star in this tenth instalment of the 'Fast and Furious' action thriller franchise. Dom (Diesel)'s past is catching up with him, as extraordinary escapes from high-stakes chases and shutting down the criminal empires of his enemies begin to attract even more of the wrong kind of attention. Dante (Jason Momoa) was the heir to one such empire, until his father died at Dom's hands and all of his wealth was lost with him. Now Dante will stop at nothing to force Dom to face him, attempting to destroy all Dom holds dear along the way. For Dom to defeat this brutal and dangerous nemesis, he will need the strongest and bravest men and women he can get, alongside the most powerful weapons and fastest cars he can lay his hands on.

titles.title: The father
titles.summary: Florian Zeller directs this adaptation of his play starring Anthony Hopkins and Olivia Colman. The film follows Anne (Colman) as she moves in with her 80-year-old father Anthony (Hopkins) in order to provide better care for him, despite his reluctance to accept any help. However, as his mental state begins to rapidly deteriorate, Anthony is forced to finally confront his fragile grasp of reality. The cast also includes Olivia Williams, Rufus Sewell, Mark Gatiss and Imogen Poots.

titles.title: The favourite
titles.summary: Olivia Colman stars in this bawdy period drama directed by Yorgos Lanthimos. Queen Anne (Colman) may occupy the throne but it is her co-dependent, Lady Sarah (Rachel Weisz), who makes most of the Monarch's decisions, leaving The Queen to get on with eating pineapples and racing ducks. When Lady Sarah's cousin, Abigal Masham (Emma Stone), arrives and is given work at the palace as a servant she quickly endears herself to The Queen and threatens Lady Sarah's status as the favourite. Lady Sarah cannot hide her jealously and a bitter and petty rivalry ensues as both ladies vie for The Queen's affections.

titles.title: Fawlty Towers: Remastered
titles.summary: To mark its 30th anniversary, all 12 episodes of John Cleese and Connie Booth's highly successful comedy series, set in a Torquay hotel, have been remastered. In 'Basil the Rat', waiter Manuel (Andrew Sachs)'s Siberian hamster turns out to be a rat, which goes missing just in time for a visit from the hotel inspector. 'Communication Problems' sees Basil (Cleese) forced to deal with a deaf guest while attempting to conceal his gambling win from Sybil (Prunella Scales). In 'The Anniversary', a secret party planned for Sybil goes awry when the guest of honour storms out of the hotel. 'The Germans' sees Basil failing to cope with a fire drill and the arrival of some German guests while Sybil is in hospital - 'Don't mention the war - I did once, but I think I got away with it!'. In 'The Hotel Inspectors', Basil goes into fawning overdrive when he learns that a group of hotel inspectors are operating in the area. In 'A Touch of Class', Basil's quest for a better class of clientele seems to have succeeded with the arrival at the hotel of Lord Melbury (Michael Gwynn). Or has it? 'The Kipper and the Corpse' finds Basil and Manuel trying to dispose of a dead body without any of the guests noticing. Needless to say, they are less than successful. In 'Waldorf Salad', some newly-arrived American guests' request for transatlantic cuisine does not go down well with Basil in the kitchen. 'Gourmet Night' sees the Fawltys' attempt to throw a cultural evening fail when their chef hits the bottle. In 'The Psychiatrist', Basil begins behaving even more oddly than usual when he learns that a psychiatrist is staying at the hotel. 'The Builders' sees Basil in hot water with Sybil when he employs the unreliable Irish labourer Mr O'Reilly (David Kelly) to do some work in the hotel lobby. Finally, in 'The Wedding Party', Basil gets the wrong impression when some old friends of Polly (Booth)'s arrive at the hotel.

titles.title: Ferrari
titles.summary: Michael Mann directs this biographical drama based on the life and career of Enzo Ferrari, starring Adam Driver, Penélope Cruz and Shailene Woodley. In 1957, Enzo Ferrari (Driver)'s world is on the brink of collapse. The threat of bankruptcy to his company, his failing marriage to his wife Laura (Cruz) and the untimely death of his son are all taking their toll on the founder of the Ferrari empire. After forming his own racing team, Scuderia Ferrari, Enzo sets out to restore the brand's struggling reputation. However, when tragedy strikes and Enzo faces brutal public scrutiny, his mission to return Ferrari to its former glory will become his greatest challenge yet.

titles.title: Final destination: Bloodlines
titles.summary: Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein direct this sixth instalment of the supernatural horror franchise. College student Stefani (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) discovers that she has inherited premonitions from her grandmother Iris (Gabrielle Rose). After seeing visions of a rooftop restaurant catching fire and collapsing, Stefani realises that she must speak with her family to find out what it means. When Stefani locates her grandmother, Iris tells her that she once thwarted Death's intentions and now Stefani must do the same...

titles.title: Finding Nemo
titles.summary: Academy Award-winning animated family adventure. Motherless clownfish Nemo (voice of Alexander Gould) is carried away from his home in Australia's Great Barrier Reef. His overprotective father Marlin (Albert Brooks) and Dory (Ellen DeGeneres), a friendly but forgetful regal blue tang fish, go to his rescue. The two embark on an adventure that leads to encounters with a range of colourful characters including Bruce the Great White Shark (Barry Humphries), a Sea Tortoise called Crush (Andrew Stanton) and a Pelican called Nigel (Geoffrey Rush).

titles.title: Fireflies
titles.summary: Gay-themed drama from Iranian film-maker Bani Khoshnoudi. The film follows young gay man Ramin (Arash Marandi) as he settles in the Mexican port city of Veracruz having fled persecution in his native Iran. As he ponders how he can get back to Turkey, Ramin befriends hotel owner Leti (Flor Eduarda Gurrola), who teaches him Spanish, and fellow construction worker Guillermo (Luis Alberti), with whom he falls in love.

titles.title: Fireman Sam: Race against time!
titles.summary: Five animated adventures featuring Pontypandy's favourite fireman. In this instalment, the fire department comes to the rescue when a runaway train catches fire with a science class on board. The episodes are: 'Space Train', 'Dashing Through the Snow', 'Float Your Boat', 'Castles in the Air' and 'Wicker Bear'.

titles.title: Fireman Sam: Runaway horse
titles.summary: Five animated episodes following Pontypandy's favourite fireman. In this instalment, Fireman Sam (voice of Steven Kynman) gives a lesson about woodland fire safety while Norman (Kynman) has trouble with a runaway horse and puts on a big top circus show. The episodes are: 'Runaway Horse', 'Bus Trouble', 'Shape Up and Shine', 'Big Top Norman' and 'Lost in the Caves'.

titles.title: Fireman Sam: S.O.S. Sam
titles.summary: Five animated adventures from Pontypandy's favourite fireman. Episodes are: 'Fireworks for Mandy', 'Off Duty Sam', 'Sheep Dog Trials', 'Norman's Ark' and 'Mike's Rocket'.

titles.title: Fireman Sam: The day of the penguin
titles.sortTitle: fireman sam: the day of the penguin
titles.summary: Another five animated adventures following Pontypandy's favourite fireman. In this instalment, Norman makes a spy film full of dangerous stunts and a penguin escapes from Newtown Zoo. It is up to Sam and his team to save the day.

titles.title: Fireworks
titles.summary: Giuseppe Fiorello writes and directs this LGBTQ+ drama based on true events, starring Samuele Segreto and Gabriele Pizzurro. In 1980s Italy, a friendship is blossoming between Gianni Accordino (Segreto) and Nino Scalia (Pizzurro), uniting their mothers in shared anxiety when members of the local community take notice of the young men and their increasing closeness. When rumours begin to spread about the true nature of their relationship, how long will they be able to enjoy their secrecy before everything is out in the open?

titles.title: First cow
titles.summary: US drama co-written and directed by Kelly Reichardt. In 1820s Oregon, Chinese immigrant King-Lu (Orion Lee) crosses paths with chef Cookie (John Magaro), who is travelling with a band of fur trappers. Together, the pair decide to improve their fortunes by making and selling cakes using the stolen milk of the first cow in the region, a venture that places both of their lives in danger.

titles.title: First man
titles.summary: Damien Chazelle directs this US biographical drama about astronaut Neil Armstrong (Ryan Gosling) as he prepares to lead NASA's Apollo 11 mission to land a man on the Moon in the late 1960s. As pressure begins to mount around the impending mission and recurrent failings of the spacecraft leave the project hanging in the balance, Neil must question whether the need to fulfil mankind's biggest adventure outweighs the risk of possibly leaving his family behind forever and never returning home. The cast also includes Claire Foy, Corey Stoll, Kyle Chandler and Jason Clarke.

titles.title: The first slam dunk
titles.summary: Japanese anime written and directed by Takehiko Inoue which follows the Shohoku High School basketball team. Point guard Ryota Miyagi (voice of Shugo Nakamura) has always loved basketball. Now he and his teammates must prove they belong by facing the team from Sannoh Kogyo High School in a tournament. Not only does Sannoh have a generational talent in Eiji Sawakita (Shunsuke Takeuchi) but they are considered unbeatable. Can Ryota and his team rise to the challenge?

titles.title: Fisherman's friends
titles.summary: British comedy drama based on a true story. While on a stag weekend in Cornwall, London music executive Danny (Daniel Mays) is tasked with signing a group of local fishermen who perform together as part-time sea shanty singers. Despite the uphill challenge of convincing all of the ten men, who want no part of fame or fortune, to sign with him, Danny embeds himself in the community and succeeds, only to find out from his boss that the idea to sign them was just a big joke. Unwilling to go back on his word, Danny attempts to convince another label to offer them a real contract. The cast also includes James Purefoy, Tuppence Middleton and David Hayman.

titles.title: Five
titles.summary: French comedy written and directed by Igor Gotesman. The story follows five childhood friends as they move into an expensive apartment in Paris. Not long after arriving, Samuel (Pierre Niney), who had offered to pay half the rent, ends up penniless and unable to provide his share. Deciding not to tell the others, Samuel becomes a drug dealer in a desperate attempt to make some quick cash. However, after running into trouble with rival dealers, Samuel is forced to turn to his friends for help.

titles.title: Flee
titles.summary: Animated feature written and directed by Jonas Poher Rasmussen. As he prepares to marry his long-time boyfriend, 36-year-old Amin Nawabi (voice of Daniel Karimyar/Fardin Mijdzadeh) reflects on his arduous journey to Denmark as a child refugee from war-torn Afghanistan.

titles.title: The flight attendant: The complete first season
titles.sortTitle: flight attendant: the complete first season
titles.summary: Kaley Cuoco stars in this eight-part US comedy drama based on the novel by Chris Bohjalian. Alcoholic flight attendant Cassie Bowden (Cuoco) finds herself at the centre of a murder investigation when she wakes up after a one-night stand to discover her date, Alex Sokolov (Michiel Huisman), has been killed. Wanted for questioning by the FBI, Cassie begins her own investigation into Alex's death and finds herself at the centre of a dangerous conspiracy. The episodes are: 'In Case of Emergency', 'Rabbits', 'Funeralia', 'Conspiracy Theories', 'Other People's Houses', 'After Dark', 'Hitchcock Double' and 'Arrivals & Departures'.

titles.title: The flight attendant: The complete second season
titles.sortTitle: flight attendant: the complete second season
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the second season of the US comedy drama based on the novel by Chris Bohjalian. Now working part-time for the CIA, flight attendant Cassie Bowden (Kaley Cuoco) has quit drinking and moved to Los Angeles. While on assignment in Berlin, Cassie discovers someone is trying to frame her for murder, leading her to set off on another globe-trotting investigation to find those responsible. The episodes are: 'Seeing Double', 'Mushrooms, Tasers, and Bears, Oh My!', 'The Reykjavik Ice Sculpture Festival Is Lovely This Time of Year', 'Blue Sincerely Reunion', 'Drowning Women', 'Brothers & Sisters', 'No Exit' and 'Backwards and Forwards'.

titles.title: Florence Foster Jenkins
titles.summary: Stephen Frears directs this comedy drama starring Meryl Streep as the eponymous American opera singer. World renowned as a virtuosic pianist, Florence Foster Jenkins has a new dream: to become a famous opera singer. Her voice, however, leaves a lot to be desired and she becomes famous for her lack of talent. Despite the constant criticism from her peers and audiences which Florence's manager and partner St. Clair Bayfield (Hugh Grant) endeavours to keep from her, Florence battles on and, with St. Clair's help, she conquers the New York stage to become a household name.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 23 Sep 2016); In-transit from Hove Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 20 Aug 2022)

titles.title: The Florida project
titles.summary: Willem Dafoe and Brooklynn Prince star in this drama co-written and directed by Sean Baker. Moonee (Prince), an adventurous six-year-old girl, moves to the Florida city of Kissimmee for the summer. Staying at the Magic Castle Motel with her unstable mother Halley (Bria Vinaite), Moonee quickly settles in and makes friends with Jancey (Valeria Cotto), a young girl staying in a nearby guest house. With Halley out most nights trying to scrape together enough money to pay the rent, Moonee forms a strong bond with motel owner Bobby (Dafoe) as she and her friends explore the area and attempt to make the best of the summer.

titles.title: Flow
titles.summary: Gints Zilbalodis directs this animated fantasy adventure following the journey of a lonely cat. When Cat's home is flooded by a giant tidal wave, he sees a sailing boat and climbs aboard to safety. On board he meets other animals who have chosen the same vessel for shelter and together they must navigate their new life on the water.

titles.title: Flux gourmet
titles.summary: Dark comedy written and directed by Peter Strickland. During the course of a three-week residency, writer Stones (Makis Papadimitriou) is tasked with interviewing the culinary performance artists of the Sonic Catering Institute, including Billy Rubin (Asa Butterfield), Lamina Propria (Ariane Labed) and Elle di Elle (Fatma Mohamed), who are overseen by owner Jan Stevens (Gwendoline Christie).

titles.title: Force majeure
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Ruben Östlund. A Swedish family are enjoying a ski holiday in the alps when they are faced with an impending avalanche on the mountainside. Fearing for their lives, matriarch Ebba (Lisa Loven Kingsli) rushes to protect her children Harry (Vincent Wettergren) and Vera (Clara Wetterngren) while her husband Tomas (Johannes Kuhnke) flees the site of the disaster after saving his phone. When the life-threatening avalanche turns out to be little more than snow clouds, Tomas must answer for abandoning his loved ones while struggling to regain their trust and his own status at the head of the family.

titles.title: Foreign correspondent
titles.summary: Hitchcock espionage thriller. American crime reporter Johnny Jones (Joel McCrea) is sent to Europe in 1938 to cover the build-up to World War Two. Johnny becomes romantically involved with Carol Fisher (Laraine Day), whose father runs an international peace organisation. When Dutch diplomat Van Meer (Albert Basserman) is kidnapped, Johnny and Carol become mixed up in the espionage and intrigue.

titles.title: Forsaken
titles.summary: Western drama directed by Jon Cassar, starring Kiefer and Donald Sutherland. In 1872, Civil War veteran and former gunslinger John Henry Clayton (Kiefer Sutherland) returns home to Wyoming in an attempt to repair his relationship with his estranged father Reverend William Clayton (Donald Sutherland). With William ashamed of his son's past, John sets out to prove he's now a changed man. However, when a ruthless gang of outlaws arrives and begins to terrorise the town, John is forced to return to his old ways in a desperate effort to save the community from their merciless attackers. The cast also includes Demi Moore, Brian Cox and Aaron Poole.

titles.title: Four letters of love
titles.summary: Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter and Gabriel Byrne star in this drama directed by Polly Steele. Fate brings Nicholas Coughlan (Fionn O'Shea) and Isabel Gore (Ann Skelly) together while they are both struggling to overcome past traumas. As they each attempt to find their way through life, Nicholas refuses to give up on the possibility of true love and happiness and strives to be reunited with Isabel. The cast also includes Pat Shortt, Imelda May and Ferdia Walsh-Peelo.

titles.title: Four moons
titles.summary: Sergio Tovar Velarde directs this collection of four stories exploring love and acceptance between men as four different stages in the lunar cycle. The 'full moon' story centres on a devoted couple, Hugo (Antonio Velázquez) and Andres (Alejandro de la Madrid) whose relationship is put under strain by the inclusion of a third party. In the 'new moon' tale, young boy Mauricio (Gabriel Santoyo) struggles with the attraction he feels for his male cousin Oliver (Sebastián Rivera) in a homophobic environment at home and at school. Two close friends and fellow students Fito (Cesar Ramos) and Leo (Gustavo Egelhaaf) realise they are falling in love and begin an affair that they have to hide from family and friends in the 'waxing crescent moon' segment. In the final tale, 'waning crescent moon', old, married professor Joaquín (Alonso Echánove) finds himself drawn to younger man Gilberto (Alejandro Belmonte), also married, who works as a male prostitute so he can afford to join his family in America.

titles.title: The fox and the hound
titles.summary: Animated Disney feature about the relationship between Tod, an orphaned fox cub, and Copper, a puppy hound. As they play in the forest, looked after by Big Mama Owl, they remain unaware that adulthood will cast them as arch-enemies, putting the bonds of their childhood friendship to the test.

titles.title: The fox and the hound 2
titles.summary: Follow-up to the beloved Disney classic. Tod (voice of Jonah Bobo) and Copper (Harrison Fahn) are still the best of friends, but when Copper gets a chance to join a popular pack of hound-dog howlers it seems as if their purebred bond is about to be put to the ultimate test.

titles.title: Frances Ha
titles.summary: Noah Baumbach directs this stylised comedy co-written by and starring Greta Gerwig as a young woman struggling with the demands of growing up. Filmed in black and white, the movie revolves around the adventures of Frances (Gerwig), a 27-year-old aspiring dancer. Since college Frances has been inseparable from her flatmate Sophie (Mickey Sumner), but when Sophie, now a successful publisher, announces that she is moving out, Frances finds her life at a crossroads. With distance rapidly growing between her and Sophie and her lack of finances leading her to move into smaller and less glamorous apartments, Frances begins to realise that perhaps 27 isn't so young after all. Will she be able to move on from her youthful dreams and get her life back on track?

titles.title: The Frankenstein chronicles: Season 1
titles.summary: All six episodes of the ITV drama set in 19th century London. Sean Bean stars as Inspector John Marlott who is tasked with investigating a spate of recent crimes in the capital by Home Secretary Sir Robert Peel (Tom Ward). His findings lead him to believe the prime suspect to be a scientist trying to reanimate the dead with his search seeing him visit William Blake (Steven Berkoff), Mary Shelley (Anna Maxwell Martin) and a house where body snatchers gather known as The Fortune of War. The episodes are: 'A World Without God', 'Seeing Things', 'All the Lost Children', 'The Fortunes of War', 'The Frankenstein Murders' and 'Lost and Found'.

titles.title: Frankenweenie
titles.summary: Tim Burton's black and white stop-motion animated homage to Mary Shelley's 'Frankenstein' is a remake of his 1984 short of the same name. When young Victor Frankenstein (voice of Charlie Tahan)'s beloved dog Sparky is killed, Victor employs all of his scientific knowledge and skills to bring him back to life. However, when Victor's classmates become aware of his successful experiment, the consequences for the town are alarming. The voice cast also includes Winona Ryder, Catherine O'Hara and Martin Short.

titles.title: Freakier Friday
titles.summary: Jamie Lee Curtis and Lindsay Lohan reprise their roles in this comedy sequel set 22 years after the events of 'Freaky Friday' (2003). Anna Coleman (Lohan) is now a music producer and single mother to Harper (Julia Butters), a teenager who frequently clashes with her new classmate Lily Reyes (Sophia Hammons). After Anna meets Lily's father Eric (Manny Jacinto), the two fall in love and soon become engaged, much to the consternation of Harper and Lily. When history repeats itself and Anna switches bodies with Harper and Lily switches with Anna's mother Tess (Curtis), the two girls hope to take advantage of the situation and sabotage Anna and Eric's relationship. Will they succeed? The cast also includes Mark Harmon and Chad Michael Murray.

titles.title: Freaky Friday/Freakier Friday: Double pack
titles.summary: Double bill of comedies starring Jamie Lee Curtis and Lindsay Lohan. In 'Freaky Friday' (2003) teenager Anna Coleman (Lohan) and her mother Tess (Curtis) have a difficult relationship. Tess is engaged to Ryan Volvo (Mark Harmon) but Anna is struggling to come to terms with their upcoming wedding and the death of her father three years ago. When the magic in two fortune cookies causes the mother and daughter to switch bodies, they are forced to navigate each other's lives. This grants them a better understanding of the problems they each face but with Tess and Ryan's wedding imminent, will they find a way to switch back in time? The sequel 'Freakier Friday' (2025) is set 22 years later. Anna is now a music producer and single mother to Harper (Julia Butters), a teenager who frequently clashes with her new classmate Lily Reyes (Sophia Hammons). After Anna meets Lily's father Eric (Manny Jacinto), the two fall in love and soon become engaged, much to the consternation of Harper and Lily. When history repeats itself and Anna switches bodies with Harper and Lily switches with Anna's mother Tess, the two girls hope to take advantage of the situation and sabotage Anna and Eric's relationship. Will they succeed?

titles.title: Free guy
titles.summary: Sci-fi action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Jodie Comer and Taika Waititi. Guy (Reynolds) is a regular bank teller whose world is built upon a daily routine that sees him wear the same clothes, order the same coffee and converse with his best friend, police officer Buddy (Lil Rel Howery). However, when Guy encounters a mysterious woman who goes by the name of Molotov Girl (Comer) he learns that the world he inhabits is actually a virtual role-playing game and he is a Non-Playing Character. Molotov Girl, whose real name is Millie, is in Free City because she is a programmer who is looking to get revenge on a rival programmer who stole her codes. Together Millie and Guy attempt to subvert the game in order to upset the game's publisher Antwan (Waititi).

titles.title: Frenzy
titles.summary: Alfred Hitchcock's first British film since 'Stage Fright' (1950) stars Barry Foster as market trader Robert Rusk, a psychopathic killer who strangles women with ties. Suspicion falls, however, on the innocent Richard Blaney (Jon Finch), after Rusk kills Blaney's ex-wife Brenda (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) and his current girlfriend (Anna Massey). Set-pieces include Rusk's desperate attempt to prise an incriminating tie-pin out of one of his victim's hands (now rigid with rigor mortis) and a leisurely tracking shot up a flight of stairs to alight upon a grisly murder in progress.

titles.title: Freud's last session
titles.summary: Anthony Hopkins and Matthew Goode star in this drama based on the play by Mark St. Germain. During the onset of WWII, famed Austrian neurologist Sigmund Freud (Hopkins) invites C.S. Lewis (Goode) to his home to engage in a debate about the existence of God. As Lewis shifts from atheism to Christianity, Freud attempts to persuade Lewis of the futility of religion, while Lewis encourages Freud to embrace his faith. The cast also includes Liv Lisa Fries, Jodi Balfour and Jeremy Northam.

titles.title: Frida
titles.summary: Salma Hayek stars as iconoclastic Mexican painter Frida Kahlo in this biographical drama. Having recovered from the crippling effects of polio, Kahlo is lucky to survive a city bus accident at the age of 18. Bedridden, she is able to produce many pieces of art and, when she is fit again, she presents them to muralist Diego Rivera (Alfred Molina) who takes her under his wing as an artist. The pair later marry, but their relationship proves dysfunctional and Frida embarks on a number of controversial affairs.

titles.title: Friend request
titles.summary: Dark thriller directed by Simon Verhoeven and starring Alicia Debnam Carey as popular college student Laura. When Laura unfriends a fellow student, strange loner Marina (Liesl Ahlers), on social media it unleashes a demonic force that starts haunting Laura and her friends. The cast also includes William Moseley, Connor Paolo and Brit Morgan.

titles.title: From the land of the moon
titles.sortTitle: from the land of the moon
titles.summary: Nicole Garcia co-writes and directs this romantic drama adapted from the novel by Milena Agus. The film follows Gabrielle (Marion Cotillard), a young woman from a small village in rural France whose romantic pursuit of her teacher leaves her parents mortified. Deciding she needs a dependable husband, they arrange for her to marry Spanish farmer José (Alex Brendemühl) in the hope he will be able to curb her wild ways. However, despite José's devotion to her, Gabrielle is deeply unhappy and is given a chance to escape her situation when she is sent to a spa in the Alps for treatment for a kidney problem. While there she meets and falls for recovering war veteran André Sauvage (Louis Garrel), and although she starts to believe André could be the man she's always longed for, she must soon face reality and the prospect of returning to her husband and unhappy life back home.

titles.title: Frontier crucible
titles.summary: Myles Clohessy stars in this Western directed by Travis Mills. In 1874, former soldier Merrick Beckford (Clohessy) is tasked with delivering a wagon full of essential medical supplies to San Carlos, Arizona but to do so, he will have to pass through hostile Apache territory. Along the way he meets five survivors of an Apache attack but as they travel on together, tensions rise between them and soon all of their lives are at risk. The cast also includes Armie Hammer, William H. Macy and Mary Stickley.

titles.title: Frozen
titles.summary: Animated adventure from Disney inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's 'The Snow Queen' and featuring the voice talents of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel. Princess Elsa (Menzel), heir to the throne of Arendelle, has special powers that enable her to make snow and ice, which proves to be both a wonderful and dangerous gift. Following an accident that put her younger sister Anna (Bell)'s life at risk, Elsa has been trying to keep her powers under control. When an incident at her coronation ceremony exposes her magic ability to the citizens of Arendelle Elsa flees and cuts herself off from the rest of the world, but in her emotional state she sets off a spell that casts a perpetual winter over the kingdom. It falls to Anna, with the help of mountaineer Kristoff (Jonathan Groff), his reindeer Sven and a snowman called Olaf (Josh Gad), to journey through treacherous conditions in order to reunite with her sister and find a way to break the spell.

titles.title: Funny birds
titles.summary: Morgan Saylor, Andrea Riseborough and Catherine Deneuve star in this drama co-written and directed by Marco La Via and Hanna Ladoul. Charlie (Saylor) returns home to help her sick mother Laura (Riseborough) who owns a small organic egg farm in rural New Jersey. Their relationship is already strained and the discomfort in the house only increases when Laura's estranged mother Solange (Deneuve) arrives suddenly from France, spurred by Laura's illness to reconnect with her daughter. As they attempt to save the farm when its future is threatened by a bird flu outbreak, can they overcome their difficult pasts and form real relationships with each other?

titles.title: Funny cow
titles.summary: Maxine Peake stars in this British comedy drama as a woman who defies expectations by becoming a stand-up comedian. With a natural gift for making people laugh, she strives to leave her dull existence with her violent husband behind to pursue an on-stage profession. After some initial nervous starts, she becomes a renowned success at various comedy clubs as she surprises both men and women of all backgrounds with her wicked sense of humour. The cast also includes Paddy Considine, Stephen Graham and Christine Bottomley.

titles.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max saga
titles.summary: Dystopian sci-fi action prequel from film-maker George Miller, starring Anya Taylor-Joy and Chris Hemsworth. Set almost two decades prior to the events of 'Mad Max: Fury Road' (2015), the film follows Furiosa (Taylor-Joy) as a young girl, living in the abundant Green Place of Many Mothers. One day, despite her mother's desperate attempts to save her, Furiosa is abducted by a group of raiders when they infiltrate the Green Place. Taken as a slave and forced to grow up under the oppression of the tyrannical warlord Dr. Dementus (Hemsworth), Furiosa quietly hatches a plan to escape and find her way back home, but her path is not without vengeance...

titles.title: Furry vengeance
titles.summary: Brendan Fraser stars in this part live action, part animated family comedy. Dan Sanders (Fraser) is a profit-hungry property developer whose latest project threatens the habitat of the local woodland creatures. In a desperate effort to save their homes, the creatures set out to illustrate the environmental consequences of humankind's encroachment on nature. Led by a clever raccoon, they launch a protest that Dan cannot possibly ignore. Brooke Shields and Matt Prokop co-star.

titles.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The movie
titles.summary: Children's live-action animated adventure based on the TV series of the same name. Gabby (Laila Lockhart Kraner) and her grandmother Gigi (Gloria Estefan) go on a road trip together to Cat Francisco and Gabby brings her magical dollhouse with her. However, when the dollhouse is stolen by the cat-obsessed Vera (Kristen Wiig), Gabby must embark on a quest to retrieve the dollhouse and save the Gabby cats from Vera's clutches.

titles.title: Game of thrones: The complete eighth season
titles.sortTitle: game of thrones: the complete eighth season
titles.summary: The complete eighth and final season of the HBO medieval fantasy drama based on the bestselling novel series 'A Song of Ice and Fire' by George R.R. Martin. The programme follows the battle between the Starks and the other noble families of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros to gain control of the Iron Throne, a battle which is settled in this final season. The episodes are: 'Winterfell', 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms', 'The Long Night', 'The Last of the Starks', 'The Bells' and 'The Iron Throne'.

titles.title: Game of thrones: The complete first season
titles.sortTitle: game of thrones: the complete first season
titles.summary: The complete first season of the HBO medieval fantasy drama based on the bestselling novel series 'A Song of Ice and Fire' by George R.R. Martin. The programme follows the battle between the Starks, led by Lord Eddard (Sean Bean), and the other noble families of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros to gain control of the Iron Throne. In this land the seasons are harsh and long and, as winter approaches, its inhabitants must struggle against the toughest of conditions. The episodes are: 'Winter Is Coming', 'The Kingsroad', 'Lord Snow', 'Cripples, Bastards and Broken Things', 'The Wolf and the Lion', 'A Golden Crown', 'You Win Or You Die', 'The Pointy End', 'Baelor' and 'Fire and Blood'.

titles.title: Game of thrones: The complete fourth season
titles.sortTitle: game of thrones: the complete fourth season
titles.summary: The complete fourth season of the HBO medieval fantasy drama based on the bestselling novel series 'A Song of Ice and Fire' by George R.R. Martin. The programme follows the battle between the Starks and the other noble families of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros to gain control of the Iron Throne. In this season, Tyrion Lannister (Peter Dinklage) finds his life is in danger when he is accused and put on trial for murder. Elsewhere, Jon Snow (Kit Harington) and the brothers of the Night's Watch defend the Wall when the wildlings launch an attack. The episodes are: 'Two Swords', 'The Lion and the Rose', 'Breaker of Chains', 'Oathkeeper', 'First of His Name', 'The Laws of Gods and Men', 'Mockingbird', 'The Mountain and the Viper', 'The Watchers On the Wall' and 'The Children'.

titles.title: Game of thrones: The complete seventh season
titles.sortTitle: game of thrones: the complete seventh season
titles.summary: The complete seventh season of the HBO medieval fantasy drama based on the bestselling novel series 'A Song of Ice and Fire' by George R.R. Martin. The programme follows the battle between the Starks and the other noble families of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros to gain control of the Iron Throne. In this season, Daenerys (Emilia Clarke) returns to her homeland, Tyrion (Peter Dinklage) plans to conquer Westeros and a secret about Jon Snow (Kit Harington) is revealed. The episodes are: 'Dragonstone', 'Stormborn', 'The Queen's Justice', 'The Spoils of War', 'Eastwatch', 'Beyond the Wall' and 'The Dragon and the Wolf'.

titles.title: Game of thrones: The complete sixth season
titles.sortTitle: game of thrones: the complete sixth season
titles.summary: The complete sixth season of the HBO medieval fantasy drama based on the bestselling novel series 'A Song of Ice and Fire' by George R.R. Martin. The programme follows the battle between the Starks and the other noble families of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros to gain control of the Iron Throne. In this season, Tyrion (Peter Dinklage) attempts to rule Meereen while Daenerys (Emilia Clarke) is held captive by a Dothraki tribe, Bran (Isaac Hempstead Wright) learns more about his powers from the Three-eyed Raven (Max von Sydow), the High Sparrow (Jonathan Pryce) becomes more powerful by influencing King Tommen (Dean-Charles Chapman) and the Stark and Bolton armies meet on the battlefield. The episodes are: 'The Red Woman', 'Home', 'Oathbreaker', 'Book of the Stranger', 'The Door', 'Blood of My Blood', 'The Broken Man', 'No One', 'Battle of the Bastards' and 'The Winds of Winter'.

titles.title: Gangsta granny
titles.summary: Children's comedy based on the book by comedian David Walliams. Ben (Reece Butery) dreads staying at his gran (Julia McKenzie)'s house when his mum and dad drop him off, expecting the usual boring games of scrabble and knitting. But on his latest visit, his gran reveals a fascinating secret - that she was once a renowned jewel thief known as the 'Black Cat' - and shatters Ben's image of his boring old relative. Together they set out on a whirlwind adventure to pull off the one robbery that always eluded her, breaking into the Tower of London and stealing the crown jewels.

titles.title: The Garfield movie
titles.summary: Animated family comedy featuring the voice talents of Chris Pratt and Samuel L. Jackson. When Garfield (Pratt) is unexpectedly reunited with his absentee father Vic (Jackson), he is soon dragged out of his comfortable existence by Jinx (Hannah Waddingham). She wants revenge against Vic, her former partner in crime, and forces Garfield, Odie (Harvey Guillén) and Vic to team up to execute a daring dairy heist so that Vic can repay his debt to her. The voice cast also includes Nicholas Hoult, Ving Rhames and Cecily Strong.

titles.title: The German doctor
titles.summary: Historical drama written and directed by Lucia Puenzo. Set in 1960s Argentina, the film follows ex-Nazi SS officer and experimental physician Josef Mengele (Alex Brendemühl) during his exile in Patagonia. Forced to hide his true identity, Mengele adopts a new name and lives incognito to avoid detection. After winning the trust of local German-speaking couple Eva and Enzo (Natalia Oreiro and Diego Peretti), the former doctor grows more and more eager to resume his experiments when he develops an interest in their abnormally short daughter Lilith (Florencia Bado). Meanwhile, Israeli Mossad agents are in hot pursuit after receiving a tip as to Josef's whereabouts, which ignites suspicion throughout the community...

titles.title: Ghost stories
titles.summary: Martin Freeman stars in this British horror co-written and directed by Andy Nyman and Jeremy Dyson. The film follows Phil Goodman (Nyman), a professor of psychology who receives a letter from his old parapsychologist mentor who had gone missing 15 years earlier. A renowned sceptic, Goodman is tasked with investigating three unsolved cases of the paranormal which have left his mentor chilled and shaken. Setting off to begin his investigation, Goodman meets three people terrorised by mysterious ghostly sightings including a factory security guard, a confused teenager and a haunted businessman.

titles.title: A ghost story
titles.summary: Casey Affleck and Rooney Mara star in this US drama written and directed by David Lowery. The film follows a married couple in disagreement over whether or not to move away from their modest home in rural Texas. When the husband then suddenly dies in a car accident, his wife is left alone in the house as she grieves. Returning home as a ghost draped in a white sheet, the husband desperately tries to reconnect with his wife as she contemplates what to do next, but becomes increasingly frustrated with his inability to interact meaningfully with the physical world. After his wife eventually decides to move on, the husband remains stranded in the moment, silently watching over the house as a new family moves in.

titles.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen empire
titles.summary: Gil Kenan co-writes and directs this latest instalment in the supernatural comedy adventure franchise. Three years after the events of 'Ghostbusters: Afterlife' (2021) the Spengler family have moved to New York to join forces with Winston Zeddemore (Ernie Hudson) and Ray Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and reestablish the Ghostbusters. When a demonic entity with plans for world domination escapes from its prison and freezes the city, Ghostbusters young and old must work together if there is any hope of protecting New York and saving the world. The cast also includes Mckenna Grace, Finn Wolfhard, Paul Rudd, Carrie Coon, Kumail Nanjiani and Bill Murray.

titles.title: Giant
titles.summary: Amir El-Masry stars as boxer Prince Naseem Hamed in this biographical sports drama written and directed by Rowan Athale. Born in Sheffield to migrant Yemeni parents, Naseem is coached from the age of seven by Irish boxing trainer Brendan Ingle (Pierce Brosnan). Despite the racism and Islamophobia he faces, he rises to become a world champion. However, although he finds fame and success, his relationship with Ingle fractures beyond repair. The cast also includes Arian Nik and Katherine Dow Blyton.

titles.title: The giant pear
titles.summary: Danish children's animation in which two friends set off on a wild adventure after they discover that their town mayor needs help. When Sebastian (voice of Alfred Bjerre Larsen) and Mithco (Liva Elvira Magnussen) retrieve a letter from a bottle when they are out fishing, they piece together the message and uncover that their local mayor, JB (Henrik Koefoed), is trapped on a strange island and needs help. The dynamic duo soon gets on the case and on their journey, come across a giant pear. When they find out that the pear has invited trouble due to its size, they decide to save the pear and use it as a boat to help them on their rollercoaster adventure by sea to bring JB home.

titles.title: Gimme shelter
