titles.summary: This 1970 documentary follows the Rolling Stones on an American tour culminating in a free concert at the Altamont Speedway, where Hell's Angels were seconded as stage security - with disastrous results. A rare glimpse at the dark side of the 1960s.

titles.title: A girl at my door
titles.summary: July Jung writes and directs this South Korean drama. After being charged with personal misconduct, promising police academy graduate Lee Young-nam (Bae Doona) is sent from Seoul to the quiet seaside town of Yeosu where she meets withdrawn 14-year-old local Sun Do-hee (Kim Sae-ron). After Do-hee's grandmother is fatally injured in a tragic accident, Young-nam takes the troubled teenager into her care to protect her from the abuse of her violent, drunken stepfather Park Yong-ha (Song Sae-byeok). But when Young-nam's past catches up with her in Yeosu, her interference into the influential family's affairs brings unwanted attention upon her.

titles.title: Girl from the north country
titles.summary: Recording of the musical written and directed by Conor McPherson which features the songs of Bob Dylan. In 1934 in Duluth, Minnesota, in the midst of the Great Depression, the Laine family attempt to keep their guesthouse running. It is home to a collection of lost souls, some of whom are permanent residents and some of whom are just passing through. Each person has their own problems to deal with and they try not to lose hope that they will make it through. The cast includes Mare Winningham, Robert Joy and Jeannette Bayardelle.

titles.title: Girlhood
titles.summary: Céline Sciamma directs this French coming-of-age drama. Suffering from abuse at home and unable to achieve the grades she needs to progress in school, 16-year-old Marieme (Karidja Touré)'s future looks bleak. She decides to take fate into her own hands and befriends a gang of three girls where she discovers a sense of identity and belonging, but will she find the independence she is searching for?

titles.title: Gladiator II
titles.summary: Paul Mescal, Pedro Pascal and Denzel Washington star in this historical action sequel directed by Ridley Scott. When Roman soldiers invade his home in Numidia, Lucius (Mescal) is taken prisoner and forced to fight as a gladiator in Rome. Macrinus (Washington), an ambitious former slave, mentors Lucius, but he is not the only one with plans for the future of Rome. Lucilla (Connie Nielsen) and General Marcus Acacius (Pascal) also seek to end the rule of crazed co-emperors Geta (Joseph Quinn) and Caracalla (Fred Hechinger) and soon Lucius is at the centre of a struggle to determine Rome's future.

titles.title: Glass
titles.summary: M. Night Shyamalan writes and directs this thriller starring James McAvoy, Bruce Willis and Samuel L. Jackson. Following 'Unbreakable' (2000) and 'Split' (2016), security guard-turned vigilante David Dunn (Willis) hunts down Kevin Wendell Crumb (McAvoy), a disturbed and dangerous being with 24 distinct personalities. Both men are captured and placed in an asylum under the care of psychiatrist Dr Ellie Staple (Sarah Paulson), who specialises in treating those who believe they have supernatural gifts. However, their fellow patient Elijah Price aka Mr Glass (Jackson) enlists Kevin's help to escape the facility and realise his ambition of revealing their supernatural gifts to the world.

titles.title: The glassworker
titles.summary: Pakistani animation directed by Usman Riaz. Vincent Oliver (voice of Sacha Dhawan) is the son and apprentice of renowned glassworker Tomas (Art Malik). They live in the town of Waterfront where Vincent forms a friendship with Alliz Amano (Anjli Mohindra), a young girl who plays the violin. However, when a brutal and devastating war threatens their home, Vincent and Alliz's bond is tested like never before and tragedy looms.

titles.title: Glenrothan
titles.summary: Brian Cox and Alan Cumming star in this British comedy. At their mother's funeral, two brothers share a heated exchange with their father, with the younger brother fleeing to America to start a new life. Four decades on and the brothers are reunited and must try to find peace in the wake of their father's death. The cast also includes Shirley Henderson, Alexandra Shipp and Brad Hughes.

titles.title: The goalies's anxiety at the penalty kick
titles.sortTitle: goalies's anxiety at the penalty kick
titles.summary: Wim Wenders co-writes and directs this German drama based on the novel by Peter Handke. An inexplicable chain of events is set in motion when a goalkeeper (Arthur Brauss) storms off the pitch after letting in an easy goal and being sent off for dissent. Picking up a woman in a cinema, he takes her back to his hotel and impulsively strangles her, then takes a bus to a village where he tries to find an old girlfriend. All the while, the police close in.

titles.title: GOAT
titles.summary: Tyree Dillihay directs this animated comedy featuring the voice talents of Caleb McLaughlin, Gabrielle Union and Nicola Coughlan. Vineland is a city full of anthropomorphic animals including Will Harris (McLaughlin), a diminutive goat who dreams of following in the footsteps of his idol Jett Fillmore (Union), a black panther and a star roarball player. When he is signed to Jett's team, the Thorns, he must fight to prove himself to his new teammates who doubt that someone of his stature has what it takes to succeed in their ferocious sport. The voice cast also includes David Harbour, Jennifer Hudson and Nick Kroll.

titles.title: God's own country
titles.summary: Josh O'Connor and Alec Secareanu star in this British drama written and directed by Francis Lee. When his father is left paralysed after suffering a stroke, young Yorkshire farmer Johnny Saxby (O'Connor) is forced to take over the running of the family farm by himself. Seeing he is struggling to cope with the increased responsibility, Johnny's grandmother organises for Romanian migrant worker Gheorghe Ionescu (Secareanu) to assist him through the busy lambing season in a bid to alleviate some of the burden. However, this only complicates Johnny's life further, as Gheorghe's arrival forces him into making some big decisions regarding his future. The cast also includes Gemma Jones, Ian Hart and Melanie Kilburn.

titles.title: Godland
titles.summary: Danish-Icelandic drama written and directed by Hlynur Pálmason. Set in the late 19th century, the film follows Danish priest Lucas (Elliott Crosset Hove) as he travels to Iceland to oversee the construction of a new parish. As he follows his native guide Ragnar (Ingvar E. Sigurdsson) into rural Iceland, Lucas experiences a profound crisis of faith on the arduous journey.

titles.title: Godzilla Vs Kong
titles.summary: Sci-fi action adventure sequel starring Alexander Skarsgård, Millie Bobby Brown and Rebecca Hall. After Godzilla attacks a facility belonging to Apex Cybernetics, a team of researchers enlist Kong's help to guide them to the Titans' ancient home world in the Earth's core. A clash of the giant monsters threatens to derail the mission, but the adversaries are forced to join forces when a more powerful enemy emerges from the Apex labs. The cast also includes Brian Tyree Henry, Eiza González, Kyle Chandler and Demián Bichir.

titles.title: Goebbels and the Führer
titles.summary: Joachim Lang directs this German historical drama which explores the work done by ambitious propagandist Joseph Goebbels to promote the Nazi regime and incorporates real archival footage. Goebbels (Robert Stadlober) orchestrates a jubilant public response to Adolf Hitler (Fritz Karl)'s return from Austria after its annexation in 1938 and continues to craft public displays of loyalty throughout the war. He also commissions anti-Semitic films and as the war continues he promotes the notion that victory is imminent, until both he and Hitler are faced with the reality of their impending defeat. The cast also includes Franziska Weisz, Martin Bermoser and Katia Fellin.

titles.title: Gold
titles.summary: Matthew McConaughey stars in this drama directed by Stephen Gaghan. Desperate for a lucky break, struggling businessman Kenny Wells (McConaughey) teams up with geologist Michael Acosta (Édgar Ramírez) to search for gold in the uncharted jungles of Indonesia. After finding what they believe to be a potentially lucrative site, the pair begin mining and looking for investment. However, as their profits and notoriety rise, they begin to attract unwanted attention from rival investors and agents from the FBI. The cast also includes Bryce Dallas Howard, Corey Stoll and Toby Kebbell.

titles.title: Gold digger
titles.summary: All six parts of the drama miniseries which follows a wealthy mature woman and her relationship with a young, attractive man. When Julia Day (Julia Ormond) meets Benjamin Greene (Ben Barnes), she is given a new lease of life after divorcing the father of her children. However, after introducing him to her inner circle, their suspicions of his motives leave her reeling and questioning the validity of their relationship. The episodes are: 'Her Boy', 'Her Daughter', 'Her Rival', 'Her Husband', 'Her Baby' and 'Her Love'.

titles.title: Goldbeak
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. Goldbeak (voice of David Henrie) is a young eagle raised by chickens who shares a close bond with his adoptive sister Ratchet (Valkyrae). As he grows up he wants to learn more about who he is and so he and Ratchet embark on a journey to Avian City. However, there is a sinister scheme afoot in the city which threatens the residents of Peckington Roost and Goldbeak will have to find the courage to stand up for what he believes is right.

titles.title: The goldfinch
titles.summary: Ansel Elgort and Nicole Kidman star in this adaptation of the Pulitzer Prize-winning novel by Donna Tartt. During an ill-fated visit to New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art, Theodore 'Theo' Decker (Elgort/Oakes Fegley)'s mother is killed in a bomb attack when he is just 13-years-old. In the aftermath of the explosion, Theo takes one of his mother's favourite paintings, 'The Goldfinch' by Carel Fabritius. With no close relatives to care for him, Theo is taken in by the wealthy Barbour family before his absent father reappears and moves him to Las Vegas. Returning to New York years later, Theo reconnects with his past but as he does so his childhood theft propels him into more criminal misdeeds.

titles.title: Goldilocks and the three bears: Death and porridge
titles.sortTitle: goldilocks and the three bears: death and porridge
titles.summary: Craig Rees writes, directs and stars in this British horror. As a group of friends prepare for their annual reunion, they find themselves lost and at the wrong address. When they decide to let themselves into the mysterious house in the hope of finding directions, they soon discover that the property is occupied by a deranged group of murderers who dress as Goldilocks (Olga Solo) and the Three Bears (Jack Barry, Robson Medler and Grace Darling Smith).

titles.title: The good boy
titles.summary: Stephen Graham and Andrea Riseborough star in this thriller directed by Jan Komasa. When 19-year-old Tommy (Anson Boon)'s behaviour becomes increasingly reckless, he attracts the attention of Chris (Graham), who is determined to rehabilitate the young man. When Tommy wakes one day after a drunken night out to find himself chained up in Chris's basement, can he escape or will Chris and his wife Kathryn (Riseborough) succeed in training him to become a good boy?

titles.title: Good boys
titles.summary: Gene Stupnitsky directs this comedy drama in which three young sixth graders are opened to a whole new world when they begin their quest to get ready for a party. With a cool people's party around the corner and the boys fearing that they will be too inexperienced amongst their peers, they embark on an adventure which involves stealing beer, accidentally carrying drugs in a handbag and being chased by teenage girls. The cast includes Brady Noon, Jacob Tremblay and Keith L. Williams.

titles.title: The good dinosaur
titles.summary: Pixar animated feature about the adventures of a young dinosaur and his human friend. Set in an alternate timeline in which the asteroid that caused the extinction of dinosaurs missed the Earth, the story follows Apatosaurus Arlo (voice of Raymond Ochoa), who is left to fend for himself after losing his father in an accident and getting swept away by a river. Alone and scared, the youngster tries to find his way back to his family. He soon encounters a small human caveboy who he calls Spot (Jack Bright) and the two quickly become friends. With Spot by his side, Arlo goes on a journey, meeting lots of other dinosaurs and facing up to his fears along the way, but will he find his way home? The cast also includes Sam Elliott, Anna Paquin, Steve Zahn and Frances McDormand.

titles.title: The good liar
titles.summary: Bill Condon directs this US drama starring Ian McKellen and Helen Mirren. After meeting widow Betty McLeish (Mirren) online, elderly con artist Roy Courtnay (McKellen) resolves to take everything she has. As he works his way deeper into her life, Betty's son Steven (Russell Tovey) begins to suspect that Roy is not all that he appears. But is Betty as credulous as Roy perceives?

titles.title: Good luck to you, Leo Grande
titles.sortTitle: good luck to you, leo grande
titles.summary: Emma Thompson and Daryl McCormack star in this British comedy drama directed by Sophie Hyde. Following the death of her husband, 55-year-old retired religious studies teacher Nancy Stokes (Thompson) hires sex worker Leo Grande (McCormack) for a night of fantastical erotic adventure. Over the course of several sessions in a rented hotel room, Leo attempts to put his nervous client at ease while Nancy struggles to overcome her feelings of discomfort and lack of sexual experience.

titles.title: Good time
titles.summary: Robert Pattinson stars in this crime thriller directed by brothers Benny and Josh Safdie. The film follows brothers Constantine and Nick Nikas (Pattinson and Benny Safdie) as they try to pull off an ambitious bank heist. But when their plans go south, Nick, who has a learning disability, is arrested and taken to Rikers Island. His older brother is determined to get him out but when he fails to come up with enough cash to make bail, he must resort to more creative methods to ensure his brother doesn't spend the night behind bars. The cast also includes Jennifer Jason Leigh, Barkhad Abdi and Necro.

titles.title: Goodbye to language
titles.summary: Award-winning and critically acclaimed French-Swiss film director Jean-Luc Godard directs this abstract experimental piece. Godard deliberately disrupts the viewers perceptions of film and narrative while following various characters as they go about their daily lives musing over love, life and philosophy.

titles.title: The Goonies
titles.summary: 1980s American comedy adventure directed by Richard Donner. In Astoria, Oregon, a group of misfit friends who call themselves 'The Goonies' gather at their leader Mikey (Sean Astin)'s house for one last time before property developers demolish their homes. After finding a treasure map in Mikey's attic and escaping his older brother Brand (Josh Brolin), the gang set off on an adventure in search of legendary pirate One-eyed Willy's treasure, but their first stop leads them right into the path of the nefarious Fratelli family who also want a piece of the gold...

titles.title: Goosebumps 2
titles.summary: Ari Sandel directs this adventure sequel based on the books by R. L. Stine. In the town of Wardenclyffe, teenagers Sonny (Jeremy Ray Taylor) and Sam (Caleel Harris) find a locked manuscript titled 'Haunted Halloween'. Curious, they open the book, but by doing so they unleash a barrage of monsters onto the town. As the evil Slappy the Dummy (voice of Avery Lee Jones) attempts to create an unstoppable monster army, Sonny and Sam must work together to send Slappy and the rest of the monsters back into the book. The cast also includes Madison Iseman, Wendi McLendon-Covey and Chris Parnell.

titles.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
titles.summary: Wes Anderson directs this award-winning comedy set in 1920s Europe starring Ralph Fiennes as a hotel concierge who finds himself mixed up in the search for a valuable Renaissance painting. Gustave H. (Fiennes) is a leading concierge at the Grand Budapest Hotel. An eccentric figure known for his dalliances with older women, Gustave has a one night stand with Madame D. (Tilda Swinton) and finds himself bequeathed a valuable painting, 'Boy With Apple', when she passes away - much to the fury of her son Dmitri (Adrien Brody). With Dmitri intent on framing Gustave for his mother's murder, the concierge and his lobby boy Zero Moustafa (Tony Revolori) hatch a plan to hide the painting and evade the authorities. Will they succeed? The ensemble cast includes Willem Dafoe, Jeff Goldblum, Harvey Keitel, Jude Law, Bill Murray, Edward Norton, Saoirse Ronan, Tom Wilkinson and Owen Wilson. The film won four Academy Awards, the Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture - Comedy Or Musical as well as BAFTAs for Best Original Music and Best Original Screenplay.

titles.title: Grandpa's great escape
titles.summary: British feature-length television adaptation of the children's novel by David Walliams in which a young boy sets out to free his grandfather from the care home in which he is living out his final days when he begins to notice some sinister goings on. Jack (Kit Connor) has nothing but admiration for Grandpa (Tom Courtenay) who was once a successful World War II pilot and now suffers from Alzheimer's disease, which has prompted his family to move him into a care home ran by the intolerable Miss Dandy (Jennifer Saunders). When Jack recognises that Grandpa is miserable in his new surroundings and that Miss Dandy has unsavoury agendas of her own, Jack promises to conduct a rescue mission to get Grandpa out of the home and the two embark on a hair-raising adventure together.

titles.title: The grapes of wrath
titles.summary: John Ford's adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic novel follows the traumatic journey made by the Joads, a dispossesed Oklahoma family who head towards California to begin a new life. When Tom Joad (Henry Fonda) returns home after being released from prison, he discovers the farmlands have been destroyed by dust storms. Seeking a better future, he leaves with his mother (Jane Darwell) and the rest of the family for California. Their journey is far from easy, however, and there is no guarantee the promised land will provide the life they are hoping for.

titles.title: The great Gatsby
titles.summary: Baz Luhrmann writes, directs and produces this adaptation of the F. Scott Fitzgerald novel starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Tobey Maguire and Carey Mulligan. Set in the 1920s, the story follows aspiring writer Nick Carraway (Maguire) as he moves to Long Island, New York and becomes intrigued by his neighbour Jay Gatsby (DiCaprio)'s lavish lifestyle and mysterious past. As Nick finds himself caught up in the world of the wealthy, he witnesses romantic entanglement and betrayal. Gatsby's true nature is slowly exposed and his involvement with old flame Daisy Buchanan (Mulligan) ultimately leads to tragedy.

titles.title: Greed
titles.summary: Michael Winterbottom directs this comedy starring Steve Coogan, David Mitchell, Isla Fisher and Asa Butterfield. Self-made billionaire Richard McCreadie (Coogan) has made his money from owning retail outlets in the UK. After a public inquiry which damaged his image, he is desperate to regain trust and loyalty for the sake of his business. As his 60th birthday approaches, he tries to rekindle his relationship with many of his celebrity friends who have since deserted him, but will it be enough to rebuild his rapidly failing empire?

titles.title: Green book
titles.summary: Peter Farrelly directs this drama following Italian-American bouncer Tony Lip (Viggo Mortensen) and African-American pianist Dr. Don Shirley (Mahershala Ali) during a musical tour of the Southern United States in the 1960s. Determined to break barriers and perform his music to the masses, Dr. Shirley sets out on his tour with the help of his newly hired driver, Tony, and the aid of the Green Book, a guide listing racially accepting establishments for African-Americans to perform, eat and sleep in. Despite being forewarned that his presence in these states may bring trouble, Dr. Shirley and Tony form an unlikely bond as Tony is awakened to the prejudices the black community are subjected to while Dr. Shirley educates Tony in what it means to be sophisticated.

titles.title: The green knight
titles.summary: David Lowery writes and directs this medieval fantasy drama starring Dev Patel as Arthurian knight Sir Gawain. When the eponymous Green Knight (Ralph Ineson) appears in Camelot to challenge the court of King Arthur (Sean Harris), Gawain, the king's nephew, accepts the challenge to confront him in battle. On his quest Gawain must contend with thieves and ghosts as he makes the arduous journey to the Green Chapel where the true test of his courage awaits. The cast also includes Alicia Vikander, Joel Edgerton and Barry Keoghan.

titles.title: Greener grass
titles.summary: Jocelyn DeBoer and Dawn Luebbe co-direct, write and star in this American comedy, which follows the lives of several families in the same neighbourhood whose strive for perfection sees each of them jeopardising their own lives simply for the sake of politeness to one another. The cast also includes Beck Bennett, Neil Casey and D'Arcy Carden.

titles.title: Gregory's girl
titles.summary: Comedy written and directed by Bill Forsyth. Gregory (John Gordon Sinclair) is a gawky adolescent living in a small Scottish town. He plays on the school's struggling football team and, when the coach decides to hold a trial for new players, falls for Dorothy (Dee Hepburn), who tries out. Despite the coach's misgivings about her gender, Dorothy is a better player than the boys and easily makes the team. When Gregory finally gathers the courage to ask her out, he is thrilled when she agrees, but is unprepared for how the date unfolds.

titles.title: Gremlins
titles.summary: Comedy horror directed by Joe Dante. When Billy Peltzer (Zach Galligan) is given the cute and friendly little Mogwai, Gizmo (voice of Howie Mandel), for Christmas, he is told never to expose it to bright light, get it wet or feed it after midnight. One night when a glass of water is accidentally spilled over little Gizmo, Billy soon finds out why he was told to follow this advice as Gizmo begins to convulse, producing five new Mogwai. As Billy and his science teacher Mr. Hanson (Glynn Turman) then seek to find out more about the creatures, a series of events lead to the escape of a number of them and, due to their heightened intelligence, they know exactly how to replicate themselves. Soon after, the town is overrun by a new breed of Mogwai - the Gremlins - who are menacing little reptilian creatures, and far from friendly.

titles.title: Greta
titles.summary: Neil Jordan directs this thriller starring Chloë Grace Moretz and Isabelle Huppert. When Frances (Moretz) attempts to strike out on her own in New York City following the death of her mother, she is delighted when she encounters a lonely middle-aged woman named Greta (Huppert) who is desperate to make new friends since her daughter moved out. Having found Greta's handbag on the subway, Frances returns it to her and the two quickly befriend each other and start to spend more and more time together. However, one day Frances makes a discovery that forces her to question Greta's true intentions as she begins to unravel the web of deception that Greta has spun. When her behaviour becomes increasingly disturbing, will Frances find a way to stop her endless pursuit before it's too late?

holdings.status: In-transit from Hangleton Library to Hove Library (Set: 14 Sep 2020)

titles.title: The Grinch
titles.summary: Festive animated comedy based on the story 'How the Grinch Stole Christmas!' by Dr. Seuss. Living in a secluded cave on Mount Crumpet, the Grinch (voice of Benedict Cumberbatch) is outraged when the residents of nearby Whoville decide to make their lavish Christmas celebrations last three times longer this year. Fearing his tranquil existence will be disrupted, the Grinch decides to steal Christmas by posing as Santa Claus on Christmas Eve. However, despite his best efforts, a cheerful young girl may get in the way of the Grinch's sinister schemes...

titles.title: Grow with Joe: the complete flower garden
titles.sortTitle: grow with joe : the complete flower garden

titles.title: The Gruffalo
titles.summary: Animated adaptation of the bestselling children's book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler. When a cunning little mouse goes for a walk in the forest, he manages to outsmart not only a succession of woodland predators but the purple-prickled, wart-nosed Gruffalo too. The voice cast includes Robbie Coltrane, Helena Bonham Carter and John Hurt.

titles.title: Guardians of the galaxy: Vol. 3
titles.summary: James Gunn writes and directs this sci-fi action sequel in which Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Dave Bautista, Karen Gillan, Pom Klementieff, Vin Diesel and Bradley Cooper reprise their roles as the Marvel Comics superheroes known as the Guardians of the Galaxy. As Peter Quill (Pratt) mourns the loss of his Gamora (Saldana), her surviving past self has left the Guardians and joined the Ravagers. When Adam Warlock (Will Poulter) attacks and grievously injures Rocket (voice of Cooper), the Guardians join forces with the Ravagers to save their friend's life and must battle the High Evolutionary (Chukwudi Iwuji), a dangerous eugenicist. As they fight to save Rocket, they uncover painful secrets from his past. The cast also includes Elizabeth Debicki, Sean Gunn and Sylvester Stallone.

titles.title: The Guernsey literary and potato peel pie society
titles.sortTitle: guernsey literary and potato peel pie society
titles.summary: Historical drama directed by Mike Newell. Based on the novel by Annie Barrows and Mary Ann Shaffer, the film follows Juliet Ashton (Lily James), a journalist who forms a strong bond with members of The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society as she writes a book about their experiences during World War II. As she gets to know the islanders better, Juliet begins to form lifelong friendships as she learns about life on Guernsey during its Nazi occupation in the war. The cast also includes Michiel Huisman, Matthew Goode and Jessica Brown Findlay.

titles.title: Guilt
titles.summary: Four-part BBC crime comedy starring Mark Bonnar and Jamie Sives. On their way home from a wedding, brothers Max and Jake McCall (Bonnar and Sives) accidentally run over and kill an elderly man named Walter (Joe Donnelly). They attempt to conceal their guilt by staging Walter's death as a result of natural causes. However, careless errors in their attempts to cover their tracks lead the brothers to be drawn into the lives of Walter's family and friends, including his American niece Angie (Ruth Bradley) who suspects foul play in her uncle's death.

titles.title: H is for hawk
titles.summary: Claire Foy stars in this drama directed by Philippa Lowthorpe. When Cambridge academic Helen (Foy) loses her beloved father Alisdair (Brendan Gleeson), her grief threatens to consume her. They shared a love of birding and so Helen decides to begin training a goshawk. After she adopts the raptor, which she names Mabel, she forms a deep bond with the creature and slowly begins to heal and find joy again in her life. The cast also includes Sam Spruell, Lindsay Duncan and Josh Dylan.

titles.title: Hacks: Season one
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the first season of the American comedy drama starring Jean Smart. When veteran Vegas comedian Deborah Vance (Smart) finds herself falling down the popularity charts, her boss threatens to reduce her dates. However, when she is paired with up-and-coming comedy writer Ava Daniels (Hannah Einbinder), the unlikely duo find mutual ground that has the potential to be a winning combination. The episodes are: 'There Is No Line', 'Primm', 'A Gig's a Gig', 'D'Jewelry', 'Falling', 'New Eyes', 'Tunnel of Love', '1.69 Million', 'Interview' and 'I Think She Will'.

titles.title: Half of a yellow sun
titles.summary: Biyi Bandele makes his directorial debut with this adaptation of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's novel starring Thandie Newton and Chiwetel Ejiofor. In the late 1960s twin sisters Olanna (Newton) and Kainene (Anika Noni Rose) arrive back home in Nigeria, having finished their studies in England. While Olanna moves in with her boyfriend, professor Odenigbo (Ejiofor), and his young houseboy, Ugwu (John Boyega), Kainene becomes a businesswoman and gets involved with British writer Richard (Joseph Mawle). When the Nigerian Civil War breaks out the sisters' lives are changed forever.

titles.title: Hamlet
titles.summary: Riz Ahmed stars as the eponymous character in this reimagining of Shakespeare's tragedy set in modern London. Soon after the death of his father, Hamlet's world is turned upside down when his mother Gertrude (Sheeba Chaddha) marries his uncle Claudius (Art Malik). As he grieves and gathers evidence against Claudius for orchestrating the murder of his father, Hamlet becomes increasingly unstable as he is consumed by his anger and desire for revenge. The cast also includes Morfydd Clark, Timothy Spall and Joe Alwyn.

titles.title: Hamlet
titles.summary: Ian McKellen stars in the titular role in this cinematic reimagining of Shakespeare's tragedy which transforms the entirety of the Theatre Royal Windsor into Elsinore Castle. When his father dies and his mother Gertrude (Jenny Seagrove) marries his uncle Claudius (Jonathan Hyde), Hamlet's world is turned upside down. As he grieves and gathers evidence against Claudius for the murder of his father, he becomes increasingly unstable as he is consumed by his anger and desire for revenge. The cast also includes Frances Barber, Francesca Annis, Steven Berkoff, Emmanuella Cole and Alis Wyn Davies.

titles.title: Hamnet
titles.summary: Paul Mescal and Jessie Buckley star in this historical drama directed by Chloé Zhao. A deep connection forms between William Shakespeare (Mescal) and Agnes Hathaway (Buckley) when they meet and the two soon marry. They have a daughter, Susanna (Bodhi Rae Breathnach), followed by twins Hamnet and Judith (Jacobi Jupe and Olivia Lynes). As William finds success in London, Agnes and the children remain in Stratford-upon-Avon but when the family suffers a devastating loss, William is compelled to write his greatest play yet. The cast also includes Emily Watson, Joe Alywn and Noah Jupe.

titles.title: Hampstead
titles.summary: Diane Keaton and Brendan Gleeson star in this British drama based on a true story. The film follows widowed American expat Emily Walters (Keaton) as she strikes up an unlikely friendship with Donald Horner (Gleeson), who has been living illegally in a shack in Hampstead Heath for the past 17 years. A year after the death of her partner, Emily whiles away her days in the British capital by volunteering in a charity shop and spending time with her son Philip (James Norton) but when she first lays eyes on Donald and his rustic dwelling she's keen to investigate further and begins a friendship which transforms her outlook on life, despite Donald's initial hostility to the company. When she learns property developers are trying to evict him to build luxury apartments Emily vows to help him fight back but Donald is uncomfortable with all the attention his cause gains when he is eventually taken to court to save his home and his way of life.

titles.title: Han Gong-ju
titles.summary: Korean drama written and directed by Su-jin Lee. Abandoned by her alcoholic father and ignored by her newly married mother, 17-year-old Han-Gong-ju (Chun Woo-hee) is forced to move schools after being one of several victims of a terrible crime carried out by her peers. Driven out by the perpetrator's influential parents, Han's sympathetic teacher (Jo Dae-hee) sends her to his mother (Yeong-ran Lee)'s house while the criminal investigation continues in her hometown. In the intimidating environment of her unfamiliar school, Han is encouraged to join a singing group after making friends with a classmate (In-seon Jeong) who discovers her hidden musical talent. But when her new hobby brings increasing amounts of unwanted attention, Han is again forced to confront the trauma of her recent past.

titles.title: Happening
titles.summary: French language film directed by Audrey Diwan. Set in 1963, Anne (Anamaria Vartolomei) is a working-class student with a bright future. When she finds out she is pregnant, she fears her life is over. Abortion is illegal but with her exams approaching, Anne resolves to act, whatever price she must pay.

titles.title: Happy as Lazzaro
titles.summary: Italian drama written and directed by Alice Rohrwacher. Lazzaro (Adriano Tardiolo) is an adolescent peasant living in the isolated village of Inviolata, where he and his fellow workers in the tobacco fields are ruthlessly exploited by Marchesa Alfonsino de Luna (Nicoletta Braschi). Lazzaro strikes up a close relationship with the marchesa's son Tancredi (Luca Chikovani), who decides to fake his own kidnapping to end his mother's exploitation of her workers and enlists his new friend's help.

titles.title: Happy end
titles.summary: Isabelle Huppert, Jean-Louis Trintignant and Mathieu Kassovitz star in this French drama written and directed by Michael Haneke, following the Laurent family as they experience a number of trials and tribulations. Upset with her mother, young Eve (Fantine Harduin) leaves her in a coma by poisoning her. Meanwhile, her aunt, Anne Laurent (Huppert), becomes embroiled in a costly legal battle after one of her employees is injured in an accident at their construction firm. She does so while also caring for her father George (Trintignant), who suffers with dementia, and her troubled son Pierre (Franz Rogowski), who has a drinking problem, as events threaten to tear the family apart at their mansion in Calais.

titles.title: The happy prince
titles.summary: Rupert Everett writes, directs and stars in this British biographical drama which charts the final years of Irish poet and playwright Oscar Wilde (Everett). Recently released from prison after being convicted of gross indecency as a result of his relationship with Lord Alfred Bosie Douglas (Colin Morgan), Wilde travels to Paris in a bid to escape his troubles in England. With his health failing, Wilde resumes his relationship with Alfred, only to find himself forced into a life of poverty as he lives out his days in exile abroad. The cast also includes Colin Firth and Emily Watson.

titles.title: The happytime murders
titles.summary: Brian Henson directs this US action comedy starring Melissa McCarthy, Elizabeth Banks and Maya Rudolph. When a number of puppets who starred in the beloved 1980s TV series 'The Happytime Gang', including his own brother, turn up dead, former LAPD Detective Phil Philips (voice of Bill Barretta) reunites with his old partner Detective Connie Edwards (McCarthy) to track down the killer responsible. However, as puppets have been relegated to second-class citizens, it's not long before old tensions between the pair resurface which threaten to derail their investigation. With his former lover Jenny (Banks), the sole human star of the show, next on the hit list, can Phil and Connie uncover the root of the conspiracy before it's too late?

titles.title: Hard paint
titles.summary: Brazilian gay-themed drama co-written and directed by Filipe Matzembacher and Marcio Reolon. The film follows young gay man Pedro (Shico Menegat), who, after getting kicked out of college, lives in Porto Allegre and makes a living as a webcam performer, covering himself in neon paint. When he learns of another performer stealing his routine, Pedro sets out to find the culprit and discovers he is an aspiring dancer named Leo (Bruno Fernandes). The pair bond over their troubled pasts and form a double act that sparks a passionate relationship.

titles.title: Hard truths
titles.summary: Mike Leigh writes and directs this British drama starring Marianne Jean-Baptiste as Pansy Deacon, a woman suffering with crippling depression and anxiety. Giving in to pressure from her sister Chantelle (Michele Austin) to visit their mother's grave on the fifth anniversary of her death, Pansy reveals to Chantelle that she always felt second in their mother's eyes. As she attempts to come to terms with the root of her issues, Pansy must continue her battle to get out of bed every morning. The cast also includes Sophia Brown, David Webber and Tuwaine Barrett.

titles.title: Harold and the purple crayon
titles.summary: Zachary Levi stars in this fantasy adventure based on the children's books by Crockett Johnson which combines live-action and animation. Harold (Levi) lives inside of a book and can make anything come to life if he draws it with his magical purple crayon, including his friends Moose (Lil Rel Howery) and Porcupine (Tanya Reynolds). When the narrator of his story disappears, Harold draws a door into the real world to find him and meets Terri (Zooey Deschanel) and her son Mel (Benjamin Bottani). Mel is eager to help but Harold and his crayon soon cause chaos in the city, drawing the attention of Gary (Jemaine Clement), a librarian who wants to take the crayon and use its power for his own gain.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the chamber of secrets
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the chamber of secrets
titles.summary: Chris Columbus directs this fantasy film based on the second instalment in J.K. Rowling's popular series of novels. Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) and his friends Hermione (Emma Watson) and Ron (Rupert Grint) are back at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their second year. Vain author Gilderoy Lockhart (Kenneth Branagh) joins the staff as the new Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher and Harry, Hermione and Ron soon find that, once again, all is not right at the school...

titles.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the deathly hallows: part 1
titles.summary: First slice of the two-part final instalment in the fantasy adventure film series based on the bestselling books by J.K. Rowling. Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson reprise their roles as Harry Potter, Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger, who set out on a dangerous quest to uncover and destroy the lost Horcruxes, the secret behind Voldemort (Ralph Fiennes)'s immortality. Voldemort's power has now grown to unprecedented proportions, with the Death Eaters in control of the Ministry of Magic and under orders to find Harry and bring him to Voldemort - alive. Away from the protection of Dumbledore (Michael Gambon) and Hogwarts, Harry draws ever closer to the moment for which he has been preparing since boyhood: the ultimate showdown with the Dark Lord.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the deathly hallows: part 1
titles.summary: First slice of the two-part final instalment in the fantasy adventure film series based on the bestselling books by J.K. Rowling. Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson reprise their roles as Harry Potter, Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger, who set out on a dangerous quest to uncover and destroy the lost Horcruxes, the secret behind Voldemort (Ralph Fiennes)'s immortality. Voldemort's power has now grown to unprecedented proportions, with the Death Eaters in control of the Ministry of Magic and under orders to find Harry and bring him to Voldemort - alive. Away from the protection of Dumbledore (Michael Gambon) and Hogwarts, Harry draws ever closer to the moment for which he has been preparing since boyhood: the ultimate showdown with the Dark Lord.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the deathly hallows: part 2
titles.summary: The final instalment in the fantasy adventure film series based on the bestselling books by J.K. Rowling. With Voldemort's domination almost complete, Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), Hermione (Emma Watson) and Ron (Rupert Grint) face a race against time to find and destroy the Horcruxes, thereby extinguishing the Dark Lord's power. Returning to Hogwarts, where the last Horcrux is to be found, Harry, his school friends and the tutors soon find themselves preparing for the final, desperate battle with Voldemort (Ralph Fiennes), with Harry realising that in order for him to win the day, he may have to make the ultimate sacrifice.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the goblet of fire
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the goblet of fire
titles.summary: Directed by Mike Newell, the fourth instalment of the hugely popular series sees Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) board the train to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he will attend his fourth year of magical education. Shortly after his reunion with his best friends, Ron (Rupert Grint) and Hermione (Emma Watson), Harry is introduced to yet another Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher: the grizzled Mad-Eye Moody (Brendan Gleeson). Of course, Harry's wishes for an uneventful school year are almost immediately shattered when he is unexpectedly chosen, along with fellow student Cedric Diggory (Robert Pattinson), as Hogwarts' representative in the Tri-Wizard Tournament, which awards whoever completes three magical tasks the most skilfully with a thousand-galleon purse and the admiration of the international wizard community.

titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the half-blood prince
titles.summary: The sixth in the sequence of films based on the phenomenally successful books by J.K Rowling. As Lord Voldemort exerts his power over both the Muggle and wizarding worlds, Hogwarts no longer provides the safe haven it once did. Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), suspecting that new dangers lie within the castle ramparts, discovers a mysterious old book marked 'property of the Half-Blood Prince' and begins to unlock the secrets of Voldemort's dark past, aided by Hermione (Emma Watson), Ron (Rupert Grint) and new teacher Horace Slughorn (Jim Broadbent). Meanwhile, the sixth-formers grapple with teenage hormones as various romantic liaisons unfold between them, some more dignified than others.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the order of the phoenix
titles.summary: The fifth instalment of the hugely popular franchise based on J.K. Rowling's novels. Harry (Daniel Radcliffe) returns for his fifth year of study at Hogwarts and discovers that much of the wizarding community has been denied the truth about his recent encounter with the evil Lord Voldemort (Ralph Fiennes). Fearing that Hogwarts' venerable headmaster, Albus Dumbledore (Michael Gambon), is lying about Voldemort's return in order to undermine his power and take his job, the Minister for Magic, Cornelius Fudge (Robert Hardy), appoints a new Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher to keep watch over Dumbledore and the Hogwarts students. But Professor Dolores Umbridge (Imelda Staunton)'s Ministry-approved course of defensive magic leaves the young wizards woefully unprepared to defend themselves against the dark forces threatening them and the entire wizarding community. So, at the prompting of his friends Hermione (Emma Watson) and Ron (Rupert Grint), Harry takes matters into his own hands. Meeting secretly with a small group of students who name themselves 'Dumbledore's Army', Harry teaches them how to defend themselves against the Dark Arts, preparing the courageous young wizards and witches for the extraordinary battle that lies ahead.

titles.title: Harry Potter and the philosopher's stone
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the philosopher's stone
titles.summary: First instalment of the fantasy adventure series based on the novel by J.K. Rowling. On his eleventh birthday, orphan Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) discovers that he is a wizard when he receives a letter of acceptance into Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Newly enrolled at Hogwarts, Harry is introduced to the wizarding world and learns the truth about his famous past before meeting fellow first-years Hermione Granger (Emma Watson) and Ron Weasley (Rupert Grint). The three friends have a surprise encounter with a three-headed dog guarding a secret trapdoor and begin to suspect that something important might be hidden beneath the school. When they investigate it leads to an encounter with the evil wizard Voldemort (Ian Hart). Will Harry be able to keep up with his studies, lead his team to victory in the school sport Quidditch and still triumph over Voldemort?

titles.title: Harry Potter and the prisoner of Azkaban
titles.sortTitle: harry potter and the prisoner of azkaban
titles.summary: Third instalment in the phenomenally successful Harry Potter series. Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), Ron (Rupert Grint) and Hermione (Emma Watson) have returned to Hogwarts for their third year, but there is a shadow hanging over Harry: dangerous serial killer Sirius Black (Gary Oldman) has escaped from the Wizards' prison, the Azkaban Fortress - and he wants revenge for the death of his master, Voldemort, who Harry defeated 13 years earlier. For Harry's protection, Azkaban has sent an army of soul-sucking Dementors to guard Hogwarts from a possible attack by Black - but they turn out to be as much of a threat to Harry as Black himself. As myth, magic and teenage hormones combine to weave their dark spell, Harry uncovers a few more crucial secrets about his mysterious past. The supporting cast includes Emma Thompson, Michael Gambon, Alan Rickman, Julie Walters, Maggie Smith, Robbie Coltrane, David Thewlis and Timothy Spall.

titles.title: The hate u give
titles.summary: American drama in which a young woman must balance her life at a predominantly white prep school while staying true to her roots in a predominantly black neighbourhood. As she blends in with the other students at school and still manages to maintain friendships within her community, Starr (Amandla Stenberg) begins to feel the pressures of racial divide. One night, while out driving with her best friend, Khalil (Algee Smith), her life drastically changes when a police officer shoots and kills Khalil. Torn apart by grief, Starr immediately seeks retribution and to shine a spotlight upon racial injustices in America. Soon, her community rallies to support her and Starr leads a campaign to have her voice heard and represent her late friend, Khalil.

titles.title: The hateful eight
titles.summary: Quentin Tarantino writes and directs this Western thriller featuring an all-star cast including Kurt Russell, Samuel L. Jackson, Tim Roth and Walton Goggins. Set after the American Civil War, the film follows bounty hunter John 'The Hangman' Ruth (Russell) as he takes shelter in a remote stagecoach stopover with his captive prisoner Daisy Domergue (Jennifer Jason Leigh). On his way there, Ruth meets ex-Union soldier and fellow bounty hunter Major Marquis Warren (Jackson) and Chris Mannix (Goggins), a man who claims to be the sheriff. When the newly-formed group arrive at the cabin an assortment of other unfamiliar and unsavoury characters awaits them. Ennio Morricone won a Golden Globe Award, a BAFTA and an Academy Award for his score and the film was nominated for three Academy Awards including Best Supporting Actress (Jason Leigh).

titles.title: A haunting in Venice
titles.summary: Crime drama directed by Kenneth Branagh in which he reprises his role as Hercule Poirot, now retired and living in Venice. Mystery writer Ariadne Oliver (Tina Fey) visits Poirot, hoping to persuade her friend to join her at a Halloween séance taking place at a palazzo which is rumoured to be haunted. She thinks that he will enjoy debunking the work of celebrated medium Mrs Reynolds (Michelle Yeoh) but when another of the attendees is murdered, Poirot is instead put to work. He must ascertain if something supernatural is at work or if the strange phenomena they have witnessed is merely a diversion created by an all-too-human killer... The cast also includes Riccardo Scarmarcio, Kelly Reilly and Jamie Dornan.

titles.title: Heart eyes
titles.summary: Olivia Holt and Mason Gooding star in this slasher horror directed by Josh Ruben. The Heart Eyes Killer strikes every Valentine's Day, targeting couples and dispatching them with brutal efficiency. Ally (Holt) and Jay (Gooding) have only recently met when they are attacked by the killer and they are soon caught in a desperate fight for survival. The cast also includes Jordana Brewster, Devon Sawa and Yoson An.

titles.title: Heartstone
titles.summary: Icelandic drama written and directed by debut film-maker Guðmundur Arnar Guðmundsson. The film follows the coming-of-age of best friends Þór (Baldur Einarsson) and Kristján (Blær Hinriksson) in their remote, coastal community. As they both try to escape their families and the boredom of their small village, Þór strikes up the courage to pursue a romance with Beta (Diljá Valsdóttir) while Kristján wrestles with his own fluctuating feelings for his best friend.

titles.title: Heidi: Rescue of the lynx
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure directed by Toby Schwarz. When eight-year-old Heidi (voice of Lilly Graffam) rescues an injured baby lynx from a trap, she names him Pepper and decides to keep him safe while he heals. However, when she learns of plans to build a new sawmill nearby which would jeopardise not only Pepper's future but the entire local ecosystem, she is determined to help. Together with her friend Peter (Leonardo Lucero), she embarks on a dangerous journey through the Alps to return Pepper to his family.

titles.title: Heist
titles.summary: Robert De Niro, Jeffrey Dean Morgan and Dave Bautista star in this heist thriller from director Scott Mann. In need of money to pay for his sick daughter's medical bills Vaughn (Morgan), with the help of his colleague Cox (Bautista), plots to rob from ruthless casino owner The Pope (De Niro). The plan does not go accordingly, however, and the heist turns into a hostage situation when Vaughn is forced to hijack a bus with the authorities hot on his trail.

titles.title: Hellboy
titles.summary: David Harbour stars as the Dark Horse Comics superhero in this fantasy action adventure. In his role as an agent for the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense, half-demon Hellboy protects the world from supernatural threats, under the guidance of his adoptive human father Professor Broom (Ian McShane). After being despatched to London to aid a team of giant hunters, Hellboy finds himself taking on the resurrected Blood Queen Nimue (Milla Jovovich), who seeks to avenge her demise and raise the apocalypse.

titles.title: Help! I shrunk the family
titles.summary: Children's fantasy adventure. One day, nine-year-old Johannes (Sasha Mylanus) is amazed to find a tiny wizard named Wiplala (Geza Weisz) hiding in his kitchen. It's not long before his new friend shrinks Johannes, his older sister Nella Della (Kee Ketelaar) and their dad Mr. Blom (Peter Paul Muller) down to his size. Together they go on incredible adventures in their new miniaturised forms but must also deal with the big threats that come with being so small.

titles.title: The here after
titles.summary: Swedish drama written and directed by Magnus von Horn. Teen pop star Ulrik Munther plays John, recently released from prison for an unknown crime. He returns to his rural family home to stay with his dad (Mats Blomgren) and younger brother (Alexander Nordgren) in the hope of reassimilating into his former life. The local community and student body at his old high school struggle with his presence, and soon John is being attacked by strangers in shops and other pupils. His failure to respond to these acts intrigues new girl Malin (Loa Ek), whose curiosity draws out the details of the incident that led to his imprisonment. The attitude of the local community descends rapidly, committing hostile acts of violence and aggression against John and his family and it seems he must take action to protect his father and brother.

titles.title: Here we are
titles.summary: Hebrew drama directed by Nir Bergman. The film follows devoted father Aharon (Shai Avivi) as he struggles with the idea of sending his autistic son Uri (Noam Imber) to a boarding school for special needs students. Convinced that his son needs more time to adjust to the idea, Aharon defies a court order and takes his son on a road trip across Israel.

titles.title: Herself
titles.summary: Clare Dunne co-writes and stars in this drama directed by Phyllida Lloyd. In Dublin, Sandra (Dunne) finally decides to escape her abusive, controlling husband and finds herself temporarily living in an airport hotel with her two daughters. Faced with a three-year waiting list for social housing, Sandra decides to take matters into her own hands and build herself a house.

titles.title: Hey Arnold: The jungle movie
titles.summary: US animated adventure directed by Raymie Muzquiz and Stu Livingston. After winning a video competition, Arnold (voice of Mason Vale Cotton) and his classmates set off on a trip to the island of San Lorenzo, the last place his parents had been seen before their mysterious disappearance. However, when the group are kidnapped by pirates, Arnold and his friends are forced to come up with an elaborate plan in order to get to safety.

titles.title: Hey Duggee: The fashion badge and 9 other stories
titles.sortTitle: hey duggee: the fashion badge and 9 other stories
titles.summary: Ten episodes of the animated CBeebies series narrated by Alexander Armstrong. The show follows the adventures of The Squirrel Club run by the big, brown dog Duggee (voice of Sander Jones) where the attending children try to solve the problems that arise and achieve their squirrel badges. The episodes are: 'The Fashion Badge', 'The Looking After Badge', 'The Comedy Badge', 'The Singing Badge', 'The Playing Badge', 'The Party Badge', 'The Tour Guide Badge', 'The Sailing Badge', 'The Key Badge' and 'The Glasses Badge'.

titles.title: High life
titles.summary: Claire Denis co-writes and directs this sci-fi drama starring Robert Pattinson and Juliette Binoche. A group of death row inmates are offered a chance at redemption when they are selected to take part in a space mission to research the potential energy uses of black holes. However, once on board their ship, it quickly becomes apparent they are embarking on a suicide mission. As they drift through space towards their intended target, they are subjected to the sexual experiments of scientist Dr Dibs (Binoche), who becomes obsessed with the crew's only celibate member, Monte (Pattinson).

titles.title: High school musical 1-3
titles.summary: Collected edition of all three of Disney's super-successful teen musicals. Follow the fortunes of sporty Troy Bolton (Zac Efron) and brainy Gabriella Montez (Vanessa Hudgens) as they sing and dance their way through their years at East High School.

titles.title: High-rise
titles.summary: Ben Wheatley directs this dystopian action thriller set in 1975 London, adapted from the novel by J.G. Ballard. Tom Hiddleston plays Robert Laing, a wealthy young doctor who joins an insular community that resides in a luxury high-rise building where the floor you inhabit is determined by your status and affluence. Designed by renowned architect Anthony Royal (Jeremy Irons), Laing takes up residence on the 27th floor or, halfway up the hierarchy. He befriends documentary maker Richard Wilder (Luke Evans) and his wife (Elizabeth Moss), who are confined to a lower floor. Wilder is bent on mobilising a class war and toppling the serene isolated community, which divides the residents into aggressive factions. The story follows Laing as he navigates amongst the chaos and complete dismantling of societal order.

titles.title: The highway rat
titles.summary: Rob Brydon narrates this animated adaptation of the book by Julia Donaldson. An adventurous rat (voice of David Tennant) travels along the highway and steals food from other animals but his desire for sweet treats eventually leads him into trouble. The voice cast also includes Frances de la Tour, Tom Hollander, Nina Sosanya and Husaam Kiani.

titles.title: Hilma
titles.summary: Lasse Hallström writes and directs this biographical drama centred on the life of Swedish painter Hilma af Klint (Tora Hallström/Lena Olin). Now recognised as one of the first abstract artists, the film follows Hilma as she studies her craft at university, discovers an interest in the spiritual world and pioneers a new style of painting while working with a group of like-minded women known as The Five.

titles.title: His dark materials: Season one
titles.summary: All eight episodes of the BBC fantasy adventure based on the trilogy of novels by Philip Pullman. In an alternate world, orphan Lyra Belacqua (Dafne Keen) grows up in the care of Jordan College, Oxford, along with her daemon Pantalaimon (voice of Kit Connor). After her uncle, famed explorer Lord Asriel (James McAvoy), departs on a new expedition, Lyra is adopted by adventurer Mrs Coulter (Ruth Wilson) and accompanies her to London. When one of her friends is kidnapped, Lyra embarks on a quest to find him and uncovers some dark secrets along the way. The episodes are: 'Lyra's Jordan', 'The Idea of North', 'The Spies', 'Armour', 'The Lost Boy', 'The Daemon-Cages', 'The Fight to the Death' and 'Betrayal'.

titles.title: The history of sound
titles.summary: Paul Mescal and Josh O'Connor star in this drama directed by Oliver Hermanus. In New England in 1917, students Lionel Worthing and David White (Mescal and O'Connor) meet and immediately bond over their shared love of traditional folk music. They enter into a relationship until David is drafted to fight in World War I but after the war, they reunite and embark on a journey across Maine to collect folk songs together. When they are forced apart once more, Lionel travels to Europe but years later returns to Maine in search of his former lover. The cast also includes Chris Cooper, Hadley Robinson and Emma Canning.

titles.title: Hocus pocus
titles.summary: Bette Midler, Kathy Najimy and Sarah Jessica Parker star in this comedy horror directed by Kenny Ortega. 300 years after they were sentenced to die in Salem, a trio of witches return to gain their revenge. Terrorising the town's trick-or-treaters on Halloween and riding on vacuum cleaners instead of broomsticks, the only thing that can stop them is a black cat - who is in fact a boy transformed into feline form on the day of the witches' original execution and cursed to live forever.

titles.title: Hoff the record
titles.summary: All six episodes of the documentary-style comedy series following David Hasselhoff as he tries to reignite his career. With his acting vocation in Hollywood stalling, the former 'Knight Rider' and 'Baywatch' actor moves to the UK to star in a documentary about his life. Put up in a shabby hotel, things get worse for the Hoff across the Atlantic when he finds out he must audition to play himself in the programme and loses the part, and a 24-year-old German named Dieter (Mark Quartley) introduces himself claiming to be David's son. In desperate need of money after his fifth divorce, the Hoff attempts to take on a series of bizarre jobs including working as a UN goodwill ambassador, singing at a war criminal's birthday and acting in a pantomime. But will any of them be enough to turn his fortunes around?

titles.title: Holding the man
titles.summary: Gay-themed Australian drama based on Timothy Conigrave's memoir. The film follows the relationship of Conigrave (Ryan Corr) and his partner John (Craig Stott), who first met at their Catholic high school. With John the star captain of the school's football team and Tim an aspiring actor in the school play, the pair seem like an unlikely couple but continue their journey together through high school and university where they allow their love for each other to help them overcome the challenges being gay men in '80s Australia throws at them. However, one challenge proves too much for the pair after they are both diagnosed with HIV in 1985.

titles.title: The holdovers
titles.summary: Paul Giamatti stars in this comedy drama from director Alexander Payne. Classics professor Paul Hunham (Giamatti) is disliked by his students for his harsh critique and general persona. When he jeopardises the school's funding by giving the son of an important donor a low grade, headmaster Hardy Woodrup (Andrew Garman) assigns him to holdover duty, minding the students unable to go home for the holidays. Along with school chef Mary Lamb (Da'Vine Joy Randolph), Paul must take care of student Angus Tully (Dominic Sessa) whose mother cancelled their holiday in favour of a trip with her new husband. As the unlikely trio make the best of a bad situation, they attempt to enjoy each others' company and find common ground.

titles.title: Holy lands
titles.summary: Amanda Sthers writes and directs this drama starring James Caan, Tom Hollander and Jonathan Rhys Meyers. The story follows retired American cardiologist Harry Rosenmerck (Caan) as he moves to Israel and becomes a pig farmer. There, he befriends Orthodox rabbi Moshe (Hollander), attempts to reconnect with his faith and is visited by his estranged daughter Annabelle (Efrat Dor) after her mother, Monica (Arquette), is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Meanwhile, back in New York, Harry's son David (Rhys Meyers) continues to write to his father, without reply, as he prepares to launch his new play.

titles.title: Holy motors
titles.summary: Leos Carax directs this surrealist French drama starring Denis Lavant, Kylie Minogue and Eva Mendes. Monsieur Oscar (Lavant) is a man of many identities. Driven around Paris by his chauffeur, Celine (Edith Scob), he makes use of an elaborate dressing room in his limousine to assume the appearance and identity of a number of different figures. At various points throughout the day Oscar is a businessman, a beggar, an assassin, a father and an old woman, venturing out into the world to engage with others in each role and embarking on bizarre adventures that include kidnapping a beautiful model, Kay (Mendes). What is at the root of Oscar's extraordinary behaviour?

titles.title: Home
titles.summary: Tim Johnson directs this animated comedy featuring the voice talents of Jim Parsons, Rihanna and Steve Martin. When the alien race known as the Boov, headed up by Captain Smek (voiced by Steve Martin), decides to invade Earth and make it their new home after their enemies declare war upon their planet, they set about evicting and rehousing the entire human race. One human, a young girl called Tip (Rihanna) manages to avoid being captured and goes on the run where she meets young Oh (Jim Parsons), a Boov who has been banished by his people after he accidentally told their enemies where they were. As Tip and Oh become friends they decide the best plan of action is to work together. The voice cast also includes Jennifer Lopez and Matt Jones.

titles.title: Home alone
titles.summary: Family comedy starring Macaulay Culkin as ten-year-old Kevin McCallister who is inadvertently left home alone by his large family when they go on vacation. On the evening before his family leave for their Christmas break to Paris, Kevin is banished to his room for misbehaving by his mother Kate (Catherine O'Hara). When he wakes the following morning, he discovers that he is alone in an empty house. Kevin must cope not only with life on his own but also with the threat of two persistent, albeit incompetent, burglars, Marv (Daniel Stern) and Harry (Joe Pesci). Meanwhile, Kate vainly tries to find a way to get back home to Kevin.

titles.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
titles.summary: Clifford Choi directs this Mandarin-language romance starring Alex Man and Cherie Chung as lovers Kong Yuen Sang and Man Si Sun. When she arrives in Hong Kong having travelled illegally from mainland China, Man Si Sun meets gambler and aspiring boxer Kong Yuen Sang and the two embark on a passionate affair.

titles.title: Hoppers
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voice talents of Jon Hamm, Kathy Najimy and Meryl Streep. Mabel Tanaka (Piper Curda) lives in Beaverton and loves animals. She is campaigning against Jerry Generazzo (Hamm), the mayor of Beaverton, who plans to build a road through a local forest glade which was home to a colony of beavers until Jerry drove them out. When she discovers that her biology professor Dr. Samantha Fairfax (Najimy) has invented a device that enables the user to send their consciousness into a robotic animal, she hops into a robotic beaver, befriends the local wildlife and becomes embroiled in their fight for survival. The voice cast also includes Dave Franco, Isiah Whitlock Jr. and Bobby Moynihan.

titles.title: Horrible histories: Series 1
titles.summary: All 13 episodes of the CBBC history series. Based on the bestselling series of children's books and liberally splattered with guts, blood and poo, the series offers an anarchic and unconventional take on some of history's most gruesome and funny moments. Episodes include: 'Savage Stone Age', 'Awful Egyptians', 'Rotten Romans', 'Vicious Vikings', 'The Measly Middle Ages', 'Terrible Tudors', 'Gorgeous Georgians', 'Vile Victorians' and 'The Woeful Second World War'.

titles.title: Horrible histories: Series 2

titles.title: Horrible histories: Series 3

In this series, each episodes focuses on the life and times of a prominent historical ruler including William the Conqueror, Mary Queen of Scots, Napoleon and Cleopatra. The episodes are: 'Crooked King John and Magna Carter', 'Awesome Alfred the Great', 'Wicked William the Conqueror', 'Mardy Mary Queen of Scots', 'Naughty Napoleon', 'Horrid Henry VIII', 'Crafty Cleopatra', 'Gorgeous George III', 'Bolshy Boudica', 'Wily Winston Churchill', 'Tricky Queen Vicky', ''Orrible Oliver Cromwell' and 'Rotten Rulers'.

titles.title: Horrible histories: Series seven
titles.summary: The complete seventh series of the award-winning CBBC history show. Based on the best-selling children's books, the series offers an anarchic and unconventional take on some of history's most gruesome and funny moments. In this series, the episodes look at some intrepid explorers, hopeless romantics, brilliant inventors and famous rulers from throughout history.

The episodes are: 'Horrid Henry's Uber Homework', 'Horrid Henry and the Germy Germ', 'King Henry the Ninth', 'Horrid Henry and the 3D Nightmare' and 'Silence Is Golden'.

titles.title: Horrid Henry: Too cool for school
titles.sortTitle: horrid henry: too cool for school
titles.summary: Another collection of episodes of the CITV animated series based on the bestselling children's books by Francesca Simon. The episodes are: 'Horrid Henry Is Too Cool for School', 'Horrid Henry and the Single Sock Saga', 'Horrid Henry Takes the Blame', 'Horrid Henry Eco Warrior', 'Good Morning Henry' and 'Horrid Henry Looks at Love'.

titles.title: Horrid Henry: Top ten things
titles.summary: Another collection of episodes of the CITV animated series based on the bestselling children's books by Francesca Simon. The episodes are: 'Hashtag Henry', 'Horrid Henry Gets the Message', 'Horrid Henry and the Raid of the Century', 'Horrid Henry and the Number Gnomes Knowhow' and 'Horrid Henry's Top Ten Things'.

titles.title: The horse dancer
titles.summary: Family drama directed by Joel Paul Reisig and starring Richard Karn, Jason London and Sophie Bolen. Despite her talent, young American gymnast Samantha Wick (Bolen) is dropped from the national Olympic team. To help soften this blow, Samantha's grandmother arranges for her to attend a horseback riding camp. Samantha learns to translate her gymnastic ability into equestrian skill and this, along with her reputation as an Olympic-level gymnast, helps the campsite attract more students to the program in the midst of its financial woes.

titles.title: A horse for spring
titles.summary: American drama in which college student Riley Adams (Natalie Weese) has her dreams shattered when she is badly injured in a serious car accident and loses her ability to dance. Riley is well on her way to the nationals in the dance competition she is participating in while facing jealousy from her peers as well as the pressure and physical challenges involved, but things soon take a turn for the worse when she collides with another car on her way home from practice. With a brain injury and affected mobility, Riley's doctor suggests that equine therapy may be the answer to slowly rehabilitating her. But with getting back to the way she was ever present on her mind, Riley struggles to trust in her Christian faith and to allow God to lay out his plan.

titles.title: A horse for summer
titles.summary: Dean Cain stars in this family drama. To fulfil his dream of running a ranch, Kent Walsh (Cain) moves with his wife Teri (Terri Minton) and 14-year-old daughter Sarah (Nicole Taylor Criss) to small-town Arizona. Struggling to make their dream come true and faced with a tough economy, the family's life changes further when they are joined by Kent's niece Summer Dean (Mandalynn Carlson) after her mother is arrested in New York. Struggling to adapt to life outside of the city, the troubled teenager soon comes round to life on the ranch and finds a purpose in caring for the family's horses.

titles.title: Hostiles
titles.summary: Christian Bale and Wes Studi star in this Western co-written and directed by Scott Cooper. The film follows Joseph J. Blocker (Bale), a renowned army captain escorting Cheyenne chief Yellow Hawk (Studi) back home through hostile territory. Setting out from the deserts of Arizona, Blocker and his small band of soldiers pick up the traumatised Rosalie Quaid (Rosamund Pike) and dangerous convict Philip Wills (Ben Foster) along the way as they attempt to reunite the ageing chief with his family in Montana. The cast also includes Q'orianka Kilcher, Rory Cochrane and Peter Mullan.

titles.title: Hot milk
titles.summary: Emma Mackey and Fiona Shaw star in this drama directed by Rebecca Lenkiewicz. Rose (Shaw) brings her daughter Sofia (Mackey) with her when she travels to Spain for a consultation with Dr. Gomez (Vincent Perez) about the debilitating pain she experiences which means she cannot walk unaided and must use a wheelchair. Sofia's life is limited by her mother's condition and she has spent years trying to understand it. Now as Rose receives treatment, Sofia finds herself increasingly drawn to Ingrid (Vicky Krieps) and later decides to visit her estranged father but if she is going to live her own life, she must first face her mother. The cast also includes Patsy Ferran, Yann Gael and Vangelis Mourikis.

titles.title: Hotel Mumbai
titles.summary: Drama directed by Anthony Maras based on the Mumbai terror attacks that occurred in 2008. Arjun (Dev Patel) works as a waiter at the Taj Mahal Palace hotel where guests take precedence over all else. On this particular day the hotel is stormed by four armed terrorists who open fire with reckless abandon and Arjun and his colleagues, including Chef Oberoi (Anupam Kher), must use their knowledge of the building to do all they can to protect the guests. The cast also features Armie Hammer, Nazanin Boniadi and Jason Isaacs.

titles.title: Hotel Transylvania 3
titles.summary: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez, Mel Brooks and Andy Samberg. Dracula (Sandler)'s daughter Mavis (Gomez) worries that her father works too hard to give everyone else a good vacation that he never takes any time for himself. Seeing an advert for a monster vacation, Mavis books a cruise for the whole family. On board, Dracula meets the ship's captain Ericka (Kathryn Hahn) and the two share an immediate connection, of which Mavis is dubious. When Mavis discovers that Ericka is actually a direct descendant of Abraham Van Helsing (Jim Gaffigan), Dracula's arch nemesis whom he defeated over 100 years ago, she realises she must put a stop to the relationship before it goes any further.

titles.title: The house
titles.summary: Will Ferrell and Amy Poehler star as a married couple who open an illegal casino in this US comedy. After Alex Johansen (Ryan Simpkins) is accepted into Buckley University her mum and dad Kate and Scott (Poehler and Ferrell) discover they don't have enough money to pay for her tuition. Their neighbour Frank (Jason Mantzoukas) pitches them the idea of opening an underground casino in his basement which he promises will earn them enough money for four years of college tuition in one month. Seeing no other solution, the couple agree and Frank, who has a serious gambling problem, is soon kitting his house out like a Las Vegas hotel complete with card tables, roulette wheels, strip clubs, bars and fight nights. However, it's not long before Alex begins to see through their stories of working late every night and the party starts to get out of control, attracting unwanted attention to the trio's illicit dealings.

titles.title: House of Dracula
titles.summary: Sequel to 'House of Frankenstein' (1944). Count Dracula (John Carradine) arrives at the laboratory of Dr Edelman, claiming to seek a cure for his vampirism, but in fact eager to turn Edelman's beautiful assistant into his vampire bride. At the same time, a wretched Wolf Man Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr) asks Edelman to bring his lycanthropy to an end. The first attempt to cure Talbot fails, and he throws himself off a cliff in a bid to commit suicide. This attempt fails, but leads him to an underground cavern where he discovers the monster (Glenn Strange) created years before by Dr Frankenstein... The last in the original Universal series of horror films was later followed by the comedy send-up 'Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein' (1948).

titles.title: House of Gucci
titles.summary: Lady Gaga and Adam Driver star in this biographical crime drama centred on the Italian fashion house of Gucci. When Maurizio Gucci (Driver), heir to the house of Gucci, marries middle-class office manager Patrizia Reggiani (Lady Gaga) in the 1970s, he is forced to give up his inheritance and leave the family. However, the ambitious Patrizia vows to reclaim Maurizio's birthright, and devises a plot to seize control of the fashion brand that ultimately leads to murder. The cast also includes Jared Leto, Jeremy Irons, Salma Hayek and Al Pacino.

titles.title: House of the dragon
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the first season of the HBO fantasy drama based on the novel 'Fire and Blood' by George R.R. Martin. Set 200 years before 'Game of Thrones', the show follows House Targaryen as they rule over the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros before a devastating civil war brings an end to its dynasty. When King Viserys I Targaryen (Paddy Considine) assumes the Iron Throne, he divides his kingdoms by naming his daughter, Princess Rhaenyra (Emma D'Arcy/Milly Alcock), as his heir, sparking a deadly war of succession. The episodes are: 'The Heirs of the Dragon', 'The Rogue Prince', 'Second of His Name', 'King of the Narrow Sea', 'We Light the Way', 'The Princess and the Queen', 'Driftmark', 'The Lord of the Tides', 'The Green Council' and 'The Black Queen'.

titles.title: The house with a clock in its walls
titles.sortTitle: house with a clock in its walls
titles.summary: American adventure drama in which an orphaned boy named Lewis Barnavelt (Owen Vaccaro) is welcomed into a whole new world when he discovers that his eccentric uncle is a warlock. Beginning a new life with his uncle, Jonathan Barnavelt (Jack Black), Lewis is jealous of the other boys at school as he struggles to blend in with his peers and is bullied for his introverted ways, but everything changes when Jonathan and his neighbour Mrs. Zimmerman (Cate Blanchett) introduce him to the magical world. Lewis quickly learns the makings of a warlock and practises his spells with great talent, but gets more than he bargained for when a trick to impress his new friends results in the resurrection of an evil witch. Things are made even worse when Jonathan's quirky home reveals that a hidden ticking clock within the heart of the house may bring about the end of the world, and it is up to Jonathan, Lewis and Mrs. Zimmerman to prevent disaster.

titles.title: The housemaid
titles.summary: Sydney Sweeney and Amanda Seyfried star in this thriller directed by Paul Feig. Struggling to find work due to her troubled past, Millie (Sweeney) jumps at the chance to become the live-in housemaid for Nina and Andrew Winchester (Seyfried and Brandon Sklenar), a wealthy couple in upstate New York. However, she soon discovers that the Winchesters have secrets and the job is far more dangerous than she could ever have imagined. The cast also includes Michele Morrone, Elizabeth Perkins and Indiana Elle.

titles.title: How the Grinch stole Christmas
titles.summary: Jim Carrey stars as the eponymous green grouch in this festive family comedy directed by Ron Howard. The Grinch lives high up on a mountain overlooking the town of Whoville and he hates happiness, merriment and, most of all, Christmas. One year as the festive season approaches, he plots to steal all of the decorations and presents from the citizens of Whoville. However, Cindy Lou Who (Taylor Momsen) refuses to give up on him. She is determined to end the Grinch's isolation and remind everyone in Whoville of the true meaning of Christmas. Will she succeed? The cast also includes Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Baranski and Molly Shannon.

titles.title: How to build a girl
titles.summary: Beanie Feldstein stars in this coming-of-age comedy based on Caitlin Moran's novel. Hoping to realise her dream of becoming a writer, 16-year-old Johanna Morrigan (Feldstein) leaves her Wolverhampton council estate to begin working as a music critic in London. Reinventing herself as red-haired Dolly Wilde, Johanna learns that to be successful she must write scathing reviews of the rock music she loves, gaining the fame and adulation she so craved but at great personal cost. The cast also includes Alfie Allen, Paddy Considine, Sarah Solemani and Emma Thompson.

titles.title: How to change the world
titles.summary: Jerry Rothwell writes and directs this documentary about the history of Greenpeace. The film chronicles the rise and birth of the environmental organisation which began as the Don't Make a Wave Committee in the early 1970s when a group of friends protested against American nuclear testing on the Alaskan island of Amchitka. Featuring archive footage and interviews with the eco-minded group's founding members, the feature documents some of their early endeavours and most notable campaigns including their efforts to end whale poaching and to save the native seals of Newfoundland.

titles.title: How to have sex
titles.summary: Molly Manning Walker writes and directs this coming-of-age drama following a group of three teenage girls on holiday in Malia.
