Tara (Mia McKenna-Bruce), Skye (Lara Peake) and Em (Enva Lewis) arrive in the party town of Malia, Crete, determined to have the best holiday ever during a hedonistic week of drinking and sex. 16-year-old Tara is yet to lose her virginity and is feeling the pressure from Skye, who wastes no time in hooking up with boys and heckles Tara into losing her virginity before the holiday is over. During the course of the holiday, Tara begins to question the cost of her new-found liberation as she is exposed to the darker side of party culture.

titles.title: How to make a killing
titles.summary: Glen Powell stars in this black comedy thriller written and directed by John Patton Ford. Becket Redfellow (Powell) was raised by a single mother after her wealthy family disowned her when she became pregnant as a teenager. Determined to fight for the life he believes he deserves, he decides to kill the seven Redfellows who stand between him and a multibillion-dollar inheritance. With the FBI closing in, will Becket succeed in executing his deadly scheme? The cast also includes Margaret Qualley, Ed Harris and Jessica Henwick.

titles.title: How to talk to girls at parties
titles.sortTitle: how to talk to girls at parties
titles.summary: Elle Fanning, Alex Sharp and Nicole Kidman star in this romantic comedy co-written and directed by John Cameron Mitchell. Set in 1970's London, young Enn (Sharp) heads to a party thrown by local punk Queen Boadicea (Kidman). While there, he meets foreign exchange student Zan (Fanning) and immediately falls for her. However, when Enn discovers that Zan is actually an alien who has come to study Earth, he soon finds himself having to recruit Queen Boadicea and her followers in a desperate bid to save her from an uncertain fate. The cast also includes Ruth Wilson and Matt Lucas.

titles.title: How to train your dragon
titles.summary: Mason Thames stars in this live-action remake of the 2010 animation written and directed by Dean DeBlois. Teenaged Viking Hiccup (Thames) lives on the windswept island of Berk where his father Stoick the Vast (Gerard Butler) is the tribe's fierce chief. As part of his warrior training Hiccup is forced to fight dragons but his life takes an unexpected turn when he saves and befriends an injured dragon he names Toothless. As he learns more about dragons and dreams of a future where Vikings and dragons can live together in harmony, he comes into conflict with not only his father but also an ancient and powerful enemy. The cast also includes Nico Parker, Nick Frost and Julian Dennison.

titles.title: How to train your dragon
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure based on the children's novel by Cressida Cowell. Teenaged Viking Hiccup (voice of Jay Baruchel) lives on the windswept island of Berk, where his father Stoic the Vast (Gerard Butler) is the tribe's feared chief, and fighting dragons is part of every young warrior's training. But Hiccup's destiny of becoming a prized dragon fighter takes an unexpected diversion when he saves and befriends an injured dragon, Toothless. Hiccup now embarks on a mission of his own to convince his tribe to abandon its barbaric tradition of ruthless dragon-slaying and try out some new methods.

titles.title: How to train your dragon - The hidden world
titles.sortTitle: how to train your dragon - the hidden world
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure sequel based on the children's novel by Cressida Cowell. Now ruling over Berk as village chief, Hiccup (voice of Jay Baruchel) has allowed for dragons and humans to happily co-exist in the same land, but things take a strange turn when the enigmatic female white dragon Light Fury captures Toothless's attention. As he clumsily sets out to impress her with the hope of becoming her mate, their budding romance is soon quashed by the arrival of a ruthless enemy who intends to invade Berk and capture all of the dragons. To save the fate of their kingdom and get the dragons to safety, Hiccup and Toothless venture out to the mythical Hidden World which dragons call home and where they may be able to summon their own army against the evil tyrants who threaten their new way of living.

titles.title: Howard Lovecraft and the frozen kingdom
titles.sortTitle: howard lovecraft and the frozen kingdom
titles.summary: Animated adventure written and directed by Sean Patrick O'Reilly. After visiting his father Winfield (voice of Tyler Nicol) in Arkham Sanitarium, young Howard Lovecraft (Kiefer O'Reilly) is ordered to destroy the Necronomicon, the legendary book of evil once held by his father. Ignoring the desperate plea, Howard instead begins to read the book and unwittingly opens a portal to a mysterious frozen world filled with vile creatures and untold danger. Alone and scared, Howard must do all he can to uncover the dark secrets of his strange new surroundings and find a way home. The cast also includes the voice talents of Ron Perlman, Doug Bradley and Christopher Plummer.

titles.title: Human flow
titles.summary: German documentary focusing on the current refugee crisis and the influx of people seeking sanctuary from all around the globe. With increasing pressures from war, political change or religious radicalisation, now more people than ever look to escape their dangerous surroundings and begin a new life away from persecution. Footage shows how aid workers receive the refugees and their reasons for fleeing their home countries.

titles.title: The hunger games: The ballad of songbirds and snakes
titles.sortTitle: hunger games: the ballad of songbirds and snakes
titles.summary: Tom Blyth and Rachel Zegler star in this action adventure prequel based on the novel by Suzanne Collins. Set 64 years before the events of 'The Hunger Games' (2012), 18-year-old Coriolanus Snow (Blyth) has earned a scholarship in a bid to restore his family's wealth by becoming a mentor for the tenth annual Hunger Games. Coriolanus has been assigned to mentor District 12 tribute Lucy (Zegler), who has been winning over the viewership with her beautiful singing and cunning tactics. As the games unfold however, Coriolanus desires to protect Lucy more than his role permits, leading him to go to extraordinary measures to ensure her success. The cast also includes Hunter Schafer, Jason Schwartzman and Peter Dinklage.

titles.title: Hustlers
titles.summary: Constance Wu, Jennifer Lopez and Julia Stiles star in this US drama based on the 'New York' magazine article 'The Hustlers at Scores' by Jessica Pressler. The film follows Dorothy, aka Destiny (Wu), as she begins working at New York strip club Moves. She is taken under the wing of veteran Ramona (Lopez), who shows Destiny how to profit from her new role. However, when the financial crash hits the club's business the following year, Ramona and her co-workers begin robbing their wealthy Wall Street clientele with an elaborate scheme that quickly spirals out of control.

titles.title: I am not a witch
titles.summary: Debut feature from writer and director Rungano Nyoni. The film follows nine-year-old Zambian Shula (Maggie Mulubwa) as she is exiled to a witch camp after one of her fellow villagers claims she is a witch. There, she is caught up in the schemes of camp manager Tembo (John Tembo) and told that if she tries to leave she will be turned into a goat. As others try to exploit her and tourists arrive to gawk at the witches, Shula must decide whether to try and escape or resign herself to life in the witch camp.

titles.title: I feel pretty
titles.summary: Amy Schumer stars in this American comedy about a woman who begins to view herself differently after an accident. After sustaining a head injury in a freak accident at the gym, Renee Barrett (Schumer), wakes up believing she is the most beautiful woman in the world. Banishing her low self-esteem, deep insecurity and feelings of inadequacy, Renee begins living life to the fullest with a new sense of empowerment, from picking up guys to seeking a job promotion at a New York fashion company. Although her perceived transformation gives her a new-found confidence and assuredness, how will Renee cope when she realises it's only the way she sees herself that has changed? The cast also includes Michelle Williams, Emily Ratajkowski, Busy Philipps and Naomi Campbell.

titles.title: I swear
titles.summary: Kirk Jones directs this biographical comedy drama following the life of Tourette syndrome sufferer and campaigner John Davidson (Robert Aramayo). As a young boy, John (Scott Ellis Watson) and his family knew there was something different about him. After being diagnosed with Tourette syndrome in the 1980s, a condition about which little was known at that time, he set about making as much noise as possible to create more awareness of the condition. The cast also includes Shirley Henderson, Maxine Peake and Peter Mullan.

titles.title: I, Daniel Blake
titles.summary: Ken Loach directs this drama that follows a 59-year-old joiner as he tries to navigate the British benefits system. In the North-East of England, widower Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is forced to stop working when he is taken ill with heart disease and so applies for Employment and Support Allowance from the Government. But his life is further thrown into disarray when his benefits are suddenly taken away from him and he is forced to jump through the many hoops of the bureaucratic system to get them back. During this time, he meets the similarly-troubled single mother Katie (Hayley Squires) whose financial problems mean she is being forced out of her home in London along with her two kids Dylan and Daisy (Dylan McKiernan and Briana Shann). The film was nominated for five BAFTAs including Best Film, Best Director (Loach), Best Original Screenplay and Best Supporting Actress (Squires) and won the award for Outstanding British Film of the Year.

titles.title: I'll be next door for Christmas
titles.sortTitle: i'll be next door for christmas
titles.summary: American family comedy set during the Christmas holidays. When her boyfriend is due to visit during Christmas, Nicky (Juliette Angelo) hires actors to portray her parents because she is embarrassed by how over-the-top they act during the holidays. However, when the hired actors don't get along her ploy seems destined to fail...

titles.title: I'm so excited
titles.summary: Pedro Almodóvar writes and directs this Spanish comedy which follows the actions of a group of airline passengers who decide to cast decorum aside when they realise their jet is in trouble. After discovering a fault in the aircraft's landing gear shortly after take-off, a Peninsula Airways jet bound for Mexico City is kept in a holding pattern above Madrid. As the authorities on the ground try to solve the problem, the remaining business class passengers - those in economy having been drugged by the crew - try to calm their nerves by embarking on a frenzied and debauched course of sex and drugs, aided by three flight attendants.

titles.title: Ice Age
titles.summary: At the dawn of the great ice age, a group of three animals embark upon an epic journey. Sid the sloth, Manfred the mammal, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger team up to help return a human baby to its father, and must risk life and limb as they traverse boiling lava pits and travel through dangerous ice caves to complete their mission. Along the way they also meet Scrat, a squirrel-rat determined to plant an acorn in a glacier. Features the voices of John Leguizamo, Denis Leary and Jack Black.

titles.title: Ice age: Collision course
titles.summary: Fifth instalment of the CGI-animated comedy adventure franchise. When Scrat (voice of Chris Wedge), still determined to get his elusive acorn, finds himself catapulted into outer space, he crashes his craft which sets off a series of catastrophic cosmic events that threaten the future of planet Earth. As an asteroid hits Earth, Manny (Ray Romano), Ellie (Queen Latifah), Sid (John Leguizamo), Diego (Denis Leary) and the gang decide to pack up their things and move as far away as possible from the falling boulders. As they embark on an epic journey to find a new home, they come across some new and exciting sights as well as some interesting characters. The voice cast also includes Melissa Rauch, Jennifer Lopez, Simon Pegg and Adam DeVine.

titles.title: Ice age: Continental drift
titles.summary: Fourth instalment of the CGI-animated comedy adventure franchise. When the entire continent is set adrift following a global cataclysm, Manny (voice of Ray Romano), Diego (Denis Leary) and Sid (John Leguizamo) find themselves separated from the rest of the herd. Commandeering a nearby iceberg as a makeshift boat, they take to the high seas. Fearsome sea creatures and battlethirsty pirates are among the challenges faced by the intrepid trio as they ride the waves of the world in search of their family. The voice cast also includes Peter Dinklage, Jennifer Lopez and Queen Latifah.

titles.title: The ice princess
titles.summary: German animation about an adventurous dragon known as Tabaluga (voice of Wincent Weiss) who relies on the importance of friendship, especially his bond with Princess Lily (Yvonne Catterfeld), to stay safe from the clutches of evil snowman Arktos (Heinz Hoenig).

titles.title: Ida
titles.summary: Pawel Pawlikowski directs this award-winning Polish drama set in a convent in the 1960s. When Anna (Agata Trzebuchowska), an orphan who was brought up by the nuns of the convent, decides she wants to take her vows, she is told that first she must visit her only living relative, Wanda (Agata Kulesza). As Wanda reveals to Anna that her real name is Ida Lebenstein and that she is actually Jewish, Anna starts to rethink her whole life. As the two go on a journey to find out more about their ancestors they reveal certain facts that were best left hidden. The film won a BAFTA for Best Film Not in the English Language and the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

titles.title: IF
titles.summary: Ryan Reynolds and Cailey Fleming star in this live-action/animated family comedy written and directed by John Krasinski. Struggling after the death of her mother, 12-year-old Bea (Fleming) gains the ability to see people's abandoned imaginary friends, known as IFs, and is moved to help them. She joins forces with her neighbour Cal (Reynolds), who shares the ability, in an attempt to reunite the IFs with the children who created and loved them but later forgot them. The cast also includes the voice talents of Steve Carell, Phoebe Waller-Bridge and Emily Blunt.

titles.title: If -
titles.summary: Allegorical drama from director Lindsay Anderson in which a group of non-conformist students lead a revolt against their oppressive masters at an English private school. Parallels are drawn in the film between the bullying, inflexible and snobbish approach of the schoolmasters to their pupils, led by the rebellious Mick Travis (Malcolm McDowell), and the dysfunction and injustice of the British class system at large. As Mick and his gang of cohorts indulge in acts of petty disobedience, such as heading into town to try and seduce a local waitress, the school's acts of retribution, led by Rowntree (Robert Swann), become increasingly cruel and malicious. Finally, the students are provoked into open rebellion, the bloody nature of which shocked a number of commentators at the time and led to claims that the film aimed to provoke a violent uprising in society as a whole.

titles.title: If Beale Street could talk
titles.summary: American romantic drama based on the novel by James Baldwin. After falling in love and getting engaged, Tish (KiKi Layne) and Fonny (Stephan James) have their world turned upside down when Tish finds out she is pregnant. Despite being only nineteen years old, Tish's family offer to support her in the bringing up of their child. Soon after, Fonny is falsely accused of a crime and sent to prison, raising uncertainty over his presence at the birth of his child. Determined to have Fonny freed, Tish and her family set out to prove his innocence while Tish attempts to keep up Fonny's spirits with the promise of their eventual reunion. Will Fonny make it out of jail to be with his fiancée and child?

titles.title: Illumination presents: 3-movie collection
titles.summary: Triple collection of animated comedies from Illumination. In 'Sing' (2016), Buster Moon (voice of Matthew McConaughey) is the highly optimistic koala proprietor of a venerable theatre. But as the splendour of his theatre begins to fade and Buster's life ambition with it, he must quickly devise a way to save his playhouse. Despite the reservations of his sheep friend Eddie (John C. Reilly), Buster decides to hold a singing contest in the hopes of raising enough money and attention to save his ailing theatre. With most of the town signing up to take part, the most promising contestants are Rosita (Reese Witherspoon), an overworked pig housewife, Mike (Seth MacFarlane), an arrogant, larger-than-life mouse, Ashley (Scarlett Johansson), a punk-rock porcupine, Meena (Tori Kelly), a stage-frightened elephant, and Johnny (Taron Egerton), a British gorilla pressured by his father's criminal exploits. How will they fare? And will Buster be able to save his theatre? 'The Secret Life of Pets' (2016) follows the adventures had by a group of New York pets after their owners leave the house. Pampered terrier Max (Louis C.K.) is shocked when his owner brings home a huge, sloppy mongrel named Duke (Eric Stonestreet) from the dog pound. An intense rivalry quickly sparks between the two pets, with a jealous Max desperate to regain the attention he once had. However, the duo must put their differences to one side when cunning rabbit Snowball (Kevin Hart) begins to build an army of neglected ex-pets intent on getting revenge on all happily-owned pets and their owners. With the help of the other animals in his Manhattan building, Max must put a stop to Snowball's evil schemes before it's too late. Finally, 'Despicable Me' (2010) follows an arch-criminal who has a change of heart. Trying to outdo his main rival Vector (Jason Segel), serial villain Gru (Steve Carell) hatches a plan to steal the moon, aided by his army of genetically altered corn pops. About to set his dastardly plan in motion, and bristling with his arsenal of freeze-rays and sci-fi gadgetry, all goes according to plan until the arrival at his door of three little orphan girls, Margo (Miranda Cosgrove), Agnes (Elsie Fisher) and Edith (Dana Gaier), in search of a father figure.

titles.title: The impossible
titles.summary: Ewan McGregor and Naomi Watts star in this Academy Award-nominated disaster drama set in Thailand during the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami. Henry and Maria (McGregor and Watts) are spending their Christmas holidays relaxing in a Thai resort with their three sons, Lucas (Tom Holland), Thomas (Samuel Joslin) and Simon (Oaklee Pendergast), when the deadly wave crashes through the hotel complex where they are staying. All five members of the family are swept away, and Maria and Lucas manage to stay together and to keep above the water. Once the water settles, the badly-injured mother and son begin a frantic search for the missing members of their family, but it soon becomes apparent that Maria is desperately ill and must be given medical help as quickly as possible.

titles.title: An impossible love
titles.summary: Catherine Corsini co-writes and directs this French drama starring Virginie Efira and Niels Schneider. In 1960 small-town office worker Rachel (Efira) falls in love with the bourgeois Parisian Phillipe (Schneider) and the pair begins a passionate relationship. However, Phillipe refuses to marry her because of her lower social standing and when Rachel falls pregnant with his baby he abandons her, leaving her to raise their daughter Chantal (Jehnny Beth/Estelle Lescure/Ambre Hasaj/Sasha Alessandri-Torrès Garcia) alone. When Phillipe returns decades later, seeking a relationship with his daughter, his sudden reappearance threatens to throw all of their lives into disarray.

titles.title: In a lonely place
titles.summary: Nicholas Ray directs this film noir adaptation of the novel by Dorothy B. Hughes starring Humphrey Bogart and Gloria Grahame. Troubled screenwriter Dixon Steele (Bogart) is given the opportunity to reinvigorate his failing career by creating a film adaptation of a trashy novel. After balking at the thought of actually reading it, Dixon hires Mildred (Martha Stewart), who he meets in a bar, to summarise the novel for him. They leave the bar together but when Mildred is found murdered the next day Dixon is the prime suspect. His only forthcoming alibi is from Laurel Gray (Grahame), who testifies to his innocence out of affection, rather than truth. As the pair fall helplessly in love, Laurel is haunted by the possibility that Dixon was the murderer.

titles.title: In between
titles.summary: Israeli drama directed by Maysaloun Hamoud and starring Mouna Hawa, Sana Jammelieh and Shaden Kanboura. The film follows Layla (Hawa), Salma (Jammelieh) and Nour (Kanboura), three Palestinian women living in the heart of Tel Aviv who lead complex lives while occupying an uneasy position within their predominantly Jewish society. Independent lawyer Layla refuses to compromise on her underground lifestyle, gay DJ Salma maintains a facade of propriety in the presence of her conservative Christian family and traditionally educated Muslim girl Nour is studying for a degree at Tel Aviv University. Despite their varied backgrounds and lifestyles, they each share their minority position in their society as well as their struggle to find romantic partners capable of accepting their complex lives.

titles.title: In safe hands
titles.summary: Jeanne Herry writes and directs this French drama starring Sandrine Kiberlain, Gilles Lellouche and Élodie Bouchez. After Clara (Leïla Muse) decides to put her newborn baby up for adoption, social workers Karine (Kiberlain), Jean (Lellouche), Alice (Bouchez) and Mathilde (Clotilde Mollet) are tasked with finding the child a suitable home. Over a three-month period, they work together to decide what is best for the baby's future and find the best possible adoptive parent.

titles.title: In the Earth
titles.summary: British horror written and directed by Ben Wheatley. As a deadly virus decimates the Earth, scientist Martin Lowery (Joel Fry) is sent to a forest outside Bristol to research crops efficiency, building on work conducted by his former lover Olivia Wendle (Hayley Squires) before her recent disappearance. As he makes his way through the forest Martin and his guide, Alma (Ellora Torchia), discover evils lurking in the woods that threaten both of their lives...

titles.title: In the heights
titles.summary: Anthony Ramos, Corey Hawkins and Leslie Grace star in this adaptation of the Broadway musical created by Lin-Manuel Miranda. In the diverse Manhattan neighbourhood of Washington Heights, bodega owner Usnavi de la Vega (Ramos) dreams of returning to his native Dominican Republic to restore his late father's bar while attempting to romance Vanessa (Melissa Barrera), who works at the local nail salon but aspires to become a fashion designer downtown. Meanwhile, college student Nina (Grace) returns home from Stanford University with some stunning news and Usnavi discovers he has sold a winning lottery ticket.

titles.title: In the night garden: Hello Iggle Piggle
titles.sortTitle: in the night garden: hello iggle piggle

titles.title: In the night garden: Where's Upsy Daisy gone?
titles.sortTitle: in the night garden: where's upsy daisy gone?
titles.summary: Five episodes of the CBeebies preschool series which takes children on an imaginative journey through a night garden and its eccentric residents. Created by Andrew Davenport, co-creator of 'Teletubbies', and narrated by Derek Jacobi, the show features a host of funny and lovable characters including Upsy Daisy (voice of Rebecca Hyland), Igglepiggle (Nick Kellington), Makka Pakka (Justyn Towler) as well as the Tombliboos, the Pontipines and the Haahoos. The episodes are: 'Where's Upsy Daisy Gone', 'Upsy Daisy's Tiring Walk', 'The Wottingers Hiding Game', 'The Pontipine Children in the Tombliboos' Trousers' and 'Hurry Up Tombliboos'.

titles.title: In the night garden: Windy day in the garden
titles.sortTitle: in the night garden: windy day in the garden
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the CBeebies preschool series which takes children on an imaginative journey through a night garden and its eccentric residents. Created by Andrew Davenport and narrated by Derek Jacobi, the show features a host of funny and lovable characters including Upsy Daisy, Igglepiggle, Makka Pakka, the Tombliboos, the Pontipines and the Haahoos. The episodes are: 'Windy Day in the Garden', 'Upsy Daisy Forgets Her Stone', 'Long and Ponky Ride On the Pinky Ponk', 'High and Low' and 'What Loud Music Tombliboos!'.

titles.title: The incredible journey
titles.summary: Classic family adventure set against the majesty of the Canadian wilderness. The film tells the story of three beloved animals in search of their home and family. Two dogs and a cat - Bodget, Luath, and Tao - are left with a loving friend 200 miles away from home. But they miss their human family. So they leave only to find their way home full of danger. A lynx, a mean farm dog, and a fiercely protective mother bear are among the obstacles in their treacherous path.

titles.title: Indiana Jones and the dial of destiny
titles.sortTitle: indiana jones and the dial of destiny
titles.summary: Harrison Ford reprises his role as the eponymous archaeologist and adventurer in this fifth instalment of the action adventure franchise. In 1944, Indiana Jones and Basil Shaw (Toby Jones) cross paths with Jürgen Voller (Mads Mikkelsen), a Nazi scientist seeking both halves of the Archimedes Dial which, if whole, gives its wielder power over space and time. 25 years later, Jones is being forced into retirement, while Voller is working for NASA under an assumed name. Voller's dream to unite the two halves of the Dial and reintroduce Nazism to the world endures, and only Jones and his goddaughter, Helena (Phoebe Waller-Bridge), stand in Voller's way.

titles.title: The informer
titles.summary: British crime drama starring Joel Kinnaman, Rosamund Pike and Clive Owen. The film follows ex-convict and former soldier Pete Koslow (Kinnaman) as he infiltrates New York's Polish mafia while working as an informant for the FBI. After a drug deal goes wrong, Pete finds himself back in jail, where he is tasked with taking over the prison's drug operation by his boss, The General (Eugene Lipinski). Pete's FBI handlers, Agents Wilcox and Montgomery (Pike and Owen), insist he goes along with The General's plan, in the hope of finally landing the head of the cartel. But back in prison, Pete is left isolated and forced to fight for his life as events threaten to reveal his true identity.

titles.title: Ingrid goes west
titles.summary: Aubrey Plaza and Elizabeth Olsen star in this dark comedy directed and co-written by Matt Spicer. Social media obsessed Ingrid Thorburn (Plaza) spends her days stalking unsuspecting people on the Internet. When she discovers Taylor Sloane (Olsen) who appears to have the perfect life, Ingrid quickly develops an obsession for the so-called influencer, even relocating her life to California just to be near her. As she manages to worm her way into Taylor's life by returning her escaped dog, Ingrid becomes determined to make Taylor her new best friend. The cast also includes O'Shea Jackson Jr., Wyatt Russell and Billy Magnussen.

titles.title: Inland empire
titles.summary: Laura Dern stars in this surrealist psychological thriller written and directed by David Lynch. Actress Nikki Grace (Dern)'s new role tests her to her limits. She soon finds herself falling for her co-star Devon Berk (Justin Theroux) while the film's director Kingsley Stewart (Jeremy Irons) is a cloying, creepy character but, far worse, the production is apparently cursed. An earlier attempt to make the film in Poland ended in tragedy when the two leads were murdered. As Grace begins to take on some of the personality traits of her character, she has trouble distinguishing between real life and film, while the Phantom (Krzysztof Majchrzak) dogs her every step.

titles.title: The innocent
titles.summary: Italian director Luchino Visconti's last film is an understated melodrama set at the turn of the century and follows a gentleman of leisure who indulges all his own whims but is shaken to his core when he discovers his wife is having an affair.

titles.title: Insecure: The complete first season
titles.summary: The complete first season of the US comedy created by and starring Issa Rae. The show follows African-Americans Issa (Rae) and Molly (Yvonne Orji) as they navigate life and love in Los Angeles and explore all that the world has to offer for modern African-American females. The show begins with Issa turning 29, working for a non-profit organisation that helps African-American schoolkids and encountering difficulties with her long-term boyfriend Lawrence (Jay Ellis). Molly, on the other hand, is flying high as a corporate lawyer but struggling to find the right guy to settle down with. The episodes are: 'Insecure As F***', 'Messy As F***', 'Racist As F***', 'Thirsty As F***', 'Shady As F***', 'Guilty As F***', 'Real As F***' and 'Broken As F***'.

titles.title: Inside
titles.summary: Guy Pearce and Cosmo Jarvis star in this Australian drama written and directed by Charles Williams. After he is transferred from juvenile detention to a maximum security prison, 18-year-old Mel Blight (Vincent Miller) meets two older inmates: the notoriously violent and dangerous Mark Shepard (Jarvis) and jaded Warren Murfett (Pearce), who is due to be released shortly. However, Warren has debts to pay and soon Mel becomes part of a plot to murder Mark. The cast also includes Toby Wallace and Tammy MacIntosh.

titles.title: Inside out
titles.summary: Award-winning animated comedy drama from Disney/Pixar featuring the voice talents of Amy Poehler, Phyllis Smith, Bill Hader, Lewis Black and Mindy Kaling. When eleven-year-old Riley (Kaitlyn Dias) is forced to relocate to San Francisco after her dad gets a new job, she has trouble adjusting to her new surroundings. Her emotions - Joy (Poehler), Sadness (Smith), Fear (Hader), Anger (Black) and Disgust (Kaling) - that reside in Headquarters, the control centre of her mind, try to help her navigate her way through the big change. However, after a slight mishap at Headquarters, the situation gets out of hand, causing Riley's emotional state to worsen. Will the five emotions be able to restore order and make Riley feel better about her new life? The voice cast also includes Richard Kind, Diane Lane, Kyle MacLachlan and Frank Oz.

titles.title: Inside out 2
titles.summary: Amy Poehler and Phyllis Smith reprise their roles in this animated sequel from Disney/Pixar. When Riley (voice of Kensington Tallman) turns 13, her core emotions - Joy (Poehler), Sadness (Smith), Fear (Tony Hale), Anger (Lewis Black) and Disgust (Liza Lapira) - are thrown into chaos by the arrival of four new emotions. Envy (Ayo Edebiri), Ennui (Adèle Exarchopoulos) and Embarrassment (Paul Walter Hauser) enter Headquarters led by Anxiety (Maya Hawke), who brings stress and disruption into Riley's life. When Riley attends a hockey skills camp, the escalating clash between Joy and Anxiety leads to the imprisonment of Riley's original emotions. As Riley loses her sense of self, can the five emotions escape their confinement and prevent Anxiety from overwhelming Riley? The voice cast also includes Diane Lane and Kyle MacLachlan.

titles.title: The intern
titles.summary: Robert De Niro and Anne Hathaway star in this comedy from film-maker Nancy Meyers. When Ben Whittaker (De Niro), a 70-year-old widower, becomes bored with retired life he decides to return to work, seeking an internship at an online fashion company, owned by Jules Ostin (Hathaway), that runs a senior intern programme. Ben gets the position and as he adjusts to his new surroundings he makes a good impression on his new boss with whom he forms an unlikely friendship.

titles.title: Interstellar
titles.summary: Sci-fi thriller written and directed by Christopher Nolan. On a resource-depleted Earth in the near future, the discovery of a wormhole which can transport users through time and space unites scientists and explorers in the most important mission in human history. Among the potential travellers is a widowed engineer (Matthew McConaughey) who must decide whether to remain with his two children or to test the limits of human space travel, to see if there is a future for humanity out among the stars or whether the end of the Earth spells the end for humanity. The cast includes Jessica Chastain, Michael Caine and Anne Hathaway.

titles.title: Introduction To Jazz Guitar
titles.summary: Helps understand and master the essential concepts and techniques of jazz.

titles.title: The invisible man
titles.summary: Elisabeth Moss and Oliver Jackson-Cohen star in this modern horror adaptation of the novel by H.G. Wells. When Cecilia (Moss)'s abusive husband allegedly takes his own life, she celebrates that she is finally free from him. However, when she starts to experience strange goings on around the house, she begins to wonder whether her husband could have faked his death and found a way to make himself invisible. The cast also includes Aldis Hodge, Michael Dorman and Storm Reid.

titles.title: The invite
titles.summary: Olivia Wilde directs and stars in this comedy drama alongside Seth Rogen, Penélope Cruz and Edward Norton. Joe and Angela (Rogen and Wilde)'s marriage isn't what it used to be and they begin to confront their problems. When they invite their neighbours Piña and Hawk (Cruz and Norton) to dinner, they quickly discover what keeps their relationship alive, but are they willing to try something new to reignite their own flame?

titles.title: The iron claw
titles.summary: Sean Durkin writes and directs this biographical drama based on the lives of the Von Erich brothers. Kevin Von Erich (Zac Efron) proves to be a promising talent in the world of professional wrestling and his father, WCCW owner Fritz (Holt McCallany), is keen to push his other sons to follow in their footsteps. After David (Harris Dickinson), Kerry (Jeremy Allen White) and Mike (Stanley Simons) have each made their wrestling debuts and live up to the family name, a series of tragedies strike which threaten to tear them apart. As Kevin's career reaches new heights, his family are forced to fight their toughest battles yet.

titles.title: The iron giant: Signature edition
titles.summary: Remastered version of Brad Bird's animated classic featuring two new scenes. In 1957, a gigantic iron man crash lands from outer space in Rockwell, Maine. After reassembling itself, the giant is discovered by nine-year-old Hogarth Hughes (voice of Eli Marienthal), who helps it to conceal itself while feeding on scrapyard cars. Hogarth is assisted by beatnik Dean McCoppin (Harry Connick Jr), unaware that government agent Kent Mansley (Christopher McDonald) is already on the trail of what he regards as an 'alien invader'.

titles.title: Irvine Welsh: Reality is not enough
titles.sortTitle: irvine welsh: reality is not enough
titles.summary: Paul Sng directs this documentary which chronicles the life and career of Scottish novelist Irvine Welsh. As Welsh reflects on his life and how his experiences have influenced his writing, Liam Neeson, Stephen Graham, Maxine Peake, Nick Cave and Ruth Negga narrate excerpts from his novels which include 'Trainspotting' (1993), 'Filth' (1998) and 'Porno' (2002).

titles.title: Is this thing on?
titles.summary: Will Arnett and Laura Dern star in this comedy drama co-written and directed by Bradley Cooper. As Alex and Tess Novak (Arnett and Dern) navigate the end of their marriage and their decision to divorce, Alex discovers a passion for stand-up comedy. Whilst seeing other people and rediscovering themselves, they learn how to co-parent their two children and are eventually forced to face the truth about their feelings for each other. The cast also includes Andra Day, Sean Hayes and Ciarán Hinds.

titles.title: Isle of dogs
titles.summary: American stop-motion animation directed by Wes Anderson in which future Japan sees itself overrun by packs of dogs which are beginning to spread disease to humans. A mayor's solution is to exile every dog to an island filled with toxic waste and rubbish, where they will live out their days away from civilisation. When a young boy is devastated to find his dog is missing, he flies a plane to the island where he enlists the help of its inhabitants to track him down. As the dogs become frustrated with their new home, they formulate a plan to get off the island and back to the mainland. The cast includes the voice talents of Bryan Cranston, Edward Norton, Bill Murray, Jeff Goldblum and Scarlett Johansson.

titles.title: It
titles.summary: Bill Skarsgård stars as Pennywise the clown in this adaptation of Stephen King's novel directed by Andrés Muschietti. In Derry, Maine, in the late 1980s, a group of seven childhood friends, known as The Losers Club, unite to combat a mysterious threat which their cursed town had thought was long since buried. After his little brother Georgie (Jackson Robert Scott) disappears, along with several more of the town's youngsters, Bill Denbrough (Jaeden Liberher) gathers his group of outsider friends together to search for clues. Their quest eventually leads them to fight back against the shape-shifting, supernatural predator lurking in the shadows of their town and preying on children's innermost fears, manifesting itself as a killer clown called Pennywise.

titles.title: It ends with us
titles.summary: Blake Lively stars in this drama based on the novel by Colleen Hoover. When florist Lily Bloom (Lively) meets neurosurgeon Ryle Kincaid (Justin Baldoni), she soon falls in love. However, Ryle is far from perfect and after Lily unexpectedly crosses paths with her high school sweetheart Atlas Corrigan (Brandon Sklenar), Ryle's behaviour towards her worsens. When she learns that she is pregnant, Lily has a difficult choice to make. The cast also includes Jenny Slate, Hasan Minhaj and Amy Morton.

titles.title: It's a sin
titles.summary: British drama miniseries set in London during the 1980s at the onset of the AIDS crisis. Three young gay men, Ritchie (Olly Alexander), Roscoe (Omari Douglas) and Colin (Callum Scott Howells), newly moved to London rent a flat together that they subsequently dub the Pink Palace. However, as a mystery illness gathers pace they each suffer identity crises as they try to make sense of what is going on around them.

titles.title: It's a wonderful life
titles.summary: Frank Capra directs this heartwarming Christmas fantasy. George Bailey (James Stewart) has spent his entire life in the small town of Bedford Falls. Despite his yearning to see the world, George has always sacrificed his personal ambitions for the sake of his family and the local community, settling down to marry his childhood sweetheart, Mary (Donna Reed), and raise a family. However, when a huge amount of money goes missing from his savings and loans company he panics and finds himself preparing to commit suicide. He is shown the error of this idea by Clarence (Henry Travers), an angel who has been sent to Earth in order to earn his wings. To this end, Clarence shows George just how badly Bedford Falls and its residents would have turned out had he never been born.

titles.title: Jackie Brown
titles.summary: Quentin Tarantino writes and directs this crime drama starring Pam Grier in the title role. Air stewardess Jackie Brown smuggles money on the side for gunrunner Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson). When she is caught with $50,000 and a consignment of cocaine, she makes a deal with Ordell that if convicted, she will not give him up as long as he pays her $100,000. Meanwhile Jackie also makes a deal with the cops, promising to help convict Ordell and enlists the help of bail bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster) in a daring attempt to outwit both the police and Ordell.

titles.title: Jamaica Inn
titles.summary: Alfred Hitchcock directed this adaptation of the Daphne du Maurier novel - his last British film - before leaving for Hollywood and a contract with David O. Selznick. Young orphan Mary (Maureen O'Hara) arrives in 18th century Cornwall to live with her Uncle Joss (Leslie Banks), the landlord of Jamaica Inn. After finding work as a barmaid, Mary discovers that Joss commands a band of pirates who smuggle contraband from wrecked ships. Mary is further unnerved by the ever-present Justice of the Peace, Sir Humphrey Pengallan (Charles Laughton).

titles.title: Jane Austen wrecked my life
titles.summary: Camille Rutherford stars in this French romantic comedy written and directed by Laura Piani. Agathe (Rutherford) is a lonely bookseller in Paris who has just begun writing her first romance novel. When she is given the opportunity to attend the Jane Austen Residency, a writing retreat in England, she is initially reluctant, but it could be the spark she needs to find her voice and achieve her dreams. However, in the process of attending she finds herself torn between two men, her best friend and co-worker Félix (Pablo Pauly) and Oliver (Charlie Anson), a literature professor. The cast also includes Annabelle Lengronne, Liz Crowther and Alan Fairbairn.

titles.title: Jiro dreams of sushi
titles.summary: Japanese documentary about Michelin three-star sushi restaurant Sukiyabashi Jiro, located in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and its 85-year-old owner Jiro Ono. While Jiro works endlessly, committed to producing the perfect sushi, his son Yoshikazu prepares to take over his father's small but world famous restaurant.

titles.title: Joana Mallwitz: Momentum
titles.summary: Documentary looking at the life and career of conductor Joana Mallwitz who broke down boundaries and stereotypes to become the youngest general music director in all of Europe before being named chief conductor of Konzerthausorchester Berlin in 2023.

titles.title: Joker
titles.summary: Joaquin Phoenix stars as the DC Comics supervillain in this crime drama directed by Todd Phillips. Set in 1981, the film follows Arthur Fleck (Phoenix), a mentally ill professional clown who aspires to be a stand-up comedian and lives with his elderly mother (Frances Conroy) in Gotham City. When he is fired from his job, Arthur begins a violent descent into madness that culminates in his rebirth as Gotham's clown prince of crime. The cast also includes Robert De Niro, Zazie Beetz and Brett Cullen.

titles.title: Joker: Folie á deux
titles.summary: Joaquin Phoenix reprises his role in this sequel to the 2019 thriller based on the character created by DC Comics. While struggling to come to terms with his dual identity, Arthur Fleck aka Joker (Phoenix) meets Lee Quinzel (Lady Gaga) during his incarceration at Arkham State Hospital. Together, the unlikely duo find mutual interests giving Joker what he has always desired: love.

titles.title: Journey 2 - the mysterious island
titles.summary: Josh Hutcherson, Dwayne Johnson and Vanessa Hudgens star in this action adventure sequel to 'Journey to the Center of the Earth' (2008). After receiving a radio transmission from his missing grandfather (Michael Caine), Sean Anderson (Hutcherson) sets out on a journey with his mother's boyfriend, Hank (Johnson), to an uncharted island he believes may be the same one Jules Verne wrote a book about. Along the way they meet pilot Gabato (Luis Guzmán) and the attractive Kailani (Hudgens) who Sean soon falls for. As they explore the island they come across many wonders and encounter some deadly creatures. When the island looks set to self-destruct, the adventurers must race against time to find a way back to safety.

titles.title: Journey to the center of the Earth
titles.sortTitle: journey to the center of the earth
titles.summary: Fantasy adventure directed by Henry Levin, starring James Mason and Pat Boone. The film follows newly-knighted science professor Sir Oliver Lindenbrook (Mason) as he discovers a message left by a long-dead Icelandic scientist claiming to have discovered a means to reach the very centre of the Earth. Along with his assistant Alec McEwan (Boone), Lindenbrook sets out to find the reputed path, deep in an Icelandic volcano, and encounters the widow of a scientist recently murdered during his attempt at finding the path. As they descend into the heart of the Earth they encounter wonders beyond their imagining, but unknown to them, they are being pursued by a devious scientist determined to hoard the subterranean wonders for himself.

titles.title: Joy ride
titles.summary: American comedy from film-maker Adele Lim starring Ashley Park, Sherry Cola, Stephanie Hsu and Sabrina Wu. Audrey (Park), an adopted Asian-American lawyer, is headed for China on a high-stakes business trip with her childhood best friend Lolo (Cola) acting as translator. However, Audrey reaches a stumbling block with her challenging client, who asks Audrey to find her birth mother so that she can confirm her true identity. With Lolo's cousin Deadeye (Wu) and college roommate Kat (Hsu) also in tow, Audrey's mission is derailed when the four women are suddenly thrust into a criminal's scheme which sees them sent on a far-flung adventure across the country.

titles.title: Judas and the black messiah
titles.summary: Shaka King co-writes and directs this US biographical drama starring Daniel Kaluuya and LaKeith Stanfield. In 1960s Chicago, car thief William O'Neal (Stanfield) becomes an informant for the FBI and is tasked with infiltrating the Illinois chapter of the Black Panther Party and bringing down its charismatic leader, 21-year-old Fred Hampton (Kaluuya). The cast also includes Jesse Plemons, Martin Sheen and Lil Rel Howery.

titles.title: Judy
titles.summary: Renée Zellweger stars in the title role of this biopic centred on the later life and career of Judy Garland. As her private life descends into chaos with child custody issues, financial trouble and an escalating drug habit, Judy moves to London to reinvent herself and give her career one final shot. As her insecurities around her age and her deteriorating health begin to overwhelm her however, Judy must find the strength needed to make her big comeback.

titles.title: Juliet and Romeo
titles.summary: Clara Rugaard and Jamie Ward star as the eponymous ill-fated lovers in this musical adaptation of the play by William Shakespeare. The Montague and Capulet families are embroiled in a long-running feud and are also fighting amongst themselves. When Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet meet at the market one night, they fall in love, but bloodshed and tragedy threaten their future together. The cast also includes Rebel Wilson, Jason Isaacs and Derek Jacobi.

titles.title: Julieta
titles.summary: Pedro Almodóvar directs this Spanish drama based on the short stories 'Chance', 'Soon' and 'Silence' from Alice Munro's book 'Runaway'. When recently widowed Julieta (Emma Suárez) discovers that her 18-year-old daughter Antía (Blanca Parés) has run away, she vows to put aside her grief for her late husband and do everything she can to find her daughter. The more she searches, however, the more Julieta realises she doesn't know Antía very well at all.

titles.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the jungle
titles.summary: Jake Kasdan directs this sequel to the 1995 film 'Jumanji'. When four teenagers - Spencer (Alex Wolff), Anthony 'Fridge' Johnson (Ser'Darius Blain), Bethany (Madison Iseman) and Martha (Morgan Turner) - suffer the punishments of detention by cleaning out their school's basement, they discover a vintage video game called 'Jumanji'. As they select their avatars to play the game, they get sucked into the screen and find themselves living the jungle game as Dr. Smolder Bravestone (Dwayne Johnson), Franklin 'Moose' Finbar (Kevin Hart), Professor Shelly Oberon (Jack Black) and Ruby Roundhouse (Karen Gillan). As they get further into the jungle they learn that their only way home is to finish the game, and to finish the game they must survive everything the jungle throws at them.

titles.title: The jungle book (Disney)
titles.summary: Disney's animated adaptation of Rudyard Kipling's Mowgli stories. After being abandoned as a child, Mowgli (voice of Bruce Reitherman) is raised by wolves in the jungle. However, when news arrives that the murderous, man-hating tiger Shere Khan (George Sanders) has returned to their part of the jungle, Mowgli's friends Bagheera the black panther (Sebastian Cabot) and Baloo the bear (Phil Harris) decide to take a reluctant Mowgli to a nearby human village for his own safety. Their task is not made any easier when Mowgli is hypnotised by Kaa the python (Sterling Holloway) and is later kidnapped at the behest of the monkey leader King Louie (Louis Prima), who wishes to learn how to make fire...

titles.title: Jungle trouble
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. Max dreams of becoming a superhero and when he meets Zuzu the tiger in the jungle, he is determined to save him and the other jungle animals from the poachers hunting them. The poachers are certainly persistent but have they met their match in Max and his new friends?

holdings.status: On loan - Due: 16 Sep 2026; Long overdue (Set: 14 Oct 2026)

titles.title: Jurassic world
titles.summary: Fourth instalment in the blockbusting dinosaur series. 22 years after the events of 'Jurassic Park' (1993), Isla Nublar, located off the Pacific Coast of Central America, has been reopened as a dinosaur theme park. In order to boost attendance, operations manager Claire Dearing (Bryce Dallas Howard) asks the park's geneticists to create genetically modified hybrid dinosaurs - the latest product of their experimentation being the Indominus rex. But when the Indominus rex escapes and begins killing other dinosaurs for sport, it's left to park staff member and behavioural researcher Owen Grady (Chris Pratt) to clean up the mess. The supporting cast includes Vincent D'Onofrio, Jake Johnson, Nick Robinson, Ty Simpkins and Irrfan Khan.

titles.title: Jurassic world: Dominion
titles.summary: Colin Trevorrow directs this conclusion to the 'Jurassic Park' adventure series, set four years after the events of 'Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom' (2015) where dinosaurs were set free into the wild after the Lockwood estate incident. As dinosaurs now live alongside humans all over the world, Owen Grady (Chris Pratt) and Claire Dearing (Bryce Dallas Howard) are joined by Alan Grant (Sam Neill), Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) to try to determine whether the two species can live together in peace.

titles.title: Jurassic world: Rebirth
titles.summary: Scarlett Johansson, Mahershala Ali and Jonathan Bailey star in this seventh instalment of the sci-fi action adventure franchise directed by Gareth Edwards. Five years after the events of 'Jurassic World: Dominion' (2022) most of the world's surviving dinosaurs have settled in remote tropical regions. Mercenary Zora Bennett (Johansson) is recruited by a pharmaceutical company to obtain DNA from three different species of hybrid dinosaurs to further life-saving and lucrative medical research. She and her team travel to a remote island that once served as an InGen research facility where they soon encounter more than they bargained for. The cast also includes Rupert Friend, Manuel Garcia-Rulfo and Ed Skrein.

titles.title: Kangaroo
titles.summary: Ryan Corr stars in this Australian comedy directed by Kate Woods. When ambitious TV weather man Chris Masterman (Corr) goes viral for all the wrong reasons, he is fired and forced to leave Sydney. On his way to Broome he rescues an orphaned joey and meets Charlie (Lily Whiteley), a young girl grieving the loss of her father. Charlie loves kangaroos and cares for multiple orphaned joeys and as an unlikely friendship forms between the two of them, Chris finds his life completely changed. The cast also includes Rachel House, Deborah Mailman and Wayne Blair.

titles.title: Karate kid: Legends
titles.summary: Jackie Chan and Ralph Macchio reprise their roles in this sixth instalment of the martial arts drama franchise. Li Fong (Ben Wang) studies kung-fu under Mr. Han (Chan) but when his brother is killed after a fight, his mother decides they need to leave Beijing and kung-fu behind. They move to New York where Li struggles to fit in until he meets Mia (Sadie Stanley) and her father Victor (Joshua Jackson). However, Mia's former boyfriend Connor (Aramis Knight), a karate champion, will not leave Li alone. With Mr. Han's encouragement, Li decides it is time to face his past trauma and so he enters a tournament in which Connor will also be competing. With Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso (Macchio) training him together, can Li successfully blend their differing styles and emerge victorious? The cast also includes Ming-Na Wen, Wyatt Oleff and Tim Rozon.

titles.title: Katak: The brave beluga
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure following Katak (voice of Robert Naylor), a beluga whale living in the Arctic ocean who desperately wants to turn white instead of grey so that he can live with the other adult males. Hoping to prove himself to his pod, he leaves home and travels further north in search of his grandfather. Along the way, he encounters some dangerous creatures but also finds new friends.

titles.title: Katie Morag: Complete series 1
titles.summary: All episodes from the first series of the children's television programme which follows the life of Katie Morag (Cherry Campbell), a little girl who lives with her parents on the remote Scottish island of Struay. The episodes are: 'Katie Morag Delivers the Mail', 'Katie Morag and the Two Grandmothers', 'Katie Morag and the Old Teacher', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: The Big Smelly Goat', 'Katie Morag and the New Boy', 'Katie Morag and the Halloween Pirate', 'Katie Morag and Izzy', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: Stone Soup', 'Katie Morag and the Special Delivery', 'Katie Morag and the Tiresome Ted', 'Katie Morag and the Mysteries', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: Little Izzy', 'Katie Morag and the Two Peas', 'Katie Morag and the New Year Party', 'Katie Morag and the Baking Day Secret', 'Katie Morag and the Grumpy Grannie', 'Katie Morag and the Bad Boy Cousins', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: Grandpa's Bowl', 'Katie Morag and the Seals Singing', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: Annie Jessie and the Merboy', 'Katie Morag and the Hill Race', 'Grannie Island's Ceilidh: Hugh Handy', 'Katie Morag and the Big Picture', 'Katie Morag and the Brochan Bus', 'Katie Morag and the Wedding: Part 1' and 'Katie Morag and the Wedding: Part 2'.

titles.title: Keeper
titles.summary: Tatiana Maslany and Rossif Sutherland star in this supernatural horror thriller directed by Osgood Perkins. Liz and Malcolm (Maslany and Sutherland) travel to a secluded cabin in the woods for their first anniversary but their celebrations stall when Malcolm, a doctor, is called home due to an emergency. Liz soon begins to fear that she is not alone in the cabin and when she is confronted by something truly evil, she enters a desperate fight for her life. The cast also includes Birkett Turton, Eden Weiss and Claire Friesen.

titles.title: The keeper
titles.summary: Biographical sporting drama set in post-war Britain and based on the life of German goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, starring David Kross and Freya Mavor. After being captured on the Western Front, German soldier Bert Trautmann (Kross) is sent to a prisoner-of-war camp in Lancashire. When local football coach Jack Friar (John Henshaw) is looking to recruit some players for his struggling team he selects Trautmann as goalkeeper, much to his daughter Margaret (Mavor)'s annoyance. Despite her initial doubts about him Margaret soon falls in love with Bert. On the field Trautmann's impressive performances between the sticks quickly win over his team mates and after one season he is signed by Manchester City. As his profile grows Trautmann continues to face derision over his past but his resilience and the support of Margaret and his young family enable him to achieve sporting greatness. The cast also features Harry Melling, Dave Johns and Gary Lewis.

titles.title: Kensuke's kingdom
titles.summary: Animated adventure based on the novel by Michael Morpurgo following eleven-year-old Michael (voice of Aaron MacGregor) who finds himself shipwrecked on an island in the middle of nowhere. During a family sailing trip, they encounter bad weather and after Michael tries to rescue their dog, they both get washed overboard. As he explores his new home in search of food and water, Michael quickly realises he is not the only inhabitant of the mysterious island...

titles.title: Khumba: A zebra's tale
titles.summary: Anthony Silverston directs this animation featuring the voices of Jake T. Austin, Liam Neeson, Steve Buscemi and Richard E. Grant. Khumba (Austin), a zebra born with only half his stripes, is picked on and ridiculed by the members of his stripe-obsessed herd. When a drought is declared upon the Great Karoo, Khumba is blamed for bringing a curse to their land. After a mysterious creature appears in front of him showing a map leading to water, Khumba sees an opportunity to earn his stripes and sets off in search of a new life. When his path crosses that of Phango (Neeson), a superstitious, blind leopard, Phango reveals that he has been waiting a long time for Khumba because, according to an ancient myth, a half-striped zebra is destined to make Phango the most powerful hunter who ever lived.

titles.title: The kid who would be king
titles.summary: Joe Cornish writes and directs this fantasy adventure drama based on the legend of King Arthur. School boy Alex (Louis Ashbourne Serkis) is fed up of being picked on by bullies at his school. Everything changes however when one night, while being chased by the bullies, he encounters the sword of Excalibur. Alex at first doubts its origins, but when Merlin (Angus Imrie/Patrick Stewart) arrives he soon learns the truth about the sword and his own destiny. Meanwhile, the powerful sorceress Morgana (Rebecca Ferguson) is clawing her way back to the land of the living which spells disaster for the world and it is now up to Alex and his unlikely band of fellow knights to put a stop to her before it's too late.

titles.title: Kika
titles.summary: Spanish black comedy written and directed by Pedro Almodóvar. The film follows young make-up artist Kika (Veronica Forque) as she starts a relationship with the stepson of a philandering American writer living in Madrid. After being called to the mansion of Nicholas Pierce (Peter Coyote) to make-up the corpse of his stepson Ramón (Alex Casanovas), Kika is shocked when Ramón turns out not to be dead and is revived by her attentions. Later, the pair start dating and decide to move in together, but their future is then put in jeopardy when Kika begins an affair with Nicholas and Ramón's ex-psychologist and lover decides she wants him back.

titles.title: The killer
titles.summary: John Woo directs this English-language remake of his own 1989 Hong Kong action thriller of the same name. Skilled assassin Zee (Nathalie Emmanuel) is hired by Finn (Sam Worthington) to kill the members of a Marseille drug gang while they are at a nightclub. She executes them all but leaves an innocent woman alive, a decision which puts her own life at risk. Jenn (Diana Silvers) was blinded during the attack and as Zee continues to attempt to save her, she is caught between the actions of Finn and Sey (Omar Sy), a determined police officer on her trail. The cast also includes Eric Cantona, Saïd Taghmaoui and Grégory Montel.

titles.title: Killing Eve
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the British drama in which two women find themselves tangled in a deadly web of obsession. Working in MI5, Eve (Sandra Oh) feels unfulfilled by her day-to-day role and is desperate to acquire a mission she can immerse herself in. The opportunity soon presents itself in the form of a deadly assassin named Villanelle (Jodie Comer) whose murder of a Russian diplomat gains her the attention of the Russian sector of the security service which seeks to identify her and track her down, recruiting Eve to carry out the orders. The highly astute Villanelle, however, is always two steps ahead, and Eve will have to move fast before her target gets to her first. The episodes are: 'Nice Face', 'I'll Deal With Him Later', 'Don't I Know You?', 'Sorry Baby', 'I Have a Thing About Bathrooms', 'Take Me to the Hole!', 'I Don't Want to Be Free' and 'God, I'm Tired'.

titles.title: Killing Eve: Season three
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the third season of the British drama in which two women find themselves tangled in a deadly web of obsession. In this season, assassin Villanelle (Jodie Comer) goes back to her roots to settle an old score, and Eve (Sandra Oh) adjusts to her new civilian life while trying to patch things up with Niko (Owen McDonnell). The episodes are: 'Slowly Slowly Catchy Monkey', 'Management Sucks', 'Meetings Have Biscuits', 'Still Got It', 'Are You from Pinner?', 'End of Game', 'Beautiful Monster' and 'Are You Leading Or Am I?'.

titles.title: Killing Eve: Season two
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the second season of the British drama in which two women find themselves tangled in a deadly web of obsession. In this season, assassin Villanelle (Jodie Comer) goes off radar while recovering from her injury, MI6 are perplexed by new cases of assassinations and attempt to piece together the killer's identity and Eve (Sandra Oh) and Niko (Owen McDonnell)'s relationship is on the rocks. The episodes are: 'Do You Know How to Dispose of a Body', 'Nice and Neat', 'The Hungry Caterpillar', 'Desperate Times', 'Smell Ya Later', 'I Hope You Like Missionary!', 'Wide Awake' and 'You're Mine'.

titles.title: The killing of a sacred deer
titles.summary: Colin Farrell and Nicole Kidman star in this horror drama written and directed by Yorgos Lanthimos. Steven Murphy (Farrell) is a successful cardiac surgeon who lives a happy life with his ophthalmologist wife Anna (Kidman) and their two children Kim (Raffey Cassidy) and Bob (Sunny Suljic). However, his perfect life starts coming apart at the seams after he befriends 16-year-old Martin (Barry Keoghan). Steven spends much of his time hanging out alone with the teenager and also invites him round to his upper-class home to socialise with his kids. However, when Steven visits Martin and his mother (Alicia Silverstone) for dinner, the teenager's motives for their unusual friendship become clear and it transpires he's willing to go to great lengths to get what he wants, to the detriment of Steven and his family.

titles.title: The kindergarten teacher
titles.summary: American drama starring Maggie Gyllenhaal. Lisa Spinelli (Gyllenhaal) is dissatisfied with her life as a mother, wife and kindergarten teacher on Staten Island. She attends a poetry class, led by Simon (Gael García Bernal), as a means of artistically expressing herself, but her talents are quickly dismissed by her peers and mentor. However, when she overhears one of her pupils, Jimmy (Parker Sevak), reciting his own poem she steals it for herself and uses it to wow her classmates. Convinced that Jimmy is a child genius, Lisa becomes determined to help him harness his unique gift, however her behaviour begins to cross the normal boundary between student and teacher.

titles.title: Kinds of kindness
titles.summary: Emma Stone, Jesse Plemons and Willem Dafoe star in this black comedy anthology co-written and directed by Yorgos Lanthimos which features three loosely connected chapters. 'The Death of RMF' follows Robert Fletcher (Plemons) whose boss and lover Raymond (Dafoe) controls every aspect of his life. However, when Robert refuses to obey Raymond's latest order, his life falls apart and he begins to fear that he has been replaced in Raymond's affections by Rita (Stone). In 'RMF Is Flying', Daniel (Plemons) mourns his wife Liz (Stone), a marine biologist who disappeared during an expedition at sea. When she miraculously returns, he becomes convinced that she is not his wife and forces her to go to great lengths to convince him that she is who she claims to be. Finally, 'RMF Eats a Sandwich' follows cult members Emily (Stone) and Andrew (Plemons) as they search for a woman who is believed to have the power to resurrect the dead. The cast also includes Hong Chau, Margaret Qualley and Mamoudou Athie.

titles.title: The king of Staten Island
titles.summary: Pete Davidson co-writes and stars in this comedy drama as high school dropout Scott, who is reluctant to embrace adult life after the death of his firefighter father when he was seven. Now 24-years-old and living with his mother, Margie (Marisa Tomei), Scott spends his days smoking with his friends and dreaming of becoming a tattoo artist despite his sketchy ability to draw. When his mother begins dating another firefighter, Ray (Bill Burr), Scott is forced to assess his own life and starts to make efforts to become more grown up.

titles.title: King of thieves
titles.summary: Michael Caine stars in this British crime drama directed by James Marsh. A group of retired crooks come together to rob an underground safe deposit facility in London's Hatton Garden jewellery quarter. The gang break into the vault over the Easter holiday weekend and get away with over £200 million worth of stolen goods. However, as the police start to close in, cracks begin to show among the group as they become increasingly suspicious of each other and their plans to split the money. The cast also includes Charlie Cox, Michael Gambon, Ray Winstone, Jim Broadbent and Paul Whitehouse.

titles.title: King Richard
titles.summary: Will Smith stars as tennis coach Richard Williams in this US biographical drama. Even before his daughters Venus and Serena (Saniyya Sidney and Demi Singleton) were born, Richard Williams was convinced that under his guidance they could become the world's greatest tennis players. In Compton, California, Richard determinedly coaches his daughters from a young age, occasionally drawing scrutiny for his obsessive methods, before seeking out coach Rick Macci (Jon Bernthal) to help take his daughters' play to the next level.

titles.title: Kingdom of the planet of the apes
titles.sortTitle: kingdom of the planet of the apes
titles.summary: Owen Teague and Freya Allen star in this sci-fi action sequel directed by Wes Ball. Centuries after the death of Caesar, apes have become the dominant species on Earth. Noa (Teague) belongs to the peaceful eagle clan but when his home is destroyed by members of a rogue clan led by Proximus Caesar (Kevin Durand), who has twisted Caesar's teachings for his own benefit, he embarks on a journey to rescue the kidnapped survivors. Along the way he meets Raka (Peter Macon) as well as Mae (Allen), a human girl on a quest of her own, and the choices they make will determine the future of both of their species. The cast also includes William H. Macy, Travis Jeffery and Lydia Peckham.

titles.title: Kingsman: The golden circle
titles.summary: Matthew Vaughn returns to direct this sequel to the 2015 British action comedy 'Kingsman: The Secret Service'. After the Kingsman headquarters in London are destroyed in an explosion, they discover that the organisation behind the attack is the notorious Golden Circle, led by criminal mastermind Poppy (Julianne Moore). As they prepare to travel to America to confront and take down Poppy and her crew, the Kingsmen contact their American counterparts, Statesman, who agree to help them in their quest. Although they have the same agenda - save the world - the Kingsmen and the Statesmen have very different methods and values but they must put these aside and work together if they stand any chance of bringing down the Golden Circle. The cast features Taron Egerton returning as Eggsy, Colin Firth as Harry Hart and Mark Strong as Merlin, with Channing Tatum as Agent Tequila, Halle Berry as Ginger Ale and Jeff Bridges as Champagne.

titles.title: Kirikou and the men and women
titles.sortTitle: kirikou and the men and women
titles.summary: The third animated film in the series that follows the adventures of a small African boy named Kirikou. The five separate stories relate to Kirikou's day-to-day life growing up in his tribal village alongside his mother and grandfather, and his efforts to try and outwit the scheming local sorceress Karaba.

titles.title: Kirikou and the sorceress
titles.summary: Kirikou speaks to his mother from within her womb, demanding to be born. Taken aback by such boldness, Kirikou's mother tells him to go ahead and birth himself; which he does and emerges walking, talking and looking at the world with a mind uncluttered by myth, superstition and prejudice. He undertakes a perilous journey in order to free his village from the spell of a sorceress.

titles.title: Kneecap
titles.summary: Rich Peppiatt directs this Irish comedy starring Naoise O Cairealláin, Liam Og O Hannaidh and JJ O Dochartaigh. When Belfast teacher JJ (O Dochartaigh) meets reprobates Naoise (O Cairealláin) and Liam (Og O Hannaidh), they set about forming an unlikely band of Irish rappers. Passionate about saving their native language from extinction, the trio write and perform hip-hop tracks in their mother tongue in the hope of raising awareness of the forgotten dialect. The cast also includes Michael Fassbender, Fionnuala Flaherty and Simone Kirby.

titles.title: Kraven the Hunter
titles.summary: Aaron Taylor-Johnson stars as the eponymous Marvel Comics character in this action thriller directed by J.C. Chandor. Sickened by the actions of his father Nikolai (Russell Crowe), a crime lord and big game hunter, Sergei Kravinoff becomes Kraven, a vigilante who hunts criminals and poachers. When his half-brother Dmitri (Fred Hechinger) is kidnapped, Kraven joins forces with voodoo priestess Calypso (Ariana DeBose) to find him. However, this pulls him back into his estranged father's world with devastating consequences. The cast also includes Alessandro Nivola and Christopher Abbott.

titles.title: Krisha
titles.summary: Trey Edward Shults writes, directs and stars in this drama which follows alcoholic Krisha (Krisha Fairchild) as she tries to reconnect with her family for the first time in over ten years. After being invited to Thanksgiving dinner, Krisha hopes to prove her dark days of drink and drug abuse are behind her and arrives at the home of her younger sister Robyn (Robyn Fairchild) for the meal. However, when her attempts at rebuilding her relationship with nephew Trey (Shults) end in rejection, Krisha's anxiety begins to get the better of her as past demons return to haunt her once more.

titles.title: Kubo and the two strings
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure directed by Travis Knight. Kubo (voice of Art Parkinson) is a kind-hearted young boy who cares for his mother in their peaceful Japanese seaside home. However, his relatively sheltered life changes forever when he accidentally summons an evil spirit from the past, which storms his home to enforce an age-old vendetta. Forced to flee, Kubo teams up with Monkey (Charlize Theron) and Beetle (Matthew McConaughey) to begin an epic quest to save his family and unravel the mystery surrounding his father, a fallen samurai master. With the help of his new companions, Kubo is able to master the untold power behind his mother's mystical stringed instrument and his father's legendary suit of armour. Now, with the magic of Kubo's family driving them forward, the trio do battle against ferocious monsters and vengeful gods in order to fulfil their heroic destinies.

titles.title: Kubo and the two strings
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure directed by Travis Knight. Kubo (voice of Art Parkinson) is a kind-hearted young boy who cares for his mother in their peaceful Japanese seaside home. However, his relatively sheltered life changes forever when he accidentally summons an evil spirit from the past, which storms his home to enforce an age-old vendetta. Forced to flee, Kubo teams up with Monkey (Charlize Theron) and Beetle (Matthew McConaughey) to begin an epic quest to save his family and unravel the mystery surrounding his father, a fallen samurai master. With the help of his new companions, Kubo is able to master the untold power behind his mother's mystical stringed instrument and his father's legendary suit of armour. Now, with the magic of Kubo's family driving them forward, the trio do battle against ferocious monsters and vengeful gods in order to fulfil their heroic destinies.

titles.title: Kung fu panda 2
titles.summary: Animated martial arts comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman, Jackie Chan, Angelina Jolie, Lucy Liu, Seth Rogen, David Cross and Gary Oldman. Now a kung fu master, giant panda Po (Black) spends his days working alongside Master Shifu (Hoffman) and The Furious Five - Monkey (Chan), Crane (Cross), Tigress (Jolie), Viper (Liu), and Mantis (Rogen) - to protect the Valley of Peace. However, when the sense of harmony cultivated by the group is threatened by the evil emperor peacock Lord Shen (Oldman), who has developed a deadly new weapon with which he plans to conquer China and destroy the ancient art of kung fu, Po and his comrades must set out to restore order once again.

titles.title: Kung fu panda 3
titles.summary: Third instalment of the animated martial arts comedy franchise which features the voice talents of Jack Black, Bryan Cranston and J.K. Simmons. When giant panda Po (Black) meets his biological father Li Shan (Cranston) he is excited to get to know him. However, the vengeful General Kai (Simmons) is on a mission to steal the chi from every kung fu master and destroy the Valley of Peace with his army of jade zombies. In order to save everyone, Po must teach the inhabitants of the panda village kung fu so that they can face General Kai together but it will not be an easy fight. The voice cast also includes Dustin Hoffman, Angelina Jolie and Jackie Chan.

titles.title: Kung fu panda 4
titles.summary: Fourth instalment of the animated martial arts comedy franchise featuring the voice talents of Jack Black, Awkwafina and Viola Davis. As giant panda Po (Black) prepares to take on a new role as the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, he must first find someone to replace him as the Dragon Warrior. However, he struggles to decide who should take over his position and runs into further trouble when he crosses paths with a sorceress known as The Chameleon (Davis) who intends to steal the abilities of every kung fu master and become the ultimate warrior. Po joins forces with Zhen (Awkwafina), a wanted thief, to stop The Chameleon, but can Zhen be trusted? The voice cast also includes Dustin Hoffman, Bryan Cranston and Ian McShane.

titles.title: L'immensita
titles.summary: Emanuele Crialese writes and directs this Italian-language drama starring Penélope Cruz and Luana Giuliani and set in 1970s Rome. Clara (Cruz) is a wife and mother who has been left to pick up the pieces of an unfulfilling and abusive marriage, all while helping her children to navigate the complexities of life. Clara's eldest child, Adriana (Giuliani) is struggling with gender dysphoria and, though Clara is supportive of Adriana, it is causing even more distance between Clara and her husband, Felice (Vincenzo Amato). As Adriana, latterly known as Andrea, explores their identity, so too does Clara, as she relishes in childlike play with her children and grows only closer to them in the process.

titles.title: La gloire de mon père
titles.summary: A screen account of the childhood of filmmaker Marcel Pagnol, based on his autobiography. The story begins with Marcel's birth in 1895, his family's move to Marseilles and an idyllic summer holiday near La Treille.

titles.title: La grande vadrouille
titles.summary: French wartime comedy co-written and directed by Gerard Oury. When a British bomber is shot down over Paris during the Second World War, the crew members become separated as they parachute into the Nazi-occupied city. One lands on the scaffold of an amiable painter and decorator, Augustin (Bourvil). Another lands on top of a concert hall and is rescued by patriotic conductor Stanislas Lefort (Louis de Funes). The third ends up in the otter enclosure of a Parisian zoo. Meanwhile, the Germans are hot on their trail as they attempt to make their escape into the neutral zone of Southern France.

titles.title: La la land
titles.summary: Damien Chazelle writes and directs this romantic musical starring Emma Stone and Ryan Gosling. Aspiring actress Mia (Stone) and jazz musician Sebastian (Gosling) are both down on their luck in Los Angeles, a city of broken dreams. Tired of being rejected in auditions and reduced to serving stars their coffees, Mia stumbles into a jazz club to the entrancing melody of a piano being played within; there she finds Sebastian, who is being discarded by his boss. The two soon fall in love as they strive to truly make something of themselves. But the rocky road of pursuing their dreams may prove too much strain for their budding romance to bear. The film was nominated for eleven BAFTAs, winning five including Best Film, Best Director (Chazelle) and Best Leading Actress (Stone), and seven Golden Globe Awards, winning in all seven categories including Best Motion Picture - Comedy Or Musical, Best Performance By an Actor in a Motion Picture - Comedy Or Musical (Gosling) and Best Performance By an Actress in a Motion Picture - Comedy Or Musical (Stone). The film was also nominated for 14 Academy Awards, winning six including Best Actress (Stone), Best Director (Chazelle) and Best Original Music Score (Justin Hurwitz).

titles.title: La strada
titles.summary: Classic Italian drama co-written and directed by Federico Fellini. The film follows Gelsomina (Giulietta Masina), a young girl who is sold by her impoverished mother to a travelling performer named Zampano (Anthony Quinn) in exchange for some food. With his act involving breaking a metal chain wrapped around his chest, Zampano attempts to incorporate Gelsomina into his routine by teaching her to perform a drum roll as part of his introduction. However, when the pair join up with a small travelling circus, fellow performer Il Matto (Richard Basehart) soon questions the way Zampano treats Gelsomina, leaving her facing a number of tough choices as she contemplates her future. The cast also includes Aldo Silvani, Marcella Rovere and Livia Venturini.

titles.title: Lady and the Tramp 2
titles.summary: In this sequel to 'Lady and the Tramp', the original duo's offspring, mischievous pup Scamp (voiced by Scott Wolf), is always getting into trouble. After running away from home he meets lovely stray Angel (Alyssa Milano) and the streetwise Buster (Chazz Palminteri), who enrolls Scamp in the Junkyard Dogs gang. However, how long will Scamp be happy in his new, collar-free surroundings?

titles.title: Lady bird
titles.summary: Saoirse Ronan stars in this US comedy drama written and directed by Greta Gerwig.
