The film follows Christine 'Lady Bird' McPherson (Ronan), a high school student from Sacramento living with her parents and adopted older brother. Dreaming of leaving her bland lifestyle behind and moving to New York, Lady Bird endures a rocky relationship with her mother Marion (Laurie Metcalf), a hard-working nurse who works long hours to provide for her family. With her thoughts turning to college applications and life out with Sacramento, Lady Bird takes on a number of new projects as she attempts to successfully navigate her final year in high school.

titles.title: The lady vanishes
titles.summary: Classic thriller from Alfred Hitchcock, made shortly before he moved to America. When the elderly Miss Froy (Dame May Whitty) goes missing on a train bound for England, her friend Iris Henderson (Margaret Lockwood) sets out to find her. However, Iris's attempts are immediately frustrated by her fellow passengers, who question whether Miss Froy ever even existed. Only music scholar Gilbert Redman (Michael Redgrave) is prepared to believe Iris, and together they set about getting to the bottom of the mystery.

titles.title: The Land of Sometimes
titles.summary: Ewan McGregor, Helena Bonham Carter and Mel Brooks lend their voices to this animated adventure directed by Leon Joosen. When twins Elise and Alfie (Alisha Weir and Andrei Shen) find a magical watch that grants wishes, they are transported by the Wish Collector (McGregor) to the musical Land of Sometimes where they learn a valuable lesson.

titles.title: The last act
titles.summary: Al Pacino and Greta Gerwig star in this comedy drama adapted from Philip Roth's novel 'The Humbling'. Ageing actor Simon Axler (Pacino) is suffering from mental health problems and, with his once-successful career in decline, he considers suicide. He finds a new lease of life when he encounters Pegeen (Gerwig), a much younger gay woman who is the daughter of his friends, and the two embark on an unlikely affair. As their relationship develops Axler is given the opportunity to return to the stage, but can he successfully revive his career?

titles.title: The last dragonslayer
titles.summary: Made-for-TV fantasy adventure based on the novel by Jasper Fforde. Set in the magical world of the Ununited Kingdom, the ruler of Herefordshire King Snodd (Matt Berry) is slowly weakening the influence of magic while only one dragon remains. Meanwhile, orphan Jennifer Strange (Ellise Chappell) is taken into the servitude of magician The Great Zambini (Andrew Buchan) where she discovers her true destiny to be the prophesised last dragonslayer.

titles.title: The last duel
titles.summary: Matt Damon, Jodie Comer and Adam Driver star in this historical medieval drama directed by Ridley Scott. When Marguerite de Carrouges (Comer) accuses Jacques Le Gris (Driver) of sexually assaulting her, her husband, renowned knight Jean de Carrouges (Damon), challenges his former friend to a duel. As both men prepare for combat rumours abound about what actually happened and de Carrouges is placed under much scrutiny.

titles.title: The last kingdom: Season two
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the second season of the historical BBC drama centred around the wars between the Saxons and Danes during the ninth century. Alexander Dreymon stars as the warrior Uhtred of Bebbanburg, the son of a Saxon nobleman who was captured by the Danes as a child and raised as one of their own. In this season, Uhtred travels north from Wessex in his bid to avenge the death of Earl Ragnar (Tobias Santelmann) and recapture his ancestral lands of Bebbanburg. Meanwhile, King Alfred (David Dawson) looks to unite the kingdoms of England and hopes a new king can fulfil his wish. However, with his preferred choice enslaved, Uhtred is forced to embark on a dangerous rescue mission which sees him come up against a feared adversary from his past.

titles.title: The last letter from your lover
titles.summary: Felicity Jones, Shailene Woodley and Callum Turner star in this romantic drama based on Jojo Moyes' bestselling novel. While researching her next assignment, newspaper journalist Ellie Haworth (Jones) stumbles upon a series of archived letters detailing the illicit love affair between American socialite Jennifer Stirling (Woodley/Diana Kent) and financial journalist Anthony O'Hare (Turner/Ben Cross) in 1960s London. After reading their letters, Ellie, with help from archivist Rory (Nabhaan Rizwan). endeavours to discover more about the story of the two lovers.

titles.title: The last musician of Auschwitz
titles.summary: Toby Trackman directs this documentary which explores the role of music during the Holocaust. 99-year-old cellist Anita Lasker-Wallfisch arrived at Auschwitz as a teenager and is the only surviving member of that camp's women's orchestra. While music helped to save her life, it also risked losing all meaning for her as she was forced to perform for Josef Mengele and play as her fellow prisoners were killed. Her recollections feature alongside testimonies from the surviving relatives of other camp musicians.

titles.title: Last night in Soho
titles.summary: Thomasin McKenzie and Anya Taylor-Joy star in this psychological horror directed by Edgar Wright. Aspiring fashion designer Eloise Turner (McKenzie), who is obsessed with 1960s London, finds herself mysteriously transported to the era of her dreams after she moves to the capital to study at the London College of Fashion. As she explores the city, she meets nightclub singer Sandie (Taylor-Joy) at the Café de Paris. However, Eloise's idealised vision of '60s London is shattered when she discovers the darker side of the city and witnesses a murder. The cast also includes Matt Smith, Terence Stamp and Diana Rigg.

titles.title: The last of us: The complete first season
titles.sortTitle: last of us: the complete first season
titles.summary: Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey star in this post-apocalyptic action drama based on the Naughty Dog video game. 20 years after a global pandemic decimates civilisation, smuggler Joel (Pascal) is hired to escort 14-year-old Ellie (Ramsey) out of the Boston quarantine zone. However, when he discovers that Ellie is seemingly immune to the mutant Cordyceps fungus, Joel accompanies her across the country as they search for a rebel group hoping to develop a cure. The episodes are: 'When You're Lost in the Darkness', 'Infected', 'Long, Long Time', 'Please Hold to My Hand', 'Endure and Survive', 'Kin', 'Left Behind', 'When We Are in Need' and 'Look for the Light'.

titles.title: The last showgirl
titles.summary: Pamela Anderson stars in this drama directed by Gia Coppola. 57-year-old showgirl Shelly Gardner (Anderson) has performed at Le Razzle Dazzle in a Las Vegas casino for 30 years. When she learns that it is going be closed in two weeks due to declining ticket sales and will be replaced by a more modern show, she is devastated. While her younger co-workers begin auditioning for roles in other shows, Shelly fears for her future. As she navigates this new challenge, she must also face her estranged daughter Hannah (Billie Lourd). The cast also includes Jamie Lee Curtis, Dave Bautista and Kiernan Shipka.

titles.title: The last tree
titles.summary: British indie drama written and directed by Shola Amoo. Nigerian-born Femi (Tai Golding) has been brought up in rural Lincolnshire by his foster carer Mary (Denise Black), however, when his biological mother Yinka (Gbemisola Ikumelo) returns, Femi is brought to London to live with her. As a teenager Femi (Sam Adewunmi) struggles to connect with his mother and finds himself getting involved in fights at school and also mixing with petty criminals and drug dealers. Will Femi be able to forgive his mother and find a true sense of place?

titles.title: Last year in Marienbad
titles.summary: Classic French drama directed by Alain Resnais. In a luxury hotel somewhere in Europe, an unnamed man (Giorgio Albertazzi) attempts to persuade one of his fellow guests, a similarly unnamed married woman (Delphine Seyrig), that they have not only previously met, but that they had an affair and made plans to elope together. The woman, however, does not appear to recognise him and does her best to rebuff his advances. The cast also includes Sacha Pitoeff, Francoise Bertin and Luce Garcia-Ville.

titles.title: Late night
titles.summary: Mindy Kaling writes and stars in this American comedy also starring Emma Thompson. When ruthless, straight-shooting TV show host Katherine (Thompson) discovers that she only has one more year left of her post, she sets out to uncover why she is losing popularity with the public. Her subordinates, however, are too afraid to speak the truth in case of being fired like many of their colleagues, so it is up to new writer Molly (Kaling) to step forward and offer a new direction for the show. Soon, Katherine and Molly begin to form a bond as they work together to save the star's late-night slot.

titles.title: The laureate
titles.summary: Tom Hughes, Laura Haddock and Dianna Agron star in this drama written and directed by William Nunez, which follows the life of war poet and novelist Robert Graves (Hughes) during the 1920s. Having returned home to his wife Nancy (Haddock) after the First World War, Robert is struggling both to write and to process the trauma he experienced on the battlefield. When he finds inspiration again after reading the work of Laura Riding (Agron), Nancy encourages her to visit and the three of them are soon caught up in a complicated and ultimately destructive relationship. Fra Fee also stars.

titles.title: Lazy eye
titles.summary: Gay-themed comedy drama written and directed by Tim Kirkman. After experiencing problems with his eyesight, L.A. graphic designer Dean (Lucas Near-Verbrugghe) is unexpectedly contacted by former flame Alex (Aaron Costa Ganis) who hopes to rekindle their relationship. The two rendezvous at a quiet vacation house in the Mojave Desert having not spoken since the end of their ill-fated summer romance in New York 15 years ago. The pair reacquaint themselves by discussing work, art, their hopes for the future and their lives since but secrets from their past resurface and threaten to reshape their lives.

titles.title: Le chateau de ma mère
titles.summary: An adaption of the second volume of filmmaker Marcel Pagnol's memoirs; the first of which is covered in the film 'La Gloire de Mon Pere'. A 10- year-old Pagnol and his family return to their country villa for Christmas and renew acquaintances. Back in town Marcel takes special classes to prepare for the lycee, and on an Easter visit to the country, he falls in love for the first time.

titles.title: Le week-end
titles.summary: Unconventional romantic comedy directed by Roger Michell. Nick (Jim Broadbent) and Meg (Lindsay Duncan), a married couple approaching 60, return to Paris to celebrate their 30th wedding anniversary with hopes of reigniting the spark in their relationship. Desperately clinging on to their marriage, which has evidently gone stale in the past few years, they visit memorable landmarks and places of mutual interest in the French capital. Despite their best endeavours, it is clear that both possess reservations about the relationship. However, a chance meeting with an old friend (Jeff Goldblum) results in the couple being invited to a party at his fashionable home and their run-in with the Parisian bourgeoisie may change their perspective on life - and each other - profoundly.

titles.title: The legend of Ochi
titles.summary: Helena Zengel and Willem Dafoe star in this fantasy adventure written and directed by Isaiah Saxon. Yuri (Zengel) lives on the island of Carpathia where the locals hunt reclusive creatures called Ochi. Her father Maxim (Dafoe) is a passionate hunter and has taught Yuri to fear the Ochi. However, when Yuri finds an injured baby Ochi and realises it is far from the violent monster she has been led to believe, she embarks on a dangerous journey to reunite it with its family. The cast also includes Emily Watson and Finn Wolfhard.

titles.title: LEGO DC Batman: Family matters
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure set in a Lego version of Gotham City. When Two-Face (voice of Christian Lanz) buys Wayne Enterprises and sets about tearing the city apart, Batman (Troy Baker) enlists the help of the Bat family - Batgirl (Alyson Stoner), Robin (Scott Menville) and Nightwing (Will Friedle) - to stop him. Meanwhile, a mysterious villain known as the Red Hood (Jason Spisak) plots his own attack to destroy the entire Bat family.

titles.title: LEGO jurassic world: The secret exhibit
titles.sortTitle: lego jurassic world: the secret exhibit
titles.summary: Children's animated miniseries based on 'Jurassic World' (2015) which follows the opening of an exciting new attraction at the dinosaur theme park, but plans are stalled when the dinosaurs do not arrive in time. With animal behaviourist Owen (voice of Ian Hanlin) tasked with gathering the dinosaurs for delivery and Claire (Britt McKillip) in charge of the exhibit, will they be able to find a way around the chaos and ensure the grand opening of the exciting new feature?

titles.title: The LEGO movie 2
titles.summary: Chris Pratt, Elizabeth Banks and Will Arnett return to lend their voices to this CGI-animated adventure sequel based on the line of toys made by Lego. When Apocalypseburg is invaded by alien Duplos and his friends are kidnapped by General Mayhem (Stephanie Beatriz), Emmet (Pratt) sets off on an adventure to outer space to save them. There, he teams up with Rex Dangervest (Pratt) and heads to the Systar System to confront Queen Watevra Wa'Nabi (Tiffany Haddish) and rescue his friends. But will the gang be able to prevent the dreaded Ourmomageddon?

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 28 Jan 2020); On loan - Due: 04 Nov 2026

titles.title: LEGO Ninjago - Masters of spinjitzu: Day of the departed
titles.sortTitle: lego ninjago - masters of spinjitzu: day of the departed
titles.summary: Special episode of the children's animation based on the line of toys by Lego. Set in the fictional world of Ninjago, the series follows a group of young Ninja who, under the tutelage of Sensei Wu (voice of Paul Dobson), are Spinjitzu martial artists in training, learning to wield their special Golden Weapons and use their unique elemental powers to protect the land from evil forces. In this instalment, on the Day of the Departed, Cole (Kirby Morrow) accidentally releases the ghosts of several fearsome, vanquished foes from the Departed Realm. Can the Ninja defeat some of their old adversaries once again?

titles.title: Lemony Snicket's A series of unfortunate events
titles.sortTitle: lemony snicket's a series of unfortunate events
titles.summary: Visually inventive and stylised adaptation of the dark and sinister children's books, starring Jim Carrey. After their parents are killed in a fire, the Baudelaire siblings, Violet (Emily Browning), Klaus (Liam Aiken) and the infant Sunny, are taken in by a succession of relatives and guardians, including kindly snake expert Uncle Monty (Billy Connolly) and their nervous Aunt Josephine (Meryl Streep). Worst of the lot though is the evil Count Olaf (Jim Carrey), obsessed with getting his hands on the Baudelaire children's inheritance. Imagining himself a master of disguise, Count Olaf undertakes a series of dastardly crimes to separate the Baudelaire children from their kindly guardians, and hopefully from their lives.

titles.title: Les biches
titles.summary: French drama from filmmaker Claude Chabrol starring his real life wife, Stéphane Audran, who won the Best Actress award at the 1968 Berlin Film Festival for her performance. Frédérique (Audran), a cool, rich lesbian picks up a young student named Why (Jacqueline Sassard) and takes her back to her elegant villa in St Tropez. They live happily for some time, annoyed only by the lunatic pranks of two resident camp buffoons. At a party Why falls for a young architect (Jean-Louis Trintignant) and begins an affair with him. At first amused by this, Frédérique later visits the architect herself and begins an affair, drawing him into an unstable and ultimately tragic ménage-a-trois.

titles.title: Les misérables
titles.summary: Ladj Ly directs this French drama set in Paris where police officer Stéphane Ruiz (Damien Bonnard) has newly transferred to the poverty-stricken district of Montfermeil, notorious for its gang warfare. Working closely with his new colleagues Chris (Alexis Manenti) and Gwada (Djebril Zonga), Stéphane struggles to adjust to his new settings, particularly put off by the heavy handedness of Chris. As tensions increase between the local authority and members of the community violence appears inevitable.

titles.title: Les misérables
titles.summary: Six-part BBC adaptation of Victor Hugo's novel starring Dominic West, David Oyelowo and Lily Collins. Set in 19th-century France, the drama tells the story of Jean Valjean (West), a prisoner who breaks his parole and spends the next two decades fleeing from obsessive police inspector and former prison guard Javert (Oyelowo). In his quest for personal redemption, Valjean adopts Cosette (Ellie Bamber), daughter of impoverished prostitute Fantine (Collins), and is eventually elected as mayor of Montreuil. But despite the events of the intervening years, can he ever really shake off his past?

titles.title: Les misérables
titles.summary: Tom Hooper directs this Academy Award-winning big-screen adaptation of the stage musical based on Victor Hugo's classic novel. Set in 19th-century France, the film tells the story of Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman), a prisoner who breaks his parole and spends the next two decades fleeing from obsessive police inspector Javert (Russell Crowe). In his quest for personal redemption, Valjean adopts Cosette (Isabelle Allen/Amanda Seyfried), daughter of impoverished prostitute Fantine (Anne Hathaway), and is eventually elected as town mayor. But despite the events of the intervening years, can he ever really shake off his past? The ensemble supporting cast includes Helena Bonham Carter, Sacha Baron Cohen, Eddie Redmayne and Samantha Barks. Hathaway won the Academy Award, Golden Globe and BAFTA for her supporting performance. The film also won two additional Oscars and three BAFTAs, and received Golden Globe Awards for Best Motion Picture - Musical Or Comedy and Best Actor - Motion Picture Musical Or Comedy (Jackman).

titles.title: The lesson
titles.summary: Alice Troughton directs this drama starring Richard E. Grant, Daryl McCormack and Julie Delpy. Promising young writer Liam (McCormack) is hired as a tutor at the vast estate of famous writer J.M. Sinclair to help his son Bertie (Stephen McMillan) excel in his studies. As Liam enjoys the privileges of working alongside one of his idols, he forms a bond with Sinclair, but it is not long before Liam uncovers the family's tragic past and the fiercely guarded secrets that threaten to tear them apart.

titles.title: Let him go
titles.summary: Kevin Costner and Diane Lane star in this drama based on the novel by Larry Watson. George and Margaret Blackledge (Costner and Lane) are mourning the loss of their son. When they learn that their son's widow Lorna (Kayli Carter) has remarried, they fear for the safety of their grandson when they witness the behaviour of his new step-father Donnie (Will Brittain). As they attempt to rescue their grandson, they discover why Donnie is the way he is...

titles.title: Let the sunshine in
titles.summary: Claire Denis co-writes and directs this French drama starring Juliette Binoche as a divorced Parisian artist searching for true love. Unsure of exactly what she's looking for, Isabelle (Binoche) has a series of affairs with a succession of doomed lovers, including the married banker Vincent (Xavier Beauvois) and a married actor (Nicolas Duvauchelle), in her seemingly endless quest for happiness. Will any of them help her find what she wants most out of life?

titles.title: Life
titles.summary: Ryan Reynolds, Jake Gyllenhaal and Rebecca Ferguson star in this sci-fi thriller directed by Daniel Espinosa. When a crew of astronauts and scientists embark on a journey to the International Space Station, their task is to study a sample of matter taken from Mars and determine whether it can provide proof of the existence of extraterrestrial life. However, when the matter begins to display intelligence far beyond its suspected capabilities, the crew realise that they are in danger - and so is all of Earth. The cast also includes Olga Dihovichnaya, Ariyon Bakare and Hiroyuki Sanada.

titles.title: Life itself
titles.summary: Oscar Isaac and Olivia Wilde star in this US romantic drama written and directed by Dan Fogelman. Narrated by Samuel L. Jackson, who portrays a skewed version of himself, the film is set between New York and Carmona, Spain and split into five chapters that are linked by chance encounters and events with profound implications that span generations.

titles.title: The life of Chuck
titles.summary: Mike Flanagan directs this fantasy drama based on the short story by Stephen King which chronicles key moments in the life of a seemingly ordinary accountant. After losing his parents in a car accident, Chuck (Tom Hiddleston/Jacob Tremblay/Benjamin Pajak/Cody Flanagan) is raised by his grandparents. His grandmother Sarah (Mia Sara) shares her love of dance with him and he later enjoys a spontaneous dance in the street with a stranger. However, as his health declines, the world is afflicted by devastating natural disasters and civilisation begins to crumble. The cast also includes Chiwetel Ejiofor, Karen Gillan and Mark Hamill.

titles.title: Life of the party
titles.summary: Melissa McCarthy co-writes and stars in this US comedy alongside Maya Rudolph, Jacki Weaver and Matt Walsh. After her husband of 23 years leaves her for another woman, middle-aged mother Deanna Miles (McCarthy) decides to go back to college to finish her archaeology degree. She enrols herself in the same college and joins the same sorority as her daughter, senior student Maddie (Molly Gordon), and the pair find themselves constantly crossing paths as Deanna revels in the college lifestyle she gave up more than two decades ago for her family.

titles.title: The lighthouse
titles.summary: Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson star in this psychological drama co-written and directed by Robert Eggers. Ephraim Winslow (Pattinson) arrives on a remote island off the coast of New England during the 1890s to work alongside veteran lighthouse keeper Tom Wake (Dafoe). However, the pair have a volatile relationship and the solitary nature of the job results in both men becoming suspicious and paranoid of the other. Ephraim, in particular, struggles to maintain his sanity and a threatening storm does little to suppress his anxieties.

titles.title: The lighthouse
titles.summary: Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson star in this psychological drama co-written and directed by Robert Eggers. Ephraim Winslow (Pattinson) arrives on a remote island off the coast of New England during the 1890s to work alongside veteran lighthouse keeper Tom Wake (Dafoe). However, the pair have a volatile relationship and the solitary nature of the job results in both men becoming suspicious and paranoid of the other. Ephraim, in particular, struggles to maintain his sanity and a threatening storm does little to suppress his anxieties.

titles.title: Lilo & Stitch
titles.summary: Dean Fleischer-Camp directs this live-action animated remake of the 2002 Disney animation. Lilo Pelekai (Maia Kealoha) is a six-year-old orphan who lives with her older sister and legal guardian Nani (Sydney Agudong). Lilo is lonely and is desperate to find a friend and so when she meets Stitch (voice of Chris Sanders), an alien fugitive, she immediately adopts him. While Stitch is pursued by aliens and government agents and Nani faces concerned social workers, Lilo attempts to teach Stitch the meaning of family. The cast also includes Zach Galifianakis, Billy Magnussen and Courtney B. Vance.

titles.title: Limbo
titles.summary: British comedy drama written and directed by Ben Sharrock. The film follows the plight of Syrian refugee Omar (Amir El-Masry), who finds himself on a remote Scottish island awaiting the outcome of his application for political asylum. A talented musician, Omar is encouraged to perform at the island's open mic nights, while attempting to adjust to his new surroundings with the help of cultural-awareness classes.

titles.title: Lion
titles.summary: Garth Davis directs this drama based on a true story. The film follows the remarkable journey of Indian orphan Saroo Brierley (Sunny Pawar/Dev Patel) who, after becoming lost on the streets of Calcutta at five-years-old, is adopted by Australian couple John and Sue Brierley (David Wenham and Nicole Kidman). 25 years later in Australia, Saroo, with the help of his girlfriend Lucy (Rooney Mara), turns to the Internet and Google Earth to finally find and reconnect with his mother, Kamla Mushi (Priyanka Bose), and the rest of his true family. The film was nominated for four Golden Globe Awards including Best Motion Picture - Drama, Best Performance By an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture (Patel), and Best Original Score - Motion Picture (Dustin O'Halloran/Volker Bertelmann) and six Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Supporting Actor (Patel) and Best Supporting Actress (Kidman). The film was also nominated for five BAFTAs, winning for Best Supporting Actor (Patel) and Best Adapted Screenplay (Davies).

titles.title: The lion guard - Life in the pride lands
titles.sortTitle: lion guard - life in the pride lands
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the animated series which follows the adventures of Simba (voice of Rob Lowe)'s son Prince Kion (Max Charles) as he assumes his position as the head of the Lion Guard. Promising not to abuse his powers like his great-uncle Scar once did, Kion forms his own group with various members of the animal kingdom and together they continue to watch over the circle of life in the African savanna. The episodes are: 'The Rise of the Makuu', 'The Kupatana Celebration', 'Bunga and the King', 'Never Roar Again' and 'The Imaginary Okapi'.

titles.title: The lion guard - The rise of Scar
titles.sortTitle: lion guard - the rise of scar
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the animated series which follows the adventures of Simba (voice of Rob Lowe)'s son Prince Kion (Max Charles) as he assumes his position as the head of the Lion Guard. Promising not to abuse his powers like his great-uncle Scar (David Oyelowo) once did, Kion forms his own group with various members of the animal kingdom and together they continue to watch over the circle of life in the African savanna. The episodes are: 'The Rise of Scar', 'The Trouble With Galagos', 'Janja's New Crew', 'Baboons!' and 'Lions of the Outlands'.

titles.title: The lion king
titles.summary: Jon Favreau directs this remake of the 1994 Disney animation featuring the voice talents of Donald Glover, Chiwetel Ejiofor and Beyoncé. After the death of his father Mufasa (James Earl Jones) young lion cub Simba (Glover/JD McCrary) is destined to become King of the Pride Lands, but is instead forced into exile by his evil and greedy uncle Scar (Ejiofor), who tricks Simba into taking responsibility for his father's death and claims the throne for himself. Away from his family, Simba befriends meerkat Timon (Billy Eichner) and warthog Pumbaa (Seth Rogen) and begins living a carefree life until his best friend Nala (Beyoncé/Shahadi Wright Joseph) convinces him to return home and take his rightful place as ruler of the Pride Lands.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 20 Nov 2019); On loan - Due: 27 Oct 2026

titles.title: The lion king 3 - Hakuna matata
titles.summary: The third instalment (which did not have a cinema release) in this popular children's animated story, but this time the story is told from Timon the Meerkat and Pumba the Warthog's perspective. When Timon decides to explore the world, it's not long before his path crosses with that of Pumba and they become good friends. But their plan to find a new home is forgotten when they come across a young cub called Simba (voiced again by Matthew Broderick) and help him save the Serengeti..

titles.title: The little drummer girl
titles.summary: All the episodes from the television drama set in the 1970s and based on the novel by John le Carré in which a talented young actress is given a role like never before when she is used as a pawn in a political minefield. During a holiday in Greece, Charlie (Florence Pugh) is offered an opportunity to help put right a complex situation involving Israeli-Palestine conflict, yet matters are soon complicated further when she begins to question to which side she belongs.

titles.title: The little mermaid
titles.summary: Rob Marshal directs this live-action reimagining of the 1989 animated Disney classic. Mermaid Ariel (Halle Bailey) is the youngest daughter of King Triton (Javier Bardem), and she yearns to explore the world beyond the sea. When she defies her father's rules and ventures to the surface, she sees Prince Eric (Jonah Hauer-King) and is fascinated by him, ultimately saving his life during a storm. A fight with her father drives Ariel to seek out Ursula (Melissa McCarthy), a sea witch, and she trades her voice for legs so that she can live on land. She has three days to receive true love's kiss from Eric, but Ursula is treacherous and has plans of her own...

titles.title: The little stranger
titles.summary: Drama based on the novel by Sarah Waters in which a highly respected doctor questions his science-based beliefs when a family are torn apart by their haunted past. When Dr Faraday (Domhnall Gleeson) is called out to tend to a patient dwelling in the vast and decaying Hundreds Hall, a country manor which stood as a landmark of his childhood, he is shocked to find the state of disrepair that the once grand building is now enduring. Called out to treat a former soldier returned from WWII who is suffering from mental deterioration, his behaviour is diagnosed as war shock. As strange events begin to take hold of the Ayres family and their home, however, Dr Faraday must find a rational explanation for the goings-on or risk losing his sanity also.

titles.title: The little vampire
titles.summary: Children's animated feature in which a young boy's fascination with vampires is fulfilled when he meets a real vampire. When Tony (voice of Amy Saville) and his family arrive at a spooky country manor on a family holiday, he is in for a shock when he gets a tap on the shoulder from a vampire named Rudolph (Rasmus Hardiker). As the pair embark on a world of adventures, Tony soon discovers that a group of evil vampire hunters are on Rudolph's tail. Can Tony help to save Rudolph and his family?

titles.title: The littlest reindeer
titles.summary: Canadian animated adventure co-written and directed by Jennifer Westcott. When one of Santa's main reindeer announces his retirement just before Christmas, young miniature horse Elliot (voice of Josh Hutcherson) is given three days to prove he can step in and earn a spot on Santa's team at the North Pole try-outs. Will Elliot be able to do enough and fulfil his dream?

titles.title: Living
titles.summary: Bill Nighy stars in this remake of the 1952 Japanese film 'Ikiru'. In 1950s London, civil servant Mr Williams (Nighy) is left devastated when he discovers he has only six months to live. Dissatisfied with his life's work, he uses all the influence of his 30-year service in the Public Works office to gain approval for a dilapidated area to be transformed into a children's playground. The cast also includes Aimee Lou Wood, Alex Sharp and Tom Burke.

titles.title: Lizzie
titles.summary: Chloë Sevigny stars as infamous murderess Lizzie Borden in this biographical crime drama. In 1892, unmarried outcast Lizzie lives trapped under the strict control of her wealthy father, Andrew (Jamey Sheridan). She discovers a kindred spirit when her family hires Irish immigrant Bridget Sullivan (Kristen Stewart) as a live-in housemaid. As the pair grow closer and share their experiences of abuse at the hands of Lizzie's father, they hatch a plan to get their revenge, a violent act for which Lizzie would go down in history.

titles.title: London: The modern Babylon
titles.summary: Documentary about the history of London from filmmaker Julien Temple. Beginning in the early 20th century and covering up to the winning bid for the 2012 Summer Olympics, the film looks at how the city has been changed by its people, including its many immigrants, from musicians and artists to politicians and rebels, and includes input from citizens, both past and present, archive footage of historical events and popular music.

titles.title: The loneliness of the long distance runner
titles.sortTitle: loneliness of the long distance runner
titles.summary: 1960s British drama which centres on Colin Smith (Tom Courtenay), a cynical working class youth, who finds himself in a boys' reformatory for robbing a bakery. The governor in charge of the reform school (Michael Redgrave) preaches to his inmates that exercise and physical challenge can permanently destroy a boy's rebellious streak. But Colin is fortunate enough to be on the boss's good side due to his natural running prowess and is offered the chance to train for a race against the local public school. Tensions build as the big day approaches and after a lot of time spent thinking on his lonely runs, Colin might just reconsider his naturally rebellious instincts.

titles.title: The long walk
titles.summary: Francis Lawrence directs this dystopian horror thriller based on the novel by Stephen King. A group of young men including Raymond Garraty (Cooper Hoffman) and Peter McVries (David Jonsson) enter an annual televised walking contest in the hope of winning the prize money and with it a chance to change their lives forever. However, this is no ordinary walk. Any participant who cannot maintain the required pace of three miles per hour will be executed by one of the soldiers accompanying them. With no chance for the men to rest, the walk will end when there is only of them left alive. As the participants begin to walk, many find a shared camaraderie together, but as the days pass their situation becomes increasingly bleak. The cast also includes Mark Hamill, Judy Greer and Ben Wang.

titles.title: The lord of the rings: The return of the king
titles.sortTitle: lord of the rings: the return of the king
titles.summary: Final instalment of Peter Jackson's adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's epic fantasy trilogy. As Frodo and Sam (Elijah Wood and Sean Astin) make their way through Mordor, Gandalf (Ian McKellen) rides to Minas Tirith to warn Denethor (John Noble) of Sauron's plan to attack Gondor. After reclaiming his birthright, Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen) leads the outnumbered forces of Gondor and Rohan into battle against Mordor's forces, determined to avert Sauron's gaze so that Frodo can complete his quest to destroy the Ring by casting it into the fires of Mount Doom. The cast also includes Orlando Bloom, John Rhys-Davies and Bernard Hill.

titles.title: The lord of the rings: The two towers
titles.sortTitle: lord of the rings: the two towers
titles.summary: Second instalment of Peter Jackson's adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's epic fantasy trilogy. With the Fellowship now divided, Frodo and Sam (Elijah Wood and Sean Astin) find themselves lost in the hills of Emyn Muil when they realise they are being followed by Gollum (Andy Serkis), a creature who promises to show them the way to Mount Doom. Meanwhile, Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen), Legolas (Orlando Bloom) and Gimli (John Rhys-Davies) search for Merry and Pippin (Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd) in the kingdom of Rohan, which is under attack from Saruman (Christopher Lee)'s forces. The cast also includes Ian McKellen, Bernard Hill and Karl Urban.

titles.title: The lost boys
titles.summary: Zeno Graton co-writes and directs this French-language LGBTQ+ drama starring Khalil Gharbia and Julian De Saint Jean. Joe (Gharbia) is preparing for his release from a juvenile detention centre, but everything changes with the arrival of William (De Saint Jean), whom Joe is attracted to. As the boys get to know each other, a forbidden romance ensues between them, and Joe begins to question whether his freedom matters more than being with William.

titles.title: The lost king
titles.summary: Stephen Frears directs this British drama starring Sally Hawkins, Steve Coogan and Harry Lloyd. Based on a true story, the film follows amateur historian Philippa Langley (Hawkins) as she begins an exhaustive search for the final resting place of King Richard III (Lloyd). After seeing a performance of Shakespeare's 'Richard III', Philippa becomes obsessed with re-examining the controversial king's legacy and solving the mystery of his lost remains.

titles.title: Love
titles.summary: Gaspar Noé writes, directs and produces this explicit romantic drama. The story follows American film student Murphy (Karl Glusman) who has split-up with his French girlfriend Elektra (Aomi Muyock) after cheating on her with another woman, named Omi (Klara Kristin). Two years later, a worried phone call from Elektra's mother causes Murphy to spend New Year's Eve in search of his former lover as he ponders how their relationship fell apart.

titles.title: Love & mercy
titles.summary: Bill Pohlad directs this biopic about the musician, songwriter and founding member of The Beach Boys. In the 1960s, emerging talent Brian Wilson (Paul Dano) struggles to comprehend the sudden fame that his hit records have brought him and his band, and, after a panic attack, he turns away from touring and sets his mind to focus on creating the greatest album ever made. Later on in his life, Wilson (John Cusack)'s struggles turn to ones of health and sanity as his therapist Dr. Eugene Landy (Paul Giamatti) sees it necessary to have his patient permanently medicated. When Wilson, a shadow of his former self, meets car saleswoman Melinda (Elizabeth Banks) she finds herself determined to rid the innocent man of his brainwashing doctor and recapture the talent that he once possessed.

titles.title: Love hurts
titles.summary: Jonathan Eusebio directs this action comedy starring Ke Huy Quan and Ariana DeBose. Real estate agent Marvin Gable (Quan) has changed his ways since leaving his previous career as a hitman, but when his past comes back to haunt him, his peaceful suburban life looks to be ruined. The cast also includes Daniel Wu and Sean Astin.

titles.title: Love in the Time of Cholera
titles.sortTitle: love in the time of cholera

titles.title: Love lies bleeding
titles.summary: Rose Glass writes and directs this romantic thriller set in 1989, starring Kristen Stewart, Katy O'Brian and Jena Malone. On the way to Las Vegas to compete in a bodybuilding competition, Jackie (O'Brian) passes through a small town where she meets gym manager Lou (Stewart) and the pair begin an intense love affair. Jackie, however, will do anything to achieve her dreams and Lou is entangled in her family's criminal enterprise, which forces both women into a vicious cycle of violence and increasing danger... The cast also includes Dave Franco, Anna Baryshnikov and Ed Harris.

titles.title: The love that remains
titles.summary: Saga Gardarsdóttir and Sverrir Gudnason star in this Icelandic comedy drama written and directed by Hlynur Pálmason. After his marriage breaks down, Maggi (Gudnason), a fisherman, struggles with what comes next. He has three children with his wife Anna (Gardarsdóttir), an artist, and continues to spend most of his time with the four of them when he is not out at sea. Over the course of a year, Maggi and Anna attempt to navigate their separation and what it means for their family.

titles.title: Lovecraft country: The complete first season
titles.sortTitle: lovecraft country: the complete first season
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the first season of the American horror drama starring Jurnee Smollett and Jonathan Majors. Based on Matt Ruff's novel, the show follows Korean war veteran Atticus Freeman (Majors) as he travels through 1950s America with his friend Letitia (Smollett) and uncle George (Courtney B. Vance) in search of his missing father, encountering racism and terrifying supernatural phenomena at every stop. The episodes are: 'Sundown', 'Whitey's On the Moon', 'Holy Ghost', 'A History of Violence', 'Strange Case', 'Meet Me in Daegu', 'I Am.', 'Jig-a-Boo', 'Rewind 1921' and 'Full Circle'.

titles.title: Loving Vincent
titles.summary: Dorota Kobiela and Hugh Welchman co-write and direct this animated biographical drama. The first fully hand-painted animated feature, the film tells the story of renowned Dutch painter Vincent Van Gogh (voice of Robert Gulaczyk) and the circumstances surrounding his death. Following the painter's suicide, young postman Armand Roulin (Douglas Booth) travels north from Arles in southern France to Auvers to deliver a final letter to Van Gogh's brother. Discovering that he is also dead, Armand decides to try and find out more about the mysterious circumstances surrounding the artist's sudden death. Speaking with those who were with him in the days before his suicide, Armand does his best to piece together the events which ultimately led to Van Gogh's tragic passing.

titles.title: Luca
titles.summary: Animated feature set on the Italian Riviera during the 1950s and 60s. Luca Paguro (voice of Jacob Tremblay) is a human-like sea monster who leads a lonely existence under the surface of the water with his parents, who do all they can to protect Luca from the human world. One day Luca meets a fellow sea monster, Alberto Scorfano (Jack Dylan Grazer). The two boys quickly strike up a friendship and Alberto encourages Luca to leave the sea and explore the land with him. What follows is an adventure that neither boy will ever forget, but as they travel and interact with the human population, Luca's parents set out to retrieve their son.

titles.title: Lucky - Dream champion
titles.summary: Children's feature about a young girl pursuing her dream of becoming a rodeo rider. When her mum decides to go away on holiday for the summer, teenager Priscilla (Sophie Bolen) is sent to live with the father she barely knows on his ranch in Michigan. As her dad Duke (Kevin Sorbo) finally steps up to the challenging duties of fatherhood, Priscilla trains with her horse Lucky in the hope of gaining a place at the National Youth Rodeo.

titles.title: Luis and the aliens
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. Eleven-year-old outcast Luis (voice of Callum Maloney) makes friends with three small aliens after they crash-land in the field opposite his house. While they search for the fabled Nubbi Dubbi massage mat they came to Earth for, Luis' new friends move into his house, where their shape-shifting powers cause all sorts of mayhem.

titles.title: Lunana - A yak in the classroom
titles.sortTitle: lunana - a yak in the classroom
titles.summary: Dzongkha-language drama written and directed by Pawo Choyning Dorji. In Bhutan, Ugyen (Sherab Dorji) has almost completed his teacher training when he is assigned to work in a school in the remote mountain village of Lunana. Harbouring dreams of moving to Australia and becoming a singer, Ugyen struggles to adjust to the villagers' way of life. However, he is soon won over by his pupils' enthusiasm for his teaching.

titles.title: Lyle, Lyle, crocodile
titles.summary: Josh Gordon and Will Speck direct this musical comedy adventure based on the children's books by Bernard Waber. Shawn Mendes provides the voice of Lyle, a crocodile who lives in the attic of a New York home and loves to sing but suffers with terrible stage fright. Lyle's owner Hector P. Valenti (Javier Bardem) is forced to leave the home and the Primm family move in. When Josh Primm (Winslow Fegley) discovers Lyle in the attic, the two become friends. Lyle wins over Mr and Mrs Primm (Scoot McNairy and Constance Wu) but their downstairs neighbour Mr Grumps (Brett Gelman) is annoyed by all the noise and begins to investigate. What will happen when he discovers Lyle?

titles.title: Ma ma
titles.summary: Penélope Cruz stars in this Spanish drama from film-maker Julio Medem. When unemployed teacher and single mother Magda (Cruz) is diagnosed with breast cancer, she begins to doubt everything around her. While watching her son play football she meets talent scout Arturo (Luis Tosar) who takes a shine to both Magda and her son. When Arturo receives a phone call with news that his wife and daughter have been in a car accident, Magda goes with him to the hospital. As she has told no-one else of her illness, Magda decides to confide in Arturo and the two grow closer, bonding over ill fate. When she discovers that she is pregnant Magda realises that she has something to live for and changes her ways to ensure she is around to see her daughter grow up.

titles.title: Mad Max: Fury road
titles.summary: Tom Hardy and Charlize Theron star in this fourth instalment of the post-apocalyptic action series from film-maker George Miller. Set in a desolate desert wasteland, the story follows Max (Hardy), who, following the murder of his wife and child, has been captured by a gang, led by the tyrannical Immortan Joe (Hugh Keays-Byrne). In order to escape his captors, Max teams up with Imperator Furiosa (Theron), a woman who wants to travel across the desert and find her way back home. But, after liberating five female captives from Joe's clutches, she too must escape from the crazy gang leader and his henchmen. Can they make it across the desert in one piece? The film was nominated for ten Academy Awards including Best Picture, Best Cinematography and Best Director, winning six statuettes in categories such as Best Production Design, Best Costume Design and Best Sound Mixing.

titles.title: Madagascar
titles.summary: CGI animated feature from Dreamworks Studios. When a group of pampered Central Park Zoo animals find themselves transported to the wild, they find that their easy life in captivity hasn't prepared them in the slightest for the real world. Alex the Lion (voiced by Ben Stiller), Marty the Zebra (Chris Rock), Gloria the Hippo (Jada Pinkett Smith) and Melman the Giraffe (David Schwimmer) are star attractions at the Central Park Zoo in New York. When they find themselves mixed up in an attempted zoo-break by the cunning penguins, the keepers decide that the animals are restless and return them to the wild. On the island of Madagascar, the animals are having a hard time adjusting, but when they meet eccentric King Julien (Sacha Baron Cohen), they start to find life a bit easier, even if Alex the Lion is gradually reverting to his more primal instincts.

titles.title: Mademoiselle Chambon
titles.summary: Stéphane Brizé directs this French romantic drama. Bricklayer Jean (Vincent Lindon) is a devoted husband and father with a simple yet contented life. But when he volunteers as a classroom assistant at his young son's school, Jean finds himself inexorably drawn to teacher Véronique Chambon (Sandrine Kiberlain) - and the threads that hold his home and family life together gradually begin to unravel.

titles.title: Madfabulous
titles.summary: Callum Scott Howells stars as the main character in this biopic about the life of Henry Cyril Paget, the 5th Marquess of Anglesey. In the late 19th century, Henry lives a flamboyant and extravagant lifestyle, amassing debts he cannot pay. Renowned in society for his elaborate parties and luxurious purchases, Henry quickly gains a less-than-favourable reputation and must deal with constant judgement from the outside. The cast also includes Rupert Everett, Siobhán McSweeney and Ruby Stokes.

titles.title: The magic faraway tree
titles.summary: Ben Gregor directs this family adventure based on the book series by Enid Blyton. When the Thompson family fall on hard times, they decide to move to the country to live a simpler life. While mum Polly (Claire Foy) and dad Tim (Andrew Garfield) attempt to renovate a dilapidated barn into a comfortable home, children Beth, Fran and Joe (Delilah Bennett-Cardy, Billie Gadsdon and Phoenix Laroche) discover an enchanted forest with a magical tree that can transport them to fantastical lands. The cast also includes Nicola Coughlan, Jennifer Saunders and Rebecca Ferguson.

titles.title: Magician - The astonishing life and work of Orson Welles
titles.sortTitle: magician - the astonishing life and work of orson welles
titles.summary: Documentary exploring the life and work of acclaimed film-maker Orson Welles. The feature chronicles his life from an early age when he was viewed as a musical prodigy at the age of 10 and subsequently directed Shakespeare, became an accomplished magician and starred on stage and radio before he turned 20. Featuring interviews with the man himself alongside those who admired and were influenced by his work, the film explores his career after co-writing, directing and starring in his first movie 'Citizen Kane' (1941), aged only 25. With footage from his catalogue of works as well as previously unseen material, the documentary follows his struggles as a Hollywood director and his battles for creative control with major film studios.

titles.title: The magnificent seven/The big country/The long riders
titles.sortTitle: magnificent seven/the big country/the long riders
titles.summary: Triple bill of classic westerns. 'The Magnificent Seven' (1960) stars Yul Brynner as Chris Adams, one of seven master gunmen who help the defenceless farmers of an outlying village, pitted against Calvera (Eli Wallach) and his army of bootlegging bandits in a tale based on Akira Kurosawa's classic 'Seven Samurai'. In 'The Big Country' (1958), when sea-captain Jim McKay (Gregory Peck) forgoes a life on the ocean waves and travels west to claim his bride Patricia Terrill (Carroll Baker), he finds more trouble than he bargained for. The Terrill clan are embroiled in a bitter feud over water rights with a rival family headed by Rufus Hannassey (Burl Ives). Both clans want access to land which belongs to Julie Maragon (Jean Simmons), and as their squabbling escalates, Jim and Julie find themselves caught up in the middle, doing their best to calm things down. In 'The Long Riders' (1980) Walter Hill follows in the footsteps of directors Nicholas Ray and Philip Kaufman, and presents his version of the story of the James-Younger gang. Hailed as heroes by many, and much celebrated for their attacks upon the railroad, the gang became the most famous band of outlaws in the country. They were eventually brought to ruin by the Pinkerton detective agency, losing many of their number in the ill-fated Northfield, Minnesota bank raid. Hill's film tells the whole story with explosive slow-motion violence, vivid period detail, and a cast made up of celebrity brothers (the Carradines, Keaches, Quaids and Guests).

titles.title: Maigret
titles.summary: Gérard Depardieu stars as the eponymous police detective in this crime drama co-written and directed by Patrice Leconte. In 1950s Paris, a girl is found dead, wearing an expensive rented gown. Maigret, recently advised by his doctor to take a break or consider retirement, begins to investigate, seeking to identify her and to find her killer. He soon learns that she came to Paris hoping for a better life, but lost her innocence and her dreams before ultimately losing her life. The cast also includes Jade Labeste, Aurore Clément, Mélanie Bernier, Anne Loiret and Pierre Moure.

titles.title: Make mine music
titles.summary: Disney's eighth animated feature is a musical extravaganza made up of ten short films. Included are 'Peter and the Wolf', 'Casey at the Bat', 'The Whale Who Wanted to Sing at the Met' and 'Johnnie Fedora and Alice Bluebonnet'.

titles.title: Mama
titles.summary: Two young sisters are haunted by the ghost of their dead mother in this paranormal horror from director Andrés Muschietti. On the day after their parents are killed, Victoria (Megan Charpentier) and Lilly (Isabelle Nélisse) disappear from their suburban home without a trace. Five years later, a man out walking in the woods discovers the now feral girls living in a rundown shack. As the girls try to return to a normal life after being taken in by their uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend Annabel (Jessica Chastain), chillingly ominous signs begin to convince the couple that, along with the girls, something else has come to stay.

titles.title: Mamma mia! Here we go again
titles.sortTitle: mamma mia! here we go again
titles.summary: Amanda Seyfried stars in this musical sequel directed by Ol Parker. Following on from the events of the first film, Sophie Sheridan (Seyfried) is running her mother Donna (Meryl Streep)'s villa on the Greek island of Kalokairi and is expecting her first baby with Sky (Dominic Cooper). Wondering what her life will be like raising a child, Sophie learns more about her mother's past and her experiences as a single mother. The cast also includes Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters and Colin Firth.

titles.title: The man who invented Christmas
titles.summary: Dan Stevens and Christopher Plummer star in this drama directed by Bharat Nalluri. Adapted from Les Standiford's novel of the same name, the film follows Charles Dickens (Stevens) as he attempts to get his career back on track with the release of his new book 'A Christmas Carol' in 1843. Having been rejected by his publishers following the failure of his previous work, Dickens sets about writing his new festive story in a hectic six-week period, combining real-life experiences with his vivid imagination to create a Christmas tale which could stand the test of time and become a family favourite for years to come. The cast also includes Jonathan Pryce, Miriam Margolyes and Donald Sumpter.

titles.title: The man who killed Hitler and then The Bigfoot
titles.sortTitle: man who killed hitler and then the bigfoot
titles.summary: Sam Elliott and Aidan Turner star in this American adventure drama from film-maker Robert D. Krzykowski. As a younger man during WWII, Calvin Barr (Turner) assassinates Adolf Hitler, changing the course of history forever. Now, decades later, Calvin (Elliott) reflects on the actions he took and how it changed him as a man. He is unaware, however, that his reputation precedes him, and has placed him in the spotlight of the FBI, who wish to put his deadly skills to use in tracing and killing the Bigfoot. Known to be carrying a deadly strain of influenza which has the potential to wipe out masses of civilisation, Calvin must use all of his learned experience to put a stop to potentially devastating events from taking place.

titles.title: The man with the answers
titles.summary: Stelios Kammitsis writes and directs this European indie drama. Following the death of his grandmother, former diving champion Victor (Vasilis Magouliotis) repairs her old car and goes on a road trip across Europe. Along the way he meets German student Matthias (Anton Weil), and despite their differences the pair travel to Italy.

titles.title: The man with the golden gun
titles.summary: Roger Moore stars as James Bond for the second time. Bond travels to the Far East to hunt for hired assassin Francisco Scaramanga (Christopher Lee), who appears to have Bond in his sights. However, it soon transpires that Scaramanga is really after a missing scientist, the creator of a pocket-sized solar converter. Bond and agent Mary Goodnight (Britt Ekland) race to the rescue.

titles.title: Manchester by the sea
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Kenneth Lonergan, starring Casey Affleck, Michelle Williams and Lucas Hedges. Lee Chandler (Affleck) has his life turned upside down when his older brother Joe (Kyle Chandler) dies suddenly and leaves his son Patrick (Hedges) all alone. Though reluctant at first, Lee feels he must accept his brother's wishes and become Patrick's legal guardian. This involves Lee returning to his hometown of Manchester in Massachusetts and facing all the complications that come with it, including his estranged ex-wife Randi (Williams) and certain members of the local community. Lee grapples with his new role as a father figure to Patrick and tries to support the young man with his problems, while still contending with his own. The film was nominated for five Golden Globe Awards, winning for Best Performance By an Actor in a Motion Picture - Drama (Affleck), as well as six BAFTAs, winning for Best Leading Actor (Affleck) and Best Original Screenplay (Lonergan), and six Academy Awards, winning for Best Actor (Affleck) and Best Original Screenplay (Lonergan).

titles.title: Manglehorn
titles.summary: Al Pacino stars as the titular character A.J. Manglehorn in this drama directed by David Gordon Green. Unable to recover from losing the love of his life, Clara Massey (Natalie Wilemon), 20 years previously, small-town Texas locksmith Manglehorn still writes her daily letters. Living a reclusive life alone with his cat Fanny, Manglehorn takes refuge in his job while only occasionally meeting his grown-up son Jacob (Chris Messina) and granddaughter Kylie (Skylar Gasper), and shunning the advances of friendly bank teller Dawn (Holly Hunter). Will he ever be able to escape his solitary existence and learn to love something other than his cat?

titles.title: Manhattan
titles.summary: Woody Allen co-writes, directs and stars in this romantic comedy drama. Isaac Davis (Allen) is a twice-divorced TV comedy writer, frustrated with both his career and his love life. An on-off affair with teenage drama student Tracy (Mariel Hemingway) is blighted by his anxiety about their age difference, whilst his attraction to the pretentious Mary (Diane Keaton) is complicated by the fact that she is already having an affair with his married friend Yale (Michael Murphy). Meanwhile, his lesbian ex-wife Jill (Meryl Streep) prepares to dish the dirt about their marriage in a forthcoming book.

titles.title: Maps to the stars
titles.summary: Julianne Moore, John Cusack and Mia Wasikowska star in this drama directed by David Cronenberg. Havana Segrand (Moore) is a mature actress struggling for work that her agent Stafford Weiss (Cusack) can't provide. While Stafford's wife Christina (Olivia Williams) is occupied with managing the life and schedule of their child star son Benjie (Evan Bird), who has just been released from rehab at the age of 13, their shunned daughter Agatha (Wasikowska) returns from a private sanatorium where she was being treated for criminal pyromania. As more details emerge about the reasons for Agatha's incarceration, Havana delves deeper into her own problems as she tries to confront the abuse she experienced as a child.

titles.title: Marcel the shell with shoes on
titles.sortTitle: marcel the shell with shoes on
titles.summary: Jenny Slate voices the titular character in this comedy drama combining live-action and stop-motion animation directed by Dean Fleischer-Camp. When documentary film-maker Dean (Fleischer-Camp) moves into an Airbnb after the collapse of his marriage, he discovers a one-inch-tall talking shell called Marcel living there with his grandmother, Nana Connie (voice of Isabella Rossellini) and Alan, their pet ball of lint. As Dean begins filming Marcel's adventures and posting them online, they discover the benefits and perils of sharing their lives on the internet, but all Marcel wants is to find his missing family members who were inadvertently taken by one of the house's previous occupants while hiding in a sock drawer.

titles.title: Marching powder
titles.summary: British comedy starring Danny Dyer as ageing football hooligan Jack Jones. After a matchday fight lands him in handcuffs, Jack is on his last chance with the law and his wife, Dani (Stephanie Leonidas), who is fed up with his behaviour. He is given six weeks to sort himself out or face time in prison and so Jack gets to work on improving his life. The cast also includes Calum MacNab, Daniel Fearn and Phillip Ray Tommy.

titles.title: Mare of Easttown
titles.summary: Kate Winslet stars as Easttown detective Marianne 'Mare' Sheehan in this seven-part HBO crime drama. In the small Pennsylvanian town of Easttown, Mare investigates the murder of teenage single mother Erin McMenamin (Cailee Spaeny), aided by county detective Colin Zabel (Evan Peters). Pressured into reopening a year-old missing person's case, Mare also faces a painful legal battle for custody of her grandson following her son's suicide. The episodes are: 'Miss Lady Hawk Herself', 'Fathers', 'Enter Number Two', 'Poor Sisyphus', 'Illusions', 'Sore Must Be the Storm' and 'Sacrament'.

titles.title: Maria
titles.summary: Angelina Jolie portrays opera singer Maria Callas in this biopic from director Pablo Larraín. With the backdrop of a television interview given four years after her retirement, the film follows the singer's final days as she fends off fans and critics all begging for one more performance while battling with addiction and the changes in her vocal ability. The cast also includes Pierfrancesco Favino, Alba Rohrwacher and Haluk Bilginer.

titles.title: Marry me
titles.summary: Jennifer Lopez and Owen Wilson star in this romantic comedy from director Kat Coiro. Kat Valdez (Lopez) is one half of the most popular couple in showbusiness alongside her boyfriend Bastian (Maluma). As part of their brand, they announce to their fans that they will get married live during their next concert. However, moments before the show Kat discovers that Bastian has been unfaithful and so she decides to marry a stranger from the audience instead. Forced to go to the concert by his daughter, divorced high school teacher Charlie Gilbert (Wilson) finds himself caught up in a whirlwind as he agrees to marry the pop superstar live on stage. Will the unlikely pair make it as husband and wife or will it all end in tears?

titles.title: Marshall
titles.summary: Chadwick Boseman stars in this biographical drama based on the life of the first African American Supreme Court Justice Thurgood Marshall. Before the height of his law career, as a young attorney, Marshall (Boseman) fights in a case alongside fellow inexperienced lawyer Sam Friedman (Josh Gad) in defence of a black chauffeur named Joseph Spell (Sterling K. Brown). Spell finds himself under investigation for sexual assault and attempted murder after being accused by his white employer Eleanor Strubing (Kate Hudson) and it is up to Marshall to prove the innocence of this man while also defeating racial prejudice in society.

titles.title: Martin Eden
titles.summary: Luca Marinelli stars in the title role of this drama based on Jack London's novel. In 20th-century Naples, Martin Eden is a young sailor who falls in love with aristocrat Elena Orsini (Jessica Cressy) after saving her brother from a beating. She inspires him to educate himself and he ultimately decides he wants to become a writer. He pursues his dream despite constant rejection, but his lack of money and lowly class status cause his relationship with Elena to deteriorate before he attains success.

titles.title: Marty supreme
titles.summary: Timothée Chalamet stars in this comedy drama co-written and directed by Josh Safdie. In 1950s New York City, Marty Mauser (Chalamet) believes in his heart that he is a world champion table tennis player. However, the sport is not taken seriously in America and is viewed as merely a hobby. As Marty pursues his dream, his personal and professional choices frequently alienate others and threaten any chance he has of achieving greatness. The cast also includes Gwyneth Paltrow, Odessa A'zion and Kevin O'Leary.

titles.title: Martyr
titles.summary: Lebanese drama written and directed by Mazen Khaled. Set in Beirut, the sudden drowning of a young man results in his family and friends coming together to ensure his safe burial. However, as different communities band together tensions arise over age-old traditions and how best to honour the life that has been lost.

titles.title: Mary Poppins returns
titles.summary: Emily Blunt stars in the titular role of this musical fantasy sequel. In 1930s London, recently widowed Michael Banks (Ben Whishaw) faces losing his family home on Cherry Tree Lane, which he shares with his sister Jane (Emily Mortimer), three children and housekeeper Ellen (Julie Walters), after getting into financial difficulties. At his lowest moment, nanny Mary Poppins returns to lend a helping hand and once again bring a little magic and adventure into the lives of the Banks family. The cast also includes Lin-Manuel Miranda, Colin Firth, Meryl Streep and Dick Van Dyke.

titles.title: Mary Queen of Scots
titles.summary: Historical drama starring Saoirse Ronan and Margot Robbie. Mary Stuart (Ronan) returns to her native Scotland to reclaim her throne at a time when England is ruled by her cousin Elizabeth I (Robbie). Despite both announcing their desire for peace Elizabeth feels threatened by Mary's legitimate claim to the English throne and when she produces an heir Elizabeth regards this as a direct threat to her sovereignty. This provocation leads Scotland and England closer to war as betrayal and rebellion threaten both thrones. The cast also features David Tennant and Guy Pearce.

titles.title: Masha and the bear: Holiday on ice
titles.sortTitle: masha and the bear: holiday on ice
titles.summary: Seven more episodes from the children's animated series based on the Russian folk tale. The programme follows the unlikely friendship of an adventurous little girl named Masha (voice of Elsie Fisher) and a woodland bear. The pair meet after the bear gives up his job as a performer in the circus and hopes to settle down to a peaceful life in the woods, only to be disturbed by Masha and tagged along on her adventures. The episodes are: 'Holiday On Ice', 'One, Two, Three! Light the Christmas Tree!', 'Picture Perfect', 'Tracks of Unknown Animals', 'Watch Out!', 'First Day of School' and 'No Trespassing'.

titles.title: The mastermind
titles.summary: Josh O'Connor stars in this comedy drama written and directed by Kelly Reichardt. In Framingham, Massachusetts in 1970, unemployed husband and father James Blaine Mooney (O'Connor) moonlights as a small-time art thief. When he hatches a plan to steal four paintings from a local museum, he is unprepared for the fallout when everything goes wrong. With the police on his trail, he is forced to go on the run and risks losing his family forever. The cast also includes Alana Haim, Hope Davis and John Magaro.

titles.title: Materialists
titles.summary: Dakota Johnson, Chris Evans and Pedro Pascal star in this romantic drama written and directed by Celine Song. Lucy Mason (Johnson) works at an exclusive matchmaking company in New York and has been responsible for nine marriages so far. Despite her professional success, she remains single. When she meets wealthy financier Harry Castillo (Pascal) and encounters her ex-boyfriend John Finch (Evans), still a struggling actor currently working as a waiter, on the same night, her romantic life is thrown into chaos. As Harry pursues her, Lucy must decide what it is she truly wants from life and love. The cast also includes Zoë Winters and Marin Ireland.

titles.title: The Matrix resurrections
titles.summary: Keanu Reeves and Carrie-Anne Moss return to star in this sci-fi action sequel directed by Lana Wachowski. 60 years after he sacrificed himself to save the world, Neo (Reeves) has reverted back to his previous identity of Thomas Anderson, and works as a video game designer in San Francisco. However, when a visit from Morpheus (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) leads him to question the nature of his reality, Neo finds himself facing off with his business partner, Smith (Jonathan Groff). The cast also includes Jessica Henwick, Neil Patrick Harris and Jada Pinkett Smith.

titles.title: Matthew Bourne's Romeo and Juliet
titles.summary: Shakespeare's classic tragedy is directed and choreographed by Matthew Bourne in this contemporary version set in an asylum for young people.

titles.title: Mavka: The forest song
titles.summary: Animated fantasy adventure inspired by Ukrainian folklore and based on 'The Forest Song' by Lesya Ukrainka. Mavka (voice of Nataliya Denisenko/Laurie Hymes) is chosen to be the guardian of the forest but when she meets Lucas (Artem Pivovarov/Eddy Lee), a human musician sent to her realm on a secret mission, she is soon torn between love and duty. Caught between two worlds, can she protect her forest from those who would destroy it?

titles.title: MaXXXine
titles.summary: Ti West directs this horror starring Mia Goth as Maxine Minx, an adult film actress who has just landed a lead role in a horror. Keen for the money, Maxine retains her part-time job at a peep show but during a performance she attracts unwanted attention from a cloaked figure who she confronts and scares away. When she learns that several of her friends and colleagues have been murdered, she takes it upon herself to investigate and avenge their deaths.

titles.title: May December
titles.summary: Todd Haines directs this drama starring Natalie Portman and Julianne Moore. Elizabeth (Portman) will soon be starring in a film portraying Gracie (Moore), a controversial woman who was the subject of public scrutiny due to her relationship with a minor. Gracie agrees to Elizabeth coming to spend the week with her so that Elizabeth can study her daily life and prepare for her role, whilst coming to terms with Gracie's past. When Gracie was 36, she had an indecent affair with 12-year-old Joe (Charles Melton), now her husband, and her notoriety has led to the development of a film based on her life. As Elizabeth learns more about Gracie, can she separate herself from the life she is trying to emulate?

titles.title: McQueen
titles.summary: Ian Bonhote directs this British documentary about renowned fashion designer Alexander McQueen. Born in Lewisham in London, McQueen served an apprenticeship on Saville Row before going on to become chief designer at luxury French fashion house Givenchy. The film charts McQueen's career and achievements while also giving an insight into the designer's own world.

titles.title: The measure of a man
titles.summary: Vincent Lindon stars in this French social drama co-written and directed by Stéphane Brizé. Having been laid-off more than a year ago, 51-year-old former factory worker Thierry Taugourdeau (Lindon) is increasingly struggling to make ends meet with his small monthly unemployment supplement. Trying desperately to provide for his wife (Karine De Mirbeck) and disabled teenage son (Matthieu Schaller), Thierry's lengthy search for work finally leads him to become an in-store security guard at a large supermarket where he is tasked with monitoring the store's CCTV system and deterring any potential thieves. How will he cope with dealing with his fellow desperate citizens who are also just trying their best to make ends meet?

titles.title: Meet the Robinsons
titles.summary: Time travelling animated Disney adventure about a young boy searching for family life in the future. Orphan Lewis is a twelve-year-old inventor who has created a 'Memory Scanner' that he hopes can capture memories of his real mother. Stolen from him by the 'Bowler Hat Guy', a figure from the future, Lewis is helped by the mysterious Wilbur Robinson, who transports him to his future world in his time-machine. While staying with Wilbur's eccentric family, Lewis soon gets the chance to track down his invention and save both the day, and the future.

titles.title: Megalopolis
titles.summary: Francis Ford Coppola writes and directs this fantasy sci-fi epic starring Adam Driver, Giancarlo Esposito and Nathalie Emmanuel. While the city of New Rome prepares to host the duel between forward-thinking Cesar Catilina (Driver) and Mayor Franklyn Cicero (Esposito), Julia Cicero (Emmanuel) must decide whether to support her father or her lover. The all-star cast also includes Aubrey Plaza, Shia LaBeouf, Jon Voight, Dustin Hoffman and Laurence Fishburne.

titles.title: Mektoub, my love
titles.summary: Abdellatif Kechiche writes and directs this French romantic comedy based on the novel 'La blessure, la vraie' by François Bégaudeau. Set in 1994, the film follows aspiring screenwriter Amin (Shaïn Boumedine) as he returns to his hometown of Sète in the south of France after quitting his studies in Paris to pursue his dream of becoming a writer. With his cousin Tony (Salim Kechiouche) by his side, Amin spends the summer relaxing at the beach and partying in nightclubs as he searches for love.

titles.title: Melancholia
titles.summary: Lars von Trier directs this sci-fi drama about the effects of depression on two sisters, Justine (Kirsten Dunst) and Claire (Charlotte Gainsbourg). Played out in two acts, the film opens with the wedding of Justine (Dunst) and Michael (Alexander Skarsgård): a sumptuous affair paid for by Justine's Claire (Charlotte Gainsbourg) and her husband John (Kiefer Sutherland). However, when Justine notices a strange star in the sky, she starts behaving oddly and the wedding is ruined. The film's second act follows Justine, now extremely weak and ill, after she goes to live with her sister. As Claire and John struggle to deal with Justine's condition, astronomy buff Claire becomes increasingly concerned about a large blue planet that is threatening to collide with the earth. Charlotte Rampling and John Hurt co-star.

titles.title: Memoir of a snail
titles.summary: Adam Elliot directs this stop-motion animated tragicomedy featuring the voice talents of Sarah Snook and Kodi Smit-McPhee. In Melbourne, Australia, Grace Pudel (Snook) lives with her twin brother Gilbert (Smit-McPhee) and their alcoholic father Percy (Dominique Pinon). Grace collects snails as a way to be close to her late mother who had the same hobby. When tragedy strikes the family once again, the twins are separated and sent to live at opposite ends of the country. As they endeavour to make their way back to each other, their individual lives begin to follow very different directions. The voice cast also includes Eric Bana, Nick Cave and Jacki Weaver.

titles.title: Men in black: International
titles.summary: Chris Hemsworth stars in this spin-off to 'Men in Black' (1997). 20 years ago, the Men in Black erased the memories of a young couple who were witnesses to alien activity. They didn't, however, erase the memory of their child who, two decades on, has found the MiB headquarters and is demanding a job. After an interview with Agent O (Emma Thompson), the newly-appointed Agent M (Tessa Thompson) is given a tutor in the form of Agent H (Hemsworth) who is tasked with showing M the ropes of MiB. When a series of alien attacks are reported in London, M and H are sent on a mission to save the world. The cast also includes Liam Neeson, Rebecca Ferguson and Rafe Spall.

titles.title: Men of hard skin
titles.summary: Argentinian gay-themed drama written and directed by José Campusano. The film follows Ariel (Wall Javier), a young man living and working on his father's rural farm. Although his father refuses to accept his homosexuality, Ariel has been involved in an exploitative relationship with an older Catholic priest for a number of years. When the clandestine relationship comes to an end, Ariel begins to embrace and explore his sexuality and begins a relationship with one of his father's employees.

titles.title: Mercy
titles.summary: Chris Pratt and Rebecca Ferguson star in this sci-fi thriller directed by Timur Bekmambetov. LAPD detective Chris Raven (Pratt) helped to develop the Mercy programme, an advanced judicial system powered by artificial intelligence which now acts as judge, jury and executioner for criminals on trial. When he awakens hungover and restrained in the courtroom to find himself accused of the murder of his wife Nicole (Annabelle Wallis), he has 90 minutes to prove his innocence to AI Judge Maddox (Ferguson) or face the consequences. However, as he fights to uncover the truth about what happened to Nicole, he realises that he is embroiled in a sinister conspiracy. The cast also includes Kali Reis, Chris Sullivan and Kenneth Choi.

titles.title: The mercy
titles.summary: Colin Firth stars in this British biographical drama directed by James Marsh. The film follows amateur yachtsman Donald Crowhurst (Firth)'s disastrous attempt to complete the 1968 Golden Globe round-the-world boat race. Burdened by financial troubles, Crowhurst enters the race in the hope of winning a cash prize which he intends to use as a lifeline for his failing business. However, after his boat runs into difficulties early in his voyage, Crowhurst is forced to make some tough decisions as he attempts to keep his fading hopes of victory alive. The cast also includes Rachel Weisz, David Thewlis and Ken Stott.

titles.title: Michael
titles.summary: Antoine Fuqua directs this musical biopic based on the life and career of Michael Jackson, portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson. Growing up in a musical family, Michael Jackson was destined to be in the limelight. From being frontman of the Jackson Five to branching out on his own, the film looks at how Michael created his own brand of unique showmanship, both on and off stage.

titles.title: Mickey 17
titles.summary: Robert Pattinson stars in this sci-fi comedy based on the novel by Edward Ashton. Mickey Barnes (Pattinson) lives an unsatisfying life on Earth. Wishing for something bigger and better, he applies to become an Expendable, a disposable soldier who regenerates every time he dies. Sent to work on the human colony of Niflheim, Mickey is assigned tasks that will determine if a new planet is habitable. As each assignment results in Mickey's death, a new Mickey is brought in, but when two Mickeys are allowed to exist simultaneously, they must figure out how to survive the brutal experiment. The cast also includes Mark Ruffalo, Toni Collette and Naomi Ackie.

holdings.status: In-transit from Jubilee Library to Patcham Library (Set: 07 Apr 2026)

titles.title: Microbe et gasoil
titles.summary: Michel Gondry writes and directs this French coming-of-age comedy about two teenage friends. Androgynous loner Daniel 'Microbe' (Ange Dargent), who gets picked on by his fellow school students, forms an unlikely friendship with cool new classmate Théo 'Gasoline' (Théophile Baquet). Together they build a caravan-type vehicle and go on a journey across the country. The film includes an appearance by Audrey Tautou as Microbe's mother.

titles.title: Mid90s
titles.summary: Jonah Hill makes his feature directorial debut with this downbeat coming-of-age drama set in Los Angeles during the 1990s. 13-year-old Stevie (Sunny Suljic) begins hanging out with a new group of friends by the skate shop. As he makes his first steps in the world of skateboarding he also sustains a bad injury prompting his mother Dabney (Katherine Waterston) to warn him against socialising with his new friends. However, life at home is troubled and Stevie continually gets beaten up by his older brother Ian (Lucas Hedges). Going against his mother's wishes Stevie continues to hang out with his new skating friends and shares in their experiences as he begins learning about the difficulties of young manhood.

titles.title: Midas man
