titles.summary: Joe Stephenson directs this docudrama following the journey of Brian Epstein, manager of The Beatles. In Liverpool in 1961, Brian Epstein (Jacob Fortune-Lloyd) manages his family's record store. After numerous requests for a record by a new local band, he goes to the Cavern Club to check them out. The band, The Beatles, impress Epstein with their set and he convinces them to let him be their manager. Changing their image, he gets them an audition with a major record label and begins their journey into stardom. The cast also includes Eddie Marsan, Jay Leno and Ed Speleers.

titles.title: Midsommar
titles.summary: Ari Aster writes and directs this American horror starring Florence Pugh, Jack Reynor and Will Poulter. Following a family tragedy, American student Dani (Pugh) decides to accompany her boyfriend Christian (Reynor) and his friends Mark (Poulter), Josh (William Jackson Harper) and Pelle (Vilhelm Blomgren) on a trip to Sweden to take part in a summer solstice festival that only takes place every 90 years. In Pelle's hometown, the friends initially receive a warm welcome but as the ceremonies and rituals get underway they begin to question their hosts' true intentions.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 28 Jan 2020); In-transit from Hangleton Library to Hove Library (Set: 14 Sep 2020)

titles.title: Midwinter of the spirit
titles.summary: Anna Maxwell Martin and David Threlfall star in this three-part ITV drama. Searching for help to solve the recent crucifixion of a satanist, Hereford police requests the assistance of exorcism expert Reverend Merrily Watkins (Maxwell Martin). Convinced that the victim was murdered, Merrily turns to the supernatural to find reasons for his death with the help of her fellow clergyman and mentor Huw Owen (Threlfall). Meanwhile, Merrily also tries to tend to a dying man haunted by an evil spirit and deal with her troublesome teenage daughter Jane (Sally Messham).

titles.title: Migration
titles.summary: Benjamin Renner directs this American children's animation featuring the voice talents of Elizabeth Banks, Danny DeVito and Kumail Nanjiani. The Mallards, a family of ducks, are preparing to embark on a new adventure away from the pond they call home. Dad Mack (voice of Nanjiani) is worried about the dangers of the wider world, however, and unsuccessfully attempts to convince wife Pam (Banks) and kids Dax (Caspar Jennings) and Gwen (Tresi Gazal) not to join a flock of ducks on their migration to Jamaica. As a reluctant Mack and the rest of the family set off on their journey, however, they must overcome all manner of hazards and obstacles along the way... The voice cast also includes Carol Kane, Awkwafina and David Mitchell.

titles.title: Military wives
titles.summary: Kristin Scott Thomas and Sharon Horgan star in this British drama about a group of military wives who come together to form a choir. With their husbands deployed in Afghanistan, their wives left behind at their English military base form a choir, led by officers' wives Kate (Scott Thomas) and Lisa (Horgan), to cope with their husbands' absence and take their minds off the conflict. What begins with some performances in the local village culminates in a televised concert performance at the Festival of Remembrance in London's Royal Albert Hall. Can the women come together to make the choir a success?

titles.title: Miller's girl
titles.summary: Jenna Ortega and Martin Freeman star in this drama written and directed by Jade Halley Bartlett. When a creative writing assignment causes the lives of 18-year-old high school student Cairo Sweet (Ortega) and her teacher Jonathan Miller (Freeman) to become dangerously entwined, the consequences will be far-reaching. The cast also includes Gideon Adlon, Bashir Salahuddin and Dagmara Dominczyk.

titles.title: Minari
titles.summary: Steven Yeun stars in this American drama written and directed by Lee Isaac Chung. Set in the 1980s, South Korean man Jacob (Yeun) moves his young family to a remote plot of land in rural Arkansas that he dreams of turning into a successful vegetable garden and farm. However, as they struggle with the demands of their new life and raising their two American-born children, his wife Monica (Yeri Han) sends for her mother (Youn Yuh-jung) from Korea to help raise the children. Her unorthodox manner is at odds with her grandchildren and their expectation of what a grandmother should be, especially young boy David (Alan Kim). Meanwhile, Jacob and Monica deliberate over how best to achieve their dreams.

titles.title: A Minecraft movie
titles.summary: Jared Hess directs this adventure comedy based on the popular video game Minecraft. When a group of misfits - Garrett (Jason Momoa), Dawn (Danielle Brooks), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Henry (Sebastian Hansen) - all get pulled through a portal into an alternate universe called Overworld, they must band together to try to get back home. Relying on their imagination as the world demands, they work with expert crafter Steve (Jack Black) to hone their skills when unexpected challenges are thrown their way.

titles.title: The Miniaturist
titles.summary: British television drama based on the novel by Jessie Burton in which a young woman arrives at a grand house where she is to fulfil her duties as a wife to a wealthy man. At first greeted by her sullen and mysterious sister-in-law, it is some time before she at last meets her new husband who gives her a wedding gift of a doll's house, a scale replica of their lavish home. Strange things begin to occur in her surroundings however, and it soon becomes apparent that it may all be caused by the doll's house.

titles.title: Minions
titles.summary: Pierre Coffin and Kyle Balda direct this animated prequel to the 2010 hit 'Despicable Me'. Before Gru, the Minions have served many a despicable master throughout history, including Genghis Khan, Napoleon and Dracula. However, having contributed to their masters' downfalls through a series of mishaps, the Minions find themselves living in Antarctica with no one to serve. A number of years pass and it isn't until 1968 that dispirited Minions Kevin, Stuart and Bob (all voiced by Coffin) set off to New York City to attend a villain convention and find themselves a new master. Here they meet the ambitious and dastardly Scarlet Overkill (Sandra Bullock), who, with the help of her husband Herb (Jon Hamm), plans to take over the world...

titles.title: Minions & monsters
titles.summary: Pierre Coffin directs this animated comedy adventure which serves as the seventh instalment of the 'Despicable Me' franchise. In the 1920s, a tribe of Minions are in search of new villains to serve but when they interrupt the making of a silent film, they become Hollywood stars. However, because their language is incomprehensible to humans, they struggle to cope when silent films give way to sound. Hoping to make their own film and recapture their previous success, they search for monsters to fight but instead find themselves at the centre of a plot to destroy the world. The voice cast includes Trey Parker, Allison Janney and Christoph Waltz.

titles.title: Minions: The rise of Gru
titles.summary: Animated prequel featuring the voice of Steve Carell. Young Gru (Carell) is a fan of supervillain supergroup the Vicious 6 and so he hatches a plan to become evil enough to join them. Together with his loyal Minions, he builds his first lair and experiments with weapons. However, when he interviews to join the Vicious 6, it goes badly, and things soon get even worse when he outsmarts them and becomes their mortal enemy.

titles.title: Miracle on 34th Street
titles.summary: Richard Attenborough stars in this remake of the 1947 classic, telling the heart-warming story of a young girl's desire for a fully-functional family, complete with a father and a baby brother. The girl, Susan (Mara Wilson), confides in Kris Kringle (Attenborough), the kindly old man who is acting as the grotto Santa in the department store managed by her mother (Elizabeth Perkins). Kris Kringle, however, believes he is the genuine Santa Claus and this devotion to the cause makes him very popular indeed, leading to record profits for the store. This annoys rival retailers so much that they try to discredit the so-called Santa, leading eventually to a court case in which Kringle and his lawyer try to prove that he is the real thing.

titles.title: Miraculous - Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir: Volume 3
titles.sortTitle: miraculous - tales of ladybug & cat noir: volume 3
titles.summary: Six episodes from the CGI-animated series which follows the adventures of two Parisian teenage superheroes. Marinette Dupain-Cheng (voice of Cristina Valenzuela) lives a normal teenage life with one major exception - she has the miraculous power to transform into the superheroine Ladybug. She uses her special power, Lucky Charm, to fight crime on the streets of Paris with her superhero partner Cat Noir, unaware that beneath his mask is the object of her affection Adrien Agreste (Bryce Papenbrook). Together, the pair take on the evil supervillain Hawk Moth (Keith Silverstein) who is using his powers to populate Paris with more supervillains. The episodes are: 'Gamer', 'Animan', 'Antibug', 'The Puppeteer', 'Reflekta' and 'Princess Fragrance'.

titles.title: Miraculous - Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir: Volume 4
titles.sortTitle: miraculous - tales of ladybug & cat noir: volume 4
titles.summary: Six more episodes from the CGI-animated series which follows the adventures of two Parisian teenage superheroes. Marinette Dupain-Cheng (voice of Cristina Valenzuela) lives a normal teenage life with one major exception - she has the miraculous power to transform into the superheroine Ladybug. She uses her special power, Lucky Charm, to fight crime on the streets of Paris with her superhero partner Cat Noir, unaware that beneath his mask is the object of her affection Adrien Agreste (Bryce Papenbrook). Together, the pair take on the evil supervillain Hawk Moth (Keith Silverstein) who is using his powers to populate Paris with more supervillains. The episodes are: 'Pixelator', 'Guitar Villain', 'Simon Says', 'Ladybug Origins: Part 1', 'Stoneheart Origins: Part 2' and 'Volpina'.

titles.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir - A Christmas special
titles.sortTitle: miraculous: tales of ladybug and cat noir - a christmas special
titles.summary: Christmas special from the children's animation which follows the adventures of two Parisian teenage superheroes. In this instalment, Adrien (voice of Bryce Papenbrook) is disappointed when he thinks his father does not want to celebrate Christmas, so, after turning into Cat Noir, he leaves to roam the Parisian streets in the snow. When Cat Noir's father becomes worried about his whereabouts, Marinette (Cristina Valenzuela) turns into Ladybug to help find him. Meanwhile, Hawk Moth (Keith Silverstein) is out causing trouble and terrorises a Santa Clause.

titles.title: Miroirs no. 3
titles.summary: Christian Petzold writes and directs this German drama starring Paula Beer and Barbara Auer. When Laura (Beer)'s boyfriend is killed in a car accident, witness Betty (Auer) offers to take her in and care for her. However, is Betty's kindness sincere or is there something deeper going on? The cast also includes Philip Froissant, Matthias Brandt and Hendrik Heutmann.

titles.title: Mirror
titles.summary: Experimental Russian drama co-written and directed by Andrei Tarkovsky in which a dying man looks back on his life and his relationships with his parents, his wife and his son. The narrative includes a number of reflections on the Russian people and their history, using the life of one man to consider the Russian experience from World War II through to the end of the Stalinist period. The cast includes Margarita Terekhova, Ignat Danilstev and Oleg Yankovskiy.

titles.title: The miseducation of Cameron Post
titles.summary: Chloë Grace Moretz stars in this coming-of-age drama based on the novel by Emily M. Danforth. Set in 1993, orphaned teenager Cameron Post (Moretz) is seen in a car kissing another girl. Concerned that she is heading down the wrong path, her aunt, now her guardian, sends her to a conversion camp called God's Promise where she and those around her are subjected to therapies designed to quash their homosexual thoughts. The cast also includes Jennifer Ehle, Marin Ireland, Quinn Shephard and Sasha Lane.

titles.title: Misericordia
titles.summary: Alain Guiraudie writes and directs this French thriller starring Félix Kysyl and Catherine Frot. When Jérémie (Kysyl) receives news that his former boss has died, he travels home to attend the funeral. Accepting the hospitality of his boss's widow Martine (Frot), Jérémie's presence upsets her son Vincent (Jean-Baptiste Durand), causing tension which soon culminates in a stand-off. The cast also includes Jacques Develay, David Ayala and Sebastien Faglain.

titles.title: Miss Moxy
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. When Miss Moxy the cat (voice of Tess Bryant) is separated from her beloved owner whilst on holiday, she embarks on an epic quest to return home. As she travels across Europe she makes new friends and she will need their help if she is to find her way safely back.

titles.title: Miss Peregrine's home for peculiar children
titles.sortTitle: miss peregrine's home for peculiar children
titles.summary: Tim Burton directs this fantasy adventure based on the bestselling book by Ransom Riggs. When Jacob Portman (Asa Butterfield)'s grandfather dies, he leaves him clues to a mysterious place called Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children. As Jacob determines to discover the story behind this strange establishment and the unusual Miss Peregrine (Eva Green), he finds that the peculiar children in question are so-called because they have extraordinary powers and it is his destiny to protect them from an evil force intent on destroying them. The all-star cast includes Judi Dench, Samuel L. Jackson, Chris O'Dowd and Rupert Everett.

titles.title: Missing link
titles.summary: Stop-motion animation featuring the voice talents of Hugh Jackman, Zach Galifianakis and Zoe Saldana. In search of a legendary creature, said to be the missing evolutionary link between man and beast, Sir Lionel Frost (Jackman) discovers the giant, talking Mr. Link (Galifianakis), the last of his kind, who enlists the help of the monster investigator to find his distant cousins. The duo joins forces with adventurer Adelina Fortnight (Saldana) and set off on an adventure across the globe to find Mr. Link's distant relatives and potentially make the discovery of the century.

titles.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead reckoning
titles.summary: Tom Cruise reprises his role as Impossible Mission Force (IMF) agent Ethan Hunt in this seventh instalment of the action franchise. Hunt and his team are tasked with saving the world from a new threat, an artificial intelligence known as The Entity, which has the ability to dismantle the world's infrastructure and bring about global war. They must locate both halves of the key needed to control or destroy it, but they are not the only ones searching... The cast also includes Hayley Atwell, Simon Pegg, Rebecca Ferguson, Ving Rhames, Pom Klementieff and Esai Morales.

titles.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
titles.summary: Tom Cruise reprises his role as Impossible Mission Force (IMF) agent Ethan Hunt in the sixth film of the action thriller series. When an IMF operation goes badly wrong, Ethan finds himself isolated and unsure of who to trust as he attempts to complete his original mission. With the CIA questioning his motives and deadly assassin August Walker (Henry Cavill) on his tail, Ethan recruits his old IMF team as they bid to save the world from impending disaster. The cast also includes Simon Pegg, Rebecca Ferguson, Ving Rhames and Alec Baldwin.

titles.title: Mission: Impossible - The final reckoning
titles.summary: Tom Cruise reprises his role as Impossible Mission Force (IMF) agent Ethan Hunt in this eighth instalment of the action franchise. Hunt and his team race to prevent an artificial intelligence known as The Entity from starting a global nuclear war that will destroy the world. Their mission takes them from the depths of the North Pacific Ocean to a secure bunker in South Africa but if they are to have any hope of defeating The Entity, they must be willing to sacrifice everything. The cast also includes Hayley Atwell, Simon Pegg and Ving Rhames.

titles.title: The Mitchells vs. the machines
titles.summary: Michael Rianda and Jeff Rowe write and direct this animated adventure featuring the voice talents of Olivia Colman, Danny McBride and Maya Rudolph. The Mitchells are a normal family trying to live their normal lives. When Katie Mitchell gets accepted into film school, her parents plan one last family holiday before her departure. On their journey however, they find themselves caught in the middle of a robot uprising, with the machines' mission to capture all humans on planet Earth.

titles.title: Moana
titles.summary: Catherine Laga'aia stars as the eponymous heroine in this live-action remake of the 2016 Disney animation. When the future of her peaceful island home is threatened, Moana vows to do whatever it takes to save her people. She sets out on a daring sea voyage to find the shape-shifting demigod Maui (Dwayne Johnson) who stole the heart of Te Fiti, the goddess of nature, many years ago. If Moana is to fulfil her destiny, she and Maui must restore Te Fiti's heart but as they traverse the ocean together, they encounter difficult conditions and dangerous creatures and soon, Moana discovers that Maui may not be the hero he proclaims himself to be.

titles.title: Moana
titles.summary: Disney animated adventure set in ancient Polynesia. When a fiery ocean demon threatens her peaceful island home, Moana (voice of Auli'i Cravalho) vows to save her people. Putting her navigation skills to the test, she sets out on a daring sea voyage to find the demigod Maui (Dwayne Johnson) who stole the heart of Te Fiti, the goddess of nature, many years ago. If Moana is to fulfil her destiny, she and Maui must restore Te Fiti's heart but as they traverse the ocean together, they encounter difficult conditions and dangerous creatures and soon, Moana discovers that Maui may not be the hero he proclaims himself to be. The voice cast also includes Jemaine Clement, Rachel House, Temuera Morrison and Nicole Scherzinger.

titles.title: Moana 2
titles.summary: Auli'i Cravalho and Dwayne Johnson reprise their roles in this animated adventure sequel. Moana (voice of Cravalho) has been exploring nearby islands in search of other communities connected to the ocean when she receives a vision from her ancestor. After learning that the storm god Nalo (Tofiga Fepulea'i) sunk the legendary island of Motufetu, which connected all islands, and that if it remains submerged then her home of Motunui will soon be uninhabited, Moana assembles a crew to find it. Meanwhile, Maui (Johnson) is also seeking Motufetu when he runs afoul of Nalo's enforcer Matangi (Awhimai Fraser), but Maui and Moana will need to work together if they are to have any hope of raising Motufetu from the depths of the ocean. The voice cast also includes Temuera Morrison, Nicole Scherzinger and Alan Tudyk.

titles.title: Moffie
titles.summary: South African drama focusing on a young gay soldier coming to terms with his sexuality, co-written and directed by Oliver Hermanus. In 1981, 18-year-old Nicholas Van der Swart (Kai Luke Brummer) is conscripted into the South African Defence Force and sent to fight in their ongoing border war with communist Angola. As he undergoes basic training, led by the callous Sergeant Brand (Hilton Pelser), Nicholas must adapt to life in the barracks as he strikes up a relationship with fellow conscript Dylan Stassen (Ryan de Villiers).

titles.title: Mog's christmas
titles.summary: British children's animation based on the book by Judith Kerr and narrated by Adjoa Andoh. As the Thomas family prepare the home for Christmas, their cat Mog (voice of Tacy Kneale) becomes overwhelmed by all of the new festive sights and sounds and scarpers up to the roof. The Thomases attempt to coax Mog back down, but before she returns she sets off on a thrilling Christmas adventure.

titles.title: Molly monster
titles.summary: Children's animation based on the German cartoon character Molly Monster. Molly (voice of Sophie Rois) is quite happy being an only child, spending her days having fun with her toy friend Edison (voice of Jay Simon). When Molly's mother announces that Molly is to become a big sister, she realises her life is about to change. While the egg is taken to Egg Island by her father who must wait for it to hatch, Molly decides to embark on a journey to see what it means to be a big sister.

titles.title: Molly Moon and the incredible book of hypnotism
titles.sortTitle: molly moon and the incredible book of hypnotism
titles.summary: Christopher N. Rowley co-writes and directs this children's fantasy adventure adapted from Georgia Byng's novel. After discovering a magical book on hypnotism, orphan Molly Moon (Raffey Cassidy) uses its powers to escape her glum orphanage life and travel to London in search of her friend Rocky (Jadon Carnelly-Morris). With the bright lights of the city quickly causing a distraction, Molly soon deviates from her quest and mesmerises her way into the lead role of her very own musical, becoming a singing sensation overnight. Trouble is not far away however, as Molly's new-found fame attracts the attention of bungling criminal Simon Nockman (Dominic Monaghan), who attempts to steal the magic book to use as part of his latest robbery scheme. The cast also includes Emily Watson, Joan Collins and Omid Djalili.

titles.title: Molly's game
titles.summary: Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba and Kevin Costner star in this US drama which marks the directorial debut of writer Aaron Sorkin. Following the rise and fall of entrepreneur Molly Bloom (Chastain/Samantha Isler), the story follows Bloom as she plans one of the most exclusive high-stakes poker games in history. Managing to run her game for nearly ten years, Bloom suddenly finds herself the subject of an FBI investigation but with her players including members of the Hollywood elite as well as business tycoons and the Russian mob, Bloom faces the ethical dilemma of protecting their anonymity or facing trial herself.

titles.title: The monkey
titles.summary: Osgood Perkins directs this comedy horror based on the short story by Stephen King. When twin brothers Hal and Bill (Theo James) rediscover their father's toy monkey which they had tried to destroy when they were children, the monkey begins to take over their lives and kill everyone in its way. The cast also includes Adam Scott, Elijah Wood and Sarah Levy.

titles.title: Monsoon
titles.summary: Henry Golding stars in this drama as Kit, a young man who travels back to his home country of Vietnam after fleeing with his family at the age of six during the Vietnam war. A year after the death of his mother, Kit flies out to Vietnam to gain a sense of self and explore the roots of his culture. However, despite visiting the place where he spent the first few years of his life, he struggles to find a sense of belonging and must find new ways to embrace his identity.

titles.title: Monster
titles.summary: Sakura Andô stars in this Japanese coming-of-age drama directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda. Saori Mugino (Andô) is a single mother to her son Minato (Soya Kurokawa) and when he starts behaving strangely, she suspects that his teacher Mr Hori (Eita Nagayama) is to blame. When she confronts the school, Mr Hori is fired but Saori is unsatisfied with the outcome. As both adults continue to investigate what is wrong with Minato, they uncover the unexpected secret that he has been hiding.

titles.title: A monster calls
titles.summary: Based on the bestselling novel, this fantasy drama adaptation is directed by J.A. Bayona and written by Patrick Ness. Young Conor (Lewis MacDougall) struggles to deal with his mother (Felicity Jones)'s terminal illness, the heartless grandmother (Sigourney Weaver) he must stay with, and the bullying he receives at school from Harry (James Melville). Gripped by guilt, anger and fear, Conor is given support from a quite unlikely source: a drawing of a great, ancient tree monster (voice of Liam Neeson) that comes to life. The monster visits Conor at night to tell him stories and help him come to terms with his difficult situation. With the monster at his back, Conor faces his problems directly with courage and conviction.

titles.title: Monster family
titles.summary: Animated adventure directed by Holger Tappe. Struggling to deal with an overworked husband and two grumpy teenagers, Emma Wishbone (voice of Emily Watson) tries to bring her family back together by organising a night out to a Halloween party. However, the Wishbones soon find themselves in trouble when they are cursed by a witch and turned into monsters. Forced to work together, the family must do all they can to figure out how to break the curse and get back to normal. The cast also includes the voice talents of Catherine Tate, Jason Isaacs and Nick Frost.

titles.title: Monster trucks
titles.summary: Children's action adventure directed by Chris Wedge. Desperate to escape life in small-town America, high school student Tripp (Lucas Till) begins to build a monster truck from pieces of scrapped cars as his ticket to bigger and better things. His creation gets an unexpected upgrade when a strange subterranean creature is let loose by an accident at a local oil-drilling site and takes up residence in his truck. After discovering his unlikely companion has a serious taste for speed, Tripp and his friend Meredith (Jane Levy) realise they may just have found the escape route they were looking for. The cast also includes Amy Ryan, Barry Pepper and Danny Glover.

titles.title: Monsters and men
titles.summary: American drama set in Brooklyn, written and directed by Reinaldo Marcus Green. When the police fatally shoot a black man on a street corner and the incident is recorded by Manny (Anthony Ramos) he must consider the risk of sharing the footage and potentially jeopardising his ability to support his young family. The subsequent aftermath is then told from three perspectives that highlight the far-reaching consequences such an event places on different individuals within the local community as it forces them to question their own moral duty.

titles.title: Monsters university
titles.summary: Pixar animated sequel to 'Monsters, Inc.' (2001) chronicling the university years of James P. 'Sulley' Sullivan (voice of John Goodman) and Michael 'Mike' Wazowski (Billy Crystal). After meeting in college, Sulley and Mike soon become rivals. When they are rejected from the 'Scare' programme, however, the two put their differences aside and work together in order to fulfil their ambition to become scarers. In the process they join a fraternity of fellow rejects and compete in the Scare Games to prove their worth. The film also features the voice talents of Helen Mirren and Steve Buscemi.

titles.title: Monsters, inc
titles.summary: Children's animated feature from Disney Pixar featuring the voice talents of John Goodman and Billy Crystal. Sulley (Goodman) and sidekick Mike (Crystal) are the top scaring team on the job at an energy firm where their task is to keep Monstropolis ticking over, running it on the power generated by children screaming. Believing children are toxic, dangerous creatures who must be kept out of Monstropolis at all costs, Mike and Sulley are terrified when they realise that a little girl called 'Boo' (Mary Gibbs) has followed them back through a door. Slowly they realise that little Boo isn't actually dangerous at all and uncover a sinister plot that exists behind the company's happy facade, involving creepy arch-rival scarer Randall (Steve Buscemi).

titles.title: Moomins on the Riviera
titles.summary: Family animation about the characters created by Tove Jansson. When the tranquility of Moominvalley is interrupted by pesky pirates, the family set sail on their own adventure to the French Riviera. After battling ferocious storms and tired from the long journey, the family are at first fascinated by the high society they encounter at their destination. Moominpappa (Nathaniel Parker) loves the lifestyle so much he adopts the name de Moomin to fit in better with his new friends, securing entry to the best hotel in the process, while Snorkmaiden (Stephanie Winiecki) is infatuated with a rich bachelor who dazzles her with his wealth. But it appears not all the family are as taken with the outlandish ways of the Riviera when Moominmamma (Tracy Ann Oberman) retreats to the shelter and calm of the boat and waits for the family to be reunited.

titles.title: Moominvalley: The complete first series
titles.summary: All 13 episodes from the rebooted animated family drama based on the comic strips and novels by Tove and Lars Jansson which follows the adventures of young Moomintroll (voice of Taron Egerton) and all his friends and family in the peaceful and picturesque Moominvalley. The cast also includes the voice talents of Rosamund Pike, Matt Berry and Warwick Davis. The episodes are: 'Little My Moves In', 'The Spring Tune', 'The Last Dragon in the World', 'Moominsummer Madness', 'The Golden Tale', 'The Secret of the Hattifatteners', 'Snufkin and the Park Keeper', 'Monster Fish', 'Night of the Groke', 'Moominmama's Maid', 'Ghost Story', 'The Invisible Child' and 'Midwinter Ancestor'.

titles.title: Moon and me: Pepi Nana's letter & other episodes
titles.sortTitle: moon and me: pepi nana's letter & other episodes
titles.summary: First six episodes of the children's animation which follows the adventures of magical doll Pepi Nana. When the Moon shines bright, Pepi Nana comes alive at night. When she writes a letter to the Moon, Pepi is visited by Moon Baby, who comes down to her toy house to hear a special story. The episodes are: 'Pepi Nana's Letter', 'Pepi Nana Crosses the Bridge', 'The Big Tea', 'Who Rides What?', 'Everybody in the Tub!' and 'Humpty Onion'.

titles.title: Moonage daydream
titles.summary: Brett Morgen directs this in-depth look at the life and career of David Bowie. Featuring footage of Bowie performing and being interviewed as well as previously unseen concert footage released by his estate, the documentary follows his creative journey to become one of the most successful artists in musical history.

titles.title: Moonlight
titles.summary: Barry Jenkins writes and directs this drama starring Trevante Rhodes, André Holland and Janelle Monáe. The story is divided into three different timelines, each focusing on Chiron - played by Alex R. Hibbert, Ashton Sanders and Rhodes - at different stages in his life. As a child, Chiron is nicknamed 'Little' because of his diminutive size and shy demeanour. He struggles with bullying at school and becomes involved with a drug dealer and his girlfriend who look after him when Chiron can no longer bear to be around his abusive mother Paula (Naomie Harris). As he also begins to explore his sexuality, Chiron grows into his teenage years and becomes a more resilient adult, but the travails of his upbringing and the experiences of his younger years may never truly leave him. The film was nominated for four BAFTAs, six Golden Globe Awards, winning for Best Motion Picture - Drama, and eight Academy Awards, winning for Best Picture, Best Supporting Actor (Mahershala Ali) and Best Adapted Screenplay (Jenkins).

titles.title: Mortal engines
titles.summary: Post-apocalyptic adventure starring Hugo Weaving. Set in the future where cities are motorised and capable of consuming smaller traction towns Thaddeus Valentine (Weaving) is the chief navigator of London, one of the most powerful predator cities in the world. When she was only eight-years-old Hester Shaw (Hera Hilmar)'s mother (Caren Pistorius) was murdered by Thaddeus. Years later Hester enlists the help of rogue outlaw Anna Fang (Jihae) and outcast Tom Natsworthy (Robert Sheehan) to seek retribution for her mother's death.

titles.title: Most beautiful island
titles.summary: Ana Asensio writes, directs and stars in this US thriller. The film follows a day in the life of illegal immigrant Luciana (Asensio) as she struggles to survive in New York City. Unable to make enough money from her two jobs to pay the bills, Luciana turns to her Russian friend Olga (Natasha Romanova) for advice. She offers Luciana a mysterious opportunity to make some quick cash that night but when Luciana arrives at the specified location in a black cocktail dress, as instructed, she finds herself in a dark basement and ordered to stand with a group of like-minded desperate women who are selected one by one to enter into the next room to face an unknown fate...

titles.title: mother!
titles.summary: Jennifer Lawrence and Javier Bardem star in this psychological horror written and directed by Darren Aronofsky. The film follows a successful poet (Bardem) and his young wife (Lawrence) as they settle in to their new home in the remote countryside. Their peaceful existence is soon shattered however, as they are joined at the house by some uninvited guests including a doctor (Ed Harris), his wife (Michelle Pfeiffer) and two brothers (Domhnall and Brian Gleeson). With mysterious visitors continuing to arrive at the house, the wife's fragile mental state quickly deteriorates as she begins to experience a number of increasingly threatening and disturbing visions.

titles.title: Motherfatherson
titles.summary: Eight-part BBC drama starring Richard Gere, Helen McCrory and Billy Howle. Max Finch (Gere) is a divorced media mogul who wields great power and influence in world politics and whose son Caden (Howle), in an attempt to emulate his father, runs the family paper, The National Reporter, as editor-in-chief. Under intense pressure, Caden's self-destructive lifestyle begins to spiral out of control and causes him to have a devastating stroke. The tragedy reunites Max with his ex-wife Kathryn (McCrory), as they come together to care for their son. However, with a British general election looming, the family try to resolve their issues while Caden struggles with his recovery, but their secrets threaten to destroy Max's empire.

titles.title: Mothering Sunday
titles.summary: Odessa Young, Josh O'Connor and Olivia Colman star in this British drama based on Graham Swift's novel. On Mothering Sunday 1924, Jane Fairchild (Young), a 22-year-old maid employed at Beechwood House by Mr and Mrs Niven (Colin Firth and Colman), spends the day with her clandestine lover, law student Paul Sheringham (O'Connor), who is engaged to be married. However, that afternoon a devastating event takes place which alters the course of Jane's life.

titles.title: Mr Bean - The animated adventures: Egg and Bean
titles.sortTitle: mr bean - the animated adventures: egg and bean
titles.summary: Another eight episodes from the animated series based on the popular British television comedy about the eccentric loner and his slapstick adventures. In this collection, Mr Bean (voice of Rowan Atkinson) attempts to clean up his messy room, adopts an orphaned bird and decides to go on a holiday to the seaside. The episodes are: 'Spring Clean', 'Egg and Bean', 'Ice Cream', 'Hopping Mad', 'A New Friend', 'Holiday for Teddy', 'Ray of Sunshine' and 'Scout Bean'.

titles.title: Mr Holmes
titles.summary: Ian McKellen stars as the famous sleuth Sherlock Holmes in this crime drama adaptation directed by Bill Condon. Set in 1947, the long-retired detective, now aged 93, lives in exile and spends his days tending to his bees and completing his memoirs. As Holmes examines the numerous achievements of his life, he finds himself continually troubled by his last ever case involving a beautiful woman (Hattie Morahan) which still remains unsolved. With his health failing, and his mind not as sharp as it once was, Holmes uses his fragmented memories of the case to try and piece the mystery together.

titles.title: Mr. Burton
titles.summary: Marc Evans directs this biopic based on the life of Welsh actor Richard Burton. In the small town of Port Talbot, wayward schoolboy Richard Jenkins (Harry Lawtey) struggles to focus, earning a reputation as a disruptive child. His teacher, Philip Burton (Toby Jones), however, recognises his potential and takes him under his wing to guide him into the world beyond school. The cast also includes Lesley Manville, Aimee-Ffion Edwards and Steffan Rhodri.

titles.title: Mr. Peabody and Sherman
titles.summary: Robert Minkoff directs this animated adventure feature in which an ingenious talking dog and his human sidekick attempt to avert disaster. Mr. Peabody (voice of Ty Burrell) has the achievements to support claims that he is the smartest being on Earth. An influential and highly successful scientist, inventor, businessman and all-round polymath, he also happens to be a dog who, in a somewhat unusual turn of events, has adopted a human boy, Sherman (Max Charles), to look after. However, when the curious Sherman creates havoc with Mr. Peabody's latest invention, the WABAC time-travelling machine, the duo must embark on an adventure through history to try and put things right, meeting figures including Leonardo Da Vinci (Stanley Tucci) and Sigmund Freud (Mel Brooks) along the way.

titles.title: Mrs Lowry and son
titles.summary: Adrian Noble directs this biographical drama centred on renowned English artist L. S. Lowry, following Lowry (Timothy Spall) as he draws inspiration from his industrial surroundings and the difficulties he faces in his personal life as he cares for his ailing mother, Elizabeth (Vanessa Redgrave). As well as being barraged with criticism and negativity from his mother, Lowry struggles to contend with critics from the art world and proving himself as a serious painter.

titles.title: Mrs. Harris goes to Paris
titles.summary: Lesley Manville stars in this period drama based on the novel by Paul Gallico. Set in 1950s London, Mrs Harris (Manville) earns money by cleaning the houses of the capital's rich and famous and yearns to spend a day in their shoes. When she receives a lump sum back payment of her widow's pension following her husband's death in the war, she embarks on a trip to Paris to live out her dream of wearing a custom-made Dior gown. The cast also includes Isabelle Huppert, Jason Isaacs and Rose Williams.

titles.title: Mufasa: The lion king
titles.summary: Animated musical prequel directed by Barry Jenkins. Mandrill Rafiki (voice of John Kani) tells Mufasa (Aaron Pierre)'s granddaughter Kiara (Blue Ivy Carter) the story of her grandfather and his best friend Taka (Kelvin Harrison Jr.). Separated from his parents during a flash-flood, Mufasa is saved by Taka and taken in by his family. When they are attacked by a vicious pride of lions called the Outsiders, Mufasa fights back, but Taka's father sends the two young lions in search of a new home. During their journey, they meet Sarabi (Tiffany Boone), a brave lionness. She and Mufasa fall in love but as the trio are pursued by the Outsiders, who seek to eliminate all challengers to their tyrannical rule, Taka becomes increasingly resentful of Mufasa's innate goodness, strength and nobility.

titles.title: Mulan
titles.summary: Yifei Liu stars as the eponymous Chinese warrior in this live-action remake of the 1998 Disney animation. When Imperial China comes under attack from the invading forces of Hun warrior Bori Khan (Jason Scott Lee), the Emperor (Jet Li) decrees that all families in the Northern Province must unite to defend their homeland and contribute one man to fight. Hua Mulan, the only child of an ailing war hero, disguises herself as a male soldier in order to take her father's place on the battlefield. Prepared for battle by Commander Tung (Donnie Yen), Mulan proves her skill and courage, sacrificing everything to defend her nation and bring honour to her family.

titles.title: The mule
titles.summary: Clint Eastwood directs and stars as an ageing drug courier in this American crime drama. Based on a true story, the film follows 90-year-old divorced war veteran Earl Stone (Eastwood) in his new role as a drug runner for the Mexican Sinaloa cartel. After losing his family and his home, Earl seeks to atone for his failures as a husband and a father by paying for his granddaughter's wedding and earn enough money to move back into his home. A chance job opportunity leads to a lucrative partnership with the cartel, but Earl risks losing more than his new job when the Drug Enforcement Administration start to close in on his misdeeds. The cast also includes Bradley Cooper, Laurence Fishburne, Michael Peña, Dianne Wiest and Andy Garcia.

titles.title: Muppets most wanted
titles.summary: Jim Henson's Muppets return in this musical comedy starring Tina Fey, Ricky Gervais and Ty Burrell. The Muppets are on tour in Europe when Kermit the Frog (voice of Steve Whitmire) is mistaken for infamous Russian jewel thief Constantine (voice of Matt Vogel), to whom he bears a striking resemblance, and is imprisoned in a Siberian gulag by Nadya (Fey). Meanwhile, Constantine joins the rest of the Muppets posing as Kermit but they begin to grow suspicious of his strange behaviour. As Constantine and his accomplice Dominic Badguy (Gervais) use the tour as cover to commit a series of heists, a trio of Muppets travel to Siberia to rescue Kermit. Meanwhile, Interpol agent Jean Pierre Napoleon (Burrell) is hot on the trail of the thieves... The cast also includes Tom Hiddleston, Ray Liotta and Danny Trejo.

titles.title: Murder on the Orient Express
titles.summary: Murder mystery based on the 1934 novel by Agatha Christie starring Kenneth Branagh, Johnny Depp and Judi Dench. When notorious gangster Ratchett (Depp) is murdered on a luxurious train ride through Europe, Detective Hercule Poirot (Branagh) must solve the case before another victim is claimed by one of the 13 mysterious passengers on board. Among the suspects are Princess Dragomiroff (Dench), Pilar Estravados (Penélope Cruz), a devout missionary, and Mrs Hubbard (Michelle Pfeiffer), an American widow. Can Poirot identify the killer before another life is taken?

titles.title: Muscle
titles.summary: British thriller written and directed by Gerard Johnson. Tele salesman Simon (Cavan Clerkin) is full of self-loathing for the life he leads. Deciding to make a drastic change he joins a gym where he is taken under the wing of personal trainer and former soldier Terry (Craig Fairbrass). However, even though Simon loses weight and gains muscle in a short space of time the intimidating and fierce Terry makes demands of him that make Simon question the type of man he is becoming.

titles.title: The music lovers
titles.summary: Richard Chamberlain and Glenda Jackson star in this biographical drama directed by Ken Russell. Peter Ilyich Tchaikovsky (Chamberlain) struggles to overcome memories of his traumatic childhood but succeeds in attracting Madame Nadezhda von Meck (Izabella Telezynska) as his patron, which boosts his musical career. However, his marriage to Antonina Milyukova (Jackson) is a difficult one, for his interests lie elsewhere and he lusts after Count Anton Chiluvsky (Christopher Gable). Soon, his inner turmoil threatens to destroy both himself and Antonina. The cast also includes Kenneth Colley, Max Adrian and Bruce Robinson.

titles.title: My brilliant friend
titles.summary: All eight episodes of the Italian miniseries based on Elena Ferrante's novel. The drama follows two young girls, Elena (Elisa Del Genio/Margherita Mazzucco) and Lila (Ludovica Nasti/Gaia Girace), as they come of age in an impoverished and violent district of 1950s Naples. In their dangerous and male-dominated neighbourhood, the girls forge an enduring friendship that continues into their teenage years, as they each strive to prolong their education. Years later, Elena, now in her 60s, receives a phone call informing her of Lila's disappearance and begins to reflect on their lifelong friendship. The episodes are: 'The Dolls', 'The Money', 'The Metamorphoses', 'Dissolving Margins', 'The Shoes', 'The Island', 'The Fiancés' and 'The Promise'.

titles.title: My brilliant friend: Series 3

The drama follows two young friends, Elena (Margherita Mazzucco) and Lila (Gaia Girace), as they come of age. Now in their 20s, their lives have moved on from the poor Naples neighbourhood where they grew up together. Elena left and has become a successful writer while Lila stayed in Naples and works in a meat factory to support herself and her young son. The episodes are: 'Indecencies', 'The Fever', 'The Treatment', 'Cold War', 'Terror', 'Becoming', 'Try Again' and 'Those Who Leave, Those Who Stay'.

titles.title: My cousin Rachel
titles.summary: Rachel Weisz stars in Roger Michell's adaptation of the classic novel by Daphne Du Maurier. Orphaned Englishman Philip (Sam Claflin) seeks the truth about the sudden death of his guardian. As he gathers the facts he begins to suspect that his cousin Rachel (Weisz), the widow of his late guardian, may be responsible for his death. As he gets closer to his mysterious cousin however, deep feelings begin to develop and he finds himself falling for her mesmerising guise. The cast also includes Holliday Grainger, Iain Glen and Simon Russell Beale.

titles.title: My favourite cake
titles.summary: Lily Farhadpour stars in this Persian-language drama written and directed by Maryam Moghadam and Behtash Sanaeeha. Mahin (Farhadpour) is 70 years old and has been a widow for decades. Her children live abroad and she is lonely in Tehran until she meets Faramarz (Esmaeil Mehrabi), who makes her feel alive again. However, in a country where women's freedoms are restricted, will she have the chance to find happiness once more?

titles.summary: Jayson Thiessen directs this animated fantasy adventure featuring the voice talents of Tara Strong, Ashleigh Ball and Andrea Libman. titles.title: My pet dinosaur
titles.summary: Australian family adventure in which a young boy befriends a tiny dinosaur after a biological experiment goes pear-shaped. When the small creature rapidly grows into a gargantuan beast, the local town and authorities are soon alerted to its presence and panic spreads. With the military now looking to hunt it down, can it evade capture and live a life of peace with his new human companion?

titles.title: The naked civil servant
titles.summary: Jack Gold directs this British television drama based on the autobiography by Quentin Crisp. As he grows up and becomes aware of his sexuality, Quentin (John Hurt) is determined never to hide who he is, despite the highly conservative and intolerant society he is living in. After becoming a prostitute and then an artist, he is rejected from serving in the military in WWII and instead takes up nude modelling at an art school. However, as he searches for love, the threats of violence and imprisonment are ever present. The cast also includes John Rhys-Davies, Colin Higgins and Stanley Lebor.

titles.title: The naked gun
titles.summary: Liam Neeson stars in this fourth instalment of the action comedy franchise directed by Akiva Schaffer. Lieutenant Frank Drebin Jr. (Neeson) followed in his father's footsteps and joined Police Squad. Now he and his partner Captain Ed Hocken Jr. (Paul Walter Hauser) are investigating the case of a man who was found dead at the bottom of a lake in his cutting-edge electric car. As Drebin falls in love with the victim's sister Beth (Pamela Anderson), she joins them in their fight to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, someone is determined to shut Police Squad down forever... The cast also includes Danny Huston, Kevin Durand and C.C.H. Pounder.

titles.title: Nativity 3 - dude, where's my donkey?
titles.summary: Debbie Issit directs this seasonal British comedy starring Marc Wootton, Martin Clunes and Catherine Tate. The staff and pupils of St. Bernadette's face their biggest challenge yet when new teacher Mr. Shepherd (Clunes) loses his memory. Not only that, the school's Christmas mascot Archie the Donkey has also gone missing. With Mr. Shepherd's fiancée Sophie (Tate) in New York, can the pupils help reunite them and restore order before Christmas comes?

titles.title: Nativity rocks!
titles.summary: British children's comedy sequel in which a school put on a nativity production with a twist. This year, at St Bernadette's primary school, the children and staff are tasked with the challenge of competing against other schools for the Christmas Town of the Year competition. With the wacky new teaching assistant Mr Poppy (Simon Lipkin) on hand to help out and bring an exciting new flair to the nativity, the school are well on their way to reaching regional stardom.

titles.title: Neon bull
titles.summary: Brazilian drama written and directed by Gabriel Mascaro. The film follows Iremar (Juliano Cazarré), a bull handler working on rodeos in the north of Brazil. Dreaming of leaving to start a career as a fashion designer, Iremar begins designing custom horse masks and outfits for his friend Galega (Maeve Jinkings). However, things soon change for Iremar as he meets pregnant factory worker Geise (Samya De Lavor) and the pair quickly strike up a relationship.

titles.title: Never grow old
titles.summary: Western starring Emile Hirsch and John Cusack. Irish immigrant Patrick Tate (Hirsch) is a carpenter and undertaker living in the small town of Garlow where Preacher Pike (Danny Webb) holds sway over the puritanical and God-fearing residents. Patrick lives a fairly settled life with his wife Audrey (Déborah François) and their two children, but with business dwindling Patrick dreams about making it out to California with his family. However, the arrival of Dutch Albert (Cusack) and his small cohort of bounty hunters leads to an increase in business for Patrick. With the saloon open again and an on-going feud between Preacher Pike and Albert, Patrick finds himself facing a moral dilemma as the body count continues to rise and his services are required more than ever.

titles.title: Never let go
titles.summary: Halle Berry stars in this horror thriller from director Alexandre Aja. Momma (Berry) and her sons Samuel (Anthony B. Jenkins) and Nolan (Percy Daggs IV) live in a secluded cabin in the forest. Momma reminds her children on a daily basis of the dangers of The Evil which has killed the rest of humanity, with the three of them the only survivors. In order to stay safe, they must remain connected to the cabin at all times, with rope tied to them while they go hunting for food. When Nolan starts to doubt his mother's reasons for their isolation, tensions rise and they begin to lose their close connection.

titles.title: Neverland
titles.summary: Charlie Rowe, Rhys Ifans and Anna Friel star in this TV fantasy adventure, which explores a new beginning to the origins of J.M. Barrie's classic children's story. Scraping a living on the streets of Victorian London, orphan Peter (Rowe) and his pickpocket friends find themselves transported to a magical realm after they're instructed to steal a mysterious treasure on the orders of their criminal tutor, Jimmy Hook (Ifans). In the strange and beautiful Neverland, Peter and his friends have to do battle with a group of 18th century pirates led by Captain Elizabeth Bonny (Friel), who, along with Hook, is eager to discover the whereabouts of a magical mineral dust that gives the power of flight.

titles.title: Next goal wins
titles.summary: Taika Waititi co-writes and directs this comedy drama about the American Samoa football team's quest to qualify for the 2014 World Cup, despite being known as one of the weakest teams in the world. After losing 31-0 to Australia and enduring a decade without any signs of improvement, the team hires troubled Dutch-American coach Thomas Rongen (Michael Fassbender), hoping that he can spark a change in their fortunes. Rongen, however, is struggling with his own problems and may need this team just as badly as they need him. The cast also includes Oscar Kightley, Beulah Koale, Kaimana, Elisabeth Moss and Will Arnett.

titles.title: Next to her
titles.summary: Liron Ben-Shlush co-writes and stars in this Israeli drama. After being abandoned by their mother, 27-year-old Rachel (Ben-Shlush) becomes the full-time carer for her younger sister Gabby (Dana Ivgy), who has severe learning difficulties. When circumstances force Rachel to place Gabby in day care while she's at work, she begins a relationship with her colleague Zohar (Jacob Daniel). Will she be able to cope with sustaining both relationships as Zohar becomes a bigger part of her life?

titles.title: The night
titles.summary: American-Iranian psychological horror co-written and directed by Kourosh Ahari. On their way home from a dinner party with their one-year-old daughter, Iranian couple Babak and Neda (Shahab Hosseini and Niousha Noor) get lost and decide to spend the night at the Hotel Normandie in Los Angeles. As they settle into room 414 for the night, Babak and Neda witness a series of disturbing supernatural occurrences that force them to re-evaluate their troubled marriage.

titles.title: Night at the museum 3 - Secret of the tomb
titles.sortTitle: night at the museum 3 - secret of the tomb
titles.summary: Ben Stiller reprises his role as Larry Daley, night guard of the Museum of Natural History, in the third and final instalment of the 'Night at the Museum' trilogy. As the magic of the Tablet of Ahkmenrah - the powers that bring the museum exhibits to life after sunset - begin to fade, Larry travels around the world in order to reunite members of his museum crew including Teddy Roosevelt (Robin Williams), Jedediah and Octavius (Owen Wilson and Steve Coogan) and, of course, Ahkmenrah (Rami Malek) to try to save the magic before it's too late.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 13 Apr 2015); On loan - Due: 06 Oct 2026

titles.title: The night of
titles.summary: Eight-part crime drama starring John Turturro and Riz Ahmed. New York student Naz (Ahmed) embarks on a wild night out with a mysterious woman after picking her up in his dad's cab. The next morning he finds her stabbed to death in his bed. With no recollection of the previous night's events, Naz flees the scene but is quickly brought in by the city's police and identified as the main suspect for the victim's murder. After he is denied a legal representative, defence lawyer John Stone (Turturro) steps in to help Naz prove his innocence. As he awaits prosecution on Rikers Island, Naz adapts to the politics of life on the inside while his legal team try to piece together what happened on the night of the crime. The episodes are: 'The Beach', 'Subtle Beast', 'A Dark Crate', 'The Art of War', 'The Season of the Witch', 'Samson and Delilah', 'Ordinary Death' and 'The Call of the Wild'.

titles.title: Nightcrawler
titles.summary: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this Academy Award-nominated satirical thriller written and directed by Dan Gilroy. Gyllenhaal plays Lou Bloom, a desperate man living in Los Angeles who resorts to theft in order to support himself. One night Lou chances upon a terrible traffic accident while on his way home and meets freelance reporter Chris (Bill Paxton), who sells his video footage to local news stations. Seeing a chance to make it rich, Lou then trades in an expensive bike for a police scanner and a video recorder and begins hunting down the city's crime scenes as they happen. Hiring Rick (Riz Ahmed), a homeless man, as his assistant, Lou takes a journey into LA's crime-ridden underbelly searching for footage to sell to Nina (Rene Russo), a particularly twisted and ratings-driven news producer...

titles.title: The nightingale
titles.summary: Australian thriller written and directed by Jennifer Kent. Set in 1825 in the British penal colony of Van Diemen's Land, Irish convict Clare Carroll (Aisling Franciosi) seeks revenge on British Army officers for taking the lives of her husband and child. As she employs the help of Aboriginal tracker Billy (Baykali Ganambarr), the unlikely pair journey through the wilderness with the hope of getting justice, one way or another...

titles.title: Nightmare alley
titles.summary: Bradley Cooper and Cate Blanchett lead an all-star cast in this psychological thriller co-written and directed by Guillermo del Toro. Ambitious confidence trickster Stanton Carlisle (Cooper) uses his job as a carny to learn the special technique clairvoyant Zeena the Seer (Toni Collette) uses to convince her unsuspecting customers she can read their minds. Stanton leaves the carnival with his lover and fellow performer Molly (Rooney Mara) and reinvents himself as a high-society psychic in Chicago working alongside psychiatrist Dr Lilith Ritter (Blanchett). However, their lucrative scheme begins to fall apart as Stanton and Lilith's deceptions are revealed.

titles.title: The nightmare before Christmas
titles.summary: Animated musical fantasy following Jack Skellington (voice of Chris Sarandon), the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town. When Jack, tired of the same celebrations each year, discovers Christmas Town, he decides to improve the holiday by kidnapping Santa (Edward Ivory) and taking over the festivities. Unfortunately his attempts end in disaster but, in trying to repair what he has broken, he might just discover the true meaning of Christmas after all.

titles.title: Nikita
titles.summary: Luc Besson writes and directs this French drama starring Anne Parillaud. Nikita (Parillaud) is a nihilistic punk who is given a life sentence for killing a policeman. Without warning she is transferred to a secret training centre where the mysterious Bob (Tchéky Karyo) transforms her into a ruthless government assassin. The cast also includes Jean-Hugues Anglade, Jean Bouise and Vincent Skimenti.

titles.title: Nine perfect strangers: Season 1
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the first season of the television drama based on the novel by Liane Moriarty. Nine strangers meet at a luxury wellness resort to undergo a 10-day retreat designed to transform their lives in ways they never could have thought possible. As the days unfold, programme leader Masha (Nicole Kidman) will guide the participants to dig up their most painful memories and confront their pasts if they are to move forward. The episodes are: 'Random Acts of Mayhem', 'The Critical Path', 'Earth Day', 'Brave New World', 'Sweet Surrender', 'Motherlode', 'Wheels On the Bus' and 'Ever After'.

titles.title: Nitram
titles.summary: Australian drama based on the Port Arthur massacre in Tasmania in April 1996. Nitram (Caleb Landry Jones) lives with his mother (Judy Davis) and father (Anthony LaPaglia), isolated and angry. His parents are conflicted about how to deal with his difficult behaviour, which began in childhood. He becomes friends with his neighbour Helen (Essie Davis), a wealthy heiress, but their friendship ends tragically. Spiralling out of control, Nitram commits a horrific act of violence.

titles.title: No hard feelings
titles.summary: German coming-of age drama directed by Faraz Shariat. Following a minor violation of the law, confident 20-something Parvis (Benny Radjaipour) must serve 120 hours of community service at a local refugee detention centre. Despite some of the newly arrived immigrants mocking Parvis about his sexuality he finds himself connecting with many of the people there, as the son of Iranian exiles, Parvis recognises their struggles. In particular, Parvis strikes up a bond with the reserved Amon (Eidin Jalali), whose sister Banafshe (Banafshe Hourmazdi) also resides at the centre. As romance blossoms between Parvis and Amon, all three learn from one another as they set about determining a future they can believe in.

titles.title: No trolleys to aquarium: Brighton's trams, trolleybuses, buses & railways
titles.sortTitle: no trolleys to aquarium : brighton's trams, trolleybuses, buses & railways
titles.summary: Assembled to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the closure of Brighton's much-admired trolleybus system, this DVD contains superb colour footage of all types of Corporation and Company trolleybuses in action. Congregate at Old Steine Climb past the station up to Seven Dials Admire activity at St. Peters Church, Preston Circus and Open Market Scale the heights to Preston Drove, Hollingbury and Race Hill Snake down to Black Rock Visit Whitehawk and Lewes Road garages Also Brighton trolleys in Bournemouth, Bradford, Maidstone and Teeside

titles.title: Noah
titles.summary: Biblical epic directed by Darren Aronofsky and starring Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly and Anthony Hopkins. The film tells the story of Noah (Crowe), the last of the pre-flood Patriarchs. Considered a madman by many, Noah has visions of an apocalyptic flood that will wash over the earth and wipe out the sinful from existence. Instructed by these visions to build a vessel that will enable Noah, his family and two of every living creature to live through the deluge and begin the planet's repopulation, he begins construction on an ark. However, his project attracts the attention of his nemesis Tubal-cain (Ray Winstone) and his followers who threaten Noah's family and the ongoing construction of the vessel. The supporting cast includes Emma Watson, Douglas Booth, Nick Nolte and Frank Langella.

titles.title: Nobody
titles.summary: Bob Odenkirk stars in this US action thriller directed by Ilya Naishuller. Unassuming family man Hutch Mansell (Odenkirk) reaches breaking point and decides to revisit his violent past after armed robbers invade his suburban home and terrorise his family. While hunting down his daughter's stolen bracelet, Hutch gets into a fight with some Russian gangsters and attracts the ire of crime boss Yulian Kuznetsov (Aleksey Serebryakov). Using skills his family never knew he was capable of Hutch blazes a trail of violent retribution against those who threatened his loved ones. The cast also includes Connie Nielsen, Christopher Lloyd and RZA.

titles.title: Nomadland
titles.summary: Frances McDormand stars in this drama based on the book by Jessica Bruder. After losing her job, 60-something widow Fern (McDormand) leaves her small town of Empire, Nevada, sells most of her possessions, purchases a van and begins living as a modern-day nomad. Living in her van as she travels across the country in search of work, Fern takes a series of low-paying jobs and meets like-minded drifters as she adjusts to her new life on the road.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 19 Oct 2021); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 28 Aug 2025)

titles.title: Non-fiction
titles.summary: Guillaume Canet and Juliette Binoche star in this French drama written and directed by Olivier Assayas. In Paris, literary editor Alain (Canet) reluctantly informs Léonard (Vincent Macaigne) that he cannot publish his latest manuscript. The author, who has been having an affair with Alain's wife Selena (Binoche) for six years, is left devastated by the rejection, bemoaning the changing literary landscape. Meanwhile, Alain, who has his own misgivings about his changing industry, begins an affair with Laure (Christa Théret), who has been hired to update Alain's publishing company for the digital age.

titles.title: Nope
titles.summary: Sci-fi horror written and directed by Jordan Peele starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. After the residents of an isolated California town witness a strange and frightening event resulting in the death of one of their elders, siblings OJ and Emerald Haywood (Kaluuya and Palmer) attempt to catch a repeat of the event on film. Without knowing what they are dealing with however, are they prepared to chase the unknown?

titles.title: Norm of the North - Keys to the kingdom
titles.sortTitle: norm of the north - keys to the kingdom
titles.summary: Children's animated sequel about the adventures of a polar bear named Norm (voice of Andrew Toth). When he is invited to New York to receive the keys to the city, Norm, the new King of the Arctic, is framed for a series of robberies and forced to go on the run to prove his innocence. Meanwhile, a water company is up to no good back home in the Arctic. Can Norm and his friends clear his name and save their home before it's too late?

titles.title: Norman: The moderate rise and tragic fall of a New York fixer
titles.sortTitle: norman: the moderate rise and tragic fall of a new york fixer
titles.summary: Richard Gere stars in this drama written and directed by Joseph Cedar. President of the New York based Oppenheimer Strategies, Norman Oppenheimer (Gere) is a renowned fixer, relying purely on word-of-mouth to drive in new business and clients. He takes pride in introducing influencial people to each other for the mere mutual benefit it could provide. When he befriends young Israeli diplomat Micha Eshel (Lior Ashkenazi), Norman's life, unbeknown to him, would never be the same. Three years later, Eshel is elected Prime Minister of Israel and he calls upon his old friend Norman to act as a consultant and confidant. Always eager to please, Norman boasts of his acquaintance with the Prime Minster but when he starts making promises he cannot keep he finds that being in the inner circle of Israeli politics is not quite the perfect job he imagined. The all-star cast also includes Michael Sheen, Dan Stevens, Steve Buscemi and Hank Azaria.

titles.title: North v South
titles.summary: Steven Nesbit directs this thriller starring Steven Berkoff and Bernard Hill. When two young lovers realise that they belong to rival gangs, they quickly discover that their love must be hidden from their gang leaders Vic Clarke and John Claridge (Berkoff and Hill) for fear of causing an inter-gang war. The cast also includes Mason Adams, Freema Agyeman and Judith Alexander.

titles.title: The northman
titles.summary: Robert Eggers directs this historical action thriller. When the young Viking prince Amleth (Alexander Skarsgård) witnesses his father King Aurvandil (Ethan Hawke)'s murder at the hands of his uncle Fjölnir (Claes Bang), he vows to seek vengeance on Fjölnir and save his mother Queen Gudrún (Nicole Kidman) from his evil grasp. The cast also includes Anya Taylor-Joy, Willem Dafoe and Björk.

titles.title: Northpole
titles.summary: Tiffani Thiessen and Josh Hopkins star in this festive family adventure directed by Douglas Barr. Northpole, the magical land where Santa Claus (Robert Wagner) lives, is powered by the festive spirit generated by people around the world. However, as modern life takes over and people have less time to spend with their families over Christmas, Northpole is rapidly losing power and so it is left to one young boy, Kevin (Max Charles), to convince his family to save Christmas.

titles.title: Nosferatu
titles.summary: Robert Eggers writes and directs this gothic horror remake based on the 1922 silent film inspired by Bram Stoker's 'Dracula'. When Ellen (Lily-Rose Depp), a lonely girl, prays for relief from her loneliness, her prayers are answered, but not in the way she had hoped. Visited by a malevolent entity which proceeds to attack her, Ellen is left reeling from her ordeal. Years later, Ellen's husband, property agent Thomas Hutter (Nicholas Hoult), is preparing to sell abandoned mansion Schloss Grünewald to recluse Count Orlok (Bill Skarsgård). As Ellen grows suspicious of the Count, she is plagued by visions that quickly turn into reality.

titles.title: Nostalgia
titles.summary: Drama from Russian film-maker Andrei Tarkovsky. In the Tuscan hills, Russian poet Andrei Gorchakov (Oleg Yankovsky) is researching the life of an 18th century composer when he meets a mysterious man named Domenico (Erland Josephson) who is convinced that the end of the world is nigh. Once Domenico leaves the village he asks Andrei to cross an ancient mineral pool carrying his lighted candle as an act of faith.

titles.title: Notorious
titles.summary: Ingrid Bergman and Cary Grant star in this espionage thriller from director Alfred Hitchcock. Alicia Huberman (Bergman) is a social butterfly recruited by the American government to work as a spy in Rio de Janeiro in the years directly following WWII. Huberman is assigned with marrying Alexander Sebastian (Claude Rains), a member of a covert group of exiled Nazis, and is assisted by fellow agent Devlin (Grant). She succeeds in marrying Sebastian and uncovers a Nazi plot to stockpile uranium, but when Sebastian discovers who his wife is working for he begins to plot to get rid of her.

titles.title: Novocaine
titles.summary: Jack Quaid stars in this action comedy directed by Dan Berk and Robert Olsen. Nathan Caine (Quaid) works at a bank and has a rare disorder which means he is unable to feel physical pain. When his co-worker Sherry (Amber Midthunder), the woman he loves, is taken hostage by a gang of bank robbers, the usually cautious Nathan vows to do whatever it takes in order to rescue her. As he faces off against dangerous criminals, the police and his own mortality, will he succeed in finding Sherry? The cast also includes Jacob Batalon, Ray Nicholson and Betty Gabriel.

titles.title: Now you see me: Now you don't
titles.sortTitle: now you see me: now you don't
titles.summary: Jesse Eisenberg, Woody Harrelson, Dave Franco and Isla Fisher reprise their roles in this third instalment of the crime thriller franchise. The Four Horseman - J. Daniel Atlas (Eisenberg), Merritt McKinney (Harrelson), Henley Reeves (Fisher) and Jack Wilder (Franco) - no longer work together. However, in order to steal the world's largest diamond from Veronika Vanderberg (Rosamund Pike), the head of a powerful international crime syndicate, they must reunite and join forces with three young and gifted illusionists: Charlie (Justice Smith), Bosco (Dominic Sessa) and June (Ariana Greenblatt). Can the group overcome their differences and work together to achieve their greatest feat yet?

titles.title: Nowhere special
titles.summary: Uberto Pasolini writes and directs this emotional drama starring James Norton as a terminally ill single father. In Northern Ireland, 35-year-old window cleaner John (Norton) devotes his life to caring for his young son Michael (Daniel Lamont). However, when he discovers he only has a few months to live, John sets out on a tireless search to find the right family to raise his son after he is gone.

titles.title: The nut job
titles.summary: Computer-animated comedy from director Peter Lepeniotis featuring the voice talents of Will Arnett, Brendan Fraser and Liam Neeson. When sassy squirrel Surly (Arnett) and his mute rat friend Buddy decide to tackle their park's food shortage problem by stealing from a dangerous group of urban animals, their plan goes awry as they come face to face with urban leader Raccoon (Neeson). After a series of unfortunate collisions, Surly is banished from the park leaving Buddy to fend for himself. Noticing a human's nut cart in the park, Surly sets about re-establishing his position in the colony; little does he know that the nut cart is a cover for a group of thieves who plan to rob the local bank.

titles.title: The nutcracker and the four realms
titles.summary: Helen Mirren, Keira Knightley and Mackenzie Foy star in this fantasy adventure directed by Lasse Hallström and Joe Johnston. Based on the story by E.T.A. Hoffmann, the film follows Clara (Foy), a young girl searching for a special key which will unlock a box containing a gift from her mother. At a lavish party on Christmas Eve, Clara's godfather Drosselmeyer (Morgan Freeman) presents her with a golden thread which will lead her to the key. However, after following the thread Clara finds herself transported to a mystical land consisting of four realms where she befriends soldier Philip (Jayden Fowora-Knight) and the Sugar Plum Fairy (Knightley). After then learning that her key is being held in the dark Fourth Realm, Clara and her new friends find themselves coming up against the might of the evil dictator Mother Ginger (Mirren).

titles.title: Octonauts: Christmas adventures
titles.summary: Six festive episodes from the children's animated series following a team of underwater adventurers. Led by Captain Barnacles Bear, Lieutenant Kwazii Cat, Doctor Peso Penguin and the other heroes travel through the sea helping various creatures and making new discoveries. After a hard day's work they return to their base, known as the Octopod. The episodes are: 'Octonauts and the Very Vegimal Christmas', 'Octonauts and the Great White Shark', 'Octonauts and the Manta Rays', 'Octonauts and the Sea Skaters', 'Octonauts and the Immortal Jellyfish' and 'Octonauts and the Urchin Invasion'.

titles.title: Odyssey
titles.summary: Polly Maberly stars in this British thriller directed by Gerard Johnson. Ambitious London-based estate agent Natasha Flynn (Maberly) walks a fine line between success and failure. When her drug addiction and gambling habits leave her indebted to a very dangerous man, her life begins to unravel. To clear her debt she is forced to become complicit in his criminal activities and as her situation worsens, she desperately searches for a way out. The cast also includes Jasmine Blackborow and Mikael Persbrandt.

titles.title: Of an age
titles.summary: Australian gay romantic drama from film-maker Goran Stolevski. Kol (Elias Anton), a 17-year-old ballroom dancer, has his world turned upside down when he is introduced to Adam (Thom Green), the elder brother of his dance partner, Ebony (Hattie Hook). A mutual attraction soon grows between the two, but with Adam about to leave to go travelling, a whirlwind romance ensues.

titles.title: Official competition
titles.summary: Mariano Cohn and Gastón Duprat co-direct this Spanish satirical comedy drama starring Penélope Cruz, Antonio Banderas and Oscar Martínez. Hoping to finally cement his legacy, 80-year-old billionaire businessman Humberto Suárez (José Luis Gómez) hires acclaimed director Lola Cuevas (Cruz) to helm a film based on an award-winning novel. However, as rehearsals get underway, Lola's artistic ambitions are thwarted by her two rival lead performers: Hollywood star Félix Rivero (Banderas) and renowned thespian Iván Torres (Martínez).

titles.title: The old man and the gun
titles.summary: Robert Redford stars in this playful biographical crime drama based on Forrest Tucker's real-life escapades. Having spent most of his life in and out of prison Forrest Tucker (Redford), now in his seventies, is not ready to retire from the life of crime. Tucker uses his charm and the subtle hint that he is armed with a gun, also aided by his accomplices (Danny Glover and Tom Waits), to carry out a series of daring bank robberies. As Detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck) comes closer to bringing Tucker to justice he cannot help but be captivated by the methods of the charismatic old man.

titles.title: The old woman with the knife
Oliver!
titles.summary: Musical version of the classic Dickens tale. Young orphan Oliver (Mark Lester) suffers under a harsh regime at the workhouse run by Mr Bumble (Harry Secombe). He manages to escape, and, after meeting a friendly pickpocket known as the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild), joins a gang of street thieves operated by the disreputable Fagin (Ron Moody). Although happy with his new friends, Oliver takes a dislike to Fagin's violent and aggressive colleague, Bill Sykes (Oliver Reed). The film won six Academy Awards including Best Picture and Best Director.

titles.title: On the rocks
titles.summary: Sofia Coppola writes and directs this comedy drama starring Bill Murray and Rashida Jones. When mother of three Laura (Jones) admits to her amiable playboy father Felix (Murray) that she is in a rut and seeing much less of her husband Dean (Marlon Wayans) due to his work commitments, her father wonders if Dean might be having an affair. Initially dismissive of the suggestion, Laura eventually agrees to tag along with her father as they investigate some of Dean's alibis, a journey which takes them all over New York and allows them to reconnect. The cast also includes Jenny Slate, Jessica Henwick and Barbara Bain.

titles.title: On the sea
titles.summary: Helen Walsh directs this romantic drama starring Barry Ward and Lorne MacFadyen. Fisherman Jack (Ward) runs a mussel-dredging business with his brother and nephews. His own son Tom (Henry Lawfull) shows no interest in joining the family business and so Jack seeks help in the form of deckhand Daniel (MacFadyen). Daniel wastes no time in declaring his feelings for Jack and soon the two begin a passionate affair, away from the disapproving eyes of the fishing community.

titles.title: Once upon a time in - Hollywood
titles.sortTitle: once upon a time in - hollywood
titles.summary: Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt and Margot Robbie star in this comedy drama written and directed by Quentin Tarantino. Set in Hollywood in 1969, film star Rick Dalton (DiCaprio) relies on his stunt double Cliff Booth (Pitt) to make him look good. With his career rapidly failing, Dalton accepts a part in a Spaghetti Western that he believes is beneath him. When actress Sharon Tate (Robbie) moves in to the house next door, Dalton sees her as a way back in to Hollywood. But after Charles Manson (Damon Herriman) pays them a visit, their plans for the future get put on hold.

titles.title: One battle after another
titles.summary: Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this black comedy action thriller written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson. 16 years ago, Bob (DiCaprio) was part of a group of radical activists along with his partner Perfidia (Teyana Taylor) but now he is a paranoid and overprotective single father to 16-year-old Willa (Chase Infiniti). When an old enemy returns and Willa disappears, Bob is desperate to save her. He turns to Willa's karate teacher Sergio St. Carlos (Benicio Del Toro) for help and attempts to reconnect with his old allies but as they come together, they must face the consequences of their past actions. The cast also includes Sean Penn, Regina Hall and Tony Goldwyn.

titles.title: One fine morning
titles.summary: Léa Seydoux stars in this French romantic drama written and directed by Mia Hansen-Løve. In Paris, single mother Sandra Kienzler (Seydoux) works as an interpreter while struggling to care for her ailing elderly father (Pascal Greggory). While she searches the city for a suitable care home, she crosses paths with old friend Clément (Melvil Poupaud) with whom she embarks on a passionate affair.

titles.title: One life
titles.summary: James Hawes directs this British drama which portrays the true story of Sir Nicholas Winton, a British man who helped hundreds of vulnerable children escape the Nazi occupation of Czechoslovakia. During a visit to Prague in 1938, Nicholas (Johnny Flynn) was driven to help Trevor Chadwick (Alex Sharp) and Doreen Warinner (Romola Garai) in their efforts to save as many children as possible from the looming threat of the Nazis and transport them to safe countries. Despite his role in ensuring the safety of 669 children, Nicholas struggles to come to terms with the knowledge that many more were left behind. Five decades later, however, Nicholas (Anthony Hopkins) is invited to a special edition of a live television show where a life changing surprise awaits him.

titles.title: One nation, one king
titles.summary: French historical drama centred on the country's 1789 revolution.
