The film follows a group of common Parisians as they attempt to overthrow the monarchy and create a new republic in the aftermath of the storming of the Bastille. The cast includes Gaspard Ulliel, Adèle Haenel, Olivier Gourmet and Louis Garrel.

titles.title: Only you
titles.summary: British romantic drama centred on a couple who meet on New Year's Eve. Spanish council worker Elena (Laia Costa) and PhD student Jake (Josh O'Connor) meet while arguing over and then sharing the same taxi home after celebrating the New Year in Glasgow. Sparks fly between the pair and it's not long before they're moving in together. After deciding to have a baby, the couple are forced to turn to IVF treatment, but the stress of the process threatens to tear them apart.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 20 Nov 2019); On loan - Due: 07 Nov 2026

titles.title: Operation mincemeat
titles.summary: Colin Firth, Kelly Macdonald and Matthew Macfadyen star in this drama centred on the titular Second World War operation. As the Allies finalise plans to invade Sicily in July 1943, British intelligence officers Ewen Montagu and Charles Cholmondeley (Firth and Macfadyen) launch a deceptive plan to convince Germany that the true target of their invasion is Greece. The cast also includes Penelope Wilton, Johnny Flynn and Jason Isaacs.

titles.title: The operative
titles.summary: Diane Kruger and Martin Freeman star in this espionage thriller directed by Yuval Adler. Mossad agent Rachel (Kruger) poses as an English language teacher in Tehran where she strikes up a relationship with the head of an electronics firm, Farhad (Cas Anvar), who has ties with the Iranian military. However, as her relationship with Farhad becomes more intimate she loses contact with her Mossad handlers and Thomas (Freeman), responsible for first hiring Rachel, is sent to investigate her whereabouts.

titles.title: Oppenheimer
titles.summary: Cillian Murphy stars as theoretical physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer in this biographical drama written and directed by Christopher Nolan, which is set in two distinct time periods. In 1942, with the US government anxious to build an atomic bomb, Oppenheimer is appointed as the scientific director of the Manhattan Project, leading a team of scientists at Los Alamos in New Mexico who will develop and test the bombs that will ultimately be detonated over Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Meanwhile, in 1954, having come into conflict with politicians due to his opposition to the development of the hydrogen bomb and his belief in strict controls on nuclear power, Oppenheimer is subjected to a closed security hearing where his previous communist associations are used to discredit him. The all-star cast also includes Robert Downey Jr., Emily Blunt, Matt Damon and Florence Pugh.

titles.title: Oranges and sunshine
titles.summary: Jim Loach directs this drama about the woman who uncovered the hidden plight of the children in the British care system who were illegally deported to Commonwealth countries during the 1940s and 50s. Emily Watson stars as Margaret Humphreys, the Nottingham social worker who, in the 1980s, exposes the shocking secret that the British government has kept hidden for years: namely, that over 130,000 children, some as young as four, had been taken to children's homes on the other side of the world, where many were subjected to appalling hardship and abuse. Supported by her husband Merv (Richard Dillane), also a social worker, Margaret takes on the authorities in both Britain and Australia in her battle to expose the scandal and provide answers for its emotionally damaged victims.

titles.title: Osiris
titles.summary: Linda Hamilton stars in this low-budget sci-fi action horror co-written and directed by William Kaufman. When a team of U.S. Special Forces commandos led by Sergeant Kelly (Max Martini) are abducted during a military operation, they wake to find themselves aboard an alien spacecraft. There they meet Ravi (Brianna Hildebrand) and her mother Anya (Hamilton) who have survived on the ship for years and together, they formulate a plan to fight back against their merciless captors. The cast also includes LaMonica Garrett and Michael Irby.

titles.title: The other lamb
titles.summary: Horror directed by Malgorzata Szumowska. Born and raised in a cult led by her father, Shepherd (Michiel Huisman), Selah (Raffey Cassidy) has only ever known a life of loyal servitude to her master. However, as she approaches adolescence Selah begins to question Shepherd's teachings and the power he exerts over his cult of female followers.

titles.title: The other side of hope
titles.summary: Finnish comedy drama written and directed by Aki Kaurismäki. The film follows the journey of Syrian asylum seeker Khaled (Sherwan Haji) as he arrives in Helsinki on a coal train and begins looking for work after evading the law. Meanwhile, traveling salesman Wikström (Sakari Kuosmanen) buys the Golden Pint restaurant with the proceeds of a high-stakes poker game shortly after leaving his troubled wife. The pair meet when Khaled arrives at the restaurant seeking employment and Wikström is more than happy to help him, going so far as to take him in and procure a fake ID card for him. When Wikström finds out that Khaled's sister went missing en route he also feels compelled to help find her.

titles.title: Our time
titles.summary: Spanish drama directed by and starring Carlos Reygadas. Renowned poet Juan (Reygadas) runs a cattle ranch with his wife Esther (Natalia López) in rural Mexico. While he tends to the horses and the bulls, Esther manages the ranch and looks after their three children. Despite previously suggesting the idea of an open marriage, Juan is devastated when he discovers his wife has been having a passionate affair with horse trainer Phil (Phil Burgers).

titles.title: Out of blue
titles.summary: Patricia Clarkson stars as a detective in this crime drama directed by Carol Morley. When renowned astrophysicist and black hole expert Jennifer Rockwell (Mamie Gummer) is found dead next to her telescope, Detective Mike Hoolihan (Clarkson) investigates the killing. The first two suspects she identifies are Jennifer's academic colleagues Ian Strammi (Toby Jones) and Duncan Reynolds (Jonathan Majors). However, finding out more about the victim only further mystifies Hoolihan's certainty about what happened in this particular case as she is made to confront the nature of existence and the vastness of the universe. The cast also features James Caan and Jacki Weaver.

titles.title: The outfit
titles.summary: American crime drama directed by Graham Moore. Leonard (Mark Rylance) is an English tailor who used to craft suits on Savile Row until a personal tragedy led him to move to Chicago. Setting up a small tailor shop in a rough part of town, his main customers are a family of violent gangsters and he is soon pulled into their world. Zoey Deutch, Dylan O'Brien, Johnny Flynn and Simon Russell Beale also star.

titles.title: The outrun
titles.summary: Saoirse Ronan stars in this drama based on the memoirs of Amy Liptrot. Growing up on Scotland's Orkney Islands, Rona (Ronan) finds herself stuck on a self-destructive path of alcoholism. After studying in London, enjoying the freedom that the student life brought, her need for alcohol grew stronger. Before long her body became dependent on a drink and she struggled more and more to keep it under control. After she is attacked while under the influence, she realises she needs to change her ways and checks in to rehab. Can she turn her life around?

holdings.status: On loan - Due: 01 Feb 2025; Claims returned (Set: 15 Feb 2025)

titles.title: Overlord
titles.summary: Jovan Adepo, Wyatt Russell and Pilou Asbæk star in this action horror directed by Julius Avery. During World War II, a group of US paratroopers are dropped behind enemy lines on the eve of the D-Day landings in German-occupied France. The soldiers are tasked with infiltrating a Nazi stronghold in a small village, an assignment crucial to the success of the mission. However, the men soon make a shocking discovery as they uncover a horrific plan to use supernatural forces to build an army of undead warriors. Can they put a stop to the evil experiments before it's too late?

titles.title: Oz the great and powerful
titles.summary: Sam Raimi directs this fantasy adventure which serves as a prequel to 'The Wizard of Oz' (1939). When con artist and circus magician Oscar Diggs (James Franco) is transported to Oz after his hot air balloon is caught in a tornado, his life changes forever. As he becomes embroiled in the lives and schemes of three witches - Theodora (Mila Kunis), Evanora (Rachel Weisz) and Glinda (Michelle Williams) - can he realise his true potential and achieve greatness beyond his imagination?

titles.title: Pacifiction
titles.summary: Albert Serra writes and directs this French drama centred on a government official on the French Polynesian island of Tahiti. While rumours abound of a possible submarine sighting, French High Commissioner De Roller (Benoît Magimel) charms his way around the island's elite as he approaches the end of his term in office.

titles.title: Paddington
titles.summary: Nicole Kidman and Hugh Bonneville star in this family comedy based on the popular children's books written by Michael Bond. A young Peruvian bear (voice of Ben Whishaw) grows up dreaming of a life in London, having been influenced by his aunt who once met an explorer from England. When an earthquake leaves his home destroyed, his aunt smuggles him onto a ship headed for the English capital. He winds up in London's Paddington Station, lost and alone, until he meets Mr Brown (Bonneville) and his family, who decide to look after him while he searches for his aunt's old acquaintance. However, the bear finds himself in danger when taxidermist Millicent (Kidman) attempts to get her hands on him for her museum collection. The cast also includes Sally Hawkins, Julie Walters, Jim Broadbent and Peter Capaldi.

titles.title: Paddington 2
titles.summary: Hugh Grant and Hugh Bonneville star in this family comedy sequel based on the popular children's books written by Michael Bond. Now settled in London and living with the Brown family in Windsor Gardens, Peruvian bear Paddington (voice of Ben Whishaw) has begun building a reputation as an upstanding member of his new community. After spotting a unique pop-up book which he thinks will be a perfect present for his Aunt Lucy (Imelda Staunton)'s 100th birthday, Paddington sets out to complete a number of odd jobs in an attempt to raise enough money to buy it. However, when the book is suddenly stolen, Paddington and the rest of the Brown family must work together in order to catch the thief and recover the book before Aunt Lucy's big day comes around. The cast also includes Jim Broadbent, Julie Walters and Sally Hawkins.

titles.title: Paddington Bear: The complete collection
titles.summary: All 56 episodes from both series of the children's animated adventure based on the books by Michael Bond. Shipped off by his aunt from darkest Peru, Paddington is discovered at the London train station of the same name by Mr. and Mrs. Brown. The thoughtful bear with a love for marmalade sandwiches becomes a member of the Brown family at 32 Windsor Gardens where his adventures begin... Series 1 episodes are: 'Please Look After This Bear', 'A Bear in Hot Water', 'Paddington Goes Underground', 'A Shopping Expedition', 'Paddington and the Old Master', 'A Spot of Decorating', 'A Family Group', 'Paddington Makes a Bid', 'Do-It-Yourself', 'A Disappearing Trick', 'Something Nasty in the Kitchen', 'Trouble at the Launderette', 'Too Much Off the Top', 'A Visit to the Dentist', 'Paddington Cleans Up', 'Trouble at Number Thirty Two', 'Paddington and the Christmas Shopping', 'Paddington's Christmas', 'Mr. Curry Takes a Bath', 'Paddington Turns Detective', 'Paddington and the Cold Snap', 'Trouble at the Wax Works', 'Paddington Makes a Clean Sweep', 'A Sticky Time', 'Paddington Hits the Jackpot', 'Paddington Hits Out', 'A Visit to the Hospital', 'Paddington Recommended', 'Fortune Telling' and 'An Unexpected Party'. Series 2 episodes are: 'Paddington in Court', 'Paddington Bakes a Cake', 'A Picnic On the River', 'Paddington's Patch', 'In and Out of Trouble', 'Paddington at the Tower', 'A Visit to the Bank', 'Paddington Clears the Coach', 'Picture Trouble', 'Trouble at the Beach', 'Keeping Fit', 'Paddington in the Hot Seat', 'Paddington and the Mystery Box', 'Paddington's Puzzle', 'Paddington Weighs In', 'Paddington Takes a Snip', 'A Visit to the Theatre', 'Paddington Buys a Share', 'Paddington in a Hole', 'Paddington and the Finishing Touch', 'Trouble in the Bargain Basement', 'An Outing in the Park', 'Paddington Dines Out', 'Paddington Takes the Stage', 'Paddington in Touch' and 'Comings and Goings at Number Thirty Two'.

titles.title: Paddington in Peru
titles.summary: Live-action adventure sequel from director Dougal Wilson, based on the children's books by Michael Bond. When Paddington (voice of Ben Whishaw) receives a letter from the Home for Retired Bears in Peru, they inform him that his beloved aunt has been acting strangely. Worried, Paddington plans an expedition to his homeland. Accompanied by the Browns, Paddington meets the Reverend Mother (Olivia Colman) who heads up the retirement home and provides the family with a map of the jungle where they believe Aunt Lucy (voice of Imelda Staunton) may have gone. With nothing ever straightforward, they set out on their mission, hitting a few bumps along the way. The cast also includes Hugh Bonneville, Emily Mortimer, Julie Walters and Jim Broadbent.

titles.title: Pain & glory
titles.summary: Pedro Almodóvar writes and directs this Spanish drama starring Antonio Banderas and Penélope Cruz. As a film director begins to struggle with his health, he reflects on his life so far. From his memories as a young boy and his relationship with his mother, Jacinta, (Cruz/Julieta Serrano) to his adult life dabbling in drugs and realising his sexuality, Salvador (Banderas) wrestles with his conscience over the key decisions he has made.

titles.title: Palestine 36
titles.summary: Jeremy Irons, Saleh Bakri and Hiam Abbass star in this historical drama written and directed by Annemarie Jacir. In 1936, the Palestinian people begin to revolt against British colonial rule and as the situation escalates, the lives of many people are profoundly impacted. These include Yusuf (Karim Daoud Anaya), a farmer who travels regularly to Jerusalem for extra work, journalist Khouloud (Yasmine Al Massri), dock worker Khalid (Bakri) and Afra (Wardi Eilabouni) and her family, whose way of life is threatened by the influx of Jewish settlers and the actions of the British Army. Meanwhile, High Commissioner Arthur Wauchope (Irons) claims to be helping both Palestinians and Jews but many see little evidence of this, while Captain Wingate (Robert Aramayo) continues to inflict unprovoked violence upon the Palestinians he encounters. The cast also includes Liam Cunningham, Billy Howle and Dhaffer L'Abidine.

titles.title: Panda bear in Africa
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure. When his best friend Jielong (voice of Georgina Verbaan), a dragon, is kidnapped, Pang the panda (Yootha Wong-Loi-Sing) follows her to Africa, determined to save her from those who seek to use her rare gifts for evil.

titles.title: Paper planes
titles.summary: Australian comedy about a young boy's dream of greatness. While at school, Dylan (Ed Oxenbould) learns about flying and develops a passion that he didn't know could exist. When he hears about the World Paper Plane Championships held in Japan, he puts aside everything else in his life, determined to become the next champion.

titles.title: Paper towns
titles.summary: Coming-of-age drama based on the novel by John Green. Quentin Jacobsen (Nat Wolff) lives next door to Margo Roth Spiegelman (Cara Delevingne), a mysterious girl on whom he has had a crush for many years. When Margo climbs in through Quentin's bedroom window one night requesting to borrow his car for a night of personal errands which includes getting revenge on her cheating boyfriend, Quentin can't resist the chance to spend time with her and goes along for the ride. The next day, when Margo fails to turn up for school, her parents report her missing and Quentin, feeling responsible, convinces his friends to help him track her down.

titles.title: Parallel mothers
titles.summary: Pedro Almodóvar writes and directs this Spanish drama starring Penélope Cruz. Single mothers Janis (Cruz) and Ana (Milena Smit) meet after they both give birth on the same day in a Madrid maternity ward. Middle-aged professional photographer Janis decides to embrace motherhood alone after Arturo (Israel Elejalde), with whom she is having an affair, decides he is unable to support her. As she faces family problems of her own, Janis supports adolescent Ana as she begins to come to terms with her role as a new mother.

titles.title: Parasite
titles.summary: Korean satirical black comedy co-written and directed by Joon-ho Bong. Kim Ki-taek (Kang-ho Song) sees a way out of his struggling family's poverty when he is employed by the wealthy Park family to tutor their daughter Da-hye (Ji-so Jung). He quickly ingratiates himself with the Park family and convinces them to employ the rest of his impoverished family disguised as his acquaintances. However, their scheme to infiltrate the Park's lavish life soon turns awry when their true identities come under scrutiny.

titles.title: Paris, Texas
titles.summary: Wim Wenders directs this 1980s drama starring Harry Dean Stanton as Travis Clay Henderson, an errant husband who reappears in the middle of a Texas desert after an absence of four years. His brother Walt (Dean Stockwell) picks him up and Travis slowly begins to retrace the paths of his old life, getting to know his seven-year-old son Hunter (Hunter Carson), and going in search of his ex-wife Jane (Nastassja Kinski), who is now working in a peepshow.

titles.title: The partisan
titles.summary: James Marquand directs this World War II thriller starring Morgane Polanski and Malcolm McDowell. Polish agent Krystyna Skarbek (Polanski) is working as a spy for the British Special Operations Executive. In one of the most ambitious moves of the war, she embarks on a mission to liberate Nazi-occupied France, but along the way she is double crossed and finds herself smuggling top secret information across enemy lines. The cast also includes Ingvar Sigurdsson, Piotr Adamczyk and Agata Kulesza.

titles.title: Partisan
titles.summary: Vincent Cassel stars in this Australian thriller directed and co-written by Ariel Kleiman. Told from the perspective of 11-year-old Alexander (Jeremy Chabriel), the story follows the lives of a group of young children who have been raised in a closed community led by self-elected patriarch Gregori (Cassel). As he trains the children to become assassins, Gregori finds himself increasingly power-hungry sending the children out to kill people on his list. As Alexander's training progresses, he begins to doubt Gregori's rule and decides to challenge his authority the only way he knows how...

titles.title: Passages
titles.summary: Ira Sachs writes and directs this French drama starring Franz Rogowski, Ben Whishaw and Adèle Exarchopoulos. Tomas (Rogowski) and Martin (Whishaw) are a married couple living in Paris, their marriage falling apart due to Tomas's infidelity with his new friend Agathe (Exarchopoulos). With Tomas unable to end his affair with Agathe Martin draws the line, but when Martin attempts to move on Tomas can't let go of him either...

titles.title: Passengers
titles.summary: Sci-fi adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence and Chris Pratt. When more than 5,000 people volunteer to help set up a new colony on a faraway planet known as Homestead II, they board the Starship Avalon spaceship and embark on their 120-year journey, throughout which they will settle into a cryogenic sleep. When two of the sleep chambers malfunction and awaken passengers Jim (Pratt) and Aurora (Lawrence) just 30 years into their voyage, they are faced with the prospect of dying alone before reaching the planet, with just each other and robot bartender Arthur (Michael Sheen) for company. When they realise that there is something wrong with the ship, they must work together if they are to have any chance of saving the thousands of people on board.

titles.title: Past lives
titles.summary: Celine Song writes and directs this romantic drama starring Greta Lee, Teo Yoo and John Magaro. 20 years ago, 12-year-old best friends Na Young (Lee) and Hae Sung (Yoo) were forced to part ways when Na Young's family emigrated from Seoul to Toronto. Now the pair have reconnected via social media but are living very different lives. Na Young goes by the name Nora and is living in New York with her husband Arthur (Magaro). Arthur is sympathetic to the complex feelings that arise when Hae Sung tells Nora he will be visiting New York and would like to meet, encouraging her to do so. When Nora and Hae Sung finally reunite after two long decades, Nora must decide whether her nostalgic longing is enough to propel a romance between her and her childhood friend, or whether to leave Hae Sung in the past and remain content in her new life.

titles.title: Paterson
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Jim Jarmusch. The film follows Paterson (Adam Driver), a New Jersey bus driver with a hidden talent for writing poetry. Following the same routine each day, Paterson uses his observations while driving as inspiration for his writing. With his quirky and ambitious wife Laura (Golshifteh Farahani) pushing him to publish his work, Paterson is reluctant to make any change to his comfortable and serene world. The cast also includes Barry Shabaka Henley and Chasten Harmon.

titles.title: Paw patrol
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the children's animated series following the PAW Patrol, a group of hero pups who go around solving the problems that the people of Adventure Bay face on a daily basis. The episodes are: 'Pups Save the Sea Turtles/Pups and the Very Big Baby', 'Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe/Pups Save a Train', 'Pup Pup Boogie/Pups in a Fog', 'Pup Pup Goose/Pup Pup and Away' and 'Pups Save the Circus/Pup a Doodle Do'.

titles.title: Paw patrol: Pups save Christmas
titles.summary: Collection of five episodes from the children's animated series following the PAW Patrol, a group of hero pups who go around solving the problems that the people of Adventure Bay face on a daily basis. The episodes are: 'Pups Save Christmas', 'Pups Save the Penguins', 'Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins', 'Pups Save Skye' and 'Pups Bear-ly Save Danny'.

titles.title: Paw patrol: Pups save Puplantis
titles.summary: Collection of six episodes from the children's animated series following the PAW Patrol, a group of hero pups who go around solving the problems that the people of Adventure Bay face on a daily basis. The episodes are: 'Pups Save Puplantis', 'Pups Save a Sunken Sloop', 'Pups Save a Wiggly Whale', 'Pups Save the Flying Diving Bell', 'Pups Save a Soggy Farm' and 'Pups Save Their Pirated Sea Patroller'.

titles.title: Paw Patrol: Sea patrol
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the children's animated series following the PAW Patrol, a group of hero pups who go around solving the problems that the people of Adventure Bay face on a daily basis. The episodes are: 'Pups Save a Baby Octopus', 'Pups Save a Shark', 'Pups Save the Pier', 'Pirate Pups to the Rescue', 'Pups Save a Frozen Flounder' and 'Pups Save a Narwhal'.

titles.title: Paw patrol: The movie
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure following the PAW Patrol, a group of hero pups who go around solving the problems that the people of Adventure Bay face on a daily basis. Newly elected Mayor Humdinger (voice of Ron Pardo) sets out to thwart the PAW Patrol from carrying out their work, however, a dachshund puppy named Liberty (Marsai Martin) alerts Ryder (Will Brisbin) and his team, and offers her support to overcome the new Mayor and his wicked doings.

titles.title: Pearl
titles.summary: Mia Goth co-writes and stars in this horror prequel to 'X' (2022). In 1918, Pearl (Goth) dreams of becoming a movie star so she can escape life on her parents' farm in rural Texas. When she learns of a travelling dance troupe auditioning chorus girls in a nearby town, Pearl seizes the opportunity to escape her abusive mother (Tandi Wright) and disabled father (Matthew Sunderland), and is encouraged to pursue her dream by a young movie theatre projectionist (David Corenswet). However, her lust for violence threatens to derail her dreams of stardom.

titles.title: The pearl button
titles.summary: Patricio Guzmán writes, directs and narrates this Spanish documentary. The film-maker again explores Chile's violent past but this time also examines the country's waterways and its 2,600 mile-long coastline. The film tells the story of the country's most ancient inhabitants, The Water People, and features interviews with their descendants who discuss the reasons behind their demise. Meanwhile, Guzmán narrates the tale of another native who was taken from his home in Tierra del Fuego to England in 1830 in order to be made civilised. He also later narrates the tale of the country's 'disappeared' who dared to oppose President Salvador Allende.

titles.title: The penguin lessons
titles.summary: Steve Coogan and Jonathan Pryce star in this comedy drama from director Peter Cattaneo. In 1976, British teacher Tom Michell (Coogan) takes a job in Argentina. Setting up in a school in Buenos Aires teaching English to a class of privileged teenage boys, his new position is challenging with most of the children seemingly wanting to be anywhere but in the classroom. When he helps to rescue a penguin stuck in oil on a beach, he soon finds himself with a penguin companion as the animal follows him home. Seeing an opportunity, he invites the penguin into his lessons with the hope that a defenceless animal may have more luck getting through to his students. The cast also includes Bjorn Gustafsson, David Herrero and Hugo Fuertes.

titles.title: The penguins of Madagascar: Operation penguin patrol
titles.sortTitle: penguins of madagascar: operation penguin patrol
titles.summary: Ten more episodes from the Nickelodeon CGI-animated series following the comical adventures of four penguins at the Central Park Zoo in New York. Episodes included in this collection are: 'Dr Blowhole', 'Truth Ache', 'Command Crisis', 'Go Fish', 'Roomies', 'Needle Point', 'Launchtime', 'All Choked Up', 'The Hidden' and 'Tangled in a Web'.

titles.title: The penguins of Madagascar: Operation penguin takeover
titles.sortTitle: penguins of madagascar: operation penguin takeover
titles.summary: Ten episodes of the Nickelodeon CGI-animated series following the comical adventures of four penguins at the Central Park Zoo in New York.

titles.title: Peppa Pig: The Easter bunny
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the children's animated series. In these episodes, Peppa and her friends visit Rebecca Rabbit to take part in an Easter egg hunt and try to find the chocolate eggs hidden by the Easter Bunny, Peppa and friends build castles as part of a school project and bring them to playgroup, Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George spend time with Mr. Potato at Digger World and lots more adventures take place.

titles.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of monsters
titles.summary: The second instalment of the fantasy adventure franchise based on the bestselling children's books by Rick Riordan. After discovering that their demigod training ground, Camp Half-Blood, is in danger of being overrun by monsters, Percy (Logan Lerman), Annabeth (Alexandra Daddario), Grover (Brandon T. Jackson) and Tyson (Douglas Smith) set out on a perilous journey to the Sea of Monsters, known today as the Bermuda Triangle, to retrieve the mythical object that can save their camp - the Golden Fleece.

titles.title: The perfect candidate
titles.summary: Haifaa Al-Mansour directs this drama about a female Saudi Arabian doctor who stands for election. The film follows Dr Maryam Alsafan (Mila Al Zahrani) as she stands in the local municipal election. As the town's first female candidate, she struggles to gain acceptance from the conservative, male-dominated population. However, her campaign goes viral and Maryam decides to embrace her new-found position as a champion of her community and women's rights in the kingdom.

titles.title: Perfect days
titles.summary: Wim Wenders co-writes and directs this drama starring Kôji Yakusho, Tokio Emoto and Yumi Asô. Hirayama (Yakusho) is a public toilet cleaner in Tokyo and appreciates his simple life. From day to day, when not at work, he contently spends his time enjoying music, reading and admiring the beauty of nature.

titles.title: Persona
titles.summary: Study of womanhood and identity, featuring two of Ingmar Bergman's greatest leading ladies, Liv Ullmann and Bibi Andersson. Elizabeth (Ullmann) is a famous actress who is taken ill and left without speech. While convalescing on the coast, she is cared for by Nurse Alma (Andersson) and, silenced by the effect of her - possibly psychosomatic - illness, finds that her nurse does the talking for both of them. Gradually, the two women's personalities merge and the boundaries between their identities begin to blur.

titles.title: The personal history of David Copperfield
titles.summary: Armando Iannucci co-writes and directs this comedy drama starring Dev Patel. Based on Charles Dickens' novel, the film follows the life of David Copperfield (Patel) as he comes of age in Victorian London. Raised by his single mother, David's idyllic childhood comes to an abrupt end with the arrival of his new step-father, who sends the young boy to an unforgiving boarding school. Following the death of his mother, David moves in with his aunt Betsey Trotwood (Tilda Swinton) and her husband Mr Dick (Hugh Laurie) before encountering the scheming Uriah Heep (Ben Whishaw).

titles.title: Personal services
titles.summary: A waitress (Julie Walters), tired of not being able to make ends meet, starts to oversee the activities of the prostitutes to whom she sublets bedsits and is soon a fully fledged madame, running a brothel that caters mostly to middle-aged men with kinky requirements. Based loosely on notorious Cynthia Payne (aka 'Madame Cyn') whose respectable clients could pay using luncheon vouchers.

titles.title: Pete's dragon
titles.summary: David Lowery directs this Disney fantasy adventure remake starring Bryce Dallas Howard, Oakes Fegley and Robert Redford. Young boy Pete (Fegley) has lived in a forest for the last six years alongside his best friend, a dragon called Elliot (voice of John Kassir). When forest ranger Grace (Dallas Howard) discovers the boy she takes him home with her, hoping to help find his family. She soon learns of the dragon's existence and, when he comes under threat from a hunter (Karl Urban), Pete, Grace, her father (Redford) and lumber mill owner (Wes Bentley)'s daughter Natalie (Oona Laurence) set out to protect him.

titles.title: Pete's dragon
titles.summary: A Disney production mixing animation with live action. Lonely orphan boy Pete (Sean Marshall) finds a new friend in a surprising form: Elliott, a 12-foot tall dragon that has the power to make itself invisible. Together they innocently cause chaos in their sleepy hometown, but their partnership is put in jeopardy when a visiting medicine seller (Jim Dale) tries to kidnap Elliott.

titles.title: Pete's dragon
titles.summary: A Disney production mixing animation with live action. Lonely orphan boy Pete (Sean Marshall) finds a new friend in a surprising form: Elliott, a 12-foot tall dragon that has the power to make itself invisible. Together they innocently cause chaos in their sleepy hometown, but their partnership is put in jeopardy when a visiting medicine seller (Jim Dale) tries to kidnap Elliott.

titles.title: Peter Pan (Disney)
titles.summary: Classic Disney adaptation of J.M. Barrie's famous play. After visiting the Darling family nursery, Peter Pan (voice of Bobby Driscoll) takes Wendy (Kathryn Beaumont), John (Paul Collins) and Michael (Tommy Luske) on a magical journey to the island of Never Land. When they arrive they become embroiled in an ongoing battle between Peter, his friends the Lost Boys, and the wicked Captain Hook (Hans Conried), a pirate who has lost his hand and his watch to a hungry crocodile.

titles.title: Peter rabbit
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure based on Beatrix Potter's characters featuring the voice talent of James Corden as the eponymous mischievous rabbit. Peter Rabbit thinks he has the perfect life, stealing vegetables from Mr. McGregor (Sam Neill)'s garden with his sisters Flopsy (Margot Robbie), Mopsy (Elizabeth Debicki) and Cottontail (Daisy Ridley), and being cared for by kind-hearted neighbour Bea (Rose Byrne). When Mr. McGregor suddenly dies his nephew Thomas (Domhnall Gleeson) arrives from the city to take over his uncle's house. He promptly takes drastic action to keep Peter and his friends off his land, starting an aggressive war that turns into a battle for Bea's affection.

titles.title: Peter rabbit 2
titles.summary: Will Gluck returns to direct the sequel to the 2018 family adventure featuring a mix of CGI animation and live action. As Thomas (Domhnall Gleeson), Bea (Rose Byrne) and their family of rabbits settle in to their new life, Peter (voice of James Corden) finds it hard to stay out of trouble. When he decides to take his family on an adventure to a farmers' market where he promises a feast of incredible food, he inadvertently puts their lives in danger. The voice cast also includes Margot Robbie as Flopsy, Elizabeth Debicki as Mopsy and Aimee Horne as Cottontail.

titles.title: Peter Rabbit: The tale of the Christmas star
titles.sortTitle: peter rabbit: the tale of the christmas star
titles.summary: Collection of episodes featuring the adventures of the popular children's character and his various animal friends. In this instalment, Peter (voice of Connor Fitzgerald) tries to give everyone what they want for Christmas and the rabbits build a spectacular sled. The episodes are: 'The Tale of the Christmas Star', 'The Tale of the Thing-a-ma-jig', 'The Tale of the Spectacular Sled', 'The Tale of Cotton-tail's Tooth', 'The Tale of the Sleepy Hedgehog' and 'The Tale of Musical Mayhem'.

titles.title: Peter Rabbit: The tale of the king of the woods
titles.sortTitle: peter rabbit: the tale of the king of the woods
titles.summary: Six episodes featuring the adventures of the popular children's character and his various animal friends. In this collection, Peter enlists his friends' help to save Mr Tolly from Owl Island before tackling some thieving mice. The episodes are: 'The Tale of the King of the Woods', 'The Tale of the Locked Cage', 'The Tale of the Hungry Thieves', 'The Tale of the Tricky Tortoise', 'The Tale of Fish Out of Water' and 'The Tale of the Flooded Burrow'.

titles.title: Peter Rabbit: The tale of the unexpected hero
titles.sortTitle: peter rabbit: the tale of the unexpected hero
titles.summary: Six more episodes featuring the adventures of the popular children's character and his various animal friends. In this collection, the rabbits try to deliver Mrs Tiggy-Winkle's laundry using a fast new go-kart, Benjamin gets a pet snail and the gang try to find a new hideout after being moved out of their tree house. The episodes are: 'Seed Snatch', 'Unexpected Hero', 'The Racing Rabbit', 'Fred Snail', 'Go-Kart Getaway' and 'The New Hideout'.

titles.title: Peterloo
titles.summary: British historical drama following the events which culminated in the Peterloo massacre at St. Peter's Field, Manchester in 1819. As the Napoleonic Wars reached an end, political unrest struck the nation as ongoing stretches of famine, unemployment and the introduction of the Corn Laws began to stir the working classes. A demonstration took place on 16th August led by Henry Hunt (Rory Kinnear) with the intention to challenge the government and propose parliamentary reform. Their hopes were soon diminished, however, when a cavalry charged in to the massive crowd, causing the situation to turn deadly.

titles.title: Petite maman
titles.summary: French fantasy drama written and directed by Céline Sciamma. Following the death of her elderly grandmother, eight-year-old Nelly (Joséphine Sanz) helps her parents (Nina Meurisse and Stéphane Varupenne) clear out her mother's childhood home. While exploring the nearby woods, Nelly befriends a young girl named Marion (Gabrielle Sanz) who is building a tree fort.

titles.title: The phantom of the Open
titles.summary: British comedy drama based on the true story of Maurice Flitcroft. A shipyard worker from Cumbria, Flitcroft (Mark Rylance) managed to gain entry to the 1976 British Open qualifying, despite never having played golf before. After shooting the worst round in Open history, he must deal with the reactions of his family and the golfing community. Sally Hawkins and Rhys Ifans also star.

titles.title: The Phoenician scheme
titles.summary: Black comedy from film-maker Wes Anderson featuring an ensemble cast of Benicio Del Toro, Tom Hanks, Bryan Cranston, Bill Murray and Mia Threapleton. When wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda (Del Toro), considering his future, appoints his daughter Liesl (Threapleton) sole beneficiary of his estate, she quickly becomes a target for schemers wishing to get their claws into Korda's assets. The all-star cast also includes Michael Cera, Scarlett Johansson, Benedict Cumberbatch, Rupert Friend and Richard Ayoade.

titles.title: Photograph
titles.summary: Ritesh Batra writes and directs this Hindi romantic drama starring Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Sanya Malhotra. When his grandmother pressures him about his bachelor status before visiting him in Mumbai, photographer Rafi (Siddiqui) assuages her concerns by claiming he is getting married to a stranger in one of his photographs. When she asks to be introduced to her grandson's fiancée, Rafi is forced to go in search of the mysterious woman and convince her to go along with his story.

titles.title: Pig
titles.summary: Nicolas Cage stars in this indie drama set in Oregon written and directed by Michael Sarnoski. Former head chef Rob (Cage) now leads a reclusive existence in a cabin in the woods with his foraging pig who is prized for finding truffles. However, following the theft of his beloved pig Rob makes his way to Portland where he enlists the help of one of his suppliers, Amir (Alex Wolff), to help him retrieve the animal.

titles.title: A pigeon sat on a branch reflecting on existence
titles.sortTitle: pigeon sat on a branch reflecting on existence
titles.summary: Swedish comedy drama consisting of twelve self-contained vignettes. Among the characters are Jonathan (Holger Andersson) and Sam (Nils Wesblom), two travelling salesmen who make a living selling joke products. Their stock is limited, however, as they only have three lacklustre items for sale: vampire teeth, canned laughter and a rubber mask, which they take from shop to shop whilst struggling to obtain orders. Meanwhile King Karl XII of Sweden (Viktor Gyllenberg) rides into a bar to procure the barman's services in the war against Russia.

titles.title: Piggy tales: Season 1
titles.summary: All 31 episodes from the animated spin-off series starring the Bad Piggies from the 'Angry Birds' franchise. The episodes are: 'Trampoline', 'Roughnecks', 'Abduction', 'Teeter Trotter', 'The Hole', 'Push Button', 'The Mirror', 'Super Glue', 'Piggy in the Middle', 'Epic Sir Bucket', 'Push Button Trouble', 'Sha-Zam!', 'Puffed Up', 'Peekaboo!', 'Up Or Down?', 'Gloves', 'Snooze', 'Superpork', 'Cake Duel', 'Dr. Pork, M.D', 'Hog Hoops', 'The Cure', 'Up the Tempo', 'Jammed', 'Fly Piggy, Fly!', 'The Game', 'The Catch', 'Snowed Up', 'The Wishing Well', 'Stuck In?' and 'It's a Wrap'.

titles.title: Pinocchio
titles.summary: Matteo Garrone directs this film adaptation of the story about the famous wooden puppet who wants nothing more than to be a real boy. When the pinewood puppet Pinocchio (Federico Ielapi) miraculously comes to life he starts to create a lot of trouble for the man who made him, poor toymaker Gepetto (Roberto Benigni). After running away from his papa's house, Pinocchio ventures into the real world to experience some wild adventures in which he learns the true cost of misbehaviour.

titles.title: Pinocchio (Disney)
titles.summary: Classic Disney animated feature which follows the famous wooden puppet who wants nothing more than to be a real boy. Pinocchio (voice of Dickie Jones) is the wood-carved creation of Geppetto (Christian Rub). When the pair are visited by the Blue Fairy (Evelyn Venable), she grants Pinocchio the opportunity to become a real, flesh-and-blood boy, but only if he learns to be brave, honest and unselfish. To this end Pinocchio is granted a conscience, one which comes in the shape of the diminutive Jiminy Cricket (Cliff Edwards). However, Pinocchio soon discovers that being good is not as easy as it sounds. The film won two Oscars, for Best Song ('When You Wish Upon a Star') and Best Original Score.

titles.title: The pirates! In an adventure with scientists
titles.sortTitle: pirates! in an adventure with scientists
titles.summary: Academy Award-nominated animated feature following the attempts of a pirate captain to outdo his rivals, featuring the vocal talents of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Salma Hayek. Pirate Captain (voice of Grant) is determined to win the coveted 'Pirate of the Year' award. He is aware, however, that he will face stiff competition from other buccaneers including Black Bellamy (Jeremy Piven) and Cutlass Liz (Hayek). But the Captain has other issues as well. Queen Victoria (Imelda Staunton) is determined to capture him and hold him to account for his pirating, while the weight of history hangs over his encounter with a young man named Charles Darwin (Tennant).

titles.title: PJ Masks - Save the summer
titles.summary: Another seven episodes from the children's animated series following the adventures of Connor, Amaya and Greg (voices of Jacob Ewaniuk, Addison Holley and Kyle Harrison Breitkopf). After the three six-year-olds put on their pyjamas at night, they transform into their alter egos Catboy, Owlette and Gekko and set out to fight crime as the superhero team PJ Masks.

titles.title: Planes
titles.summary: Disney animated comedy spin-off of 'Cars' (2006) following an aircraft who dreams of becoming a racer. Crop dusting plane Dusty (voice of Dane Cook) hopes to become a competitor in high-flying races but is afraid of heights. With the help of US Navy veteran Skipper (Stacy Keach), Dusty trains for the upcoming around-the-world competition and learns to overcome his fear. However, he will have to face a tough opponent in defending champion Ripslinger (Roger Craig Smith) who will do anything to make sure Dusty doesn't win. The voice cast also includes Brad Garrett, Teri Hatcher, Cedric the Entertainer, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Val Kilmer, Anthony Edwards and John Cleese.

titles.title: Planes 2 - Fire and rescue
titles.summary: Dane Cook and Stacy Keach return as the voices of lovable aeroplanes Dusty and Skipper in this sequel to the 2013 Disney animation 'Planes'. When world-famous air racer Dusty gets told his engine is damaged and that he may never race again he refuses to let go and launches head first into the world of aerial firefighting. Joining the ranks of veteran fire and rescue helicopter Blade Ranger (Ed Harris), Dusty begins his training to become a real hero. The voice cast also includes Jerry Stiller, Steve Schirripa and Erik Estrada.

titles.title: Playmobil - The movie
titles.summary: Children's animation based on the Playmobil line of toys featuring the voice talents of Anya Taylor-Joy, Gabriel Bateman and Daniel Radcliffe. After being whisked away to the magical land of Playmobil, Charlie (Bateman) is taken prisoner by the evil Emperor Maximus (Adam Lambert). In an attempt to save him, his sister Marla (Taylor-Joy) teams up with food truck driver Del (Jim Gaffigan) and secret agent Rex Dasher (Radcliffe), who is investigating the top-secret organisation that is somehow causing citizens across the land to vanish into thin air. Together, they embark on a dangerous rescue mission that takes them through different worlds and sees Marla rediscover her sense of adventure.

titles.title: Pokémon - The movie: The power of us
titles.sortTitle: pokémon - the movie: the power of us
titles.summary: Feature-length animation based on the Pokemon characters created by Satoshi Tajiri. Ash Ketchum (voice of Sarah Natochenny) and Pikachu (Ikue Otani) visit Fula City for the annual wind festival, where legendary Pokemon Lugia brings the wind said to have saved the town many years ago. However, a number of incidents threaten the celebrations as well as the local people and Ash and Pikachu must call on the help of five diverse characters to help save the day.

titles.title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu
titles.summary: Children's action adventure following Detective Pikachu (voice of Ryan Reynolds) as he investigates his former partner's mysterious disappearance. While looking for his missing father in Ryme City, Tim Goodman (Justice Smith) stumbles upon Detective Pikachu, his dad's former partner, and discovers he is the only one who can hear him talk. The pair team up to solve the mystery, enlisting the help of aspiring reporter Lucy Stevens (Kathryn Newton) and her Psyduck, but they quickly find themselves investigating a larger conspiracy that threatens to jeopardise the harmonious relationship between humans and Pokémon.

titles.title: Poker face: Season one
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the first season of the television comedy starring Natasha Lyonne. Casino waitress Charlie Cale (Lyonee) has an extraordinary ability to uncover the truth behind the most bizarre of mysteries, a power which gets her into all manner of trouble. When Charlie attempts to shut down a scam set to take place in the casino, she unwittingly attracts the attention of dangerous gangsters who will stop at nothing to take her down. With nowhere to run, Charlie hits the road, solving a series of incredible cases along the way. The episodes are: 'Dead Man's Hand', 'The Night Shift', 'The Stall', 'Rest in Metal', 'Time of the Monkey', 'Exit Stage Death', 'The Future of the Sport', 'The Orpheus Syndrome', 'Escape from Shit Mountain' and 'The Hook'.

titles.title: Ponyo
titles.summary: Animated adventure by the Japanese anime studio Studio Ghibli, written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki and loosely based on Hans Christian Andersen's story 'The Little Mermaid'. When a feisty baby goldfish/mermaid called Ponyo (voiced by Noah Lindsey Cyrus) runs away from her home in the sea, she ends up stranded on the shore and is rescued by Sosuke (Frankie Jonas), a human boy who lives on a nearby clifftop. Ponyo yearns to become human herself so that she can be with Sosuke, but many obstacles stand in her way. Cate Blanchett, Matt Damon, Lily Tomlin and Liam Neeson lend their voices to the English version of the film.

titles.title: Poor things
titles.summary: Emma Stone, Mark Ruffalo and Willem Dafoe star in this black comedy fantasy drama directed by Yorgos Lanthimos. When medical student Max McCandles (Ramy Youssef) begins working with eccentric surgeon Godwin Baxter (Dafoe), he falls in love with Godwin's ward, Bella (Stone). He soon learns that Godwin resurrected Bella after her death and gave her the brain of an infant. However, as Bella's mind develops, she begins to crave knowledge and life experience and embarks on a journey of self-discovery that takes her across Europe as she breaks free from those who would control her. The cast also includes Jerrod Carmichael, Hanna Schygulla, Suzy Bemba and Christopher Abbott.

titles.title: The portable door
titles.summary: Patrick Gibson and Sophie Wilde star in this Australian fantasy adventure directed by Jeffrey Walker. Paul Carpenter (Gibson) begins interning at J.W. Wells & Co. without understanding exactly what it is that the company does. They are responsible for creating the moments of coincidence and good fortune that are part of daily life and Paul is tasked with locating a magical door that has gone missing on the premises. However, he and his fellow intern Sophie Pettingel (Wilde) soon begin to realise that the CEO, Humphrey Wells (Christoph Waltz), has his own agenda, which is disrupting the magical world. The cast also includes Sam Neill, Miranda Otto and Rachel House.

titles.title: Portrait of a lady on fire
titles.sortTitle: portrait of a lady on fire
titles.summary: Céline Sciamma writes and directs this French historical drama starring Noémie Merlant and Adèle Haenel. In 1770, artist Marianne (Merlant) travels to Brittany to paint a portrait of Héloïse (Haenel), the daughter of a French countess, to celebrate her impending marriage to an Italian nobleman. However, Héloïse objects to the marriage, so Marianne is tasked with completing her portrait in secret and acting as Héloïse's companion. As the two women spend more time together, their relationship evolves into a forbidden affair.

titles.title: The Portuguese nun
titles.summary: Drama starring Leonor Baldaque as a French actress who discovers that art mirrors life while on a shoot in Lisbon, where a chance encounter changes her life. Julie de Hauranne (Baldaque) is the star of a film based around the story of a nun who embarks on a relationship with a soldier. Directed by Denis Verde (played, appropriately, by director Eugène Green), the film demands that Julie immerse herself in the role and utilises actual places of worship in Lisbon as settings. While filming in one such location, a local chapel, Julie becomes fascinated by a nun who appears to pray non-stop. The encounter with the woman moves her greatly and leads her to reflect upon the path she has chosen, her identity and the possibility of a different future.

titles.title: Possessor
titles.summary: Sci-fi horror written and directed by Brandon Cronenberg. Tasya Vos (Andrea Riseborough) is an elite assassin who utilises brain implant technology to take control of other people's minds and eliminate her targets. When she is assigned to kill powerful CEO John Parse (Sean Bean) by possessing Colin Tate (Christopher Abbott), her host reasserts control and begins to fight back against his possessor.

titles.title: The Post
titles.summary: Steven Spielberg directs this political drama starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Set in 1971, 'Washington Post' publisher Katharine Graham (Streep) faces the difficult decision of whether to publish documents surrounding the American government's communications during the Vietnam War, brought to her by military analyst Daniel Ellsberg (Matthew Rhys). Within the papers are the communications of Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara (Bruce Greenwood) in which he revealed his belief of the war being unwinnable but stood by his decision to send American men to Southeast Asia and their certain death. The cast also includes Sarah Paulson, Bob Odenkirk and Bradley Whitford.

titles.title: Postcards from London
titles.summary: British drama in which a young man has his life turned upside down when he becomes involved in the field of escorting. Fed up of living a humble existence in a small town, Jim (Harris Dickinson) sets off to London to embark on an exciting journey to live a more luxurious life. When he approaches an eccentric escort agency to enquire about a job, they recruit him on the condition that he adapts to their unique way of life and learns everything he needs to know. When Jim is made to act as a muse in re-enactments of famous paintings, he soon finds that there is more to his new profession than he first thought.

titles.title: Power ballad
titles.summary: Paul Rudd and Nick Jonas star in this musical comedy drama directed by John Carney. When failed rock star Rick (Rudd) performs at a wedding, he is upstaged by boy band member Danny (Jonas), but as the unlikely pair bond over music, they end up writing a collaborative song. When Rick learns that Danny has released the song without crediting him however, he embarks on a journey of vengeance and revenge determined to take what is rightfully his.

titles.title: Power rangers
titles.summary: Dean Israelite directs this sci-fi adventure reboot of the Power Rangers franchise. Five teenage students running the gamut of the teenage experience - Jason (Dacre Montgomery), Kimberly (Naomi Scott), Billy (RJ Cyler), Trini (Becky G) and Zack (Ludi Lin) - stumble upon a set of powerful artefacts which begin to imbue each of them with superhuman strength, speed and agility. However, the friends soon realise that their discovery has awoken deadly alien sorceress Rita Repulsa (Elizabeth Banks), who is heading to their small town of Angel Grove to claim the ancient energy for herself. With the fate of the world now in their hands, the group seek the help of legendary warrior Zordon (Bryan Cranston) as they attempt to master their newfound powers and put a stop to Rita's evil plans. The cast also includes Bill Hader and Emily Maddison.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 28 Jul 2017); On loan - Due: 15 Oct 2026

titles.title: Power rangers ninja steel: Volume 3 - Fusion
titles.sortTitle: power rangers ninja steel: volume 3 - fusion
titles.summary: Four more episodes from the children's television series in which a group of teenage superhuman heroes must save the world from evil and destruction. When the Ninja Steel Gold Ranger makes an appearance the others try and find out who it is. The episodes are: 'Rocking and Rolling', 'The Ranger Ribbon', 'Poisonous Plots' and 'Family Fusion'.

titles.title: Power rangers ninja steel: Volume 4 - Rumble
titles.sortTitle: power rangers ninja steel: volume 4 - rumble
titles.summary: Five more episodes from the children's television series in which a group of teenage superhuman heroes must save the world from evil and destruction. In this volume Calvin (Nico Greetham) and Hayley (Zoë Robins) both compete to become Student President and the Rangers must face off against the challenge of a mysterious princess and her loyal followers. The episodes are: 'Ace and the Race', 'The Royal Arrival', 'The Royal Rumble', 'Monkey Business' and Halloween special, 'Grave Robber'.

titles.title: The president
titles.summary: Mohsen Makhmalbaf co-writes and directs this political drama starring Misha Gomiashvili as the president of an unnamed country whose regime comes crashing down around him when his people attempt to overthrow him. Left with only his recently orphaned grandson for company, the president disguises himself as a travelling street musician in order to avoid capture and certain death.

titles.title: The president's cake
titles.summary: Hasan Hadi directs this drama set in Iraq in 1991. When nine-year-old Lamia (Baneen Ahmad Nayyef) is selected by her teacher to bake a cake in honour of President Saddam Hussein's birthday, she knows she will be punished if she does not comply. However, her grandmother is poor and food is expensive and scarce due to the war and the ensuing sanctions. As Lamia and her friend Saeed (Sajad Mohamad Qasem) embark on a desperate search for ingredients, their quest is fraught with danger.

titles.title: The price of fame
titles.summary: Xavier Beauvois directs and co-writes this French comedy drama inspired by true events. Set in 1977 in Vevey, on Lake Geneva, the film follows immigrant Eddy (Benoît Poelvoorde), who, after being released from prison, goes to stay with his friend Osman (Roschdy Zem) and his young daughter Samira (Séli Gmach), agreeing to help look after the girl while her mother is in hospital. The friends struggle to make ends meet so when Charlie Chaplin's death is announced on Christmas Day, Eddy comes up with a plan to steal Chaplin's coffin and hold it for ransom. Will they be able to pull off such a ludicrous idea?

titles.title: Primitive war
titles.summary: Jeremy Piven and Ryan Kwanten star in this sci-fi action thriller directed by Luke Sparke. When a special forces platoon goes missing during the Vietnam War, Colonel Jericho (Piven) sends Sergeant First Class Baker (Kwanten) and his highly-skilled team into the jungle to find them. However, they are soon forced to fight for their lives when they discover that a secret Soviet experiment has transported dinosaurs through time to the present day and unleashed them in the jungle. The cast also includes Tricia Helfer and Nick Wechsler.

titles.title: The princess and the jester
titles.summary: Family adventure written and directed by Christopher Lombardi. When her father King Victor (Byron Herlong) is captured by goblins, Princess Halle (Emma Duchesneau) escapes with Henrí the court jester (Duncan Novak) and disguises herself as a peasant to hide. Her stepmother Perscilla (Rachel Stacy) takes over the throne and offers a reward for Halle's capture, leaving Halle to work together with her new friends to save her father and the kingdom.

titles.title: The princess diaries 2 - The royal engagement
titles.summary: Anne Hathaway and Julie Andrews reunite in this sequel to the 2001 family comedy. American high school graduate Mia Thermopolis (Hathaway) has just turned 21, and is being groomed to succeed her grandmother as Queen of Genovia. But it materialises that an ancient Genovian law decrees that unmarried women cannot take the throne, and the bitter Viscount Mabrey (John Rhys-Davies) and his cronies oppose her coronation. When Queen Clarice (Andrews) asks that Mia be given 30 days to find a husband, Mabrey is reluctant to allow it - but little does he know that his own nephew, the young and handsome Nicholas (Chris Pine), has caught Mia's eye.

titles.title: Priscilla
titles.summary: Sofia Coppola directs this biographical drama starring Cailee Spaeny and Jacob Elordi. 14-year-old Priscilla (Spaeny) is captivated by the charming Elvis Presley (Elordi) whom she meets while her father is stationed in a U.S. military base in Germany. Despite her parents warnings, Priscilla and Elvis soon fall for each other and Priscilla is thrust into the spotlight of Elvis's hedonistic and extravagant lifestyle. As she attempts to navigate a turbulent adult life as a teenager, Priscilla begins to question the cost of loving a world-famous star at the expense of her identity and ultimately, her future.

titles.title: A private war
titles.summary: Biographical drama about war correspondent Marie Colvin, starring Rosamund Pike and Jamie Dornan in Matthew Heineman's feature debut. Having covered conflicts across the globe Marie Colvin (Pike) has been widely praised for her journalism that has highlighted the plight of ordinary people suffering the perils of war. Her dedication to her work has meant much personal sacrifice. In the besieged Syrian city of Homs, Colvin and her photographer, former soldier Paul Conroy (Dornan), experience brutal bombing and shelling from the Syrian government with fatal consequences.

titles.title: The problem with people
titles.summary: Colm Meaney and Paul Reiser star in this Irish comedy directed by Chris Cottam. Fergus Gorman (Des Keogh) is dying and his last wish is for his son Ciáran (Meaney) to end a feud that has existed between the American and Irish sides of their family for generations. Ciáran duly tracks down his long-lost cousin Barry (Reiser) in New York and persuades him to travel to Ireland. However, as the two men get to know each other, Fergus's final act ignites a fierce new quarrel between them. The cast also includes Lucianne McEvoy, Jane Levy and Patrick Martins.

titles.title: The professor
titles.summary: American drama written and directed by Wayne Roberts and starring Johnny Depp as an English college professor who is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Rather than admit to his colleagues that he only has months left to live, Richard (Depp) continues to teach but his reckless behaviour makes them believe he is having a mid-life crisis. As his health deteriorates further, Richard begins to realise what is most important in his life.

titles.title: Project Hail Mary
titles.summary: Ryan Gosling stars in this sci-fi adventure directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller. When molecular biologist and teacher Ryland Grace (Gosling) wakes from an induced coma to find himself alone aboard a spacecraft light years from Earth, he has no memory of how he came to be there. As his memories slowly return, he realises that the fate of mankind rests on his actions. With alien microbes slowly killing the sun, the Earth will soon be too cold to support life. As Grace searches for a way to avert a global catastrophe, he discovers that he is not alone after all and the unexpected friendship he forms may hold the key to the survival of two worlds. The cast also includes Sandra Hüller, Lionel Boyce and Ken Leung.

holdings.status: In-transit from Hove Library to Hangleton Library (Set: 01 Oct 2026)

titles.title: The promised land
titles.summary: Nikolaj Arcel writes and directs this historical drama adapted from the novel 'The Captain and Ann Barbara' and based on the life of Captain Ludvig Kahlen. In Denmark in 1755, former officer Kahlen (Mads Mikkelsen) is dissatisfied with his meagre pension and lack of status and is determined to make his own way. Kahlen plans to cultivate the heath on the moorlands of Jutland and form a settlement, but unyielding landowner Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg) refuses to stand down and will do everything in his power to stop Kahlen from succeeding in his mission.

titles.title: Promising young woman
titles.summary: Carey Mulligan stars in this dark comedy thriller written and directed by Emerald Fennell. Still living with her parents and working in a coffee shop, 30-year-old Cassie (Mulligan) is haunted by a traumatic event from her past which led her to drop out of medical school. In search of revenge, Cassie spends her nights feigning drunkenness and vulnerability before turning the tables on her eager male suitors. However, following a chance encounter with her former classmate Ryan (Bo Burnham), Cassie begins to question her vengeful habit. The cast also includes Alison Brie, Clancy Brown, Jennifer Coolidge and Laverne Cox.

holdings.status: In-transit from Hove Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 19 Oct 2021)

titles.title: Prospect
titles.summary: Sci-fi drama starring Jay Duplass, Sophie Thatcher and Pedro Pascal. Damon (Duplass) and his daughter Cee (Thatcher) travel to an alien planet looking to claim their fortune. However, they are not the only ones attempting to mine for riches and Damon's greed puts Cee in a perilous position as she attempts to stave off the other hostile inhabitants.

titles.title: Proxima
titles.summary: Eva Green and Matt Dillon star in this drama written and directed by Alice Winocour. Astronaut Sarah (Green) is selected for the penultimate launch into space before a manned mission to Mars alongside Mike Shannon (Dillon) and Anton Ochievski (Aleksey Fateev). However, despite her professionalism and dedication Sarah is concerned about the impact being away from home for one year will have on her eight-year-old daughter Stella (Zélie Boulant). Under increasing pressure to prove herself worthy of the mission Sarah must push herself to the very limit both emotionally and physically in order to achieve her dreams.

titles.title: Psycho
titles.summary: Anthony Perkins and Janet Leigh star in this classic horror directed by Alfred Hitchcock. Secretary Marion Crane (Leigh) goes on the run after stealing $40,000 from one of her employer's clients. Taking a wrong turn in a storm, she arrives at the isolated Bates Motel run by the twitchy Norman (Perkins) who is constantly at the beck and call of his unseen mother. When Marion takes a shower in her room, a sudden knife attack ends her life. Upon discovering her body, Norman attempts to cover up the murder, but it is not long before Marion's sister and boyfriend arrive, attempting to track her down...

titles.title: Pudsey the dog - The movie
titles.summary: Family comedy starring Olivia Coleman, John Sessions and the voice of David Walliams. Pudsey (Walliams) is a stray dog living, quite happily, alone on the streets of London. While wandering the streets one day he meets Molly (Izzy Meikle-Small), George (Spike White) and Tommy (Malachy Knights), three siblings with a lot of love to give. Having recently lost their father, the three children are set to move to a new house in the countryside with their mum Gail (Jessica Hynes). Unbeknownst to the family, Pudsey decides to tag along and become the newest member of their household. When Pudsey discovers something untoward about the family's landlord Mr Thorne (Sessions), the little dog sets about trying to put everything right.

titles.title: Puss in boots: The last wish
titles.sortTitle: puss in boots: the last wish
titles.summary: Antonio Banderas returns to voice the title role of this children's animated spin-off of 'Shrek' (2001). Following on from the events of 'Shrek Forever After' (2010), legendary adventurer Puss in Boots is shocked to discover he has used eight of his nine lives. Hunted by the Big Bad Wolf (Wagner Moura), Jack Horner (John Mulaney) and Goldilocks (Florence Pugh) and the Three Bears, Puss in Boots teams up with his former lover Kitty Softpaws (Salma Hayek) and stray dog Perrito (Harvey Guillén) and sets off on a quest to find the magical Wishing Star.

titles.title: The queen of my dreams
titles.summary: Fawzia Mirza directs this Pakistani drama starring Amrit Kaur and Nimra Bucha. Azra (Kaur) struggles to maintain a relationship with her mother due to their differing opinions of the world. After a tragedy, her outlook on life changes and she embarks on a journey inspired by her mother's youth and upbringing in Karachi. The cast also includes Hamza Haq and Gul-e-Rana.

titles.title: The Queen's corgi
titles.summary: Children's animated feature following the adventures of Rex (voice of Jack Whitehall), the Queen (Julie Walters)'s corgi. Rex lives a life of luxury in Buckingham Palace as the Queen's favourite pet. But when President Trump (Jon Culshaw) comes to visit, Rex accidentally upsets his owner and is tricked into leaving the palace grounds in search of a new home. After finding himself in an animal shelter, Rex unites the other stray canines against former fighting dog Tyson (Ray Winstone) and attempts to make his way back home. But will he be able to reclaim his place as the Queen's favourite corgi?

titles.title: Queer
titles.summary: Daniel Craig stars in this biographical drama directed by Luca Guadagnino. Set in 1950s Mexico City, American William Lee (Craig) is somewhat of an outcast, leading a solitary life in a small town. He believes he is set in his ways until, that is, he meets young student Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey) who begins to change his whole outlook on life. The cast also includes Jason Schwartzman, Colin Bates and Drew Droege.

titles.title: Queers
titles.summary: British drama miniseries featuring eight short monologues by gay and lesbian individuals as a commemoration of the passing of the Sexual Offences Act 1967 which legally allowed private homosexual acts between two men if both parties are aged 21 or over. The cast includes Russell Tovey, Rebecca Front and Alan Cumming.

titles.title: The quiet girl
titles.summary: Irish Gaelic drama written and directed by Colm Bairéad. In 1981, nine-year-old Cáit (Catherine Clinch) is sent to spend the summer with her mother (Kate Nic Chonaonaigh)'s cousin Eibhlín (Carrie Crowley) and her husband Seán (Andrew Bennett). While Cáit receives a warm welcome from Eibhlín, Seán initially finds it difficult to have the young girl in his home. However, as he opens up to Cáit, she soon begins to flourish in the loving care of her surrogate family.

titles.title: A quiet place
titles.summary: John Krasinski co-writes, directs and stars in this US horror. The film follows a family living in total silence in a bid to stay one step ahead of an unseen threat which hunts by sound. With his wife Evelyn (Emily Blunt) pregnant, defiant father Lee Abbott (Krasinski) is forced to go to extreme lengths to keep her and their children Marcus (Noah Jupe) and Regan (Millicent Simmonds) safe from the mysterious and deadly creatures which stalk their every move.

titles.title: A quiet place: Day one
titles.summary: Lupita Nyong'o stars in this horror prequel directed by Michael Sarnoski. Sam (Nyong'o) has terminal cancer and is living at a hospice facility with her cat, Frodo. She reluctantly agrees to join a group of patients on an outing into New York City but when aliens arrive on Earth and begin laying waste to humanity, she is caught in the apocalyptic chaos. It quickly becomes apparent that the aliens cannot see but have excellent hearing and the only way to survive is to stay silent. As the military prepares to evacuate survivors, Sam meets Eric (Joseph Quinn), a law student from England, and together they attempt to navigate this dangerous new world. The cast also includes Djimon Hounsou and Alex Wolff.

titles.title: A quiet place: Part II
titles.summary: John Krasinski returns to write and direct this horror sequel which follows on from events in the 2018 film. Having previously attempted to live with a semblance of normality at their safe house in the countryside, the Abbott family now have no option but to set out into unchartered and dangerous territory. While remaining vigilant for the constant threat of summoning the terrifying creatures that have wiped out most of the population, they are soon confronted with the realisation that the real threat lies with other human beings.

titles.title: Rage of angels: the story continues
titles.sortTitle: rage of angels : the story continues

titles.title: The railway children
titles.summary: Lionel Jeffries directs this adaptation of E. Nesbit's classic children's novel which follows the fortunes of three Edwardian children whose father is wrongly jailed for treason. Exiled with their mother to a life of genteel poverty on the Yorkshire Moors, they are soon drawn to the railway at the bottom of the garden, and all kinds of adventures. The cast includes Dinah Sheridan, Bernard Cribbins and Jenny Agutter.

titles.title: The railway children return
titles.summary: Jenny Agutter, Tom Courtenay and Sheridan Smith star in this sequel to the classic 1970 film. Following the outbreak of the Second World War, Lily (Beau Gadsdon), Pattie (Eden Hamilton) and Ted (Zac Cudby) are evacuated from their home in Manchester and sent to a rural Yorkshire village where they encounter retired headteacher and former evacuee Bobbie (Agutter). As they explore the countryside with their new friend Thomas (Austin Haynes), the children befriend local stationmaster Richard (John Bradley) and come to the aid of an American soldier who claims to be on a secret mission.

titles.title: The railway children/Swallows and amazons
titles.summary: A children's classic double bill. An adaptation of E. Nesbit's children's classic, 'The Railway Children' follows the fortunes of a group of Edwardian children whose father is wrongly jailed for treason. Exiled with their mother to a life of genteel poverty on the Yorkshire Moors, they are soon drawn to the railway at the bottom of the garden, and all kinds of adventures. 'Swallows and Amazons' is a classic children's adventure yarn based on the Arthur Ransome book. The story recounts the adventures of a group of children who call themselves the Swallows, after their boat, as they holiday in the Lake District during the 1920s. There, they meet two piratical sisters, known as the Amazons, who have already claimed the waters for themselves.

titles.title: Rainer Werner Fassbinder: Volume 2
titles.summary: Four films by acclaimed German director Rainer Werner Fassbinder. In 'Veronika Voss' (1982), a journalist (Hilmar Thate) becomes fascinated with Veronika Voss (Rosel Zech), 1940s German film star and one-time friend to Goebbels, who has deteriorated into a morphine addict in the care of a disreputable doctor. In 'In a Year of Thirteen Moons' (1978), Volker Spengler gives an extraordinary performance as the transgendered Elvira, a man who has become a woman in a desperate bid to please a former lover. Relaying various episodes from Elvira's life, Fassbinder's powerful film is also one of his most intensely personal. 'The Third Generation' (1979), one of Fassbinder's most controversial films, is a perverse satire about an incompetent gang of bourgeois terrorists who are motivated more by a desire for action than by their weak political convictions. 'Germany in Autumn' (1978) is a portrayal of the political unrest wrought in the autumn of 1977 by the terrorist activities of the Red Army Faction. Through documentary, dramatised vignettes and archival footage, Fassbinder and his collaborators examine the events and explore the motivations behind this crisis point in German history.

holdings.status: In-transit from Caversham Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 09 Oct 2026)

titles.title: Raining stones
titles.summary: A story of inner-city poverty from director Ken Loach. Unemployed and penniless, Bob (Bruce Jones) is desperate to earn enough money to pay for his daughter Coleen's (Gemma Phoenix) communion dress. Unable to raise the cash any other way, he ends up borrowing from a vicious loan shark who then proceeds to terrorise Bob's wife and threaten further violence. As the communion approaches, the family seemed locked into an impossible situation.

titles.title: Ralph breaks the Internet
titles.summary: Disney animated sequel featuring the voice talents of John C. Reilly and Sarah Silverman. When Vanellope (Silverman)'s 'Sugar Rush' game is unplugged, Ralph (Reilly) decides the best way to fix it is to use the arcade's new Internet connection to go in search of the part they need. As the best friends explore the strange and dangerous online world, Vanellope discovers thrilling new racing game 'Slaughter Race', where she is finally able to unleash her racing skills. Meanwhile, Ralph becomes a viral celebrity, before he accidentally releases a devastating virus and breaks the Internet. Can he find a way to repair the damage he has caused and stop Vanellope from leaving him alone in the arcade forever?

titles.title: Rambo: Last blood
titles.summary: Sylvester Stallone returns to star as Vietnam War veteran John Rambo in this fifth instalment of the action franchise. Still haunted by his violent past, Rambo embarks on another revenge mission when his niece, Gabrielle (Yvette Monreal), is kidnapped by a Mexican cartel headed by brothers Victor and Hugo Martinez (Óscar Jaenada and Sergio Peris-Mencheta). After venturing across the border, Rambo is aided in his search by reporter Carmen Delgado (Paz Vega), whose sister has also been abducted by the cartel. When his initial attempt to confront the cartel fails, Rambo lures them back to his Arizona ranch for an explosive showdown.

titles.title: Ran
titles.summary: Akira Kurosawa directs this Japanese action drama based on the play 'King Lear' by William Shakespeare. After years of ruthless slaughter, Lord Hidetora Ichimonji (Tatsuya Nakadai) divides his kingdom amongst his three sons, seeking a peaceful retirement. However, his life descends into chaos when he is unable to escape the greed and corruption within his family and the torment within his soul. The cast also includes Akira Terao, Jinpachi Nezu and Daisuke Ryu.

titles.title: Ratatouille
titles.summary: Animated adventure from the creators of 'Cars' and 'The Incredibles'. Remy (voiced by Patton Oswalt) is a rat who dreams of becoming a great French chef despite the obvious problem of being a rat in a decidedly rodent-phobic profession. When fate places Remy in the sewers of Paris, he finds himself ideally situated beneath a restaurant made famous by his culinary hero, Auguste Gusteau (Brad Garrett). Despite the apparent dangers of being an unlikely - and certainly unwanted - visitor in the kitchen of a fine French restaurant, Remy's passion for cooking soon sets into motion a hilarious and exciting rat race that turns the culinary world of Paris upside down. Remy finds himself torn between his calling and passion in life or returning forever to his previous existence as a rat.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 19 Oct 2015); On loan - Due: 31 Oct 2026

titles.title: Ratchet and Clank
titles.summary: Kevin Munroe and Jericca Cleland co-direct this animation based on the video game and featuring the original voice cast including James Arnold Taylor, David Kaye and Jim Ward. This origin story charts the first meeting of Lombax mechanic Ratchet (Taylor) and rebellious robot Clank (Kaye). Ratchet's attempts to join the Galactic Rangers are initially rebuffed by their leader Captain Qwark (Ward), but the rodent-robot duo soon prove themselves to be useful in the fight against the evil Chairman Drek (Paul Giamatti), leader of the Blarg, as he executes his plan to control the Solana galaxy and repopulate it with his Blarg armies. The voice cast also includes Sylvester Stallone, John Goodman and Rosario Dawson.

titles.title: Ray & Liz
titles.summary: Richard Billingham writes and directs this British drama centred on a couple who live on a Dudley council estate. The film begins in 2016 with alcoholic Ray (Justin Salinger/Patrick Romer) looking back on his failed marriage to chain-smoker Liz (Ella Smith/Deirdre Kelly) and reflecting on the tough times they experienced trying to raise their two sons, Jason (Callum Slater/Joshua Millard-Lloyd) and Richard (Jacob Tuton/Sam Plant), in the 1980s.

titles.title: Raya and the last dragon
titles.summary: Disney animated adventure featuring the voice talents of Kelly Marie Tran and Awkwafina. In the ancient land of Kumandra, warrior Raya (Tran) sets off on a mission to bring peace to her kingdom by finding the last surviving dragon, Sisu (Awkwafina), who can protect her people from the resurgent Druun monsters. Joined on her quest by her companion Tuk Tuk (Alan Tudyk), Raya discovers she is not the only one searching for the fabled dragon as she sets out to unite her divided kingdom and restore Kumandra to its former glory.

titles.title: The Reader
titles.summary: Drama starring Ralph Fiennes and Kate Winslet, based on the novel by Bernard Schlink set in post World War II Germany. When teenage boy Michael Berg (David Kross) falls ill with scarlet fever, he is helped home by Hanna (Winslet), a stranger twice his age. When Michael recovers, he tracks Hanna down in order to thank her for her kindness. Despite their age difference, the two embark on an intense and secret affair that is based largely on Michael reading aloud to Hanna, until Hanna suddenly and mysteriously disappears one day, leaving Michael confused and heartbroken. Several years later, when Michael (Fiennes) is a law student observing the Nazi war crime trials, he comes across Hanna again - this time as a defendant in the courtroom. As Hanna's past is revealed, Michael uncovers a secret that profoundly affects both their lives.

titles.title: Reagan
titles.summary: Dennis Quaid stars as the eponymous actor and politician in this drama directed by Sean McNamara.
