After Hollywood actor Ronald Reagan comes to the attention of the Soviet Union, KGB agent Viktor Petrovich (Jon Voight) is sent to surveil him. Years later, Petrovich reflects on Reagan's life from his childhood in Illinois to his time as a lifeguard and actor and then his move into politics. After his first marriage to Jane Wyman (Mena Suvari) fails, he later meets and marries Nancy Davis (Penelope Ann Miller) and in 1981, he becomes President of the United States. Meanwhile, tensions escalate between America and the Soviet Union and Reagan publicly brands the country an evil empire. The cast also includes Kevin Dillon, Xander Berkeley and Robert Davi.

titles.title: Real
titles.summary: Aki Omoshaybi writes, directs and stars in this British romantic drama centred on two young lovers in Portsmouth. After meeting outside the city's courthouse, a romantic relationship develops between Kyle (Omoshaybi) and single mother Jamie (Pippa Bennett-Warner). However, secrets from their respective pasts threaten to ruin their blossoming relationship.

titles.title: The real ghostbusters: Volume 1
titles.summary: Children's animated TV series based on the original film. The series revolves around a group of Ghostbusters as they battle demons, curses and spooks in order to keep New York City safe. The episodes are: 'Ghosts R Us', 'Killerwatt', 'Mrs. Roger's Neighborhood', 'Slimer, Come Home', 'Troll Bridge', 'The Boogieman Cometh', 'Mr. Sandman, Dream Me a Dream', 'When Halloween Was Forever', 'Look Homeward, Ray', 'Take Two', 'Citizen Ghost', 'Janine's Genie' and 'Xmas Marks the Spot'.

titles.title: A real pain
titles.summary: Jesse Eisenberg writes, directs and stars in this comedy drama also starring Kieran Culkin. Jewish American cousins David (Eisenberg) and Benji (Culkin) travel to Poland to honour their late grandmother. They hope to visit her childhood home and connect with their heritage but they clash immediately due to their very different personalities. They have recently drifted apart and as their trip progresses, old tensions resurface and painful truths are revealed. The cast also includes Jennifer Grey, Will Sharpe and Kurt Egyiawan.

titles.title: Rear window
titles.summary: James Stewart and Grace Kelly star in Alfred Hitchcock's classic thriller which explores the role of the voyeur. After breaking his leg during a shoot, photo-journalist L.B. 'Jeff' Jeffries (Stewart) is forced to spend a humid summer recuperating in his Greenwich Village apartment. The wheelchair-bound Jeff whiles away his time observing his neighbours through a telephoto lens, bestowing them with nicknames and growing familiar with their daily routines. However, his society girlfriend Lisa (Kelly) is exasperated and then alarmed when Jeff becomes obsessed with the notion that Lars Thorwald (Raymond Burr), who lives in the apartment opposite, has murdered his wife...

titles.title: Red Joan
titles.summary: Judi Dench stars as an ex-spy with a secret past in this British drama directed by Trevor Nunn. Based on real events, the film begins with the arrest of Joan Stanley (Dench/Sophie Cookson), an octogenarian living in London accused of treason. After being brought in for questioning, Joan's secret life as a KGB spy is exposed. While studying physics at Cambridge in the late-1930s, Joan falls in love with Jewish refugee Leo Galich (Tom Hughes) and finds herself drawn into his communist activism. When the Second World War begins, Joan is hired to assist Professor Max Davies (Stephen Campbell Moore) on a top-secret government project but finds her loyalties severely tested.

titles.title: Red Sonja
titles.summary: Matilda Lutz stars as the eponymous Marvel Comics character in this low-budget fantasy adventure directed by M.J. Bassett. When her homeland of Hyrkania is invaded by barbarians, young Sonja witnesses the slaughter of most of her people and is forced to flee into a nearby forest. Years later she must unite a group of warriors and outcasts in an attempt to defeat the evil Emperor Draygan (Robert Sheehan) and his most deadly fighter, Dark Annisa (Wallis Day). The cast also includes Michael Bisping, Rhona Mitra and Martyn Ford.

titles.title: Redoubtable
titles.summary: French biographical drama written and directed by Michel Hazanavicius. Set in the late 1960s, during a period of civil unrest in France, renowned film-maker Jean-Luc Godard (Louis Garrel) becomes increasingly concerned about his wavering reputation and standing in French cinema. While also getting more involved in political protests, Jean-Luc struggles to control his jealousy as his relationship with his young wife Anne Wiazemsky (Stacy Martin) becomes strained. The cast also includes Bérénice Bejo, Grégory Gadebois and Micha Lescot.

titles.title: Regretting you
titles.summary: Allison Williams, Dave Franco and Mckenna Grace star in this drama based on the novel by Colleen Hoover. When her husband Chris (Scott Eastwood) and sister Jenny (Willa Fitzgerald) are killed in a car accident, Morgan (Williams) and her daughter Clara (Grace) struggle to cope in the aftermath. Their bond is strained by secrets but when the truth finally comes to light, can they salvage their relationship? The cast also includes Mason Thames and Clancy Brown.

titles.title: Reinventing Marvin
titles.summary: French drama based on true events in which a young boy named Marvin Bijou (Finnegan Oldfield) struggles against his family's oppressive views of sexuality and personal identity. Unable to find his place in school, he is approached by a drama teacher who introduces him to a student acting troupe where he finally finds a sense of belonging. When he approaches his family about his new-found hobby, however, they are less than accepting and refuse to encourage his efforts. As Marvin finally outgrows his family home, he heads to Paris where he can at last identify his true self and pursue his passions.

titles.title: Relic
titles.summary: Natalie Erika James co-writes and directs this horror starring Emily Mortimer, Robyn Nevin and Bella Heathcote. When her elderly mother, Edna (Nevin), goes missing, Kay (Mortimer) leads a frantic search to find her along with her own daughter, Sam (Heathcote). When Edna mysteriously returns home, with no recollection of where she has been, Kay begins to suspect that a sinister presence in the house is exacerbating her mother's fragile mental state.

titles.title: Remember
titles.summary: Atom Egoyan directs this drama starring Christopher Plummer as Zev, a German survivor of Auschwitz suffering with dementia and living in a New York City care home. With the help of fellow Auschwitz survivor and care home resident Max (Martin Landau), and before he runs out of time, Zev decides to track down a camp guard he remembers as being responsible for killing his family, who has thus far evaded justice. Zev's investigations and his difficulty with memory take him perilously close to danger.

titles.title: Rememory
titles.summary: Peter Dinklage stars in this US sci-fi drama co-written and directed by Mark Palansky. When scientist and inventor Gordon Dunn (Martin Donovan) is killed shortly after revealing a radical new device able to extract and play a person's memories, Sam Bloom (Dinklage) is recruited by Gordon's wife to try and solve the mystery of his murder. Using Gordon's memory device to help him, it's not long before Sam finds himself in danger as he becomes entangled in a web of lies and deceit. The cast also includes Anton Yelchin, Henry Ian Cusick and Matt Ellis.

titles.title: Rental family
titles.summary: Brendan Fraser stars in this comedy drama co-written and directed by Hikari. Phillip Vanderploeg (Fraser) is an American actor living in Japan who is struggling to make a living. Desperate, he accepts a job at Rental Family, a company which provides actors to strangers who need them to play the roles of family members or friends. Although Phillip is initially uncertain, he comes to find the experience rewarding until it causes his life to become increasingly complicated. The cast also includes Takehiro Hira, Mari Yamamoto and Akira Emoto.

titles.title: Respect
titles.summary: Jennifer Hudson stars as American soul singer Aretha Franklin in this biographical drama. The film follows Franklin (Hudson/Skye Dakota Turner)'s life from her relatively privileged upbringing in 1950s Detroit as she discovers her talent for singing and begins performing in her preacher father (Forest Whitaker)'s church choir. Following the tragic death of her mother (Audra McDonald) when she is just ten-years-old, Aretha's early career is shaped by her father as she signs her first recording contract with Columbia Records. However, frustrated by her failed attempts to achieve success as a jazz singer, Aretha begins to find her voice as a soul singer after marrying her new manager, Ted White (Marlon Wayans), and signing with Atlantic Records.

titles.title: The return
titles.summary: Uberto Pasolini directs this drama based on the ancient Greek poem 'The Odyssey' by Homer. After 20 years of the Trojan War, Odysseus (Ralph Fiennes) washes up on the shore of his homeland of Ithaca. With his wife Penelope (Juliette Binoche) a prisoner in her own home and under pressure to choose a suitor to be her new husband, Odysseus faces new challenges to secure his old life. The cast also includes Charlie Plummer, Marwan Kenzari and Claudio Santamaria.

titles.title: The return
titles.summary: Russian director Andrey Zvyagintsev makes his feature debut with this poignant family drama. Teenage brothers Andrei (Vladimir Garin) and Ivan (Ivan Dobronravov) have lived with their mother (Natalya Vdovina) and grandmother (Galina Petrova) for as long as they can remember when their long-lost father (Konstantin Lavronenko) suddenly turns up after a 12-year absence. While Andrei seems happy to see him, the younger Ivan is reluctant and suspicious of his father's motives. The three take a boat to a deserted island in a remote lake in the north of Russia - a trip which turns into an endurance test as the boys struggle to come to terms with their father's presence and cruel, mysterious ways. The film won the Golden Lion award at the 2003 Venice Film Festival.

titles.title: Return to Seoul
titles.summary: French-Korean drama written and directed by Davy Chou. The film follows 25-year-old French woman Frédérique 'Freddy' Benoît (Park Ji-min) as she attempts to reconnect with her Korean heritage while visiting Seoul. Having been born in South Korean but adopted by French parents, Freddy seeks out her biological parents while struggling to come to terms with her complex identity.

titles.title: Revolting rhymes
titles.summary: Animated television adaptation of Roald Dahl's famous 'Revolting Rhymes' based on classic fairy tales. The two-part series features the voice talents of David Walliams, Tamsin Greig, Dominic West and Rob Brydon and looks at Dahl's grisly take on the characters of Snow White, Red Riding Hood, Cinderella and The Three Little Pigs.

titles.title: Rhino
titles.summary: Tom Martienssen directs this documentary narrated by Tom Hardy which follows the efforts of a group of Kenyan wildlife rangers to protect the rhinos in their care. Habitat loss and poaching has left the black rhino on the brink of extinction but in Kenya, the population of rhinos in conservancies is increasing. Unfortunately at the Borana Reserve they are running out of space and so head ranger Ramson Kiloku and his team plan a dangerous mission to move 21 rhinos to another conservancy. If they are to succeed, they will have to traverse miles of terrain where armed poachers wait.

titles.title: Richard Jewell
titles.summary: Clint Eastwood directs this US drama based on true events. Security guard Richard Jewell (Paul Walter Hauser) foils a terrorist plot when he discovers a bomb in Atlanta's Centennial Park during the 1996 Summer Olympics. However, he is then named as the primary suspect in the FBI's investigation and denounced as a terrorist by the national press. The cast also includes Sam Rockwell, Kathy Bates, Jon Hamm and Olivia Wilde.

titles.title: The rider
titles.summary: US drama written and directed by Chloé Zhao. The film follows Brady Blackburn (Brady Jandreau), a young rodeo star who has his career cut short when he suffers a serious head injury in a riding accident. With his family living in poverty and threatened with the loss of their home, Brady's father sells his horse, forcing Brady to take a job as a store clerk in order to try and make ends meet. However, it's not long before Brady's burning ambition to ride takes over once more as he ignores medical advice and enters an upcoming competition in a bid to fulfil his dream of making it as a rodeo rider.

titles.title: Riders of justice
titles.summary: Mads Mikkelsen stars in this Danish action thriller written and directed by Anders Thomas Jensen. Soldier Markus Hansen (Mikkelsen) is forced to return home to care for his teenage daughter, Mathilde (Andrea Heick Gadeberg), after her mother is killed in a train crash. However, when Markus learns that the accident was an assassination attempt carried out by a member of the 'Riders of Justice' biker gang, he sets out on a vengeful mission to murder every last gang member with ruthless efficiency. The cast also includes Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Nicolas Bro and Lars Brygmann.

titles.title: Rise of the guardians
titles.summary: DreamWorks computer-animated family adventure film based on the book series by William Joyce. When the nightmare king Pitch (voiced by Jude Law) launches his evil plan to engulf the whole world in darkness, the Guardians - Santa Claus (Alec Baldwin), the Tooth Fairy (Isla Fisher), the Easter Bunny (Hugh Jackman) and the Sandman - enlist the help of a young and reluctant Jack Frost (Chris Pine) to stop Pitch in his tracks and protect children everywhere. But with the powers of the Guardians waning, will they be able to convince the world's children of their existence and overcome the power of Pitch?

titles.title: Rise of the viking
titles.summary: Historical action adventure starring Jonathan Banks, Gijs Naber and Loes Haverkort. Set in Northern Europe in 700 AD, the film follows the Franks' attempt to convert the entire region to Christianity. When Redbad (Naber), King of Frisia, opposes this measure Pepin of Herstal (Banks) uses force and a power struggle begins that leads to much bloodshed.

titles.title: Roald & Beatrix - The tail of the curious mouse
titles.sortTitle: roald & beatrix - the tail of the curious mouse
titles.summary: Children's drama starring Dawn French as Beatrix Potter. The film is based on the real-life meeting between Potter and six-year-old Roald Dahl (Harry Tayler). Following the death of his father, young Roald takes solace in the books he reads, resulting in him wishing to meet with the author who wrote them. When his mother Sofie (Jessica Hynes) agrees to this they go on an adventure to the Lake District where Roald's imagination is allowed to run wild.

titles.title: Roald Dahl's Matilda the musical
titles.summary: Matthew Warchus directs this adaptation of the award-winning musical based on the book by Roald Dahl, with music and lyrics by Tim Minchin. Matilda Wormwood (Alisha Weir) is extraordinarily bright and gifted but has to contend with uncaring parents as well as a cruel and terrifying new headteacher in Miss Trunchbull (Emma Thompson). Thankfully she finds a friend in kind teacher Miss Honey (Lashana Lynch) and decides it's time for things to change. Andrea Riseborough, Stephen Graham and Sindhu Vee also star.

titles.title: Roald Dahl's The witches
titles.summary: Robert Zemeckis co-writes and directs this fantasy adventure based on Roald Dahl's novel. While living with his grandmother, Agatha (Octavia Spencer), in 1950s Alabama, young orphan Charlie Hansen (Jahzir Bruno) stumbles upon a convention being held by a coven of witches, masquerading as the International Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Children, at the Grand Orleans Imperial Island Hotel. When he is caught and turned into a mouse by the Grand High Witch (Anne Hathaway), however, Charlie and his grandmother must find a way to stop the witches' evil scheme to eliminate all of the world's children.

titles.title: Robin Hood
titles.summary: Taron Egerton, Jamie Foxx and Ben Mendelsohn star in this historical action adventure directed by Otto Bathurst. Disillusioned with life under the tyrannical rule of the Sheriff of Nottingham (Mendelsohn) and the corrupt British crown after returning from the Crusades, courageous bandit Robin of Loxley (Egerton) teams up with Little John (Foxx) and a band of outlaws known as the Merry Men in a bid to fight back. Planning to target the treasury in order to steal from the rich and give back to the poor, Robin and his men set out on a daring mission to infiltrate the Sheriff's forces and take him down from the inside. The cast also includes Jamie Dornan, Tim Minchin and Eve Hewson.

titles.title: Rocketman
titles.summary: Taron Egerton stars as Elton John in this musical biopic of the English musician. When the ordinary and relative unknown Reg Dwight makes his first tentative steps in the music business he realises he must stand out if he wishes to make a name for himself and so begins his transition into Elton John. Along the way he is supported by lyricist Bernie Taupin (Jamie Bell) but he also experiences a tumultuous relationship with influential figures within the music industry including John Reid (Richard Madden) and Dick James (Stephen Graham). As his fame grows John must avoid all the trappings and difficulties that come with being a superstar.

titles.title: Rogue one - A star wars story
titles.sortTitle: rogue one - a star wars story
titles.summary: Gareth Edwards directs this sci-fi adventure set in the 'Star Wars' universe, featuring a stand-alone story written by Chris Weitz and Tony Gilroy. After being recruited by Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma (Genevieve O'Reilly), former criminal Jyn Erso (Felicity Jones) is tasked with stealing the plans for the Death Star so that the weapon can be destroyed before it causes damage to the galaxy. Teaming up with Rebel Captain Cassian Andor (Diego Luna), master swordsman Chirrut Imwe (Donnie Yen) and a band of hardy freedom fighters, Jyn takes on the might of the Empire in a challenge tougher than anything she could have imagined. The cast also includes Ben Mendelsohn, Forest Whitaker, Mads Mikkelsen and Alan Tudyk.

titles.title: Rogue one - A star wars story
titles.sortTitle: rogue one - a star wars story
titles.summary: Gareth Edwards directs this sci-fi adventure set in the 'Star Wars' universe, featuring a stand-alone story written by Chris Weitz and Tony Gilroy. After being recruited by Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma (Genevieve O'Reilly), former criminal Jyn Erso (Felicity Jones) is tasked with stealing the plans for the Death Star so that the weapon can be destroyed before it causes damage to the galaxy. Teaming up with Rebel Captain Cassian Andor (Diego Luna), master swordsman Chirrut Imwe (Donnie Yen) and a band of hardy freedom fighters, Jyn takes on the might of the Empire in a challenge tougher than anything she could have imagined. The cast also includes Ben Mendelsohn, Forest Whitaker, Mads Mikkelsen and Alan Tudyk.

titles.title: Romeos
titles.summary: German drama about a young transgender man adapting to his new life. As Lukas (Rick Okon) is completing his transformation from female to male, he spends the summer going on nights out in Cologne with his best friend, Ine (Liv Lisa Fries). When Lukas meets charming local catch Fabio (Maximilian Befort), a mutual attraction grows between them. In time Fabio finds out the truth about Lukas's past but how will it affect their relationship?

titles.title: Ron's gone wrong
titles.summary: Animated family comedy starring the voice talents of Zach Galifianakis, Jack Dylan Grazer, Olivia Colman and Ed Helms. Socially awkward middle schooler Barney (Grazer) struggles to make friends and feels increasingly isolated when he is one of the only people at his school without a B-Bot, a digital avatar that links up and makes connections with fellow users. Barney pleads with his father, Graham (Helms), and grandmother, Donka (Colman), to buy one for him. However, when they finally relent Barney's joy is short-lived as he discovers that his B-Bot, which he names Ron (Galifianakis), has code missing and doesn't quite function as he should.

titles.title: Roofman
titles.summary: Channing Tatum and Kirsten Dunst star in this comedy drama co-written and directed by Derek Cianfrance. In an attempt to help his family, former United States Army Reservist Jeffrey Manchester (Tatum) robs multiple branches of McDonald's. When he is captured, he is sentenced to 45 years in jail but soon hatches a plan to escape. Needing somewhere to lay low, he hides in the roof of a Toys R Us store but he risks his freedom when he finds himself falling for employee Leigh Wainscott (Dunst). The cast also includes LaKeith Stanfield, Juno Temple and Peter Dinklage.

titles.title: Room on the broom
titles.summary: Animated film adapted from the popular children's book written by Julia Donaldson. Narrated by Simon Pegg, the film tells the story of a benevolent witch (voiced by Gillian Anderson) travelling on her broomstick who invites a variety of different animals to join her on her journey, much to the dismay of her cat (Rob Brydon). The film also features the vocal talents of Timothy Spall, Martin Clunes, Sally Hawkins and David Walliams.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 23 Mar 2015); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Saltdean Library (Set: 13 Aug 2021)

titles.title: Rory's way
titles.summary: Oded Binnun and Mihal Brezis co-direct this family drama set between Scotland and America, starring Brian Cox. After being diagnosed with a terminal illness Rory MacNeil (Cox) leaves his Hebridean home to travel to San Francisco with hopes of finding a cure. Once there he reunites with his estranged son Ian (JJ Feild) and his family, wife Emily (Thora Birch) and young baby boy. Rory's stubborn ways lead to many confrontations but as he realises his health is not improving he tries to make the most of his time with his family and in particular forms a special bond with his grandson. The cast also features Rosanna Arquette.

titles.title: Rose plays Julie
titles.summary: Joe Lawlor and Christine Molloy co-write and direct this drama in which a young woman goes in search of her biological parents. Dublin vet student Rose (Ann Skelly) was adopted at birth and has always longed to know her biological parents. When she tracks down her biological mother, Ellen (Orla Brady), in London, Rose discovers a shock revelation that leads her to finally confront her father, Peter (Aidan Gillen).

titles.title: The roses
titles.summary: Olivia Colman and Benedict Cumberbatch star in this black comedy directed by Jay Roach. Ivy and Theo Rose (Colman and Cumberbatch) appear to have it all until Theo's career as an architect is ruined overnight when one of his buildings is destroyed during a storm. At the same time, Ivy's career as a restaurateur begins to flourish which exacerbates the insecurities and tensions between the pair. As their conflict escalates and their relationship becomes increasingly toxic, is there any chance of reconciliation or will they succeed in destroying each other? The cast also includes Andy Samberg, Kate McKinnon and Allison Janney.

titles.title: Rosie
titles.summary: Irish drama written by Roddy Doyle. After their landlord decides to sell the house they were living in, Rosie Davis (Sarah Greene), her partner John Paul (Moe Dunford) and their four kids are made homeless and forced to live in their car. After sending her three eldest kids to school each day, Rosie searches Dublin for a temporary shelter for her and her family. Unable to afford the city's rising rental costs, Rosie works through a list of suitable accommodation given to her by her local authority, with little luck. Meanwhile, her children's school troubles threaten to make Rosie's dire situation more perilous.

titles.title: The royal hotel
titles.summary: Kitty Green writes and directs this Australian thriller starring Julia Garner and Jessica Henwick. American backpackers Hanna and Liv (Garner and Henwick) take a job working at The Royal Hotel, a pub in the remote Australian outback. Hanna struggles to match Liv's enthusiasm at the prospect and is unsettled by the misogynistic behaviour of the regulars, which is seemingly accepted by the pub's owners, Carol and Billy (Ursula Yovich and Hugo Weaving). As Hanna's patience wears thin, some of the men become more persistent in attempting to win the girls over and increase their hostility as Hanna rejects their advances. With no easy way to escape the remoteness of the outback, can Hanna convince Liv to leave with her before the men take it too far?

titles.title: Royal Sussex County Hospital, Brighton: Maternity Unit tour
titles.sortTitle: royal sussex county hospital, brighton : maternity unit tour

titles.title: Ruby Gillman, teenage kraken
titles.summary: Animated action adventure featuring the voice talents of Lana Condor, Toni Collette and Jane Fonda. When 16-year-old Ruby Gillman (Condor) discovers that she is descended from a royal family of sea krakens, she must face her destiny and learn to harness her powers before taking on evil mermaid Chelsea (Annie Murphy).

titles.title: Rumours
titles.summary: Cate Blanchett and Charles Dance star in this comedy horror from directors Evan Johnson, Galen Johnson and Guy Maddin. When world leaders meet at the G7 conference, they take themselves off into the woods as they discuss the composition of a joint statement regarding a global crisis. As they lose their way owing to thick fog, they begin to encounter bog people who are less than happy to see them in their home...

titles.title: The running man
titles.summary: Glen Powell, Josh Brolin and Colman Domingo star in this dystopian action thriller directed by Edgar Wright. Desperate to save his seriously ill young daughter and secure a better life for his family, Ben Richards (Powell) is convinced by producer Dan Killian (Brolin) to enter the most popular and violent show on television: 'The Running Man'. To win the billion-dollar jackpot - a feat no one has yet achieved - contestants must stay alive for 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins for the entertainment of the watching public. As Ben fights to stay alive against all odds, he meets unexpected allies and uncovers the sinister truth about the show. The cast also includes Lee Pace, William H. Macy and Michael Cera.

titles.title: Rust and bone
titles.summary: Jacques Audiard directs this French relationship drama detailing the bond that develops between two people, both profoundly damaged in different ways. The film starts by telling two parallel stories: one of Ali (Matthias Schoenaerts), a homeless father struggling to care for his five-year-old son, and the other of Stephanie (Marion Cotillard), a woman who loses her legs in an accident while working as a trainer of killer whales. Both strong, idiosyncratic characters who are used to defining the parameters of their personal relationships, their union forces them out of the emotional safety zones they have each developed for the purposes of self-protection.

titles.title: Sabotage
titles.summary: A classic Hitchcock chiller based on the novel by Joseph Conrad. In Thirties London, unbeknown to his wife Sylvia (Sylvia Sidney), cinema manager Karl Verloc (Oscar Homolka) is acting as a paid saboteur. After Karl's cutting off of London's electricity supply fails to create the havoc his employers hoped for, Karl is charged with delivering a bomb to Piccadilly Circus. However, the police are already on his trail.

titles.title: Saboteur
titles.summary: Factory worker Barry Kane (Robert Cummings) finds himself branded an industrial saboteur after a fire breaks out in the workplace. The extinguisher he handed to his colleague and best friend itself burst into flame, and Kane is now on the run, determined to find the real culprit and so prove his innocence. The only person who believes his story is Patricia Martin (Priscilla Lane), who aids him in his flight from the authorities. Alfred Hitchcock's suspenseful chase film, a contribution to America's wartime propaganda, can be seen as a precursor to his later success 'North by Northwest'.

titles.title: Saint Maud
titles.summary: British psychological horror written and directed by debut film-maker Rose Glass. After leaving her job in a hospital, hospice nurse Maud (Morfydd Clark) is assigned to care for Amanda (Jennifer Ehle), an elderly former dancer stricken by illness. Having converted to Catholicism following a recent trauma, Maud's faith and sanity are tested as she clashes with Amanda over their respective ideological beliefs.

titles.title: Saipan
titles.summary: Eanna Hardwicke and Steve Coogan star in this drama directed by Lisa Barros D'Sa and Glenn Leyburn. When the members of the Republic of Ireland football team travel to Saipan to prepare for the 2002 FIFA World Cup, captain Roy Keane (Hardwicke) clashes with manager Mick McCarthy (Coogan). Believing the team's preparations and facilities to be unprofessional and insufficient, Keane questions McCarthy's competence and as the feud between them escalates, the situation quickly spirals out of control. The cast also includes Jack Hickey, Harriet Cains and Alice Lowe.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 24 Jul 2026); On loan - Due: 05 Nov 2026

titles.title: The salt path
titles.summary: Jason Isaacs and Gillian Anderson star in this adaptation of Raynor Winn's memoir, directed by Marianne Elliott. When Moth Winn (Isaacs) receives some bad news from his doctor, he and his wife Raynor (Anderson) take it as a sign to start having adventures. After also losing their family farm in a bad business deal, they decide to embark on a special journey. As they set out to walk the 630-mile South West Coast Path of Devon and Cornwall, they rediscover the meaning of life.

titles.title: Santa buddies
titles.summary: Children's animated festive adventure from Disney's popular Buddies series. In this instalment, the puppies take a trip to the North Pole where they visit Santa's workshop. When they get there they discover that Christmas is losing its spirit but, with the help of Santa Paw's son, the puppies work together to save the day.

titles.title: Santa claws
titles.summary: Festive family comedy starring Erica Duke and Evan Boymel. Santa (Boymel) is highly allergic to cats and has always had a strict rule against delivering them as Christmas presents. When young Tommy (Ezra James Colbert), who has always been on the nice list, asks for a kitten for Christmas Santa decides to break his rule just this once. All is fine until the kitten's brothers and sisters decide to climb into Santa's sack as well and he has a severe allergic reaction. What will Santa do?

titles.title: Santa Paws
titles.summary: This straight-to-DVD Disney Christmas film is a prequel to the 2009 film 'Santa Buddies'. Santa (Richard Riehle) and his new friend Paws (voiced by Zachary Gordon) discover that children across the world have forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and set off to New York City in an attempt to revive the spirit of the season. But when Santa loses his memory, Paws joins forces with orphan Quinn (Kaitlyn Maher), her friend Will (Madison Pettis) and a group of magical talking dogs to remind Santa and the world what Christmas is really all about.

titles.title: Santa's boot camp
titles.summary: Festive family adventure. When Santa (Doug Kaye)'s elves become tired of working for spoiled children, they decide to go on strike leaving Santa to enlist the help of some unruly teenagers to satisfy his high demand for presents. After several failed attempts to escape, the teens are put through their paces in Santa's workshop and are made to vote on who makes the naughty or nice list. But what will they decide when they see their own behaviour throughout the year?

titles.title: Sarah & Duck: Snowball skate and other stories
titles.sortTitle: sarah & duck: snowball skate and other stories
titles.summary: Ten more episodes of the CBeebies animation created by Sarah Gomes Harris and Tim O'Sullivan. Narrated by Roger Allam, the show follows the adventures of seven-year-old Sarah (voice of Tasha Lawrence) and her faithful companion Duck as they learn a variety of life lessons. In this collection, the pair explore a winter fair, take a snowy train journey and visit an observatory to view a comet. The episodes are: 'Snowball Skate', 'Mountain Mints', 'Comet's Coming', 'Perimeter Pals', 'Hedge Opera', 'Boo Night', 'Park Trimming', 'Whatsathingy', 'Cinema Scoot' and 'Ribbon Alvida'.

titles.title: Saturday night and Sunday morning
titles.summary: Director Karel Reisz's adaptation of Alan Sillitoe's novel about a hard-living factory worker and the married woman he seduces. Arthur Seaton (Albert Finney) is a young man filled with a rage perhaps even he doesn't fully understand. Working in the tough environment of a Nottingham factory, he compensates for the drudgery and discipline of his weekday life with weekends spent drinking and womanising. His affair with a fellow factory worker's wife, Brenda (Rachel Roberts), seems especially ill-advised - particularly when Brenda informs him that she is pregnant with his child. With abortion illegal at the time, Arthur and Brenda face a difficult dilemma. Will Arthur face up to the kind of domestic responsibilities he openly scorns in his own parents, or run harder than ever?

titles.title: Scales
titles.summary: Children's fantasy drama. Eleven year old Siren (Emmy Perry)'s life changes dramatically when she discovers she is a mermaid, with her special abilities due to reveal themselves on her 12th birthday. As she comes to terms with her true self, Siren discovers that a gang of mermaid hunters are after her for the healing properties in her mermaid blood. With the help of her friends, will Siren be able to escape the hunters and realise her destiny?

titles.title: Scoob!
titles.summary: Children's animated feature based on the classic Hanna Barbera cartoon. Ten years after meeting and forming Mystery Inc., Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and Shaggy (Will Forte/Iain Armitage) embark on a wild adventure after they are attacked by killer robots and saved by the Blue Falcon (Mark Wahlberg). Meanwhile, Fred (Zac Efron/Pierce Gagnon), Daphne (Amanda Seyfried/Mckenna Grace) and Velma (Gina Rodriguez/Ariana Greenblatt) search for a way to help their friends and stumble upon one of Dick Dastardly (Jason Isaacs)'s evil schemes.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo & WWE: Curse of the speed demon
titles.sortTitle: scooby-doo & wwe: curse of the speed demon
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the gang as they team up with the WWE to investigate another mystery. Whilst competing in an off-road race with The Undertaker, Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and Scooby team up with the wrestlers of the WWE universe to defeat an out of control demon driver called Inferno.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: Big top Scooby-Doo!
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure feature following Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang as they investigate strange goings-on at a circus. Scooby (voice of Frank Welker), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), Fred (also Welker), Daphne (Grey DeLisle) and Velma (Mindy Cohn) visit Brancusi Circus and end up performing in the show but they soon find themselves trying to solve a mystery involving a terrifying werewolf that has been wreaking havoc at the big top.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: Frankencreepy
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure of Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the Mystery, Inc. gang. Velma (Mindy Cohn) inherits a cursed estate that belonged to her great-great-uncle but in an attempt to keep her away from the castle, her distant relative destroys the Mystery Machine. Despite the warning, Velma and her friends Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), Fred (Welker), Daphne (Grey DeLisle) and Scooby-Doo decide to investigate and soon find themselves in some bizarre and troubling situations.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: Mask of the blue falcon
titles.sortTitle: scooby-doo: mask of the blue falcon
titles.summary: Another feature-length adventure following the Mystery Incorporated team. This time the gang investigate at the Mega Mondo Pop Cartoon-a-Con where the villainous Mr. Hyde (voice of John DiMaggio) releases a horde of evil creatures. Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and Scooby (Frank Welker) take inspiration from their favourite superheroes Blue Falcon and Dynomutt as they attempt to put a stop to Mr. Hyde's wicked ways and save the convention.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: Moon monster madness
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the Mystery, Inc. gang. Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), Fred (also Welker), Daphne (Grey DeLisle), Velma (Mindy Cohn) and Scooby-Doo win places on board a spaceship and head out on their journey along with various characters including billionaire Sly Baron (Malcolm McDowell) and astronaut Shannon Lucas (Jennifer Hale). While they are in space they encounter an alien who wreaks havoc with their vessel and they are forced to land on the moon. Can the gang catch the alien and get everyone safely back to Earth?

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: Shaggy's showdown
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the Mystery Incorporated gang as they try to solve another ghostly mystery. On a visit to the Crazy Q Dude Ranch the gang learn it was once haunted by the ghost of villainous cowboy Dapper Jack, who, it turns out, looks just like Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), as the pair are distantly related. When Dapper Jack returns once again to terrorise the ranch, the gang agrees to help stop him so that ranch owner Tawny Rogers (Melissa Villasenor) doesn't have to sell up and leave. Will they be able to solve the mystery and trap the outlaw before he drives everyone out of the ranch?

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: The mystery begins
titles.summary: The third live-action film based on the classic kids cartoon series. This feature tells the story of how Daphne (Kate Melton), Velma (Hayley Kiyoko), Fred (Robbie Amell), Shaggy (Nick Palatas) and a puppy called Scooby-Doo (Frank Welker) first met and became friends while attending Coolsville High. When ghosts start appearing, the gang get suspended from school after being falsely accused of playing spooky practical jokes. In an effort to prove their innocence, they set out to get to the bottom of the supernatural mystery.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo: WrestleMania mystery - original movie
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the gang as they investigate another mystery. Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and Scooby win tickets for WrestleMania XXX and, along with Fred (Welker), Velma (Mindy Cohn) and Daphne (Grey DeLisle), head to WWE City for the event. While there, however, they encounter a mysterious monster whose presence is sure to ruin the show. Assisted by wrestlers such as John Cena, Triple H, The Miz and Kane, the gang work together to solve the case.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo! and Kiss - Rock 'n' roll mystery
titles.sortTitle: scooby-doo! and kiss - rock 'n' roll mystery
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following the Mystery, Inc. gang who are this time joined by the band members of Kiss. Shaggy (voice of Matthew Lillard), Velma (Mindy Cohn), Fred (Frank Welker), Daphne (Grey Griffin) and Scooby-Doo (also Welker) go to the amusement park Kiss World where the band will be performing. While there, however, they discover that the evil Crimson Witch (Pauley Perrette) has been wreaking havoc at the park and is planning to summon a monster to destroy Earth. The gang use their mystery-solving skills to try to save the park and the world in time for Kiss to put on their rock show. Kiss members Gene Simmons, Paul Stanley, Eric Singer and Tommy Thayer lend their voices to their animated selves.

titles.title: Scooby-Doo!: Return to Zombie Island
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following Scooby-Doo (voice of Frank Welker) and the Mystery Inc. gang as they investigate another mystery. Not long after retiring, the gang win a chance to holiday at the Moonstar Island Resort. However, when they arrive, Daphne (Grey Griffin), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard), Velma (Kate Micucci) and Fred (Welker) discover the island feels strangely familiar and their getaway takes a turn for the worse when the resort is attacked by zombies. Can they finally solve the mystery of Zombie Island before it's taken over by the undead?

titles.title: Scrapper
titles.summary: Lola Campbell and Harris Dickinson star in this British drama written and directed by Charlotte Regan. Since the death of her mother, 12-year-old Georgie (Campbell) has been living alone in their council house, struggling with her grief and stealing bicycles to earn money, all the while pretending to any prying adults that her uncle is there with her. Only her best friend Ali (Alin Uzun) knows the truth until Jason (Dickinson), the father Georgie has never met, appears on her doorstep. Slowly, they begin to get to know each other, realising that they are more alike than they had initially thought, but can Georgie trust that Jason won't abandon her again?

titles.title: Scream 7
titles.summary: Neve Campbell returns to star in this seventh instalment of the slasher horror franchise. Having survived multiple attempts on her life over the years, Sidney Prescott (Campbell) now lives in Pine Grove, Indiana with her husband Mark (Joel McHale) and daughter Tatum (Isabel May). However, when she is targeted once again by Ghostface, she must fight to stay alive and protect her family. The cast also includes Courteney Cox, Jasmin Savoy Brown and Mason Gooding.

titles.title: Screwed
titles.summary: Finnish gay-themed drama that follows the relationship between 17-year-olds Miku and Elias (Mikko Kauppila and Valtteri Lehtinen). After being persuaded by his big brother, Miku celebrates the beginning of summer by throwing a wild house party when his parents leave town. However, when they return earlier than expected the next day, Miku is forced to spend the entire summer with them in their remote country cottage as punishment. There, he meets confident young neighbour Elias and sparks begin to fly between the two.

titles.title: The seagull
titles.summary: American drama based on the play by Anton Chekhov in which five people who connect when they visit a country estate find that their lives are about to intertwine with each other. Set in the early 20th century, fading actress Irina (Annette Bening) pays a visit to her brother, Sorin (Brian Dennehy), and her son, Konstantin (Billy Howle) and brings along her lover and famed writer, Boris (Corey Stoll). Konstantin is infatuated with the girl who lives on the nearby estate, Nina (Saoirse Ronan). The two get along well until Nina is swept off her feet by the sophisticated and intelligent writer Boris. Konstantin is furious that Nina has betrayed him and ends up on a downward spiral. Meanwhile, Konstantin is Masha (Elisabeth Moss)'s object of desire, a forlorn girl who wishes to quash her feelings of loneliness in the form of a romantic conquest with Konstantin. Irina, however, becomes increasingly envious of the young, free-spirited Nina who is starting to captivate Boris's attention.

titles.title: A season in France
titles.summary: French drama written and directed by Mahamat-Saleh Haroun. The film follows the plight of former teacher Abbas (Eriq Ebouaney), who fled his home in the Central African Republic in the midst of a civil war in search of a better life for his family. Still recovering from the loss of his wife who died during their escape, Abbas strikes up a relationship with florist Carole (Sandrine Bonnaire), who welcomes Abbas and his two children into her home in Paris. However, despite her hospitality, Abbas's situation remains perilous as he awaits a response to his application for political asylum.

titles.title: Sebastian
titles.summary: Mikko Mäkelä directs this drama starring Ruaridh Mollica as Max Williamson, a young writer struggling to write his debut novel. With an idea for a plot, aspiring author Max decides to immerse himself in his lead character in order aid his writing process.

titles.title: Second act
titles.summary: Jennifer Lopez stars as a frustrated underachiever who finally gets to realise her career ambitions in this American romantic comedy. 40-year-old Maya Vargas (Lopez) is tired of her dead-end job as a manager of a big box store in Queens and being passed over for promotions because of her lack of education. All that changes after Maya's son creates a fake CV and gives her a new online identity, boasting of her prestigious college degrees and distinguished achievements, and she is hired by corporation Franklin & Clark. After finally getting her foot in the door of a corporate career, Maya is determined not to let the opportunity pass her by and seizes her chance to make a better life for herself and her family. The cast also includes Vanessa Hudgens, Leah Remini and Milo Ventimiglia.

titles.title: The second mother
titles.summary: Brazilian drama written and directed by Anna Muylaert. 13 years ago, Val (Regina Casé) left her daughter Jéssica (Camila Márdila) with relatives in Pernambuco so she could go to work in São Paulo as a housemaid for a wealthy family and a nanny to their son Fabinho (Michel Joelsas). When Jéssica comes to São Paulo to apply to university she stays with her mother in the family's house. Despite feeling guilty for leaving Jéssica behind, Val finds living with her opinionated daughter a challenge...

titles.title: The secret agent
titles.summary: Wagner Moura stars in this Portuguese-language political thriller written and directed by Kleber Mendonça Filho. In 1977, Brazil is in turmoil due to the military dictatorship. Former professor Armando Solimoes (Moura)'s life is in jeopardy but as he seeks to escape persecution, he crosses paths with corrupt police officer Euclides (Robério Diógenes) and finds even more danger. The cast also includes Tânia Maria, Carlos Francisco and Maria Fernanda Cândido.

titles.title: The secret garden
titles.summary: Colin Firth and Julie Walters star in this family fantasy drama based on the novel by Frances Hodgson Burnett. Following the death of her parents, young orphan Mary Lennox (Dixie Egerickx) is sent to live with her strict uncle Lord Archibald Craven (Colin Firth) at his remote Yorkshire estate. In Misselthwaite Manor she meets her sickly cousin Colin (Edan Hayhurst) and discovers a magical secret garden that captures her imagination. Fascinated by her tales of the world beyond the manor walls, Colin enlists Mary's help to transport him outside, where he is rejuvenated by the magic of the secret garden.

titles.title: The secret garden
titles.summary: Children's fantasy drama based on the novel by Frances Hodgson Burnett. The film follows young Mary Lennox (Glennellen Anderson) who is forced to live with her uncle after her parents are tragically killed in a plane crash. As she tries her best to adjust to her new surroundings and forge new friendships, Mary begins exploring her uncle's mysterious Misselthwaite Factory and its secret garden.

titles.title: The secret life of pets
titles.summary: Computer-animated children's comedy following the adventures had by a group of New York pets after their owners leave the house. Pampered terrier Max (voice of Louis C.K.) is shocked when his owner brings home a huge, sloppy mongrel named Duke (Eric Stonestreet) from the dog pound. An intense rivalry quickly sparks between the two pets, with a jealous Max desperate to regain the attention he once had. However, the duo must put their differences to one side when cunning rabbit Snowball (Kevin Hart) begins to build an army of neglected ex-pets intent on getting revenge on all happily-owned pets and their owners. With the help of the other animals in his Manhattan building, Max must put a stop to Snowball's evil schemes before it's too late. The film also includes the voice talents of Steve Coogan, Jenny Slate and Lake Bell.

titles.title: The secret life of pets 2
titles.summary: Computer-animated children's comedy sequel following the adventures had by a group of New York pets after their owners leave the house. Max (voice of Patton Oswalt) begins to feel anxious when he experiences new changes at home and so sets out to become a braver dog, while Snowball (Kevin Hart) harnesses his superhero abilities to help with a rescue mission. The cast also includes the voice talents of Eric Stonestreet, Jenny Slate and Tiffany Haddish.

titles.title: The seed of the sacred fig
titles.summary: Mohammad Rasoulof directs this Persian-language political thriller starring Soheila Golestani. Lawyer Iman (Missagh Zareh) enjoys a peaceful life with his wife and daughters. When he is appointed judge of the Revolutionary Court in Tehran, his status improves and along with it his salary. However, when he discovers that he was hired only because he is expected to look the other way on certain cases, his once quiet life takes a dramatic turn. The cast also includes Soheila Golestani, Setareh Maleki and Mahsa Rostami.

titles.title: Sentimental value
titles.summary: Stellan Skarsgård stars in this drama co-written and directed by Joachim Trier. After the death of their mother, sisters Nora (Renate Reinsve) and Agnes (Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas) are forced to face their difficult family history when their estranged father Gustav (Skarsgård) re-enters their lives. A film director, he left Norway after his divorce and focused on his career which is now in decline. He wants to make a film inspired by his mother but when Nora, an actress, refuses to play her or even read the script, he casts American star Rachel Kemp (Elle Fanning) instead and the production becomes increasingly troubled. The cast also includes Anders Danielsen Lie, Jesper Christensen and Cory Michael Smith.

titles.title: September 5
titles.summary: Peter Sarsgaard and John Magaro star in this thriller co-written and directed by Tim Fehlbaum set during the 1972 Olympic Games in Munich. An ABC Sports crew led by Roone Arledge (Sarsgaard), Geoffrey Mason (Magaro) and Marvin Bader (Ben Chaplin) are in Germany covering the event, working with local translator Marianne Gebhardt (Leonie Benesch). After hearing gunshots one night, they learn that a terrorist attack is underway and a group of Israeli athletes and coaches have been taken hostage. Mason and Arledge seize the opportunity and begin covering the crisis but Bader fears that his colleagues are forgetting that the lives of the hostages are at stake and could be put at risk through the actions of the crew.

titles.title: Sequin in a blue room
titles.summary: Australian drama co-written and directed by Samuel Van Grinsven. Gay Australian teenager known as Sequin (Conor Leach) uses an app that protects his anonymity to meet up with older men for sexual encounters, vowing to never meet with the same person twice. Despite his father (Jeremy Lindsay Taylor)'s increasing concerns about his promiscuous lifestyle Sequin continues to balance school life with these secret hook-ups. However, when one older man, known only as B (Ed Wightman), insists on meeting again Sequin's naivety comes to the fore as his safety becomes compromised.

titles.title: The seventh veil
titles.summary: British drama starring Anne Todd and James Mason. A talented young pianist (Todd) is prone to fits of depression and suicide attempts. With the help of a psychiatrist (Herbert Lom) she begins to explore her past, which allows her to rediscover her true identity and enable her to play again.

titles.title: Severance: Series 1
titles.summary: All nine episodes from the first season of the psychological thriller created by Dan Erickson. The series follows biotechnology organisation Lumon Industries as they perfect a medical procedure known as severance which involves implanting a chip into the subject which, when activated, separates the consciousness from the rest of the mind. The episodes are: 'Good News About Hell', 'Half Loop', 'In Perpetuity', 'The You You Are', 'The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design', 'Hide and Seek', 'Defiant Jazz', 'What's for Dinner?' and 'The We We Are'.

titles.title: Shadow of a doubt
titles.summary: Hitchcock thriller. Young 'Charlie' Newton (Teresa Wright) longs for something exciting to happen to brighten her dull existence in Santa Rosa with parents Joseph (Henry Travers) and Emma (Patricia Collinge). The arrival of her Uncle Charlie (Joseph Cotten) seems to be just what she needs: urbane, witty and charming, the elder Charlie has announced that he wishes to quit New York to spend some time with his family. Uncle Charlie soon makes himself at home, but his suspicious behaviour begins to unsettle his niece. When police detective Macdonald Carey (Jack Graham) tells Charlie that he believes her uncle to be none other than the Merry Widow murderer, she begins to question whether she really knows Uncle Charlie at all.

titles.title: The shaggy dog
titles.summary: Comedy in which Tim Allen transforms from family dad to family dog. It all begins when workaholic Deputy D.A. Dave Douglas (Allen) takes on a case involving an animal laboratory - one that will take him away yet again from his wife, Rebecca (Kristin Davis) and kids, Carly (Zena Grey) and Josh (Spencer Breslin), who already yearn for his all-too-distracted attention. But when Dave is accidentally infected with a top-secret, genetic-mutation serum, everything he thought he knew about being himself and his family changes. Yet with his newly perked-up ears, and his front-row seat on the household carpet, Dave is able to gain a whole new perspective into his family's secrets and dreams. Now he wants nothing more than to stop fetching and return to fathering - only first he'll have to stop the evil forces behind the serum.

titles.title: Shang-Chi and the legend of the ten rings
titles.sortTitle: shang-chi and the legend of the ten rings
titles.summary: Simu Liu stars as Marvel Comics superhero Shang-Chi in this fantasy action adventure directed by Destin Daniel Cretton. Despite growing up in a powerful family in the mountains of China who are responsible for the mystical weapons known as the ten rings, Shang-Chi moves to San Francisco and goes by the name of Shaun, leading an ordinary life working as a valet. However, one day he comes under attack from a gang who steal a pendant from him and he is forced to admit his true origins to his best friend Katy (Awkwafina). As he is reacquainted with his estranged family, Shang-Chi must finally face his destiny. Tony Leung and Michelle Yeoh also star.

titles.title: The shape of water
titles.summary: Romantic fantasy drama from film-maker Guillermo del Toro starring Sally Hawkins and Octavia Spencer. Mute cleaner Elisa Esposito (Hawkins) works in a government laboratory in 1960s Baltimore. When the lab takes delivery of a classified experiment Elisa's life changes forever. Inside a mysterious water tank is a creature that was caught in a South American river by Colonel Richard Strickland (Michael Shannon). While cleaning one day, Elisa discovers that the creature is in fact a humanoid amphibian (Doug Jones) for which she quickly develops romantic feelings. When she learns of the creature's fate at the hands of the Colonel, she sets a plan in motion to kidnap him and return him to the sea. The cast also includes Richard Jenkins, Michael Stuhlbarg and David Hewlett.

titles.title: Shared rooms
titles.summary: Rob Williams writes and directs this gay-themed comedy drama that follows three couples celebrating the holiday season. Married couple Laslo (Christopher Pearson) and Cal (Alec Manley Wilson) are bemoaning all of their friends becoming parents when they receive a surprise visit from Cal's teenage nephew Zeke (Ryan Weldon). After being disowned by his parents for his sexuality, he decides to seek refuge with his gay uncle in the city. Meanwhile, Dylan (Robert Werner) returns home from travelling to discover he has no place to stay and is forced to share with his roommate Julian (Daniel Lipshutz), who he secretly has feelings for. Across town, singletons Sid (Justin Xavier) and Gray (Alexander Neil Miller) get together for a wild night after meeting online.

titles.title: Shaun the sheep in the farmer's llamas
titles.sortTitle: shaun the sheep in the farmer's llamas
titles.summary: Children's animated special from the popular Shaun the Sheep series directed by Jay Grace. Justin Fletcher voices Shaun, a mischievous sheep who regularly torments the farmer and his dog Bitzer (both voiced by John Sparkes). When the farmer and his dog set off to a country fair, Shaun stows away with them, sensing the opportunity for causing havoc. At the animal sale, Shaun spots three llamas who seem to have similar love of wacky pranks, and manages to influence the unwitting farmer into purchasing them. When the party returns to Mossy Bottom Farm, however, Shaun realises the llamas might not be the best barn-mates.

titles.title: Shaun the sheep movie
titles.summary: Feature-length movie from Aardman Animations following Shaun (voice of Justin Fletcher) and his flock of sheep. After their mischievous behaviour gets their farmer in a spot of bother Shaun and his friends go on a big adventure to the city to save him. While there they get up to all sorts of shenanigans. Will everyone get back to the farm in one piece? The film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Film.

titles.title: A Shaun the sheep movie - Farmageddon
titles.summary: Feature-length sequel from Aardman Animations following Shaun (voice of Justin Fletcher) and his flock of sheep as they try to help a lost alien find its way home. Shaun and his friends on Mossy Bottom Farm receive an unexpected visitor when friendly alien Lu-La (Amalia Vitale) crash-lands into one of their fields. Her arrival causes a frenzy in Mossingham, with the Farmer (John Sparkes) putting the flock to work to build a 'Farmageddon' theme park to cash in on the craze. Meanwhile, Shaun attempts to help Lu-La find a way home, but the Ministry of Alien Detection have their own plans for the alien creature.

titles.title: Shaun the sheep: Best of 10 years
titles.sortTitle: shaun the sheep: best of 10 years
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the popular children's animated series which follows Shaun, a mischievous and unique sheep who leads his flock into all manner of trouble. The episodes are: 'Off the Baa', 'Shape Up With Shaun', 'Take Away', 'Saturday Night Shaun', 'Save the Tree', 'Two's Company', 'Prickly Heat', 'Cones', '3D TV' and 'Babysitter Blitzer'.

titles.summary: Ten episodes from the children's animated series following Shaun, a mischievous and unique sheep who leads his flock into all manner of trouble. The episodes are: 'Duck', 'Bitzer for a Day', 'Bitzer's Secret', 'The Stare', 'Ping Pong Poacher', 'Save the Dump', 'Picture Perfect', 'Hidden Talents', 'Fruit and Nuts' and 'The Intruder'.

titles.summary: Collection of ten episodes from the popular children's animated series which follows Shaun, a mischievous and unique sheep who leads his flock into all manner of trouble. The episodes are: 'A Prickly Problem', 'Wanted', 'Rude Dude', 'Keeping the Bone', 'Happy Farmers' Day', 'Checklist', 'Return to Sender', 'Dangerous Deliveries', 'Sheep Farmer' and 'Turf War'.

titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the popular children's animated series which follows Shaun, a mischievous and unique sheep who leads his flock into all manner of trouble. The episodes are: 'Out of Order', 'Karma Farmer', 'Spoilsport', 'Baa-d Hair Day', 'The Farmer's Nephew', 'Babysitter Bitzer', 'Dodgy Lodger', 'Timmy and the Dragon' and 'Cone of Shame'.

titles.title: She
titles.summary: Another classic Hammer film, shot in Israel and based on H. Rider Haggard's fantasy novel. While on an expedition, Major Horace Holly (Peter Cushing) and his team discover the secret kingdom of Ayesha (Ursula Andress) - she who must be obeyed. Condemned to eternal life, Ayesha wishes Holly's colleague to join her in her eternal existence; believing him to be the reincarnation of her former lover, an Egyptian high priest whom she murdered two thousand years ago.

titles.title: She said
titles.summary: Maria Schrader directs this drama based on the book by Jodi Kantor and Megan Twohey, journalists who exposed film producer Harvey Weinstein's crimes of sexual misconduct. The film follows New York Times investigative reporters Kantor and Twohey (Zoe Kazan and Carey Mulligan) as they investigate reports of pervasive sexual harassment in Hollywood. Their investigation leads them to uncover a series of sexual abuse allegations against Weinstein (Mike Houston) and a system protecting abusers. The cast also includes Patricia Clarkson, Samantha Morton and Jennifer Ehle.

titles.title: She-Ra: The secret of the sword
titles.sortTitle: she-ra: the secret of the sword
titles.summary: Full-length feature comprising the first five episodes of 'She-Ra: Princess of Power', edited to form a stand-alone movie. Prince Adam of Eternia, otherwise known as He-Man, journeys to the land of Etheria to track down the mysterious owner of a magic sword. Upon its discovery, Hordak and his minions meet the might of He-Man head-on, but their captain, Adora, seems to have a strange connection to the magical blade. Can this servant of evil be connected to the magical blade?

titles.title: The sheep detectives
titles.summary: Hugh Jackman stars in this comedy directed by Kyle Balda. Farmer George Hardy (Jackman) cares deeply for his flock of sheep. Every evening he reads crime novels to them, unaware that they can understand everything he is saying. When he is found dead one morning the sheep, led by Lily (voice of Julia Louis-Dreyfus), are determined to uncover the truth about what happened to him. Upon witnessing the ineptitude of local policeman Tim Derry (Nicholas Braun), they vow to do whatever they must to find the killer and secure justice for George. The cast also includes Emma Thompson, Nicholas Galitzine and Molly Gordon.

titles.title: Shelter
titles.summary: Jason Statham stars in this action thriller directed by Ric Roman Waugh. When former MI6 assassin Michael Mason (Statham) is forced out of seclusion to protect Jesse (Bodhi Rae Breathnach), the young girl who has been bringing him supplies, his previous employers are determined to hunt him down and kill him. Forced to face his past after years of hiding, he fights to keep Jesse alive. Meanwhile, as Roberta Frost (Naomi Ackie) spearheads the search for Mason at MI6, she begins to suspect that all is not as it seems... The cast also includes Bill Nighy, Daniel Mays and Bryan Vigier.

titles.title: The sheriff
titles.summary: Josh Tessier directs this action thriller starring Michael Edwards as Nick Light, Sheriff of Riverwood. Plagued by memories of his son's murder, Nick is forced to relive the horrors after another person is killed in similar circumstances. The cast also includes Patrick Cage, Henning Baum and Milo Gibson.

titles.title: Sherlock Gnomes
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voice talents of Emily Blunt, Johnny Depp and James McAvoy. When a number of garden gnomes suddenly disappear, Gnomeo and Juliet (McAvoy and Blunt) recruit detective Sherlock Gnomes (Depp) and his sidekick Gnome Watson (Chiwetel Ejiofor) to help solve the mystery. Setting out on an epic adventure, the courageous gnomes must go to extreme lengths to find their friends and bring them home safely. The cast also includes Michael Caine, Stephen Merchant and Mary J. Blige.

titles.title: Shetland: Series 5
titles.summary: All six episodes from the fifth series of the Scottish crime drama based on the novels by Ann Cleeves. Set in the Shetland Islands, the programme follows Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez (Douglas Henshall) as he works to solve a number of murder mysteries. He is assisted by Detective Sergeant Alison 'Tosh' Macintosh (Alison O'Donnell) and Detective Constable Sandy Wilson (Steven Robertson). In this series, the discovery of a holdall containing body parts initiates a complicated murder investigation and Jimmy lands Cassie (Erin Armstrong) in trouble when he visits her in Glasgow.

titles.title: Shirley
titles.summary: Elisabeth Moss stars as writer Shirley Jackson in this biographical drama directed by Josephine Decker. In the 1950s, Shirley is engrossed in the writing of her latest book about the disappearance of a young woman when her unfaithful husband Stanley (Michael Stuhlbarg) welcomes newly-weds Rose and Fred Nemser (Odessa Young and Logan Lerman) into their home. As Shirley struggles with a creative crisis, Rose and Fred's relationship is tested by their hosts.

titles.title: Shoreham Aerodrome: the story of the oldest flying ground on the South Coast
titles.sortTitle: shoreham aerodrome : the story of the oldest flying ground on the south coast
titles.summary: SHOREHAM AERODROME, known today as Shoreham Airport, was the birthplace of aeronautical heritage in the South East of England. There have been many a famous aviator flying to and from Shoreham's grass, but this story tells about the less well known characters that have made Shoreham the well respected airport that it is today. Harold Piffard, the first person to fly a heavier-than-air powered flying machine over Sussex, created local public interest in flying, Cecil and Eric Pashley, the two brothers who put Shoreham on the aviation map, and Fred, George and Blossom Miles, the family that kept the airport operational during those lean years after the Second World War.

titles.title: Show dogs
titles.summary: American children's animated comedy in which a Rottweiler police dog is tasked with going undercover at a high-class dog show. When a baby panda is under threat of being stolen by smugglers, canine detective Max (voice of Ludacris) and his human partner Frank (Will Arnett) must race against time to rescue the tiny panda and put a stop to the evil animal smugglers. Can Frank assemble an elite team of pooches to save the day? Voice talents also include Stanley Tucci, Shaquille O'Neal and RuPaul.

titles.title: Showing up
titles.summary: Michelle Williams stars in this drama co-written and directed by Kelly Reichardt. Lizzie (Williams) is a sculptor preparing for an upcoming show but she is distracted by numerous personal problems. She has a difficult relationship with her landlord and neighbour Jo (Hong Chau), a rival artist, and is concerned about her family. Her father is being taken advantage of by unwanted house guests and her brother has become reclusive and is suffering from delusions. Meanwhile, Lizzie is struggling to care for the pigeon that her cat almost killed. As the day of the show draws closer and she becomes increasingly stressed, she tries to find the time to finish her work. The cast also includes John Magaro, Judd Hirsch and André Benjamin.

titles.title: Shrek collection [Digital Versatile Disc]: Shrek and Shrek 2
titles.sortTitle: shrek collection [digital versatile disc] : shrek and shrek 2

titles.title: Shrek: The 4-movie collection
titles.summary: All four chapters of the post-modern animated comedy-fantasy following Shrek (voice of Mike Myers), a reclusive ogre living in a swamp on the edges of a fairytale kingdom. In 'Shrek' (2001), the vain yet diminutive ruler of the land, Prince Fahrquaad (John Lithgow) decides to streamline his kingdom by getting rid of all the fairytale characters who promptly decamp to live in Shrek's swamp. Faced with these unwanted tenants Shrek strikes a deal with the Prince, promising to find and return with Princess Fiona (Cameron Diaz), marriage to whom will finally confer on the Prince his kingly status. In return the Prince promises to evict the various characters living on Shrek's land. Shrek's task is further irritated by the unwanted company of a tirelessly wise-cracking Donkey (Eddie Murphy), and while their adventure bears all the hallmarks of a classic fairytale, nothing in 'Shrek' turns out quite like you expect. In 'Shrek 2' (2004), Shrek returns from his honeymoon with his bride Princess Fiona to find an invitation from Fiona's parents, King Harold (John Cleese) and Queen Lilian (Julie Andrews) asking the newlyweds over to the Land Far, Far Away for dinner. On their arrival, they find that the King and Queen are less than pleased to see their daughter hitched to an affable green ogre, and looking rather the worse for wear herself compared to her former dazzling royal brilliance. When reminded by a conniving Fairy Godmother (Jennifer Saunders) of an ancient deal to match Fiona with her son, the vain and pompous Prince Charming (Rupert Everett), Shrek's new in-laws and their accomplices pull out all the stops to rid their kingdom of Shrek and restore their daughter to her former beauty - including hiring the services of notorious swashbuckling ogre-slayer Puss-in-Boots (Antonio Banderas). Murphy also reprises his role as the faithful Donkey. In 'Shrek the Third' (2007), when his frog-in-law suddenly croaks, Shrek embarks on another whirlwind adventure with Donkey and Puss in Boots to find the rightful heir to the throne, the awkward Arthur (Justin Timberlake). Unfortunately the envious Prince Charming has designs on the throne himself, joining with other fairytale villains in a coup d'etat to seize the crown. Can Shrek, with a magically misguided Merlin (voice of Eric Idle), a powerful posse of princesses, and a bundle of unexpected arrivals, manage to save the day? In 'Shrek: Forever After - The Final Chapter' (2010), after all of his many and varied adventures, Shrek has finally settled down to become a domesticated family ogre. Yearning for the days when he felt like a real ogre, Shrek is duped into signing a pact with smooth-talking wheeler-dealer Rumpelstiltskin (Walt Dohrn). He immediately finds himself plunged into a twisted alternate version of Far Far Away where ogres are hunted, Rumpelstiltskin is king, all his friends have completely different personalities, and Shrek and Fiona have never even met. It is now up to Shrek to save his friends, restore his world and reclaim his One True Love.

titles.title: Shun li and the poet
titles.summary: Italian drama exploring the relationship between two outsiders living in a small community in Venice. Shun Li (Tao Zhao) is living in Chioggia while trying her best to save enough money for her young son to join her from China. In the tavern where she works she is introduced to local fisherman Bepi (Rade Serbedzija), who moved to the town over 30 years previously but is still regarded as a foreigner. The two discover that they share a mutual passion for poetry and as their friendship progresses into something more serious they find that other members of the community have no scruples in stating their disapproval.

titles.title: Siblings: Series 2
titles.summary: All six episodes from the second series of the British comedy drama starring Tom Stourton and Charlotte Ritchie as brother and sister Dan and Hannah. The dysfunctional relationship shared by Dan and Hannah sees them getting themselves - and others - into awkward situations, including Dan landing a cleaning job at Hannah's place of work, Hannah attempting to learn the ins and outs of women's rugby, and Dan reluctantly taking up the position of his mother's new dance partner. The episodes are: 'Kevin Rugby', 'Golden Aunt', 'Old Man Model', 'Gregg and Lily', 'Baby Sack' and 'Jack's Wedding'.

titles.title: Silence
titles.summary: Liam Neeson, Adam Driver and Andrew Garfield star in this historical drama co-written and directed by Martin Scorsese. The film follows 17th century Jesuit priests Sebastiao Rodrigues (Garfield) and Francisco Garrpe (Driver) as they travel to Japan in search of their mentor Father Cristóvao Ferreira (Neeson). With the Japanese government wishing to suppress any kind of western influence and Japanese Christians forced into the wilds of the countryside to practice their faith in secret, the pair face violence and persecution immediately after setting out on their quest. Witnessing the torture and punishment of the Japanese first hand, it's not long before the priests face a spiritual crisis as they begin to question all that they previously believed. The cast also includes Ciarán Hinds, Shin'ya Tsukamoto and Tadanobu Asano.

titles.title: Silent youth
titles.summary: Observational drama written and directed by Diemo Kemmesies that focuses on the awkward budding relationship of a German and a Russian. On a break from school to visit a friend in Berlin, young and reserved engineering student Marlo (Martin Bruchmann) has a chance encounter with Kirill (Josef Mattes), who has travelled from Russia to visit his grandmother and has recently been the victim of a homophobic attack. The pair bond as they explore the city together but it seems neither can overcome their respective anxieties enough to further their relationship amid the intermittent conversation. Marlo seems happy just to have found a new friend but the more the extroverted Kirill opens up to him, the more confused Marlo becomes about the future of their relationship.

titles.title: Silver screen, silent voices: the story of film making at Bungalow Town-Shoreham Beach 1914-1923
titles.sortTitle: silver screen, silent voices : the story of film making at bungalow town-shoreham beach 1914-1923
titles.summary: By the time Progress Film Company began their operation of the Shoreham studio, just after World War One, Bungalow Town-Shoreham Beach was already established as a theatrical colony. Florrie Forde, Marie Loftus, Will Evans, Hetty King, Billy Williams, Seymour Hicks, Marie Lloyd, Vesta Tilley and Gladys Cooper were some of the popular stars who lived or had holiday homes built on the narrow strip of shingle beach between Brighton and Worthing. With the arrival of Progress, who established a studio centre they hoped would rival Hollywood, an exciting era began and the fame of Bungalow Town spread.
subjects: Motion pictures -- England -- West Sussex -- History

titles.title: A simple favour
titles.summary: Anna Kendrick and Blake Lively star in this crime thriller directed by Paul Feig. The film follows Stephanie Ward (Kendrick), a blogger who becomes friends with the glamorous Emily Nelson (Lively) after meeting outside their children's school. The pair begin to form a strong bond, only for Emily to suddenly disappear shortly after calling Stephanie asking her to do her a small favour. With no sign of her after days of searching, Stephanie begins looking into the secrets of Emily's past as she desperately searches for answers. The cast also includes Rupert Friend, Linda Cardellini and Henry Golding.

titles.title: Sing 2
titles.summary: Animated musical sequel featuring the voice talents of Matthew McConaughey, Reese Witherspoon and Scarlett Johansson. Buster Moon (McConaughey) is happy and thriving at his new theatre but he dreams of finding success in Redshore City. Together with his cast and crew, he travels there to audition for entertainment mogul Jimmy Crystal (Bobby Cannavale). Unfortunately, Jimmy is unimpressed until Gunter (Nick Kroll) panics and promises Jimmy that they have former rockstar Clay Calloway (Bono) with them. However, there is a slight problem: nobody has seen Clay for 15 years. Can the team find a way to put on the show?

titles.title: Single white female
titles.summary: Barbet Schroeder directs this thriller starring Bridget Fonda and Jennifer Jason Leigh. When Allie (Fonda) finds that her boyfriend is cheating on her, she kicks him out and advertises for a flatmate. She selects Hedra (Jason Leigh), a shy newcomer to Manhattan and at first Hedra seems to be the perfect companion, but dark secrets lie just beneath the surface...

titles.title: Singularity
titles.summary: John Cusack stars in this US sci-fi thriller co-written and directed by Robert Kouba. When Elias van Dorne (Cusack), the head of the world's most powerful robotics corporation, introduces his new supercomputer Kronos in a bid to end all wars and save the planet, the programme quickly identifies mankind as the main threat to Earth's future. After Kronos launches an attack which wipes out most of the human race, mysterious survivors Andrew (Julian Schaffner) and Calia (Jeannine Wacker) surface years later and set out on a perilous journey to Aurora, a settlement where Kronos and its robots can't reach.

titles.title: Sink or swim
titles.summary: French comedy drama co-written and directed by Gilles Lellouche. The film follows five middle-aged men, each tackling personal crises, as they form a synchronised swimming team and bid to compete in the World Championships in Norway. Under the guidance of their tough coaches Delphine (Virginie Efira) and Amanda (Leila Bekhti), the men attempt to whip themselves into championship shape as they each chase a modicum of success.

titles.title: The Sisters brothers
titles.summary: John C. Reilly and Joaquin Phoenix star in this Western adventure in which two brothers, Eli and Charlie Sisters (Reilly and Phoenix) set out to take out a gold prospector under the instruction of their boss, the Commodore. With Eli beginning to question their line of work and Charlie succumbing to alcoholism, the brothers begin to struggle with the task ahead of them. Meanwhile, their target Hermann Warm (Riz Ahmed) has concocted a genius but dangerous means of unearthing gold in riverbeds which has gained him both unwanted attention as well as unlikely acquaintances. When Warm and the Sisters brothers eventually cross paths, will Charlie and Eli go through with their plans or discover a lucrative way to make even more money? The cast also includes Jake Gyllenhaal, Rutger Hauer and Carol Kane.

titles.title: Six minutes to midnight
titles.summary: Eddie Izzard co-writes and stars in this drama set in England during the Second World War. In the summer of 1939, Thomas Miller (Izzard) is hired to teach English at a private boarding school in Bexhill-on-Sea. Tasked with teaching daughters of the Nazi high command, Miller becomes suspicious of his predecessor's demise and sets out to find proof of the school's collaboration with Nazi Germany, a task made more dangerous by the looming outbreak of war. The cast also includes Judi Dench, Carla Juri, James D'Arcy and Jim Broadbent.

titles.title: Skate kitchen
titles.summary: US drama co-written and directed by Crystal Moselle. The film follows Camille (Rachelle Vinberg), a New York teenager who defies her mother's wishes and gets involved with a group of girls brought together by their love of skateboarding. After a showdown with her mother, Camille moves in with her friend Janay (Dede Lovelace) and also begins skating with some of the local boys. However, things get complicated when Camille begins getting close to Devon (Jaden Smith), a member of the boys' crew who has a complicated history with Janay. The cast also includes Nina Moran, Kabrina Adams and Ajani Russell.

titles.title: Sketch
