titles.summary: Fantasy comedy adventure written and directed by Seth Worley. Widowed father Taylor Wyatt (Tony Hale) has two children, gamer Jack (Kue Lawrence) and aspiring artist Amber (Bianca Belle). Jack discovers a pond near his home one day and realises it possesses mysterious powers which affect anything that enters it. When Amber's sketchbook falls in, it unleashes havoc as the monsters she has drawn inside come to life. Can the siblings find a way to stop the fiendish beasts together before their home is destroyed?

titles.title: The skin I live in
titles.summary: Pedro Almodóvar directs this revenge tale based on Thierry Jonquet's 1995 novel 'Mygale'. Antonio Banderas stars as Robert Ledgard, an eminent plastic surgeon whose attempts to cultivate a new form of human skin have led to years of experimentation on a live woman, Vera (Elena Anaya). But as the story of Vera's past emerges, it becomes clear that Robert has a questionable agenda of his own as he manipulates her face and body for his own purposes.

titles.title: Slaughterhouse rulez
titles.summary: British horror comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Don Wallace (Finn Cole) is from a working class background but finds himself being sent to the elite Slaughterhouse boarding school. As he tries to get to grips with the hierarchy of the students, a giant sinkhole appears in the grounds with local woodsman Woody (Frost) informing them that it is a gateway to Hell. When terrifying monsters begin emerging from the hole, the students and teachers of Slaughterhouse face a battle to survive. The cast also includes Michael Sheen, Asa Butterfield and Jamie Blackley.

titles.title: Sleep furiously
titles.summary: Gideon Koppel directs this poetically-rendered portrait of Trefeurig, the small farming community in mid-Wales where he grew up. On a practical level, the isolated rural community struggles for survival as the local primary school is threatened with closure, traditional farming methods are rendered non-viable and key services disappear - but the community spirit and strong connection with nature ensure that many of the more intrinsic aspects of the old way of life are kept alive. Reminiscent of the works of Dylan Thomas in its subtle portrayal of rural life, the film combines striking cinematography with an ambient electronic soundtrack by Aphex Twin to pay homage to the filmmaker's birthplace and a way of life that could soon die out altogether.

titles.title: Sleeping beauty (Disney)
titles.summary: Classic Disney version of the Brothers Grimm fairy tale. After being cursed as a child by the evil sorceress Maleficent (voice of Eleanor Audley), Princess Aurora (Mary Costa) is destined to prick her finger on the spindle of a spinning wheel and fall into a deep and endless sleep on her 16th birthday. Only a kiss from Prince Phillip (Bill Shirley) can wake her, but he has been kidnapped by Maleficent who vows to keep him captive until he is an old man on the verge of death. Determined to save Aurora and put an end to Maleficent's evil schemes, good fairies Flora (Verna Felton), Fauna (Barbara Jo Allen) and Merryweather (Barbara Luddy) join forces in an attempt to free Phillip and help him break the curse.

titles.title: Sleeping dogs
titles.summary: Russell Crowe and Karen Gillan star in this crime thriller from director and co-writer Adam Cooper. Retired cop Roy Freeman (Crowe) is suffering from dementia, with notes around his house reminding him of simple tasks. When one of his old cases comes back to the surface, he decides to reopen the investigation and, in turn, jog some old memories. The cast also includes Marton Csokas, Pacharo Mzembe and Tommy Flanagan.

titles.title: Smallfoot
titles.summary: Children's animated adventure featuring the voice talents of Channing Tatum, James Corden and Zendaya. Having searched the entire mountain to prove the existence of humans, who they call smallfoots, yeti Migo (Tatum) is shocked when he finally discovers a smallfoot on the side of his mountain. However, when he returns to his tribe to tell them of his encounter, Migo is banished for lying and sets out on a quest to prove that smallfoots really do exist, with the help of his friends and the Smallfoot Evidentiary Society. His adventure takes him below the clouds, to the base of the mountain, where he finds another smallfoot, named Percy Patterson (Corden), and takes him back home to clear his name.

titles.title: The smashing machine
titles.summary: Dwayne Johnson stars as former amateur wrestler and pioneering mixed martial arts fighter Mark Kerr in this sports drama written and directed by Benny Safdie. After he loses a fight, Kerr knows that he needs to change his behaviour. However, his attempts to overcome his drug addiction strain his already tumultuous relationship with his girlfriend Dawn Staples (Emily Blunt). As he focuses on training harder, he battles constant pain and must prepare to fight his close friend Mark Coleman (Ryan Bader) for the world championship. The cast also includes Satoshi Ishii, James Moontasri and Oleksandr Usyk.

titles.title: Smurfs
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voice talents of Rihanna. The evil wizards Gargamel and Razamel (voice of JP Karliak) have been gathering together a set of magical books as part of their plan to take over the world and now only one remains hidden from them. Papa Smurf (John Goodman) has been keeping it safe but when the wizards kidnap him, Smurfette (Rihanna) leads her fellow Smurfs on a mission to save him and in the process, save the world. The voice cast also includes James Corden, Nick Offerman and Kurt Russell.

titles.title: The Smurfs 2
titles.summary: Family comedy sequel featuring a blend of CGI animation and live action based on the iconic characters created by Peyo for the 1980s television series. When the dastardly Gargamel (Hank Azaria) kidnaps Smurfette (voice of Katy Perry) and steals her away to Paris, the rest of the Smurf gang team up with their human friends Patrick (Neil Patrick Harris) and Grace (Jayma Mays) to try and rescue Smurfette from Gargamel's evil clutches. However, with Smurfette the key to Gargamel's plans to transform his latest minions, the Naughties (voiced by Christina Ricci and J.B. Smoove), into Smurfs, this will be no simple task - not least because Smurfette seems rather taken by the Naughties...

titles.title: The snail and the whale
titles.summary: Children's animated adaptation of the book by Julia Donaldson. Longing to see the world, a seaside-dwelling snail (voice of Sally Hawkins) writes an advert on a rock, hoping to catch a lift around the world. When a wandering humpback whale (Rob Brydon) finds the message, he welcomes her onto his vast tail and the pair set off on an incredible journey together.

titles.title: Snoopy and Charlie Brown - The peanuts movie
titles.sortTitle: snoopy and charlie brown - the peanuts movie
titles.summary: Steve Martino directs this animated family comedy based on the characters from the 'Peanuts' comic strip. When a new kid moves in to the house next door, Charlie Brown (voice of Noah Schnapp) sees it as an opportunity to make a new start with someone who doesn't yet know about his inability to make friends. Learning that his new neighbour is in fact a very pretty Little Red-Haired Girl (Francesca Capaldi), he turns his attention to winning her affection, not just friendship. With his trusty dog Snoopy (Bill Melendez) in tow, Charlie Brown sets about wooing the Little Red-Haired Girl in every unconventional way he knows how.

titles.title: Snow White and the seven dwarfs (Disney)
titles.sortTitle: snow white and the seven dwarfs (disney)
titles.summary: Disney's classic animated adaptation of the famous fairytale. Snow White (voice of Adriana Caselotti) is born pure and beautiful, so beautiful that her evil stepmother orders a huntsman to take her into the forest and kill her. However, the huntsman takes pity on the young girl and sets her free. Alone and lost in the forest, she meets a group of kindly dwarfs, who provide her with friendship and a place to sleep. But her evil stepmother refuses to give up and plans to kill Snow White herself using a poisoned apple...

titles.title: The snowman
titles.summary: Michael Fassbender and Val Kilmer star in this British crime drama directed by Tomas Alfredson. Based on Jo Nesbø's novel of the same name, the film follows Norwegian detective Harry Hole (Fassbender) as he investigates the mysterious murders of a number of women in and around the city of Oslo. With a sinister looking snowman found near the scene of each murder, it's not long before Harry realises he is dealing with a dangerous and ruthless serial killer. The cast also includes Rebecca Ferguson, Chloë Sevigny and Charlotte Gainsbourg.

titles.title: The snowman and the snowdog
titles.summary: The sequel to Raymond Briggs' classic animated tale about a snowman that comes magically to life after the chimes of midnight. Created to mark the 30th anniversary of the original short film, the story follows a young boy named Billy who, after moving into the house where the Snowman first appeared, and with the snow beginning to fall, discovers a box containing a scarf, a hat, coal lumps and a dried satsuma...

titles.title: Snowpiercer
titles.summary: Chris Evans stars in this sci-fi action drama co-written and directed by Bong Joon Ho. Following a failed attempt to halt global warming that sparked a new ice age in 2014, the last humans on Earth circumnavigate the globe aboard the Snowpiercer train. 17 years on, with the train rigidly divided by class, the poor inhabitants of the train's tail section, led by Curtis (Evans), decide to rebel and demand better treatment and living conditions. After freeing security expert Namgoong (Song Kang-ho) and his daughter Yona (Ko Asung), the band of rebels make their way to the front of the train in search of its creator, Wilford (Ed Harris). The cast also includes John Hurt, Tilda Swinton, Jamie Bell and Octavia Spencer.

titles.title: Socrates
titles.summary: Brazilian drama from film-maker Alexandre Moratto which centres on a 15-year-old boy names Socrates (Christian Malheiros), who is forced to grow up fast when his mother suddenly dies. Left with no money or guidance, Socrates must find a way to make a living and survive, all the while taking a self-destructive path of grief and exploring his identity as a young man.

titles.title: Sodom
titles.summary: British gay-themed drama. While on his stag weekend in Berlin twenty-something Will (Pip Brignall) finds himself naked and handcuffed to a lamppost until he is rescued by mature local Michael (Jo Weil) and invited back to his apartment. Recognising their instant chemistry with one another, the film follows the pair as they engage in a night of passion and self-discovery.

titles.title: Solaris
titles.summary: Psychological drama from Russian director Andrei Tarkovsky, adapted from the Stanislaw Lem novel of the same name. The film charts the strange events which befall a group of young cosmonauts who work on a space station orbiting the ocean-covered planet Solaris. Fellow cosmonaut Chris Kelvin (Donatas Banionis) is sent to investigate the occurrences, and soon begins encountering a variety of supernatural phenomena, including the physical manifestation of his own painful memories of his late wife. Kelvin tries to get to the bottom of the mystery and begins looking for a way to communicate with the powerful forces of Solaris.

titles.title: Something must break
titles.summary: Ester Martin Bergsmark co-writes and directs this Swedish gay-themed drama starring Saga Becker and Iggy Malmborg. The film follows Sebastian and Andreas (Becker and Malmborg), two young Swedes, who must come to terms with their identities and sexuality over the course of a burgeoning relationship. Andreas, who identifies himself as being straight, finds himself struggling with his attraction to the transgendered Sebastian, who, more frequently, has started living as 'Ellie'.

titles.title: Something special: King of the castle
titles.sortTitle: something special: king of the castle
titles.summary: Seven more episodes from the award-winning BBC series designed for children with learning and communication difficulties, based on the Makaton sign language system. In this instalment, Mr Tumble visits an ice cream factory, goes bird-watching and has a go at playing king. The episodes are: 'Castle', 'Narrowboat', 'Ice Cream', 'My Pets', 'Lifeboat', 'Birds' and 'Pottery'.

titles.title: Something special: Music stars
titles.summary: Nine more episodes from the award-winning BBC series designed for children with learning and communication difficulties, based on the Makaton sign language system. In this collection, Mr Tumble judges 'Tumbleton's Got Talent' and visits a dinosaur park. The episodes are: 'Music Stars', 'Hairdressers', 'Monkeying Around', 'Dinosaurs', 'Fairies', 'Pairs', 'Getting Sporty', 'Vets' and 'Imaginary Journey'.

titles.title: Something special: Sporty time with Mr.Tumble
titles.sortTitle: something special: sporty time with mr.tumble
titles.summary: Eight more episodes from the BBC series for children with learning and communication difficulties, based on the Makaton sign language system. The episodes are: 'Rugby', 'Gymnastics', 'Fishing', 'Football', 'Beaver Scout', 'Cycling', 'Outdoors' and 'Cheerleaders'.

titles.title: Something special: Superheroes
titles.summary: Eight more episodes from the award-winning BBC series designed for children with learning and communication difficulties, based on the Makaton sign language system. In this collection, Mr. Tumble goes camping and does a bit of spring cleaning while Justin looks after some animals and visits a radio star. The episodes are: 'Superheroes', 'Great Outdoors', 'Spring', 'Summer', 'Radio Star', 'In the Mood for Dancing', 'Animal Keeper' and 'Star Chart'.

titles.title: Sometimes always never
titles.summary: British comedy drama starring Bill Nighy and Sam Riley, directed by Carl Hunter. For years fashionable tailor Alan (Nighy) has been searching for his son Michael who went missing after a row during a game of scrabble. This pursuit has put him at odds with his youngest son Peter (Riley), but when a body is discovered and the family are informed that it may be Michael the fractured pair make the journey together. As Alan moves in with Peter and his young family he uses his grandson's computer to play online scrabble and becomes convinced that an online player is his missing son. Will Alan manage to bring his family together? The cast also features Tim McInnerney, Jenny Agutter and Alice Lowe.

titles.title: Son of Saul
titles.summary: László Nemes co-writes and directs this award-winning Hungarian drama. Set in 1944, the story follows Auschwitz prisoner Saul Ausländer (Géza Röhrig) who is forced to work with a Sonderkommando unit, burning the bodies of fellow Jews in the camp's crematorium. When Saul finds the body of a young boy he believes to be his son he risks everything to try and save him from being cremated and vows to give him a proper burial. The movie won the Golden Globe and the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film as well as the BAFTA for Best Film Not in the English Language.

titles.title: Son of Saul
titles.summary: László Nemes co-writes and directs this award-winning Hungarian drama. Set in 1944, the story follows Auschwitz prisoner Saul Ausländer (Géza Röhrig) who is forced to work with a Sonderkommando unit, burning the bodies of fellow Jews in the camp's crematorium. When Saul finds the body of a young boy he believes to be his son he risks everything to try and save him from being cremated and vows to give him a proper burial. The movie won the Golden Globe and the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film as well as the BAFTA for Best Film Not in the English Language.

titles.title: The son's room
titles.summary: Nanni Moretti writes, directs and stars in this Italian drama about family grief and bereavement. Psychiatrist Giovanni (Moretti) lives happily with his family in a small Italian coastal town. One Sunday he is due to spend time with his son Andrea (Giuseppe Sanfelice), when he receives an anguished call from Oscar (Silvio Orlando), one of his patients, and feels he must go and see him instead; later that afternoon Andrea dies in a diving accident. Over the following weeks, Giovanni, his wife Paola (Laura Morante), and daughter Irene (Jasmine Trinca), remain shell-shocked with grief; with Giovanni suspending his practice, and relations between himself and Paola becoming increasingly difficult. When a love letter arrives from a girl whom Andrea met the previous summer, the family become curious to learn more about this person who meant so much to their departed son and brother.

titles.title: Song of granite
titles.summary: Pat Collins co-writes and directs this Irish biographical drama about traditional sean nós folk singer Joe Heaney (Colm Seoighe/Michael O'Confhaola/Macdara O'Fátharta). Born in Carna in County Galway, a remote part of western Ireland, Joe first learns to sing after being taught by his mother and father. Leaving home at the age of 16 to study in Dublin, Joe moves on to London, Glasgow and then across to America. Recording hundreds of songs over the course of his life, Joe established himself as one of the most talented folk singers in Ireland.

titles.title: Song sung blue
titles.summary: Kate Hudson and Hugh Jackman star in this biographical musical drama written and directed by Craig Brewer. Musicians Claire and Mike Sardina (Hudson and Jackman) meet at the Wisconsin State Fair and soon fall in love and marry. Together they form a Neil Diamond tribute act called Lightning & Thunder but as they begin to find success together, they face numerous personal struggles and tragedies which they must fight to overcome. The cast also includes Michael Imperioli, Mustafa Shakir and Jim Belushi.

titles.title: Song to song
titles.summary: Ryan Gosling, Michael Fassbender and Rooney Mara star in this romantic drama written and directed by Terrence Malick. The film follows Faye (Mara), a young singer-songwriter from Austin who begins sleeping with powerful producer Cook (Fassbender) in the hope it will benefit her music career. While attending one of Cook's high-profile parties, she meets rising star BV (Gosling) and the pair quickly fall for each other. Although her relationship with BV begins to get serious Faye is unwilling to end things with Cook, fearing that her career prospects would suffer if she did. Meanwhile, Cook starts an affair with alluring waitress Rhonda (Natalie Portman) who is drawn to her new lover's flash celebrity lifestyle. The cast also includes Cate Blanchett, Holly Hunter and Val Kilmer.

titles.title: Sonic the hedgehog 2
titles.summary: Adventure comedy sequel featuring the computer game character Sonic the Hedgehog (voice of Ben Schwartz). Sonic and Tails (Colleen O'Shaughnessey) team up to defeat Dr. Robotnik (Jim Carrey) and Knuckles (Idris Elba) as both sides search for an emerald that has the power to destroy the world. Can Sonic and Tails find the jewel before it's too late?

titles.title: Sonic the hedgehog 3
titles.summary: Third instalment of the adventure comedy franchise based on the video game series. Sonic the Hedgehog (voice of Ben Schwartz) and his friends Tails (Colleen O'Shaughnessey) and Knuckles (Idris Elba) are tasked with catching and stopping Shadow the Hedgehog (Keanu Reeves), who was created as part of a secret government experiment and has now escaped confinement. Shadow possesses the ability to teleport and has super strength, making him a formidable opponent, and so Team Sonic may have to join forces with their arch-nemesis Dr. Ivo Robotnik (Jim Carrey) if they are to have any hope of stopping Shadow. The cast also includes James Marsden, Tika Sumpter and Krysten Ritter.

titles.title: Sonita
titles.summary: Documentary focusing on Afghan refugee Sonita Alizadeh, who dreams of one day becoming a successful rapper. The film follows Sonita, who lives apart from her family in Iran, as she tries to secure a visa that would allow her to pursue an education in America. However, her family are keen to marry her off to procure enough money for their own son's marriage as soon as possible, forcing Sonita to rebel and keep them in the dark about her true intentions.

titles.title: Sorry to bother you
titles.summary: A genre-bending satirical comedy directed by Boots Riley. Cassius Green (Lakeith Stanfield) is unemployed and living in his uncle's garage with his girlfriend Detroit (Tessa Thompson). When Cassius manages to get a job in telemarketing he struggles to get many sales until his older colleague Langston (Danny Glover) advises him to adopt a 'white voice'. Taking heed of this advice Cassius begins to improve his sales and finds himself moving upstairs to the coveted role of power-caller. Cassius' rise through the ranks comes at a time when Detroit is protesting against corporate greed and his colleagues are attempting to improve their poor working conditions. Cassius must then question the merits of gaining greater personal wealth at the expense of others.

titles.title: Sorry we missed you
titles.summary: Drama directed by Ken Loach and written by Paul Laverty. After losing his job as a construction worker Ricky Turner (Kris Hitchen) gains employment as a delivery driver. However, the working conditions leave him vulnerable as he attempts to raise his two children with wife Abbie (Debbie Honeywood). Similarly, her zero-hours contract as a home carer leaves the couple struggling to raise their young family.

titles.title: Soul
titles.summary: Disney-Pixar animation featuring the voice talents of Jamie Foxx and Tina Fey. New York City music teacher Joe Gardner (Foxx) has always dreamed of becoming a successful jazz musician. However, when he is given the chance to play with legendary bandleader Dorothea Williams (Angela Bassett), an untimely accident leads Joe to leave Earth for the Great Before. Refusing to accept his fate and venture into the Great Beyond, Joe attempts to convince cynical soul 22 (Fey) that life is worth living so he can make it back to Earth in time to deliver the performance of his life.

titles.title: Southpaw
titles.summary: Jake Gyllenhaal, Forest Whitaker and 50 Cent star in this hard-hitting sports drama directed by Antoine Fuqua. Reigning light-heavyweight boxing champion Billy 'The Great' Hope (Gyllenhaal) has a loving wife (Rachel McAdams) and child and a promising career ahead of him. However, Billy finds himself in danger of losing all of that after tragedy strikes and he is declared unfit to look after his young daughter Leila (Oona Laurence). Having hit rock-bottom, Billy desperately tries to regain control of his life and win back custody of his little girl with the help of boxing trainer Titus 'Tick' Wills (Whitaker).

titles.title: The souvenir
titles.summary: Honor Swinton Byrne, Tom Burke and Tilda Swinton star in this drama from British film-maker Joanna Hogg. Set in the 1980s, the film follows 24-year-old film student Julie (Swinton Byrne) as she falls in love with Anthony (Burke), a worldly but troubled upper-class man who works at the Foreign Office. Despite the concerns of her friends and family, Julie allows Anthony to move in with her. She begins to notice warning signs of his destructive behaviour, with Anthony becoming increasingly dependent on her, but she fails to fully comprehend the extent of his addictions until they tear them apart.

titles.title: The souvenir: Part II
titles.summary: Honor Swinton Byrne and Tilda Swinton return to star in the second part of this biographical drama from British film-maker Joanna Hogg. Following the end of her troubled relationship with an older man, film student Julie (Swinton Byrne) attempts to process her grief while focusing her attention on completing her graduation short. The cast also includes Richard Ayoade, Jaygann Ayeh, Ariane Labed and Charlie Heaton.

titles.title: Spaceship
titles.summary: British drama written and directed by Alex Taylor. Seven years on from the sudden death of her mother, teenager Lucidia (Alexa Davies) mysteriously disappears in what her friends believe to be an alien abduction. Desperate to find out the truth, Lucidia's father Gabriel (Antti Reini) is forced to seek help from her eccentric friends in a bid to bring her home. The cast also includes Lara Peake, Steven Elder and Lucian Charles Collier.

titles.title: Spark
titles.summary: Animated adventure directed by Aaron Woodley and featuring the voice talents of Jessica Biel, Susan Sarandon and Patrick Stewart. Spark (voice of Jace Norman) is a heroic young monkey who, along with his friends Vix (Biel) and Chunk (Rob deLeeuw), must face down an evil warlord. General Zhong (Alan C. Peterson) is the cruel ruler of Spark's home planet, Bana, and seeks to harness the power of the fearsome Kraken to create black holes and rule the galaxy through fear and domination. Spark, Vix and Chunk must travel to the far reaches of space if they are to find the power to resist Zhong and foil his diabolical plan.

titles.title: The Sparks brothers
titles.summary: Edgar Wright directs this documentary focusing on the career of American pop rock duo Sparks, formed by brothers Russell and Ron Mael in 1966. Featuring interviews with famous fans including Beck, Flea, Jason Schwartzman and Thurston Moore, the film charts Sparks' unconventional five decades in the music business.

titles.title: Speak no evil
titles.summary: James McAvoy stars in this psychological horror thriller remake of the 2022 Danish-Dutch film of the same name. Whilst on holiday in Italy, American couple Louise and Ben Dalton (Mackenzie Davis and Scoot McNairy) meet British couple Paddy and Ciara (McAvoy and Aisling Franciosi). After they return home, they accept an invitation for their family, including their daughter Agnes (Alix West Lefler) to visit Patrick and Ciara at their home. However, soon after they arrive, they begin to feel uncomfortable with their hosts' unsettling behaviour. Wary of causing offence, they stay, but this decision could cost them dearly.

titles.title: Spellbound
titles.summary: Psychological thriller from master of suspense Alfred Hitchcock. Psychiatrist Dr Constance Peterson (Ingrid Bergman) is intrigued by the arrival of her new boss, Dr Edwardes (Gregory Peck). Edwardes seems to be suffering from amnesia, and when he faints it transpires that he is in fact an imposter, and may be guilty of murdering the real Dr Edwardes. Constance sets about probing the imposter's psyche in an attempt to discover the truth. Features a famous dream sequence designed by Salvador Dali.

titles.title: Spencer
titles.summary: Kristen Stewart stars as Diana, Princess of Wales in this biographical drama directed by Pablo Larraín. As rumours of infidelity and speculation regarding an impending divorce from her husband, Prince Charles (Jack Farthing), swirl around her, Diana arrives at Sandringham House to spend Christmas with the royal family. As the formal festive proceedings get under way, Diana contemplates the breakdown of her loveless marriage while growing increasingly disillusioned with life in the royal family. The cast also includes Timothy Spall, Sally Hawkins and Stella Gonet.

titles.title: Spider-Man: Across the spider-verse
titles.summary: Animated superhero sequel based on Marvel Comics character Miles Morales. Miles (voice of Shameik Moore) is struggling to cope with the pressure of his parents' expectations and with missing Gwen Stacy (Hailee Steinfeld), who has returned to her own universe. When he encounters The Spot (Jason Schwartzman), a former scientist with a vendetta against Miles, Gwen reappears in his world and the two are soon travelling together across the multiverse in pursuit of the dangerous villain. As Miles learns more about his origins and the wider Spider-Verse, he comes into conflict with the leader of the Spider-Society, Miguel O'Hara (Oscar Isaac), and ends up alone in a bleak and dangerous world...

titles.title: Spider-Man: Far from home
titles.summary: Tom Holland reprises his role as the Marvel Comics superhero in this action adventure sequel directed by Jon Watts. Following on from the events of 'Avengers: Endgame' (2019), Peter Parker (Holland) takes a much-needed break with his friends. While on holiday, he is visited by Nick Fury (Samuel L. Jackson) who wants to recruit Spider-Man for his team. The cast also includes Zendaya, Jake Gyllenhaal, Jon Favreau and Cobie Smulders.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 08 Nov 2019); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Patcham Library (Set: 05 Oct 2024)

titles.title: Spider-Man: Into the spider-verse
titles.summary: Animated superhero action based on Marvel Comics character Miles Morales and featuring the voices of Nicolas Cage and Liev Schreiber. Brooklyn teen Miles Morales (voice of Shameik Moore) thinks he is the one and only Spider-Man, but in the shared multiverse known as the Spider-Verse, there are alternate universes and each one has its own version of Spider-Man. When The Kingpin (Schreiber) uses his supercollider and causes these different versions to collide and meet in modern day Brooklyn, they must work together to save the world.

titles.title: Spider-Man: No way home
titles.summary: Tom Holland reprises his role as the eponymous superhero in this action adventure sequel directed by Jon Watts. Following on from 'Spider-Man: Far from Home' (2019), Peter Parker (Holland)'s secret identity has been exposed and he tries to adapt to a new life where the whole world knows who he really is. However, when he approaches Dr. Stephen Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch) and asks him to magically restore his secret, he has no idea of the dire consequences that will follow. The cast also includes Zendaya, Marisa Tomei and Jon Favreau.

titles.title: Spinal Tap II: The end continues
titles.sortTitle: spinal tap ii: the end continues
titles.summary: Christopher Guest, Michael McKean and Harry Shearer reprise their roles as members of the fictional British heavy metal band Spinal Tap in this mockumentary comedy sequel directed by Rob Reiner. After 15 years, Spinal Tap are forced to reunite and perform one last concert in New Orleans. Film-maker Marty DiBergi (Reiner) returns to explore their activities during their hiatus and to capture the reunion on camera, but will the concert be a triumph or a disaster?

titles.title: The spirit of '45
titles.summary: Ken Loach directs this documentary about the rise of the British Welfare State and the need to safeguard it from powerful political movements that favour privatisation. At the end of the Second World War, the British public welcomed in a Labour government which promised better state housing and a National Health Service for its citizens. Although these things have contributed to higher standards of living in Britain, a mixture of apathy and a focus on the individual in recent political movements has weakened the institutions. The film is Ken Loach's attempt to rally the public in support of the state rights people fought for so long to acquire.

titles.title: Spirited away
titles.summary: Japanese animated fantasy written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki. During the journey to their new home, Chihiro (voice of Rumi Hiiragi/Daveigh Chase)'s parents discover a tunnel which leads to a seemingly abandoned amusement park and decide to explore. As they begin to eat at an empty restaurant still stocked with food, Chihiro is uncomfortable and continues to look around. She meets Haku (Miyu Irino/Jason Marsden) who warns her to leave before the sun sets but when she returns to her parents, she discovers that they have been transformed into pigs. In an attempt to save them, she begins working for Yubaba (Mari Natsuki/Suzanne Pleshette), the witch who cursed them, but Yubaba seeks to trap her in the spirit world forever...

titles.title: SpongeBob and friends: Patrick SquarePants
titles.summary: 14 more wacky adventures featuring the kind-hearted sea sponge and his friends Squidward, Mr Krabs, Patrick the Starfish, and Sandy the Squirrel. The episodes are: 'Big Pink Loser', 'The Secret Box', 'I'm With Stupid', 'New Student Starfish', 'Dunces and Dragons', 'Patrick Smartpants', 'That's No Lady', 'Driven to Tears', 'The Gift of Gum', 'Karate Star', 'Big Sister Sam', 'Squidward's School for Grown Ups', 'The Googly Artiste' and 'Pet Sitter Pat'.

titles.title: The SpongeBob movie: Search for SquarePants
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voice talents of Tom Kenny, Mark Hamill and Regina Hall. Determined to prove himself to Mr. Krabs (Clancy Brown), SpongeBob (Kenny) agrees to accompany the ghostly Flying Dutchman (Hamill) on a quest to the underworld. However, he is unaware that the Dutchman intends to use SpongeBob to free himself from a terrible curse placed upon him long ago. As Mr. Krabs, Squidward (Rodger Bumpass) and Gary the Snail (also Kenny) race to save SpongeBob and Patrick (Bill Fagerbakke) from the Dutchman, SpongeBob must decide if he really wants to change who he is at heart. The voice cast also includes Carolyn Lawrence, George Lopez and Sherry Cola.

titles.title: The SpongeBob movie: Sponge on the run
titles.sortTitle: spongebob movie: sponge on the run
titles.summary: Animated children's adventure featuring the loveable sea sponge, set in the underwater town of Bikini Bottom. When his pet snail Gary (voice of Tom Kenny) is kidnapped, SpongeBob (also Kenny) and Patrick (Bill Fagerbakke) set off on a quest to find him. Guided by a wise Sage (Keanu Reeves), SpongeBob and Patrick head to Atlantic City where they attempt to avoid the distractions of the lost city and free Gary from the clutches of King Poseidon (Matt Berry). The voice cast also includes Clancy Brown, Awkwafina and Snoop Dogg.

titles.title: The SpongeBob movie: Sponge out of water
titles.sortTitle: spongebob movie: sponge out of water
titles.summary: Feature-length live-action/animated adventure featuring the kind-hearted sea sponge and his friends Squidward, Mr Krabs, Patrick the Starfish and Sandy the Squirrel. The film follows SpongeBob (voice of Tom Kenny) and the rest of the gang, including his arch-enemy Plankton (Doug Lawrence), as they track down the formula for the famous Krabby Patty, which has been stolen by a fiendish pirate called Burger Beard (Antonio Banderas).

titles.title: Spooky stakeout
titles.summary: Irish adventure film in which a dynamic team of four young friends are requested to investigate a haunted castle, and hunt the ghouls which drive away any potential buyers of the building. Having already had spooky experiences in an abandoned school, the team discover that they have not left the past behind them as ghostly entities reappear.

titles.title: Springsteen: Deliver me from nowhere
titles.summary: Jeremy Allen White stars as the eponymous musician in this biographical drama written and directed by Scott Cooper. In 1981, Bruce Springsteen has just finished touring for 'The River', his first number one album, and is on the verge of superstardom. However, he is also burned out and struggling to cope with both his newfound success and with lingering demons from his childhood. As record executives at Columbia pressure him to produce more commercial hits, he instead rents a home in Colts Neck, New Jersey and begins working on the songs that will form his next album, 'Nebraska'. Recorded in his bedroom there, the songs are raw and haunting and tell stories of struggling blue-collar workers and outsiders but his team must battle Columbia to preserve what he has created. The cast also includes Jeremy Strong, Paul Walter Hauser and Stephen Graham.

titles.title: Spy x family code: White
titles.summary: Japanese anime based on the manga by Tatsuya Endo. After a lengthy and devastating war, the countries of Westalis and Ostania are finally at peace, but there are those who seek to reignite the war. Westalian spy Twilight (voice of Takuya Eguchi) needs to create a family for a mission designed to maintain the peace between the two nations. Calling himself Loid Forger, he marries Yor (Saori Hayami), unaware that she is an assassin from Ostania also in need of a marriage of convenience to maintain her own cover, and adopts Anya (Atsumi Tanezaki), a telepathic orphan. When Loid learns from his handler that he will be reassigned and replaced on his mission unless meaningful progress is made, he is determined to salvage the situation. Soon he, Yor and Anya are embroiled in an adventure involving a cooking competition, missing microfilm and a treacherous soldier but when Anya is kidnapped, can Loid rescue her and retrieve the microfilm without blowing his cover?

titles.title: Stan & Ollie
titles.summary: Steve Coogan and John C. Reilly star as famous comedy double act Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy as they embark on a tour of Britain and Ireland during their final years. Playing to half-empty halls the pair are no longer as popular as they once were and as they attempt to boost ticket sales with a number of public appearances their relationship is tested by the emotional strain of touring. After many years of great success Stan and Ollie are made to face up to the harsh realities of their twilight years. The cast also features Shirley Henderson and Nina Arianda.

titles.title: Stand or fall: The remarkable rise of Brighton & Hove Albion
titles.sortTitle: stand or fall: the remarkable rise of brighton & hove albion
titles.summary: Ross Clarke and Matt Lorenzo direct this documentary which chronicles the journey of Brighton & Hove Albion FC from the brink of extinction in the late 1990s to the Premier League. Founded in 1901, the club faced financial problems in the 1990s and were almost relegated from the Football League to the National League in 1997. Saved from liquidation, they achieved successive promotions in 2001 and 2002 to return to the EFL Championship and finished second in the 2016-17 season to win promotion to the Premier League. Their sixth place finish in the 2022-23 season saw them qualify for the UEFA Europa League, the first time in their history that they have competed in European club football. Archival footage and interviews with players, managers and fans are featured.

titles.title: A star is born
titles.summary: Bradley Cooper directs and stars in this romantic musical drama also starring Lady Gaga. Troubled country music star Jackson Maine (Cooper) meets and falls for aspiring singer-songwriter Ally (Lady Gaga) after seeing her perform at a roadside bar. Recognising her talent, Jackson invites Ally to perform with him and the pair form an onstage partnership that sends her soaring towards pop superstardom. However, as she strives to achieve her dream, their offstage relationship begins to break down when Jackson struggles to maintain control over his inner demons.

titles.title: A star is born
titles.summary: A remake of the 1937 classic, this time as a musical about a Hollywood couple going through bad times. Would-be singer Esther Blodgett (Judy Garland) finds herself taken under the wing of fading star Norman Maine (James Mason) when she saves him from making a drunken fool of himself on stage. Changing her name to Vicki Lester, Esther becomes a star, and is soon married to Norman. However, as Vicki's star rises, so Norman's falls. Harold Arlen/Ira Gershwin songs include 'The Man That Got Away'.

titles.title: Star wars: Episode II - Attack of the clones
titles.sortTitle: star wars: episode ii - attack of the clones
titles.summary: Ewan McGregor, Natalie Portman and Hayden Christensen return to star in this second instalment of the sci-fi saga's prequel trilogy. After disobeying the strictures of his Jedi training, Anakin Skywalker (Christensen) embarks on a forbidden affair with Padmé Amidala (Portman). Meanwhile, Obi-Wan Kenobi (McGregor)'s investigation of assassination attempts against Senator Organa (Jimmy Smits) leads him to the distant ocean planet of Kamino and into the middle of a separatist plot which brings the Galactic Republic to the very brink of civil war.

titles.title: Star wars: Episode IV - A new hope
titles.sortTitle: star wars: episode iv - a new hope
titles.summary: George Lucas directs this Academy Award-winning sci-fi adventure, the first film of the 'Star Wars' franchise. Set 19 years after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the Death Star is nearing completion and will soon be capable of destroying planets. When Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher), leader of the Rebel Alliance, discovers the Empire's plans, she is captured and taken to the Death Star. Meanwhile, farm boy Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) meets Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi (Alec Guinness) who vows to teach Luke how to be a Jedi like his father. When they discover that the princess has been kidnapped, they team up with smuggler Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Wookie warrior Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) and droids C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) and R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) in a bid to rescue Leia and ultimately aid the rebellion.

titles.title: Star wars: Episode V - The Empire strikes back
titles.sortTitle: star wars: episode v - the empire strikes back
titles.summary: Irvin Kershner directs this classic sci-fi sequel to 'Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope' (1977). After destroying the Death Star, the Rebel Alliance has set up a secret base on the ice planet Hoth. However, it's not long before the Empire discovers their location, leading the Imperial fleet, led by Darth Vader (Dave Prowse/voice of James Earl Jones), to launch a full-scale attack on their location. While Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Leia (Carrie Fisher), Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) flee in the Millennium Falcon and seek refuge in the cloud city of Bespin, Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) travels to the swamp planet Dagobah to continue his Jedi training under the guidance of Jedi Master Yoda (Frank Oz).

titles.title: Star wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
titles.sortTitle: star wars: episode vi - return of the jedi
titles.summary: Final instalment of the sci-fi saga's original trilogy. Following the events of 'Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back' (1980), Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams) save Han Solo (Harrison Ford), who has been frozen in carbonite, from Jabba the Hutt. While Luke returns to Dagobah to continue his training under Master Yoda (Frank Oz), the Rebel Alliance learns that the Empire, led by Darth Vader (Dave Prowse/voice of James Earl Jones) and Emperor Palpatine (Ian McDiarmid), has built a second Death Star, and set in motion a plan to destroy it before it is fully operational.

titles.title: Star wars: The last Jedi
titles.summary: Rian Johnson writes and directs this eighth instalment of the epic sci-fi film series in which Carrie Fisher and Mark Hamill reprise their roles from the original trilogy. Set immediately after the events of 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens' (2015), the film follows Princess Leia (Fisher), Rey (Daisy Ridley), Finn (John Boyega), Poe Dameron (Oscar Isaac) and Jedi Master Luke Skywalker (Hamill) as they continue their fight against First Order Supreme Leader Snoke (Andy Serkis) and his forces of darkness.

titles.title: Star wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
titles.sortTitle: star wars: the mandalorian and grogu
titles.summary: Pedro Pascal stars as the eponymous bounty hunter in this sci-fi action adventure directed by Jon Favreau which serves as a continuation of the television series of the same name. In the aftermath of the fall of the Galactic Empire, Din Djarin (Pascal), known as the Mandalorian, along with his alien apprentice Grogu, are tasked by Colonel Ward (Sigourney Weaver) of the New Republic with hunting down surviving Imperial warlords. To locate their next target, they must first rescue Rotta the Hutt (voice of Jeremy Allen White) from the clutches of Lord Janu (Jonny Coyne) but the mission soon proves to be far more complex than they first thought.

titles.title: Steve Jobs
titles.summary: Danny Boyle directs this award-winning biopic starring Michael Fassbender as the American businessman and co-founder of multinational tech company Apple Inc. The film follows Steve Jobs (Fassbender) as he sacrifices his personal life and relationships while transforming Apple from a dwindling loss-making company into a key player in the digital revolution. The supporting cast includes Kate Winslet, Seth Rogen, Jeff Daniels and Michael Stuhlbarg. The film won Golden Globe Awards for Best Screenplay and Best Supporting Actress (Winslet), the BAFTA for Best Supporting Actress (Winslet) and was nominated for two Academy Awards for Best Actor (Fassbender) and Best Supporting Actress (Winslet).

titles.title: Stick man
titles.summary: BBC animated adaptation of the children's book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler. The short film follows the journey of Stick Man (voice of Martin Freeman) as he ventures across the seasons and tries to make it back home before Christmas. On an early morning jog, Stick Man is snatched by a playful dog (Russell Tovey) and taken far away from his house. Will he make it back to Stick Lady Love (Sally Hawkins) and their three children in time for Christmas?

titles.title: Still Alice
titles.summary: Drama starring Julianne Moore as a linguistics professor who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Beginning with the loss of a few words in the middle of a lecture, Alice (Moore) becomes increasingly disorientated and even begins to feel lost in her own home and neighbourhood. Initially calm after the diagnosis, Alice struggles to cope with the everyday realities of the illness as her short-term memory rapidly deteriorates, forcing her to eventually leave her teaching post at Columbia University. Along with Alice, her two grown-up children (Kate Bosworth and Hunter Parrish), rebellious daughter Lydia (Kristen Stewart) and husband John (Alec Baldwin) have to come to terms with the full implications of the hereditary disease. Moore won a Golden Globe, a BAFTA and an Academy Award for her performance.

titles.title: Still life
titles.summary: Uberto Pasolini writes and directs this sentimental drama starring Eddie Marsan. Marsan plays the role of John May, a selfless civil servant, who is responsible for tracking down the next of kin of people who have passed away alone. However, facing redundancy through planned cuts to the council's budget, John is left with one last assignment. As he travels the city trying to find Kelly (Joanne Froggatt), the orphaned daughter of recently deceased Billy Stoke, John learns a few lessons about life and living along the way.

titles.title: Still walking
titles.summary: Japanese family drama adapted by Hirokazu Koreeda from his own novel. Middle-aged art restorer Ryota (Hiroshi Abe) and his sister Chinami (You) return to their childhood home with their own families for a gathering to mark the anniversary of the death of their older brother Junpei, who drowned while saving another boy's life 15 years earlier. The film tracks the subtle events that take place over the course of one summer's day as the family members reconnect while struggling to come to terms with undercurrents of generational conflict and the consequences of loss.

titles.title: Stonewall
titles.summary: Roland Emmerich directs this drama starring Jeremy Irvine and Jonathan Rhys Meyers. Growing up in Indiana, Danny Winters (Irvine) was always afraid to be himself. After being caught having sex with his boyfriend and subsequently disowned by his father, Danny moves to New York where he hopes he can finally be open about his life choices and his sexuality. When he reaches Greenwich Village he befriends a group of drag queens who lead him to the Stonewall Inn, a gay bar run by Mafia boss Ed Murphy (Ron Perlman). As Danny gets more involved in the underground gay culture of New York City, regularly clashing with the police, he realises that something must be done about the treatment of homosexuals and joins others in the struggle for gay liberation. The cast also includes Jonny Beauchamp, Joey King and Caleb Landry Jones.

titles.title: A stork's journey
titles.summary: Animated adventure directed by Toby Genkel. Young Richard (voice of Cooper Kelly Kramer/Tilman Döbler) is a sparrow, though having been orphaned at birth and raised by storks he behaves very much like a stork. One thing Richard cannot imitate however is the migratory habits of storks and so when it becomes time for the storks to fly south they have no choice but to leave Richard behind. Nonetheless, Richard is undeterred and decides to travel south to Africa anyway with the help of his new companions, Olga (Shannon Conley) and Kiki (Christian Gaul).

titles.title: Straight outta Compton
titles.summary: Hip hop biopic detailing the rise of American gangsta rap group N.W.A directed by F. Gary Gray. The film shows how aspiring rappers Eazy-E (Jason Mitchell), Dr. Dre (Corey Hawkins), Ice Cube (O'Shea Jackson Jr.), MC Ren (Aldis Hodge) and DJ Yella (Neil Brown Jr.) all met on the tough streets of Compton, California, during the 1980s and how they formed the group which would later become one of the most controversial and seminal acts in the history of hip hop music. The film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.

titles.title: Strange journey: The story of Rocky Horror
titles.sortTitle: strange journey: the story of rocky horror
titles.summary: Linus O'Brien directs this documentary which celebrates the 50th anniversary of 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show' (1975). O'Brien chronicles its development as a London stage show and explores its production, cultural impact, enduring legacy and continued relevance today. Archival footage features alongside interviews with the cast, creators and fans including Richard O'Brien, Tim Curry and Susan Sarandon.

titles.title: The stranger
titles.summary: French drama from director François Ozon. Based on the controversial novel by Albert Camus, the story follows antihero Meursault (Benjamin Voisin) as he is sentenced to death for committing murder. The cast also includes Rebecca Marder, Pierre Lottin and Denis Lavant.

titles.title: Stranger by the lake
titles.summary: Explicit gay thriller directed by Alain Guiraudie. Young gay man Franck (Pierre Deladonchamps) spends his summer days at a secluded lakeside shore, which has become a regular haunt for like-minded men hoping for a liaison. Here he meets Henri (Patrick d'Assumcao), a keen voyeur of the goings-on, who warns him to steer clear of the mysterious yet captivating Michel (Christophe Paou). Despite these warnings, Franck finds himself growing more and more attracted to Michel and even after witnessing first-hand the extent of his unrestrained rage, his feelings toward him never falter. Can Franck get through to this lethal and dangerous man on an emotional level?

titles.title: Stranger than paradise
titles.summary: Jim Jarmusch's black and white indie hit starring John Lurie. Willie (Lurie) is a New York hipster of Hungarian origin. When his relatives ask him to look after his 16-year-old cousin, Eva (Eszter Balint), he reluctantly agrees. Initially hostile to one another, it isn't long before the cousins develop an affectionate bond, but after ten days Eva leaves to stay with her Aunt Lotte (Cecillia Stark). A year later Willie and his friend Eddie (Richard Edson) head off to Cleveland to visit the two women...

titles.title: Straw dogs
titles.summary: Sam Peckinpah's controversial tale of a pacifist pushed to the limit has been widely criticized for its explicit depictions of violence and was banned in the UK from 1984 through to 2002. David Sumner (Dustin Hoffman) is an American mathematician who comes to live in a Cornish farmhouse with his wife Amy (Susan George). The locals don't take kindly to the young couple's presence, and begin a bullying campaign against them; when this escalates to rape and a direct assault upon the farmhouse, the ordinarily timid and slow-to-anger David begins to fight back.

titles.title: Strawberry shortcake: Berry bake shop
titles.summary: Three more adventures from the popular children's animated series. In this instalment, Huckleberry Pie (voice of Aidan Drummond) finds a lucky charm and Strawberry Shortcake (Anna Cummer) and the rest of the girls compete to make the biggest cupcakes for Berrykin Bloom (Paul Dobson). The episodes are: 'The Berry Lucky Day', 'A Basket Full of Blueberries' and 'The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bake-Off'.

titles.title: Strawberry shortcake: Fun under the sun
titles.sortTitle: strawberry shortcake: fun under the sun
titles.summary: More adventures from the popular children's animated series. In this instalment, Strawberry Shortcake (voice of Anna Cummer) and her friends go on vacation. The episodes are: 'The Berry Best Vacation', 'Where the Berry Breeze Blows' and 'No Blueberry Is an Island'.

titles.title: The stray
titles.summary: American family drama based on a true story in which a young boy named Christian (Connor Corum) befriends a stray dog who comes to his aid when he is being bullied at a local park. Though Christian's family are initially wary of their new pet, they soon warm to him as they discover that the dog can offer them more than they ever could have imagined. With Christian's parents' marriage on thin ice and his relationship with his father almost non-existent, his new canine best friend helps to strengthen the bond of the entire family while setting out on adventures with them along the way.

titles.title: A street cat named Bob
titles.summary: Roger Spottiswoode directs this feature film based on the true story that was adapted into the international bestselling autobiographical novel by James Bowen. Luke Treadaway stars as James, a homeless man struggling with drug addiction and busking to get by on the streets of London. When James comes across an injured stray cat he nurses him back to health and names him Bob. They become inseparable and make for an unusual street music act. Bob's companionship inspires James to overcome his drug addiction and share his story. The cast also includes Joanne Froggatt, Anthony Head and Ruta Gedmintas.

titles.title: Streets of Gloria
titles.summary: Drama written and directed by Felipe Sholl. Following the death of his grandmother, anthropologist Gabriel (Caio Macedo) feels the need to travel and decides to take a trip to Rio to study male sex workers. As he delves deeper, Gabriel finds himself intrigued enough by the world of sex work that he decides to try it for himself.

titles.title: Stronger
titles.summary: Jake Gyllenhaal and Tatiana Maslany star in this biographical drama based on the memoir of Jeff Bauman (Gyllenhaal), a survivor of the 2013 Boston Marathon bomb attack. After learning that his ex-girlfriend Erin (Maslany) is running the marathon, Jeff promises to come and support her as she crosses the line. However, he arrives at the finish just as the bombs go off, sustaining severe injuries which result in both his legs being amputated above the knees. Jeff is hailed a hero for his role in identifying the bomber and is thrust into the limelight, but his newfound fame soon starts to affect his mental state as he struggles to cope with intense rehab sessions, interviews and the uncertainty surrounding his future.

titles.title: Stuber
titles.summary: Michael Dowse directs this action comedy in which a dejected Uber driver is accidentally roped in to chasing down serious criminals with a hardened detective. While Stu (Kumail Nanjiani) is out driving one day, he is stopped by detective Vic (Dave Bautista) who involves him in a chase. What follows is a high-octane adventure as a nervous Stu reluctantly joins Vic in a violent and dangerous mission.

titles.title: The substance
titles.summary: Demi Moore and Margaret Qualley star in this body horror satire written and directed by Coralie Fargeat. When fading star Elisabeth Sparkle (Moore) is fired from her aerobics show by her producer Harvey (Dennis Quaid) on her 50th birthday, she is devastated. After learning about The Substance, an illicit drug that grants users a younger and more perfect version of themselves, she decides to try it and Sue (Qualley) is born. However, there are strict rules governing the use of The Substance and as Elisabeth and Sue vie for control, the consequences of their feud proves devastating.

titles.title: Suburbicon
titles.summary: George Clooney co-writes and directs this dark thriller starring Matt Damon, Julianne Moore and Oscar Isaac. In 1959, the quiet neighbourhood of Suburbicon is home to Gardner Lodge (Damon) and his family. When his home is broken into and his wife Rose (Moore) is murdered, Gardner and his son Nicky (Noah Jupe) welcome Rose's twin sister Margaret (also Moore) into their lives to help take care of them. When insurance agent Bud Cooper (Isaac) turns up asking questions about the suspicious circumstances of the break-in however, both Gardner and Margaret are suspected of having a part to play in her death.

titles.title: Succession: The complete fourth season
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the fourth and final season of the US drama created by Jesse Armstrong. On his 80th birthday, media mogul Logan Roy (Brian Cox) announces to his family that he will not be stepping down as CEO of their media and entertainment empire Waystar Royco. His decision incenses his four children, particularly heir apparent Kendall (Jeremy Strong), and sparks a bitter power struggle for the soul of the company which pits the ruthless siblings against one another and the rest of their family. In this season, with the GoJo deal about to close, the siblings adopt a divide and conquer approach to taking the ultimate control of Waystar, meanwhile Logan's poor health forces the siblings to question their intentions. The episodes are: 'The Munsters', 'Rehearsal', 'Connor's Wedding', 'Honeymoon States', 'Kill List', 'Living+', 'Tailgate Party', 'America Decides', 'Church and State' and 'With Open Eyes'.

titles.title: Succession: The complete third season
titles.summary: All nine episodes from the third season of the US drama created by Jesse Armstrong. On his 80th birthday, media mogul Logan Roy (Brian Cox) announces to his family that he will not be stepping down as CEO of their media and entertainment empire Waystar Royco. His decision incenses his four children, particularly heir apparent Kendall (Jeremy Strong), and sparks a bitter power struggle for the soul of the company which pits the ruthless siblings against one another and the rest of their family. In this season, a bitter family feud erupts in the wake of Kendall's press conference, while Logan attempts to acquire streaming company GoJo. The episodes are: 'Secession', 'Mass in Time of War', 'The Disruption', 'Lion in the Meadow', 'Retired Janitors of Idaho', 'What It Takes', 'Too Much Birthday', 'Chiantishire' and 'All the Bells Say'.

titles.title: Suffragette
titles.summary: British drama starring Carey Mulligan, Meryl Streep and Helena Bonham Carter. Maud Lancaster (Mulligan) was born in the Glasshouse laundry in London and knows nothing of the world other than performing her duties as a laundress and as a wife to her possessive husband Sonny (Ben Whishaw). When she hears of a group of women campaigning for the right to vote, she seizes the opportunity to break free from her mundane life and joins the Women's Social and Political Union. Together, the members of the militant organisation attend regular meetings chaired by their leader Emmeline Pankhurst (Streep) and plan their course of action to ensure politicans acquiesce to their requests, by whatever means necessary...

titles.title: The suicide squad
titles.summary: James Gunn writes and directs this action adventure sequel based on the DC Comics characters. Recruiting inmates from Belle Reve penitentiary, Amanda Waller (Viola Davis) forms Task Force X aka The Suicide Squad - a group of unlikely heroes comprised of imprisoned criminals including Harley Quinn (Margot Robbie), Bloodsport (Idris Elba), Peacemaker (John Cena), Rick Flag (Joel Kinnaman), Ratcatcher (Daniela Melchior) and Polka-Dot Man (David Dastmalchian). Sent to the island of Corto Maltese, the team is tasked with destroying the Jotunheim prison, where The Thinker (Peter Capaldi) is conducting experiments for Project Starfish.

titles.title: Suicide squad
titles.summary: Will Smith, Jared Leto, Margot Robbie and Cara Delevingne star in this action film following DC Comics supervillains who are transformed into a team of anti-heroes. Amanda Waller (Viola Davis) heads up a secret government agency for which she forms Task Force X aka the Suicide Squad - a group of unlikely heroes made up of imprisoned criminals. Once released from Belle Reve penitentiary, the squad, which includes Deadshot (Smith), Katana (Karen Fukuhara), Boomerang (Jai Courtney), El Diablo (Jay Hernandez), Killer Croc (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje), Slipknot (Adam Beach), The Joker (Leto) and Harley Quinn (Robbie), must carry out life-threatening covert operations, under the command of leader Rick Flag (Joel Kinnaman), to protect the planet from unseen evils.

titles.title: The summer with Carmen
titles.summary: Zacharias Mavroeidis directs this Greek comedy drama starring Yorgos Tsiantoulas and Andreas Lambropoulos. As Demosthenes (Tsiantoulas) recovers from a break-up, he tries to help his friend Nikitas (Lambropoulos) write a script for his first feature film. Regretting leaving his dog Karmen with his ex-boyfriend Panos (Nikolaos Mihas), Demosthenes uses his experience of loss to help Nikitas. The cast also includes Roubini Vasilakopoulou and Vasilis Tsigristaris.

titles.title: Summerland
titles.summary: Jessica Swale writes and directs this British drama starring Gemma Arterton, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Tom Courtenay. In southern England during the Second World War, reclusive writer Alice Lamb (Arterton) reluctantly becomes the guardian of a young boy, Frank (Lucas Bond), who was forced to evacuate his London home during the Blitz. Despite her reservations, Alice and Frank form a strong bond as they help each other overcome personal tragedy.

titles.title: Summertime
titles.summary: Catherine Corsini directs this French drama about forbidden love between two women. Set in 1971, Cécile De France plays Carole, a Spanish teacher and radical feminist living in Paris. By pure chance, on one of her feminist group's actions she meets Delphine (Izïa Higelin), the daughter of farmers. Almost instantly they fall in love, but their romance is disrupted when Delphine receives word that her father has had a stroke and she must return home to help with the farm. Carole, finding the separation difficult, decides to join Delphine on the family farm. However, the rural community isn't as liberal as Paris...

titles.title: Sunset
titles.summary: Hungarian drama co-written and directed by László Nemes. Set in 1913, the film follows Írisz Leiter (Juli Jakab) as she travels from Trieste to Budapest, hoping to reconnect with her past. She visits the millinery store once owned by her late parents, which is preparing to celebrate its 30th anniversary, but her attempts at learning more about her parents are dismissed by the store's new proprietor, Oszkár Brill (Vlad Ivanov). When she is attacked one night at her boarding house, Írisz learns she may have a brother and goes in search of answers as the outbreak of war looms over Europe.

titles.title: Sunset song
titles.summary: Terence Davies writes and directs this adaptation of the novel by Lewis Grassic Gibbon. Set on a small farm in rural Aberdeenshire in the early 1900s, the story follows the life of young farm girl Chris Guthrie (Agyness Deyn) as she fights for her independence from her tyrannical father (Peter Mullan). After witnessing the brutal flogging of her brother at the hands of her father, Chris meets Ewan (Kevin Guthrie), a handsome young farmer who falls for her unabashedly and promises her a better life. Can Chris ever truly escape her painful past and be completely happy?

titles.title: Super elfkins
titles.summary: Children's animated fantasy comedy sequel. Elfie (voice of Cindy Eliz) and her fellow Elfkins spend their time secretly helping humans in need but she is hungry for adventure. When she discovers the mischievous and technologically-minded Super Elfkins led by Bo (Jackson Poole), she wants to join them. However, when they encounter a human police officer and her cat who are determined to prove the existence of Elfkins to the world, it may take both clans of Elfkins working together to save the day.

titles.title: The super Mario galaxy movie
titles.summary: Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Jack Black provide the voices for this animated adventure based on the video game. Twin plumbers Mario and Luigi (Pratt and Charlie Day) put their problem-solving skills to the test as they attempt to reform the imprisoned Bowser (Black). Along the way, Princess Peach (Taylor-Joy)'s birthday party leads them on a galactic adventure and introduces them to Rosalina and Bowser Jr. (Brie Larson and Benny Safdie). The voice cast also includes Glen Powell, Keegan-Michael Key and Luis Guzmán.

titles.title: Supergirl
titles.summary: Milly Alcock stars as the eponymous superhero in this action adventure directed by Craig Gillespie. When Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, turns 23, she celebrates by making the journey across the galaxy with just her dog Krypto for company. When she meets a young alien by the name of Ruthye Marye Knoll (Eve Ridley) and learns of her quest to find Krem of the Yellow Hills (Matthias Schoenaerts), the man who killed her father, Kara immediately changes course and sets her sights on helping Ruthye get revenge.

titles.title: Superman
titles.summary: David Corenswet stars as the eponymous DC Comics superhero in this action adventure written and directed by James Gunn. When Superman tries to prevent a war, he faces an enemy capable of defeating him for the first time. Meanwhile, as Lex Luther (Nicholas Hoult) attempts to turn public opinion against Superman, a shocking secret about his Kryptonian parents is uncovered that could damage his reputation irreparably. With time running out, can Superman overcome the doubts and challenges he faces and thwart Luther's destructive schemes? The cast also includes Rachel Brosnahan, Edi Gathegi and Anthony Carrigan.

titles.title: Supernova
titles.summary: Colin Firth and Stanley Tucci star in this British drama written and directed by Harry Macqueen. Having been diagnosed with early onset dementia, novelist Tusker (Tucci) and his partner of 20 years, pianist Sam (Firth), tour England in their camper van, visiting friends and family before Tusker's condition worsens. However, their love for one another is put to the test as Tusker becomes resigned to his fate and Sam remains unwilling to give up hope.

titles.title: The surfer
titles.summary: Nicolas Cage stars as the eponymous surfer in this thriller directed by Lorcan Finnegan. When the surfer returns to his hometown seeking to purchase his childhood home, he takes his teenage son (Finn Little) to the nearby beach where he loved to surf as a boy. However, the beach is now ruled by a crew of surfers led by Scally (Julian McMahon) who refuse to let outsiders surf there. As the conflict between them escalates to violence, the surfer becomes increasingly enraged and begins to lose his grip on reality. The cast also includes Nic Cassim, Alexander Bertrand and Justin Rosniak.

titles.title: The surrogate
titles.summary: US drama written and directed by Jeremy Hersh. Brooklyn web designer Jess (Jasmine Batchelor) is delighted when she discovers she's pregnant after agreeing to be a surrogate for her gay best friends Josh and Aaron (Chris Perfetti and Sullivan Jones). However, when they learn that their baby will be born with Down's syndrome, the three friends are forced to confront some difficult choices about the child's future.

titles.title: Surviving Christmas with the relatives
titles.summary: James Dearden writes and directs this British festive comedy starring Julian Ovenden, Gemma Whelan, Joely Richardson and Sally Phillips. Chaos ensues when a dysfunctional family reunites at their late parents' dilapidated country house to celebrate the Christmas holidays together.

titles.title: Suspiria
titles.summary: Luca Guadagnino directs this remake of the 1977 Italian horror by Dario Argento. When young American ballet student Susie Bannion (Dakota Johnson) arrives at a German dance academy, the violent and bloody murder of one of the students opens her eyes to the history of the mysterious academy. As the body count rises, Susie becomes involved in a tale of murder, black magic and madness. The cast also includes Chloë Grace Moretz, Tilda Swinton and Malgorzata Bela.

titles.title: Swallows and Amazons
titles.summary: Classic children's adventure based on Arthur Ransome's classic novel. The story recounts the adventures of the Walker children who call themselves the Swallows, after their boat, as they holiday in the Lake District during the 1920s. There they meet two piratical sisters, known as the Amazons, who have already claimed the waters for themselves.

titles.title: Sweet country
titles.summary: Australian Western directed by Warwick Thornton. The film follows Sam Kelly (Hamilton Morris), a middle-aged Aboriginal farmhand sent to help embittered war veteran Harry March (Ewen Leslie) renovate his ranch. However, tensions between the pair soon reach breaking point and a fight breaks out, resulting in Sam killing Harry in self-defence. Now a wanted criminal, Sam and his wife are forced to flee into the outback as local lawman Sergeant Fletcher (Bryan Brown) gathers his forces and sets out into the wild to track him down. Meanwhile, as more details about the killing are revealed, many in the local community begin to question whether justice is being served.

titles.title: Swimming with men
titles.summary: Oliver Parker directs this British comedy drama starring Rob Brydon, Jim Carter and Rupert Graves. When middle-aged Eric Scott (Brydon) realises his life is missing some excitement, he joins a local group of men who escape from their mundane lives by practising synchronised swimming. When his ambition pushes the rest of the team to train harder they realise they could have what it takes to compete in the British championships.

titles.title: Swimming with men
titles.summary: Oliver Parker directs this British comedy drama starring Rob Brydon, Jim Carter and Rupert Graves. When middle-aged Eric Scott (Brydon) realises his life is missing some excitement, he joins a local group of men who escape from their mundane lives by practising synchronised swimming. When his ambition pushes the rest of the team to train harder they realise they could have what it takes to compete in the British championships.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 08 Nov 2018); In-transit from Rottingdean Library to Patcham Library (Set: 15 Sep 2023)

titles.title: Swinging safari
titles.summary: Australian comedy drama starring Guy Pearce and Kylie Minogue. Set in the 1970s, the film follows the lives of three middle-class suburban families in the coastal town of Wallaroo. While their parents revel in the decade's sexual promiscuity, their kids are brought together to perform stunts for budding teenage film-maker Jeff (Atticus Robb). When an enormous whale washes up on their beach, Jeff is presented with an opportunity to plot an escape from his dull life with the help of his crush, Melly (Darcey Wilson).

titles.title: Taboo
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the British television drama starring Tom Hardy, Jonathan Pryce and Oona Chaplin. Following the death of his father, a feared shipping tycoon, adventurer James Keziah Delaney (Hardy) returns to London in 1814 after a decade spent travelling in Africa to claim the rights to the mysterious island of Nootka Sound which has been left as part of his father's will. Surprising everyone, including his half-sister Zilpha (Chaplin) who feared he was dead, Delaney finds himself coming up against the head of the mighty East India Company Sir Stuart Strange (Pryce) who is desperate to secure the much sought-after island for his own gain. Negotiating the dark and dangerous games of London's rich and powerful, Delaney is forced to go to extreme lengths in his attempts to claim what is his. The cast also includes Leo Bill, David Hayman and Richard Dixon.

titles.title: Tad, the explorer
titles.summary: Animated adventure following the escapades of amateur explore Tad Jones (voice of Kerry Shale). Tad lives in Chicago and works in construction, but dreams of becoming a famous explorer like his hero Max Mordon (Adam Jones). His wish is granted when he takes the place of a professor on a flight to Peru to unlock the legendary Incan city of Paititi with the help of Mordon, Professor Lavrov (Mac Macdonald) and his daughter Sara (Ariel Winter). Tad's new job is not as easy as he dreamed though as the group are pursued by henchman from the evil firm Odysseus Inc. who are also out to explore the lost city and be the first to find any treasures it may hold. Will Tad be able to overcome the distractions of working with Sara and his hero to battle the corporation and their evil tricks so they can reach the ancient city before it is lost forever?

titles.title: Talk to me
titles.summary: Australian supernatural horror thriller directed by Danny and Michael Philippou. On the anniversary of her mother's death, Mia (Sophie Wilde) and her friends hold a séance using what is purported to be the embalmed hand of a powerful medium. The rush they experience from each brief possession becomes addictive but malevolent spirits are not to be toyed with and they are quick to exploit Mia's grief to bridge the divide between the worlds of the living and the dead...

titles.title: Tarzan (Disney)
titles.summary: Disney Studios turn their attention to Edgar Rice Burroughs' classic tale with this lively animated adaptation. Tarzan (voiced by Tony Goldwyn) is a human who was taken in and raised by gorilla Kala (Glenn Close) when his parents were killed by Sabor the leopard. Now a grown male, Tarzan has never been fully accepted by Kala's husband Kerchak (Lance Henriksen), the head of the tribe, but has female gorilla Terk and elephant Trantor for friends. When explorer Professor Porter (Nigel Hawthorne) arrives in the jungle with his daughter Jane (Minnie Driver) and adventurer Clayton (Brian Blessed), Tarzan discovers his human heritage for the first time, gradually learning how to speak and spending time at the visitors' encampment. However, although Porter merely wishes to study the gorillas, Clayton secretly plans to capture them and take them back to England, and tries to trick Tarzan into leading him to the tribe.

titles.title: The taste of things
titles.summary: Juliette Binoche and Benoît Magimel star in this French historical drama written and directed by Tran Anh Hung. Eugénie (Binoche) works as a cook for Dodin (Magimel), a gourmand who enjoys the creative brilliance of her food. They are in love and have been together for years, but Eugénie continues to decline his proposals of marriage, preferring that their relationship remain as it is. However, Dodin's plans to invite a visiting prince to his home for a meal are complicated by his growing concern for Eugénie's health. The cast also includes Galatéa Bellugi and Bonnie Chagneau-Ravoire.

titles.title: Teen titans go! to the movies
titles.sortTitle: teen titans go! to the movies
titles.summary: Animated feature following the adventures of the young DC Comics superheroes. Tired of every other superhero getting their own movie, Robin (voice of Scott Menville) leads the Teen Titans - Raven (Tara Strong), Starfire (Hynden Walch), Cyborg (Khary Payton) and Beast Boy (Greg Cipes) - to Hollywood where they hope to get their own film made. Seeking an arch nemesis to battle, the Titans are given their chance to shine and prove their worth when they learn of Slade (Will Arnett)'s plot to gain control of the minds of the Justice League to take over the world.

titles.title: Teen titans go! vs Teen titans
titles.sortTitle: teen titans go! vs teen titans
titles.summary: Animated feature following the adventures of the young DC Comics superheroes. After being summoned to the Master of Games (voice of Rhys Darby)'s arena, Robin (Scott Menville) and the Teen Titans finds themselves battling the serious versions of themselves from 2003. Trigon (Kevin Michael Richardson) reveals himself to be behind the showdown, kidnaps Raven (Tara Strong) and sets in motion his plan to conquer the multiverse. Can the two sets of heroes put aside their differences and work together to stop him?

titles.title: Teenage mutant ninja turtles: Wanted - Bebop and Rocksteady
titles.sortTitle: teenage mutant ninja turtles: wanted - bebop and rocksteady
titles.summary: Another collection of episodes from the children's CGI-animated cartoon tracing the origins of the sewer-dwelling, superhero foursome Leonardo (voice of Seth Green), Donatello (Rob Paulsen), Raphael (Sean Astin) and Michelangelo (Greg Cipes).

titles.title: Tehran taboo
titles.summary: Foreign animated drama in which a group of strangers with their own separate paths each take risks in order to break away from their oppressive lives in an Islamic society. A woman wants nothing more than to work despite the protests of her husband, a mother takes desperate measures to provide for her son and an aspiring musician attempts to release an album despite its contradictions of Islamic values. They must carry out their lives in secrecy if they are to both keep themselves alive and find happiness.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 30 Jan 2019); On loan - Due: 07 Nov 2026

titles.title: Tenet
titles.summary: Christopher Nolan writes and directs this action thriller starring John David Washington and Robert Pattinson. While attempting to foil a terrorist attack in Kiev, the Protagonist (Washington) learns of a future technology capable of reversing time. Employed by a shadowy international organisation, the Protagonist works with handler Neil (Pattinson) on a mission to investigate the origins of the future technology as they race to prevent it from being used to destroy the world. The cast also includes Elizabeth Debicki, Kenneth Branagh, Michael Caine and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

titles.title: Tesla
titles.summary: Ethan Hawke stars as inventor Nikola Tesla in this biographical drama directed by Michael Almereyda. In the late 19th century, Tesla unveils his novel system of electrical energy using alternate currents. Hoping to transform the way the world works, Tesla works with rival inventor Thomas Edison (Kyle MacLachlan), who initially lambasts Tesla's system as impractical and dangerous, entrepreneur George Westinghouse (Jim Gaffigan) and financier JP Morgan (Donnie Keshawarz), but his visionary ideas for worldwide wireless electrical power fail to make an impact during his lifetime.

titles.title: That day we sang
titles.summary: Victoria Wood writes and directs this musical drama starring Michael Ball and Imelda Staunton as Tubby and Enid, two lonely Mancunians who find love while preparing for a televised choir reunion.
