Tubby and Enid sang in the same choir when they were schoolchildren but it is only now, thirty years later, that they feel a connection. However, Enid is romantically involved with a married man. But how will she react when she finds out that Tubby carries a torch for her?

titles.title: Theeb
titles.summary: Naji Abu Nowar co-writes and directs this Arabic drama set during the First World War. In the Ottoman province of Hejaz, young Bedouin orphans Theeb (Jacir Eid Al-Hwietat) and his older brother Hussein (Hussein Salameh Al-Sweilhiyeen) embark on a perilous journey across the desert to take an English soldier and his Arabian guide to a well near an Ottoman train track. Although Hussein orders his younger brother to stay home, Theeb follows and is soon left to fend for himself when the rest of the group are ambushed and killed by Arab rebels. When an injured mercenary comes across the youngster the pair are forced to rely on each other to survive in the inhospitable desert amidst the surrounding violence. The film won the BAFTA Award for Outstanding Debut By a British Writer, Director or Producer.

titles.title: Theo and Hugo
titles.summary: Olivier Ducastel directs this French, gay-themed drama that follows two lovers over the course of their first night together in Paris. Theo (Geoffrey Couët) and Hugo (François Nambot) meet in salubrious circumstances, but form a special connection. A devastating revelation shakes their emerging friendship but binds the pair together as over the course of the evening they seek out the truth and the future of their relationship.

titles.title: The theory of everything
titles.summary: James Marsh directs this biographical drama starring Eddie Redmayne as English physicist and cosmologist Stephen Hawking and Felicity Jones as his first wife Jane. The film follows the relationship between Stephen and Jane as they fall in love while studying at Cambridge during the 1960s. With Jane's support, Stephen is able to cope with his diagnosis of advanced motor neurone disease, which leads to him becoming almost completely paralysed over the years, and achieve great success and international acclaim in the scientific field with his theories on time and space. However, with the deterioration of his health comes a deterioration of his marriage, putting further strain on the now world-renowned scientist. The cast also includes Charlie Cox, Emily Watson and David Thewlis.

titles.title: The thicket
titles.summary: Peter Dinklage and Juliette Lewis star in this Western thriller from director Elliott Lester. When Jack Parker (Levon Hawke)'s sister Lula (Esme Creed-Miles) is kidnapped by the elusive Cut Throat Bill (Lewis), he employs the help of bounty hunter Reginald Jones (Dinklage) to hunt down the killer and rescue his sister. When they find themselves in a deadly land known as The Thicket, they encounter a neverending line of people out to do them harm. The cast also includes Gbenga Akinnagbe, Ned Dennehy and Arliss Howard.

titles.title: Things to come
titles.summary: Mia Hansen-Løve writes and directs this drama starring Isabelle Huppert. The film follows high school philosophy teacher Nathalie Chazeaux (Huppert) as she re-evaluates her life in the wake of the death of her mother and the breakdown of her marriage. The Parisian mother of two has her world shattered when her husband of 25 years Heinz (André Marcon) informs her he is leaving her to be with another woman and a week later her possessive mother passes away in her nursing home. Faced with a new-found freedom, Nathalie tries to take back control of her life and find her true self while putting the theories she teaches to her students into practice. As she does so, she develops a close friendship with her favourite former student Fabien (Roman Kolinka) who is trying to find his own path in life.

titles.title: The third man
titles.summary: Classic thriller starring Orson Welles in which an author investigates the death of a friend in post-World War II Vienna. Holly Martins (Joseph Cotten), a pulp Western writer, arrives in the Austrian capital expecting to take up a job with his old acquaintance Harry Lime (Welles). When he is informed that Lime died a week previously in a car accident, Martins is intrigued by inconsistencies in the accounts of the death and decides that he can't leave the city without investigating further. As a consequence, he finds himself drawn into a web of intrigue as he searches for the elusive 'third man' who was at the scene of Lime's death. When the head of the local military police, Major Calloway (Trevor Howard), informs him that Lime was involved in black market drug distribution, the plot thickens even further...

titles.title: Third person
titles.summary: Paul Haggis writes, directs and produces this drama starring Liam Neeson and James Franco. Award-winning author Michael (Neeson) is suffering with writer's block while trying to complete his latest book and so, after leaving his wife, he travels to Paris to lock himself in a hotel room until he has finished. Simultaneously, businessman Scott (Adrien Brody) is on a business trip in Italy when he stumbles across an American-style café. Suddenly realising he is alone Scott strikes up a conversation with the beautiful Monika (Moran Atias) who tells him she is awaiting a reunion with her young daughter. Wanting to help her Scott offers to lend her money to help pay for the arrangement. In America, actress Julia (Mila Kunis) is in the middle of a messy custody battle with her husband Rick (Franco). As the plotlines intertwine and links between the couples begin to emerge, it is discovered that one person connects them all...

titles.title: Thomas & friends: A colourful world
titles.summary: Eight episodes from the 22nd series of the children's programme following the adventures of tank engine Thomas and his locomotive friends. In this collection, James gets sent for repairs and dreams he has been painted different colours. Elsewhere, Thomas gets a part in a Bollywood film before visiting China. The episodes are: 'An Engine of Many Colours', 'Tiger Trouble', 'The Water Wheel', 'Thomas Goes to Bollywood', 'Counting On Nia', 'Thomas & the Dragon', 'Hunt the Truck' and 'Thomas in the Wild'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Big world! Big adventures! the movie
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: big world! big adventures! the movie
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following tank engine Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. When racing car Ace (Peter Andre) passes through Sodor on his journey around the world, Thomas finds himself inspired to take a trip of his own.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Christmas on Sodor
titles.summary: Eight festive animated adventures with Thomas the Tank Engine (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. The episodes are: 'Terence Breaks the Ice', 'Daisy's Perfect Christmas', 'Confused Coaches', 'Emily in the Middle', 'The Big Freeze', 'Cautious Connor', 'Tit for Tat' and 'All in Vain'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Danger at the docks
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: danger at the docks
titles.summary: Children's animation series following steam locomotive Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his friends on Sodor Island in which they are introduced to Carly (Lucy Montgomery) the crane. Cranky (Matt Wilkinson) worries that he will be replaced by the shiny new crane and his feelings worsen when Carly is keen to muck in and get to work. The two cranes begin to try and outdo each other, resulting in them getting their hooks tangled together. Can they learn to work alongside each other and become friends? Also, Harvey (Keith Wickham) has crane problems of his own, Philip (Rasmus Hardiker) discovers the origins of his number 68 and Diesel (Kerry Shale) makes a new friend. The episodes are: 'Cranky at the End of the Line', 'New Crane on the Dock', 'Stuck in Gear', 'A Most Singular Engine', 'Springtime for Diesel', 'Den & Dart' and 'Philip's Number'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Digs & discoveries
titles.summary: Feature-length episode of the children's animation following the adventures of tank engine Thomas and his locomotive friends. In this instalment, Thomas and his friends are working in Italy where they learn about the country's hidden history and uncover the legend of the lost engine.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Extraordinary engines
titles.summary: Another six episodes from the children's animated series featuring tank engine Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. In this instalment, the arrival of a new engine named Hugo (Rob Rackstraw) makes the others worry about being replaced, a ghost train makes an ominous appearance and Skiff (Jamie Campbell Bower) takes the Fat Controller (Keith Wickham) on a search for mermaids. The episodes are: 'Engine of the Future', 'Henry in the Dark', 'The Missing Breakdown Train', 'Hugo and the Airship', 'Three Steam Engines Gruff' and 'Skiff and the Mermaid'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Here comes the steam team
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: here comes the steam team
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the children's animation following tank engine Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. In these episodes, Thomas competes with Hong-Mei (Chipo Chung) in a race to find out which of them is the number one engine, Nia (Yvonne Grundy) helps out Gordon (Keith Wickham) when he is feeling sad and Thomas gets lost in the outback. The episodes are: 'Confusion Without Delay', 'What Rebecca Does', 'Number One Engine', 'Trusty Trunky', 'Forever and Ever', 'Outback Thomas' and 'The Case of the Puzzling Parts'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Journey beyond Sodor - The movie
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: journey beyond sodor - the movie
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following tank engine Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. As Thomas prepares to leave the Island of Sodor for the very first time, he embarks on a journey to the mainland where he meets new, experimental engines Merlin (Hugh Bonneville), Lexi (Lucy Montgomery) and Theo (Darren Boyd). The voice cast also includes Rob Rackshaw, Nigel Pilkington and Jim Howick.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Merry winter wish
titles.summary: Six festive-themed episodes from the children's animation following Thomas the Tank Engine and his friends. In this instalment, Thomas has to deliver a special Christmas light, the Town Square hosts a snowman party, Henry and the Fat Controller have a surprise for Sodor Island and Misty Island holds its very first Christmas party. The episodes are: 'Merry Winter Wish', 'Thomas and the Snowman Party', 'Henry's Magic Box', 'Merry Misty Island', 'Let It Snow' and 'Surprise Surprise'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Monkey trouble!
titles.summary: Nine animated adventures following tank engine Thomas and his locomotive friends. In this instalment, Thomas encounters some mischievous monkeys in India and meets a new stealth engine. The episodes are: 'Thomas and the Monkey Palace', 'School of Duck', 'Seeing Is Believing', 'Cyclone Thomas', 'Banjo and the Bushfire', 'Rosie Is Red', 'Apology Impossible', 'Samson and the Fireworks' and 'Thomas' Animal Ark'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: On the go with Thomas
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: on the go with thomas
titles.summary: Seven episodes of the animated children's television show following the adventures of tank engine Thomas and his locomotive friends. In these episodes, Rosie is repainted red and James challenges her to a race so that he can prove that he is the quickest red engine in Sodor, The Fat Controller gets his hands on a new P.A. system which ends up causing trouble and Millie needs to let off some steam. The episodes are: 'The Fastest Red Engine On Sodor', 'A Shed for Edward', 'Dowager Hatt's Busy Day', 'Runaway Engine', 'P.A. Problems', 'Hasty Hannah' and 'Unscheduled Stops'.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Sodor's legend of the lost treasure - The movie
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: sodor's legend of the lost treasure - the movie
titles.summary: Feature-length animated adventure following tank engine Thomas (voice of John Hasler) and his locomotive friends. After Thomas is banished for causing some problems on the tracks he comes across a pirate ship and finds himself on the hunt for the lost treasure of Sodor Island. But he will have to race against time in order to stop Sailor John (John Hurt) getting his hands on the treasure. Will he succeed and get back in Sir Topham Hatt (Keith Wickham)'s good books? The voice cast also includes Eddie Redmayne, Jamie Campbell Bower and Olivia Colman.

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Tale of the brave
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: tale of the brave
titles.summary: Feature-length adventure with tank engine Thomas (the voice of Ben Small) and his locomotive friends. While facing their fears in a monstrous storm on the Island of Sodor, the trains discover some mysterious footprints and Thomas and Percy (Keith Wickham) aim to find where they came from.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 24 Mar 2015); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Saltdean Library (Set: 10 Oct 2021)

titles.title: Thomas & friends: Tales from the rails
titles.sortTitle: thomas & friends: tales from the rails
titles.summary: Eight new animated adventures with Thomas the Tank Engine and his friends Emily, Percy, Gordon and James, on the island of Sodor. In these episodes, Thomas helps his friend Hiro after he is derailed and Henry gets to pull the Express. The episodes are: 'Helping Hiro', 'Henry Gets the Express', 'Toby's New Friend', 'Sidney Sings', 'Diesel and the Ducklings', 'Bradford the Brake Van', 'Saving Time' and 'Very Important Sheep'.

titles.title: Thor: Love and thunder
titles.summary: Taika Waititi directs this action adventure sequel which sees Chris Hemsworth reprise his role as the Marvel Comics superhero Thor, based on the mythical Norse God of Thunder. Gorr the God Butcher (Christian Bale) seeks to destroy all gods. Thor and his allies including Valkyrie (Tessa Thompson), Korg (voice of Waititi) and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster (Natalie Portman), now wielding Mjölnir as The Mighty Thor, must defeat him before he can succeed.

titles.title: Thor: The dark world
titles.summary: Action adventure sequel which sees Chris Hemsworth reprise his role as the Marvel Comics superhero Thor, based on the mythical Norse God of Thunder. After the events of 'Marvel Avengers Assemble' (2012), Earth and the Nine Realms come under attack from the powerful Malekith (Christopher Eccleston) and his age-old army that have existed since even before the creation of the universe. With the enemy proving near impossible to defeat, Thor approaches his adoptive brother Loki (Tom Hiddleston) for help, despite his villainous past. Meanwhile, the hero becomes reacquainted with the woman he loves, astrophysicist Jane Foster (Natalie Portman), and takes her to Asgard in an attempt to protect her from harm. The cast also includes Anthony Hopkins, Stellan Skarsgård, Kat Dennings and Zachary Levi.

titles.title: Three billboards outside Ebbing, Missouri
titles.summary: American dark comedy drama in which a mother becomes frustrated at the local police force's ineptitude to solve her daughter's murder. When no potential perpetrators have been identified and the investigation slowly grinds to a halt, Mildred (Frances McDormand) takes matters into her own hands to ensure that the media, local citizens and the police take her plight seriously and find her daughter's killer.

titles.title: Three thousand years of longing
titles.summary: Idris Elba and Tilda Swinton star in this fantasy drama written and directed by George Miller. While visiting Istanbul, narratologist Alithea Binnie (Swinton) discovers a djinn (Elba) who offers to grant her three wishes. While she remains sceptical of the djinn's claims and fearful of the power of wishes, the djinn attempts to win Alithea's trust by narrating tales of his former masters.

titles.title: Thunderbolts*
titles.summary: Florence Pugh, Sebastian Stan and Lewis Pullman star in this superhero action adventure directed by Jake Schreier. After being sent into a trap meant to kill them by CIA director Valentina Allegra de Fontaine (Julia Louis-Dreyfus), Yelena Belova (Pugh), John Walker (Wyatt Russell) and Ava Starr (Hannah John-Kamen) join forces with Alexei Shostakov (David Harbour) and Bucky Barnes (Stan) to take her down. However, one of her projects involved conducting experiments on Bob Reynolds (Pullman) who now possesses superpowers and has a dark side known as the Void, an invincible force which spreads darkness and turns people into shadows. Can this disparate group of antiheroes overcome their difficult pasts and form a real team capable of stopping the Void and saving the world?

titles.title: Ticket to paradise
titles.summary: American romantic comedy starring Julia Roberts and George Clooney. When divorced couple Georgia and David Cotton (Roberts and Clooney) learn that their daughter Lily (Kaitlyn Dever) is getting married to a man she met while on holiday in Bali, they race to her side to try to prevent the marriage from going ahead. Although they are each other's nemesis, the pair work together to achieve their common goal of breaking up the young couple. The cast also includes Billie Lourd, Lucas Bravo and Rowan Chapman.

titles.title: Timber - The treasure dog
titles.summary: American children's adventure. When his family's ranch is threatened with foreclosure, 12-year-old Mikey Jones (J.D. Hoppe) sets out with his friend Billie (Averie South) and his special dog Timber (voice of Kix Brooks) to find his grandfather's fabled buried treasure and save the ranch. However, their quest is not as easy as following the intrepid Timber as Casper Stonewall (Sewell Whitney), who hopes to buy the ranch, employs his bumbling henchmen to stop them in their tracks.

titles.title: The time that remains
titles.summary: Palestinian filmmaker Elia Suleiman directs this drama set against the backdrop of the creation of the state of Israel in 1948 through to the present day. The film recounts a quartet of family stories inspired by the private diaries of the director's father, the letters his mother wrote to family members who were forced to leave the country in the late 1940s, and his own personal experiences, and paints a bittersweet portrait of the everyday lives of the Palestinians labelled 'Israeli-Arabs' who chose to remain and became an ethnic minority in their own country.

titles.title: The time traveler's wife
titles.summary: All six episodes from the first season of the US sci-fi romantic drama based on the novel by Audrey Niffenegger. Henry DeTamble (Theo James) is afflicted with a rare genetic disorder that causes him to become unstuck in time, flitting uncontrollably between various moments in his life. As a young girl, Claire (Rose Leslie) once met Henry during one of his travels, and ever since that moment their two fates have become entwined. Later in life, the two become married, but the reality of living with Henry's disorder threatens to tear the destined couple apart.

titles.title: Tina
titles.summary: Music documentary focusing on the life and career of Tina Turner, affectionately dubbed the Queen of Rock 'n' Roll. From her humble beginnings to breakthrough success as a duo with Ike Turner, who she later married, the film also features an up-to-date interview with the musician where she shares her memories on her successful career.

titles.title: Tinker Bell and the legend of the NeverBeast
titles.sortTitle: tinker bell and the legend of the neverbeast
titles.summary: Sixth feature-length film in Disney's animated adventure series following Tinker Bell (voice of Mae Whitman) and her friends. When animal fairy Fawn (Ginnifer Goodwin) becomes friendly with a huge, hairy beast with fangs Tinker Bell and the other fairies of Pixie Hollow have their doubts about her new acquaintance. However, with the legendary NeverBeast in danger of being captured by the Scout Fairies, Fawn must convince her friends to help her save the creature. The voice cast also includes Lucy Liu, Anjelica Huston and Rosario Dawson.

titles.title: Tinkerbell
titles.summary: Animated adventure featuring the tiny star of Disney's 'Peter Pan'. When Pixie Hollow comes under threat, Tinker Bell (voice of Mae Whitman) and the other fairies must use their mystical, miniature powers to rescue their home.

titles.title: To catch a thief
titles.summary: Cary Grant and Grace Kelly star in this classic thriller directed by Alfred Hitchcock. Former jewel thief John Robie (Grant) finds himself forced to prove his innocence after a spate of burglaries on the French Riviera. Enlisting the help of insurance man H.H. Hughson (John Williams), Robie sets out to catch the real thief and clear his name. At the top of their list of suspects is Jessie Stevens (Jessie Royce Landis) who is in France looking to find a suitable husband for her daughter Frances (Kelly). However, just as he is getting close to uncovering the crook's identity, Robie's burgeoning relationship with Frances threatens to get in the way and derail his investigation.

titles.title: To Tokyo
titles.summary: British psychological horror written and directed by debut film-maker Caspar Seale Jones. After learning her mother is ill, Alice (Florence Kosky) falls into a fantasy world where she is stalked by a malevolent spectre as she attempts to make her way to Tokyo.

titles.title: Tolkien
titles.summary: Nicholas Hoult and Lily Collins star in this biopic following the early life of English writer and poet J.R.R. Tolkien. From childhood, Tolkien (Hoult) discovers a passion for writing and studying philology, while drawing inspiration from the strong bond he shares with his three friends and their adventures together. However, the outbreak of WWI forces Tolkien into an overwhelming world of violence and bloodshed as he sets aside his incredible creative abilities to fight for his country, tearing him apart from his fellowship of friends, his wife Edith (Collins) and threatening the course of his literary career.

titles.title: Tom of Finland
titles.summary: Finnish biographical drama directed by Dome Karukoski and starring Pekka Strang, Taisto Oksanen and Lauri Tilkanen. Touko Laaksonen (Strang), who would come to be known as Tom of Finland, serves in the Second World War and defends his homeland from invasion, becoming a decorated lieutenant in the process; this is not what he is remembered for however. Touko is homosexual and in the years after the war he encounters some of his old comrades again and forges a lifelong relationship with one of them, but he also suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder and relies heavily on his sister for support. Touko is a skilled draughtsman and his homoerotic drawings gain him notoriety as part of an increasingly open gay community, despite the continued persecution of homosexuality in Finland and beyond. His art soon makes Tom of Finland a gay icon and a symbol for the emergent social movement for years to come.

titles.title: Tom's midnight garden
titles.summary: Film adaptation of the classic children's tale in which a young boy finds access to a magical midnight garden. When his brother comes down with the measles, Tom (Anthony Way) is sent to stay with his Aunt Gwen (Greta Scacchi) and his Uncle Alan (James Wilby) in the dilapidated old manor they inhabit. One night, after hearing the house clock strike 13, Tom heads downstairs to investigate. What he finds is incredible: a huge garden filled with wondrous characters. Even more strangely, Tom seems to be invisible to all of the garden's inhabitants except the delightful Hatty (Florence Hoath). As Hatty and Tom become friends, he is drawn ever deeper into the mystery of the garden and the strange old house which contains it.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 25 Apr 2014); In-transit from Saltdean Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 08 Oct 2021)

titles.title: Tomcat
titles.summary: Austrian drama written and directed by Händl Klaus. The film follows content couple Andreas and Stefan (Philipp Hochmar and Lukas Turtur) who live a blissful life in the suburbs of Vienna with their cat Moses. Their peaceful existence is shattered by an impulsive and unexplainable violent outburst from Stefan which threatens to tear the pair's relationship apart. Unable to reconcile with his partner, Andreas turns silent and becomes increasingly distant towards Stefan. Will they ever be able to love one another again and restore their previously perfect union?

titles.title: Top Cat begins
titles.summary: Animated prequel which tells the origin story of the Hanna-Barbera character. The film follows the adventures of Top Cat (voice of Jason Harris) as he forms his gang of felines and attempts to bring down notorious villain Mr. Big (Darin De Paul).

titles.title: Top gun
titles.summary: US action drama directed by Tony Scott. Tom Cruise plays Maverick, a young fighter pilot enrolled at Naval college, training with the most gifted pilots of his generation who are all competing for the prestigious Top Gun award. Maverick soon establishes himself as one of the best in his class but his insistence on doing things his own way brings him into conflict with his superiors and his main rival, Iceman (Val Kilmer). The cast also includes Anthony Edwards, Kelly McGillis and Meg Ryan.

titles.title: Top gun
titles.summary: US action drama directed by Tony Scott. Tom Cruise plays Maverick, a young fighter pilot enrolled at Naval college, training with the most gifted pilots of his generation who are all competing for the prestigious Top Gun award. Maverick soon establishes himself as one of the best in his class but his insistence on doing things his own way brings him into conflict with his superiors and his main rival, Iceman (Val Kilmer). The cast also includes Anthony Edwards, Kelly McGillis and Meg Ryan.

titles.title: Top gun: Maverick
titles.summary: Tom Cruise returns to star in this action sequel directed by Joseph Kosinski. After serving for more than 30 years as one of the Navy's best test pilots and avoiding the advancement in rank that would see him grounded, Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell (Cruise) begins training recent Top Gun graduates for a new mission. One of these pilots is Bradley 'Rooster' Bradshaw (Miles Teller), the son of Maverick's late best friend Nick 'Goose' Bradshaw. Maverick must confront his past and his fears as a mission that may demand the ultimate sacrifice from those involved draws near.

titles.title: Top wing
titles.summary: Collection of seven episodes from the children's animation series which follows the adventures of four birds, Penny (voice of Abigail Oliver), Rod (Ethan Pugiotto), Swift (Jonah Wineberg) and Brody (Lucas Kalechstein) as they learn new skills and rescue their friends from tricky situations. The episodes are: 'Time to Earn Our Wings', 'Race Through Danger Canyon', 'Rod's Big Jump', 'Treasure Map Mission', 'Goose On the Loose', 'Shirley Squirrely Flies Away' and 'Lunch Box Rescue'.

titles.title: Topaz
titles.summary: Hitchcock spy thriller. CIA agent Michael Nordstrom (John Forsythe) learns from a Soviet defector that Russia has become embroiled in the Cuban missile crisis via a NATO spy codenamed Topaz. Enlisting the help of French agent Andre Devereaux (Frederick Stafford), Nordstrom attempts to discover the link, but his actions have disastrous international consequences.

titles.title: Topsy and Tim: Moving house
titles.summary: Collection of episodes from the children's educational programme following the everyday adventures of five-year-old twins Topsy and Tim (Jocelyn Macnab and Joshua Lester). The episodes are: 'Rainy House', 'Strange Beds', 'Marble Run', 'Car Wash', 'Bad Smell' and 'Moving House'.

titles.title: Tornado
titles.summary: John Maclean directs this historical action drama set in 1790. Before he became a puppeteer, Fujin (Takehiro Hira) was a samurai and he trained his daughter Tornado (Kôki) well. She must now utilise all of the skills he taught her to fight back against the band of thieves chasing her, led by the ruthless Sugarman (Tim Roth). The cast also includes Jack Lowden, Joanne Whalley and Rory McCann.

titles.title: Touch
titles.summary: Baltasar Kormákur directs this Icelandic drama starring Egill Olafsson. Set in the 1960s, Icelandic Kristófer (Pálmi Kormákur) is studying at the London School of Economics. Losing passion for his chosen career path, Kristófer makes an impulsive decision to leave school and takes a job as a dishwasher at a Japanese restaurant. When he meets the owner's daughter Miko (Kôki), he realises he made the right decision and their immediate bond grows into a relationship. When he suddenly finds the restaurant closed and Miko and her father gone, Kristófer is distraught and confused but with no way of contacting them. Years later, Kristófer (Olafsson)'s health is in decline and so he decides to try to find Miko to find out what truly happened all those years ago. The cast also includes Masahiro Motoki, Yôko Narahashi and Ruth Sheen.

titles.title: Toy story
titles.summary: Animated comedy adventure from Disney/Pixar featuring the voice talents of Tom Hanks and Tim Allen. In a world in which toys are sentient but hide this fact from humans, Woody (Hanks) and his fellow toys belong to Andy (John Morris) and are preparing to move house. Woody is Andy's favourite toy until he receives a Buzz Lightyear (Allen) action figure for his sixth birthday. Woody's jealousy sparks a battle for Andy's affections between the two toys but they are forced to team up when they are taken by Andy's neighbour Sid (Erik von Detten), who destroys toys for fun. As they attempt to return to Andy, Woody and Buzz forge a unique friendship.

titles.title: Toy story 2
titles.summary: Tom Hanks and Tim Allen reprise their roles in this animated comedy adventure sequel from Disney/Pixar. When Woody (voice of Hanks) is kidnapped by toy shop owner Al McWhiggin (Wayne Knight), Buzz Lightyear (Allen) sets out to rescue him before Al can sell him to a toy museum in Tokyo. However, the plan derails when Buzz is imprisoned by Utility Belt Buzz, who takes his place amongst the toys. Meanwhile, Woody discovers that he was once the star of a popular children's television show and is no longer sure he wants to return to Andy (John Morris)'s toy box...

titles.title: Toy story 3
titles.summary: Tom Hanks and Tim Allen reprise their roles in this third instalment of the animated comedy adventure franchise from Disney/Pixar. When their owner Andy (voice of John Morris) clears out his bedroom in preparation for starting college, Woody (Hanks), Buzz (Allen) and their fellow toys find themselves at the mercy of a horde of toddlers at a nearby nursery. As they struggle to stay together, they meet a new group of toys led by pink teddy bear Lotso (Ned Beatty), while Barbie (Jodi Benson) is at last united with her male counterpart Ken (Michael Keaton). However, the toys soon discover that all is not well at the nursery and chaos ensues as they attempt to escape and find their way home.

titles.title: Toy story 4
titles.summary: Tom Hanks and Tim Allen reprise their roles in this fourth instalment of the animated comedy adventure franchise from Disney/Pixar. On Bonnie (voice of Madeleine McGraw)'s first day of kindergarten, she makes a new toy, a spork called Forky (Tony Hale), to join Woody (Hanks), Buzz (Allen) and the gang. However, Forky is not comfortable with being a toy and wants nothing more than to be thrown back in the trash. When Bonnie and her family go on a road trip, the toys are all taken along for the ride and find themselves having to keep a close eye on Forky to make sure nothing happens to Bonnie's beloved creation. They are helped by Woody's old friend Bo Peep (Annie Potts), who he finds discarded in an antiques shop, but her reappearance makes the cowboy question what it means to be a toy.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 20 Nov 2019); On loan - Due: 26 Oct 2026

titles.title: Toy story 5
titles.summary: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen and Joan Cusack reprise their roles in this fifth instalment of the animated comedy adventure franchise from Disney/Pixar. When eight-year-old Bonnie (voice of Scarlett Spears) is given a frog-themed tablet named Lily (Greta Lee), she quickly becomes addicted to it and begins neglecting the toys she once treasured. While Jessie (Cusack) struggles with her fears of abandonment, Woody (Hanks) must come to terms with the realities of ageing and Buzz (Allen) tries to find the courage to ask Jessie a very important question. As the toys reunite to face the threat Lily poses to playtime together, can they help Bonnie find the friendship she craves?

titles.title: Transformers one
titles.summary: Animated sci-fi action prequel which depicts the origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron. On Cybertron, Orion Pax (voice of Chris Hemsworth) and his best friend D-16 (Brian Tyree Henry) work together in the Energon mines but when they discover that Cybertron's leader Sentinel Prime (Jon Hamm) has betrayed them all, they are determined to expose the truth. However, when a disagreement between them ends in tragedy, the war between the Autobots and the Decepticons begins. The voice cast also includes Scarlett Johansson, Keegan-Michael Key and Steve Buscemi.

titles.title: Transit
titles.summary: Christian Petzold writes and directs this German-French drama based on the novel by novel by Anna Seghers. The film follows young Jew Georg (Franz Rogowski) as he flees Nazi-occupied Paris and travels to Marseille. There, he assumes the identity of a deceased writer named Weidel to secure safe passage out of the country. As he waits to set sail, Georg befriends Weidel's wife Marie (Paula Beer), who is also looking to escape before the Nazi raids begin tearing through the port city.

titles.title: Trap
titles.summary: M. Night Shyamalan directs this psychological thriller starring Josh Hartnett. When Cooper Adams (Hartnett) takes his teenage daughter to a pop concert, he is shocked by the police presence in the atrium. When he learns that a serial killer known as The Butcher is in attendance and the concert is a trap planned to capture him, he quickly takes steps to ensure his safety as he is in fact The Butcher. As he attempts to escape from the building, he remains one step ahead of police, thwarting their operation at every opportunity, but how long can he hold them off before he finally slips up? The cast also includes Saleka Night Shyamalan, Ariel Donoghue and Alison Pill.

titles.title: The trip to Italy
titles.summary: Michael Winterbottom directs this documentary following entertainers Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon as they travel to Italy to retrace the steps of the legendary Romantic poets Byron and Shelley. The programme follows on from 'The Trip' (2010), in which Coogan and Brydon travelled around the north of England sampling local hospitality and conversing on matters of interest. This time the pair enjoy Italian cuisine as they visit sites relating to the experiences of Byron and Shelley in the country. The poets, who left England following persistent outrage and threats relating to their social and political views, found refuge in Italy and particularly Pisa, where they often dined, hunted and discussed poetry together.

titles.title: Trolls
titles.summary: Animated comedy featuring the voice talents of Justin Timberlake, Anna Kendrick, Gwen Stefani and James Corden. Branch (Timberlake) is a grumpy, paranoid loner who is quite content living on his own, away from the ridiculously happy population of Troll Village. When the village is invaded by troll-eating Bergens, the overly optimistic and annoyingly chirpy troll leader Poppy (Kendrick) comes to Branch for help. As the unlikely pair go on a journey to rescue their kidnapped friends, they both find themselves realising what they have been missing. The film was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song - Motion Picture (Can't Stop the Feeling) and the Academy Award for Best Original Song (Can't Stop the Feeling).

titles.title: Trolls band together
titles.summary: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Justin Timberlake, Anna Kendrick, Camila Cabello and Troye Sivan. Following on from events in 'Trolls World Tour' (2020), Poppy and her boyfriend Branch (voices of Kendrick and Timberlake) are learning about each other's pasts as they enjoy their new romance. Poppy is shocked when she discovers that Branch was a member of the iconic boyband Brozone, but Branch and his brothers went their separate ways and Branch wants to leave his musical career behind him. All that is about to change, however, when Branch learns that his brother Floyd (Sivan) has been taken captive by wicked duo Velvet and Veneer (Amy Schumer and Andrew Rannells). Before Velvet and Veneer can succeed in stealing Floyd's musical talents, Branch and Poppy must set out on an adventure to get the band back together and save Floyd, but there are more surprises in store for Poppy...

titles.title: Trolls: The beat goes on - Season 1
titles.sortTitle: trolls: the beat goes on - season 1
titles.summary: All the episodes from the first season of the children's animation which follows on from events in 'Trolls' (2016). With Poppy (voice of Amanda Leighton) as their new Queen, the gang get involved in all manner of adventures. In this season, Poppy must solve a problem when she discovers that Branch (Skylar Astin) and Bridget (Kari Wahlgren) have the same birthday, a drought means that Cloud Guy (Walt Dohrn) has the opportunity to use his special talents and Poppy is disappointed when someone steals a Bergen's pie. The episodes are: 'A New Bergen-ing', 'Laugh-Out Cloud', 'Two-Party System', 'Fun Branch', 'Royal Review', 'Funishment', 'Bad News Bergens', 'Unhealthy Competition', 'Cloudy With a Chance of Hugs', 'Creek Week', 'The Giver' and 'Bellow Bug Day'.

titles.title: Trolls/Trolls world tour
titles.summary: Double bill of animated comedies. In 'Trolls' (2016), Branch (voice of Justin Timberlake) is a grumpy, paranoid loner who is quite content living on his own, away from the ridiculously happy population of Troll Village. When the village is invaded by troll-eating Bergens, the overly optimistic and annoyingly chirpy troll leader Poppy (Anna Kendrick) comes to Branch for help. As the unlikely pair go on a journey to rescue their kidnapped friends, they both find themselves realising what they have been missing. In the sequel 'Trolls World Tour' (2020), Poppy and Branch have their worlds turned upside down when they discover they are one of six tribes in the Troll kingdom, each one for six separate types of music: pop, classical, country, funk, techno and rock. When Queen Barb (Rachel Bloom) and the other rock Trolls arrive and threaten to take over the kingdom and wipe out all other kinds of music, Poppy, Branch and their friends must come up with a plan to make sure that each of the lands is able to retain their unique sound and avoid being taken over by rock.

titles.title: Tron: Ares
titles.summary: Jared Leto stars in this third instalment of the sci-fi action franchise directed by Joachim Ronning. Dillinger Systems, led by CEO Julian Dillinger (Evan Peters), seeks to create virtual reality supersoldiers in The Grid and bring them into the real world. Ares (Leto) is Julian's crowning achievement, highly skilled and possessing super-strength and intelligence, but after 29 minutes in the real world, all of Dillinger's creations are reduced to dust. Knowing that ENCOM's current CEO Eve Kim (Greta Lee) has a way to keep them intact forever, Julian sends Ares after her but the longer he spends in the real world, the more Ares begins to question his creator. The cast also includes Gillian Anderson, Jodie Turner-Smith and Jeff Bridges.

titles.title: TRON: Legacy
titles.summary: Sci-fi action adventure sequel to the 1982 film 'Tron'. Sam Flynn (Garrett Hedlund) is the rebellious technological whizzkid son of leading video-game developer Kevin Flynn (Jeff Bridges). After his father mysteriously disappears, Sam finds himself pulled into the dangerous virtual world that his father has been inhabiting for the past 20 years. Along with Kevin's loyal confidante, fearless warrior Quorra (Olivia Wilde), father and son embark on a perilous journey across a terrifyingly advanced neon-lit cyber universe created by Kevin himself, populated with state-of-the-art vehicles and weapons - and a ruthless enemy who will stop at nothing to prevent their escape. Beau Garrett and Michael Sheen co-star.

titles.title: True detective: The complete second season
titles.sortTitle: true detective: the complete second season
titles.summary: All eight episodes of the second season of the anthology crime drama created by Nic Pizzolatto. In this season, set in California, Detective Ray Velcoro (Colin Farrell), Detective Sergeant Ani Bezzerides (Rachel McAdams) and Highway Patrol Officer Paul Woodrugh (Taylor Kitsch) investigate the murder of bent city manager Ben Caspere. Career criminal and the dead man's business partner Frank Semyon (Vince Vaughn) discovers that over $5 million he gave to Caspere has been embezzled, money with which he was planning to invest in a rail deal in order to set him and his wife Jordan (Kelly Reilly) on the straight and narrow. Hoping to get his money back, Frank begins his own investigation into the murder. Each of the characters also has to deal with problems in their personal lives. The episodes are: 'The Western Book of the Dead', 'Night Finds You', 'Maybe Tomorrow', 'Down Will Come', 'Other Lives', 'Church in Ruins', 'Black Maps and Motel Rooms' and 'Omega Station'.

titles.title: True grit
titles.summary: Coen Brothers updating of the classic 1969 western starring Jeff Bridges as U.S. Marshal 'Rooster' Cogburn, originally played by John Wayne. After her father is murdered, 14-year-old Mattie Ross (Hailee Steinfeld) sets out to capture the killer, Tom Chaney (Josh Brolin), with the help of two lawmen - the ageing, alcoholic marshall Rooster Cogburn (Bridges), and Texas Ranger La Boeuf (Matt Damon). Determined to accompany them on their quest, Mattie wonders whether Cogburn, with his loose morals, has the required 'true grit' for the job. When Chaney's trail heads into Indian territory, Mattie, stubborn to the last, insists on joining the pair in their search, which soon finds them in a raft of dangerous adventures that will test them to the core.

titles.title: True history of the Kelly gang
titles.sortTitle: true history of the kelly gang
titles.summary: George MacKay stars as Australian outlaw Ned Kelly in this adaptation of the Peter Carey novel. Following the death of his father, young Ned (Orlando Schwerdt) is brought up by his mother, Ellen Kelly (Essie Davis), and an escaped convict by the name of Harry Power (Russell Crowe). Learning the ways of the outlaw, Ned grows up with frequent altercations with the local police force. When he forms a gang and continues to be involved in skirmishes with the law Ned's fame and notoriety grow, and the authorities become more determined than ever to capture Ned and his acquaintances. The cast also features Charlie Hunnam and Nicholas Hoult.

titles.title: The truth
titles.summary: Catherine Deneuve and Juliette Binoche star in this French drama directed by Hirokazu Koreeda. After her mother, celebrated actress Fabienne (Deneuve), publishes her memoirs, Lumir (Binoche) travels to Paris to visit her, accompanied by her American husband, Hank (Ethan Hawke), and their young daughter. Back in her childhood home, Lumir's reunion with her mother leads to confrontations about the past and harsh truths being revealed.

titles.title: Tuesday, after Christmas
titles.summary: Romanian-language drama in which a married man with a child finds himself compelled to choose between his wife and his lover in the lead up to Christmas. Paul Hanganu (Mimi Branescu) has been with Adriana (Mirela Oprisor) for ten years. The pair are married, settled and have a young daughter to look after. However, when taking the child to have her teeth seen to, Paul meets Raluca (Maria Popistasu), a pretty young dentist. The pair swiftly embark on an affair fuelled by the kind of passion that has long since dissipated in Paul's relationship with his wife. Knowing that it is morally wrong to carry on a double-life, Paul finds himself forced to make an agonising choice between the woman of his dreams and a stable family life.

titles.title: Tuner
titles.summary: Daniel Roher directs this crime thriller starring Leo Woodall and Dustin Hoffman. Apprentice piano tuner Niki White (Woodall) spends his days learning the trade from Harry Horowitz (Hoffman). While tuning a piano for a wealthy client, he disturbs a gang of Israeli thieves and ends up using his skills to help them crack the safe, earning himself a job offer with the criminals. With Harry out of action due to illness, Niki seizes the opportunity to earn some extra money, but just how far will he go?

titles.title: Turbo
titles.summary: A snail follows his dream of winning the Indianapolis 500 in this CGI-animated children's feature from Dreamworks Studios. Eager to follow in the footsteps of his hero, Indy 500 champ Guy Gagné (voice of Bill Hader), and obsessed with all things to do with speed, Turbo the snail (Ryan Reynolds) has become a bit of an embarrassment to his friends. But when a freak accident sucks him into the supercharger of a drag racer, he wakes the next morning to discover he's acquired some of the characteristics of a car, such as headlight eyes, but more importantly, incredible acceleration and speed. Armed with his new abilities and aided by friends Tito (Michael Peña), Whiplash (Samuel L. Jackson), Smoove Move (Snoop Dogg), Burn (Maya Rudolph) and Skidmark (Ben Schwartz), Turbo soon sets out for the famous racetrack, determined to fulfil his destiny.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 28 Apr 2014); In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hangleton Library (Set: 01 Oct 2022)

titles.title: Turn the key softly
titles.summary: Drama starring Joan Collins, Yvonne Mitchell and Kathleen Harrison as a trio of women from different backgrounds released from prison on the same day. Monica (Mitchell) ended up in prison after taking the fall for a crime masterminded by her lover, David (Terence Morgan), while Stella Jarvis (Collins) was sent to jail for prostitution and Mrs Quilliam (Harrison) was put away for shoplifting, having been too poor to afford food. The three women agree to meet for dinner to discuss their first day of freedom - if they can survive its temptations and avoid heading straight back to jail, of course.

titles.title: Turning red
titles.summary: Disney-Pixar animated comedy directed and co-written by Domee Shi. Due to a hereditary curse, 13-year-old Meilin (voice of Rosalie Chiang) starts turning into a giant red panda whenever she experiences strong emotions. Her difficult relationship with her overprotective mother Ming (Sandra Oh) causes her to transform in public and she is told that the red panda spirit must be sealed in a talisman. Meilin's friends like her transformation and her father Jin (Orion Lee) encourages her to accept this part of herself. Can she mend her relationship with her mother and find her own path?

titles.title: Twilight of the warriors: Walled in
titles.sortTitle: twilight of the warriors: walled in
titles.summary: Cantonese-language action thriller directed by Soi Cheang and set in 1980s Hong Kong. When undocumented refugee Chan Lok-kwun (Raymond Lam) arrives in Hong Kong from the mainland, he hopes to win enough bare-knuckle fights to pay for new paperwork. However, when he is double-crossed by ruthless gang leader Mr Big (Sammo Hung), he steals a bag of cocaine and flees into Kowloon Walled City. Mr Big's men will not follow him there for it is under the control of Cyclone (Louis Koo), with whose crew Lok-kwun finds a home. The cast also includes Terrance Lau, Philip Ng and Richie Jen.

titles.title: Twisters
titles.summary: Glen Powell and Daisy Edgar-Jones star in this sequel to the 1996 action adventure 'Twister'. Kate Carter (Edgar-Jones) is a meteorologist who is working with a team of experts on a piece of technology that could reduce the intensity of a tornado, but after a disastrous attempt which resulted in three members of her team losing their lives, Kate is on the edge of giving up. Years later, she is alerted to a tornado on the radar which could make her career, but in order to get close enough to the action she must put her trust in storm chaser Tyler Owens (Powell), known on social media as the Tornado Wrangler. They must put their differences aside if they are to prove Kate's hypothesis correct and potentially save thousands of lives. The cast also includes Anthony Ramos, Brandon Perea and Daryl McCormack.

titles.title: Two by two
titles.summary: Children's animated feature. When an apocalyptic flood threatens the Earth, Noah builds an ark to save all of the planet's animals two by two. But unfortunately for Dave (voice of Dermot Magennis) and his son Finny (Callum Maloney) Nestrians aren't allowed on board and after trying to sneak their way on in disguise, disaster strikes as the boat departs with Finny stranded back on land with young grymp Leah (Ava Connolly). The pair have to work together to survive the oncoming flood and try to find a way to return to the ark. Meanwhile, Dave, along with Leah's mum Hazel (Tara Flynn), have to put aside their differences to unite the ark in a quest to find their missing children.

titles.title: Two of us
titles.summary: Filippo Meneghetti directs and co-writes this drama starring Barbara Sukowa and Martine Chevallier. Elderly neighbours Madeleine Girard (Chevallier) and Nina (Sukowa) are involved in a romantic relationship and have been for two decades. As they consider their future however, Nina grows increasingly frustrated by Madeleine's refusal to inform her two adult children, Anne (Léa Drucker) and Frédéric (Jérôme Varanfrain) about the true nature of their relationship. When Madeleine suffers a heart attack Anne and Frédéric become concerned by the overbearing actions of Nina, who is devastated at her lover's ill-health and her inability to be by her side.

titles.title: Tyrannosaur
titles.summary: Tense drama following the relationship between a self-destructive, alcoholic widower and a Christian charity shop worker. Joseph (Peter Mullan) is an aggressive and self-destructive loner who suffers from extreme mood swings and an inability to keep his temper in check. One such lack of control forces him to flee into a charity shop to hide from three youths. Here he strikes up an unlikely friendship with Hannah (Olivia Colman), a volunteer who attempts to calm Joseph and offer him a Christian way out of his troubles. Despite their differences, a relationship develops between the two. However, will the other man in Hannah's life, her husband, James (Eddie Marsan), have something to say about the burgeoning friendship?

titles.title: UFO
titles.summary: Alex Sharp and Ella Purnell star in this sci-fi thriller written and directed by Ryan Eslinger. College student Derek Echevaro (Sharp) has spent his life haunted by a childhood UFO sighting. When he learns of mysterious goings on at airports around America, he believes that they are the work of aliens and sets his mind to proving his theory, with the help of his girlfriend Natalie (Purnell) and mathematics professor Dr Hendricks (Gillian Anderson).

titles.title: Ugly dolls
titles.summary: Children's animation featuring the voice talents of Kelly Clarkson, Nick Jonas, Janelle Monáe and Pitbull. Uglydoll Moxy (Clarkson) dreams of leaving Uglyville and venturing to the Big World to become a child's toy. When she decides to realise her dream, Moxy and her friends find themselves in the Institute of Perfection, overseen by Lou (Jonas), where only perfect dolls are chosen to journey to the Big World. Can the Uglydolls prove themselves capable of completing the gauntlet and finally reach the Big World?

titles.title: Umberto D
titles.summary: Hugely revered Neo-Realist film from Vittorio De Sica, that was for years banned in Italy and labelled as subversive and negative to the country. It is a portrait of an old man, living out his last days alone and abandoned by a post-war Italian society. Non-professional Carlo Battisti plays Umberto Domenico Ferrari, a retired civil servant with no friends, family or prospects to speak of, only his dog Flike for company. Umberto lives only on his meagre pension and in dire surroundings with a grasping landlady. He has fallen behind on his rent and after many indignities finally reaches a point where suicide seems like the only answer. However he puts those thoughts aside when he realises that Flike would be left to the streets if he was not there.

titles.title: The unbeatables
titles.summary: Children's animated feature from director Juan José Campanella featuring the voice talents of Rupert Grint, Peter Serafinowicz and Anthony Head. Amadeo (Grint) is a young boy who lives for his time playing table football on his own. When his beloved table is destroyed he fears his life is ruined, until he hears his name being called. The person saying his name is Loco (Serafinowicz), one of the players from his table; he has come to life. Fun and frolics ensue as Amadeo embarks on an adventure with his best friends.

titles.title: Under the silver lake
titles.summary: Andrew Garfield stars in this dark comedy written and directed by David Robert Mitchell. When Sam (Garfield) discovers a mysterious woman swimming in his pool one evening, he quickly becomes infatuated with her. After spending the night together she departs with the promise of meeting up again. When Sam goes to her apartment however, he finds it empty, with no trace that she ever lived there. Believing there is something sinister behind her disappearance, Sam embarks on a quest to decipher potential clues that could lead him to his mystery lady.

holdings.status: In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 12 Sep 2020)

titles.title: The undoing
titles.summary: Nicole Kidman and Hugh Grant star in this six-part HBO miniseries based on the novel 'You Should Have Known' by Jean Hanff Korelitz. Therapist Grace Fraser (Kidman) lives a seemingly perfect life in New York City with her husband Jonathan (Grant), a celebrated oncologist, and their son Henry (Noah Jupe). However, her life begins to unravel when Elena Alves (Matilda De Angelis), whose son attends the same elite school as Henry, is brutally murdered. Jonathan, with whom Elena was having an affair, is identified as a potential suspect and disappears, leading Grace to uncover a series of shocking revelations which cause her to question everything she thought she knew about her husband. The episodes are: 'The Undoing', 'The Missing', 'Do No Harm', 'See No Evil', 'Trial By Fury' and 'The Bloody Truth'.

titles.title: The unlikely pilgrimage of Harold Fry
titles.summary: Jim Broadbent and Penelope Wilton star in this British drama based on the novel by Rachel Joyce. Pensioner Harold Fry (Broadbent) has lived a somewhat humdrum life, reluctant to step outside his comfort zone at home with his wife, Maureen (Wilton). One day, however, Harold receives a letter from his old friend, Queenie Hennessy (Linda Bassett), which informs him that Queenie is dying of cancer. Unable to accept her fate, Harold decides to walk from Devon to Queenie's hospice in Berwick-upon-Tweed in the hope that his journey will save her. Harold quickly inspires ordinary members of the public to join him in his mission, but along the way Harold must come to terms with the tragic loss of his son and the possible breakdown of his marriage.

titles.title: Up and away
titles.summary: Danish children's animated adventure. Hodja (voice of Thure Lindhardt), a young boy from a small village, longs to see the world and is granted his wish when an elderly neighbour gives him a magic carpet in exchange for finding his granddaughter. Along with his pet goat, Hodja sets off to the city of Pjort to find her, but he finds himself in danger when the evil Sultan (Peter Frödin) steals his magic carpet and leaves him stranded in the city. Can he find a way to get it back and make his way home?

titles.title: Up the junction
titles.summary: Suzy Kendall and Dennis Waterman star in this British drama directed by Peter Collinson. When Polly (Kendall) grows weary of her privileged life in Chelsea, she decides to move to a working class community in Battersea. She gets a job at a candy factory where she makes new friends and begins a relationship with working class Peter (Waterman), who dreams of leaving Battersea and becoming rich. However, the stark differences in their circumstances soon threaten to come between them. The cast also includes Adrienne Posta, Maureen Lipman and Liz Fraser.

titles.title: Upgrade
titles.summary: US sci-fi horror written and directed by Leigh Whannell. After a freak car accident leaves him paralysed, Grey Trace (Logan Marshall-Green) is forced to sit and watch helplessly as his wife is murdered right in front of him. With his life in ruins, Grey is approached by wealthy inventor Eron (Harrison Gilbertson) who offers to give him a new life by implanting him with Stem, a sophisticated artificial intelligence technology which will improve every aspect of his physical and mental ability. Armed with his new superhuman capabilities, Grey sets out to get revenge on those who killed his wife.

titles.title: The upside
titles.summary: Bryan Cranston, Kevin Hart and Nicole Kidman star in this American comedy drama based on the 2011 French film 'Les Intouchables'. After a paragliding accident turns billionaire thrill seeker Phillip (Cranston) into a quadriplegic he employs unqualified ex-con Dell (Hart) as his carer, to the dismay of his assistant Yvonne (Kidman). Despite their very different backgrounds and outlooks on life, the two men quickly form a strong bond, showing each other what they are missing in life and teaching important life lessons about acceptance, respect and the true meaning of friendship in the process.

titles.title: Urban hymn
titles.summary: British coming-of-age drama directed by Michael Caton-Jones. The film follows troubled, London teenager Jamie Harrison (Letitia Wright) who has lived in care homes for most of her life after being abandoned by her mother. Her new, unconventional support worker Kate (Shirley Henderson) tries to help her realise her potential but Jamie's best friend Leanne (Isabella Laughland) is not so keen on letting her partner in crime abandon the life of drugs and violence they share together.

titles.title: Us
titles.summary: Jordan Peele directs this horror starring Lupita Nyong'o, Winston Duke and Elisabeth Moss. While visiting friends the Wilsons decide to stay at a remote beach house, but while settling in to their surroundings, they discover what appears to be another family standing mysteriously in their driveway. Things turn strange when the family makes a run towards the house, causing the Wilsons to shut themselves inside and defend themselves from the attackers. When they get a closer look at the crazed killers they realise they look identical to their own family, however act completely different. When the Wilsons realise the family will stop at nothing to kill them, they must find a way to identify who they are and bring them down before it's too late.

titles.title: Utoya
titles.summary: Norwegian drama directed by Erik Poppe. The film follows Kaja (Andrea Berntzen), a young girl attending a political summer camp on the island of Utoya on the lake Tyrifjorden in Norway. Not long after receiving news that a bomb has gone off in the political quarter of Oslo, the campers suddenly find themselves in a desperate fight to survive as a crazed gunman arrives on the island and opens fire. Will Kaja be able to outrun the killer and get out alive?

titles.title: Vagabond
titles.summary: French drama written and directed by Agnès Varda. The film tells the story of the final few weeks in the life of drifter Mona Bergeron (Sandrine Bonnaire), who feels incapable of participating in ordinary society. Beginning with her death, the film presents Mona's final perambulations in winter in the south of France through the lives of the various characters she meets, revealing more about her past along the way.

titles.title: Valerian and the city of a thousand planets
titles.sortTitle: valerian and the city of a thousand planets
titles.summary: Luc Besson writes and directs this French action sci-fi based on Pierre Christin's sci-fi comic series 'Valérian and Laureline'. Tasked with maintaining peace throughout the universe, special government operatives Valerian (Dane DeHaan) and Laureline (Cara Delevingne) are sent by their commander Arün Filitt (Clive Owen) to the spectacular city of Alpha, an ever-expanding metropolis home to millions of inhabitants from all over the galaxy. With an unseen villainous force causing an uprising which could put the future of the city in danger, Valerian and Laureline must put their personal issues to one side and work together to put a stop to the trouble before it's too late. The cast also includes Ethan Hawke, Rutger Hauer and Rihanna.

titles.title: Vergel
titles.summary: South American drama following a woman in mourning as she begins to explore her sexuality. After her husband dies in an accident while they are on holiday, a Brazilian woman (Camila Morgado) living in Buenos Aires begins a romantic relationship with her neighbour (Maricel Alvarez) while dealing with the bureaucracy of her husband's death.

titles.title: Vertigo
titles.summary: Psychological thriller directed by Alfred Hitchcock. After his fear of heights indirectly causes the death of a colleague, San Francisco cop Scottie (James Stewart) retires. He is subsequently hired by magnate Gavin Elster (Tom Helmore) to follow his wife, Madeleine (Kim Novak), as Elster says he fears for her life. Scottie becomes bewitched by Madeleine, falling in love with her after saving her from a suicide attempt. However, when Scottie's vertigo prevents him saving Madeleine from a second attempt to kill herself, he becomes obsessed with recreating the dead woman's image.

titles.title: Vice
titles.summary: Biographical drama depicting Dick Cheney's time as American Vice President starring Christian Bale, Amy Adams, Steve Carell and Sam Rockwell. Having previously served as Secretary of Defence and White House Chief of Staff Dick Cheney (Bale) is reluctant to accept the largely symbolic role of Vice President unless he and George W. Bush (Rockwell) can come to a different understanding of the position. When the President gives him free reign over bureaucracy, military, energy and foreign policy Cheney becomes the most powerful Vice President in American history resulting in extensive consequences for America and the rest of the world.

titles.title: Viceroy's House
titles.summary: Hugh Bonneville and Gillian Anderson star in this drama set in 1947, telling the story of the days leading up to India's independence from Britain. In Delhi, Viceroy's House is home to Lord Mountbatten (Bonneville), great-grandson to Queen Victoria, with his wife Lady Mountbatten (Anderson) and their daughter Pamela (Lily Travers). Mountbatten has been charged with overseeing the transition of British India to an independent nation but when Indian politicians descend upon the house with differing opinions of what form the independence should take, chaos ensues resulting in a divided nation. The cast also includes Michael Gambon, Simon Callow and Manish Dayal.

titles.title: Victim
titles.summary: Basil Dearden directs this British crime drama starring Dirk Bogarde and Sylvia Syms. Now happily married to wife Laura (Syms), successful lawyer Melville Farr (Bogarde) has tried to forget his past homosexual affair. However, he finds he cannot escape it when he receives a phone call from his former lover, Jack Barret (Peter McEnery), who has been arrested for theft. Once the police discover that he has no money to his name they come to the assumption that he is being blackmailed because of his sexuality. When Melville refuses to help him Jack commits suicide. Opening himself up to legal proceedings, and risking his career, Melville decides to prosecute the blackmailers himself with the help of their other victims.

titles.title: The Victorian slum: The complete series
titles.summary: Michael Mosley presents this six-part BBC documentary that follows a group of 21st-century citizens living in a recreated Victorian slum in East London. The programme explores what life was really like for those living in late Victorian Britain, beginning in the economic depression of the 1870s through to the recovery of the 1900s.

titles.title: Vienna blood
titles.summary: All three episodes from the first series of the crime drama based on the 'Liebermann' novels by Frank Tallis. When a series of murders take place in the most unexpected locations in early 20th century Vienna, Detective Oskar Reinhardt (Jürgen Maurer) enlists the help of one of Sigmund Freud's own students, Max Liebermann (Matthew Beard), in the investigation. The episodes are: 'The Last Seance', 'Queen of the Night' and 'The Lost Child'.

titles.title: The virtues
titles.summary: All four parts of the British miniseries starring Stephen Graham. After his ex-partner leaves for Australia with his young son, Joseph (Graham) is catapulted into a downward spiral of substance abuse. Reaching the end of his tether, he heads for Ireland where he reunites with his sister, Anna (Helen Behan), who takes him in with her husband, Michael (Frank Laverty). His new-found sanctuary is not safe for long, however, when Joseph begins to be haunted by traumatic memories from his past and he begins to question the integrity of the people around him.

holdings.status: In-transit from Jubilee Library to Hove Library (Set: 20 Jan 2024)

titles.title: Visions
titles.summary: Kevin Greutert directs this supernatural horror starring Isla Fisher and Anson Mount. Following a car crash Eveleigh Maddox (Fisher) suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder. A year later, a now pregnant Eveleigh moves with her husband David (Mount) to Paso Robles, California, where they plan to restore a vineyard. However, after arriving Eveleigh begins experiencing terrifying visions and soon starts to lose her grip on reality. She attempts to look for answers, hoping to find out if there is any truth to her visions...

titles.title: Vita & Virginia
titles.summary: Biographical romantic drama based on the relationship between writers Vita Sackville-West and Virginia Woolf (Gemma Arterton and Elizabeth Debicki) during the 1920s. After meeting at a party in Bloomsbury, the pair strike up a romantic relationship despite their respective marriages and begin writing love letters to one another. As the relationship develops, it inspires each to reach new artistic heights, culminating in the publication of Woolf's novel 'Orlando' in 1928. The cast also includes Isabella Rossellini, Rupert Penry-Jones and Peter Ferdinando.

titles.title: Volk's Railway: the oldest working electric railway in the world, part 1
titles.sortTitle: volk's railway : the oldest working electric railway in the world, part 1
titles.summary: For many generations the skeletal like carriages or cars of Volk's Railway have run along Brighton Beach carrying excited children and the young at heart to Children's Playground and Black Rock. Opened on 4 August 1883, the creator of this popular railway was electrical pioneer Magnus Volk. Owners of seafront shops and beach traders alongside the route feared the railway would drive away their customers, and the residents of Kemp Town were vocal in their oposition. But with the passing of time, the sight of the cars on their way to and from Black Rock became a familiar part of beach life, and once hostile residents embraced the railway, believing it to be an asset to their town. As part of his transport plan for Brighton seafront Magnus Volk also built a railway in the sea. Nicknamed Daddy-Long-Legs, this curious hybrid of boat and pier ran from Black Rock to Rottingdean from 1896 to 1901.
