titles.summary: Narrated by Tim Blissett

titles.title: Waffle the wonder dog: Waffle's day out
titles.sortTitle: waffle the wonder dog: waffle's day out
titles.summary: Six more episodes of the CBeebies TV show about a family and their magical talking dog named Waffle (voice of Rufus Hound). When Jess (Andrea Valls) and Simon (James Merry) get married and move in together, along with Jess's daughter Evie (Tahliya Lowles), they stumble upon an abandoned puppy. Evie desperately wants to keep it, but her mum and Simon are not so sure it's a good idea. However, all that changes when they discover his special talent. The episodes are: 'Waffle's Day Out', 'Waffle Walkies', 'Training Waffle', 'Waffle and the Good Dog', 'Waffle's Visit' and 'Waffle Misses Doug'.

titles.title: The wait
titles.summary: Director Piero Messina makes his feature debut in this Italian/French drama starring Juliette Binoche and Lou de Laâge. Anna (Binoche) is living in a villa in Sicily when her son Giuseppe (Giovanni Anzaldo)'s girlfriend, Jeanne (Laâge), shows up after agreeing to meet Giuseppe there. Anna welcomes Jeanne and they bond over time while they wait for Giuseppe to arrive. However, Anna is hiding a secret about her son's whereabouts...

titles.title: Wakefield
titles.summary: Drama directed by Robin Swicord and starring Bryan Cranston and Jennifer Garner. A responsible husband and father, Howard Wakefield (Cranston) works as a lawyer in order to earn the money that gives him and his family a comfortable life. But after a particularly exhausting day at work Howard returns home to find a raccoon infestation in his garage. As he wearily clears them out, he discovers that an isolated corner of the garage allows him to observe much of his home undisturbed. Thinking only to rest for a short while, Howard wakes the next morning with the realisation that he doesn't want to go back to the tiresome routine of his life and work, electing to stay in the garage and watch from the outside looking in as his family respond to his apparent disappearance.

titles.title: A walk among the tombstones
titles.summary: Liam Neeson stars in this crime thriller based on the novel by Lawrence Block. When former NYPD detective turned private investigator Matthew Scudder (Neeson) gets a call from a notorious drug dealer (Dan Stevens) who wants revenge on the men who kidnapped and killed his wife, Matthew suddenly finds himself deep in a world of violence, gangs and people who will stop at nothing to get what they want. Boyd Holbrook and Sebastian Roché also star.

titles.title: A walk in the woods
titles.summary: Robert Redford stars as Bill Bryson in this adaptation of the travel writer's memoirs. After spending ten years in England, Bryson feels adventure calling and decides to return to his American homeland to hike the 2,200 mile-long Appalachian Trail. Despite his wife (Emma Thompson)'s concerned objections, he embarks upon the gruelling journey with the only person that would join him, his old friend, recovering alcoholic and long-time philanderer Katz (Nick Nolte). Although Bill sought out the tranquility of nature, Katz's presence ruins his best intentions and the differing pair find themselves up against the many dangers lurking in their harsh surroundings.

titles.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
titles.summary: Tracing the 160 million year history of dinosaurs, from their first appearance to their abrupt demise, this series marks a watershed in televiion imagery. Classic natural history techniques, leading edge computer technology and animatronics combined with the latesgt scientific findings, recreate the sights and sounds of an endlessly fasinating era.

titles.title: Wall Street: Money never sleeps
titles.summary: Oliver Stone's long-awaited sequel to his 1987 hit, 'Wall Street'. The film again follows the infamous Gordon Gekko (Michael Douglas, who also co-produced the film) as he is released from prison only to discover he is an outsider in the world he once ruled. He attempts to reconnect with his estranged daughter, Winnie (Carey Mulligan), by making a deal with Jacob (Shia LaBeouf), a young Wall Street trader and Winnie's fiance. By helping Jacob get revenge for the death of his former mentor, Gekko hopes Jacob, in return, will offer a path to reconciliation with Winnie.

titles.title: WALL.E
titles.summary: Heart-warming Pixar animated tale about a robot who accidentally discovers the way to save planet Earth. 700 years after humanity has left Earth, WALL-E (Waste Allocation Load Lifter Earth-Class) fills his days collecting rubbish, and anything else that takes his fancy, trying to fend off the boredom of his lot. But unknowingly, the tiny tube-eyed robot has discovered a secret that could make the once beautiful planet habitable again, enabling humankind to return. One day, Eve, a search robot, lands on Earth in a cloud of dust, and WALL-E is smitten. When she realises the importance of his find, she sets out to tell the remaining humans, eager to let them know the planet can be saved. But WALL-E, after centuries of being alone, can't bear to see her go, and hitches a ride through the cosmos on an adventure his memory banks will never forget.

titles.title: The war of the worlds
titles.summary: Three-part British drama based on the novel by H.G. Wells. Set in Edwardian England, journalist George (Rafe Spall) and his wife Amy (Eleanor Tomlinson) are settling in to their new life in Woking, away from society that frowns upon their marriage. With George already having a wife, albeit one who refuses to grant him a divorce, the couple become the topic of a conversation they prefer to avoid. When Amy's boss, scientist Ogilvy (Robert Carlyle) reveals that planet Earth may be under attack from Martian aliens, their previous problems look set to fade into obscurity as their lives now revolve around saving the world.

titles.title: Wasteman
titles.summary: David Jonsson and Tom Blyth star in this British drama directed by Cal McMau. After spending over a decade in prison, Taylor (Jonsson) is told that if he continues to demonstrate good behaviour, he will be eligible for early release. However, when he gains a new cellmate in Dee (Blyth), Dee's plans to take over the prison's drug trade threaten to damage Taylor's chances of securing a fresh start for himself. The cast also includes Corin Silva and Alex Hassell.

titles.title: Watch the skies
titles.summary: Inez Dahl Torhaug stars in this Swedish sci-fi adventure directed by Victor Danell. Teenager Denise (Dahl Torhaug)'s father, a ufologist searching for proof of the existence of aliens, disappeared eight years ago. Determined to finally discover the truth about what happened to him, she seeks help from his friends at UFO-Sweden and together they embark on a dangerous quest for answers. The cast also includes Jesper Barkselius and Sara Shirpey.

titles.title: We live in time
titles.summary: Andrew Garfield and Florence Pugh star in this romantic comedy drama from director John Crowley. Tobias Durand (Garfield) is preparing to sign divorce papers when he is hit by a car driven by chef Almut Brühl (Pugh). As Almut - unaware of his impending divorce - offers Tobias and his wife a meal in her restaurant, she learns the truth when he turns up alone. Immediately feeling the chemistry, the pair embark on a passionate romance. The cast also includes Aoife Hinds, Douglas Hodge and Niamh Cusack.

titles.title: Weapons
titles.summary: Josh Brolin and Julia Garner star in this horror thriller written and directed by Zach Cregger. When 17 children disappear from their homes in Maybrook, Pennsylvania at 2.17am on an otherwise ordinary Wednesday, the town descends into chaos. The children were all in teacher Justine Gandy (Garner)'s class and many suspect her involvement. As she is ostracised by the community, her mental health begins to deteriorate. Meanwhile, Archer Graff (Brolin) is the father of one of the missing children and when the police fail to find his son, he begins his own investigation. Can Justine and Archer unravel the mystery of what happened or will the children be lost forever?

titles.title: Weathering with you
titles.summary: Japanese animated adventure written and directed by Makoto Shinkai. When teenager Hodaka Morishima (voice of Kotaro Daigo) runs away to Tokyo, his ferry to the city almost capsizes and Keisuke Suga (Shun Oguri) saves his life. Keisuke hires Hodaka to work at his publishing company and they begin to investigate the unusually bad weather currently affecting Tokyo. Hodaka also crosses paths with Hina Amano (Nana Mori) and learns that she has the power to control the weather but is struggling with her abilities. Meanwhile, the police are tracking them, Hodaka is falling in love and Hina's life is at risk from using her power.

titles.title: Wednesday: The complete first season
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the first season of the television comedy horror based on the character of Wednesday Addams, created by Charles Addams. Wednesday Addams (Jenna Ortega) has been expelled from her school after she violently retaliates against the bullies of her brother, Pugsley (Isaac Ordonez). Wednesday's parents, Gomez and Morticia Addams (Luis Guzmán and Catherine Zeta-Jones) send her to Nevermore Academy for outcasts, but Wednesday refuses to fit in. One day, however, Wednesday discovers her psychic powers, which might just be the key to solving a murder mystery... The episodes are: 'Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe', 'Woe Is the Loneliest Number', 'Friend Or Woe', 'Woe What a Night', 'You Reap What You Woe', 'Quid Pro Woe', 'If You Don't Woe Me By Now' and 'A Murder of Woes'.

titles.title: West Side story
titles.summary: Steven Spielberg directs this adaptation of the Broadway musical starring Ansel Elgort and Rachel Zegler. Set in 1961 in Manhattan's West Side, the film depicts the forbidden love affair between Tony and Maria (Elgort and Zegler), two young lovers caught on opposite sides of a violent gang war between the Jets and the Sharks. The two gangs are sworn enemies, and nothing Maria or Tony can say will persuade them to end the escalating conflict. The cast also includes Ariana DeBose, David Alvarez and Mike Faist.

titles.title: Western
titles.summary: European drama written and directed by Valeska Grisebach. The film revolves around a group of German construction workers who are building a new water power station in the Bulgarian countryside. Their presence prompts hostility from some of the locals and tensions escalate further when former legionnaire Meinhard (Meinhard Neumann) attempts to ingratiate himself with the local community rather than joining his colleagues in their after-hours bonding, actions they do not take kindly to. With tempers flaring, it's not long before their open hostilities come to a head.

titles.title: What do we see when we look at the sky?
titles.sortTitle: what do we see when we look at the sky?
titles.summary: Georgian drama written and directed by Aleksandre Koberidze. Lisa (Ani Karseladze) and Giorgi (Giorgi Bochorishvili) instantly fall in love when they first meet in the city of Kutaisi. However, when they are afflicted by a terrible curse, will they ever meet again?

titles.title: What's love got to do with it?
titles.sortTitle: what's love got to do with it?
titles.summary: British romantic comedy starring Lily James, Emma Thompson and Shazad Latif. Filmmaker Emma (James) is an emotionally closed-off person who lives with her mother (Thompson). Upon hearing that her good friend and next-door neighour Kazim (Latif) is planning to have an arranged marriage in Pakistan, Emma decides to tag along and make a documentary out of the process. As the wedding day approaches, however, cultural clashes between Emma and Kazim cause Emma to reconsider her own feelings and understanding of love.

titles.title: Wheel of fortune and fantasy
titles.summary: Japanese anthology drama written and directed by Ryûsuke Hamaguchi. Comprised of three short stories, the film features tales of a young woman who realises her ex-boyfriend is romantically involved with her best friend, an aggrieved student who seeks to ruin his university professor and two estranged friends who reunite at their high school reunion.

titles.title: Where the crawdads sing
titles.summary: Olivia Newman directs this drama based on the bestselling novel by Delia Owens. Kya Clark (Daisy Edgar-Jones), known as the Marsh Girl, raises herself in the marshlands of North Carolina in the 1950s after her parents and older siblings abandon her. Her friend Tate Walker (Taylor John Smith) teaches her to read and write and she falls in love with him but is left behind once again when he goes to college. She later becomes the main suspect in the murder of Chase Andrews (Harris Dickinson), a man who made her empty promises of love and marriage. David Strathairn and Garret Dillahunt also star.

titles.title: Whiplash
titles.summary: Miles Teller and J.K Simmons star in this Academy Award-winning drama written and directed by Damien Chazelle. With a promising career as a drummer ahead of him, Andrew (Teller) enrols at one of the most prestigious music conservatories in America to try to hone in his skills and perfect his ability. When he meets Terence Fletcher (Simmons), the notoriously harsh band leader at the school, he begins to doubt his talent as Fletcher takes every opportunity to belittle and humiliate his newest pupil. The cast also includes Paul Reiser, Melissa Benoist and Austin Stowell. Simmons won a Golden Globe, a BAFTA and an Academy Award for his performance. The film was also nominated for a further four Academy Awards including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay.

titles.title: The whistlers
titles.summary: Romanian crime comedy written and directed by Corneliu Porumboiu. In preparation for their next job, corrupt Bucharest policeman Cristi (Vlad Ivanov) and criminal Gilda (Catrinel Marlon) are sent to the island of La Gomera in the Canaries to learn an ancient whistling language, allowing them to communicate undetected while attempting to free her boyfriend Zsolt (Sabin Tambrea) from prison.

titles.title: White bird - A wonder story
titles.summary: Gillian Anderson and Helen Mirren star in this drama based on the graphic novel by R.J. Palacio. After being expelled from his previous school for bullying, Julian Albans (Bryce Gheisar) is struggling to fit in at his new school. When his grandmother Sara (Mirren) visits from Paris, she tells him about her early life as a young Jewish girl in Nazi-occupied France during World War II and inspires him to change his behaviour. The cast also includes Orlando Schwerdt, Ariella Glaser and Patsy Ferran.

titles.title: The white crow
titles.summary: Ralph Fiennes directs and stars in this biopic of Russian ballet dancer Rudolf Nureyev (Oleg Ivenko). After falling in love with dance as a child, Nureyev begins training under the tutelage of Alexander Pushkin (Fiennes) at the Vaganova Academy of Russian Ballet in Saint Petersburg. Despite beginning his training at the relatively late age of 17, Nureyev trains tirelessly to improve and impress and eventually becomes a star in his native Soviet Union performing with the Mariinsky Ballet. When the company embarks on a tour to Paris in 1961, Nureyev's ego and rebellious nature cause problems for the company's management and the KGB agents watching his every move, leading to his dramatic defection to the West.

titles.title: The White Lotus: The complete first season
titles.sortTitle: white lotus: the complete first season
titles.summary: All six episodes from the first season of the comedy drama written and created by Mike White. The series follows a week in the life of the crew and holiday makers, all with their own problems and hang-ups, at the White Lotus resort in Hawaii. As the week progresses, darker elements begin to emerge not only among the interactions between people, but also within the resort itself. The episodes are: 'Arrivals', 'New Day', 'Mysterious Monkeys', 'Recentering', 'The Lotus-Eaters' and 'Departures'.

titles.title: The White Lotus: The complete second season
titles.sortTitle: white lotus: the complete second season
titles.summary: All seven episodes from the second season of the US comedy drama written and created by Mike White. The show follows a week in the life of the guests and staff, all with their own problems and hang-ups, at the luxury White Lotus hotel in Taormina, Sicily. Among them are an Italian-American family seeking to reconnect with their heritage, hotel manager Valentina (Sabrina Impacciatore) and returning White Lotus visitor Tanya McQuoid-Hunt (Jennifer Coolidge), her husband Greg (Jon Gries) and assistant Portia (Haley Lu Richardson). The episodes are: 'Ciao', 'Italian Dream', 'Bull Elephants', 'In the Sandbox', 'That's Amore', 'Abductions' and 'Arrivederci'.

titles.title: The White Lotus: The complete third season
titles.sortTitle: white lotus: the complete third season
titles.summary: All eight episodes from the third season of the US comedy drama written and created by Mike White. This season follows one week in the lives of the guests and staff at the luxury White Lotus hotel in Ko Samui, Thailand. Among them are Kate (Leslie Bibb), Jaclyn (Michelle Monaghan) and Laurie (Carrie Coon) who are enjoying a girls reunion, struggling financier Timothy Ratliff (Jason Isaacs), his wife Victoria (Parker Posey), sons Saxon (Patrick Schwarzenegger) and Lochlan (Sam Nivola) and daughter Piper (Sarah Catherine Hook), and mysterious recluse Rick Hatchett (Walton Goggins) and his free-spirited young girlfriend Chelsea (Aimee Lou Wood). The episodes are: 'Same Spirits, New Forms', 'Special Treatments', 'The Meaning of Dreams', 'Hide Or Seek', 'Full Moon Party', 'Denials', 'Killer Instincts' and 'Amor Fati'.

titles.title: A white, white day
titles.summary: Icelandic drama written and directed by Hlynur Palmason. In a remote corner of rural Iceland, widowed police chief Ingimundur (Ingvar Eggert Sigurdsson) begins to suspect his late wife was having an affair, and decides to investigate. Still grieving his loss more than two years on, Ingimundur ventures to violent extremes when he finds the man he believes to be responsible, Olgeir (Hilmir Snaer Gudnason).

titles.title: Who you think I am
titles.summary: Juliette Binoche stars in this French drama based on the novel by Camille Laurens. Co-written and directed by Safy Nebbou, the film follows divorced middle-aged academic Claire Millaud (Binoche) as she begins an online relationship with 20-something Alex Chelly (François Civil), who falls in love with Claire's online alter ego, 25-year-old Clara Antunes, and insists that they meet in person. Meanwhile, Claire's psychoanalyst Dr Catherine Bormans (Nicole Garcia) attempts to uncover the truth behind her relationship with Alex.

titles.title: Who's that knocking at my door?
titles.sortTitle: who's that knocking at my door?
titles.summary: Martin Scorsese's semi-autobiographical debut feature stars a then-unknown Harvey Keitel as J.R., a young Italian-American living in 1960s New York. Filmed over a five-year period, the film introduces us to what have since become classic Scorsese themes: Catholic guilt, Italian mamas and their cooking, repressed sexuality, New York - and, of course, street violence. J.R., who has hitherto spent his days and nights aimlessly hanging out with his friends on the streets of Little Italy, undergoes a rite of passage when he meets The Girl (Zina Bethune) on the Staten Island ferry. Beautiful, blonde and sophisticated, she opens up a whole new world to J.R., who falls completely in love with her, and strives to maintain the sanctity of their fledgling relationship by not sleeping with her. But when she reveals that she has already lost her virginity as the result of a date rape, he struggles to reconcile this revelation with his flawless, idealistic image of her.

titles.title: Wicked
titles.summary: Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jonathan Bailey star in the first instalment of this adaptation of the stage musical which follows its first act. In the Land of Oz, Elphaba Thropp (Erivo) sets out on the path that will ultimately lead to her becoming the Wicked Witch of the West. At Shiz University she meets the popular and endlessly upbeat Glinda (Grande) and the two are forced to become roommates. As Elphaba begins to form a real friendship with Glinda, she becomes aware that there is something very wrong in Oz. However, when she discovers the shocking truth about who is responsible, there will be consequences should she refuse to join them. The cast also includes Michelle Yeoh, Jeff Goldblum and Marissa Bode.

titles.title: Wicked little letters
titles.summary: Thea Sharrock directs this mystery comedy based on true events, starring Olivia Colman, Jessie Buckley and Timothy Spall. Edith Swan (Colman) is appalled when she begins to receive offensive, crudely-written letters from an unknown sender, before learning that some of her neighbours have received similar missives. Edith's suspicion turns to her younger neighbour, single mother Rose Gooding (Buckley) who is charged with the harassment, but when Rose confronts her and the two begin to warm to each other, Edith is perplexed as to who the culprit might be.

titles.title: Wicked: For good
titles.summary: Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande reprise their roles in this second instalment of the adaptation of the stage musical which follows its second act. Elphaba Thropp (Erivo), now known as the Wicked Witch of the West, is living as a fugitive while Glinda the Good (Grande) resides in the palace in the Emerald City. When Madame Morrible (Michelle Yeoh) creates a tornado which transports a house from the human world to Oz, Elphaba's actions in the aftermath lead to the formation of an angry mob intent on stopping her forever. Forced to face the consequences of the choices they have made, Elphaba and Glinda's friendship is tested in painful new ways and the Land of Oz will never be the same. The cast also includes Jonathan Bailey, Jeff Goldblum and Marissa Bode.

titles.title: Wicked: The real story
titles.summary: Robin Bextor directs this documentary exploring 'Wicked', which tells the story of Elphaba, the girl who becomes the Wicked Witch of the West. Bextor considers its roots in L. Frank Baum's series of Oz books and chronicles the history of Gregory Maguire's 1995 novel 'Wicked' and the subsequent stage musical of the same name. Interviews with Maguire and Stephen Schwartz, who wrote the music and lyrics for the musical, feature alongside interviews with other historians, critics and writers.

titles.title: Widows
titles.summary: Crime drama directed by Steve McQueen. When a heist turns deadly and leaves four men dead, their widows are left not only burdened by grief but of the debt their husbands had acquired in their criminal careers. With pressure mounting and threats being issued to the women to find a means to pay it back fast, Veronica (Viola Davis) decides enough is enough and recruits the wives to pull off a job of their own. Veronica and the widows, Linda (Michelle Rodriguez), Alice (Elizabeth Debicki) and Belle (Cynthia Erivo) get armed and ready to make their own fortune using blueprints left behind by her husband, Harry (Liam Neeson). The cast also includes Colin Farrell, Robert Duvall and Daniel Kaluuya.

titles.title: The wild
titles.summary: Animated comedy in which an odd assortment of animals from the New York Zoo discover what a jungle the city can be when one of their own is mistakenly shipped to the wild. When an adolescent lion (Greg Cipes) is accidentally shipped from the New York Zoo to Africa, his zoo pals, including Samson the lion (voice of Kiefer Sutherland), Benny the squirrel (Jim Belushi), Bridget the giraffe (Janeane Garofalo), Larry the Anaconda (Richard Kind), Kazar the wildebeest (William Shatner) and Nigel the koala bear (Eddie Izzard) must put aside their differences to help bring him back.

titles.title: Wild card
titles.summary: Jason Statham and Michael Angarano star in this action drama from director Simon West. Gambling addict Nick Wild (Statham) works as a bodyguard for millionaire Cyrus Kinnick (Angarano) while he is in Las Vegas. After helping his friend Holly (Dominik Garcia-Lorido) get revenge on Danny DeMarco (Milo Ventimiglia), the gangster who raped her, Nick finds himself wanted by the Mob. Can he make it out of Las Vegas alive? The cast also includes Stanley Tucci, Hope Davis, Sofía Vergara, Jason Alexander and Anne Heche.

titles.title: Wild mountain thyme
titles.summary: John Patrick Shanley writes and directs this romantic drama starring Emily Blunt and Jamie Dornan. Farmer Anthony Reilly (Dornan/Darragh O'Kane) is outraged when his father, Tony (Christopher Walken), announces his intention to sell the family farm to his American nephew, Adam (Jon Hamm). Meanwhile, Rosemary Muldoon (Blunt/Abigail Coburn), who lives on the neighbouring farm and has loved Anthony since childhood, is drawn into the conflict.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 21 Nov 2021); On loan - Due: 07 Nov 2026

titles.title: The wild pear tree
titles.summary: Nuri Bilge Ceylan co-writes and directs this Turkish drama. The film follows Sinan Karasu (Dogu Demirkol) as he returns home to his rural village after college to work on a book before training to become a teacher and being called up to the army for national service. As he considers his future and attempts to get his work published, Sinan frequently clashes with those he seeks out for help, while his father, Idris (Murat Cemcir), tries to find a way to pay off his extensive gambling debts.

holdings.status: AV item (Set: 17 Apr 2019); In-transit from Hove Library to Jubilee Library (Set: 13 Sep 2021)

titles.title: The wild robot
titles.summary: Animated sci-fi adventure directed by Chris Sanders. When robot Roz (voice of Lupita Nyong'o) is swept off a cargo ship during a storm, she finds herself washed up on an uninhabited island and must adapt to her new surroundings. After being struck by lightning and attacked by a bear, she accidentally crushes a goose's nest and saves the only remaining egg. When it hatches, Roz names the gosling Brightbill (Kit Connor) and begins to care for him, determined to help him learn to fly so he won't be left behind when the rest of his flock migrate. Although she makes friends and finds a home on the island, she cannot outrun her past forever and soon the robots sent to retrieve her threaten the safety of the place she has come to love. The voice cast also includes Pedro Pascal, Catherine O'Hara and Bill Nighy.

titles.title: Wild rose
titles.summary: British drama starring Julie Walters and Jessie Buckley in which a young mother attempts to realise her dreams of becoming a country singer. Having been imprisoned and left the care of her two young children to her mother Marion (Walters), Rose (Buckley) re-enters society and struggles to adapt to a normal life. Determined to make a name for herself, Rose sets out to become a country singer but Marion tries to convince her to find a job and provide for her children. Will Rose get her shot at success and prove to her mother that she can raise her children?

titles.title: Wildfire
titles.summary: British-Irish drama written and directed by Cathy Brady. Estranged sisters Kelly and Lauren (Nika McGuigan and Nora-Jane Noone) are reunited when Kelly suddenly returns to Northern Ireland having been missing for over a year. Together they confront the trauma of their mother and father's untimely deaths during the Troubles.

titles.title: Wilding
titles.summary: David Allen directs this documentary based on the book by Isabella Tree which chronicles the transformative rewilding efforts at the Knepp estate in West Sussex. After inheriting the estate, Charlie Burrell and his wife Isabella were unable to continue successfully farming the depleted soil and so, in 2000, they decided to let nature reclaim the land instead. They faced fierce opposition initially but now, native breeds including Tamworth pigs and Exmoor ponies roam freely at Knepp and species on the verge of extinction elsewhere are thriving.

titles.title: Wildland
titles.summary: Danish thriller directed by Jeanette Nordahl. Following the death of her mother, teenager Ida (Sandra Guldberg Kampp) is sent to live with her aunt Bodil (Sidse Babett Knudsen). As Ida spends time with her cousins she is exposed to their criminal racketeering, and when she learns that her aunt is part of these enterprises Ida faces a moral dilemma and questions the bonds of kinship.

titles.title: Wildlife
titles.summary: American drama in which a boy observes both his mother and father's actions as their marriage begins to fail. Having been put out of work, Jerry Brinson (Jake Gyllenhaal) struggles mentally and begins to retreat from his family. Meanwhile, his wife, Jeanette (Carey Mulligan) begins to accept that her marriage may soon be over and looks elsewhere for affection and support for her and her son, Joe (Ed Oxenbould). While Joe sees from both sides the suffering his parents are enduring, he must manage his own inner turmoil and find a way to keep his family together.

titles.title: The wind that shakes the barley
titles.summary: Political drama from veteran British filmmaker Ken Loach. Damien (Cillian Murphy) is about to leave Ireland for his medical studies in London while his brother Teddy (Padraic Delaney) is an active IRA member. After witnessing an act of resistance to the daily violence of the 'Black and Tans', Damien abandons his burgeoning career and joins his brother in a dangerous and violent fight for freedom. Eventually, both sides agree to a treaty to end the bloodshed. But, despite the apparent victory, civil war erupts and families who fought side by side, find themselves pitted against one another as sworn enemies, putting their loyalties to the ultimate test.

titles.title: Winnie the Pooh
titles.summary: Feature-length Disney animated adventure with Tigger, Rabbit, Piglet, Kanga, Roo, Eeyore, Owl and Christopher Robin. Steering clear of modern-day CGI-style animation and reverting to the watercolour-based hand-drawn animation of Disney's original 'Winnie the Pooh' films of the 1960s and '70s, the film follows the Hundred Acre Wood gang as they search for a new tail for Eeyore and hunt down an elusive creature called the Backson.

titles.title: Winnie the Pooh: Pooh's heffalump movie
titles.sortTitle: winnie the pooh: pooh's heffalump movie
titles.summary: Animated comedy based on the books by A.A. Milne. When Winnie the Pooh (voice of Jim Cummings) hears a strange noise in the woods, he and his friends are convinced that the dreaded Heffalump has come to the woods to do them harm. Pooh, Piglet (John Fiedler), and Tigger (Cummings) set out to capture the beast, but Roo (Jimmy Bennett), who is told he's too small to join the search party, meets Lumpy the Heffalump (Kyle Stanger) face to face and discovers he's not the bad guy he's been made out to be.

titles.title: Winnie the Pooh: The Tigger movie
titles.sortTitle: winnie the pooh: the tigger movie
titles.summary: Feature length adventure for Winnie the Pooh's ever-bouncing companion. Tigger is just getting in the way when Pooh, Piglet, Roo, Rabbit and Owl try to prepare a home for their doleful friend Eeyore, so Pooh suggests that he go outside and play with some other tiggers. Tigger thinks this a very foolish suggestion, as he is the only Tigger in existence - or so he thinks. In fact, this proves the be the start of an exciting adventure in which Tigger discovers his long-lost family members.

titles.title: Wish
titles.summary: Animated musical adventure featuring the voice talents of Ariana DeBose and Chris Pine. In the magical kingdom of Rosas, King Magnifico (Pine) hoards the deepest wishes of his people and rarely grants them, fearing the consequences to his rule. When Asha (DeBose), who is hoping to become his apprentice, learns about this, she makes a wish upon a star which is so powerful that the star descends from the sky to help her change the lives of everyone in Rosas forever.

titles.title: The witch
titles.summary: Horror thriller written and directed by Robert Eggers. The story follows a puritan family living on a farm in New England in 1630. When their baby son suddenly goes missing, the superstitious parents William (Ralph Ineson) and Katherine (Kate Dickie) begin to wrongly suspect their daughter Thomasin (Anya Taylor-Joy) is responsible and capable of witchcraft. When further sinister things happen such as their crops failing, suspicion and fear begins to tear the family apart, driving them to commit heinous acts. All the while, they become more vulnerable to the real culprit that lurks in the woods behind their home.

titles.title: The wizard of Oz
titles.summary: Classic musical adaptation of the L. Frank Baum novel starring Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr and Jack Haley. When a tornado whisks Dorothy (Garland) and her house from Kansas to the magical land of Oz, squashing the Wicked Witch of the East upon landing. The Wicked Witch of the West (Margaret Hamilton) vows revenge for her sister's death, while Dorothy sets off along the yellow brick road to see the Wizard of Oz (Frank Morgan), hoping he can tell her how to get home. On the way she makes friends with a scarecrow (Bolger), a tin man (Haley) and a cowardly lion (Lahr) - all of whom have specific reasons for wanting to meet the magical Wizard. With the Wicked Witch out to get her, will Dorothy ever get home?

titles.title: Wolf children
titles.summary: Japanese anime directed by Mamoru Hosoda. Whilst at college in Tokyo, Hana (voice of Aoi Miyazaki) meets and falls in love with Kare (Takao Osawa). She does not know that he is a werewolf but is undeterred when he reveals the truth to her. They have two children together, Yuki (Haru Kuroki) and Ame (Yukito Nishii), but their hopes of a happy life are lost when Kare dies in a tragic accident. Left with two temperamental children to raise - both of whom possess the ability to switch between their human and wolf forms at will - Hana faces a daunting challenge. Meanwhile, as Yuki and Ame grow older, they must decide how they wish to live their lives.

titles.title: The wolf of Wall Street
titles.summary: Martin Scorsese directs this award-winning account of 1980s New York stockbroker Jordan Belfort's pursuit of wealth. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as Belfort, who brags about earning just shy of one million dollars a week in one year and has long been involved in manipulating stock prices for his own financial gain. Heading a committed team at his Stratton Oakmont brokerage house in Long Island, it isn't long before he attracts the attention of the FBI who are suspicious of his increasingly lavish and hedonistic lifestyle... The supporting cast includes Matthew McConaughey, Jonah Hill and Jon Bernthal. The film was nominated for five Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Actor (DiCaprio) and Best Director (Scorsese), and saw DiCaprio pick up the Golden Globe for Best Actor - Music Or Comedy.

titles.title: Woman at war
titles.summary: Benedikt Erlingsson directs this drama set in rural Iceland and starring Halldóra Geirharðsdóttir. Eco-activist Halla (Geirharðsdóttir) attempts to stop the expansion of an aluminium plant from causing more environmental degradation to her native home. However, when a long forgotten application to adopt a child is approved and she has a potential match, Halla must consider if her radical ideals are befitting for a new mother. Will her responsibility as a parent hinder her environmental activism?

titles.title: The woman king
titles.summary: American historical epic starring Viola Davis as Nanisca, general of the all-female Dahomey Amazons. In 19th-century West Africa, General Nanisca (Davis) leads the elite warriors of Dahomey, known as the Agojie, as they fight off enemies that threaten their kingdom. While Nanisca trains the next generation of warriors, the Oyo Empire prepares to launch an assault on Dahomey. The cast also includes Thuso Mbedu, Lashana Lynch, Sheila Atim and John Boyega.

titles.title: Women on the verge of a nervous breakdown
titles.sortTitle: women on the verge of a nervous breakdown
titles.summary: Antonio Banderas and Carmen Maura star in this Spanish black comedy written and directed Pedro Almodóvar. The film follows Pepa Marcos (Maura), a distraught TV actress considering suicide after her long-time lover Iván (Fernando Guillén) leaves her without warning. When she lets out her flat, the new tenants turn out to be Iván's son Carlos (Banderas) and his fiancée Marisa (Rossy de Palma) which further complicates matters. Meanwhile, Pepa's friend Candela (Maria Barranco) is desperate to contact her after learning that her former lover is wanted by the police on terrorism charges.

titles.title: Wonder Woman
titles.summary: Patty Jenkins directs this action adventure starring Gal Gadot as the eponymous DC Comics superhero. Raised on the island of Themyscira, young princess Diana (Gadot) has been trained in the ways of her fellow Amazon warriors against the wishes of her mother Queen Hippolyta (Connie Nielsen) who sought to shield her from combat. As she begins to discover the true extent of her powers, Diana and her fellow Amazons are thrust into battle when American pilot Steve Trevor (Chris Pine) crash-lands just off the shores of Themyscira, pursued by the German military. When Steve tells them about the Great War currently raging across the world, Diana suspects that Ares, the god of war, from whom Zeus has long protected the Amazons, has returned and so she travels to London with Steve to put an end to the bloodshed. The cast also includes David Thewlis, Robin Wright and Lucy Davis.

titles.title: Wonder Woman 1984
titles.summary: Patty Jenkins returns to direct this action adventure sequel with Gal Gadot reprising her role as the eponymous DC Comics superheroine. In 1984, Amazon princess Diana (Gadot/Lilly Aspell) is working as an anthropologist at the Smithsonian Institute when she learns of a businessman, Maxwell Lord (Pedro Pascal), with the power to make wishes come true. While Diana uses Lord's Dreamstone to resurrect the spirit of Steve Trevor (Chris Pine), archaeologist Barbara Minerva (Kristen Wiig), who envies her co-worker Diana, is transformed into the ferocious Cheetah, who joins forces with Lord to defeat Wonder Woman.

titles.title: Wonderstruck
titles.summary: Todd Haynes directs this US drama adapted from Brian Selznick's novel. The film follows two stories set 50 years apart as two children set out on a journey of discovery. In 1927, 12-year-old deaf girl Rose (Millicent Simmonds) dreams of leaving her sheltered life in New Jersey and heads to New York to try and find her estranged mother. Meanwhile, in 1977, ten-year-old Ben (Oakes Fegley) sets off from rural Minnesota following the death of his mother as he attempts to track down his absent father in New York. The cast also includes Julianne Moore and Michelle Williams.

titles.title: Wonka
titles.summary: Timothée Chalamet stars as Willy Wonka in this musical fantasy prequel directed by Paul King. Ambitious young inventor Willy Wonka dreams of turning his mother's chocolate recipes into world-famous creations for everyone to enjoy. Having travelled the world in search of the finest ingredients, Wonka sets out to open his own chocolate shop full of treats in the city of London, but villainous chocolatiers Slugworth (Paterson Joseph), Fickelgruber (Matthew Baynton) and Prodnose (Matt Lucas) will stop at nothing to keep Wonka's delicious chocolate under wraps. The cast also includes Hugh Grant, Sally Hawkins and Olivia Colman.

titles.title: Woolly and Tig: The complete series 1
titles.sortTitle: woolly and tig: the complete series 1
titles.summary: All 30 episodes from the first series of the children's programme following three-year-old Tig (Betsy McCredie) and her toy spider, Woolly. Mixing live action and animation, each episode presents a potentially distressing, real-life situation, such as meeting animals for the first time, in a fun, light-hearted way. The episodes are: 'Baby Ben', 'The Funfair', 'The Dance Class', 'Hair Wash Day', 'Losing Things', 'First Day', 'The Clown', 'Eating New Foods', 'Open Wide', 'Timmy's Monsters', 'One Step at a Time', 'Fire Alarm', 'Swing Park', 'The Beard', 'Changing My Room', 'Museum of Imagination', 'Sharing', 'The Party', 'The Painting Day', 'Granny No No', 'The Bus Ride', 'Hospital', 'Choosing', 'Big Stomps', 'Splash', 'Busy', 'Supermarket,' Hair Cut', 'The Dog' and 'Sleepover'.

titles.title: The worst person in the world
titles.summary: Norwegian romantic comedy drama co-written and directed by Joachim Trier. The film follows four years in the life of Julie (Renate Reinsve) as she struggles to settle down and choose a career path while navigating relationships with graphic novelist Aksel (Anders Danielsen Lie) and barista Eivind (Herbert Nordrum) in Oslo.

titles.title: Wreck-it Ralph
titles.summary: Academy Award-nominated Disney animated feature following an arcade game villain who is tired of being the bad guy. After 30 years demolishing buildings in a popular video game, Ralph (voice of John C. Reilly) longs to feel what it's like to be a good guy. He takes off on a journey which leads him on a path through the gaming world but in his attempt to be a hero he unwittingly releases a threatening enemy, putting all of the arcade in danger. With the help of young racer Vanellope von Schweetz (Sarah Silverman), can Ralph repair the damage he has caused and learn how to save the day? The film also features the voice talents of Jack McBrayer, Jane Lynch and Alan Tudyk.

titles.title: "Wuthering Heights"
titles.summary: Emerald Fennell writes and directs this adaptation of Emily Brontë's novel starring Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi. When Mr. Earnshaw (Martin Clunes) rescues Heathcliff (Elordi) from the streets of Liverpool and decides to raise him alongside his daughter Cathy (Robbie), their fates are irrevocably entwined. They are close as children but as they grow to adulthood, their feelings for each other change and heartbreak and tragedy await. The cast also includes Hong Chau, Alison Oliver and Shazad Latif.

titles.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
titles.summary: Film-maker Simon Kinberg has his directorial debut with this latest instalment of the 'X-Men' franchise based on the Marvel Comics characters. When a NASA space mission fails, leaving its team of astronauts stuck in their shuttle in free orbit, the X-Men are recruited to venture into outer space to save them. However, their rescue goes wrong and Jean Grey (Sophie Turner) is caught in a horrific explosion. Against all odds, she survives, but as a result of the explosion she is mutated even further and her powers become extraordinary. The X-Men begin to fear her capability to carry out serious destruction, and when Jean, the Dark Phoenix, begins to sense their mistrust she goes rogue and puts many lives at risk. Will they ever be able to resurrect the real Jean or will they have to destroy the corrupted Dark Phoenix?

titles.title: X-Men: Days of future past
titles.summary: Hugh Jackman, Ian McKellen and Patrick Stewart star in this superhero action adventure sequel directed by Bryan Singer. When the survivors of the battle in 'X-Men: The Last Stand' (2006) led by Magneto (McKellen), Professor X (Stewart) and Storm (Halle Berry) discover that total annihilation now awaits humans and mutants alike, they send the ageless Wolverine (Jackman) back in time to try and change the course of events. In the past, Wolverine must team up with the younger incarnations of the X-Men including Charles Xavier (James McAvoy), Erik Lensherr (Michael Fassbender) and Mystique (Jennifer Lawrence), to avert disaster, but will he succeed? The cast also includes Peter Dinklage, Nicholas Hoult and Evan Peters.

titles.title: X-Men: Days of future past - The Rogue cut
titles.sortTitle: x-men: days of future past - the rogue cut
titles.summary: Extended cut of the blockbuster superhero sequel based on the characters from the Marvel comic strip. With a storyline that alternates between the past and present, the film acts as a direct sequel to three separate films, 'X-Men: The Last Stand' (2006), 'X-Men: First Class' (2011) and 'The Wolverine' (2013). When the survivors of the battle in 'X-Men: The Last Stand', led by Magneto (Ian McKellen), Professor X (Patrick Stewart) and Storm (Halle Berry), discover that total annihilation now awaits humans and mutants alike, they send the ageless Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) back in time to try and change the course of events. In the past, Wolverine must team up with the younger incarnations of the X-Men seen in 'X-Men: First Class', Charles Xavier (James McAvoy), Magneto (Michael Fassbender) and Mystique (Jennifer Lawrence), to avert disaster. Will he succeed? This extended cut features an extra 17 minutes of previously deleted scenes that focus on the character of Rogue, played by Anna Paquin.

titles.title: Yardie
titles.summary: Idris Elba directs this British crime drama based on Victor Headley's novel. The film follows D (Aml Ameen), a young Jamaican man still trying to come to terms with the murder of his brother some years before. After heading to London to deliver drugs for a Kingston gangster, D is reunited with his ex-girlfriend and young daughter while also getting involved with the local gangs. However, when he looks to gain his revenge on the man who killed his brother, D soon comes into conflict with vicious London mobster Rico (Stephen Graham).

titles.title: Yellowjackets: Season one
titles.summary: All ten episodes from the first season of the US drama where members of a high school girls' soccer team survive a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness. The survivors are stranded for 19 months and the drama explores their attempts to stay alive in 1996 while also tracking their current lives as adults in 2021. The episodes are: 'Pilot', 'F Sharp', 'The Dollhouse', 'Bear Down', 'Blood Hive', 'Saints', 'No Compass', 'Flight of the Bumblebee', 'Doomcoming' and 'Sic Transit Gloria Mundi'.

titles.title: Yellowjackets: Season two
titles.summary: All nine episodes from the second season of the US drama where members of a high school girls' soccer team survive a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness. The survivors are stranded for 19 months and the drama explores their attempts to stay alive in 1996 while also tracking their current lives as adults in 2021. In this season, the Yellowjackets' battle for survival is made even more desperate as the harsh Canadian winter takes hold and an eerie feeling of darkness leaves them fighting for their sanity. The episodes are: 'Friends, Romans, Countrymen', 'Edible Complex', 'Digestif', 'Old Wounds', 'Two Truths and a Lie', 'Qui', 'Burial', 'It Chooses' and 'Storytelling'.

titles.title: You and the night
titles.summary: French sex comedy featuring a soundtrack written by Anthony Gonzalez of the French electronic music band M83 and starring Kate Moran, Niels Schneider and Nicolas Maury. After dark, the house of Ali and Matthias (Moran and Schneider) comes alive as they embark upon a routine orgy with their transvestite maid Udo (Maury) and specially invited guests including The Slut (Julie Brémond), The Stud (Eric Cantona), The Teen (Alain Fabien Delon) and The Star (Fanienne Babe). One by one, their guests arrive; each with their own secrets and perversions that will be uncovered throughout the course of the evening. The film also stars Béatrice Dalle and Jean-Christophe Bouvet.

titles.title: You'll never be alone
titles.summary: Chilean drama which marks the feature debut of writer and director Alex Anwandter. After his gay teenage son Pablo (Andrew Bargsted) is the victim of a horrific homophobic attack which leaves him in a coma, Juan (Sergio Hernández) is faced with getting over the ordeal whilst paying his mounting medical bills. Meanwhile, the single father also persistently continues with his desire to be made a partner at the mannequin factory where he works as a manager. However, when he is met with disappointment at every juncture Juan is left with some tough choices regarding his own and his son's future.

titles.title: Young and innocent
titles.summary: Hitchcock-directed comedy thriller. When a young woman is found strangled on the seashore, Robert Tisdall (Derrick De Marney) is quickly identified as the chief suspect in the case. The young man protests his innocence, but it seems that only Erica Burgoyne (Nova Pilbeam), the eighteen-year-old daughter of the local police constable, is prepared to believe him. Together, the unlikely duo set out to find the real killer. An early blueprint for such Hitchcock classics as 'To Catch a Thief' and 'North by Northwest'.

titles.title: Young hearts
titles.summary: Lou Goossens and Marius De Saeger star in this coming-of-age drama written and directed by Anthony Schatteman. Teenager Elias (Goossens) lives in rural Belgium and struggles to cope when he realises that he is falling in love with his new neighbour Alexander (De Saeger), who has recently moved from Brussels and is far more confident in his sexuality. Can Elias overcome his fears and embrace his true self or will he lose this chance at love? The cast also includes Geert Van Rampelberg, Emilie De Roo and Dirk van Dijck.

titles.title: Your honor
titles.summary: All ten episodes of the American crime drama starring Bryan Cranston as New Orleans judge Michael Desiato. When his teenage son Adam (Hunter Doohan) is involved in a fatal hit and run accident, Michael goes to extreme lengths to protect him when he discovers the victim was the son of Jimmy Baxter (Michael Stuhlbarg), the head of a local organised crime family. However, Michael's attempts to destroy all evidence of his son's involvement lead an innocent teenager to be imprisoned for murder, with tragic consequences, as Jimmy sets out to avenge his son's death.

titles.title: Yuli - The Carlos Acosta story
titles.summary: Icíar Bollaín directs this biographical drama focusing on the life of Cuban ballet dancer Carlos Acosta (Keyvin Martínez/Edlison Manuel Olbera Núñez). The film follows Acosta from his formative years growing up in an impoverished family in Havana and chronicles his rise to stardom. Despite his natural talent, he is initially reluctant to embrace ballet but is encouraged by his strict father, who pushes him to enrol in dance training at a young age. After studying at the Cuban National Ballet School, Acosta enjoys enormous worldwide success and joins the Royal Ballet, becoming the company's first black principal.

titles.title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
titles.summary: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill and Gal Gadot return to star in this superhero action adventure, directed by Zack Snyder, which follows on from the events of 'Batman v Superman - Dawn of Justice' (2016). Following Superman (Cavill)'s death, and with the world mourning his demise, Batman (Affleck) and Wonder Woman (Gadot) unite to form a team of superheroes to protect Earth from the looming invasion of Steppenwolf (voice of Ciarán Hinds) and his army of Parademons. They recruit metahumans Aquaman (Jason Momoa), Cyborg (Ray Fisher) and The Flash (Ezra Miller) to join them. But will the new league of heroes be able to put a stop to Steppenwolf's quest for world domination?

titles.title: Zama
titles.summary: Lucrecia Martel writes and directs this Argentine drama based on the novel by Antonio di Benedetto. Set in the late 18th century, the film follows Don Diego de Zama (Daniel Giménez Cacho), an officer of the Spanish Empire, as he eagerly awaits a royal transfer to Buenos Aires from his remote post in Asunción. Separated from his family, Zama struggles with his isolation and longs for professional advancement but his attempts are continually rebuffed by his superiors until he leaves the colony to join a band of soldiers in pursuit of a notorious criminal.

titles.title: Zana
titles.summary: Kosovan-Albanian historical drama co-written and directed by Antoneta Kastrati. Unable to conceive another child since losing her first-born, Albanian Lume (Adriana Matoshi) is pressured into visiting a healer, who informs her she is possessed. Traumatised by her past and suffering from intense nightmares, will Lume and her husband Ilir (Astrit Kabashi) be able to welcome another child into their lives?

titles.title: Zog
titles.summary: Children's animation based on the book by Julia Donaldson in which a clumsy yet enthusiastic dragon named Zog (voice of Hugh Skinner) must ace his way through dragon school. His biggest challenge yet comes in the form of a daring rescue of Princess Pearl (Patsy Ferran), meaning Zog must use all his learned dragon skills to save her. Will he save the princess and earn his long-awaited gold star?

titles.title: Zombieland
titles.summary: Comedy horror starring Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg and Bill Murray. In a world inhabited largely by zombies the few remaining humans are forced, rather reluctantly, to band together in order to avoid falling foul of their flesh-eating neighbours. Columbus (Eisenberg) is petrified of the zombies that surround him and is much happier running away from them, while Tallahassee (Harrelson) is slightly more fearless, chosing to kick zombie ass at every opportunity. However, the two unlikely comrades join forces, along with other living humans Little Rock and Wichita (Abigail Breslin and Emma Stone), in order to battle the zombies and eke out a way of survival.

titles.title: Zoolander no. 2
titles.summary: Comedy directed and co-written by Ben Stiller who also stars, reprising his role as dim but affable model Derek Zoolander. When pop stars start being taken out by hitmen, giving the Zoolander signature 'Blue Steel' look before dying, FBI agent Melanie Valentina (Penélope Cruz) begins investigating. She calls on Zoolander and Hansel (Owen Wilson) to infiltrate the new world of high fashion to uncover the truth about the pop star killings. At this point, however, Zoolander and Hansel are now aged, washed-up models. A complication arises in the form of their old foe Mugatu (Will Ferrell), who has been recently released from prison and is bent on revenge. The all-star cast also features cameos from Ariana Grande, Justin Bieber, Kim Kardashian, Kanye West and Usher.

titles.title: Zoology
titles.summary: Natalya Pavlenkova stars in this Russian drama written and directed by Ivan I. Tverdovskij. The film follows 55-year-old Natasha (Pavlenkova), a lonely zoo worker still living at home with her mother. Already tormented by nasty rumours spread about her by her co-workers, Natasha is mortified to wake up one day and find she has grown a tail. After being told that her condition is inoperable, she decides to embrace her transformation and even starts a relationship with a young radiologist named Peter (Dmitriy Groshev). However, despite enjoying her new lease of life, the persistent rumours of a woman in her neighbourhood being marked by the devil force Natasha to face up to some big decisions about her future.

titles.title: Zootropolis
titles.summary: Disney animated adventure featuring the voice talents of Jason Bateman, Ginnifer Goodwin, Idris Elba and J.K. Simmons. Zootropolis is a city full of anthropomorphic animals where newly-trained police officer Judy Hopps (Goodwin), a rabbit, strives to prove herself to her tough boss, Police Chief Bogo (Elba). When a number of citizens start disappearing, Judy investigates. However, with Bogo already displeased with her performance, she is given only two days to solve the case and told that if she fails, she will lose her job. Desperate, Judy teams up with an unlikely ally, fox Nick Wilde (Bateman), and together they race against time to find the criminal responsible for the missing animals.

titles.title: Zootropolis 2
titles.summary: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voice talents of Jason Bateman and Ginnifer Goodwin. Rabbit Judy Hopps (Goodwin) and fox Nick Wilde (Bateman) are now partners at the Zootropolis Police Department but they are struggling to work effectively together due to their vastly different personalities. As they attempt to salvage their working relationship, they become involved in a case that has serious implications for the future of Zootropolis and they must join forces with pit viper Gary De'Snake (Ke Huy Quan) to expose a sinister conspiracy. The voice cast also includes David Straithairn, Andy Samberg and Idris Elba.
